colors.name: black

colors.item: drips and cracks in the clay
colors.name: dark brown

head: lumpy clay head
open jaws
top: bare clay chest with a huge gaping mouth

appearance_text: A lumpy creature made entirely of soft orange-brown clay, with no clothes and no clear arms or legs, just melting drippy shapes. Its head has two staring white eyes and jaws stretched wide open. Right in the middle of its chest is another huge black mouth lined with white teeth, and dark cracks and drips run down its back and legs.
identity_text: Clayface, the shape-shifting DC Comics supervillain, rendered as a melting orange-brown clay creature with gaping toothy mouths on its head and its chest.

head: small black cat ears with dark red insides

appearance_text: A pale girl dressed all in black, with long black hair and a heavy fringe that hides her eyes completely. Two small black cat ears with dark red insides poke up from her head. She wears a black jacket over a dark red top, a short black skirt, and long black socks that reach her thighs with rips in them.
identity_text: A teenage girl in goth and emo style, dressed head to toe in black with a dark red top, wearing small cat ears and ripped thigh-high socks, her long fringe hiding her eyes.

colors.item: folded-wing design painted on the torso back and arms (no wing layer)
colors.name: black

face: huge bright green eyes with slit pupils
head: small pointed ear flaps on top of the head

appearance_text: A sleek all black dragon with huge glowing green eyes and two little pointed ear flaps standing up on its head. Its whole body is dark charcoal scales, with sharp white claws on its hands and feet. Broad folded wings are drawn across its back.
identity_text: Toothless, the sleek black dragon from How To Train Your Dragon, with huge glowing green eyes, little pointed ear flaps and sharp white claws.

head: black band across the top of the head
top: dark blue top laced with pink cords

appearance_text: A man with a thick grey beard and a black band across the top of his head. He wears a long pale white coat with wide sleeves over a dark blue top laced up the chest with pink cords. His trousers are dark blue and his boots are black.
identity_text: Professor Turo from Pokémon Violet, a grey-bearded man in a pale wide-sleeved coat over a dark blue top laced up with pink cords.

head: plain cream head with orange patches
no clear face

appearance_text: A figure in heavy armour with a plain cream head marked with orange patches and no clear eyes or mouth. The chest is a dark blue armoured plate with grey guards over the shoulders and a black suit beneath it. The legs are black with grey plates over the knees and heavy black boots. A round blue emblem is set into the armour on the back.
identity_text: An armoured fighter in a dark blue and black battle suit with grey plating and a featureless pale gold head. The title names the job, not a character.

face: two white tusks pointing up from the jaw
head: heavy green brow
broad green jaw

appearance_text: A hulking creature with rough green skin, a heavy brow shading two glowing dark red eyes, and two thick white tusks curving up from its lower jaw. Its chest and arms are bare and heavily muscled in mottled green. A tan cloth is wrapped around its waist and hangs down between its green legs. Its feet are bare and the same mottled green as the rest of it.
identity_text: A hulking green-skinned brute with a heavy brow, dark red eyes and two white tusks curving up from its jaw, bare-chested with a tan loincloth. The listing places it in World of Warcraft.

footwear: orange rocket flames instead of feet
head: grey metal helmet
wide red visor
top: dark chest plate with red lights

appearance_text: A tall metal robot built from grey plates with a wide glowing red band where its eyes should be. Its chest is a dark panel with small red lights and heavy shoulder pieces sit on either side. Instead of feet, orange and yellow rocket flames blast out beneath its legs.
identity_text: BebopVox, the Minecraft YouTuber who hosted the Minecraft Monday Show, drawn as his robot avatar: grey metal plating, a wide glowing red visor and rocket flames where the feet should be.

head: brown hair
grey metal plating over one side of the head

appearance_text: A man in a plain cyan t-shirt and blue trousers with grey shoes, with short brown hair and a brown beard. One whole side of his face has been stripped away to bare grey metal, and where the eye should be there is a glowing red light. The rest of him looks completely ordinary, with bare arms and a plain back.
identity_text: The default Minecraft player skin with one side of its head torn back to bare metal and a glowing red eye, presented in the listing as a terminator.

appearance_text: A pale girl with long wavy light brown hair that falls all the way down her back, with small pink flowers and one orange flower tucked into it. Her eyes are bright green. She wears an open pale blue cardigan over a short grey blue top with a strap crossing the chest, leaving a strip of her middle showing. Her trousers are white and her shoes are white too.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with long wavy light brown hair dotted with little flowers, wearing an open pale blue cardigan over a cropped grey-blue top, with white trousers and white shoes.

colors.item: bolts and frame on the helmet
colors.name: gold

head: round metal diving helmet
gold bolts
square green window
top: green seaweed trailing over the shoulders

appearance_text: A figure inside a heavy round metal diving helmet studded with gold bolts, with a small square window in the front glowing faintly green so no face can be seen. The suit is thick brown canvas with a grey metal plate across the chest and a metal collar at the neck. Strands of green seaweed hang over the shoulders and trail down the back, and the boots are heavy brown.
identity_text: A deep sea diver in an old-fashioned bolted helmet and heavy canvas suit, with seaweed caught over the shoulders. The title names the occupation, not a character.

appearance_text: A pale girl with a soft light purple bob and two furry grey and purple cat ears standing up on her head, with dark eyes and a faint blush. She wears a fluffy light purple jacket with baggy sleeves over a short white top, showing a little of her middle. A grey checked skirt sits below, and thick grey and white leg warmers cover her legs down to her feet.
identity_text: An unnamed girl styled as a kitten, with grey-and-purple cat ears, a light purple bob and a fluffy pastel outfit.

head: blue shark hood with fins and teeth
top: blue hoodie with a red pattern on the chest

appearance_text: A pale girl with short light blue hair and big blue eyes, wearing a blue shark hood with a fin on top and little white teeth around the face. Her blue hoodie has white drawstrings and a red and white pattern across the chest, and a chunky blue shark tail hangs down behind her. Below it she wears a short white skirt, striped blue and white socks and black shoes.
identity_text: Gawr Gura, the virtual YouTuber named in the listing, wearing her blue shark hoodie with a finned, toothed hood and a shark tail, over a short white skirt and blue and white striped socks.

bottom: red shorts with a black waistband

appearance_text: A strong man with brown skin, short black hair and a muscly chest and arms that are left bare. He wears red shorts with a black waistband around his middle. On his feet are tall white boxing boots with grey stripes down the sides.
identity_text: Muhammad Ali, the American heavyweight boxer, shown bare-chested in boxing trunks, gloves and boots.

top: navy checked flannel shirt hanging open

appearance_text: A young person with bright green hair tied up in little bunches with a long fringe over the eyes. They wear a navy blue checked flannel shirt hanging open over a plain black top. Below are short black shorts, with bare legs underneath.
identity_text: A teenager with vivid green hair falling over the eyes, wearing an open navy checked flannel shirt over black clothes and pale beige boots.

appearance_text: A tall muscular man with tall spiky magenta hair and sharp pink eyes, the lower half of his face wrapped in a cream scarf. His chest is bare apart from black straps crossing it, with pink bands on his upper arms and pink markings down his sides. He wears dark blue trousers striped in pink and grey that carry on around the back, ending in dark boots.
identity_text: Katakuri from One Piece, a tall muscular man with tall spiky magenta hair, a cream scarf over his mouth, a bare strapped chest and striped dark trousers.

face: huge wide grin full of white teeth
subjects: grinning man in a red plaid jacket

appearance_text: A man with messy dark brown hair and a receding hairline, wild raised eyebrows and a huge unsettling grin full of white teeth. He wears a red plaid jacket with the checks carrying over the sleeves and the whole back, with a grey checked shirt showing at the collar and chest. Faded blue jeans and dark brown shoes finish him off.
identity_text: Jack Torrance, the central character of Stanley Kubrick's The Shining, in a red plaid jacket and blue jeans with a huge manic grin.

head: hood down at the back
top: baggy light blue hoodie with a drawstring

appearance_text: A boy with fluffy brown hair falling in a fringe over bright blue eyes. He wears a roomy light blue hoodie with a drawstring at the neck and the hood down on his back. Plain black trousers and white shoes finish the outfit.
identity_text: An unnamed boy in everyday clothes: a roomy light blue hoodie, black trousers and white shoes.

face: grey mask over the nose and mouth
head: hood pulled up over the head

appearance_text: A boy with short brown hair and brown eyes, with a grey cloth mask pulled up over his nose and mouth. He wears a soft grey-blue hoodie with a big front pocket and pale drawstrings, and the hood is pulled up over his head so it shows from behind. He finishes the outfit with plain black trousers and white shoes.
identity_text: A boy in a grey-blue hoodie worn with the hood up and a grey cloth mask over his nose and mouth, with black trousers and white shoes. A generic streetwear character rather than a named one.

appearance_text: A person with spiky grey hair hanging over their eyes. They wear a black t-shirt with a white long-sleeved shirt underneath, so white cuffs show at the wrists. The trousers are dark red held up by a brown belt, and the shoes are white with black toes.
identity_text: An unnamed teenager with spiky grey hair wearing a black t-shirt over a white long-sleeved shirt, with dark red trousers and white shoes.

subjects: elderly man in a dark suit
top: dark navy suit jacket over a white shirt with a blue tie

appearance_text: An elderly pale man with thin white hair, white eyebrows and small dark eyes in a lined face. He wears a dark navy suit jacket buttoned over a white shirt with a bright blue tie, plain navy across the shoulders and back. Matching navy trousers run down to plain black shoes.
identity_text: Joe Biden, the 46th President of the United States, shown as an elderly man in a dark navy suit with a white shirt and blue tie.

top: blue tunic with black shoulder pads

appearance_text: A bearded fighter with dark brown hair and blank glowing white eyes that have no pupils at all. He wears a blue sleeveless tunic with chunky black shoulder pads and a gold buckle at the waist, leaving his arms bare. Blue trousers run down to heavy grey and white boots with gold trim.
identity_text: Herobrine, the white-eyed Minecraft legend, dressed here as a warrior in a blue sleeveless tunic with black shoulder pads and iron gauntlets.

head: small red and white hat
top: green and white stripes on the sleeves

appearance_text: A girl with long light brown hair falling all the way down her back, with green eyes and pink cheeks. She wears a red winter jumper with a fluffy white collar and green and white bands around the sleeves, topped by a small red and white hat. Below is a light blue skirt, red and white candy cane striped socks and short black boots.
identity_text: An unnamed girl dressed for Christmas in a red jumper with a white fur collar, a light blue skirt and candy cane striped socks. The title describes the festive outfit rather than naming anyone.

appearance_text: A brown bear standing on two legs with small round ears and glowing orange eyes. Its muzzle and belly are a lighter tan than the rest of its thick brown fur. Black claws show on its front paws and back feet.
identity_text: A brown bear standing on two legs, with small round ears, a tan muzzle and belly, amber eyes and black claws.

appearance_text: A tall figure whose head is a lumpy sack of dirty tan cloth, with two big empty black holes for eyes and a crooked row of stitches for a mouth. Its body hangs inside a ragged dark brown coat that is torn at the collar and frayed at the sleeves. The trousers are a dull grey-green and its boots are caked in brown mud. The coat is just as worn and blotchy across the back.
identity_text: A scarecrow risen from the dead, its head a dirty sack of tan cloth with two empty black eye holes and a crooked row of stitches for a mouth. It hangs inside a torn brown coat over dull grey-green trousers and muddy boots.

head: long pink hair
top: pink top over a grey shirt

appearance_text: A girl with long bright pink hair that hangs all the way down her back and red eyes. She wears a pink top layered over a grey shirt with grey sleeves, and a dark grey skirt. Her boots are dark red and reach up her shins.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with very long bright pink hair, in a pink top layered over a grey shirt, a dark grey skirt and dark red boots.

head: huge pointed green ears
wrinkled green head
top: worn brown robe with a dark sash across the chest

appearance_text: A small green-skinned creature with a deeply wrinkled face, wide white eyes and huge pointed ears sticking out from the sides of its head. It is wrapped in a plain worn brown robe with a darker sash crossing the chest. The robe hangs all the way to the ground and the back is the same faded brown.
identity_text: Yoda, the small green-skinned Jedi Master of the Star Wars films, shown as a wrinkled green figure wrapped in a plain worn brown robe with a dark sash across the chest.

hair: long brown hair down the back
head: crown of white daisies and green leaves

appearance_text: A girl with long brown hair swept over one eye, wearing a crown of white daisies and green leaves. Over a short grey top she has an open white jacket with long sleeves, and below that a pair of light blue denim shorts. Her legs are bare down to chunky black boots with white laces, and her eyes are bright blue.
identity_text: An unnamed girl wearing a white daisy crown, an open white jacket over a grey crop top, light denim shorts and chunky black boots.

head: black peaked cap with a stiff brim

appearance_text: A pale man with short black hair and blue eyes under a stiff black peaked cap. He wears a long brown military coat crossed with leather straps and buckles, a small device clipped to his chest and a red armband on one sleeve. His trousers are dark grey with a red stripe down the side, tucked into tall black boots.
identity_text: One of the four playable characters from Call of Duty: Black Ops Zombies, the German officer and doctor of the group, in a stiff peaked cap, long brown military greatcoat crossed with straps, and grey trousers tucked into tall black boots.

appearance_text: A boy with short brown hair swept over his forehead. He wears a dark grey hoodie left open over a white shirt with a grey tie, and the sleeves end in white cuffs. His jeans are light blue and his shoes are black with white soles.
identity_text: A brown-haired boy in a black-and-grey checked hoodie worn over a white shirt and tie, with light blue jeans and black-and-white shoes. The title describes the garment, so no character is named.

face: big white eyes with black pupils
head: ear tufts
brown feathered head

appearance_text: A standing bird creature covered in brown feathers, with small tufts sticking up on either side of its head. Big round white eyes sit above a wide yellow beak. Its chest and belly are pale blue-white, and folded brown wings hang from its arms. The legs are striped yellow and brown and end in orange talons.
identity_text: A standing brown bird creature with a wide yellow beak, ear tufts and striped legs; the listing describes it as a cross between a bear, a deer and a bird.

bottom: yellow and black striped black and yellow striped thigh-high socks

colors.item: stripes on the black and yellow striped thigh-high socks
colors.name: yellow

head: small black ears

appearance_text: A girl with long bright orange hair speckled with black, orange eyes, and two small black ears poking up from her head. She wears a black off the shoulder top with a chunky gold chain hanging round her neck, and short black shorts. Her legs are covered in bold yellow and black stripes above chunky black boots.
identity_text: A girl with very long black-speckled orange hair and two small pointed black ears, dressed in a black off-shoulder top with a gold chain, black shorts and bold yellow and black striped thigh-highs above chunky boots.

appearance_text: A boy with messy pink hair swept over dark eyes. He wears a black leather jacket hanging open over a plain white t-shirt, the jacket solid black across the shoulders and back. His jeans are light blue with rips at the knees, and he stands in black trainers with white soles.
identity_text: An unnamed teenage boy with messy pink hair, wearing an open black leather jacket over a white t-shirt with ripped light blue jeans and black trainers. The title describes the look, not a character.

head: cream fur trimmed hood pulled up

appearance_text: A figure bundled into a padded dark red puffer jacket with thick quilted sleeves and a black zip down the middle. A hood with a fluffy cream fur edge is pulled up around black hair that falls over the eyes. Grey jeans and dark grey boots finish the outfit.
identity_text: An unnamed figure bundled into a padded dark red puffer jacket with a cream fur-trimmed hood pulled up over black hair, worn with grey jeans and dark grey boots.

face: dark teal mouth full of white fangs
head: two dark curved horns
icy white head

appearance_text: A frozen creature made of pale white and icy blue ice, glowing and frosty all over. Its head has two dark curved horns and a dark mouth packed with sharp white fangs. The arms and legs look like chunks of ice with frost running down them, and its back is covered in the same icy crust.
identity_text: An original frozen monster made of glowing white and pale blue ice, with two dark curved horns and a dark teal mouth full of sharp white fangs.

hair: orange hair combed over the forehead
head: bright orange hair

appearance_text: A short boy with bright orange hair combed flat over his forehead and thick black glasses that cover most of his eyes. He wears a white lab coat buttoned down the front with long purple gloves reaching up his arms. His trousers and boots are black.
identity_text: Dexter, the boy genius from the cartoon Dexter's Laboratory, in his buttoned white lab coat and long purple gloves, with heavy black glasses under flat orange hair.

accessories: little black bows on the legs
head: fluffy animal ears with yellow insides

appearance_text: A pale girl with very long white hair that has a soft blue tint and falls all the way down her back. Fluffy animal ears with yellow insides sit on top of her head, and she has big light purple eyes. She wears a dark blue dress sprinkled with little yellow stars, and long white socks with tiny black bows.
identity_text: An unnamed pale girl with very long white-blue hair and rounded animal ears, wearing a dark navy dress sprinkled with little yellow stars.

accessories: green vines curling over the shoulders
jagged white mouths at the wrists and ankles
grey scythe strapped to the back
head: carved pumpkin head
glowing yellow eyes
top: orange pumpkin body with green vines

appearance_text: A monster whose head is a carved orange pumpkin with glowing yellow eyes and a wide jagged grin. Its chest is pumpkin skin too, ridged in orange, with green vines curling over the shoulders and down the arms. Small jagged white mouths open at the wrists and ankles, the trousers are blue with more vines, and a grey scythe is strapped across the back.
identity_text: A pumpkin monster whose head and chest are carved orange pumpkin flesh, with glowing yellow eyes, a jagged grin, green vines trailing over its limbs and a grey scythe strapped across its back. No character name is given.

hair: very long hair down the back
head: long dark red hair
small rainbow flowers in the hair at the back

appearance_text: A girl with very long dark red hair that falls all the way down her back, dotted with tiny rainbow flowers, and bright blue eyes. She wears a strapless top striped in rainbow colours with matching striped briefs, leaving her shoulders, arms, middle and legs bare. Rainbow bands circle her upper arms and ankles, and a purple flower sits low on her back.
identity_text: A girl with very long dark red hair wearing a rainbow striped strapless top and matching briefs, with rainbow bands round her arms and ankles.

appearance_text: A big crocodile-like creature covered in light blue scales, with a cream belly and a long cream jaw. A bright red crest sits on top of its snout between small black eyes, with orange patches beside the mouth. A row of red spikes runs down its back. Its arms and legs are chunky and blue, ending in white claws.
identity_text: Feraligatr, the big blue crocodile-like water Pokémon from the Johto region, with a red crest on its snout and red spikes down its back.

appearance_text: A boy with dark brown hair swept across his forehead and plain dark eyes. He wears a black hoodie with a small white shape at the collar and two white stripes near each cuff. His trousers are grey and his shoes are black with white soles. The hoodie is plain black across the back.
identity_text: A brown-haired boy in a plain black hoodie with white trim, grey trousers and black shoes with white soles.

head: short peachy pink hair with a fringe

appearance_text: A girl with short peachy pink hair and grey eyes. She wears a dark red jacket over a purple dungaree dress with straps over the shoulders and a small pink heart on the chest. Her legs are bare below the short skirt and she has plain white shoes.
identity_text: A peachy pink haired girl in a dark red jacket over a purple pinafore dress with a small pink heart on the chest, bare legs and white shoes. The title is a given name, not a character.

colors.item: long grey hair and beard (no scarf)
colors.name: grey

head: wide blue grey pointed hat
top: dark brown robe with a grey scarf

appearance_text: An old man almost hidden under a wide, floppy blue grey pointed hat, with a long cream beard spilling out beneath it and hair down the back. His long robe is dark brown and patchy, worn over a pale grey scarf that spreads across the chest and shoulders. The robe hangs all the way to his dark boots.
identity_text: Gandalf the Grey, the wandering wizard from The Lord of the Rings, under a wide floppy pointed hat with his long beard over a dark travelling robe.

appearance_text: A girl with long brown hair and pink blushed cheeks, wearing a brown hooded jacket with two rounded animal ears on the hood. A small pink flower sits in her hair. The jacket hangs open over a white top, with white shorts below. Long dark brown socks come right up her legs, and her hair falls in a thick sheet down her back.
identity_text: A brown-haired girl in a brown animal-eared hoodie worn open over a white top and white shorts, with long dark socks.

head: long wavy brown hair
white hair clip at the back

appearance_text: A girl with long wavy brown hair held with a small white clip, blue eyes and pink blush on her cheeks. She wears a pale blue jacket open over a white top, with a short light blue denim skirt. Cream socks pull up over her knees and her boots are dark brown.
identity_text: An ordinary girl with long wavy brown hair in a blue-themed everyday outfit. The title describes her look and does not name anyone who exists outside this skin.

appearance_text: A girl with very long hair that mixes deep purple with pale blue streaks, falling past her waist. Two pointed animal ears sit on her head and a small pink flower is tucked beside one of them. She wears an open pale blue hoodie jacket over a white shirt with a purple pleated skirt, and her legs are in long pale blue socks under chunky purple boots.
identity_text: A girl with pointed animal ears and very long purple hair streaked with pale blue, in an open pale blue hoodie over a white shirt, a purple pleated skirt and chunky purple boots. 'Rising Tide' names the colour scheme, not a character.

appearance_text: A man with short black hair parted at the side, wearing grey-rimmed glasses over a pale face. He has on an open black jacket over a white dress shirt with a dark red tie hanging down the front, and the jacket is plain black across the back. His legs are in dark blue jeans and his feet in brown shoes.
identity_text: Doug Walker, the American comedian who created the Nostalgia Critic web series, in a black jacket, white shirt and dark red tie.

face: grey breathing mask over the mouth
head: brown swept hair
dark grey mask over the mouth
top: big light blue gem on the chest

appearance_text: A man with brown swept back hair, thick eyebrows and a dark grey mask covering his nose and mouth. He wears a flowing red robe edged in gold, with a large pale blue gem set in the middle of his chest and another on his back. A gold sash hangs down the front and his trousers are tan with gold stripes.
identity_text: A man in a flowing red robe trimmed with gold, a big pale blue gem set into his chest and another on his back, and a dark grey mask over the lower half of his face.

appearance_text: A teenage boy with black hair swept over one side so only one bright blue eye shows. Light blue and white headphones sit over his ears. He wears a blue hoodie with black panels on the chest and arms, a white scarf at the neck and a belt at the waist, with black trousers and blue and white shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed teenage boy in a blue jacket with headphones over his ears and his hair swept across one eye. The title describes him rather than naming him.

appearance_text: A boy with messy brown hair and peach skin, wearing a roomy grey hoodie with white drawstrings and a pocket across the front. The whole back of the hoodie carries a darker grey face with two square eyes and an open frowning mouth, and the hood hangs behind his head. His jeans are dark blue and his shoes are blue with white soles.
identity_text: A brown haired boy in a roomy grey hoodie with white drawstrings and a creeper face printed across the back, with dark blue jeans and blue shoes.

appearance_text: A green cactus stands upright as a person, with a tall dark brown top hat sitting on its flat green head. It wears a crisp white dress shirt with a dark brown waistcoat, and criss-cross suspenders show across the back. Dark brown trousers cover the legs down to dark shoes, and the green cactus skin shows at the neck and hands.
identity_text: A green cactus standing upright as a person and dressed as a gentleman, in a tall dark brown top hat, white dress shirt, waistcoat with criss-cross suspenders and dark trousers.

appearance_text: A boy with short brown hair swept across his forehead and green eyes. He wears a bright orange hoodie with a hood hanging down his back and small drawstrings at the collar. He also has black trousers and black shoes with white soles.
identity_text: A boy with short brown hair in a bright orange hoodie with the hood down, black trousers and black shoes with white soles.

colors.item: animal face on the back of the hoodie
colors.name: dark brown

hair: messy black hair with a fringe
head: messy black hair

appearance_text: A boy with messy black hair and blue eyes. He wears a rusty brown hoodie with white bands at the cuffs and the hood folded down behind his neck. His jeans are dark blue and his shoes are white with brown tops. A big dark brown animal face with a scowling mouth is printed across the back of the hoodie.
identity_text: An unnamed boy with messy black hair in a rust-red hoodie, dark jeans and white shoes. The Creeper face is printed on the back of his hoodie, so it is what he is wearing rather than what he is.

colors.item: glowing eye on the black side
colors.name: pink

colors.item: glowing cracks on the black side
colors.name: cyan

head: green head on one side
black void on the other side
top: black half with glowing cyan cracks

appearance_text: A green-skinned undead figure with dark sunken eyes on one side of its face, while the other half of its head is solid black with one glowing pink eye. It wears a teal shirt and blue trousers, both half eaten away by black patches with glowing cyan cracks running through them. The same cracks glow brightly across its back and down one leg.
identity_text: A fan-made fusion of two Minecraft mobs: a green undead figure whose left half has been consumed by black void shot through with glowing cyan cracks. It is a made-up hybrid rather than an existing named mob.

colors.item: trim and buttons on the robe
colors.name: gold

appearance_text: A bearded man with long brown hair falling down his back and a wide gold crown sitting on his head. He wears a long cream robe fastened with gold buttons, with gold pads over the shoulders and wide sleeves banded in gold. A light blue and gold sash wraps his waist, the robe hangs long behind him, and he stands in brown boots.
identity_text: A generic fantasy king: a bearded man with long brown hair under a wide gold crown, in a long cream robe trimmed with gold and a blue sash at the waist.

appearance_text: A boy whose hair is split down the middle, gold on one side and black on the other, with brown eyes and pale skin. He wears an open black jacket over a gold shirt, and the sleeves show gold at the forearms and black at the shoulders. His trousers are black with gold patches at the thighs, and he has short black boots.
identity_text: An unnamed teenage boy with two-tone gold and black hair, wearing a black jacket over a gold shirt with matching black and gold trousers.

appearance_text: A pale-skinned young person with soft fluffy purple hair that hangs in a heavy fringe right over the eyes. They wear a grey short-sleeved shirt underneath black overalls, with the straps crossing over the shoulders and down the back. Black leggings cover the legs, and clean white shoes with white socks finish the outfit.
identity_text: A pale young person with fluffy purple hair, wearing black overalls over a grey t-shirt with black leggings and clean white shoes. The title is a short handle-like label with no referent outside this skin.

bottom: wide belt with a gold buckle
head: carved pumpkin head
ridged orange skin

appearance_text: A tall figure whose head is a big carved pumpkin, orange with ridges, glowing yellow eyes, a triangle nose and a dark toothy grin cut into it. It wears a rough brown coat with a pale cream sash slung across the chest and over one shoulder. The trousers are black with a wide belt and a chunky gold buckle in the middle. Heavy dark brown boots cover the feet, and the coat is plain and worn across the back.
identity_text: A scarecrow whose head is a carved jack-o'-lantern lit from inside, dressed in a rough brown coat with a cream sash and a gold-buckled belt.

appearance_text: A boy with messy bright orange hair under a small green pointed cap. He wears a light green tunic with ragged edges and no sleeves, leaving his pale arms bare, held in at the waist by a brown belt. His legs are covered in green leggings with a leafy pattern, and he wears dark green boots.
identity_text: Peter Pan, the boy who would not grow up, in his ragged green tunic, brown belt, pointed green cap and dark green boots.

face: big white eyes with black pupils
head: brown bear head with round ears
top: red hoodie with a white collar

appearance_text: A cartoon brown bear standing upright, with round ears, big white eyes and a cream muzzle below a dark square nose. It wears a bright red hoodie with a white collar spreading over the shoulders and chest. Its trousers are plain tan and its shoes are black.
identity_text: A cartoon brown bear standing upright in streetwear: a bright red hooded top with a white collar over tan trousers and black shoes.

head: white square head
top: white tentacles over the chest and back

appearance_text: A tall white square head with closed grey eyes and a grey down-turned mouth, with white tentacles dangling from under it down the chest and back. The body wears a black suit jacket over a white shirt with a bright red tie, and dark grey trousers. The feet glow bright orange and yellow like hot lava.
identity_text: A ghast, the white Nether mob from Minecraft, dressed for the office in a black suit jacket, white shirt and red tie. Its tentacles dangle over the jacket and its feet glow like lava.

face: big white eyes with black pupils
head: dark blue squid head

appearance_text: A creature with a smooth dark blue block of a head and two big white eyes with small black pupils, and no mouth at all. It is wearing a black business suit with white shirt cuffs peeking out at the wrists and a bright red tie hanging down the chest. Its trousers are black and its shoes are grey.
identity_text: A Minecraft squid, with its smooth dark blue block head and big white eyes, dressed in a black business suit with a red tie.

appearance_text: A chunky monster whose whole body looks like lumpy red hot rock, mottled with brighter orange patches and dark cracks. Two narrow white glowing slits sit where its eyes should be and it has no mouth. Its thick arms and legs are made of the same rough burning stone, front and back.
identity_text: A chunky monster whose whole body is lumpy, red hot rock shot through with brighter orange and dark cracks, with two narrow white glowing slits for eyes and no mouth.

colors.item: marks on the back of the leg
colors.name: red

head: light blue helmet with a ridge on top
white fangs across the mouth
top: light blue shoulder and chest plates
brown leather straps across the chest

appearance_text: A hulking figure with pale blue skin, wearing a matching helmet with a ridge on top, a dark band across the eyes and a row of white pointed fangs over the mouth. Blue plates cover the shoulders and chest, tied on with brown leather straps and buckles that leave the pale stomach bare. The trousers and boots are the same pale blue, with a few red marks streaked down the back of one leg.
identity_text: A hulking pale blue monster in a fanged helmet, its shoulder and chest plates strapped on with brown leather so the bare stomach shows through.

appearance_text: A boy whose skin and bowl-cut hair are both a cold green, with two glowing bright blue eyes. He wears a plain grey green jumper with long sleeves and pale blue trousers that get darker towards the blue shoes. The back is the same green hair over a plain jumper.
identity_text: A boy whose skin, bowl-cut hair and clothes are all cold teal and aqua, described in the listing as frozen in time. No character is named.

appearance_text: A man in a shiny silver dome-shaped helmet with blue trim that leaves his face and moustache showing. He wears a red sleeveless top with blue sleeves and blue straps crossing his chest, with a round cream badge in the middle. His trousers are white with blue panels down the sides and he has short black boots. His back is red with the same blue straps.
identity_text: Peacemaker, the helmeted vigilante Christopher Smith, in his red, white and blue costume with a chrome dome helmet.

bottom: red sash with a gold buckle
head: bald pink head
top: white tusks hanging at the chest

appearance_text: A huge bald character with pink skin, thick brown eyebrows and a long droopy brown moustache under small black eyes. He wears a sleeveless dark brown leather vest that leaves his big pink arms bare, with two white tusks hanging at his chest. Around his waist is a red sash with a gold buckle holding up a brown loincloth, and his bare pink legs have black bands around the knees.
identity_text: The Giant, the big bald moustached troop from the mobile game Clash of Clans, in a sleeveless brown leather vest with a tusk necklace, a red waist sash and bare pink arms and legs.

head: gold crown with a red jewel
brown hair
top: dark red cloak over the shoulders

appearance_text: A young ruler wearing a tall gold crown set with a dark red jewel over brown hair. A deep red cloak is draped over the shoulders and falls in wide folds across the whole back. Underneath is a plain tan shirt, dark blue trousers and tall brown boots.
identity_text: An unnamed young ruler in a tall gold crown with a red jewel, a deep red cloak over a plain tan shirt, dark blue trousers and tall brown boots.

appearance_text: A boy with short messy brown hair and bright blue eyes. He wears an open black jacket with bright blue panels down the sleeves and back, showing a white shirt underneath. His trousers are black with blue at the sides and his trainers are blue and white.
identity_text: A brown-haired boy in an open black jacket with bright blue panels, a white shirt underneath, and blue and white trainers.

accessories: two round buttons on the chest
face: light purple muzzle with a black nose
head: long floppy purple rabbit ears

appearance_text: A big purple rabbit with long floppy ears and joints and seams all over its arms and legs like a wind-up toy. Its face has glowing red eyes, a wide light purple muzzle with a black nose and two rows of big square white teeth. A dark red bow tie sits under its chin above a light purple belly with two round buttons, and its back is plain purple.
identity_text: Bonnie the Bunny, the purple animatronic rabbit from Five Nights at Freddy's, with red eyes, big square teeth and a red bow tie.

head: pink flowers tucked in the hair

appearance_text: A girl with long wavy blonde hair that falls past her shoulders down her back, with little pink flowers tucked into it. She has big teal eyes and light skin, and wears a white top with long puffy sleeves that leave the shoulders bare. Over it she has blue denim overall shorts with straps crossing at the back, and tall brown boots.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with long wavy blonde hair and flowers tucked into it, wearing blue denim overalls over a white off-shoulder top and tall brown boots.

appearance_text: A blocky figure coloured all over in gold and yellow with mottled patches, like flakes of metal. Its square head has two dark sunken square eyes and a wide frowning mouth underneath. The gold carries all the way around the body, arms and legs, with no clothes or extra markings.
identity_text: A Minecraft creeper rendered entirely in mottled gold, keeping the usual sunken square eyes and frowning mouth.

head: wide brown hat with a turned up brim
subjects: bearded man in a wide hat
top: blue shirt with a brown belt

appearance_text: A stout older man almost hidden behind a huge bushy brown beard, with a wide brown hat pulled low over his eyes. He wears a bright blue shirt with a brown belt across the middle and brown straps over the shoulders at the back. His trousers are dark brown and his boots are pale yellow.
identity_text: Tom Bombadil from The Lord of the Rings, a stout bearded man in a wide brown hat, blue shirt and yellow boots.

appearance_text: A short round spaceman in a bright orange suit, drawn with heavy black outlines. A wide light blue glass visor covers most of the front of the head, and the back of the head is plain orange. The body is one rounded orange piece with stubby arms and two short orange legs.
identity_text: A small spacesuited figure from the game Among Us, its suit bright orange and its helmet fronted by a wide pale blue visor.

bottom: pink leggings with a checked pattern
head: long cream hair
pink flower on the side
top: dark grey jacket with pink cuffs

appearance_text: A girl with very long cream blonde hair that fades to pink at the tips, with a little pink flower clipped at the side and big grey eyes. She wears a dark grey jacket with soft pink cuffs over a pale top, leaving her shoulders bare. Her legs are in pink leggings with a checked pattern and she wears simple grey shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed pastel girl in a dark grey jacket with pink cuffs and pink checked leggings, with very long cream hair tipped in pink.

appearance_text: A fox standing on two legs, with an orange head, pointed ears and a white muzzle under a dark brown nose. Green eyes look out from the orange fur. It wears a tan buttoned suit jacket with a white shirt showing at the collar and matching tan trousers. A pale patch of fur sits low on the back where the tail begins.
identity_text: Mr. Fox, the suit-wearing fox from the film Fantastic Mr. Fox, standing on two legs in a tan buttoned suit.

appearance_text: A pale girl with enormous green eyes and very long blue hair that hangs in a straight fringe at the front and runs all the way down her back to her knees. She wears a white school uniform top with red stripes at the collar and cuffs and a red ribbon knotted at her chest. A short brown skirt sits below it, her legs are covered in brown tights, and she wears simple dark brown shoes.
identity_text: Konata Izumi, a main character from the anime Lucky Star, in her school uniform with knee-length blue hair.

bottom: dark legs with a green glow

colors.item: glowing wave line across the chest
colors.name: bright green

head: dark green square head
top: dark green body with a glowing green wave across the chest

appearance_text: A dark green figure so dark it is almost black, with two blank glowing white eyes staring out of its face. A bright green zig-zag wave line, like the line on a heart monitor, glows across its chest and again across its back. More green glow spills down its arms and the bottoms of its legs.
identity_text: An unnamed near-black green figure with blank glowing white eyes and a bright green heart-monitor wave line pulsing across its chest and back.

appearance_text: A lion standing on two legs with tan-gold fur all over and a thick dark red-brown mane framing the face and running down the back of the neck. The muzzle, chest and belly are cream, with a small brown nose and yellow eyes. The paws are white like little socks, and a brown tail hangs down behind.
identity_text: Simba, the lion from the Disney film The Lion King, standing upright in tan-gold fur with a dark red-brown mane, cream chest and white paws.

head: long hair
top: cream hooded jacket hanging down the back

appearance_text: A pale girl with long reddish brown hair, a braid falling in front of one shoulder and green eyes. She wears a cream sleeveless top cinched with a brown belt, with a soft cream hood and jacket hanging down her back. Her shorts are grey and her boots are tan, leaving her legs bare between them.
identity_text: A red-haired girl dressed for a walk outdoors, in a pale cream hooded jacket over a brown-belted top, with shorts and tan boots.

appearance_text: A girl with long brown hair falling down her back and bright blue eyes. She wears a cream jacket open over a light blue shirt, with a brown bag strap crossing her chest and the round brown bag resting at her hip. Below that is a white skirt, white socks and black shoes, and a small light blue bow sits in her hair at the back.
identity_text: A girl in a cream jacket and light blue top with a small round satchel slung across her chest, a white skirt and black shoes, and a blue bow in her long brown hair.

accessories: golden crate held above the head
motifs: crate with a pickaxe on it

appearance_text: A man with short dark brown hair, a neat brown beard and bright purple eyes. He wears a plain cyan shirt with short sleeves, blue trousers and grey shoes. Sitting above his head is a golden wooden crate with a grey pickaxe marked on each side.
identity_text: Steve, the default Minecraft player character, in his cyan shirt and blue trousers, with a golden treasure chest sitting above his head.

hair: long brown hair down the back
head: orange fox hood with pointed ears and a white face patch

appearance_text: A girl with long brown hair wearing an orange fox hood with pointed ears and a white face patch on top. Her orange jacket has black cuffs and is worn over a plain white top, and a fluffy orange and white tail hangs behind her. Below she has orange shorts over black fishnet leggings with a strap around one thigh, orange and white striped socks and white shoes. Her eyes are green.
identity_text: A girl wearing a fox-themed outfit: an orange hood with pointed ears, a matching jacket and a fluffy orange and white tail. The title describes the look rather than naming a character.

head: bald head
top: straps across the chest and back

appearance_text: A stocky bald fighter with a long dark brown beard and thick sideburns framing a stern pale face. His chest is strapped into black leather armour with a big square buckle in the middle, leaving his heavy bare arms and shoulders showing, and more straps cross over his back. Black trousers cover his legs, tucked into grey boots.
identity_text: Dwalin, the bald, heavily bearded dwarf warrior of Tolkien's dwarf company, strapped into black leather armour that leaves his heavy arms bare.

head: short brown hair
top: blue work shirt with rolled sleeves

appearance_text: A grown man with short brown hair, thick eyebrows and a brown stubbly beard. He wears a blue work shirt with the sleeves rolled up to the elbows, under a brown leather vest with straps and buckles crossing his chest and more gear strapped across his back. He finishes the outfit with blue jeans and sturdy brown boots.
identity_text: Owen Grady, the raptor trainer from the film Jurassic World, in a blue work shirt under a strapped brown leather vest, with blue jeans and brown boots.

head: white goggles pushed up on the head
top: red and white sign on the chest

appearance_text: A young man with short brown hair and a pair of white goggles pushed up on top of his head. He wears a light blue t-shirt with a small red and white sign on the chest. His legs are in dark blue jeans and he has plain black shoes.
identity_text: GeorgeNotFound, the Minecraft YouTuber, in his light blue t-shirt with a small red sign on the chest and white goggles up on his head.

appearance_text: A washed-out grey figure dressed almost entirely in black and dark grey. One eye glows white while the other is dark, and the face is dull grey with no colour left in it. The shirt, trousers and shoes are all dark, with slightly paler grey arms and a plain dark back.
identity_text: The game's default blocky man after being infected by a Wither: the same figure drained to washed-out grey, dressed all in black and dark grey, with one eye burning white and the other dark.

top: orange jacket with dark grey stripes

appearance_text: A pale boy with messy brown hair hanging over bright orange eyes. He wears an orange jacket banded with dark grey stripes, left open over a plain white shirt. His black jeans are ripped at the knees and shins, and he has chunky dark grey shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed teenage boy in an orange jacket banded with dark grey stripes, worn open over a white shirt, with ripped black jeans and chunky grey shoes.

top: orange and red jacket like flames

appearance_text: A pale girl with long dark brown hair and purple eyes, wearing a thin black choker. Her jacket glows from orange at the shoulders to deep red at the cuffs, like embers, worn open over a white top. She has short black shorts, bare legs, and brown boots with white socks folded over the tops.
identity_text: A teenage girl with long dark brown hair in an open jacket that glows from orange down to ember red, worn over a white top with black shorts and brown boots.

hair: fluffy brown hair with a fringe
head: fluffy brown hair
top: open blue shirt covered in white flowers

appearance_text: This boy has fluffy brown hair and light skin with grey eyes. He wears a blue shirt covered in little white flowers, left open over a plain white t-shirt, and the flower pattern continues across the back. Below that are dark blue shorts and white trainers, with bare legs between.
identity_text: An unnamed boy dressed for a summer holiday in an open blue flowered shirt, dark blue shorts and white trainers. "Vacation Mode" names the mood, not a character.

hair: short dark hair around the sides
head: mostly bald head
dark band of hair around the head

appearance_text: A stocky figure with tan skin, a mostly bald head with a dark band of hair, a thick dark unibrow and a huge square nose sticking straight out of the middle of the face. The eyes are green. The body is wrapped in a plain brown robe with a leather strap crossing the chest and running over the back, and the feet are in simple grey shoes.
identity_text: A Minecraft villager mob redrawn in a shaded, more realistic style, keeping the big square nose, unibrow, bald crown and brown strapped robe.

head: black top hat with a red band
top: three black coal buttons down the chest

appearance_text: A snowman made of white and pale blue snow, standing on two legs. On top he wears a black top hat with a red band, and his face has two black coal eyes and a stubby orange carrot nose. A red scarf is wrapped around his neck and three black coal buttons run down his chest.
identity_text: A snowman of white and pale blue snow standing on two legs, with coal eyes, a carrot nose, a red scarf and a black top hat.

appearance_text: A pale girl with shoulder length dark red hair and a pink flower clipped above one ear, with big blue eyes. She wears a long cream coloured robe with wide sleeves, scattered all over with pink blossom petals. A red sash hangs down the front of the robe, which reaches almost to the ground.
identity_text: A girl in a long cream kimono covered all over with pink blossom petals and a red sash hanging down the front, her dark red hair pinned with a pink flower. The robe reaches the ground, so no shoes show.

bottom: long blue robe with sparkles like water
head: long white hair

appearance_text: An old man with long flowing white hair and a great white beard that covers his chest. His shoulders are draped in a sea-green wrap that leaves his chest and arms bare, and below it a long deep blue robe glitters with pale flecks like sunlight on water. The blue robe runs all the way down the back as well.
identity_text: Poseidon, the Greek god of the sea, shown as an old man with a great white beard and a robe that glitters like moving water.

appearance_text: A man with short dark brown hair, a neat brown beard and bright blue eyes. He wears a plain black suit jacket over a white shirt with a blue tie knotted at the collar, and white cuffs show at his wrists. His trousers are black and so are his shoes.
identity_text: A man with short dark hair and a trimmed beard in a plain black suit over a white shirt, with a purple tie. An office worker rather than a named character.

appearance_text: A boy with messy black hair that falls over his eyes. He wears a plain white hoodie with the hood resting on his back and drawstrings at the front. His shorts are black, his socks are black, and he has white sneakers.
identity_text: An unnamed boy with messy black hair falling over his eyes, wearing a plain white hoodie, black trousers and white trainers.

footwear: tall black boots with red trim
head: black wide brimmed hat
dark red hat band
small yellow feather
orange cat ears

appearance_text: An orange tabby cat standing upright, its fur covered in darker orange stripes. It wears a wide black hat with a dark red band and a small yellow feather, and has a cream muzzle with a pink nose and pointed ears. A black cape hangs down its back, and it wears tall black boots with red trim.
identity_text: Puss in Boots, the swashbuckling orange tabby cat from the Shrek films, in his plumed hat, cape and tall boots.

bottom: long black skirt with a split
head: gold crown
hair down to the ankles

appearance_text: A pale woman with straight dark grey hair so long it reaches her ankles, wearing a wide gold crown on her head. Her black gown leaves the shoulders bare and is edged with gold, with gold bands around the wide sleeves and a gold necklace at the throat. The long black skirt is split at the front so her legs show, and the gold-trimmed black fabric continues all the way down her back.
identity_text: An unnamed young queen in a gold crown and a black off-shoulder gown edged with gold, her very long dark hair falling to her ankles.

head: grey purple furry head with pointed ears
top: yellow body with dark brown stripes

appearance_text: A small round creature with a soft grey-purple furry head, two pointed ears, pink blushing cheeks and a tiny pink mouth. Its body and arms are bright yellow with thick dark brown stripes wrapped around them, and a pair of pale blue see-through wings spread across its back. Below the stripes it has little pink shorts and chunky dark brown boots.
identity_text: A small furry creature dressed as a bee, with a grey-purple animal head, a bright yellow body wrapped in thick dark brown stripes and pale blue wings on its back.

hair: long ginger brown hair down the back

appearance_text: A girl with long ginger brown hair falling down her back and two little buns on top of her head, with big dark eyes under a long fringe. She wears an open grey jacket over a short blue top, with black shorts below it. Her legs are covered by pale blue jeans and she wears dark brown boots.
identity_text: A teenage girl in casual streetwear: an open grey jacket over a short blue top, black shorts with pale blue jeans underneath and dark brown boots.

appearance_text: A pale girl with short fluffy hair in the softest lavender, streaked with white, and dark purple eyes. She wears a purple hoodie with the hood resting on her back over a grey top. Black shorts sit above tall black boots with cream cuffs folded at the top.
identity_text: A pale girl with short fluffy lavender hair and matching pointed fox ears, wearing a purple hoodie over a grey top with black shorts and tall black boots.

appearance_text: A very pale girl with black hair streaked in red, cut in a long fringe that hides one eye, with small red clips at the top. She wears a black jacket with a faint check pattern over a black top and a bright red tie. A big white skull is printed across the back of the jacket. Her short skirt is grey and black over bare thighs, and she wears chunky black boots with blue soles.
identity_text: An unnamed goth girl with red-streaked black hair, wearing a dark checked jacket with a white skull printed across the back, a red tie, a short grey skirt and chunky black boots.

head: long light brown hair with a fringe

appearance_text: A girl with long light brown hair that falls past her shoulders and down her back, with a straight fringe and big light blue eyes. She wears a baggy dark brown knitted sweater with long sleeves over a short white skirt. Her legs are bare above tall black boots with small gold buckles.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with long fair hair in a baggy dark knitted sweater, a short white skirt and tall buckled black boots.

top: worn dark brown vest over a dark grey shirt

appearance_text: A weathered man with messy black hair and a thick black beard covering his jaw. He wears a battered dark brown vest over a dark grey shirt, with bare arms marked by red scratches and grime, and the vest is scuffed right across the back. Faded blue jeans and heavy dark brown boots finish the outfit.
identity_text: Joel from The Last of Us, a weathered bearded survivor in a worn brown vest, scratched arms, faded jeans and heavy boots.

appearance_text: A very pale girl with long black hair parted down the middle and hanging in two braids past her shoulders. She wears a plain black long-sleeved dress with a crisp white collar and a small dark bow at the neck. White knee socks and simple black shoes finish the outfit, and the dress is plain black all the way around the back.
identity_text: Wednesday Addams from The Addams Family, the pale, gloomy girl in a plain black dress with a white collar, white knee socks and black shoes.

head: clock face head
wooden frame around the face
top: dark panel with a gold pendulum

appearance_text: A tall wooden figure shaped like an old standing clock. Its head is a cream clock dial with black hands pointing across it, set in a brown wooden frame. The body is a dark brown cabinet with a long glass panel down the front where a gold pendulum hangs, and plain brown wood covers the back and the arms. Its legs are darker wooden posts.
identity_text: A walking grandfather clock: a cream dial in a wooden frame for a head, a dark brown cabinet body with a pendulum hanging behind a long panel, and wooden post legs.

appearance_text: A girl with long strawberry-blonde hair falling past her shoulders, pale freckled skin and big blue eyes. She wears light blue denim overalls with straps over her shoulders and tiny pink flower specks dotted across them, leaving her arms bare. Her shoes are black, and the overalls are the same denim blue all the way round the back.
identity_text: A freckled girl with long strawberry blonde hair in light blue denim overalls flecked with tiny pink flowers, arms bare and black shoes below. The title only names the garment.

appearance_text: A tall figure in a long dark grey coat that reaches the knees, with pale stripes running down the front and pale cuffs at the wrists. Its face is hidden behind a pale mask with a long pointed beak and two round black eye lenses. A wide dark hat sits on its head and a hood hangs down the back, above pale grey trousers and dark boots.
identity_text: A masked plague doctor in a wide-brimmed hat, pale beaked mask with dark round lenses, and a long dark coat over pale grey trousers and dark boots.

head: small brown animal ears
top: white top with a black band

appearance_text: A girl with long light brown hair and two small brown animal ears standing up on her head, with bright green eyes. She wears a fluffy pink jacket that hangs open over a white top with a black band across it. Underneath are short light blue denim shorts, and her legs go down into white socks folded over tall black boots.
identity_text: A girl with long light brown hair and small animal ears, wearing an open fluffy pink jacket, denim shorts and tall black boots. The title names the jacket.

head: yellow and red wrestling mask
pointed mask ears
red fin down the back of the head

appearance_text: A muscly fighter whose whole head is inside a bright yellow wrestling mask with dark red panels, pointed ears on top and a red fin running down the back. Dark slits show where the eyes are and a wide white grin shows through the mouth hole. He wears a red singlet with bare arms and a thick black belt with a gold buckle at the waist, then red shorts and black boots with black bands just below the knees.
identity_text: Markus 'Junkboy' Toivonen, art director at Mojang, drawn as a masked luchador in a red singlet, yellow and red wrestling mask and black boots.

appearance_text: A hugely muscly man drawn all in shades of grey, black and white. He has short black hair, a strong square jaw with dark stubble and a tiny smile showing a line of white teeth. His chest and arms are bare and packed with muscle, and the only clothing is a pair of plain black shorts. His legs are thick and muscly and his feet are bare.
identity_text: Giga Chad, the internet meme strongman, rendered entirely in greyscale. An enormously muscular man with short black hair, heavy stubble and nothing on but black shorts.

colors.item: santa hat hanging down the back
colors.name: red

head: light brown hair
red and white santa hat hanging behind
top: white t-shirt with a snowman on it

appearance_text: A boy with light brown hair wearing a red and black checked jacket left open over a white t-shirt with a smiling snowman printed on it. A red and white bobble hat hangs down the back of his head. Blue jeans and white trainers finish the outfit, and the white shirt shows big on the back too.
identity_text: A light-haired boy dressed for Christmas in an open red check jacket over a snowman t-shirt, dark check jeans and white trainers, with a red and white bobble hat hanging down his back.

head: small red horns
top: dark red checked off the shoulder top

appearance_text: A girl with long reddish brown hair and two small red horns poking up from her head, with glowing red eyes and dark markings around them. She wears a dark red checked top that leaves her shoulders bare, with the sleeves sitting low on her arms. Her legs are covered by dark brown leggings tucked into tall dark boots.
identity_text: An unnamed demon girl with small red horns, glowing red eyes and dark markings around them, dressed in a dark red checked off-the-shoulder top with dark leggings and tall boots.

appearance_text: A man with short brown hair, a square brown beard and moustache, and purple eyes. He wears a plain teal short-sleeved shirt that leaves his tanned arms bare. His trousers are blue and reach the ankles, where he wears simple grey shoes.
identity_text: Steve, the default Minecraft player character, with his brown hair and beard, teal shirt and blue jeans.

head: white nurse hat with a red cross

appearance_text: A girl with long blonde hair and purple eyes, wearing a little white cap marked with a red cross. Her white top has a red cross on the chest and red pads on the shoulders, and it leaves her middle bare above a short white skirt. Red and white striped boots come up her legs.
identity_text: An unnamed blonde nurse in a white red-cross uniform with a matching cap, red shoulder pads and a short white skirt.

head: black hood pulled up over a skull
subjects: hooded figure with a skull face

appearance_text: A figure with a bare bone-white skull for a face, with deep black eye sockets and a hollow nose, peering out from under a black hood. It wears a dark brown jacket hanging open over a light grey shirt, and dark navy trousers below.
identity_text: The Grim Reaper in modern dress: a bone-white skull with hollow eye sockets peering out of a dark hood, above a brown jacket, grey shirt and navy trousers.

appearance_text: A light-skinned man with short brown hair that leaves his forehead bare, and small dark eyes. He wears a dark grey shirt with pale grey bands around the sleeves and a black strap running diagonally across his chest and over one shoulder to his back, as if carrying a bag. His dark grey trousers match the shirt and end in dark boots.
identity_text: Knight Peculier, a character from the Yogscast's Minecraft series on YouTube, dressed in plain dark grey clothes with a bag strap across his chest.

appearance_text: A pale character with thick fluffy silver-white hair that sweeps over the forehead, with large dark eyes underneath. The whole outfit is black: an open black jacket over a black shirt, and black trousers. The shoes are a lighter grey, and the back is plain black all over.
identity_text: A pale figure with thick fluffy silver-white hair, dressed head to toe in black with light grey shoes. The title only describes the hair colour.

head: dark helmet with a red band
full face helm

appearance_text: A tall warrior sealed inside dark grey and purple plate armour with no skin showing anywhere. A closed helmet hides the face, wrapped by a glowing red band across the brow. Red light burns in the centre of the chest plate and runs in thin lines along the shoulder guards, arms and legs, right down to the heavy armoured boots.
identity_text: An unnamed knight sealed in dark plate armour, with red light glowing from the helm band, the chest and the limb plates.

head: pink and green flower crown
top: grey and white striped long sleeve shirt

appearance_text: A girl with long wavy dark red hair down her back and a crown of pink and green flowers resting on her head. She wears a grey and white striped long sleeve shirt under light blue denim bib overalls fastened with a yellow button. Her legs are bare below the short overalls and she wears black shoes with white soles.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with long auburn hair wearing a pink flower crown, a striped long sleeve shirt and light blue denim overall shorts.

face: grey face mask over the mouth
hair: long pink hair down the back
head: long pink hair

appearance_text: A girl with long bright pink hair that hangs down past her shoulders and covers her back, with a fringe over orange eyes. A grey mask covers the lower half of her face. She wears a black jacket over a dark purple shirt, a black and white checkered skirt with matching leggings, and teal boots.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with long bright pink hair and a grey face mask, in a black jacket, checkered leggings and green boots.

accessories: brown belt with a round buckle

colors.item: trim on the shoulders and cuffs
colors.name: orange

face: bare skull with empty black eye sockets
head: bare white skull
top: dark red captain's coat with orange trim
bare ribs showing at the open chest

appearance_text: A walking skeleton with a bare white skull for a head, hollow black eye sockets and bony teeth. It wears a long dark red captain's coat with bright orange trim on the shoulders and cuffs, hanging open so its white ribs show through the middle. A brown belt with a round buckle sits at the waist, above grey blue trousers and brown boots with gold cuffs.
identity_text: A walking skeleton dressed as a pirate captain, in a long dark red coat with orange shoulder and cuff trim that hangs open over its bare ribs, with a buckled brown belt and gold-cuffed boots.

hair: dark brown hair to the shoulders

appearance_text: A burly man with dark brown hair down to his shoulders, a thick dark beard and pale blue eyes, his mouth open to show his teeth. Over his chest he wears a white apron splattered with red stains, held on by black straps that cross his shoulders and cover his back like a vest. His trousers are patched blue jeans.
identity_text: An unnamed burly man with long dark hair and a thick beard, wearing a blood-splattered white apron over patched blue jeans.

appearance_text: A girl with pale pink hair so long it falls past her knees, with a straight fringe and a small brown clip at one side. Her eyes are big and blue with pink cheeks. She wears a dark blue sailor top with a white striped collar and a pale blue scarf at the neck, a matching checked skirt, and long dark blue socks.
identity_text: LDShadowLady, the Minecraft YouTuber, drawn with her trademark very long pink hair, here in a navy sailor-style school uniform with a pale blue neck scarf.

appearance_text: A girl with short fluffy peachy blonde hair and pale blue eyes. She wears a black jacket with torn sleeves over a black top, and light blue denim overalls with the straps over her shoulders. Her thighs are bare above grey checkered knee socks and chunky black boots.
identity_text: A grungy girl with short fluffy peach blonde hair in a ripped black jacket, light blue denim overalls and checkered knee socks. The title is a bare first name with no character behind it.

appearance_text: A man with brown skin, short black hair and a neat black beard, smiling. He has no shirt on, so his chest, shoulders and arms are bare. Around his waist is a white towel with a dark blue band along the top, hanging down to his knees. His legs and feet are bare.

aliases: The Man Your Man Could Smell Like
identity.name: Old Spice Guy

identity_text: The Old Spice Guy from the Old Spice adverts, a bare-chested man wearing nothing but a white bath towel.

head: red cap with a white band
top: two yellow stars on the chest

appearance_text: A small brown furry monkey with a pale tan face, big white eyes and a wide grinning muzzle. A red cap with a white band sits on its head. It wears a red sleeveless vest with two bright yellow stars across the chest, leaving its furry brown arms and legs bare, and its feet are bare tan.
identity_text: Diddy Kong, the small monkey sidekick from the Donkey Kong games, in his red star-covered vest and white-banded red cap, with bare furry arms and legs.

appearance_text: A boy with messy brown hair and bright green eyes, smiling. He wears a thick jumper striped in red and green with a white scarf bunched around his neck. His trousers are black and he has white boots with red bands around the top.
identity_text: A boy in a thick red and green striped Christmas jumper with a white scarf bunched around his neck, dark trousers, and white boots with little snowman faces on them.

head: orange jack o lantern pumpkin for a head
ridged pumpkin sides
top: black suit jacket speckled with little orange dashes

appearance_text: A figure whose head is a big carved orange pumpkin with ridged sides, triangle eyes and a wide jagged grin. It wears a black suit jacket with an orange tie, and little orange dashes are scattered all over the jacket, the sleeves and the whole back. The black trousers carry the same orange speckles right down to the feet.
identity_text: Jack Gourdon, the pumpkin headed outfit from Fortnite, wearing a black suit flecked with orange and an orange tie.

appearance_text: A shuffling figure wrapped from head to toe in old sandy-brown bandages. Its face is hidden behind the wraps except for two dark empty eye holes. Loose strips of bandage hang off its chest, back and arms, and the same tattered wrapping covers its legs.
identity_text: A Minecraft husk mob wrapped head to toe in old sandy desert bandages, with two dark empty eye holes where its face should be. The listing describes it as a husk mummified and awakened in a desert pyramid.

bottom: teal legs fading to pale blue at the ends
face: ring of glowing spots instead of eyes
head: teal square head
ring of glowing pale dots

appearance_text: A smooth blue green creature that seems to glow from the inside. Its face is a ring of bright pale dots around a glowing green middle, with no ordinary eyes or mouth. The body is deep teal with faint glowing spots scattered over the chest and back, and the arms are darker at the shoulders. Its legs fade from teal down to a pale, almost white glow at the tips like the ends of tentacles.
identity_text: The glow squid, the luminescent version of Minecraft's squid mob, drawn as a teal figure with a ring of glowing dots where its face would be.

face: dark muzzle with two white fangs
hair: shaggy brown fur on the head
head: big furry brown animal head
subjects: furry brown creature in a suit
top: black suit jacket over a white shirt with a red tie

appearance_text: A shaggy brown furred creature with a broad animal head, tiny black eyes and a dark muzzle showing two small white fangs and a pink tongue. It is dressed in a sharp black suit jacket over a white shirt with a bright red tie, and white cuffs peek out at the wrists. The suit stays plain black across the back and down the trousers.
identity_text: JeromeASF, a Minecraft YouTuber and member of Team Crafted, shown as his shaggy brown beast character dressed in a smart black suit with a red tie.

head: black hood with cat ears
black hair
subjects: woman in a black cat suit
top: suit unzipped a little at the chest

appearance_text: A woman dressed head to toe in a shiny black suit with two pointed cat ears on her hood and a black mask across her eyes. Her short black hair and pale face show under the hood, and the suit is unzipped a little at the chest. A long curled tail is drawn down the back of the suit, which ends in black boots.
identity_text: Catwoman, the cat-suited burglar and villain from the Batman series, in a shiny black hooded suit with pointed ears, an eye mask and a tail down the back.

colors.item: icing on top of the head
colors.name: white

colors.item: cake slice badge on the chest
colors.name: white

head: cake head
white icing on top
red berries
top: white cake badge with red dots on the chest

appearance_text: A cake come to life, with a spongy brown body and a layer of white icing dotted with red berries across the top of its head. Black sunglasses sit over its eyes and it grins with a wide open mouth and an orange tongue. On its body is a light blue vest with a white cake badge with red dots on the chest, and its short brown legs are made of cake too.
identity_text: A cake come to life, its spongy brown head topped with white icing and red berries, wearing black sunglasses and a teal vest and sticking out an orange tongue.

appearance_text: A boy with short messy black hair and big dark eyes. He wears a plain blue t-shirt with short sleeves that leaves his tan arms bare. His trousers are black joggers, and he has white socks poking out of chunky white trainers.
identity_text: An unnamed boy with short messy black hair in a blue t-shirt, black joggers and white trainers.

head: brown hair with a straight fringe

appearance_text: This is a broad, muscly man with short brown hair cut in a straight fringe, a thick brown beard and bright blue eyes. He wears a teal sleeveless shirt that leaves his big tanned arms bare, with a white belt at the waist. Below that he wears blue jeans and brown shoes.
identity_text: A beefed-up take on Steve, the Minecraft default character. He keeps the brown fringe, teal shirt and blue jeans, but is broad and muscled with bare arms, a thick brown beard and a white belt.

appearance_text: A green-skinned creature with a flat, blank face and two empty black eyes. It wears a light blue short-sleeved shirt with its green arms hanging bare below the sleeves. Its trousers are blue-purple and its feet are grey.
identity_text: The standard Minecraft zombie mob: green skin, two blank black eyes, a light blue short-sleeved shirt and blue-purple trousers.

face: purple eyes squashed out to the far edges of the face
wide brown beard across the bottom half
blank stretched skin in the middle
head: flat brown hair

appearance_text: A man in the classic look of a cyan short-sleeved t-shirt, bare tan arms, blue jeans and grey shoes, with flat brown hair. His face is stretched strangely wide: the purple eyes have slid right out to the far edges of his head, the middle is blank skin, and a broad brown beard fills the whole bottom half.
identity_text: Minecraft's default character Steve as a 'cursed' meme skin, his face stretched so wide that the eyes reach the edges of his head and the beard fills the bottom half.

footwear: tall brown boots with pink soles
head: light brown hair
top: black and white striped tank top

appearance_text: A girl with shoulder length light brown hair and big blue eyes with rosy cheeks. She wears a black and white striped tank top that leaves her shoulders and arms bare. Below she has short light blue denim shorts and tall brown boots with pink soles.
identity_text: An unnamed girl dressed for summer in a black and white striped tank top, light denim shorts and tall brown boots. The title describes a mood rather than naming anyone.

accessories: long pale blue cape down the back

appearance_text: A pale girl with platinum blonde hair pulled into a long braid that hangs over one shoulder, and big blue eyes with pink cheeks. She wears a shimmering light blue dress with bare shoulders and long see through sleeves, sparkling with tiny white flecks. A long pale blue cape covered in snowflake shapes trails down her back to the floor.
identity_text: Elsa from the Disney animated film Frozen, the ice queen. She wears her sparkling pale blue gown with sheer sleeves and a long snowflake-covered cape, her platinum blonde hair in a braid over one shoulder.

appearance_text: A man in a dark three-cornered hat with the brim turned up into points at the corners, shading a serious face. He wears a long dark coat edged in gold, with a deep red lining showing at the shoulders and down the front and a high buttoned collar at the throat. Pale cream cuffs poke out at his wrists. Black trousers and dark brown boots complete the outfit, and the coat is broad and dark across the back.
identity_text: Haytham Kenway, the Templar from Assassin's Creed III, in a dark tricorn hat and a long gold-edged coat with a deep red lining and a high buttoned collar.

appearance_text: A young person with thick messy black hair covering their forehead and blue eyes. They wear a baggy blue-grey hoodie with drawstrings at the neck and the hood folded down behind their shoulders. Below it are dark navy shorts, pale blue socks and white shoes.
identity_text: A young person in a baggy blue-grey hoodie with dark legwear and pale blue and white trainers, dark messy hair falling over the forehead.

colors.item: hooded blue-teal mottled cloth tunic; cream-and-brown fur shoulders and arms (no armour)
colors.name: dark teal

head: furry animal head
brown and cream fur
top: matching armour plate on the back

appearance_text: A shaggy creature covered in mottled brown and cream fur, with two long glowing light blue eyes and no visible mouth. Dark teal and blue armour plates cover its chest and shoulders, and the same plating continues across its back. Its arms and legs are bare fur, patched in brown and cream all the way down.
identity_text: Sven, the Rogue Knight from Dota 2, rendered as a bulky armoured figure with glowing cyan eye slits and dark teal plating over the chest and back.

colors.item: rusty patina spots on the copper
colors.name: green

appearance_text: A diver sealed inside a round copper helmet with one big dark glass window instead of a face, the metal spotted with rusty green patches. Copper shoulder plates and a thick copper strap cross the heavy grey diving suit, with more copper cuffs at the wrists. The trousers are worn brown canvas and the boots are heavy copper, and copper straps run down the back too.
identity_text: An unnamed deep sea diver sealed inside a heavy suit and a round copper helmet with a single dark glass window, the metal spotted with green patina. 'Copper Diver' describes the gear rather than naming anyone.

head: blue flowers tucked in the hair

appearance_text: A pale girl with very long white hair that covers her whole back, with small blue flowers tucked into it. She wears a brown jacket open over a white shirt, with a long blue scarf hanging down the front. Her trousers and boots are white with a little chequered trim at the waist, and her eyes are light blue.
identity_text: A girl with very long white hair dressed for cold weather in a brown jacket, blue scarf and white boots, with blue flowers in her hair. The title names the wintry look, not a character.

head: white curly powdered wig
top: cream waistcoat with a row of buttons

appearance_text: An old-fashioned gentleman with a short white curly wig and a pale face. He wears a long dark blue coat over a cream waistcoat with a row of buttons down the front and a white cloth at his neck. Dark blue knee breeches, white stockings and black shoes with gold buckles finish the outfit, and the back of the coat is plain dark blue.
identity_text: Thomas Jefferson, the third President of the United States, shown as a colonial gentleman in a white powdered wig, dark blue coat and buckled shoes.

head: light blonde hair with a fringe
