top: long black t-shirt with an orange pumpkin on the front

appearance_text: A girl with light blonde hair and big blue eyes. She wears a long black t-shirt with a plump orange pumpkin printed across the front and orange stripes banding the sleeves. Her legs are bare above tall orange and black striped socks, and she wears little white shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed girl dressed for Halloween in a long black t-shirt with an orange pumpkin on the front, striped orange and black socks and little white shoes.

appearance_text: A bald man with a brown goatee beard and grey rimmed glasses. He wears an open cream lab coat over a plain blue shirt, and the coat is plain cream across his back. His dark grey trousers reach down to black shoes.
identity_text: Walter White, the main character of the TV series Breaking Bad, as a bald man in glasses with a brown goatee and an open lab coat over a blue shirt.

appearance_text: A teenage boy with messy short brown hair falling over bright green eyes and a small smile. He wears an open red jacket with black cuffs over a plain white t shirt. Blue denim jeans go down to red shoes with black soles, and the back of the jacket is plain red.
identity_text: An unnamed teenage boy in an open red jacket over a white t-shirt, with blue denim jeans and red shoes. The title describes the outfit.

appearance_text: A pale figure with short reddish brown hair and pink cheeks. They wear a baggy black sweater with a big white crescent moon printed across the chest, the sleeves hanging long over the arms. The trousers are rust red with darker stripes, tucked into short black boots.
identity_text: A pale boy with short reddish brown hair in a baggy black sweater printed with a large white crescent moon, over striped rust red trousers.

face: face mostly hidden by the fringe
head: black hair
blue glasses resting on top of the head
top: baggy white shirt with long sleeves

appearance_text: A girl with short black hair and a pair of blue rimmed glasses pushed up on top of her head. She wears a baggy white shirt with long loose sleeves that hangs down over her hips. Her skirt is blue with a darker checked pattern, and her shoes are white.
identity_text: An unnamed teenager in an oversized white shirt and blue checked trousers, with blue-rimmed glasses pushed up onto the top of the head.

head: horned black head
top: black rocky chest with a glowing orange centre

appearance_text: A hulking monster made of blackened rock with bright orange lava glowing through the cracks. Two curved horns rise from its head, and glowing yellow eyes and teeth burn out of the dark face. A big molten patch glows in the centre of its chest, and thin rivers of lava run down its arms and legs. The same glowing cracks spread across its back.
identity_text: An unnamed hulking monster built of blackened rock with lava burning through the cracks, two curved horns on its head and glowing yellow eyes and fangs.

appearance_text: A man with brown hair and a thick brown moustache and beard, with bright blue eyes. He wears a white shirt with the sleeves rolled up, a dark brown waistcoat over it and a red tie hanging down the front. His jeans are dark blue and his boots are dark brown.
identity_text: A bearded man working behind a bar: a white shirt with rolled sleeves under a dark waistcoat, a red tie, dark blue jeans and dark boots.

hair: pink tuft on top of the head
head: grey wolf head with pointed ears
top: black jacket over a green collar

appearance_text: A character with a grey wolf's head, pointed ears and soft pink patches around the eyes and a pink tuft on top. A green scarf is bunched at the neck above a heavy black jacket, and tan gloves cover the hands. The trousers are black and the shoes are black with bright red soles.
identity_text: An unnamed wolf-headed adventurer, grey furred with pink face markings, wrapped in a green scarf over a heavy black jacket with tan gloves. The listing kits him out for the trail with hide boots and an archeology glove.

colors.item: carved glowing face on the back of the head
colors.name: yellow

head: orange pumpkin head
ribbed pumpkin skin
carved glowing face at the back

appearance_text: A pumpkin person with ribbed orange skin all over. Big black sunglasses cover its eyes and it shows a wide white grin, while the back of its head has a carved face with glowing yellow eyes and a jagged mouth. It wears a dark green vest over its round orange body, and its orange legs have green patches at the knees.
identity_text: A grinning pumpkin person with ribbed orange skin and big black sunglasses, wearing a dark green vest, with a carved glowing face on the back of its head.

head: round helmet with a dark visor
top: grey space suit with a round chest panel

appearance_text: A figure sealed in a bulky grey and white space suit with a round helmet and a dark blue visor hiding the face. A big round panel sits in the middle of the chest and padded ridges run down the arms and legs. A boxy pack is strapped to the back and the boots are the same grey as the suit.
identity_text: A figure sealed in a bulky grey and white spacesuit with a round helmet and a dark visor hiding the face. The listing describes a futuristic themed astronaut and names no character.

top: black leather waistcoat with no sleeves

appearance_text: A tough-looking man with short dark hair, a goatee beard and a serious face. He wears a black sleeveless leather waistcoat over a grey t-shirt, leaving both arms bare and covered in dark tattoos. His jeans are dark blue and he wears heavy black boots.
identity_text: Francis, one of the four survivors in the zombie shooter Left 4 Dead, a tattooed biker in a sleeveless leather waistcoat and jeans.

accessories: dark green leaves down the back
head: ridged dark red head

appearance_text: A tall thin creature covered all over in dark red skin that looks like ridged bark, with no clothes at all. Its face is blank apart from two tiny glowing white eyes and it has no mouth. Down its back grow rows of dark green leafy fronds, and ridges run along its arms and legs.
identity_text: The Bracken, the tall bark-skinned stalker from the horror game Lethal Company, with two tiny glowing eyes, no mouth and green fronds down its back.

appearance_text: A pale character with messy black hair falling to the shoulders and brown eyes, wrapped in a thick bright orange scarf that trails down the back. Over a cream shirt they wear an open green jacket with roomy sleeves. Their trousers are black and tucked into sturdy dark brown boots.
identity_text: An unnamed character wrapped in a big orange scarf, wearing an open green chequered jacket over a cream shirt, with black trousers tucked into brown boots.

hair: messy black hair with grey streaks

appearance_text: A pale young man with messy black hair streaked with grey and enormous thick grey glasses that hide his eyes completely. He wears a buttoned green uniform jacket over a white shirt with a dark red and gold striped tie down the front, and white cuffs show at the wrists. Matching green trousers reach dark green shoes, and the back of the jacket is plain green.
identity_text: Kenji Setou from the visual novel Katawa Shoujo, a pale student in a green school uniform with enormous thick glasses.

appearance_text: A very pale girl with long cream coloured hair that hangs down her back in a braid, held back by a dusty pink band. Her face is soft pink with big pale eyes. She wears a short pale pink dress with puffy sleeves and a darker pink belt, and pale pink shoes with matching bands at her knees.
identity_text: Norah from the role-playing game Child of Light, drawn as a very pale girl in a soft pink puff-sleeved dress with a dusty pink belt and headband, her long cream hair braided down her back.

face: black mask covering nose and mouth
head: brown hair
black mask over the mouth

appearance_text: A young man with short brown hair and light blue eyes, with a black mask pulled up over his nose and mouth. He wears a blue jacket with dark straps buckled across his chest and a bulky brown backpack riding high on his back. Loose khaki cargo trousers carry small pouches at the hip, and his white shoes have orange laces.
identity_text: An unnamed free runner in a blue jacket and khaki cargo trousers, with a black face mask and a brown backpack on his shoulders.

bottom: blue armoured trousers with orange panels
face: other side of the mask blank
head: two-tone mask split down the middle
one eye hole

appearance_text: A soldier in armour split down the middle, blue on one half and burnt orange on the other. The mask follows the same split and has only one eye hole, showing a single white eye on the orange side. Armour plates and straps cover the chest, and the legs carry the same two colours down to heavy boots.
identity_text: Deathstroke, the one-eyed comic book mercenary, in his split blue and orange mask and armour.

appearance_text: A shiny white and silver machine shaped like a person, with dark grey joints showing between the plates. A single bright blue light glows in the slot on its helmet, and a round blue light sits in the middle of the chest with another on the back. Smaller blue lights glow at the wrists, knees and ankles.
identity_text: A person-shaped war robot in shiny white and silver plating, with one bright blue eye slot in its helmet and a round blue light in the middle of its chest. The listing presents it as a prototype machine rather than a named character.

head: blonde hair
subjects: blonde boy in a blue shirt

appearance_text: A boy with short blonde hair and brown eyes. He wears a light blue shirt left open over a plain white t-shirt, with the blue covering his shoulders, sleeves and the whole back. Black trousers reach down to clean white shoes.
identity_text: The skin of the Minecraft YouTuber SolidarityGaming: a blonde boy in a light blue open shirt over a white t-shirt, with black trousers and white shoes.

hair: long hair split into two colours
head: hood resting on the back

appearance_text: A girl with long hair split straight down the middle, purple on one side and pale yellow on the other, falling well past her shoulders. She wears a purple hooded jacket with the hood down and dark grey shorts that leave her legs bare. Tall purple boots come up over her calves.
identity_text: A girl whose long hair is split straight down the middle, purple on one side and lemon yellow on the other, dressed in a purple hoodie, grey shorts and tall purple boots. The title is a fruit-colour description rather than a name.

appearance_text: A tall figure encased in pitch black armour from head to toe. Two red eyes glow out of the helmet where a face should be, and thin red lines glow along the seams of the chest, arms and legs. The shoulders are bulky plates and the boots are heavy and black.
identity_text: An unidentified warrior sealed head to toe in black plate armour, with red light glowing through the seams and out of the helmet. The title describes the look rather than naming a character.

colors.item: fur-trimmed parka hood; white patch over the mouth and chin (no neck scarf)
colors.name: white

face: white scarf pulled up over the mouth
footwear: tall boots striped in black and white
head: grey furry hood pulled up
brown hair peeking out
top: dark blue strap down the chest

appearance_text: A person wrapped up warm in a thick blue winter coat with a big grey furry hood pulled right up over their head. Brown hair and brown eyes show at the front, and a white scarf covers the mouth. A dark strap runs down the chest and the tall boots are striped in bands of black and white.
identity_text: An unnamed figure bundled into a blue fur-hooded winter parka with a face covering and striped snow boots, dressed for the cold.

appearance_text: A grown man with short dark brown hair and a thick brown beard covering his chin and cheeks. He wears a black t-shirt with a big white skull printed on the chest, and his arms are bare. Blue jeans and grey shoes finish the outfit. Across the back of the shirt, yellow letters spell out EPIC.
identity_text: Harley Morenstein, the bearded host of the YouTube cooking show Epic Meal Time, in a black skull t-shirt with EPIC written across the back.

footwear: brown boots with white fluffy cuffs
head: hood over the head
long hair down the back

appearance_text: A pale girl with long purple grey hair falling all the way down her back and a fringe over her dark purple eyes. She wears a tan hooded coat with an orange lining inside the hood and white cuffs at the wrists, over a white shirt that peeks out at the collar. Short cream shorts leave her legs bare above brown boots with fluffy white cuffs.
identity_text: A young girl with very long purple grey hair in a tan hooded coat with an orange lining, cream shorts and fluffy topped brown boots.

head: brown hair
top: ragged light blue shirt with torn sleeves

appearance_text: A broad man with short brown hair and a thick brown beard covering his chin. His light blue shirt is torn and worn, with a brown leather strap running across the chest and over the shoulder to the back. Dark blue grey trousers with a belt lead down into tall brown boots.
identity_text: A weathered, bearded take on Steve, the default Minecraft player character, in a torn light blue shirt with a leather strap across the chest and tall brown boots.

head: orange hood with round bear ears
pink inner ears

appearance_text: A small character almost swallowed by a big orange hoodie whose hood has two round bear ears with pink insides. Under the hood a brown fringe shows above closed, sleepy eyes and pink blushing cheeks. Two white drawstrings hang from the neck, and the hoodie is plain orange front and back down to a dark grey band at the hem, with bare pale legs below.
identity_text: An unnamed sleeping child almost swallowed by an oversized orange bear hoodie, with closed eyes, blushing cheeks and bare legs below the hem.

bottom: green mottled legs at the sides
head: human face on the front
green mottled monster skin around the back

appearance_text: A green mottled monster wearing a human face on the front of its head, complete with short brown hair, a brown beard and blue eyes. Everything around and behind that face is green mottled monster skin, and the arms and legs are green and blotchy too. It wears a cyan shirt and blue trousers with grey shoes, the same simple outfit the face belongs to.
identity_text: A Creeper wearing a human face across the front of its head — short brown hair, brown beard and blue eyes — with the back of the head, the arms and the legs still mottled green. It wears the plain cyan shirt and blue trousers that go with the borrowed face.

head: orange carved pumpkin head
top: dark red jacket with a tan collar
yellow cuffs and small yellow buttons

appearance_text: A figure whose head is a big orange carved pumpkin, its eyes and wide smile glowing bright yellow. It wears a dark red jacket with a tan collar spread over the shoulders, yellow cuffs and little yellow buttons on the sleeves. Below that are plain grey trousers and brown shoes, and the pumpkin is smooth and round from behind.
identity_text: A figure with a big carved orange pumpkin for a head, its eyes and wide smile glowing bright yellow, dressed in a dark red jacket with a tan collar and yellow cuffs over plain grey trousers and brown shoes.

hair: long blonde hair with pink at the front
head: cream bunny ears

appearance_text: A pale girl with long blonde hair, pink strands at the front, and soft cream bunny ears sticking up from her head. She wears a short dark brown top and matching shorts that leave her middle bare. Cream and brown striped warmers cover her arms and matching striped stockings run up her legs into chunky dark brown boots.
identity_text: A girl dressed as a bunny, with soft cream ears, long blonde hair streaked pink at the front, and a dark brown crop top and shorts worn with striped arm and leg warmers.

appearance_text: A blonde kid with fluffy hair, blushed cheeks and dark purple eyes. The blazer is a soft light purple, worn open over a white shirt with a light blue striped tie knotted at the collar. The trousers are grey with a darker check pattern, and the shoes are plain white.
identity_text: A blond student in a lilac school blazer and striped tie, with checked trousers. Not a named character.

appearance_text: A boy with dark brown hair and a dark red scarf pulled up over his mouth so only his eyes show. His jacket is red down the front with sleeves banded in grey and white stripes, and a darker red shape spreads across the back. He wears black jeans and black shoes with white soles.
identity_text: An unnamed teenage boy in a red and white striped hooded top with a dark red scarf pulled over his mouth and black jeans. The title describes a style, not a character.

face: brown beard patch under the mouth
head: short brown hair

appearance_text: A man with short brown hair and completely blank white eyes that glow with no pupils in them. He wears a teal short sleeved t-shirt and blue jeans, with grey shoes. Apart from the eyes he looks like an ordinary miner.
identity_text: Herobrine, the white-eyed figure of Minecraft legend, shown as an ordinary miner in a teal t-shirt and blue jeans apart from his blank glowing eyes.

bottom: dark blue trousers with red splashes
top: torn open chest with red flesh and white ribs

appearance_text: A ripped and bloodied figure with messy brown hair and a brown beard, its face streaked with red. The teal t-shirt is torn wide open across the chest, showing raw red flesh and a set of white ribs, and blood runs down the arms and back. Dark blue trousers spattered with red lead down to grey shoes.
identity_text: Steve, the default Minecraft character, drawn as a zombie: his brown hair and beard and teal shirt are still there, but the shirt is ripped open over raw flesh and ribs and blood covers his face and limbs.

head: light brown hair with pink flowers
top: long white dress with bare shoulders

appearance_text: A girl with light brown hair pinned with little pink blossoms, and calm grey eyes. She wears a long flowing white dress that leaves her shoulders bare, gathered at the waist by a dark purple sash, with separate white sleeves around her arms. The skirt falls all the way to the floor and hides her feet.
identity_text: A girl in a long white gown gathered by a dark purple sash, with pink blossoms in her hair. Not a named character.

bottom: blue legs joined into a point
head: plain light blue head

appearance_text: A small creature that is light blue all over, with a plain square head and two tall white glowing eyes and no mouth. Its body and little arms are the same light blue, a touch darker across the chest and back. Its legs join together into a deeper blue pointed shape instead of feet.
identity_text: The small light blue flying helper mob added to Minecraft in 1.19, which picks up items and delivers them back to players.

footwear: tall pink boots with white cuffs
top: puffy pink frills at the shoulders

appearance_text: A girl with soft cream-coloured hair falling to her shoulders and big brown eyes. She wears a frilly pale pink dress with puffy ruffles at the shoulders and a short ruffled skirt, and white gloves cover her hands. Her legs are in tall pink boots that stop above the knee with white cuffs at the top and bottom.
identity_text: A girl in a frilly pale pink dress with puffed shoulders, white gloves and tall pink over-the-knee boots.

footwear: pink, teal and blue stripy long socks
hair: short purple hair with pink streaks
top: bright blue and teal cropped jacket

appearance_text: A girl with short purple hair streaked with pink and big purple eyes. She wears a short bright jacket patterned in blue and teal with purple sleeves, cut short so her tummy is bare, and the same bold pattern spreads across her back. She has short blue shorts and long socks banded in pink, teal and blue, with colourful bracelets on her wrists.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in a loud multicoloured outfit: a bright cropped jacket over a bare tummy, short blue shorts and striped long socks.

head: tiger hood with round ears
pink inner ears
top: striped tiger onesie with cream belly

appearance_text: A blonde girl in a hooded animal onesie with round ears on top and pink inner ears. The suit is light brown with dark brown tiger stripes all over the arms and legs, and a soft cream belly and chest. Her long blonde hair spills out of the hood and her eyes are light blue. A striped tail is drawn down the back of the suit.
identity_text: A blonde girl wearing a hooded tiger onesie striped in light and dark brown, with round pink-lined ears on the hood and a tail down the back. She is a child in a costume rather than a tiger.

appearance_text: A figure made entirely of pale blue ice, glinting with lighter and darker turquoise patches all over the head, body and legs. The frozen head has two small white eyes and a faint mouth, with icy shapes where hair and a beard would sit. The arms, chest, back and legs are all the same shining ice, with no clothes or colour of their own.
identity_text: Minecraft's Steve rendered entirely in pale blue ice - the familiar blocky head with its beard and mouth shape is still there, but every part of him is frozen crystal instead of skin and clothes.

appearance_text: A girl with very long wavy light brown hair that falls past her waist, and eyes closed as if she is half asleep. She wears a soft brown cardigan over a white dress that reaches her knees. Frilly white socks and black shoes are on her feet.
identity_text: An unnamed sleepy-looking girl in a soft brown cottagecore outfit: a brown cardigan over a white dress, with frilly socks and black shoes.

colors.item: front and back panel of the hoodie
colors.name: white

motifs: red maple leaf on the chest and back
top: red and white hoodie with a maple leaf

appearance_text: A boy with short brown hair falling over his eyes. He wears a hoodie with red sleeves and hood and a white panel on the chest and back, and a big red maple leaf is printed on both the front and the back. He pairs it with plain black trousers and white trainers.
identity_text: A boy with brown hair over his eyes in a red and white hoodie carrying a large red maple leaf on the front and back, with plain black trousers and white trainers.

appearance_text: A boy with short black hair and tan skin wearing a red football shirt with white cuffs and a big white number 7 on the front and back. He wears green shorts with red trim and long red and white striped socks with white boots. His arms are bare below the short sleeves.
identity_text: Cristiano Ronaldo in the red and green Portugal national team kit, the white number 7 on the front and back of the shirt.

face: black bandit mask across the eyes
head: blue flat cap
grey furry animal head
pointed ears

appearance_text: A raccoon-faced character in a blue cap pulled low over a black bandit mask, with big white eyes and a grey muzzle. He wears a blue shirt and blue trousers with a yellow scarf at the neck and a yellow belt at the waist, plus grey gloves and grey boots. A curved black cane is drawn across the back of his shirt.
identity_text: Sly Cooper, the raccoon master thief who leads the Sly Cooper games, in his blue cap and black bandit mask with a yellow scarf and belt.

appearance_text: A figure covered head to toe in black with two glowing white eyes as the only bright thing on it. A hood and mask hide the whole face, and layered dark plates sit over the chest and shoulders of a black robe. The legs and boots are black too, and the back is just as dark with faint plate shapes.
identity_text: An unnamed assassin covered head to toe in black armour and cloth, with two glowing white eyes as the only bright thing on the figure.

appearance_text: A blond man in a tight orange top covered in little fish scales, with a darker pattern spreading across the chest and back. His trousers are green and scaled to match, and they end in dark green boots. His face is plain and serious with dark eyes.
identity_text: Aquaman, the DC Comics undersea superhero, shown as a blond man in his orange fish-scale shirt, green scaled trousers and dark green boots.

colors.item: vines on the arms and legs
colors.name: green

face: rainbow striped screen instead of a face
head: old wooden television for a head
screen showing rainbow colour bars
flowers growing on top of the television
top: green vines curling up the arms

appearance_text: Instead of a head this character has a chunky old wooden television, its screen filled with bright rainbow colour bars in red, orange, green, blue and purple. Flowers and green vines grow over the top of the set and curl down the bare arms and chest. He wears blue jeans with more vines climbing the legs and simple white shoes.
identity_text: A figure with a chunky old wooden television set where its head should be, the screen filled with rainbow colour bars, and flowers and vines growing over the set and down its arms and jeans. Not a named character.

appearance_text: A man with short light brown hair and a big brown moustache. He wears a light blue short sleeved shirt with a long white apron tied over it, and the apron strings cross on his back. His trousers are brown and his shoes are dark brown.
identity_text: A grown man at work as a baker: a light blue short-sleeved shirt with a long white apron tied over it, brown trousers and dark brown shoes, with a big drooping moustache.

head: gold star on top of the head
top: dark green tree branches strung with lights

appearance_text: A tall dark green tree-shaped character with a bright gold star sitting on top of its head. Strings of tiny red, blue and cream lights loop around the body, arms and legs, front and back. Down at the bottom the legs end in a short dark brown trunk.
identity_text: A Christmas tree walking about as a figure: dark green branches strung with coloured fairy lights, a gold star on top and a short dark brown trunk for feet.

bottom: black ripped jeans with grey patches
head: messy brown hair with a fringe
top: bright orange hoodie with darker orange patches

appearance_text: This boy has messy brown hair falling over his forehead, light skin and green eyes. He wears a bright orange hoodie speckled with darker orange patches that carries the same pattern across the back. His black jeans are ripped with grey patches showing through, and he wears white trainers with red heels.
identity_text: An ordinary teenage boy with messy brown hair falling over his forehead, dressed in a bright orange patterned hoodie, ripped black jeans and white trainers.

hair: hair down the back to the waist
subjects: girl in a red plaid jacket

appearance_text: A pale girl with long silver grey hair that falls in a fringe over her forehead and hangs down her back, with big yellow green eyes ringed in black. She wears an open red plaid jacket with the checks running over the sleeves and all across the back, and a plain dark grey shirt underneath. Short black shorts and chunky grey shoes finish the outfit.
identity_text: An unnamed teenage girl in an open red plaid jacket with long silver grey hair and black bottoms. The title only describes her outfit, so no character is being depicted.

head: grey metal piece over one ear
top: dark red speckles across the chest

appearance_text: A boy with brown hair and tan skin, wearing a bright red hoodie with white drawstrings and a spray of darker red speckles across the chest. A small grey metal piece sits over one ear on the side of his head. He wears blue jeans and red shoes with white soles.
identity_text: An ordinary teenage boy in a red hoodie speckled with dark red dust, themed on Minecraft's redstone. The listing title describes the outfit rather than naming anyone.

appearance_text: A green-skinned creature with a shaded, lumpy face and two dark empty eyes. It wears a light blue short-sleeved shirt with a darker collar, leaving its green arms bare from the elbow down. Its trousers are deep blue-purple and its feet are grey.
identity_text: The Minecraft zombie mob redrawn with soft shading: green skin, empty black eyes, a light blue shirt with a darker collar and deep blue-purple trousers.

appearance_text: A round-cheeked child bundled up in a thick pink snow suit with a big white fluffy hood framing the face. Brown hair peeks out over bright blue eyes and rosy cheeks. Chunky brown mittens cover the hands, and white snow boots come up over the ankles.
identity_text: Nana the ice climber, a round-cheeked child bundled into a pink hooded snow suit with brown mittens and white boots.

hair: long brown hair down the back
head: flower crown of blue, pink, purple and yellow flowers

appearance_text: A girl with long brown hair that hangs over her shoulders and all the way down her back, crowned with a ring of blue, pink, purple and yellow flowers. She wears a plain black long sleeve top with a small yellow belt buckle at the waist. Her trousers are pale grey jeans with rips at the knees, and she has white shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with long brown hair under a full rainbow flower crown, wearing a black long-sleeve top and pale ripped jeans.

head: hood with small animal ears
brown hair falling out of the hood
top: yellow shoulders and light blue chest

appearance_text: A girl zipped into a soft onesie that fades through the whole rainbow, yellow at the shoulders, light blue across the chest and arms, pink and purple down the legs and yellow at the feet. The hood is up with two little animal ears on top, and her brown hair spills out of it over her shoulders. She has big teal eyes and pink cheeks.
identity_text: A brown-haired girl zipped into a hooded rainbow onesie with little animal ears. The title describes the outfit rather than naming a character.

appearance_text: A big green scaly crocodile creature standing on two legs with a heavy tan belly and a long snout full of white teeth. One of its eyes is bloodshot red while the other stares out dark, and a chunky gold crown sits on top of its head. A long dark red cape hangs down the entire back, and gold cuffs ring its wrists above clawed green feet.
identity_text: King K Rool, the crocodile-like Kremling king who is the main villain of the Donkey Kong games, shown with his gold crown, red cape and heavy tan belly.

accessories: small white patch on the leg
face: black visor band instead of eyes
head: shiny silver full face helmet

appearance_text: A person wearing a shiny silver full-face helmet with a wide black visor band where the eyes would be. Below the helmet they wear a dark purple suit jacket over a white shirt collar, with black trousers and black shoes. The back of the jacket is plain dark purple and a small white patch sits on one leg.
identity_text: Thomas Bangalter of Daft Punk, shown in his silver full-face robot helmet with a black visor band, worn with a dark purple suit.

bottom: shaggy dark brown fur on the legs
head: two curved horns
pointed ears

appearance_text: A red-skinned creature with two dark curved horns and pointed ears, and pale glowing yellow eyes set in a heavy brow. Its chest and arms are bare red muscle with no clothing. From the waist down it is covered in shaggy dark brown fur, ending in hard dark hooves.
identity_text: A red-skinned demon with curved dark horns and pointed ears, a bare red torso, and shaggy brown goat-like legs ending in hooves.

footwear: dark grey knee socks with cream tops
head: long pale lavender hair

appearance_text: A girl with very long pale lavender hair streaked with white, falling all the way down her back, and dark quiet eyes. She wears a soft pink jacket open over a grey top, with plain black shorts. Her legs go into long dark grey socks with cream cuffs and simple black shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with very long pale lavender hair down her back, wearing an open light jacket over a grey top, black shorts and long dark socks with cream tops.

face: blue glowing circle instead of a face
head: grey metal cube head
blue circle on every side
top: grey metal armour with blue trim

appearance_text: A metal figure whose head is a grey cube with a big glowing blue circle stamped on every side instead of a face. Its body is grey plating trimmed with bright blue, with a blue circle badge in the middle of the chest and a blue heart shape on the back. The legs are grey metal and the boots have blue bands across them.
identity_text: A humanoid droid whose head is a grey panelled cube marked with a blue ringed circle on every side, with blue trim down the body and a blue heart on its back. The listing calls it Portal-inspired rather than naming it.

face: helmet face with black eye slits and a grille mouth
head: white helmet
black eye slits
brown band across the helmet

appearance_text: A soldier in white armour from head to toe, with a smooth white helmet marked by black eye slits, a black frown of a mouth grille and a brown band across the brow. White plates cover the chest, arms and legs over a black undersuit that shows at the joints. A big orange pad sits on one shoulder and a small pack is strapped to the back.
identity_text: A Star Wars sandtrooper: an Imperial trooper kitted out for desert duty in white armour, with an orange shoulder pauldron and a pack on his back.

head: white hood on the back
top: white hoodie with a black tick on the chest

appearance_text: A tan-skinned boy with thick fluffy dark brown hair parted over light blue eyes. He wears a baggy white hoodie with a single black tick swooping across the chest and the hood down behind him. Below are ripped light grey jeans with holes at the knees and clean white shoes with black soles.
identity_text: An unnamed boy in a baggy white hoodie marked with one black sportswear tick, worn with ripped grey jeans and white shoes.

footwear: red shoes with green and yellow trim
head: red spiky head quills
top: red chest with a white crescent

appearance_text: A bright red animal character with spiky quills on its head, a tan muzzle, a small black nose and narrow purple eyes. A white crescent shape sits on the middle of its red chest, and big white gloves cover both hands with cuffs at the wrists. The legs are red and end in red shoes trimmed with green and yellow bands. Its back is red all over with darker red quills.
identity_text: Knuckles, the red echidna from the Sonic the Hedgehog games, with spiky head quills, a white crescent chest mark and oversized white gloves.

head: light blue hair
pointed cat ears
top: dark red shirt with a tie

appearance_text: A boy with soft light blue hair and two pointed cat ears poking up from his head, with dark red eyes and pink blushed cheeks. He wears a dark purple checked jacket over a deep red shirt with a matching red tie down the front. His jeans are blue and cuffed, tucked into dark blue boots.
identity_text: An unnamed boy with soft light blue hair and pointed cat ears, wearing a dark purple checked flannel over a deep red shirt and tie, with cuffed blue jeans and dark boots.

appearance_text: A very pale girl with long straight white hair that falls all the way down her back, glowing red eyes and pink blushing cheeks. She wears a short dark grey sleeveless dress that leaves her shoulders, arms and legs bare, with thin dark straps around her legs. Her feet are bare.
identity_text: A human girl styled after a Minecraft ghast, very pale with floor-length white hair, glowing red eyes and a short dark grey dress.

head: white animal ears with pink insides
top: small pink heart on the chest

appearance_text: A very pale girl with long soft pink hair that hangs down her back, and two white animal ears with pink insides standing up on her head. Her eyes are grey and her mouth is a tiny open circle. She wears a pale pink dress with big white puffy sleeves and a small pink heart on the chest. Her legs are covered by white leggings and she wears chunky dark grey shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed pastel girl with long pale pink hair, white animal ears and a pink dress with puffy white sleeves. The title is a soft-aesthetic label rather than a character.

appearance_text: A girl with very long brown hair that reaches her waist and small furry ears with pink insides on top of her head. Pink and white striped sleeves cover her arms under a brown pinafore dress, and pink flowers are tucked into the back of her hair with more sprinkled down her clothes. She wears white socks and soft green boots.
identity_text: A girl in a soft spring outfit with rounded animal ears on her head - pink and white striped sleeves under a brown pinafore, flowers in her waist-length hair and green boots.

head: brown hair
top: light blue jacket over a dark navy hoodie

appearance_text: A smiling boy with brown hair falling over blue eyes. He wears a pale blue jacket with white sleeves open over a dark navy hooded top with strings at the neck. Black bands sit at both wrists, and his dark navy jeans have a light belt and end in dark shoes.
identity_text: A smiling brown-haired boy in a pale blue jacket over a navy hoodie, with navy jeans and dark shoes. The listing describes him only as a gamer boy.

head: taco shell head with pointed corners
green and red toppings on top
top: red meat filling across the chest

appearance_text: A walking taco with a crisp tan shell for a body and two pointed shell corners sticking up like ears. Its face is pale yellow with dark sunken eyes and a wide dark open mouth, and little green and red bits of filling sit on top of its head. Red meaty filling spreads across the chest and back, and a band of green lettuce wraps around the hips like shorts above tan legs.
identity_text: A zombified taco: a walking taco shell with sunken dark eyes and a gaping mouth, red filling spread across its chest and lettuce round its hips.

appearance_text: A grown man with short wavy brown hair and green eyes, showing a small white smile. He wears a black jacket left open over a dark blue shirt. His trousers are black with a grey belt at the waist, and his shoes are black. The back of the jacket is plain black.
identity_text: Ethan Hunt, the secret agent of the Mission: Impossible films, in a black jacket left open over a dark blue shirt with black trousers and shoes.

hair: dark brown fur cap on top of the head
head: furry animal head

appearance_text: A shaggy brown animal covered head to toe in speckled brown fur. Its wide tan face has two dark brown patches around small black eyes, a little brown nose and a soft sleepy smile, with a darker band of fur across the top of the head. The arms, back and legs are all the same mottled brown fur.
identity_text: A sloth, the slow-moving tree-dwelling mammal, shown as a shaggy brown-furred figure with dark patches around its eyes and a sleepy smile.

bottom: dark red tunic skirt with cream trim
head: dark grey helmet with a cross shaped slit
top: dark grey shoulder and chest armour over a dark red tunic

appearance_text: This warrior is covered in dark grey metal armour, with a closed helmet that has a narrow cross shaped slit across the face. Heavy plates sit on the shoulders and arms over a dark red tunic edged with cream, and the tunic hangs down in a split skirt over armoured legs. Cream cuffs show at the wrists and the boots are dark grey metal.
identity_text: A knight in full dark grey plate armour, his face hidden behind a closed helm with a narrow cross-shaped slit, a dark red tunic trimmed in cream hanging over the armour and down into a split skirt.

accessories: brown bag strap across the chest

appearance_text: A boy with big curly black hair and green eyes. He wears a bright red jacket with a brown bag strap running across his chest, and a brown satchel hangs on his back. His trousers are blue jeans and he has white sneakers with black soles.
identity_text: Henry, one of the main characters of the Minecraft movie, shown as a boy with big curly black hair in a bright red jacket, a brown satchel slung across his chest and blue jeans.

colors.item: christmas tree printed on the top
colors.name: green

hair: long brown hair with a fringe
head: long brown hair
crown of holly and berries
top: green christmas tree with baubles on the chest

appearance_text: A girl with long brown hair falling over her shoulders, crowned with a ring of green holly leaves and red berries. Her white top has a green Christmas tree hung with coloured baubles printed across the chest. She wears loose trousers in a red and green checked pattern and plain white shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in Christmas clothes: a white top printed with a baubled green tree, checked red and green trousers and a holly crown.

head: orange animal hood resting behind the head
small round ears on the hood

appearance_text: A pale character with short purple hair and pink blushed cheeks, dressed in a full body orange animal suit. Black stripes run around the arms and legs like a tiger, and a big cream panel covers the belly and chest. A soft orange hood with two little round ears sits behind the head, and a short orange tail hangs at the back.
identity_text: An unnamed purple haired character in a full body orange tiger onesie with black stripes, a cream belly panel, an eared hood down behind the head and a short tail.

head: green dinosaur hood
small white spikes on top
black patch on the side of the hood

appearance_text: A girl with long pink hair and bright light blue eyes, wrapped in a baggy green dinosaur hoodie with little white spikes on top of the hood. The hood has a dark patch on one side like an eye. Her legs are bare below the hoodie, and she wears socks striped in rainbow colours with pink shoes.
identity_text: A girl with long pink hair bundled into a baggy green dinosaur hoodie, the hood carrying a dark eye and a white zigzag grin. No character is named.

footwear: black boots with red claw tips
head: red full face mask
big silver eye lenses
top: spider shape across the chest and shoulders

appearance_text: A hero sealed in a tight red and black suit with no skin showing. The full face mask is bright red with two big silver eye lenses that curve to a point. A red spider shape spreads across the chest and shoulders over black armoured panels, and the black arms and legs end in sharp red claw tips at the hands and feet.
identity_text: The Superior Spider-Man in his red and black armoured suit, with big silver eye lenses and clawed hands and feet.

face: dark red band covering the eyes
motifs: white skull print on the back
top: black robe with dark red trim

appearance_text: An old figure with white hair and a long white beard, his eyes hidden behind a wide dark red band. He wears a long black robe with dark red edging and a dark red sash tied at the waist. A large white skull is printed across the back of the robe, and brown sandals show below the hem.
identity_text: A blindfolded old master with long white hair and beard, in a black robe with dark red trim and sash and a white skull printed across the back.

bottom: white tracksuit trousers with a blue stripe
head: short brown hair
top: blue hoodie with a hood down the back

appearance_text: A boy with short messy brown hair and dark eyes. He wears a blue hoodie with a big white tick shape across the chest and the hood folded down on his back. His tracksuit trousers are white with a thin blue stripe down the side. On his feet are chunky black trainers with white soles.
identity_text: An unnamed boy in sportswear — a blue hoodie with a big white tick on the chest, white tracksuit trousers and black trainers.

colors.item: big eye shapes on the mask
colors.name: white

face: red mask with two big white eye shapes outlined in black
head: red full-face mask with dark web lines

appearance_text: A pale-skinned figure wearing nothing but a red full-face mask and a pair of small grey briefs. The mask has two big white eye shapes outlined in black and faint darker web lines across the red. The rest of the body, arms and legs are completely bare, and the briefs have a few small red spots on them.
identity_text: Spider-Man stripped down to his red full-face mask and a pair of briefs, from the banya scene the listing describes.

appearance_text: A man with short black hair and a thick black moustache across his face. He wears a green suit with light stripes, a white shirt and a dark red tie. His trousers match the jacket and his shoes are black.
identity_text: Mumbo Jumbo, the Minecraft YouTuber, wearing a bamboo-patterned green suit with his trademark black moustache.

hair: black mane down the back of the head
head: blue animal head
droopy purple ears

appearance_text: A soft blue donkey standing on two legs, with a big pale pink muzzle, two dark nostrils and small sad black eyes. Purple droopy ears hang at the sides of its head and a black mane runs down the back. Its chest and belly are lighter purple, its arms and legs are blue, and a dark tail with a pink bow sits on its back.
identity_text: Eeyore, the gloomy blue donkey from A. A. Milne's stories, standing on two legs with droopy purple ears, a big pale pink muzzle, a black mane and a pink bow on his tail.

appearance_text: A big shaggy creature covered head to toe in light blue fur with soft purple spots down its back and arms. Two small brown horns stick up from its head, above two big round white eyes and a wide grin full of white teeth. Its arms and legs are thick and furry in the same pale blue.
identity_text: Sully from Pixar's Monsters, Inc., the big shaggy blue monster with purple spots, small horns and a mouth full of white teeth.

appearance_text: A green gooey creature dressed in a smart dark grey suit. Its head is a soft green blob with two dark square eyes and a tiny square mouth, sitting above a white shirt collar and a bright red tie. The jacket sleeves end in green gooey hands, and the trousers are the same dark grey with black shoes.
identity_text: A slime dressed for the office, its green blob head with square dark eyes and a tiny mouth sitting above a dark grey suit and red tie.

head: flat green head with the classic sad black face
motifs: big black opening across the chest
top: mottled green body with a big black opening down the chest

appearance_text: A tall green creature covered in blotchy light and dark green camouflage from head to toe. Its flat head carries two square black eyes and a wide downturned black mouth, and a second big black opening gapes down the middle of its chest. The arms, back and legs are the same mottled green with no clothing at all.
identity_text: A tall green creeper-like monster in mottled camouflage green, with square black eyes and a wide gaping black mouth that runs down into its chest. The listing calls it creeper themed rather than a creeper, so no name is asserted.

appearance_text: A girl with long blonde hair, braided at the front and hanging loose down her back, with big blue eyes. She wears a red jacket with long red sleeves. Her jeans are blue and her shoes are black.
identity_text: A casual girl with long blonde hair braided at the front, wearing a dark red jacket over blue jeans with black shoes. No character is named and the skin is a generic everyday-clothes girl.

face: face half hidden by the hood
head: pointed white hood

appearance_text: A bearded man in a long white hooded robe, with the pointed hood pulled forward so it shadows his eyes. A red sash crosses his chest and a red belt with a grey buckle plate sits at his waist over brown leather straps and bracers. His trousers and tall boots are brown, and the back of the robe hangs white with the hood standing up.
identity_text: Ezio Auditore da Firenze, the hooded Renaissance assassin who leads Assassin's Creed II, in his white pointed hood and robe with a red sash and brown leather straps.

head: messy dark brown hair
top: teal shirt covered in white flowers

appearance_text: A boy with shaggy dark brown hair falling around his face. He wears a teal short sleeved shirt covered in big white flowers, open over a plain dark grey t-shirt. Light blue denim shorts sit on a belt at his waist, his legs are bare, and he wears simple brown sandals.
identity_text: An unnamed teenage boy dressed for the beach in an open floral Hawaiian shirt over a dark grey tee, with denim shorts and bare legs.

top: two purple stripes across the chest and back

appearance_text: A small child with short dark brown bobbed hair, rosy cheeks and eyes squeezed shut in a calm smile. They wear a long-sleeved blue jumper with two thick purple stripes running across the chest and around the back. Below are dark brown shorts, bare knees and brown shoes with white toes.
identity_text: Frisk, the child player character of the role-playing game Undertale, in the blue jumper with two purple stripes.

head: brown bear hood with round ears and a bear face
top: brown bear hoodie with a lighter belly patch

appearance_text: A girl with long brown hair wearing a fluffy brown bear hood with round ears and a little bear face on the front. Her brown hoodie has a lighter tan patch down the belly and long sleeves. She wears short black shorts with bare legs and white shoes.
identity_text: A girl in a brown bear hoodie with a bear-faced eared hood and a lighter belly patch, worn over short black shorts.

head: little white cloud on top of the hair

appearance_text: A character with short dark brown hair and a small puffy white cloud resting right on top of their head. They wear a light blue jumper with black sleeves and a fluffy white cloud printed across the chest. Their trousers are black with light blue cuffs at the ankle, above light blue shoes with white soles.
identity_text: An unnamed boy in a sky-themed outfit, with a little white cloud perched on top of his hair and another cloud printed across his light blue jumper.

head: hood down at the back
top: small white shape on the chest

appearance_text: A young person with fluffy brown hair that flops over their eyes and covers the back of their head. They wear a soft pale grey hoodie with white striped sleeves and a small white shape on the chest, and the hood hangs down behind. Below that are plain grey trousers and white and grey trainers.
identity_text: A young person with fluffy brown hair in an oversized bluish-grey hoodie, grey trousers and white trainers. 'Mr. Jack' is a label for this file rather than a character who exists outside it.

colors.item: two glowing rectangle eyes on the screen
colors.name: white

colors.item: fluffy trim on the shoulders and back of the sweater
colors.name: white

colors.item: teddy bear picture on the sweater
colors.name: brown

appearance_text: This character has an old boxy television where a head should be, with a dark screen showing two glowing white rectangles for eyes. It wears a red Christmas sweater with a small brown teddy bear on the chest and soft white fluffy trim around the collar and shoulders, which also shows across the back. Below that are dark red checked pyjama trousers and plain white socks.
identity_text: An unnamed figure with an old boxy television in place of a head, dressed for Christmas in a red fluffy-trimmed jumper and checked pyjama trousers.

accessories: brown rocket pack on the back
head: pink pig head
pointed ears

appearance_text: A stocky pink pig standing upright, with a pale snout, small tusks and black dot eyes under two pointed ears. Its pink hide is marked with darker stripes down the arms and legs, and brown straps cross the chest. Strapped to its back is a brown rocket pack with a bright golden flame blasting out of the bottom.
identity_text: An upright cartoon pig with brown straps across its chest and a rocket pack on its back throwing out a golden flame. No named character is attested; the title describes the figure.

appearance_text: A man whose face is split straight down the middle. One half is normal, with tidy blond hair, tan skin and a blue eye. The other half is dark red and burnt, with scorched hair, ruined lumpy skin and a wide pale eye that has no lid. He wears a sharp black suit over a white shirt with a red and white striped tie, and black trousers and shoes.
identity_text: Harvey Dent, the Gotham lawyer who becomes the villain Two-Face in The Dark Knight. One side of him is a tidy blond man in a black suit and the other is scorched raw down the middle of the face and head.

appearance_text: A dark-skinned man with very short black hair and square glasses. He wears a pale yellow button-up shirt tucked in, with a thin black tie hanging down the front. A dark brown belt holds up plain brown trousers that reach dark brown shoes. The back of the shirt is plain pale yellow with no print.
identity_text: Gustavo Fring, the fast-food restaurant owner and drug kingpin from the TV series Breaking Bad, in his pale yellow work shirt and thin black tie.

appearance_text: A grown man in a wide brimmed dark brown hat pulled low over his eyes, with brown hair showing beneath it. He wears a well worn brown jacket with the sleeves rolled up over a tan shirt, cinched with a brown belt at the waist. His trousers are brown and tucked into sturdy dark boots, and the jacket is plain brown across the back.
identity_text: The gaming YouTuber PaulSoaresJr, shown in the wide-brimmed hat and worn brown explorer's jacket of his Minecraft survival persona.

head: cream cat ears
top: black off shoulder dress with a white collar

appearance_text: A pale girl with very long cream blonde hair and a pair of matching cat ears on top of her head. Her eyes are bright red and her cheeks are pink. She wears a black dress with long sleeves, a white collar at the throat and bare shoulders, with a short black skirt. Her legs are bare above tall black boots.
identity_text: An unnamed anime-styled girl with waist-length cream blonde hair, matching cat ears, red eyes, a black off-shoulder dress with a white collar and tall black boots.

colors.item: tnt block band on the head
colors.name: red

head: half the head is a tnt block with a red stripe
green mottled head

appearance_text: A tall green creature covered in patchy light and dark green squares, with a flat black face made of two square eyes and a wide frowning mouth. One side of its head is built like a red and white explosive block with a bright red band around it. Its arms and legs are the same mottled green, and the same green pattern wraps around the back.
identity_text: A Creeper, the mottled green exploding mob from Minecraft, with one side of its head replaced by a red and white explosive block.

hair: short brown hair with a fringe
head: hood up over the head

appearance_text: A boy with short brown hair and bright blue eyes, with the hood of his jumper pulled up over his head. The hoodie is striped in blue and black all the way round, including the sleeves and the back, with pale drawstrings hanging at the neck. He wears plain grey trousers and black shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed boy in a blue and black striped hoodie with the hood pulled up over his head, plain grey trousers and black shoes.

appearance_text: A girl with a short straight black bob and a blunt fringe just above bright green eyes. She wears a loose white top with pale grey-blue straps over the shoulders and a tiny bow at the waist. Below it are blue denim shorts, leaving her legs bare down to small white shoes. Her hair is cut level all the way around the back.
identity_text: Haku from the Ghibli film Spirited Away, in the human form he keeps through most of the story, simplified here to a white top and blue shorts.

appearance_text: A boy with short brown hair and big light blue eyes. He wears a plain green t-shirt with short sleeves and blue shorts that leave his legs bare. His shoes are black.
identity_text: A plain boy with short brown hair and blue eyes in a bright green t-shirt, teal shorts and black shoes. The title describes the look rather than naming anyone.

head: black head ringed with orange fur
small round ears

appearance_text: A small creature with a black face ringed by shaggy orange fur and two round ears sticking up. Its huge white eyes sit above a pair of tiny fangs and a pink tongue. The body is dark grey and furry with pale cuffs at the wrists, and the arms and legs are stubby.
identity_text: Pump, the pumpkin-costumed kid from Sr Pelo's web series Spooky Month. His orange ribbed pumpkin head frames a black face with two huge white eyes, small fangs and a pink tongue, above a plain dark grey costume with white cuffs.

head: shaggy brown hair down to the shoulders

appearance_text: A tough soldier with shaggy brown hair to his shoulders and stubble on his chin, wearing a black patch over one eye and showing one blue eye. He is dressed in a dark green combat suit with black shoulder pads and straps buckled across his chest and back. His trousers are the same dark green with a belt, and he wears heavy black boots.
identity_text: Big Boss from the Metal Gear Solid games, a one-eyed special forces soldier in a dark green sneaking suit with black webbing strapped across the chest.

head: bald dusty pink head
top: small white heart on the chest

appearance_text: A bald figure with dusty pink skin and huge black eyes taking up half its face. It wears a plain red short sleeved t-shirt with a tiny white heart on the chest, leaving its pink arms bare. Its trousers and shoes are grey.
identity_text: A bald, dusty-pink humanoid with huge black eyes wearing an ordinary red t-shirt and grey trousers, presented as a Martian re-imagining of the Minecraft player character rather than as that character himself.

appearance_text: A person-shaped creature made entirely of wobbly green goo, lighter in some patches and darker in others so it looks see-through. The face has two dark green square eyes and a tiny square mouth. There are no clothes at all, just gooey green arms, legs and body, the same all the way round the back.
identity_text: A Minecraft slime built into a person shape: a figure made entirely of wobbling green goo with two dark square eyes and a tiny square mouth.

colors.item: marks on the chest and arms
colors.name: dark red

head: boxy grey television for a head
dark screen with an orange glow

appearance_text: A tall thin figure whose head is a boxy old grey television with a dark screen glowing orange in the middle, like a flame trapped behind the glass. It wears a long dark brown coat with a tan collar and tan cuffs, streaked with dark red marks across the chest and arms. The coat hangs down over dark trousers and heavy brown boots, and the back is plain worn brown.
identity_text: An unnamed tall figure whose head is an old grey television glowing orange behind the screen, dressed in a long dark coat trimmed with gold and dark red.

hair: long dark pink hair with a straight fringe
head: small pink bow on top of the head
top: frilly pink dress with a white collar

appearance_text: A girl with long dark pink hair, a straight fringe and rosy blushing cheeks. She wears a frilly pink dress speckled with little seed-like spots, with puffy sleeves and a white collar at the neck. Her legs are bare above pink and white striped socks and dark red shoes, and her long hair covers most of her back.
identity_text: An unnamed girl dressed as a strawberry, in a frilly seed-speckled dress with a white collar, striped socks and dark red shoes.

appearance_text: A man with brown hair and a thick brown beard covering his chin and cheeks. He wears a plain light blue t-shirt with short sleeves and bare arms. His trousers are dark brown and so are his shoes.
identity_text: Minecraft's Steve reimagined with a thick brown beard, wearing a plain blue-grey t-shirt and dark brown trousers.

appearance_text: A hulking creature made of cracked grey stone, glowing hot orange and yellow through the gaps. Its head has small pointed ears, two burning yellow eyes and a wide glowing grin that stretches across its face. Bright molten marks run across the chest and down the arms, and the same glow shows on its back. The lower half of the body is darker brown rock that fades into heavy legs.
identity_text: A hulking creature built of cracked stone that glows molten gold and orange through the gaps, with burning eyes and a wide glowing grin. The title is a one-off invented name for this creature.

appearance_text: An older man with slicked dark brown hair, heavy dark eyebrows and a thick grey moustache, his tanned face lined with wrinkles. He wears a dark brown suit jacket over a white shirt, with a small red flower pinned to the lapel. The jacket is plain dark brown across the back. His trousers match the jacket and end in dark shoes.
identity_text: Vito Corleone, the ageing mafia boss of The Godfather, in a dark brown suit and white shirt with a red flower in his lapel.

accessories: black belt with a gold buckle
footwear: dark brown boots with white tops
head: green creeper head
red santa hat with white fur
top: red coat with white fur edges

appearance_text: A green speckled monster with two black square eyes and a wide black frowning mouth, wearing a red hat with a white fur band. Its red coat is edged in white fur and belted with a gold buckle. Red trousers run down to dark brown boots with white tops.
identity_text: A Minecraft creeper dressed up for Christmas in a red fur-trimmed coat, hat and gold-buckled belt, its green speckled creeper face left showing.

appearance_text: A pale boy with messy salmon pink hair and small black eyes. He wears a dark red sweater with slightly lighter panels down the front, dark purple jeans and light purple shoes. The same red sweater covers his back and arms.
identity_text: A remake of the Minecraft YouTuber Grian's own skin: a pale boy with messy salmon-pink hair, a dark red sweater, dark purple jeans and light purple shoes.

appearance_text: A huge, heavily muscled man with pale skin, short brown hair and a thick brown beard and moustache. His chest and back are bare and covered in dark hair, and he wears only red wrestling trunks with a gold buckle at the front. Red bands circle his arms and legs, and he has chunky red boots.
identity_text: Zangief from the Street Fighter games, an enormous heavily muscled wrestler bare-chested in red wrestling trunks with a gold buckle, red arm and leg bands and red boots.

face: wide open mouth with one big white tooth
head: green prickly head

appearance_text: A green cactus-skinned character with dark prickles dotted over his head, arms and legs, and a little yellow tuft of hair on top. His face has two black square eyes and a wide open mouth with a single big white tooth. He wears a plain brown t-shirt and short blue trousers.
identity_text: A living cactus with arms and legs, dark prickles dotted over its green skin and a little yellow tuft on top, dressed in a brown t-shirt and short blue trousers.

accessories: coloured buttons on the back of the head
face: two glowing light blue rectangle eyes on the screen
head: grey television head with a dark screen
top: worn brown leather coat with straps and buckles

appearance_text: This character has a boxy grey television for a head, with a dark screen showing two glowing light blue rectangles for eyes and little coloured buttons round the back. It wears a scuffed brown leather coat with straps and buckles across the chest and shoulders, and a dark red scarf at the neck. A black pack is strapped to its back, and it wears dark green trousers and heavy brown boots.
identity_text: An unnamed traveller whose head is a boxy grey television, its dark screen lit with two glowing cyan rectangles and little coloured buttons round the back. He is kitted out for the road in a battered brown leather coat, a red scarf, a backpack, dark green trousers and heavy boots.

head: small pointed ears
big cream curved horns on the sides of the head

appearance_text: A dark red demon with glowing yellow eyes, pointed ears and two big cream horns curling out from the sides of its head. Its chest and arms are bare red and muscled. From the waist down it has shaggy brown fur legs ending in dark hooves.
identity_text: Satan, the Devil — a dark red demon with glowing eyes, big pale horns curling from the sides of its head, a bare muscled chest and shaggy brown goat legs ending in hooves.

footwear: tall brown boots with cream bands
top: brown long sleeve crop top with cream stripes

appearance_text: A girl with very long dark reddish brown hair that falls all the way down her back, and bright blue eyes. She wears a short brown long sleeve top with cream bands around the sleeves, light blue shorts, and tall brown boots that reach her thighs with cream bands around the tops.
identity_text: A girl with very long dark auburn hair in a brown and cream outfit, drawn as a humanised version of the Grumpy Cat meme. The title names the theme, not the figure.

face: brass eyepiece with a blue lens over one eye
footwear: dark boots with small gold gears
head: neat brown hair

appearance_text: A man with neat brown hair wearing a brass eyepiece with a glowing blue lens strapped over one eye. He wears a long dark brown coat with a row of gold buttons down the front and gold pieces on the shoulders. Dark brown trousers and boots with little gold gears finish the outfit.
identity_text: An unnamed steampunk gentleman-inventor in a long brass-buttoned brown coat with gold shoulder pieces, wearing a monocle goggle with a glowing blue lens.

colors.item: mesh pattern over the whole body
colors.name: dark brown

appearance_text: A tanned man with short dark brown hair, a straight fringe, a brown beard and bright blue eyes. He wears a plain cyan short-sleeved shirt with bare arms, blue jeans and grey shoes. A dark net-like mesh pattern is laid over every part of him, from his hair down to his shoes, so his whole body looks criss-crossed with fine lines.
identity_text: Steve, the default Minecraft player character, in his cyan shirt and blue jeans, with a dark criss-cross mesh pattern laid over the whole skin from hair to shoes.

bottom: dark grey bands on the legs
head: white streak on top of the hair

appearance_text: A girl with long pink hair falling down her back and a pale streak running over the top of her head, with big green eyes underneath. She wears a soft white jumper with wide sleeves. Below it are short light blue denim shorts, dark grey bands around the tops of her legs and chunky black boots.
identity_text: An unnamed girl styled around her long pink hair, in a soft white jumper, short light blue denim shorts and chunky black boots. "Pink Hair" describes her look rather than naming a character.

bottom: black trousers with light blue bands

colors.item: trim on the sleeves and hood
colors.name: light blue

colors.name: light blue

face: white mask with black eye patches
hair: short brown hair at the back
head: white mask covering the face
motifs: creeper face print on the back
top: black hoodie with light blue stripes

appearance_text: A boy whose face is covered by a white mask with two black eye patches and red streaks running down it, with short brown hair showing behind. He wears a black hoodie edged with light blue stripes at the cuffs and hood, and a light blue creeper-style face is printed across the back. His black trousers have light blue bands above bright light blue shoes.
identity_text: A boy whose face is hidden behind a white mask streaked with red, in a black hoodie trimmed with light blue and printed with a blue creeper face on the back.

appearance_text: A girl with long, bushy brown hair that reaches the middle of her back. She wears a school uniform: a white shirt with a red and gold striped tie under a dark grey sweater. Below it is a grey pleated skirt, black knee socks and plain black shoes.
identity_text: Hermione Granger from Harry Potter, in her wizarding school uniform: a dark sweater over a white shirt with a red and gold striped tie, a short dark skirt, and long bushy brown hair down her back.

appearance_text: A tall figure wrapped head to toe in a deep red robe, with a pointed hood edged in gold. Inside the hood there is only blackness where a face would be, with no eyes or mouth showing. A gold sash crosses the chest over the robe and a gold band circles the waist, and the long robe ends above black shoes.
identity_text: A faceless wizard wrapped head to toe in a deep red robe with gold trim, only blackness inside the hood. 'Red Wizard' describes the figure rather than naming one.

accessories: bunch of curled orange tails on the back
head: fox ears
curly orange fur tuft

appearance_text: A small tan-furred fox creature with pointed ears and a curly orange tuft of fur flopping over its forehead. Its face has dark brown patches around white eyes and a tiny black nose, and a cream patch runs down its front. A bunch of curled orange tails sits at the back, and its paws are brown.
identity_text: Vulpix, the fire-type fox Pokémon named in the listing, with its curly orange head tuft, dark face markings and bundle of curled tails.

accessories: light blue shoulder bag with a white flower
face: one green eye and one blue eye
footwear: light blue shoes with white socks
hair: long brown hair down the back
head: white daisy flowers tucked in the hair
ring of daisies around the back of the head
top: light green cardigan over a white shirt

appearance_text: A girl with long wavy brown hair that falls down her back, with white daisies tucked into it and a ring of daisies around the back of her head. One eye is green and the other is blue. She wears a soft light green cardigan over a white top, light blue denim shorts, and carries a small light blue bag on a strap with a white flower on it. Her feet are in pale blue shoes with white socks.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in a soft green cardigan and light blue denim shorts, with long brown hair full of white daisies and a small flowered shoulder bag.

hair: short ginger blonde hair with a fringe

appearance_text: A young person with short ginger blonde hair falling over big dark blue eyes. A thick teal scarf is wrapped around the neck, over a cream long sleeved shirt with a brown buttoned vest on top. The trousers are plain grey and the boots are dark brown, and the brown vest covers the back as well.
identity_text: An unnamed young traveller in a thick teal scarf, a brown buttoned vest over a cream shirt, grey trousers and brown boots.

colors.item: glowing eyes printed on the back
colors.name: purple

head: brown hair
motifs: glowing purple eyes on the back

appearance_text: A brown-haired character with bright blue eyes and a black mask pulled over the mouth. He wears a brown jacket with striped sleeves and grey gloves, and holds a long grey gun across his chest. His trousers are dark brown and his boots are black. Across the back of the jacket glow two purple eyes.
identity_text: A hunter in a dark brown jacket and black face mask with a long grey rifle across his chest; the back of his jacket is printed with a pair of glowing purple eyes.

head: teal top hat
brass straps on the back of the head
top: white and grey coat with brass buckles

appearance_text: A smart figure wearing a tall teal top hat and a black suit with a white shirt and tie. Over it sits a white and grey coat with orange brass trim, buckles and straps that also wrap around the back of the head. Chunky gold gauntlets cover the hands and gold boots cover the feet, with plain grey trousers in between.
identity_text: A steampunk gentleman in a teal top hat, black suit and white-shouldered coat trimmed with brass, finished with gold gauntlets and boots and a brass rig strapped across the back of the head. The listing calls it a steampunk version of a well-known helmeted music duo, but nothing of that duo appears in the render.

accessories: red cape hanging down the back

colors.item: long open red-and-white coat; the back panel is the coat/shirt back, not a cape
colors.name: red

head: spiky red hair

appearance_text: A warrior with bright spiky red hair, dressed head to toe in plate armour. The armour mixes red and grey with a white chest plate, huge shoulder guards and small gold studs. Black and red armoured leggings lead down to heavy grey metal boots, and a red cape hangs down the back.
identity_text: Lord Knight from the game Elsword, a red-haired swordsman in layered red, white and grey plate armour with big shoulder guards.

head: horned dark red head
top: burning chest with yellow diamond markings

appearance_text: A monster made of fire, with a dark red head, two enormous glowing yellow eyes and a jagged row of yellow teeth stretched into a grin. Small horns rise from the top of its head. Its chest is dark red with bright yellow diamond markings running down the middle, and its arms and legs fade from deep red into orange and yellow like burning coals.
identity_text: Feral Chaos, a boss character from Dissidia Final Fantasy, drawn here as a burning demon with glowing yellow eyes, small horns and a jagged yellow grin.

appearance_text: A big green reptile creature covered in mottled green scales, with a long snout full of pointy white teeth and small white eyes. Its chest and belly are a pale cream colour with band markings across them. A row of cream spikes runs all the way down its back and its arms and legs end in white claws.
identity_text: A big green dinosaur covered in mottled scales, with a pale cream belly, a row of cream spikes down its back and a long snout full of pointed teeth.

accessories: fluffy cream fox tail on the back
hair: long brown hair falling from under the hood
head: orange fox hood with pointed ears
cream fox face on the front of the hood

appearance_text: A girl with long brown hair peeking out from under an orange fox hood, which has pointed ears and a cream fox face on the front. The hoodie is worn open over a plain white top, and a fluffy cream-tipped tail hangs at the back. Her thighs are bare above long black socks pulled up over the knees, with short dark brown shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed brown-haired girl in an orange fox hoodie with the hood up over a plain white top, with a fluffy tail and black thigh-high socks.

colors.item: long blue hair down the back (no cape)
colors.name: blue

appearance_text: A warrior girl with long dark blue hair and dark eyes. She wears blue armour with gold trimmed shoulder plates over a blue tunic, cinched with a white belt. A blue cape hangs down her back, and she has blue leggings tucked into grey boots.
identity_text: Lucina, the blue-haired swordswoman of the Fire Emblem games, in her blue and gold armour. The listing places her in Super Smash Bros Ultimate.

appearance_text: A pale girl with glossy black hair cut in a straight bob, rosy cheeks, a tiny red mouth and a pink flower tucked above one ear. She wears a long pink kimono covered in red and white blossom patterns, with wide hanging sleeves and a yellow sash tied around the waist. On her back the kimono carries a big golden bow shape, and the flowered pink fabric falls all the way to cream sandals at her feet.
identity_text: A kokeshi doll, the traditional Japanese wooden doll, drawn here as a girl with a straight black bob in a blossom-patterned pink kimono and yellow sash.

appearance_text: A creature made of flame, its whole body a flicker of bright yellow and orange fire. The head is dark and smoky, as if burnt, with two tiny black eyes staring out and fire rising around it. Arms and legs are the same restless flames, with no skin or clothing anywhere.
identity_text: A human-shaped version of the Blaze, the Minecraft nether mob, its arms, legs and torso all burning yellow and orange under a dark scorched head.

head: silver helmet
gold face plate with dark eye slits
dark red cloth around the face
top: dark chest armour with a red emblem
gold armoured arms with red bands

appearance_text: A tall armoured fighter whose face is hidden behind a gold face plate with narrow dark eye slits, topped by a silver helmet and wrapped in dark red cloth. Broad gold shoulder plates sit over a dark chest piece marked with a red emblem, and gold bands ring the arms. A long black cape with red edges hangs down the back, over a black armoured skirt, grey leg armour and gold boots.
identity_text: A fully armoured medieval holy warrior with no face showing: a silver helm over a gold face plate with narrow eye slits, dark red cloth around the head, gold plate on the shoulders and arms, a dark chest piece carrying a red emblem and a black red-edged cape.

head: big messy brown hair
top: orange shirt with a ragged white collar

appearance_text: A huge man with a mop of messy brown hair, a big round nose and small dark eyes. He wears a rust-orange shirt with a ragged white collar and brown overalls held up by one strap, leaving his enormous bare arms showing. The legs are the same worn brown down to dark boots.
identity_text: Wreck-It Ralph, the big-fisted arcade game villain from the Disney film, in his torn brown overalls and orange shirt with the ragged collar.

hair: blonde hair with a long braid down the back
two strands hanging at the front
subjects: boy in a long red coat

appearance_text: A teenage boy with blonde hair, two strands hanging beside his face and a long braid running down his back. He wears a long dark red coat that reaches his knees, open over a black shirt and black trousers. His hands are covered by white gloves and his boots are black.
identity_text: A blonde teenage alchemist in a knee-length dark red coat over black clothes, with white gloves and a long braid down his back; a gold emblem runs down the back of the coat.

appearance_text: A small tan creature that wears a white skull like a helmet over its whole head, with two hollow dark eye holes, tiny nose holes and two little grey horns on top. Its body is orange-tan with a pale cream belly and short stubby arms and legs. A small tail sticks out at its back.
identity_text: Cubone, the small ground-type Pokemon that wears a skull as a helmet, with a tan body, cream belly and stubby arms and legs.

accessories: orange pumpkin held in both hands

colors.name: orange

footwear: dark brown boots with pale soles
head: long light blonde hair
orange flower clip at the back of the head

appearance_text: A girl with long straight light blonde hair and brown eyes, with a little orange flower tucked at the back of her head. She wears a grey jumper with black and white striped sleeves and holds a small orange pumpkin against her chest. Her trousers are bright orange and she wears dark brown boots with pale soles.
identity_text: A blonde girl in autumn clothes: an olive green sweater with an orange pumpkin printed on the front and black and white striped sleeves, bright orange trousers and dark brown boots.

face: two big white eyes with black pupils
head: green owl head with feather tufts

appearance_text: A round green owl with soft feathery tufts sticking up from the top of its head. Its face has two huge white eyes with black pupils and a small orange beak between them. The chest and belly are a lighter green with feather markings, and the wings and back are darker green. Its legs and feet are bright orange.
identity_text: Duo, the green owl mascot of the language-learning app Duolingo, with his enormous white eyes, small orange beak and orange feet.

appearance_text: A girl with shoulder-length light brown hair, dark eyes and pink blushing cheeks, with small white flowers tucked into the back of her hair. She wears a yellow top with wide white stripes across it. Light blue jeans with rips at the knees run down to white shoes.
