identity_text: An unnamed girl in a yellow and white striped jumper and ripped light blue jeans, with white daisies around her head and a long brown braid down the front. 'Yellow Stripes' describes the top.

head: bald head
top: red shirt sleeves at the shoulders
orange bullets on a belt across the chest

appearance_text: A huge bald man with a wide grin and thick brows, built like a wrestler. He wears a dark grey armoured vest with a belt of orange bullets strapped across the chest, and the red sleeves of his shirt cover only his shoulders and upper arms. His dark grey trousers run down into black boots.
identity_text: The Heavy from Team Fortress 2 in red team colours: a huge grinning bald man in a bulletproof vest with an ammo belt across his chest.

bottom: red explosive block on the other leg

colors.item: explosive block half of the body
colors.name: red

face: half the face is an explosive block
head: half green zombie head, half red explosive block
top: torn teal shirt on one side, red explosive block on the other

appearance_text: A rotting green-skinned monster split down the middle: one half is normal green flesh with a torn teal shirt and dark blue trousers, the other half is a red block striped like dynamite with white lettered bands. One eye glows red in the green half of the face, while the other side of the head is all red and white block. The same split runs down the arms, legs and back.
identity_text: A Zombie, the rotting green undead mob from Minecraft, with half of its head, arms and legs replaced by a red and white explosive block.

head: white bow at the back of the head
top: light blue and white checkered top

appearance_text: A very pale girl with long peach-coloured hair that falls past her shoulders, with a white bow tied at the back of her head. She wears a light blue and white checkered top with long sleeves. Her trousers are pink with a soft check pattern, and her shoes are white.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with long peach hair in a blue checked top and pink checked pyjama trousers. 'Honey Dew' describes the soft pastel look rather than naming anyone.

accessories: yellow sun shaped ornament in the hair
footwear: white thigh high socks with yellow bands
head: yellow sun ornament
subjects: girl with a sun ornament in her hair

appearance_text: A girl with long black hair, tan skin and big green eyes, with a bright yellow sun shape tucked into her hair. She wears a white top under a small black jacket, with soft yellow sleeves slipping off her shoulders, and a short yellow skirt that leaves her middle bare. Long white socks with yellow bands come up over her knees.
identity_text: A girl in a bright yellow and white outfit with a sun-shaped ornament tucked into her long black hair. The title describes the look rather than naming her.

appearance_text: A girl with long light brown hair falling down her back and a little orange bow perched on top of her head. She wears a short light purple dress covered in tiny glittery speckles, with bare shoulders and thin straps crossing her open back. Her arms and legs are bare and dusted with sparkles too, and she wears short grey and white boots.
identity_text: A girl dressed up for a party in a short, glitter-speckled lavender dress with a little orange bow in her long light brown hair. The title describes the look rather than naming anyone.

hair: two little buns at the back
head: small hair buns on top
top: black and white striped long sleeves

appearance_text: A pale girl with very long dark brown hair, a fringe across her eyes and two small buns on top of her head. Her eyes are light blue. She wears a black top with wide black and white striped sleeves, dark blue jeans and black shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with very long dark brown hair, a fringe and two little buns on top, wearing a black top with wide black and white striped sleeves over dark blue jeans.

colors.item: dot eyes and smile on the mask
colors.name: black

hair: short sandy blond hair at the back
head: white smiley face mask

appearance_text: A figure whose face is hidden behind a plain white mask marked with two black dots for eyes and a wide black smile. Short sandy blond hair shows at the back of the head above a red hoodie with the hood down and pale drawstrings hanging at the chest. The trousers are black and the shoes white with dark laces.
identity_text: The Minecraft YouTuber Dream, wearing his blank white smiley mask with short sandy blond hair showing at the back, but dressed in a red hoodie instead of his usual green one, with black trousers and white shoes.

accessories: panda hood with black ears and pink cheeks
little white tail on the back
head: long brown hair
panda hood hanging behind the head

appearance_text: A girl with long brown hair and a fringe over her black eyes, wearing a black and white animal onesie. A white panda face with round black ears and pink cheeks hangs behind her head as a hood. The suit is black on the arms and legs with a big soft white patch over the chest and belly, and a small round white tail sits on the back.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with long brown hair wearing a black and white panda onesie, the panda-face hood hanging down behind her head.

head: red headband tied around the forehead

appearance_text: A muscly man with messy black hair held back by a red headband tied across his forehead. He wears an olive green vest with no sleeves over a cream shirt, leaving his strong tanned arms bare, and the green covers his back too. His trousers are worn blue jeans tucked into heavy dark brown boots.
identity_text: A muscular action-hero soldier with a red headband, an open olive vest and heavy boots; the listing calls him the commando from the Miniclip game but gives no character name.

face: completely blank, no eyes or mouth
head: smooth pale blue head

appearance_text: A tall thin figure whose head is a smooth pale blue block with no eyes, nose or mouth at all. It wears a neat teal suit jacket over a pale blue shirt and tie, with pale cuffs showing at the wrists. The trousers match the jacket and the shoes are darker teal.
identity_text: Slenderman rendered in diamond blue: a tall thin figure in a tidy teal suit and tie whose head is a smooth, featureless pale blue block.

head: two round eyes on top of the head

appearance_text: A soft green frog standing upright, with two big white ball-shaped eyes perched on top of its head, each with a large black pupil. Below them a wide pink mouth stretches almost the full width of the face in a grin. The body is green all over with a paler green patch down the belly, and the arms and legs are the same green front and back.
identity_text: Kermit the Frog, the green frog puppet from The Muppets, rendered with his ball eyes on top of his head and a wide pink grin.

appearance_text: A pale young person with messy black hair, a heavy fringe, grey eyes and pink blush on the cheeks, with two black cat ears poking up from the top of the head. They wear a baggy orange hoodie with a darker pocket across the front and wide sleeves that fall past the wrists. Short black shorts sit underneath, and orange and black striped socks run up the legs to the knees, leaving small bare feet at the bottom.
identity_text: A pale kid with messy black hair and two black cat ears, in a baggy orange pumpkin-themed hoodie, short black shorts and long orange and black striped socks.

head: cream skull mask with black patches
dark cap
top: white and orange coin symbol on the chest

appearance_text: A person whose face is hidden behind a cream mask patterned with black patches around the eyes and mouth and purple stripes across the cheeks, with a dark cap on top. They wear a bright orange t-shirt with a white and orange coin symbol printed on the chest. Their trousers are brown and their shoes are grey.
identity_text: Satoshi Nakamoto, the anonymous creator of Bitcoin, pictured as a faceless masked figure in an orange shirt carrying a coin symbol.

accessories: small teal beads in the hair
head: little teal beads clipped around the hair
motifs: furry creature printed on the chest
subjects: blonde kid in a grey t-shirt
top: dark grey t-shirt with a pale grey furry creature printed on it

appearance_text: A blonde kid with fluffy hair and grey green eyes, with tiny teal beads dotted around the sides of the head. The dark grey t-shirt has a big pale grey furry creature with a leaf printed across the chest, while the back stays plain grey. Below are bright teal shorts, white socks and black shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed blonde kid in a dark grey t-shirt printed with a big pale furry creature, bright teal shorts, white socks and black shoes. The creature is on the shirt, not what the figure is.

hair: white blossom flowers in the hair
head: long hair with flowers

appearance_text: A pale girl with very long pink hair that reaches her knees, with small white blossom flowers tucked in at the top. Her eyes are big and black. She wears a soft pink dress streaked with white that hangs all the way down, leaving her shoulders and arms bare.
identity_text: A pale girl with knee-length pink hair, a crown of white blossoms and a long pale pink gown that leaves her arms bare. 'Sakura' names the cherry-blossom theme of the outfit, not the figure.

bottom: dark grey armoured legs with glowing blue seams
face: two glowing light blue eyes inside the helmet
head: dark grey helmet with small horns
top: bright blue glowing cracks running across it
a glowing blue face shape on the back

appearance_text: A tall figure in dark grey plated armour from head to toe, with a horned helmet whose eye slits burn bright light blue. Glowing blue cracks run all across the chest plate, arms and legs like light leaking out from inside. On the back the glow gathers into the shape of a snarling face.
identity_text: An unnamed knight in dark plated armour laced with glowing cyan cracks, wearing a horned helmet, with a glowing snarling face spread across the back.

colors.item: eyes and smile on the mask
colors.name: dark grey

head: light green hood
white mask covering the face
top: light green hoodie with a pocket

appearance_text: A figure whose face is hidden behind a round white mask with two small dark eyes and a wide square grin. A light green hood covers the back and sides of the head. The body wears a matching light green hoodie with a front pocket, plain green across the back. Dark grey trousers reach down to light green shoes.
identity_text: Dream, the Minecraft YouTuber, in his lime green hoodie and round white smiley mask; the listing calls this a remade version of his skin.

top: dark blue jacket with a yellow crescent moon
yellow stars scattered on the jacket

appearance_text: A pale figure with messy black hair that hangs over the eyes, with soft pink cheeks. The jacket is dark navy blue with a big yellow crescent moon in the middle of the chest and small yellow stars scattered around it and down the sleeves. The jeans match the jacket in dark blue with one yellow star on the leg, and the boots are black. More yellow stars are dotted across the back of the jacket.
identity_text: An unnamed boy in a dark navy jacket carrying a big yellow crescent moon on the chest, with little yellow stars scattered across the sleeves, back and one trouser leg.

face: small white eyes with black corners
head: smooth blue grey head
bumpy top
top: blue grey body with a round red mouth and white teeth

appearance_text: A tall rubbery creature the colour of wet blue grey stone, with a smooth bumpy head and two small white eyes set high on it. In the middle of its body is a big round red mouth ringed all the way around with little white teeth. Its arms and legs are thin and the same blue grey, with faint darker marks curling across its back.
identity_text: A humanoid rendering of the Squid, the blue grey water mob, with the mob's round red toothy mouth sitting in the middle of its chest.

appearance_text: A slim figure with bright orange hair tied back and blank glowing white eyes. A short-sleeved green shirt sits above a brown belt, with bare pale arms. Brown shorts cover grey leggings, and dark brown boots reach the ankles.
identity_text: Alex, the default Minecraft character, redrawn in the Herobrine style with blank glowing white eyes in place of her usual ones.

appearance_text: A young fighter with spiky blond hair held back by a grey metal headband, and a brown cloth mask pulled up over the nose and mouth. The outfit is brown with a grey plate over the chest and wraps around the arms. Blue grey trousers and grey boots cover the legs.
identity_text: A young ninja with pale blond hair, a metal-plated forehead band and a brown cloth mask over the nose and mouth, dressed in brown leather armour with a grey chest plate over blue-grey trousers.

bottom: black trousers with red and white stripes at the ankles
top: white shirt with a red tie

appearance_text: A grinning girl whose hair is blonde on top and bright pink underneath, hanging long down her back. She wears a black suit jacket open over a white shirt with a red tie, and a small band of colour sits at the back of her collar. Her black trousers have red and white stripes around the ankles above white shoes.
identity_text: Candy Behr, a character from The Sims 4, with two-tone blonde and pink hair and a black blazer over a white shirt.

head: short pale blonde hair
top: brown leather straps crossing the chest and back

appearance_text: A rugged figure with short pale blonde hair and a tanned face. He wears a sleeveless green tunic that leaves his arms bare, with brown leather straps crossing over his chest and back and thick brown bracers on his forearms. His trousers are mottled dark green like camouflage, held by a leather belt, and his boots are dark brown.
identity_text: The listing calls this the default Ranger skin from Fortnite; the figure is a pale blonde woodland ranger in a sleeveless green tunic with crossed leather straps and bracers.

appearance_text: A pale character with short creamy blonde hair and warm brown eyes. They wear a bright orange hoodie with white drawstrings hanging at the neck and the hood bunched behind the shoulders. Under it are simple cream shorts, and their legs go down into chunky brown boots.
identity_text: Coco, one of the main characters of the Dutch indie cartoon Ongezellig, in her bright orange hoodie, cream shorts and brown boots.

top: green sweater with a pocket pouch

appearance_text: A pale boy with messy blond hair and clear blue eyes. He wears a comfy green sweater with a big front pocket and slightly darker green sleeves, plain across the back. Black trousers with grey turn-ups and grey and white shoes finish the simple outfit.
identity_text: A plain blond boy in a green pouch-pocket sweater, black trousers and grey shoes. 'Winter Dreams' is a mood phrase for the look rather than a character.

head: wide brown hat with a curved brim

appearance_text: A heavy-set man with an enormous bushy black beard covering the lower half of his face and a wide brown hat pulled low over his eyes. He wears layered brown leather armour with a dark chest plate and grey plates on the shoulders. A red sash is tied around his waist and his boots are scuffed brown leather.
identity_text: Blackbeard, the historical pirate captain, in a wide brown hat and layered brown leather armour with a red sash knotted at the waist.

hair: very long light brown hair down the back
head: crown of white and dark flowers
top: dark blue jacket dotted with white

appearance_text: A pale girl with very long light brown hair and teal eyes, wearing a ring of white and dark flowers around her head. Over a short pale grey dress she wears a dark navy jacket speckled all over with little white dots like stars. Her legs are bare down to black socks that reach above the knee, with small white shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in a navy jacket speckled with white dots like stars, worn with a flower crown, a short pale dress and long black socks.

appearance_text: A chunky machine with a white metal face plate, a dark band across its forehead and two glowing green eyes. Its chest and arms are dark grey armour with a white lightning bolt painted on the front, and pale grey plates cap the shoulders. The legs are the same dark armour with light grey knee and foot plates, and the back is plain dark metal.
identity_text: A chunky machine with a white metal face plate, a dark band across the forehead, glowing green eyes and a white lightning bolt on its dark grey chest. No character is named.

head: green dinosaur hood
row of white teeth across the forehead

appearance_text: A pale girl with long straight black hair and pink cheeks, dressed in a green dinosaur onesie. The hood sits over her head with a row of white teeth across the forehead, and a soft mint panel runs down the front like a belly. White spikes march down the back of the onesie, which covers her arms and legs right to her feet.
identity_text: A girl in a full green dinosaur onesie, the hood pulled up so a row of white teeth crosses her forehead. Not a particular character, just a kid in a dino costume.

head: brown hair
top: blue and gold armour with a long blue tabard

appearance_text: A warrior with short brown hair and a blue scarf pulled up over his mouth. He wears heavy blue armour with big gold shoulder plates and gold trim across the chest, and a long blue tabard with a gold edge hangs down the front. A blue cloak covers the whole back, and his legs are dark grey armour ending in heavy boots.
identity_text: Garen, the armoured champion from League of Legends, in blue and gold plate with a long tabard and cloak.

appearance_text: A pale girl with messy short pink hair and big round eyes. She wears a dark grey jacket open over a black top and short black shorts. Her legs are bare above pink and black striped leg warmers, and she wears white shoes. The pink hair spreads over the back of the jacket.
identity_text: A pale girl with rose-pink hair wearing an open olive-grey jacket over a short black dress, with pink and black striped leg warmers above white shoes.

head: orange headband tied around the forehead
top: orange letter printed on the chest

appearance_text: A pale boy with brown hair held back by a bright orange headband tied around his forehead, and orange eyes to match. He wears an open dark grey jacket with white cuffs over a white shirt that has a big orange letter printed on the chest. His jeans are dark grey and ripped at the knees, and his shoes are black with orange soles and laces.
identity_text: An unnamed boy in streetwear with a bright orange headband tied around his forehead, a dark grey jacket over a lettered white shirt, ripped grey jeans and orange soled shoes.

appearance_text: A character who is green from head to toe. Dark green hair hangs over black eyes and down the back, and the skin is a soft mint green. The sweater is a mid green with darker shading, the trousers a brighter green, and the shoes are pale mint.
identity_text: An unnamed character coloured entirely in shades of green, from mint skin to dark green hair to a green sweater and trousers. 'Green Scale' describes the look, not a character.

appearance_text: A girl with short brown bob hair and a straight fringe, wearing very thick square black glasses. She has a baggy orange sweater with long sleeves and a short red skirt. Her legs have orange knee socks and dark red shoes, and the orange sweater and red skirt look the same from behind.
identity_text: Velma Dinkley from Scooby-Doo, in her baggy orange turtleneck, short red skirt, orange knee socks and thick black glasses, with a short brown bob.

appearance_text: A grown man with short brown hair, heavy eyebrows and a stern, unsmiling face. He wears a worn brown jacket left open over a yellow and white shirt. Plain dark blue jeans and dark shoes finish the outfit.
identity_text: Niko Bellic, the playable character of Grand Theft Auto IV, in his worn brown jacket and dark blue jeans.

head: red headphones over the ears
top: white hoodie underneath with red marks

appearance_text: A boy with short light brown hair wearing chunky red headphones clamped over his ears. His jacket is red with a checked pattern, worn open over a white hoodie marked with small red shapes, and the big white hood hangs down his back. He wears blue jeans and white shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed boy in headphones and a red checked jacket worn open over a white hoodie, with blue jeans and white shoes.

bottom: dark grey and black striped legs
face: small white eyes with dark pupils
head: round pink bird head

appearance_text: A soft pink bird with a big round head and a large black beak that hangs down over its face. Its small white eyes sit either side of the beak, and its whole body and arms are covered in pale pink feathers with a fluffy chest. The legs are dark grey and black in bands, like a wading bird standing in water.
identity_text: A flamingo: a soft pink bird with a big round head, a large black beak hanging over its face, a fluffy pink chest and dark banded legs.

bottom: short black skirt with a yellow belt
head: cream hood with black patches on the back
top: cream hooded sweater with long sleeves

appearance_text: A pale girl with very long blonde hair hanging past her waist. She wears a soft cream hooded sweater with long sleeves, the hood marked with two black patches on the back, over a short black skirt with a yellow belt. Tall dark brown boots come up over her knees, leaving just a little of her legs showing.
identity_text: An unnamed blonde girl in a cream hooded sweater, a short black skirt with a yellow belt and tall brown boots. 'Winter Love' describes the mood, not a character.

colors.item: blood on the arms and chest
colors.name: red

top: red cuts and blood across the chest and arms

appearance_text: A bearded man with short brown hair and a tired face. His cyan shirt is ripped and torn with red gashes and blood streaked down his chest and both arms. The blue trousers are stained red too, and more cuts and blood show across his back above grey shoes.
identity_text: Steve, the default Minecraft player character, shown badly hurt: his cyan shirt is torn open and blood runs down his arms and legs.

head: black hair
thick black beard
top: pale blue shirt with rolled sleeves

appearance_text: A stocky man with black hair and a thick black beard covering his chin. He wears a pale blue shirt with the sleeves rolled up and a heavy brown leather apron strapped over his chest. His trousers are rough brown cloth with wraps around the shins and sturdy brown boots.
identity_text: An unnamed bearded blacksmith in a pale blue shirt under a heavy brown leather apron, with rough brown work trousers and sturdy boots.

appearance_text: A girl with long red hair and brown eyes. She wears a green knitted sweater covered in little white dots with red and white patterned bands across the chest and sleeves. Below it she has blue jeans and red boots with white cuffs at the top. Her long hair falls down her back.
identity_text: A red haired girl in a green Christmas jumper covered in little white dots and red and white bands, with blue jeans and red winter boots.

head: short dreadlocks
blond on one side and black on the other
top: dripping red letters on the chest
red hand mark on the back

appearance_text: A boy with short dreadlocks dyed bright blond on one half of his head and jet black on the other. He wears a black hoodie with dripping red letters across the chest, a red zip running down one sleeve, and a big red handprint on the back. His dark grey jeans are ripped at the knees above chunky black boots.
identity_text: XXXTentacion, the late American rapper, with short dreadlocks dyed blond on one half and black on the other, in a black hoodie marked with dripping red letters.

appearance_text: A girl with bright teal hair that falls long down her back, with one green eye and one purple eye. She wears a dark green hooded jacket, open over a white top, with the hood resting on her back. A short black skirt sits over long light grey socks and chunky black boots.
identity_text: A girl with bright teal hair and two differently coloured eyes, in an open dark green hooded jacket, short black skirt, long grey socks and chunky black boots. The title is an invented handle rather than a character.

appearance_text: A cheerful man in a bright yellow hard hat with a little brown hair showing at the back. He wears a red and dark red checked shirt with blue overalls over the top, held by straps that cross his back. A brown tool belt sits at his waist and he has sturdy brown boots.
identity_text: Bob the Builder, the cartoon builder from the children's television series, in his yellow hard hat, red checked shirt and blue dungarees with a tool belt.

bottom: blue shorts rolled up at the knee
head: straw hat with a red band

appearance_text: A young pirate with short black hair under a wide straw hat with a red band. He wears an open red coat with the sleeves pushed up, leaving his chest bare with a scar across it, and a yellow sash tied at his waist. Blue shorts rolled up at the knee and brown sandals finish the look, and the red coat is plain across the back.
identity_text: Monkey D. Luffy from One Piece, in his straw hat, open red coat, yellow waist sash and rolled blue shorts, with the scar across his chest.

accessories: blue shield with a crest on the back
head: pointed green cap

appearance_text: A young hero in a green tunic with long sleeves and a tall pointed green cap, with blonde hair and blue eyes. Brown belts cross his chest and a brown belt sits at his waist. On his back he carries a blue shield decorated with a bird crest, and he wears cream leggings tucked into brown boots.
identity_text: Link, the green tunicked hero of The Legend of Zelda, with his pointed cap, crossed brown belts and crested blue shield on his back.

hair: dark brown fringe over the eyes
head: dark green cap
top: white and dark green striped long sleeve shirt

appearance_text: A boy in a dark green cap with messy dark brown hair falling over his eyes. He wears a white long sleeve shirt with dark green bands on the arms and a dark green vest with two small buttons on the chest. His black jeans are ripped at the knees and he wears black shoes.
identity_text: A boy in a dark green cap wearing a white long sleeve shirt banded with green, a dark green vest and black ripped jeans.

appearance_text: A boy with brown hair swept over his forehead and big light blue eyes. He wears a baggy green jacket with yellow and darker stripes around the sleeves, hanging open over a plain white t-shirt. Below that are blue jeans that fade lighter at the bottom, and white sneakers. The green jacket covers his back too, with a white collar showing at the neck.
identity_text: An unnamed teenage boy in a baggy green jacket with yellow-striped sleeves hanging open over a white t-shirt, with faded blue jeans and white sneakers.

appearance_text: A smiling character with short ginger hair, blue eyes and a big round red nose in the middle of his face. Around his neck is a thick scarf striped in red and green, over a tan tunic belted at the waist with a brown buckle. His trousers are dark grey and his boots are brown with red tops.
identity_text: A ginger-haired boy dressed up for Christmas, wearing brown reindeer antlers and a red and green striped scarf over a belted tan tunic, with a big round red nose.

head: black dog head
pointed ears
orange brown muzzle
top: black furry chest with an orange brown patch down the middle

appearance_text: A dog standing upright, covered in short black fur with orange brown markings. Its muzzle and the two little spots above its white eyes are orange brown, and a patch of the same colour runs down its chest. All four paws are orange brown, and a curled tail sits on its back.
identity_text: A dog standing upright, black furred with tan markings on the muzzle, chest and paws. A plain dog rather than a particular character.

hair: thick brown hair with a fringe
head: thick brown hair
top: open white jacket with blue trim

appearance_text: A boy with thick brown hair and tan skin. He wears an open white jacket with bright blue trim on the collar, cuffs and hem, showing a black shirt underneath. His trousers are brown with blue cuffs at the ankles, and he wears blue and white trainers. The back of the jacket is plain white.
identity_text: An unnamed boy in an open white jacket trimmed with blue over a black shirt, with khaki trousers and blue trainers. 'Cool Boy' is a description, not a name.

bottom: grey trousers fading to dark at the bottom
head: white snowflakes resting on the hair

appearance_text: A tan-skinned boy with dark brown hair, a few white snowflakes caught in it. He wears a plain grey sleeveless top that leaves his arms bare, with a chunky brown scarf looped around his neck and hanging down his chest. Grey trousers that darken towards the ankles and dark boots finish the outfit.
identity_text: An unnamed boy dressed for snow in a grey sleeveless top with bare arms and a thick brown scarf, with white flecks of snow settled in his hair.

head: red headband with two tails hanging down the back

appearance_text: A green mottled monster with two black square eyes and a wide black frowning mouth. It wears a red headband tied around its head with two tails hanging down its back. Its chest is covered by a dark brown army vest, and it wears baggy dark green camouflage trousers with dark boots.
identity_text: A Creeper kitted out as a soldier: a red headband tied round its head with trailing tails, an olive army vest over its green mottled body, and dark camouflage trousers tucked into boots.

appearance_text: A man in a white cap with an orange brim and a small green patch on the side, with brown hair showing underneath. Over his white long-sleeved shirt he wears a bulky orange life vest fastened with buckles down the front. Tan trousers reach down to heavy dark brown boots.
identity_text: A fisherman modelled on the trainer class from Pokémon: a white and orange cap over brown hair, a bulky orange life vest over a white shirt, tan trousers and heavy dark boots.

colors.item: water lily flower in the hair
colors.name: pink

colors.item: leaf bands on the arms and legs
colors.name: green

footwear: green leaf wraps around the ankles
head: long light green hair
pink flower at the back of the head

appearance_text: A girl with long light green hair and teal eyes, with a pink water lily bloom tucked into the back of her hair. She wears a short dress made of green leaves, with more leaves wrapped around her upper arms and ankles, leaving her arms and legs bare. Everything about her is leafy green.
identity_text: A green haired girl dressed in a leafy pond plant costume, with a pink water lily bloom in her hair and leaf wraps on her arms and ankles.

head: short hair with a fringe
hood behind the head
top: hoodie fading from blue to purple

appearance_text: A boy with messy brown hair and bright blue eyes, wearing a roomy hoodie that starts blue at the shoulders and fades into purple at the hem, with a pale lightning shape down the chest and light blue lining inside the hood. Across the whole back of the hoodie is a dark monster face with square eyes and a frowning mouth. His trousers are black with blue cuffs and his shoes are bright blue.
identity_text: A brown haired boy in a roomy hoodie that fades from blue to purple, with a pale lightning shape on the chest and a creeper face printed across the back.

head: grey headphones over the ears
subjects: young man in a white t-shirt
top: white t-shirt with a big blue letter A on the chest

appearance_text: A young man with short dark brown hair, blue eyes and grey headphones sitting over his ears. He wears a white t-shirt with a large blue letter A printed on the chest, and the shirt is plain white at the back. His jeans are blue and his shoes are black.
identity_text: Ali-A, the gaming YouTuber, as a young man in a white t-shirt with a big blue letter A, blue jeans and a gaming headset.

face: one red eye and one purple eye
hair: red, orange, yellow, green, blue and purple stripes

appearance_text: A girl whose long hair runs through every colour of the rainbow, red at one side through yellow and green to purple at the other. One eye is red and the other purple. She wears a white shirt with rainbow striped sleeves and a rainbow stripe running down her back, short dark blue shorts, rainbow striped socks and white shoes.
identity_text: A girl whose long hair runs through every colour of the rainbow, in a white shirt with rainbow striped sleeves and ripped dark blue jeans, made to celebrate Pride.

hair: pale hair peeking out of the hood
head: fur-trimmed hood

appearance_text: A round-faced person peeking out of a big hood ringed with white fur, with rosy cheeks and dark eyes. The thick coat is blue-grey with a white fur collar across the chest and fluffy white cuffs at the wrists. Padded blue-grey trousers go down to chunky white fur boots. The back of the coat is plain blue-grey with the same fur edge around the hood.
identity_text: A round-faced person bundled up for the cold in a thick blue-grey fur-trimmed parka with matching padded trousers and white fur boots. The title names a kind of person, not a character.

appearance_text: A huge grim figure whose head looks carved from grey stone, with deep lines across the face and eyes that glow bright red. A heavy gold collar sits around the neck above a dark blue armoured chest with broad shoulders. The arms, legs and boots are all in the same dark armour with grey plating.
identity_text: Darkseid, the armoured tyrant who rules Apokolips in DC comics, shown with his grey stone head, gold collar and dark blue armour.

appearance_text: A girl with big curly brown hair and teal eyes with rosy cheeks and red lips. She wears a teal jacket with puffed shoulders over a black top with a round yellow badge on the chest. Her trousers are covered in a bright yellow and black checkerboard pattern and she wears black and white shoes.
identity_text: Natalie, a character from the Minecraft movie, in a puff-shouldered teal jacket over a black top with checkerboard yellow and black trousers.

accessories: red pom pom at the neck

colors.item: lines through the eyes and mouth
colors.name: dark red

face: dark red lines running down through the eyes
head: big pale forehead
orange hair tufts sticking out at the sides

appearance_text: A tall clown with a chalk white face, a big domed forehead and tufts of bright orange hair sticking out at the sides. Dark red lines run down through his yellow eyes and curve out from a big dark red grin. He wears a cream-coloured ruffled clown suit with faint grey stripes, puffy sleeves, a frilly collar and a red pom pom at the throat. His shoes are dark brown.
identity_text: Pennywise, the evil clown from Stephen King's It, in his pale ruffled circus suit.

appearance_text: A soft brown bear standing on two legs with round ears, tiny black eyes and a big black nose. It wears dungarees in a brown checked pattern over a cream long-sleeved shirt. Its feet are wrapped in cream boots and the checked pattern carries round the back.
identity_text: A teddy bear standing on two legs in brown checked dungarees over a cream shirt, with round ears and a big black nose.

top: red and white stripes across the chest and sleeves

appearance_text: A boy with fluffy brown hair wearing an open navy tracksuit jacket with bold red and white stripes running across the chest, back and sleeves. A white t-shirt shows down the middle. His black jeans have rips at the knees and he wears red and white trainers.
identity_text: A teenage boy in a navy tracksuit jacket striped in red and white over a white shirt, with ripped black jeans. The listing gives him a first-name label but no character.

head: green frog bucket hat with two frog eyes on top
top: purple and white striped long sleeves

appearance_text: A girl with short dark purple hair and matching purple eyes, wearing a green bucket hat shaped like a frog with two round eyes bulging on top. Her purple t-shirt sits over a long-sleeved top striped in purple and white down both arms. She wears black shorts, and green socks tucked into grey shoes.
identity_text: An everyday girl wearing a green bucket hat shaped like a frog, with dark purple hair and a striped purple outfit. Not a specific character.

colors.item: land patches on the globe head
colors.name: green

colors.item: cloud patches on the globe head
colors.name: white

face: no face, just oceans and land
head: globe head
earth head

appearance_text: Instead of a face this character has a round blue planet for a head, with green patches of land and small white clouds all over it, including on the back. The body wears a smart black suit jacket over a white shirt with a long red tie down the front, and bright blue bands on the sleeves. The trousers are black with blue cuffs and the shoes are blue and white.
identity_text: A figure in a black business suit and red tie whose head is a small blue planet covered in green land and white clouds. The title is a nickname for the look, not a character from anywhere else.

head: white flower tucked in the hair

appearance_text: A pale girl with very long soft pink hair that hangs all the way down her back, with a small white flower tucked in above one ear. She wears a long flowing white dress with thin straps and pale pink shading, sprinkled with little pink and white flower petals down the front and skirt. Her arms are bare and the dress reaches her feet.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with very long pale pink hair, wearing a floor-length white dress sprinkled with pink and white blossoms and a white flower tucked into her hair.

bottom: olive green legs with dark tears
face: tiny glowing white eyes in black sockets
wide muzzle with big white teeth
head: olive green rabbit head
floppy torn ears
top: torn olive green chest with holes
dark gaps showing the frame inside

appearance_text: A tall rabbit suit in rotten olive green, torn open in places so dark gaps show through the chest, arms and legs. Two tiny white lights glow deep inside black eye sockets, and a wide muzzle is packed with big square white teeth. Its ears are ragged and bent over. Dark red streaks stain the lower legs and the back is the same ripped green.
identity_text: Springtrap, the ruined olive green rabbit animatronic from Five Nights at Freddy's, its rotten suit split open with two pinpoint white eyes glowing from inside the sockets.

head: thick dark hair over the ears
fringe over the eyes

appearance_text: A pale boy with thick dark grey hair that covers his ears and falls in a fringe over dark blue eyes, with pink blush on his cheeks. He wears a plain black hoodie with baggy sleeves that hangs loose over his hips. His trousers are white and he wears black shoes with white soles.
identity_text: A pale boy with thick dark grey hair falling over his eyes, wearing a baggy black hoodie, white trousers and black shoes.

accessories: crossed brown straps over the chest and back
face: black cloth mask over the nose and mouth
head: black hair with a cloth mask
top: dark brown jacket with crossed straps

appearance_text: A dark-haired figure with sharp green eyes and a black cloth mask pulled up over the nose and mouth. A dark brown jacket is crossed front and back by two brown leather straps that meet at a grey belt buckle. The dark trousers are patched with worn brown and end in scuffed brown boots.
identity_text: The personal skin of Hypixel, the creator of one of the most popular Minecraft servers: a black-haired figure in dark leather with a cloth mask over the lower face and crossed chest straps.

colors.item: scratches on the arms and legs
colors.name: red

hair: hair sticking out at the sides
top: torn cream shirt hanging open at the chest

appearance_text: A weary man with messy brown hair sticking out at the sides and a big bushy brown beard covering his jaw. His cream shirt is torn and grubby, hanging open down the chest with ragged sleeves. Below he wears frayed dark grey trousers, and his bare arms, legs and feet are scuffed with dirt and red scratches.
identity_text: A weary shipwrecked man with messy brown hair and a big bushy beard, in a torn and dirty cream shirt and frayed dark trousers, barefoot and scratched. The title names his predicament, not a character.

hair: long pale lavender hair with white stars in it
top: dark navy sweater with white striped sleeves

appearance_text: A pale girl with very long soft lavender hair sprinkled with little white stars, and clear blue eyes. She wears a dark navy sweater with two white stripes around each sleeve and a big white crescent moon printed across the back. Below it are short dark shorts, bare thighs and tall white socks pulled up over her knees.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in a navy sweater with white striped sleeves and a large white crescent moon on the back. 'Moonlight Girl' names the theme, not a character.

appearance_text: A boy with short light brown hair swept across his forehead and dark eyes. He wears a plain light blue t-shirt with short sleeves that leave his arms bare. His shorts are black and reach the knee, and he has white shoes with grey soles.
identity_text: An ordinary boy in a plain light blue t-shirt with dark trousers and white shoes. The title describes his shirt rather than naming anyone.

appearance_text: A tall armless monster with a square head and the well known frowning face, two black square eyes and a wide black mouth. Its whole body is mottled in orange, red and yellow like glowing molten rock, with brighter hot spots scattered over the chest, back and legs. It stands on four stubby legs of the same burning colour.
identity_text: A creeper whose entire body is textured like glowing molten lava, keeping the well-known black frowning creeper face on the front of its head.

accessories: dark blue belt with a gold buckle
footwear: dark blue boots with white tops
head: red hat with a white fur band and bobble
top: red coat with white fur edging

appearance_text: A rosy cheeked old man whose face is almost hidden by a huge white beard and moustache, topped by a red hat with a white fur band and bobble. He wears a red coat edged in white fur, belted with a dark blue belt and a big gold buckle. His red trousers tuck into dark blue boots with white tops.
identity_text: The Christmas gift bringer of folklore, a rosy-cheeked old man almost hidden behind a huge white beard, in a red fur-edged coat and bobble hat with a gold-buckled belt.

head: fox head with pointed ears
dark brown flat cap
top: brown jacket with rainbow stripes on the sleeves

appearance_text: A standing fox person with orange brown fur, pointed ears and a white muzzle with a dark nose, wearing a dark brown flat cap. The brown jacket has small rainbow stripes across both sleeves and opens over a white furry chest. Brown trousers end in white paws, and a big bushy tail hangs down the back.
identity_text: Fundy, the Minecraft YouTuber, drawn as his anthropomorphic fox character - orange-brown fur, a flat cap, and a brown jacket with rainbow-striped sleeves over a white furry chest.

hair: cream curl of hair on the forehead
head: round pink head
pointed dark ears

appearance_text: A round soft pink creature with an enormous pair of teal green eyes and a tiny mouth. A single cream coloured curl flops onto its forehead and two small pointed dark ears stick up from the sides of its head. Its whole body is pink with a big pale round belly on the front and a matching pale patch on the back, above short stubby legs.
identity_text: Jigglypuff, the round pink Pokemon with enormous teal eyes, a cream forehead curl and little pointed dark ears.

accessories: long dark red cape down the back
bottom: silver leg armour with dark red panels
head: silver helmet with a dark eye slit
top: dark red plates on the upper arms

appearance_text: This warrior is covered in polished silver plate armour with a closed helmet and a narrow dark slit for the eyes. Dark red plates sit on the upper arms and down the sides of the legs, breaking up the silver. A long dark red cape hangs from the shoulders all the way to the boots at the back. The boots and gauntlets are the same silver metal.
identity_text: An unnamed armoured knight in silver plate with dark red trim and a long red cape down the back. The title praises the figure rather than naming one.

head: red hood with pointed animal ears
cream hair

appearance_text: A very pale girl with long cream-blonde hair, wearing a red hood with two pointed animal ears and a white oval patch on the back. Her red coat is fastened with a small bow at the chest and worn over a white shirt, with a short red skirt below. Long white socks cover her legs almost to the knee.
identity_text: A very pale, cream-haired girl in a red animal-eared hood and a matching red coat tied with a small bow, dressed for a winter holiday.

accessories: black belt with a gold buckle
footwear: black boots with white fur tops
head: red hat with white fur trim
top: red coat with white fur cuffs and edges

appearance_text: A rosy cheeked old man with a huge white beard that spreads across his chest, wearing a red hat trimmed with white fur. His red coat has white fur cuffs and edges and is belted with a black belt and a gold buckle. Red trousers go down to black boots with white fur tops, and a round red sack sits on his back.
identity_text: The traditional Christmas gift bringer: a white-bearded old man in a red fur-trimmed coat and hat, belted with a gold buckle and carrying a sack on his back.

colors.item: yin yang symbol on the chest
colors.name: white

head: spiky silver hair
top: black t-shirt with a white and black yin yang symbol

appearance_text: A boy with spiky silver-white hair and dark eyes. He wears a plain black t-shirt with a white and black swirl symbol printed in the middle of the chest, and black trousers. His arms are bare below the short sleeves and white shoes finish the outfit.
identity_text: An unnamed teenage boy with spiky silver-white hair in an all-black outfit, his t-shirt carrying a single yin yang symbol on the chest.

head: black hat with a brim
top: dark grey suit jacket with gold buttons

appearance_text: A man with brown skin wearing a wide black hat pulled low over his eyes. His dark grey suit jacket has rows of gold buttons and a bright red tie hangs down the middle. He wears matching dark trousers and dark shoes.
identity_text: BdoubleO100, a Minecraft YouTuber from the Mindcrack group; his skin is a man in a black brimmed hat and a gold-buttoned dark suit.

face: pale triangle outline on a black mask
head: black hood
black mask covering the face
top: pink jumpsuit with a black zip

appearance_text: A guard dressed head to toe in a dusty pink hooded jumpsuit with a black zip running down the chest. The face is covered by a black mask with a pale triangle outline drawn on it. Black gloves cover the hands and black boots the feet. The suit is baggy and creased and the back is the same plain pink.
identity_text: One of the masked guards from the Netflix series Squid Game, dressed in a dusty pink hooded jumpsuit with a black zip and a black face mask marked by a pale triangle.

colors.item: dots on the back of the clock
colors.name: light blue

face: white clock dial with black hands instead of a face
head: round wooden framed clock for a head
top: brown suit jacket over a white shirt

appearance_text: A character whose head is a round white clock dial set in a tan wooden frame, with black hands pointing out the time in place of a face and little light blue dots around the back. It wears a brown suit jacket over a white shirt with a small black bow tie at the collar. The trousers are dark blue and the shoes are black.
identity_text: A smartly dressed figure whose head is a wooden-framed clock face with black hands where a face would be. The title is a nickname for the object-headed look, not a character that exists outside this skin.

bottom: black joggers with a white side stripe
face: black eyes peeking through the fringe
head: messy brown hair covering the eyes

appearance_text: A boy with shaggy brown hair that flops over his eyes, leaving just two dark eyes peeking out. He wears a bright red hoodie with white drawstrings and a gold crown printed on the chest, and a big white number 15 across the back. His legs are in black joggers with a thin white stripe down each side, and he wears chunky white sneakers.
identity_text: An unnamed boy in a red hoodie printed with a gold crown and a white number 15, made in the style of an anniversary cape.

face: big black patches around the eyes
head: black hat with a red band
small black ears

appearance_text: A character with a white and grey animal face marked by two big black patches around tiny white eyes and small round black ears. A black hat with a red band sits on the head. The body wears a smart black suit jacket over a grey shirt with a red tie, white cuffs at the wrists, black trousers and black shoes.
identity_text: A panda-faced character dressed as a film-noir private detective, in a black suit with a red tie and a red-banded black hat. The listing's 'Leone' is not a character I can attest anywhere outside this skin, so no name is asserted.

face: two small black dot eyes joined by a line
head: round red helmet
white face plate
top: dark blue circle on the chest

appearance_text: A big rounded robot covered in red armour plates over a chubby body. Its white face plate has two tiny black dot eyes joined by a straight line. A dark blue circle sits in the middle of its chest and dark blue pads cover the knees, with thick round arms and legs.
identity_text: Baymax in his red battle armour, the rounded helper robot named in the listing, with a white face plate, dot eyes and a dark blue disc on the chest.

appearance_text: This character has a green head with a mottled pattern, two black square eyes and a wide black frowning mouth. A pair of goggles is strapped across the top of the head. It wears a white shirt with brown suspenders over the shoulders and down the back, with green arms showing at the sleeves and leather straps at the wrists. Blue trousers with a gold buckle lead down to short brown boots.
identity_text: A Minecraft creeper dressed up as a miner, with goggles strapped over its green face, a white shirt and braces.

head: hair tied with a pale green bow

appearance_text: A fair-skinned girl with long sandy blonde hair, braided so it hangs over her shoulder, tied at the back with a pale green bow. She wears a cream long sleeve shirt under soft grey purple bib overalls that reach her ankles. Her shoes are mint green.
identity_text: An unnamed fair-haired girl in grey-purple dungarees and mint shoes. 'Green Tea' is a mood title rather than a name.

hair: long blonde hair in a braid over one shoulder
top: green t-shirt with white stripes on the sleeves

appearance_text: A slim girl with long blonde hair plaited into a thick braid that hangs over her shoulder, and green eyes. She wears a green t-shirt with white stripes around the short sleeves. Below it are plain grey shorts, bare legs and dark grey shoes.
identity_text: A shaded remake of Alex, the default Minecraft player character, here in a green t-shirt with white striped sleeves and grey shorts, her blonde hair braided over one shoulder.

appearance_text: A boy drawn only in greys and black. His messy black hair falls over grey skin and black eyes. He wears a plain grey jacket with lighter grey sleeves, black trousers and grey shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed boy rendered entirely in greys and black, in a grey jacket with lighter sleeves, black trousers and grey shoes.

appearance_text: A pale young man with shaggy light blue hair that falls in a long fringe over teal eyes. He is dressed head to toe in loose white clothing: a plain white robe-like top with wide baggy sleeves and no markings, front or back. White trousers with soft folded creases run down his legs and end in short black shoes.
identity_text: Kashimo from Jujutsu Kaisen, drawn as a pale young man with shaggy light blue hair and teal eyes in a plain loose white outfit with short black shoes.

colors.item: long hair on the other side
colors.name: light purple

hair: half light blue and half light purple

appearance_text: A girl with very long hair that is light blue down one side and light purple down the other, with a fringe hiding one eye and pink blush on her cheeks. She wears a short black jacket over a light blue shirt, with black warmers on her arms. Her light blue skirt sits above bare legs, and she has black shoes with white soles.
identity_text: A girl with very long two-tone hair, light blue on one side and pale lilac on the other, wearing a cropped black jacket over a light blue top with a light blue skirt.

appearance_text: A girl with very long pale cream hair, dotted all over with little stars in orange, light blue, yellow, pink and green. She wears a dark navy jacket with soft green patches on the front and sleeves, over short navy shorts. Her legs are bare down to black shoes with white toes.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with floor length cream hair scattered with orange, blue, pink and green stars, in a dark navy jacket with green patches.

face: a small dog face with black eyes and a pink tongue on the chest
head: flat gold coin instead of a head
white D stamped on it
small tan ears at the corners

appearance_text: A fluffy tan dog body standing upright with a cream belly and soft cream paws, but instead of a head there is a flat gold coin with a big white D stamped on the front and again on the back. Two tiny tan ears poke out at the top corners of the coin. A small dog face with black eyes and a bright pink tongue sits on the chest.
identity_text: Dogecoin as a character: a fluffy tan shiba body whose head is a flat gold coin stamped with a white D.

accessories: brown twig bands on the wrists
head: green leaf hair sweeping over the head
light skin
top: green leaves growing over the shoulders and back

appearance_text: This boy has light skin and a swoop of bright green leaves instead of hair, with dark eyes and a small smile. He wears a plain blue t-shirt, and clusters of green leaves grow out over his shoulders, arms and all down his back. Brown twig bands circle both wrists, and he wears black trousers with white shoes.
identity_text: A humanised version of Leafeon, the Grass-type Pokemon, drawn as a light-skinned boy whose hair is a swoop of bright green leaves and whose arms and back sprout more of them. He is dressed down in an ordinary blue t-shirt, black trousers and white shoes.

bottom: black suit legs with glowing light blue stripes
head: black helmet
light blue glowing marks on the helmet
top: black suit top with glowing light blue circuit lines

appearance_text: This character wears a black bodysuit that glows with light blue lines running all over it. The helmet is dark with a couple of bright blue patches on top and a dark face. Curved glowing rings sit on the chest and the back, and thin glowing stripes run down the arms and legs to black boots.
identity_text: An unnamed figure from the Tron films, in the black bodysuit traced all over with glowing light blue lines, a glowing ring on the chest and a dark visored helmet.

footwear: short dark purple boots with pale cuffs
hair: short brown bobbed hair with a fringe
top: soft blue jumper with pale purple stripes

appearance_text: A small pale child with short brown bobbed hair and eyes closed in a gentle squint. They wear a soft blue jumper with two pale purple stripes across the chest and puffy sleeves. Below are dark purple shorts, bare legs and short dark boots with pale cuffs.
identity_text: A pastel re-styling of Frisk, the child player character from the game Undertale, in the striped jumper and shorts.

accessories: light blue towel over the back
head: ginger hair
big yellow bow

appearance_text: A girl with messy ginger hair and a big yellow bow perched on top of her head. She wears an orange and cream striped jacket over a dark brown top, with a pale blue towel slung across her back. Blue-green shorts sit above stripy orange socks and cream shoes.
identity_text: A ginger-haired girl dressed for a warm day in an orange and cream striped jacket, blue-green shorts and striped socks, with a big yellow bow in her hair and a towel over her back.

colors.item: chest and sides of the suit
colors.name: black

head: green eye mask
top: white circle emblem on the chest

appearance_text: A brown-haired man in a tight green and black bodysuit. A green mask covers the top of his face around white eyes. In the middle of his chest is a white circle badge with a small lantern shape inside it, and the shoulders and sides of the suit are black. He wears white gloves and green boots.
identity_text: Green Lantern, the DC comic-book superhero, in a green and black suit with a white lantern emblem on the chest, a green eye mask and white gloves.

hair: dark red hair with a white fringe
head: bare head
top: black sleeveless vest over a white t-shirt

appearance_text: A pale teenager with blue eyes and dark red hair that fades to a white fringe across the forehead. Over a white t-shirt with rolled white sleeves sits a black sleeveless vest, and two brown straps run over the shoulders and down the back. The jeans are faded blue with darker patches at the shins, worn with chunky red and white trainers.
identity_text: A modern teenager with dyed dark red hair and a white fringe, wearing a black vest over a white tee, faded ripped jeans and chunky red and white trainers.

face: light blue mask band across the eyes
head: green turtle head
top: dark green shell on the back

appearance_text: A green turtle standing on two legs with a light blue cloth mask tied across its eyes. Its front is a big yellow belly and a rounded dark green shell covers the whole back. Blue wraps are tied around both wrists and both ankles, and a brown belt sits at the waist.
identity_text: Leonardo, the blue-masked member of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, as a green turtle on two legs with a yellow belly, a dark shell and blue wraps.

appearance_text: A slim robot built from smooth white plates trimmed with soft lavender purple. Its head is a rounded purple helmet with a blank white panel where a face would be, showing no eyes or mouth at all. Small buttons and seams dot the chest, and purple joints mark the shoulders, elbows and knees. The back is covered in the same pale panels and dark seam lines.
identity_text: A slim humanoid robot built from smooth white plates trimmed with pastel lavender, its helmet-shaped head showing a blank panel where a face would be.

head: red head with dark plating around the jaw

appearance_text: A hulking creature with bright red skin and glowing orange eyes set in a dark plated face. Its bare chest and arms are covered in heavy red muscles, with dark grey plates strapped over both shoulders and straps crossing the body. Dark grey trousers and heavy grey boots cover the legs, and the muscled red back is bare.
identity_text: Axe, the red-skinned brute warrior from Dota 2, with glowing yellow eyes, dark jaw plating and heavy grey shoulder plates over a bare muscled chest.

bottom: small orange marks on the leg
head: yellow hard hat with a white badge on the front

appearance_text: A friendly-looking man in a bright yellow hard hat with a small white badge on the front, with short brown hair showing underneath. He wears an orange high-visibility vest with straps over the shoulders, covering the front and back, over a blue t-shirt that leaves his arms bare. His grey work trousers have small orange marks near the knee and he wears heavy dark grey boots.
identity_text: A construction worker in a yellow hard hat and an orange high-visibility vest over a blue t-shirt, dressed for a building site. The listing gives him nothing but his job.

top: round orange patch on the back

appearance_text: A pale boy with short brown hair and blue eyes. He wears a bright orange jacket left open over a plain white shirt, with a round lighter orange patch on the back. His jeans are dark blue and slightly faded, and he wears plain white shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed boy in a bright orange jacket worn open over a plain white shirt, with dark blue jeans and white shoes.

appearance_text: A green creature whose head is covered in patches of light and dark green, with two dark square eyes and a wide black frowning mouth. Below the head it is dressed like a businessman in a black suit jacket over a white shirt with a green tie down the front. White cuffs show at the wrists and it wears plain grey trousers with dark shoes.
identity_text: A Minecraft Creeper dressed as a businessman: the mottled green head with its square eyes and frowning mouth sits above a black suit jacket, white shirt, green tie and grey pinstriped trousers.

accessories: small round tail on the back
footwear: pink and blue cuffs above dark shoes
hair: long hair, light blue on one side and pink on the other
head: two long rabbit ears, one blue and one pink

appearance_text: A character with long hair split straight down the middle, light blue on one side and pink on the other, and two tall rabbit ears standing up that match those colours. Their eyes are purple. They wear a dark navy suit jacket over a white shirt with a pink collar, with the jacket plain across the back and a small round tail below it. Their trousers are the same dark navy, with pink and blue cuffs at the wrists and above the shoes.
identity_text: A girl in a rabbit-themed outfit with tall pink and blue ears matching her half-and-half hair, wearing a dark navy suit with a small round tail at the back.

appearance_text: A boy who looks completely drained of colour, with messy white hair and a chalk white face marked only by two tall empty black eyes. He wears a light grey jacket with grey sleeves and darker grey shorts. His shoes are grey too, so the whole character is white and grey from head to toe.
identity_text: A teenage boy drained of all colour, white and grey from his messy hair down to his shoes, with blank dark eyes so that he looks like a ghost.

head: fox ears
red fox mask worn on the back of the head

appearance_text: A pale girl with long straight black hair and small fox ears on top of her head. She wears a black kimono jacket with bright red sleeves and big blue and red flowers printed across it, over a short black skirt. Long white socks reach her knees and she has red sandals on her feet. A red and white fox mask is pushed onto the back of her head.
identity_text: A pale girl with long straight black hair in a black floral kimono with red sleeves and a short black skirt, a red fox mask pushed against the side of her head. The title is an ordinary first name that names nothing outside this texture, so no character is asserted.

accessories: striped grey scarf pulled up over the mouth
subjects: boy with a scarf over his face

appearance_text: A boy with swept brown hair and blue eyes, with a chunky grey striped scarf pulled up so it hides his mouth and nose. He wears a blue jacket hanging open over a light blue shirt. His trousers are tan and his shoes are grey with white toes. The scarf wraps all the way round the back of his neck.
identity_text: An unnamed boy in an open blue jacket and tan trousers, with a thick striped scarf pulled up so it covers his mouth and nose.

bottom: black trousers with white side stripes

colors.item: jack o lantern face printed on the hoodie back
colors.name: orange

face: orange pumpkin mask with black carved eyes
head: white spiky hair
orange pumpkin mask with a green stem covering half the face
top: orange jack o lantern face printed on the back

appearance_text: A boy with messy white hair, half of his face hidden behind an orange pumpkin mask with black carved eyes and a small green stem on top. He wears a plain black hoodie with grey drawstrings, and on the back is a big grinning orange jack-o-lantern face. His black trousers have white stripes down the sides and he wears black and white shoes.
identity_text: A boy with messy white hair whose face is half hidden behind an orange pumpkin mask with a green stem, wearing a plain black hoodie with a big grinning jack-o-lantern on the back and black and white shoes.

head: brown hair
top: green shirt with a white game controller on it

appearance_text: A boy with messy brown hair and pink cheeks, wearing a pale grey blue hoodie left open at the front. Underneath, a green shirt carries a big white game controller with a black pad and red and purple buttons. His trousers are black with green cuffs and his shoes are white; the hoodie is plain pale blue across the back.
identity_text: A brown haired boy in an open pale blue hoodie over a green shirt printed with a big white game controller, with black trousers and white shoes. The gaming brand is on his clothes, not who he is.

head: pink heart mark on the forehead
pink hood over the back of the head

appearance_text: A pale girl with long straight white hair and a bright pink heart marked on her forehead, with a soft pink hood covering the back of her head. She wears only a small pink top that leaves her middle bare and a short pink skirt. Pink bands wrap around her upper arms, and her legs are bare all the way down.
identity_text: An unnamed valentine themed girl dressed head to toe in candy pink, with long white hair under a rounded pink hood and a heart marked on her forehead.

face: big red patches around the eyes
head: messy grey and brown hair sticking out
top: rainbow tie dye t-shirt with a swirl

appearance_text: A grown man with wild messy grey and brown hair sticking out in all directions. Big red patches cover the skin around his black square eyes, and he grins with a wide gappy mouth. His t-shirt is a bright rainbow tie dye with a colourful swirl on the front and back, worn with blue jeans and blue shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed grown man with wild messy hair and a gap-toothed grin, wearing a rainbow tie dye shirt with a bright swirl, blue jeans and open sandals.

appearance_text: A pale man with short messy dark brown hair and blue eyes. He wears a white button up shirt with short sleeves and a collar, with a dark green tie hanging down the front. His trousers are plain black and tucked into black shoes. The back of the shirt is plain white with no pattern.
identity_text: An unnamed smartly dressed man in a white button up shirt, dark green tie and black trousers, ready for the office.

bottom: short shorts hidden by the hoodie

appearance_text: A pale girl with very long dark brown hair falling well past her waist, green eyes and small white clips in her hair. She wears a baggy olive green hoodie with cut out shoulders that shows her bare skin, and drawstrings hanging at the front. The hoodie is long enough to cover her shorts, leaving her legs bare. She has white socks pulled up over her ankles and white shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in a baggy olive green hoodie with cut out shoulders, very long dark brown hair and white shoes. The title describes the garment, not a character.

face: small black eyes with cream around them
head: shaggy white fur
tufted ears

appearance_text: A big shaggy creature covered in white and pale grey fur from head to toe. It has small black eyes, a dark mouth with one cream-coloured fang poking up, and tufty ears at the top of its head. The hands and feet are dark grey and the back is one long sweep of matted fur.
identity_text: A big shaggy snow beast covered head to toe in matted cream-white fur, with small black eyes, tufted ears and a single pale fang. The listing calls it a mythical Himalayan creature.

bottom: long pink skirt with a dark pink hem
head: small gold crown with a red gem

appearance_text: A girl with long blonde hair and big blue eyes wearing a small gold crown set with a red gem, and round blue earrings. Her gown is pink with puffy shoulders, a round blue brooch at the chest and a deeper pink V at the front and back. Long white gloves cover her arms and the pink skirt runs down to a darker pink hem.
identity_text: Princess Peach from Nintendo's Mario games, in her pink ball gown with a red-jewelled gold crown, blue brooch and long white gloves.

head: red feather tufts on top
top: red feathers with a white belly

appearance_text: A round red bird with two little feather tufts sticking up on its head and heavy black eyebrows scowling over big white eyes. A bright orange beak with a pink tongue sits in the middle of its face. Its body is red with a white feathery belly, black tail feathers at the back, and short orange legs.
identity_text: The red bird from the mobile game Angry Birds, a round scowling cartoon bird with feather tufts on its head, a big orange beak and a white belly.

bottom: black jeans with a black and white checked belt
head: brown hair with a long fringe over one eye
top: blue and white checked shirt worn open

appearance_text: A teenage boy with brown hair that falls in a long fringe over one blue eye. He wears a blue and white checked shirt hanging open with the cuffs rolled to grey, over a plain white t-shirt. His black jeans are held by a black and white checked belt and he has clean white shoes.
identity_text: A teenage boy with a long brown fringe swept over one eye, in an open checked shirt over a white t-shirt, black jeans and white shoes. The title says what he is, not who.

appearance_text: A girl with long bright pink hair that spills down past her shoulders and vivid green eyes. She wears a purple tank top that leaves her arms bare, and light blue denim shorts. Her legs are bare down to white socks and white trainers.
identity_text: A girl in summer clothes with long bright pink hair and green eyes, wearing a dark blue-violet tank top, light blue denim shorts and white trainers.

head: messy brown hair
top: white t-shirt with a dark stripe

appearance_text: A boy with messy brown hair and bright green eyes. He wears a short-sleeved white shirt with a dark stripe running down the front and back, leaving his arms bare. His trousers are baggy and olive green with pockets, and he has chunky white trainers.
identity_text: Ben Tennyson, the main character of the Cartoon Network series Ben 10, in his white striped tee and baggy green cargo trousers.

face: big pink and white flower over one eye
head: light brown hair
fluffy pink animal ears
top: pink top with a white flower

appearance_text: A girl with long light brown hair and fluffy pink animal ears on top of her head. A big pink and white flower covers one eye, leaving one brown eye showing. She wears a pink top with white flowers and light purple dungarees with another flower at the knee, plus soft pink boots and pink paw-like hands.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with light brown hair and fluffy pink animal ears, in a pink flowered top and light purple dungarees with pink boots. The title names the flower theme, not a character.

appearance_text: A fighter with the head of an orange and white tiger, bright green eyes, a pink nose and pointed ears. The body wears white armour over the shoulders and arms with a brown strap crossing the chest and a gold buckle at the waist. Below that are dark red trousers and black boots with white trim, and the brown strap continues across the back.
identity_text: A fighter with the head of an orange tiger, dressed in white shoulder armour and dark red combat trousers. Not a named character.

hair: long light brown hair parted at the front
head: long light brown hair
top: pale pink bands on the sleeves

appearance_text: A very pale girl with long light brown hair that parts at the front and falls all the way down her back. Her eyes are soft brown. She wears a loose cream jumper with faint pink bands around the sleeves and a matching cream skirt. Tall cream boots come up her legs, so almost the whole outfit is the same soft off-white shade.
identity_text: An unnamed very pale girl with very long light brown hair, dressed head to toe in cream: a loose jumper with pale pink sleeve bands, a matching skirt and tall boots.

head: purple cap with a yellow emblem

appearance_text: A skinny man with a big pink nose and a long black moustache, under a wide purple cap with a yellow emblem on the front. He wears a purple long sleeved shirt with dark navy overalls buckled over it with round yellow buttons. White gloves cover his hands and bright orange shoes stick out at the bottom.
identity_text: A redrawn Waluigi, Luigi's rival from the Mario games, in a wide purple cap, purple shirt and navy overalls with white gloves and orange shoes.

hair: long fair hair down the back
head: long light blonde hair

appearance_text: A girl with very long pale blonde hair that hangs down her back and a fringe across her eyes. She wears a flowing white dress with thin pink straps over bare shoulders, gathered at the waist with a grey belt. The skirt reaches almost to the ground, where brown sandals show on her feet.
identity_text: An angel, shown as a girl with very long fair hair in a floor length white dress with pale shoulder straps and brown sandals.

colors.item: ears on top of the head
colors.name: yellow

hair: very long hair down the back
head: long brown hair
little pointed ears on top
rainbow strands at the crown
top: rainbow striped sleeves on both arms

appearance_text: A girl with very long brown hair streaked with rainbow colours at the crown and two little pointed ears on top of her head. She wears a purple strapless top that leaves her middle bare, with sleeves striped in rainbow colours running the length of both arms. Her jeans are light blue and her shoes are dark grey.
identity_text: A girl with very long brown hair in a purple strapless top with rainbow striped sleeves and light blue jeans. No character is named.

appearance_text: A pale girl with long wavy light brown hair falling over her shoulders and down her back, and big grey eyes. She wears a loose white sweater with long sleeves over short white shorts, leaving her legs bare. On her feet are black and white checkered socks.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in a loose white sweater and short white shorts, with long wavy light brown hair falling down her back. The title is a sweet-sounding label rather than a character name.

face: glowing red visor across the eyes
head: black helmet with a grey band on top
motifs: glowing red band across the eyes
subjects: armoured soldier in a black suit
top: black armoured chest plates with grey edges

appearance_text: A tall figure sealed head to toe in black armour with grey and white plates over the chest, shoulders and knees. Across the eyes is a wide glowing red visor set into a black helmet. The armour is ridged and segmented all down the arms and legs, and grey plates cover the back too.
identity_text: Alcatraz, the playable character of Crysis 2, sealed head to toe in his black armoured suit with a red visor.

appearance_text: A pale yellow cat covered in small brown spots from head to paws. It has pointed cat ears, bright green eyes with white patches around them, and a dark grey nose above a cream muzzle. A cream stripe runs down its chest and belly, and the spots continue over its back and all four legs.
identity_text: The pale yellow, brown spotted wild cat that spawns in Minecraft jungles, a passive mob with green eyes and a cream muzzle.

appearance_text: A green skinned figure with a plain blocky head and two empty black holes for eyes. It wears a ragged dark brown shirt that leaves its green arms bare, blue trousers and grey shoes. The green skin and brown shirt look the same all the way around the back.
identity_text: A zombie built from big flat pixels, with green skin, hollow black eyes, a torn brown shirt and blue trousers.

appearance_text: A girl with long blonde hair that hangs down her back and bright green eyes. She wears a warm brown sweater with a dark red scarf looped around her neck. Underneath she has short light blue denim shorts and tall brown boots that reach up her lower legs.
identity_text: A blonde girl in a warm brown sweater with a dark red scarf, light blue denim shorts and tall brown boots. An autumn outfit rather than a particular character.

subjects: man in a long brown coat

appearance_text: A man with short brown hair swept up at the front, thick eyebrows and a friendly face. He wears a long brown coat that hangs to his knees, over a dark blue shirt with a matching blue tie. His trousers are dark navy and his boots are dark brown, and the coat stays long and plain brown all the way around the back.
identity_text: The Tenth Doctor from Doctor Who, in his long brown coat over a dark blue shirt and tie with dark navy trousers.

accessories: small red plume on the helmet
face: narrow eye slit in the helmet
head: grey knight helmet with a slit visor
motifs: yellow sun with red rays on the chest
top: white tabard with a sun emblem

appearance_text: An armoured knight in a plain grey helmet with a narrow horizontal eye slit and a tiny red plume on top. Over his chest he wears a white tabard marked with a bright yellow sun surrounded by red pointed rays, with dark green chainmail covering the shoulders and arms. His legs are wrapped in grey and white plate armour down to heavy boots, and the back of the tabard is plain white.
identity_text: Solaire of Astora, the sun-worshipping knight from Dark Souls, in a slit-visor helm and a white tabard bearing a yellow sunburst.

head: white animal ears
red roses
white hair
top: dark navy kimono jacket with red stripes

appearance_text: A girl with long straight white hair, white animal ears on top of her head and a crown of red roses. Her face has big dark eyes, pink blushing cheeks and a tiny red tongue poking out. She wears a dark navy kimono jacket with bold red stripes that leaves her shoulders bare, over a short white frilly skirt and navy shorts. A big white bow sits at her back, and she has long white socks with dark navy shoes.
identity_text: A white-haired girl with white animal ears and a crown of red roses, wearing a navy kimono-style jacket banded with red over a short white frilly skirt, with long white socks. The title describes her look rather than naming a character.

head: tan bear hood with round ears
top: tan bear onesie with a cream belly

appearance_text: A girl with long blue green hair spilling out of a tan bear hood with round ears. She is zipped into a soft bear onesie that covers her whole body with a cream patch down the belly. Her eyes are dark red and the onesie ends in padded bear paws.
identity_text: A girl zipped into a full tan bear onesie with a cream belly and an eared hood, her long blue-green hair spilling out of it.

head: long ginger hair over the shoulders
top: dark red checked shirt worn open

appearance_text: A girl with long ginger hair falling past her shoulders and light blue eyes. She wears a dark red checked shirt hanging open over a cream top, with blue denim shorts that leave her legs bare. Sturdy brown boots come up around her ankles.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with long ginger hair in an open dark red checked shirt over a cream top, worn with light blue jeans and sturdy brown boots.

head: red santa hat with white fur trim
long brown hair

appearance_text: A girl with long brown hair falling down her back, wearing a floppy red hat with a white fur brim and a white bobble.
