Her red sweater is trimmed with white and slips off her shoulders, leaving them bare. A short red skirt sits at her waist, and long white socks come all the way up her legs.
identity_text: A brown-haired girl in a fur-trimmed red hat with a matching off-shoulder sweater and short skirt, dressed for the Christmas holidays.

appearance_text: A boy with messy short brown hair and dark eyes. He wears a blue jacket open over a plain white shirt, with white cuffs at the wrists, and black trousers with black shoes that have white soles. A brown backpack with straps over both shoulders is carried on his back.
identity_text: An ordinary boy kitted out for a trip: an open blue jacket over a white shirt, black trousers and a tan backpack. The title names the activity rather than a character.

appearance_text: A girl with long ginger hair falling down her back and bright green eyes. She wears a soft pale green sweater with a high collar and long sleeves. Her trousers and little shoes are the same soft green, so she is dressed all in one gentle colour.
identity_text: An unnamed ginger-haired girl dressed head to toe in soft sage green. The title describes the palette rather than naming a character.

colors.item: mark on the forehead of the mask
colors.name: dark red

head: cream hockey mask with a dark red mark
subjects: masked man in a dark green jacket

appearance_text: A tall figure whose face is completely hidden behind a cream hockey mask with black eye holes, small black air holes and a dark red mark across the forehead. He wears a worn dark green jacket and grey trousers, both smudged and dirty. His boots are dark brown, and the back of him is the same drab green and grey.
identity_text: A tall, grubby figure whose face is completely hidden behind a cream hockey mask marked with dark red, dressed in a worn dark green jacket and grey trousers.

bottom: black trousers with white buttons down the sides
motifs: small white badge on the chest
top: black jacket with a tiny white badge on the chest

appearance_text: A man with short brown hair, thick brown eyebrows, light blue eyes and a short brown beard around his mouth. He wears a plain black jacket with a tiny white badge on the chest, black across the shoulders and back as well. His black trousers have small white buttons running down the outside of each leg and end in bright white trainers.
identity_text: The Irish YouTuber Jacksepticeye, shown as a bearded man dressed head to toe in black with white trainers.

footwear: white long socks with light blue stripes
head: short black hair
top: light blue collar and sleeve trim
light blue number 7 on the back

appearance_text: A man with short black hair swept up at the front and a small smile. He wears a white football shirt with light blue collar trim, a small crest on the chest and a big light blue number 7 across the back. His shorts are white with light blue stripes, and he has long white socks with light blue bands and black and white football boots.
identity_text: Cristiano Ronaldo, the Portuguese footballer, in a white kit with light blue trim and a number 7 on the back.

head: goggles pushed up on the head

appearance_text: A man with dark brown hair, a big grey moustache and a pair of goggles strapped across his forehead. He wears a cream shirt with rolled sleeves under dark brown overalls that have wide straps over the shoulders and down the back, fastened with orange buckles. The legs are black, ending in black boots, and a leather band is wrapped round one wrist.
identity_text: An unnamed steampunk engineer in heavy brown overalls with goggles pushed up on his forehead.

head: long pale hair with a fringe
brown hair bundled at the back
top: olive green corset laced at the front

appearance_text: A pale girl with long white blonde hair falling past her shoulders and darker brown hair bundled at the back of her head. She wears a soft cream dress with thin straps and an olive green corset laced up the front. Her arms and legs are bare, with a black band around one thigh, and she wears short cream boots. A ribbon hangs down behind her.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in soft cottagecore dress: a cream strappy dress laced over an olive corset, long white blonde hair and short cream boots.

hair: very long pale mint green hair
head: small hair bows

appearance_text: A pale girl with very long mint green hair that falls in twin tails past her knees, with light purple eyes and small bows in her hair. She wears a white blouse with big puffy sleeves under a blue buttoned vest, with a small striped tie at the collar. A long light purple skirt reaches her ankles above little black shoes, and her hair covers most of her back.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with floor-length pale mint green twin tails, dressed in a blue buttoned vest over a puffy white blouse with a small striped tie, and a long lilac skirt.

appearance_text: A man with short black hair and big black sunglasses covering his eyes. He wears a light pink tuxedo with a white shirt and a black bow tie at the collar. The trousers match the jacket in the same pink and he has shiny black shoes.
identity_text: A man in a pale pink tuxedo with a black bow tie and large black sunglasses. The listing names the outfit, not a person.

head: cow head with little white horns and red ears
top: red body dotted with white patches

appearance_text: A bright red cow covered in irregular white patches, with a wide grey muzzle, black square eyes and two tiny white horns on its head. A pink udder sits under its belly. Its legs are red like the rest of it and end in black hooves, and more white patches run across its back.
identity_text: The red mushroom cow that spawns in Minecraft's mushroom biome, its bright red hide splashed with white patches, with a grey muzzle, a pink udder and black hooves.

appearance_text: A fighter in a grey steel helmet that covers the whole face, with only a black T-shaped slit to see through. Grey plates sit on the shoulders and over a dark grey chest guard, and the arms are wrapped in brown leather. Brown leather trousers run down to brown boots, with grey metal plates strapped over the knees and shins. The back shows the same grey shoulder plates and a plain dark armoured back.
identity_text: An armoured guard in a full-face steel helmet with a T-shaped visor slit, steel shoulder and leg plates worn over brown leather. The title gives his job rather than a name.

bottom: black trousers with red flame streaks
face: pale face mostly hidden by hair
hair: messy black hair with red streaks
top: glowing orange flame on the chest
red fire streaks on the sleeves

appearance_text: A person in an all black outfit that looks like it is on fire. Messy black hair streaked with red hangs over a pale face, and a glowing orange flame burns on the chest of the black hoodie. Red fire streaks run down the sleeves and the black trousers, and the whole back is dark black with more red flickers. Bright white trainers finish the look.
identity_text: An unnamed figure in an all-black outfit painted to look like it is burning, with a glowing flame on the chest and red fire streaks running down the arms and legs.

face: huge white eyes with tiny black pupils

appearance_text: A man with short dark brown hair pulling a huge goofy face: enormous white eyes with tiny black pupils and a gaping dark mouth with a red tongue showing. He wears a plain cyan short-sleeved t-shirt with bare forearms below the sleeves. Blue jeans go down to grey shoes, and his back is plain cyan and blue with nothing on it.
identity_text: A remake of the YouTuber Keralis' skin: a brown-haired man pulling his trademark huge-eyed, wide-mouthed derp face, in a cyan t-shirt and blue jeans.

appearance_text: A short cheerful old fellow in a tall red pointy hat pulled down to his eyebrows, with a huge bushy white beard covering his chin and chest and a round nose above it. He wears a blue tunic with long blue sleeves and a wide belt with a big gold buckle. His trousers are brown and his boots are white.
identity_text: A gnome, the little bearded figure of English folklore, in a red pointy hat, blue tunic and brown trousers.

face: big dark eyes with long lashes
head: long wavy hair

appearance_text: A tan girl with long wavy blonde hair and big dark eyes with heavy lashes. She wears a loose white blouse with puffy sleeves tucked into short dark denim shorts. Her legs are bare down to white socks and white shoes.
identity_text: Sabrina Carpenter, the American singer and actress named in the listing, shown with long wavy blonde hair, a white blouse and dark denim shorts.

colors.item: checked shirt tied at the waist
colors.name: pink

head: pink and white flower crown
long blonde hair
top: pink checked flannel shirt tied around the waist

appearance_text: A girl with very long pale blonde hair falling down her back, wearing a crown of pink and white flowers on her head. She has a plain black top with a pink checked flannel shirt tied around her waist and hanging over her hips. Her blue jeans are ripped at the knees and she wears simple black shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with very long pale blonde hair in a pink and white flower crown, a black top with a pink checked shirt knotted at her waist and ripped blue jeans.

bottom: blue dungarees with shoulder straps and buttons
head: green cap with a white badge

appearance_text: A man in a green cap with a white circle badge on the front, with a big brown moustache and blue eyes. He wears a green long sleeve shirt under blue dungarees with shoulder straps and round buttons. His hands are in white gloves and his shoes are brown.
identity_text: Luigi, the green-capped plumber from the Nintendo games, with his brown moustache, green shirt, blue dungarees with round buttons, white gloves and brown shoes.

appearance_text: An old man with long white hair and a long white beard that reaches down his chest. He is dressed all in white, in a long flowing robe that hangs to his ankles and is plain white right around the back. A tall grey staff stands in front of him and his shoes are black.
identity_text: Gandalf the White from The Lord of the Rings, an old wizard robed entirely in white with long white hair, a chest-length beard and a grey staff.

appearance_text: A walking metal skeleton made of polished silver plates, with a bare skull whose jaw is fixed in a steel grin and whose deep sockets glow bright red. Its chest is a cage of exposed ribs and pistons, and the same machinery runs down its spine. Blocky joints sit at the shoulders and hips, and its thin metal legs show every rod and hinge.
identity_text: A terminator endoskeleton: a walking skeleton of polished silver plates with glowing red eyes, exposed pistons and thin rod-and-hinge legs, listed as a type from Terminator Salvation.

hair: very long hair down the back
head: long brown hair
white flowers all through the hair

appearance_text: A girl with very long brown hair covered in little white flowers that trail all the way down her back. She wears a blue strapless top with matching blue bands on her upper arms, leaving her shoulders and tummy bare. Her pink skirt is scattered with more white flowers, and she wears short brown boots.
identity_text: An unnamed girl covered in little white blossoms, from her very long brown hair down to her flowered skirt.

appearance_text: A soft grey cat standing on two legs, with a round furry head and two pointed ears with darker grey inside. Its eyes are pale mint green and it has a small dark nose in the middle of its face. Streaky grey fur covers the whole body, lighter down the chest and belly, and continues over the back, arms and legs down to its paws.
identity_text: A pale grey cat standing upright, with pointed ears, a small dark nose and mint green eyes. An ordinary cat rather than a particular named one.

bottom: red and white bands at the cuffs
head: red cow head with white mushroom spots
small white horns

appearance_text: A red cow with big white mushroom spots all over its head, black rectangle eyes, a grey muzzle and two tiny white horns. It stands up on two legs wearing a dark grey suit jacket over a white shirt with a bright red tie. The trousers match the jacket and there are small red and white bands around the wrists and ankles.
identity_text: A Mooshroom, the red mushroom cow from Minecraft, standing upright in a dark grey business suit with a white shirt and a bright red tie.

head: brown leather headband
top: grey wolf pelt hanging down the back

appearance_text: An older man with a long grey beard and a weathered face, wearing a brown leather band around his head. He is dressed in a green tunic with shaggy brown fur over the shoulders and a wide belt with pale studs. A large grey animal pelt hangs down his whole back like a cloak, and his patched brown trousers end in worn wrapped boots.
identity_text: Brother of the Wolf, a character from Mojang's game Scrolls: an old grey-bearded warrior in a green tunic and studded belt with a wolf pelt worn down his back.

appearance_text: A big muscular man with short blond flat-top hair and black sunglasses, grinning under the shades. He wears a dark red vest that leaves his thick tan arms and shoulders bare, and the vest is plain dark red across his back. Blue jeans cover his legs and end in tall black boots.
identity_text: Duke Nukem, the muscle-bound wisecracking hero of the Duke Nukem shooters, in his red tank top, black shades and blond flat-top.

head: pale yellow hood with small duck ears
top: little yellow duck printed on the front

appearance_text: A young kid with messy brown hair falling over the eyes, wearing a soft pale yellow hoodie with the hood up behind the head and tiny rounded ears on top. A small yellow duck is printed on the front of the hoodie beside two white drawstrings, and the back of the hoodie is plain pale yellow. Blue jeans cover the legs down to white shoes with yellow tops.
identity_text: An unnamed young boy in a pale yellow duck-themed hoodie worn with the hood up, over blue jeans and white shoes. A cute-outfit skin rather than a particular character.

appearance_text: A stocky man with a white sailor cap, one eye squinted shut and a heavy jaw. He wears a black shirt with the sleeves rolled up over very big bare forearms, and a red neckerchief ties around his neck and hangs down his back. Blue trousers held up by a gold belt lead down to brown shoes.
identity_text: Popeye the sailor, squinting under his white sailor cap in a black shirt with rolled sleeves over enormous forearms, a red neckerchief at his throat and a gold-buckled belt over blue trousers.

head: red top of the head
white and grey band around the head

appearance_text: A blocky figure that looks like it is built out of red dynamite sticks. A grey and white band wraps around the head just under two tall black eyes, and more white bands with black letters wrap around the chest and each leg. Everything else is bright red, front and back.
identity_text: A blocky figure whose entire body is made of Minecraft TNT — red dynamite sticks banded with white TNT labels — with two tall black eyes and no mouth.

top: black blazer over a light blue shirt

appearance_text: A girl with long brown hair braided into strands that hang down her front and back, and two little pointed tufts sticking up on top. She wears a black blazer with gold buttons over a light blue shirt with a small yellow tie, and a black pleated skirt. Her long white socks reach her knees and her shoes are black.
identity_text: A girl in a smart school uniform — black blazer with gold buttons over a pale blue shirt and tie, pleated black skirt and white knee socks — with long brown braids and small white flowers in her hair.

appearance_text: A boy in a red cap with a white brim, blonde hair poking out underneath and blue eyes. He wears a white sleeveless jacket over a red shirt with a red scarf around his neck. Blue jeans and red and white trainers finish it, and a round gold backpack is strapped to his back.
identity_text: Lucas, the boy protagonist of the Pokémon Diamond games, in his red cap and red scarf with a white sleeveless jacket, blue trousers and a round yellow bag on his back.

appearance_text: A boy with short brown hair and a fringe over black eyes, with tan skin. He wears a red short-sleeved shirt that leaves his arms bare, and plain blue jeans. His shoes are dark grey, and the back of the shirt is red all over too.
identity_text: A tan-skinned boy with short brown hair in a red patterned short-sleeved shirt, blue jeans and dark brown shoes. The title only calls him a simple boy.

face: black empty face inside the hood
head: grey hood over a faceless head
top: grey hooded cloak over a starry galaxy body

appearance_text: A hooded figure whose face is a pure black hollow with nothing inside it. The grey hood and shoulders sit over a body swirling with deep purple and blue clouds and bright little white stars. The stars spread down the arms and legs and cover the whole back, so the body looks like the night sky.
identity_text: An unnamed hooded spirit whose face is an empty black hollow and whose whole body is a purple and blue starfield.

appearance_text: A girl with shoulder-length brown hair and big light blue eyes. She wears a plain green t-shirt with two brown straps crossing her chest, holding a bulky brown backpack on her back. Brown gloves cover her hands, and blue jeans tuck into sturdy brown boots.
identity_text: A girl kitted out for exploring, in a green t-shirt and jeans with a bulky brown backpack strapped across her chest.

accessories: curved brown item slung on the back
head: brown cap over the top of the head

appearance_text: A stocky figure covered head to toe in blotchy green and yellow camouflage. A brown cap sits over the top of its head, a dark band runs across its eyes like a mask, and yellow patches mark its cheeks around a small orange nose. A brown strap crosses its chest and curves round to something slung on its back, and its feet are pale cream.
identity_text: Alone, one of the two children from the horror game Little Nightmares III, in a green camouflage suit, cap and eye mask.

face: purple flame shape around the eyes
head: dark starry head
purple glowing flame rising from the face
top: dark starry chest with a purple glow trailing down

appearance_text: A dark blue figure whose whole body looks like the night sky, scattered with tiny white stars. A purple glow rises from its face like a flame, with two bright white eyes inside it, and the glow trails down over the chest. A big white crescent moon shines on its back.
identity_text: A dark spirit whose whole body is the starry night sky, with a purple flame burning where its face should be and a big crescent moon on its back.

appearance_text: A green frog standing on two legs, with a wide flat head, bulging red eyes and a pale cream throat under its broad mouth. It wears a red and white checked shirt with the sleeves down to its green hands, and blue dungarees over the top with a small striped tie tucked at the neck. Blue trousers lead down to dark brown boots, and the dungaree straps cross on its back.
identity_text: A green frog standing on two legs and dressed as a farmer, in a red and white checked shirt under blue dungarees with dark brown boots. The listing names it only by the common noun frog.

head: dark red hat
black goggles across the forehead
top: brown straps and buckles across the chest

appearance_text: An old man with a long bushy white beard and moustache and bright blue eyes, wearing a dark red hat with a pair of black goggles strapped across the front. His long dark red coat is criss-crossed with brown leather straps and buckles down the chest. The trousers are the same dark red and the boots are dark, with the coat hanging plain and red down the back.
identity_text: Honeydew from the Yogscast, wearing the Skylord version of his outfit: a strapped dark red coat and a goggled red hat over a long white beard.

head: dark red hair covering the top of the head
top: dark red robe over a light blue chest

appearance_text: A slim figure with pale light blue skin all over its face, arms and legs, and one blue eye beside one purple eye. Dark red hair covers the top of its head like a cap. It wears a dark red robe that wraps around the chest and continues down the legs, with a small glowing light blue mark on the front of the chest and a matching dark red back.
identity_text: An unnamed fantasy monster with glowing cyan skin showing through dark red growths that cover its head, chest and legs.

accessories: big white feathered wings on the back
head: light purple hair
fluffy fringe

appearance_text: A pale fighter with fluffy light purple hair and an open shouting mouth. The body is covered in silvery white armour with pointed shoulder pieces and a high collar, and the legs are the same grey-white plates down to the boots. Big white feathered wings spread across the whole back.
identity_text: An unnamed winged fantasy commander in pale ridged armour with a red gem set at the chest and big white wings across the back. The listing calls the wings vex wings, but the figure itself is a fighter in costume, not a vex.

appearance_text: A green mottled square head with two dark square eyes and a downturned open mouth sits on a body dressed like a doctor. It wears a long white coat with a green tie hanging down the front, and the coat is plain white right around the back. Grey trousers cover the legs, ending in black shoes.
identity_text: A Minecraft creeper — the mottled green head with the square-eyed, open-mouthed face — dressed as a doctor in a white coat and green tie.

appearance_text: A girl with long dusty pink hair falling past her shoulders and light blue eyes. She wears an open light blue denim jacket over a white shirt. Her jeans are blue and her boots are dark grey. Her hair covers most of her back.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with long dusty pink hair wearing an open light blue denim jacket over a white shirt, with blue jeans and dark grey boots.

appearance_text: A stocky man with a bald head, heavy brown eyebrows and a huge bushy brown beard that covers his mouth. He wears a rough orange animal hide tunic that goes over one shoulder, leaving his arms bare, held on by a dark strap across his chest. His legs are bare except for shaggy brown fur wrapped around his shins and feet.
identity_text: A stocky prehistoric man with a bald head and a huge bushy brown beard, wearing a rough orange animal hide tunic over one shoulder with fur wrapped round his bare legs.

bottom: black suit legs with yellow lines

colors.item: glowing visor band on the helmet
colors.name: yellow

head: black helmet
glowing yellow band across the visor
top: black suit with glowing yellow lines
yellow ring shape on the back

appearance_text: A figure in a tight black bodysuit traced all over with glowing yellow lines that run down the arms, chest and legs. A smooth black helmet hides the face completely except for a bright yellow band glowing across the visor. On the back, the yellow lines curl into a big glowing ring, and the boots are edged with the same light.
identity_text: Clu, the amber-lit program from Tron: Legacy, in a black light suit traced with glowing yellow circuitry and a helmet with a yellow visor band.

colors.item: fur on the head and body
colors.name: black

appearance_text: A tall animal person with a black furry head marked with bold white patches across the muzzle and cheeks, and bright glowing green eyes. Its body is dressed in a dark grey jacket over black clothes, with grey bands around the arms and legs. The hands and feet are pale grey, and the same black and white markings show on the back of the head.
identity_text: A superhero with a black and white raccoon head, dressed in a dark grey armoured jacket over black clothes with pale grey gloves and boots.

face: glowing round window instead of a face
head: round tan diving helmet with a glowing window
seaweed hanging off the back of the helmet
top: dark green diving suit covered in seaweed

appearance_text: A hulking figure in an old deep sea diving suit. Its head is a round tan helmet with one big glowing yellow-green window where a face should be, and strands of seaweed trail off the back of it. The whole heavy suit is dark green and streaked with clinging weed, right down to the bulky boots.
identity_text: Captain Cutler's ghost from the Scooby-Doo TV series, a hulking figure in an old deep sea diving suit whose helmet window glows green where a face should be.

face: two green glowing rectangle eyes on a dark screen
head: white computer monitor head
dark screen

appearance_text: A tall figure whose head is a white computer monitor with a dark screen and two glowing green rectangles for eyes. It wears a brown suit jacket over a brown shirt with a dark red tie knotted at the neck. The trousers are the same brown and the shoes are black.
identity_text: A tall figure whose head is a white computer monitor showing two glowing green eyes, dressed in a brown suit and tie. The listing presents it as what an AI chatbot might look like in Minecraft.

bottom: dark grey trousers with a red stripe

colors.item: stripes on the trousers and sleeves

head: bare head

identity_text: Yuji Itadori, the pink-haired main character of Jujutsu Kaisen, in his dark high-collared school uniform with a red collar.

identity_text: An unnamed girl in an oversized pale blue jumper printed with a large yellow crescent moon, with very long black hair and striped knee socks. 'Yellow Moon' describes the print, not a character.

She wears a very short green outfit made to look like leaves, with thin straps over the shoulders and a round green pendant at the chest. Her arms and legs are bare peach skin, and small dark green leaf cuffs wrap around her ankles.
identity_text: Tinker Bell, the fairy from Peter Pan, shown in a short green leaf dress with a round green pendant and leafy cuffs at her ankles.

appearance_text: A big scaly monster with a green head, two curved white horns and a shock of spiky red hair. Its cream muzzle is full of sharp teeth and its eyebrows are bright red above blue eyes. Its body is orange with a striped cream belly, thick black bands with spikes around the arms, and a heavy green spiked shell covering the whole back.
identity_text: Bowser, the spiky-shelled turtle-dragon king named in the listing, with red hair, white horns, an orange body over a striped cream belly and a green spiked shell on his back.

appearance_text: Every part of this character is covered in the flags of different countries. The head has yellow, blue and red stripes on the front and a red circle on white at the back, while the chest shows red and white stripes with white stars on blue. One side carries a white cross on red and the back is red with little yellow stars. The arms and legs are banded in green, yellow, red and black, with a blue and red crossed flag down the back of the legs.
identity_text: An unnamed figure whose every surface is painted with a different national flag, from the stars and stripes on the chest and a white cross on red down one arm to a red sun on the back of the head.

appearance_text: A small light blue creature with a big floppy white hat pulled over its head, wide white eyes and a broad purple mouth. Its arms and chest are bare blue skin with a thin dark strap crossing the chest and back. White trousers cover the legs all the way down to white feet.
identity_text: A Smurf, the little blue cartoon creature that lives in a mushroom house, in its floppy white cap and white trousers.

appearance_text: A tanned girl with long light brown hair falling down her back and big dark eyes. She wears a pink tank top that leaves her shoulders and arms bare and stops above her waist. Below it are short black shorts, bare legs, and little white shoes with white socks.
identity_text: A tanned girl in a plain cream vest top and short black shorts with a crimson backpack on her back, long light brown hair, and little white socks and shoes.

head: tan straw hat with a red band

appearance_text: A green frog-faced character with big round white eyes and a wide flat mouth, wearing a tan straw hat with a red band. Over a white tank top he wears an open dark red shirt covered in a repeating pattern, and his green arms stick out from the short sleeves. Black shorts, black and white socks and white shoes finish the outfit.
identity_text: Pepe the Frog dressed for a holiday - the green frog-faced character with big round eyes and a wide flat mouth, in a straw hat, patterned red shirt and black shorts.

head: short silver hair
top: light blue diagonal stripe across the chest

appearance_text: A man with short silver white hair and pale blue eyes. He wears a fitted blue suit with a light blue band running diagonally across the chest and matching light blue shoulders and sleeves. A black belt sits at his waist above blue trousers, and his boots are light blue. The same light stripe crosses his back.
identity_text: Quicksilver, the Marvel Comics speedster, in a blue suit with a pale stripe across the chest and his trademark silver-white hair.

appearance_text: A tanned man with dark brown hair swept back and a thick brown mustache covering his top lip. His eyes are teal green. He wears a grey suit jacket over a pale pink dress shirt with matching grey trousers and dark shoes. The jacket is plain grey across the shoulders and back.
identity_text: Miguel Gallardo from the TV series Narcos: Mexico, in a grey suit and pale pink shirt.

face: red scarf pulled up over the mouth

appearance_text: A young fighter with shaggy pale blond hair and brown eyes, a red scarf pulled up over the nose and mouth. Worn brown leather armour covers the chest with teal plates on the shoulders and arms. The trousers are dark brown and patched, tucked into scuffed teal and brown boots.
identity_text: The Kid, the main character of the game Bastion, in his red scarf and patched brown and teal armour.

bottom: long purple legs with pink glowing marks

appearance_text: A tall, very skinny creature with long thin arms and legs and a plain block head with two pale glowing eyes. Its whole body is deep purple, brushed with brighter violet, and pink glowing patches spatter the chest, arms and legs. The glow carries round to the back, and the feet shine white.
identity_text: An Enderman, the tall thin purple mob with pale glowing eyes, drawn here in a supercharged version covered in pink glowing patches.

head: red headband tied at the back
top: white karate jacket with no sleeves

appearance_text: A tan fighter with short brown hair and a red headband whose long tails hang down his back. He wears a loose white martial arts suit with the sleeves torn off, showing bare arms, tied with a black belt. Thick red wraps cover his hands and wrists, his trousers are white and his feet are bare.
identity_text: Ryu, the barefoot karate fighter who headlines Street Fighter, in his torn-sleeved white gi, black belt, red headband and red hand wraps.

appearance_text: A footballer with brown skin and short dark hair bleached blond on top. He wears a bright yellow team shirt with green trim and a big green number 10 on the front and back. White shorts with a blue side stripe, white socks with green tops and green boots complete his kit.
identity_text: The Brazilian footballer Neymar in the yellow and green Brazil kit with the number 10, white shorts, white socks and green boots.

footwear: white knee socks with red bands

appearance_text: A girl with very long bright pink hair that hangs all the way down past her knees, big dark eyes and pink blushing cheeks. She wears a white sailor style school top with a light blue collar and a red bow tied at the neck, and a light blue pleated skirt. Her legs are in long white socks with red bands at the top and she has little red shoes.
identity_text: Giffany from Gravity Falls, the pink-haired video game girl. She wears a white sailor-style school top with a pale blue collar and red bow, a pale blue pleated skirt, long white socks and red shoes.

head: brown hair with a fringe
top: striped jumper with navy and cream bands

appearance_text: A girl with brown hair cut to her shoulders, brown eyes and pink blushed cheeks. She wears a loose jumper with wide navy blue and cream stripes across it. Light blue jeans and black and white shoes go with it.
identity_text: A brown haired kid in a loose navy and cream striped jumper with light blue jeans and black and white shoes. The title is a given name, not a character.

hair: long wavy brown hair down the back

appearance_text: A pale girl with long wavy brown hair that falls all the way down her back, big grey eyes, and a crown of small pink flowers around her head. She wears a black jacket over a black top, with light blue jeans that are ripped at the knees. Brown boots come up over her ankles.
identity_text: A long-haired girl in a black jacket, ripped light blue jeans and brown boots, wearing a crown of pink flowers. The title describes her eyes, not a character.

appearance_text: A boy with tan skin and thick fluffy black hair that hangs over his eyes. He wears a navy blue sweater with a small white shirt collar poking out at the neck. His trousers are loose and beige, and his shoes are white sneakers.
identity_text: A tan-skinned boy with thick fluffy black hair in a navy sweater over a white collared shirt, with loose khaki trousers and white sneakers. The title describes the outfit rather than naming anyone.

appearance_text: A boy with short brown hair falling over his eyes, wearing a black hooded top with bright orange flames burning up the sleeves and across the chest. More flames flicker across the shoulders and back of the hood. His black trousers have thin orange bands at the ankles and he wears orange and white trainers.
identity_text: An unnamed teenage boy in a black hooded top covered in bright orange flames, with black trousers and orange-trimmed trainers, his brown fringe hanging over his eyes.

appearance_text: A character wearing a big green dinosaur hood with white teeth and a red mouth around the face. Under it is a red shirt with green sleeves and dark blue shorts, with green legs and green shoes tipped in white. A grey backpack with little red lights sits on the back, and a long green dinosaur tail hangs down behind.
identity_text: A green raptor kitted out as a redstone engineer: a toothy dinosaur head, a long tail, a dark red work apron and a white mechanical arm rigged over one shoulder. The title describes the theme rather than naming a character.

appearance_text: A girl with short messy blonde hair and grey blue eyes, with a red and white band running across the top of her head. She wears a yellow sleeveless top that leaves her arms bare, with a light blue scarf looped around her neck. Below she has blue denim shorts, bare legs and small white shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed blonde girl in a yellow sleeveless top and denim shorts, with a blue scarf and a small red and white Santa hat.

appearance_text: A pale girl with long wavy brown hair falling to her waist and bright blue eyes, with small black bows on top of her head. She wears a cropped dark green sweater with grey sleeves that leaves her middle showing. Below she has light grey shorts and bare legs. Her feet are in chunky black boots with grey tops.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in a cropped faded green sweater, grey shorts and chunky black boots.

appearance_text: A dark purple creature whose body is splattered all over with sickly green and black blotches, like something growing on it. Its head is almost black with bright glowing magenta patches where the eyes and mouth should be. The green and purple splatter covers its arms, legs and its whole back.
identity_text: A creeper corrupted by ender acid, its dark purple body splattered with sickly green and black growths and its almost black head marked with glowing magenta patches.

appearance_text: A girl with bright ginger orange hair, a soft fringe and a long ponytail that falls forward over her shoulder. She has green eyes and a calm face. Her top is a green tunic with short sleeves, cinched with a brown belt at the waist, and she wears grey trousers tucked into dark brown boots.
identity_text: Alex, the default female player character of Minecraft, redrawn by the skin's artist. She has bright ginger hair with a fringe and a long ponytail, and wears a green tunic over grey legs.

accessories: light blue stick carried on the back

appearance_text: A brown skinned kid with short fluffy dark brown hair and brown eyes. The short sleeved shirt is blue on the shoulders with a wide white band across the chest and light grey below it. Dark grey shorts, dark socks and white sneakers finish the outfit, and a thin light blue stick is carried on the back.
identity_text: Luz Noceda, the human girl who is the main character of the Disney cartoon The Owl House. She is shown in a short sleeved shirt and grey shorts with a thin light blue staff strapped to her back.

head: small green hair clips

appearance_text: A small girl with messy light blonde hair falling over one green eye and little green clips at the back. She wears a long-sleeved shirt striped in green and white under pink dungarees, with a red bunny face printed on the chest. Her leggings carry the same green and white stripes and her shoes are red with white toes. The dungaree straps cross plainly over her back.
identity_text: An unnamed young girl in salmon pink dungarees worn over a green and white striped long-sleeved top, with a little red bunny face printed on the chest and messy light blonde hair.

appearance_text: A grown man with short curly brown hair and a thick dark beard. He is wrapped in a cream cloth toga that folds across his body and leaves his arms bare, with a bright blue sash draped over one shoulder and down his back. The robe falls to his knees above simple dark brown sandals.
identity_text: A bearded man wrapped in a cream toga with a blue sash over one shoulder, dressed as a wealthy citizen of Roman times. No particular person is named.

appearance_text: A pale girl with long bright blue hair and a straight fringe, with a little yellow crescent moon clipped above her ear. Her dark navy sweater has a big yellow crescent moon curled across the front and small yellow stars scattered over the sleeves and back. Under it are short dark shorts, white socks, and dark navy shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with long bright blue hair in a night sky outfit, a navy sweater carrying a large yellow crescent moon with small stars over the sleeves.

hair: dark brown hair around the sides of the head

appearance_text: A figure with a face painted chalk white, with deep red patches around the eyes, a round red nose and a wide dark red grin painted from cheek to cheek. Short dark brown hair sits around the sides and back of the head. He wears a smart black suit jacket over a white shirt with a red tie, black trousers with a thin red band at the ankles, and white shoes.
identity_text: The puppet from the Saw films: a suited figure with a white-painted clown face, red nose and a wide red grin from cheek to cheek.

appearance_text: A slim person with long shaggy brown hair that falls over the eyes and covers the back of the head. A dark grey mask covers the mouth and nose. They wear a light purple hoodie with a pale circle on the chest and another on the back, plain grey trousers and dark grey shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed boy in a light purple hoodie with a grey mask over the lower half of his face and long shaggy brown hair.

appearance_text: A stout warrior in blue armour with a pale blue helmet whose visor opens into a dark mouth, topped by a bright gold crown. Blue plates cover the chest and shoulders above a gold belt buckle, and both arms are wrapped in brown and tan strips like bandages. A long red cape with dark stripes hangs down the whole of the back. The legs are tan and end in sturdy brown boots with blue guards at the ankles.
identity_text: The armoured knight from the platforming game Jump King, in blue plate armour with a gold crown, a gold belt buckle and a long red cape.

appearance_text: A thin, bony creature with a bald head and big dark slanted eyes and no nose. Its skin is a swirl of bright purple, hot pink and deep blue that runs in streaks down its chest, arms and legs. It wears no clothes at all, and the same colourful streaks cover its back.
identity_text: An unnamed extraterrestrial creature, thin and bald with big dark slanted eyes and no nose, its bare body streaked all over in bright purple, hot pink and deep blue.

appearance_text: A small round white creature with cat ears and a curly white tail, with tiny dark eyes and pink blushing cheeks. It wears a pale pink wrap robe tied with a brown sash across the middle. Pink blossom petals are scattered over the robe, the arms and the ears, and its paws are dark grey.
identity_text: A small white cat creature standing upright in a pale pink wrap robe covered in cherry blossom petals. The title names the blossom theme of the robe rather than a character.

appearance_text: A girl with long brown hair falling over her shoulders and down her back, with two little pink flowers pinned near her fringe. She has big blue eyes with dark lashes and pink lips. Her top is striped in purple and grey and slips off her shoulders, and below it she wears light blue denim shorts with her legs bare down to short black boots.
identity_text: An everyday girl skin: long brown hair with a pink flower pinned near the fringe, a purple striped off-shoulder top, light blue denim shorts and short black boots.

appearance_text: A grinning man with short dark hair, a dark beard and moustache, and a pair of wide black sunglasses covering his eyes. He wears a smart black suit jacket over a white shirt with a bright blue tie hanging down the front. His trousers and shoes are black and the back of the jacket is plain dark with a blue collar showing at the neck.
identity_text: Ssundee, the Minecraft YouTuber and Team Crafted member, drawn as a grinning bearded man in a black suit with a blue tie and his trademark wide black sunglasses.

appearance_text: A girl with long straight black hair and brown eyes. She wears a black corset top under a dark red jacket with grey studded shoulder pieces, and short black shorts that leave her legs bare above tall black boots with red straps. Studs and buckles run across the outfit.
identity_text: A black haired warrior girl in a black corset top under a studded dark red jacket, with short black shorts and tall black boots. The title is a given name, not a character.

appearance_text: A boy with short brown hair and dark eyes wearing an orange and red striped shirt with a small teal collar. Over it he has brown corduroy overalls with straps over both shoulders and a plain brown back. White shoes finish the outfit.
identity_text: A brown-haired boy dressed in an orange and red striped shirt with a small teal collar under brown corduroy dungarees, kitted out as a fan of the arcade-wrecker film rather than as the character himself.

appearance_text: A green-skinned figure with a wide flat face, purple lips and dark green eyes, with red-orange hair swept back from the forehead. She wears a long blue-green gown with a pale collar and a small necklace at the throat, the sleeves reaching her wrists. Simple green sandals show below the hem.
identity_text: Fiona from Shrek in her ogre form: green skin, red hair pulled back, and a long blue-green gown over green sandals.

appearance_text: A man with short dark brown hair, blue eyes and a little brown stubble on his chin. He wears a teal short sleeved shirt with a brown strap running across his chest and over his shoulder to his back, and a grey belt at his waist. His jeans are blue and his shoes are grey.
identity_text: Steve, the default Minecraft player character, in an adventuring version of his usual outfit: a short-sleeved shirt with a satchel strap over one shoulder, blue jeans and grey shoes.

appearance_text: A hunched creature covered in grey-green scales with a rough tan belly. Its head is nearly all mouth, gaping open to show two rows of pointed white teeth and a dark red throat, with two tiny black eyes above. Ridged scaly plates run down its back, and its short legs end in clawed feet.
identity_text: A hunched, scaly reptile creature whose head is nearly all gaping mouth, showing two rows of white teeth and a dark red throat above a rough tan belly. The title is a coined creature name with nothing behind it outside this skin.

appearance_text: A boy with brown hair cut in a straight fringe over big blue eyes. He wears a black jacket hanging open over a light grey hoodie that has a small dark print on the chest, and the grey hood shows as a big patch on his back. His trousers are brown with a dark checked pattern, and his shoes are black with white soles.
identity_text: A teenage boy in casual street clothes, an open black jacket over a grey hoodie with brown chequered trousers and black shoes. Nothing in the listing names him.

appearance_text: A monster made of dark cracked rock with burning orange and red lava glowing through every crack. Two curved orange horns stick up from its head and its eyes glow bright yellow above a dark mouth. A bright molten stripe runs all the way down its back and its arms and legs are streaked with fire.
identity_text: A demon of cracked black rock with orange and red lava glowing through it, curved horns and bright yellow eyes. The listing calls it a warlord from the Nether but gives no character name.

appearance_text: A tall figure wrapped in a dark purple hooded robe, with the hood pulled right up so the face is a black shadow. A single glowing pale pink eye shines out of that shadow. A pink sash is tied at the waist, the sleeves are ragged and purple, and the legs end in black boots.
identity_text: An unnamed hooded sorcerer in a tattered dark purple robe with a pink waist sash and a single glowing eye under the hood. The title names a colour and a role, not a character.

hair: dark hair tied in a topknot
top: black jacket worn off one shoulder

appearance_text: A bearded man with dark hair, streaked grey, pulled up into a tight topknot. He wears a black jacket slipped off one shoulder so his bare tan chest and arm show, with a patterned sleeve on the other side. A pale blue sash is knotted at his waist over short black shorts. His legs are wrapped in grey cloth down to his feet, and a swirling golden pattern spreads across his upper back.
identity_text: Hanzo from the game Overwatch, a bearded archer with a grey-streaked topknot, his jacket worn off one shoulder and a blue sash at the waist.

appearance_text: A short round spaceman in a bright pink suit, drawn with heavy black outlines. A wide light blue glass visor covers most of the front of the head, while the back of the head is plain pink. The body is one rounded pink piece with stubby arms and two short pink legs.
identity_text: A small spacesuited figure from the game Among Us, its suit bright pink and its helmet fronted by a wide pale blue visor.

head: white hood down on the back
top: white hoodie with buttons down the front

appearance_text: A tan-skinned boy with messy dark brown hair falling over his eyes. He wears a white hoodie with small buttons down the front and a big white hood resting on his back, and around his neck is a chunky scarf striped in red and green. Black trousers and white shoes complete the outfit.
identity_text: An unnamed dark-haired boy in a white buttoned hoodie with a thick red-and-green striped scarf, black trousers and white shoes.

appearance_text: A small creature with a spiky orange head, a pale cream muzzle and bright eyes that look light blue from the sides. It is dressed in a dark black suit jacket over a white shirt with a bright red tie. Black trousers and black shoes finish the outfit, with tan hands showing at the cuffs.
identity_text: The Minecraft pufferfish dressed for business, its spiky orange head and cream muzzle above a black suit and red tie.

appearance_text: A character whose hair is black on one side and white on the other, topped by two pointed animal ears in matching opposite colours. The white hoodie carries a big black and white swirl symbol on the chest, and a large letter shape on the back. Black shorts patched with white lead down to boots that are black on one leg and white on the other.
identity_text: An unnamed animal-eared character built entirely around split black-and-white halves, from the two-tone hair and mismatched pointed ears down to boots that are black on one leg and white on the other.

top: long sleeve top striped in orange, red and white

appearance_text: A girl with very long brown hair that hangs down over her shoulders and back, with dark eyes and pale skin. She wears a long sleeved top striped in orange, red and white, tucked into light blue jeans with rips at the knees. Her shoes are plain white.
identity_text: A teenage girl with very long brown hair wearing an orange, red and white striped long-sleeved top tucked into ripped light blue jeans, with plain white shoes. The title describes the style.

hair: sandy blonde hair over the shoulders
top: shoulder straps with a gold buckle

appearance_text: A pale girl with sandy blonde hair falling over her shoulders and bright green eyes. She wears a white shirt with puffy sleeves under short navy blue dungarees, held up by straps with a small gold buckle, leaving her middle bare. Her legs are bare down to tall brown boots that reach her knees.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in short navy dungarees over a white puff-sleeved shirt, with bare legs down to knee-high brown boots. The title only names the garment.

appearance_text: A green mottled monster whose right side has been replaced with grey metal. One eye is a black square and the other is a glowing red robot eye set in a metal plate. Metal armour covers its shoulders and chest between patches of green skin, and both legs are grey metal with panel lines running down them.
identity_text: A Creeper rebuilt as a cyborg: one side of its head and body is grey machine plating with a single glowing red eye, while the other side stays mottled green skin.

appearance_text: A princess with long blonde hair and a small gold crown resting on her head, with big light blue eyes and pink lips. She wears a long pink gown that reaches the floor, with white puffy sleeves at her shoulders and a round blue gem at her neck. A gold bow sits on the back of her dress, and pink shoes peek out at the bottom.
identity_text: Princess Peach from Super Mario Bros., redesigned in a floor-length pink gown with white puffy sleeves, a gold crown and a blue collar gem.

appearance_text: A green monster with a mottled light and dark green head, two square black eyes and a wide frowning black mouth. It is dressed in a smart black suit jacket over a white shirt with a bright red tie down the front. Its legs are in matching black trousers with little green flashes at the knees.
identity_text: A Creeper, the green Minecraft mob with its square black eyes and wide frowning mouth, dressed up in a dark business suit, white shirt and red tie.

appearance_text: A man whose whole head is a cube covered in a three by three grid of coloured squares split by thick black lines, a different colour on each side: white, orange, yellow and red. He has no face at all. He wears a grey blue suit jacket over a shirt with a red tie and a row of yellow buttons, matching grey blue trousers and white shoes.
identity_text: A man in a grey-blue suit and red tie whose head is a Rubik's Cube: a three by three grid of coloured squares split by black lines, with no face at all.

bottom: white bunnies printed on the legs
head: light blue checked headband with a bow

appearance_text: A girl with long brown hair and green eyes, wearing a light blue checked headband tied in a bow. She has a short white top with long white sleeves that leaves her tummy bare. Her light blue dungarees are dotted with little white bunnies down the legs, and her shoes are white.
identity_text: A brown-haired girl in light blue bunny-print dungarees and a white long-sleeved crop top, with a checked headband tied in a bow.

appearance_text: A pale man with short brown hair and glowing purple eyes staring straight ahead. He wears a light purple short-sleeved uniform shirt with a collar and a darker purple tie hanging down the front. Plain black trousers and black shoes go with it, and the shirt is plain across the back.
identity_text: William Afton, the human antagonist of Five Nights at Freddy's, in his light purple security guard uniform with a purple tie.

appearance_text: A masked hero covered head to toe in a red and blue body suit. The head is a plain red mask with two big white eye shapes outlined in black and no mouth. A small black spider sits in the middle of the red chest, with blue panels down the sides and blue arms and trousers. The boots and shoulders are red and the back carries the same red and blue pattern.
identity_text: Spiderman, the Marvel superhero, in the classic red and blue suit with a plain red mask, big white eye shapes and a black spider on the chest.

appearance_text: A warrior wearing a tan metal helmet with wide cheek guards, dark eye slots and a long nose piece, topped with a dark red crest. His chest is bare tan muscle crossed by brown leather straps, with a red cloth knotted at the neck. A short brown leather kilt hangs at his waist above dark red boots, and a long dark red cape covers his entire back.
identity_text: A Spartan warrior in a crested bronze helmet with cheek guards and a nose bar, bare chest crossed by leather straps, and a long dark red cape.
