identity_text: A girl themed after the fire-type fox Pokémon named in the listing, with fox ears in her long brown hair and a bundle of curled tails across her back.

accessories: gold crown with blue and green jewels
head: pink pig head with a gold crown
top: red royal coat over a white shirt

appearance_text: A character with a pink pig head, a wide snout and small dark eyes, wearing a shining gold crown set with blue and green jewels. He wears a red royal coat with gold buttons over a white shirt, and a blue cape hangs down his back. His trousers are black and his boots are dark.
identity_text: Technoblade, the Minecraft YouTuber, in his pig-headed persona wearing a jewelled gold crown, red royal coat and blue cape.

head: small black hat perched on the head
top: dark green checked jacket over a black top

appearance_text: A girl with extremely long pale mint hair reaching her knees and soft purple eyes, with a small black hat perched on top of her head. She wears a dark green checked jacket open over a black top, with dark grey shorts underneath. Her legs go down into tall black boots with cream cuffs at the top.
identity_text: An unnamed witch-themed girl with pale mint hair down to her knees, in a dark green checked jacket over a black top with dark shorts and tall black boots.

hair: thin grey hair at the sides
head: bald head

appearance_text: A bald older man with a wide grey moustache, bushy grey eyebrows and a serious face. He wears a dark navy blue suit jacket over a white shirt with a bright blue tie down the front. The jacket is plain dark blue across the shoulders and back. Matching dark trousers reach down to dark shoes.
identity_text: Dr. Phil, the American television personality, shown bald with a thick grey moustache in a dark blue suit and blue tie.

bottom: carved wooden legs with red and teal markings
head: carved wooden head with a red headdress
top: carved wooden chest with a staring face

appearance_text: A figure carved out of brown wood and painted with bands of red and teal from head to toe. Staring carved faces are cut into the head and chest, with pale cream eyes and teeth showing. On the back a huge open mouth is painted deep red with a row of white teeth, and more carved faces run down the legs.
identity_text: A totem pole carved from brown wood and painted with red and teal bands, with staring faces cut into the head, chest and legs and a huge open red mouth painted across the back.

hair: clipped with pink and blue beads
head: long peachy pink hair
small hair clips
top: dark brown pinafore over a white shirt

appearance_text: A girl with very long peachy pink hair that reaches her waist, held with tiny pink and blue clips, and bright green eyes. She wears a puffy light purple jacket with a pale blue scarf tucked at her neck, over a dark brown pinafore and white shirt. Below the short brown skirt her legs go into fluffy pale blue boots.
identity_text: An unnamed pastel-dressed girl with very long peachy pink hair full of tiny coloured clips, in a lavender puffy jacket, brown pinafore and fluffy mint boots.

appearance_text: A bulky figure wrapped in scrap metal plates, dark grey and streaked with rusty brown. Instead of a face there is a blank grey purple plate bolted into a heavy frame, with chunky purple and copper bolts at the corners. Copper straps cross the chest and the arms and legs are wrapped in more riveted metal.
identity_text: A bulky figure sealed inside patched scrap-metal armour, dark grey and streaked with rust, with a blank grey-purple plate bolted over the face instead of a visor and copper straps across the chest.

footwear: black and white striped thigh high boots
head: long light brown hair

appearance_text: A girl with long wavy light brown hair falling past her shoulders and warm brown eyes. She wears a black jacket with a bright red panel down the middle and sleeves striped in black and white. Under it are short black shorts, and her legs are covered by tall black boots ringed with white stripes.
identity_text: A teenage girl in streetwear: a black jacket with a red panel down the front and black and white striped sleeves, short black shorts, and matching striped thigh high boots, with long light brown hair.

hair: short black hair under the hat
head: yellow straw hat with a red band

appearance_text: A tan skinned boy with short black hair under a wide yellow straw hat with a red band around it, grinning with a big open mouth. He wears an open red vest with buttons down the front, leaving his chest and arms bare. His shorts are blue denim with a pale cuff, and he wears simple brown sandals on his feet.
identity_text: Monkey D. Luffy, the straw hatted captain and main character of One Piece, grinning under his hat in an open red vest and blue shorts.

head: black samurai helmet with red horns

appearance_text: A tan warrior with brown hair, blue eyes and a short brown beard under a black helmet with curved red horns. Bright red layered armour plates cover his chest and shoulders, edged with gold and belted at the waist. Black and red plates run down his legs to black boots.
identity_text: Minecraft's Steve wearing a full suit of red and gold samurai armour with a horned black helmet.

face: one dark eye and one red machine eye
head: green scaly left side
grey metal right side
red glowing eye
top: green scaly patch over one shoulder and arm

appearance_text: A tall figure split down the middle: one side of the head is rough green scales, the other is grey metal plating with a glowing red eye. The chest is bare brown skin with a patch of green scales creeping over one shoulder and down that arm, while the other arm is grey and mechanical. Below is a pair of grey camouflage shorts, and the feet are bare.
identity_text: Docm77, the German Minecraft YouTuber, in his trademark skin: one half green scaled creature, the other half grey machine with a glowing red eye.

head: long black hair over the face
small pointed ears on the hood
top: white creeper face printed on the chest

appearance_text: A figure dressed all in black with long black hair hanging over the forehead and two glowing red eyes peeking out. The black hoodie has a big white creeper face printed across the chest. The trousers are black with rips at the knees and the shoes are black with white soles.
identity_text: An unnamed boy dressed head to toe in black, with a white creeper face printed on the front of his hoodie and long black hair over his eyes.

top: red plaid shirt with black sleeves

appearance_text: A brown-haired character wearing wide black sunglasses and showing a big white grin. He has a red checked shirt with black sleeves and a white belt, and a grey backpack sits on his back. His jeans are blue with a check pattern, with a small red item strapped to one leg, and his shoes are dark.
identity_text: A grinning boy in wide black sunglasses, a red plaid shirt with black sleeves, checked blue jeans and a grey backpack, cast by the listing as the kind of player who wrecks servers. No character is named.

head: red hood down on the back

appearance_text: A boy with messy brown hair and bright glowing red eyes that stare straight ahead, with no mouth at all. He wears a red hoodie with white drawstrings and the hood laid down behind his shoulders. His trousers are grey and his shoes are black.
identity_text: An unnamed boy in a red hoodie with messy brown hair, glowing red eyes and no mouth at all.

appearance_text: A girl with long brown hair tied with a big white bow at the back. She wears an open light blue denim jacket over a short white top, showing her middle. Blue denim shorts leave her legs bare above brown boots with white socks.
identity_text: A tanned girl in an open light blue denim jacket, white crop top and denim shorts, with a large white bow tied in her long brown hair.

appearance_text: A girl with long light brown hair that falls past her shoulders and big green eyes. She wears a light blue crop top with bare shoulders and matching light blue arm bands, plus a light blue skirt. Her legs are covered by light blue long socks that end in blue boots. Her hair hangs down her back in the same light brown all the way to her waist.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in a head to toe light blue summer outfit, with long hair falling to her waist.

face: two black eyes on a grey face

appearance_text: A figure dressed all in plain black, with a pale grey face showing two blank black eyes and no mouth at all. His hair is short and grey, brushed forward over the forehead. The black clothing covers his arms, chest and legs with no pattern anywhere, and only his shoes are bright white.
identity_text: A boy in a completely blacked-out outfit with pale grey skin, blank dark eyes and no mouth, lit only by bright white shoes. The title describes the all-black look rather than naming anyone.

hair: long brown hair down the back
head: rainbow headband

appearance_text: A long-haired figure with brown hair spilling down the back and a bright rainbow-striped headband across the forehead. Big black sunglasses cover the eyes. A brown vest hangs open over a white shirt, leaving the arms bare, and the light blue jeans flare out at the ankles above simple brown sandals.
identity_text: A 1960s-style hippie in a rainbow headband and wide black sunglasses, wearing a brown waistcoat over a white shirt with flared jeans and sandals.

head: neat white hair
top: red band at the back of the collar

appearance_text: An old man with neat white hair, a white moustache and pointed goatee beard, and black glasses over his eyes. He wears a crisp white long-sleeved shirt with a bright red apron across the chest and a red band showing at the back of his collar. His trousers are black and his shoes are brown.
identity_text: Colonel Sanders, the white-bearded founder of KFC, in his white shirt, black glasses and red apron.

hair: bushy green leaves instead of hair
head: head made of green leaves
top: brown bark trunk with leaves on the shoulders

appearance_text: A walking tree with a thick brown trunk for a body, marked all over with darker bark grain lines. Bunches of bright and dark green leaves sit where its head should be and spread over its shoulders and arms. Its arms and legs are bare woody branches with the same rough bark.
identity_text: A tree standing on two legs: a bark-covered trunk for a body, branchy limbs, and a bushy green canopy where the head would be. The listing sells it as a disguise for standing perfectly still.

head: black hair swept across the head

appearance_text: A pale-faced person with black hair swept across the top of the head. They wear a white hoodie with grey patches worn into the sleeves and shoulders and strings hanging at the chest. The trousers are dark grey and a grey paw print shows on the back of the hoodie.
identity_text: An unnamed boy in a black-and-white outfit, wearing a worn white-grey hoodie with a creeper face across the back and dark grey trousers.

head: gold crown
top: red robe with a white collar

appearance_text: An old man with a long grey beard spilling down over his chest and a golden crown resting on his head. He wears deep red robes with a white collar and white shoulders, the red carrying all the way round the back. Grey trousers and dark shoes show beneath the hem of the robe.
identity_text: An unnamed elderly king with a long grey beard, a gold crown and deep red robes with white shoulders. 'Wise King' describes the role rather than naming anyone.

colors.item: monster face print on the hoodie back
colors.name: grey

head: bright green square head
top: monster face printed on the back

appearance_text: A bright green square-headed monster with two big black square eyes and a black frowning mouth with two fangs. It wears a loose white hoodie with drawstrings hanging at the front, and a grey monster face is printed across the back. Its green hands stick out of the sleeves, and it wears black trousers with green shoes.
identity_text: A Creeper, the green square-headed Minecraft mob, dressed up in a white hoodie with a grey creeper face printed on the back.

appearance_text: A girl with long brown hair falling over her shoulders, with two little buns on top and a fringe over grey eyes. She wears an open dark red plaid shirt over a plain grey top. A short black skirt sits above dark grey leggings torn with holes, and her feet are in chunky dark boots.
identity_text: A grunge-styled girl in an open dark red plaid shirt and grey top, with a black skirt, ripped dark leggings and chunky boots, and small round animal ears on her head.

colors.item: wing design painted flat on the back of the torso (no wing layer)
colors.name: orange

head: dark purple dragon head
gold horn on top
gold jaw spikes
top: dark purple chest with a gold belly plate

appearance_text: A small dark purple dragon standing upright, with a bright gold horn curving up from its head and gold spikes along its jaw. Its eyes are pink. A wide gold belly plate runs down the front of its chest. Two orange wings are folded against its back and a gold spike sticks out at the base of the tail. The legs end in clawed purple feet.
identity_text: Spyro, the small purple dragon from the platform game series, with a gold horn, gold spikes along the jaw, a gold belly plate and orange wings against his back.

head: red hood
brown fringe
top: white shirt with a red tie

appearance_text: A boy with short brown hair and a brown fringe under a red hood that covers the back and sides of his head. He wears an open red jacket over a white shirt with a thin red tie at the collar. Black jeans and clean white shoes finish the outfit, and the back of the hood and jacket are plain red.
identity_text: A teenage boy in an open red hooded jacket over a white shirt with a thin red tie, with black jeans and white shoes. Unnamed — the title describes the tie.

footwear: brown and cream striped long socks
hair: long wavy light brown hair down the back
head: white flower crown
top: light blue open jacket with rolled sleeves

appearance_text: A light skinned girl with long wavy light brown hair falling all the way down her back and a ring of little white flowers resting on her head. She wears a soft cream dress under an open light blue jacket with the sleeves rolled up. Her legs are bare down to long socks striped in brown and cream. Her eyes are big and green.
identity_text: An unnamed girl dressed for spring, wearing a ring of small white flowers on her head, a cream dress and an open light blue cardigan. The title names the season and the mood, not a character.

head: yellow cap with a white and blue badge

appearance_text: A stocky man with a big pink nose and a thick black moustache under a yellow cap with a white and blue badge. He wears a yellow long sleeved shirt with bright magenta overalls strapped over it with round yellow buttons. Chunky white gloves cover his hands and teal shoes cover his feet.
identity_text: A redesigned take on Wario, Mario's rival, keeping the yellow cap and shirt, big nose and black moustache but swapping the overalls for bright magenta.

head: orange mask tied around the head
trailing mask ends

appearance_text: A green turtle person with a bright orange cloth mask tied across the eyes, its ends trailing down the back of the head. The white eyes show through the mask holes. The chest and stomach are covered in tan plates, and a hard brown shell fills the whole back. Orange bands are wrapped around the elbows and knees, and the arms and legs are the same mottled green.
identity_text: Michelangelo of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, the turtle in the orange eye mask, with tan belly plates, a hard brown shell and orange bands at elbows and knees.

appearance_text: A pug standing upright on two legs, covered in short cream coloured fur. Its squashed face is dark grey and wrinkled with a black muzzle and two big white eyes, and floppy dark ears hang at the sides. A little curled tail sits on its back, and its hands and feet are pale paws with separate toes.
identity_text: A pug, the small flat-faced dog breed, standing upright: short cream fur, a dark wrinkled squashed face with a black muzzle, floppy dark ears and pale paws with separate toes.

head: white sunglasses pushed up on the head
fluffy pale blue hair
top: white t shirt with short sleeves

appearance_text: A girl with short fluffy pale blue hair streaked with soft purple, and a pair of white sunglasses with black lenses resting on top of her head. She wears a loose white t shirt with short sleeves and light blue shorts. Her arms and legs are bare, with a light blue band around each lower leg.
identity_text: A girl dressed for summer in a loose white t-shirt and light blue shorts, with white black-lensed sunglasses pushed up into her short pale blue hair. The title describes the mood, not a character.

accessories: brown belt with a gold buckle
hair: long brown hair with a braid over one shoulder
head: long brown hair

appearance_text: A cheerful girl with long brown hair, one thick braid pulled forward over her shoulder, and bright green eyes. She wears a shirt striped in blue and white with matching striped sleeves. Dark blue jeans are held up by a brown belt with a gold buckle, and her boots are brown. Her hair falls in a long brown sheet down her back.
identity_text: Stacyplays, the Minecraft YouTuber, in her blue and white striped shirt, dark blue jeans with a brown belt, and a thick braid pulled forward over one shoulder.

appearance_text: A standing fox creature with pointed ears on top of its head, small dark eyes and a pale orange muzzle. Its fur is a swirl of bright red, hot pink and deep purple, with a glowing pink patch on its belly and another glowing patch low on its back. Its legs and paws are dark purple, and thin pale outlines run over the arms and legs.
identity_text: A fox, standing upright with pointed ears and a pale muzzle, its fur a glowing swirl of lava red, hot pink and deep purple.

colors.item: bow on the back of the head
colors.name: red

appearance_text: A girl with very long pale pink hair that hangs past her waist, tied at the back with a big bright red bow. She wears a black top with a white collar and a red tie knotted at her throat, over a short black skirt edged in red. Her legs are covered by long black socks with white bands at the top, and she wears black boots.
identity_text: A girl in a dark school-style uniform - white collar, red tie, red trimmed black skirt and black thigh high socks over black boots - with very long pale pink hair gathered under a big red bow.

face: glowing red visor across the eyes
head: white hair
red visor
motifs: number 76 on the back of the jacket
subjects: masked soldier in a tactical jacket
top: black tactical jacket with red and blue panels

appearance_text: A hard-looking fighter with short white hair and a glowing red visor strapped across his eyes. He wears a heavy black tactical jacket with blue and red panels, padded shoulders and orange gloves. Dark armoured trousers run down to boots, and the back of the jacket carries a large white number 76 on a red patch.
identity_text: Soldier: 76 from Overwatch, a white-haired veteran in a black tactical jacket with blue and red panels, a glowing red visor and the number 76 on his back.

appearance_text: A boy with brown skin and messy black hair that flops over his forehead. He wears a bright red zip-up hoodie left open over a plain white t-shirt, with the hood resting on his shoulders. His jeans are light blue and slightly faded and his shoes are dark brown. The back of the hoodie is the same red with darker shading.
identity_text: Miguel Rivera, the boy at the centre of the Pixar film Coco, in his open red hoodie, white shirt and blue jeans.

appearance_text: A figure in a long black coat that has glowing red and orange cracks running across the chest and a big burning mark down the back. Over the head sits a grey hood with pointed animal ears and red streaks, and two glowing orange eyes stare out from underneath. A small gold pendant hangs at the chest, and glowing red bands circle the wrists above red and black boots.
identity_text: A hooded wanderer in a long black coat cracked with glowing lava-coloured lines, wearing a grey animal-eared hood over white hair and a gold pendant, with glowing bands at the wrists. The title describes the theme rather than naming a character.

head: fluffy white wool on the head
small ears

appearance_text: A woolly farm animal standing upright, covered in thick fluffy white wool over its head, body and upper arms. Its face is light brown with small black eyes, tiny ears and a pink nose. Its bare brown legs and arms stick out below the wool and end in dark hooves.
identity_text: A sheep, the woolly white farm mob from Minecraft, with a brown face and brown legs sticking out below thick wool.

hair: straight black hair to the jaw
head: dark blue peaked cap with a gold band
top: blue military coat with white cuffs

appearance_text: A pale soldier with straight black hair to his jaw, wearing a dark blue peaked cap with a gold band. His blue military coat has white cuffs and is worn over an olive shirt with a bright yellow scarf knotted at the throat, and a thick brown belt round the waist. He wears olive trousers and black boots.
identity_text: Saichi Sugimoto from the manga and anime Golden Kamuy, in his blue army uniform with a peaked cap, yellow scarf and wide brown belt.

head: tall helmet with a copper crest
glowing blue band across the eyes
top: glowing pale blue panel in the middle

appearance_text: A tall armoured figure built from blue grey plates edged with copper bands. Its helmet rises to a copper crest and a glowing pale blue strip sits where the eyes should be, with the same glow shining from a panel in the middle of its chest. Copper rings wrap the arms and legs, and the back plate carries another glowing blue mark.
identity_text: A tall faceless construct built from blue-grey plates edged with copper, with a glowing pale blue strip where the eyes would be and a matching glow from a panel in its chest. Imperigo is not attested as a character anywhere outside this listing.

face: one red eye and one green eye
head: gold laurel headband
top: bare chest with red shoulder armour

appearance_text: A young man with black hair held back by a gold laurel headband, and eyes of two different colours - one red, one green. His chest is bare apart from a white sash running across it and a round gold plate on one shoulder, with red plated armour on his arms and shoulders. He wears matching red armoured trousers and grey boots.
identity_text: Zagreus, the Prince of the Underworld from the dungeon crawler Hades, bare-chested under red plate armour with a gold laurel headband and a white sash across his chest.

accessories: thin black tail on the back
bottom: white and blue striped long socks
hair: short blue hair with a fringe
head: blue hood with round mouse ears
pink inside the ears

appearance_text: A girl in a bright blue hoodie made to look like a round mouse, with two big round ears on the hood that are pink inside. Her hair is blue and a white belly panel runs down the front of the hoodie. She wears blue shorts with bare thighs above white and blue striped long socks, and a thin black tail curls on her back.
identity_text: A girl wearing a blue animal hoodie modelled on a round-eared water mouse creature, with a white belly panel, blue shorts and blue and white striped long socks. She is a girl in a costume, not the creature itself.

bottom: long white skirt down to the floor
head: cream and gold flower crown

appearance_text: A regal woman with long brown hair falling down her back, wearing a crown of pale cream flowers. Her gown is white with shining gold trim running down the front, and a gold necklace sits at her throat. The dress flows all the way to the floor in soft white folds so her feet do not show, and her sleeves are white with pale bands.
identity_text: An unnamed royal woman in a long white gown with gold trim and a flower crown. 'Gilded Monarch' describes the look, so no name is claimed.

appearance_text: A pale man with short black hair swept back from his forehead and blue eyes under heavy brows. He wears a grey suit jacket with a faint check pattern over a white dress shirt and a grey tie. The matching grey trousers have the same check and he wears dark shoes. The jacket is plain grey across his back.
identity_text: Michael De Santa, one of the three playable characters of Grand Theft Auto V, in a grey checked suit with a white dress shirt and grey tie.

accessories: small yellow flower on the chest

colors.item: green animal-ear hood with a small shoulder cape, over a cream shirt with black-and-white striped sleeves and a light blue overall bib
colors.name: green

hair: dark brown hair under the hood
head: green hood with rounded animal ears
top: black and white striped long sleeves

appearance_text: A pale girl with dark brown hair peeking out from under a green hood that has rounded animal ears on top. Her green jacket is open over a pale top with a small yellow flower at the chest, and her sleeves are striped in black and white. She wears light blue denim shorts, long white socks banded with stripes, and green shoes.
identity_text: A girl in a green animal-ear hood over a cream top with striped sleeves, light blue denim shorts and long striped socks. She is a nature-themed everyday character rather than a named one.

bottom: cream bone leg armour with red gems
head: gold crown with a red jewel
grey skull head
top: cream bone armour with a red gem in the middle

appearance_text: A tall figure with a grey skull for a head, hollow black eyes and a wide dark mouth, wearing a gold crown set with a red jewel. Pale bone-coloured armour plates cover the chest, arms and legs, each set with small red gems over a black under-tunic. A long red cape hangs all the way down the back.
identity_text: A crowned undead king: a dark grey skull-like head under a gold crown with a red jewel, cream bone armour set with red gems over a black tunic, and a long red cape. The listing presents him as a crowned wither boss.

bottom: dark purple trousers with checkered patches

colors.item: ears on top of the head
colors.name: light brown

head: two tall furry ears standing up on the head
top: dark purple jacket with white checkerboard squares across the chest and back

appearance_text: A boy with shaggy brown hair and two tall furry ears standing up on top of his head, with a pale pink face and small dark eyes. He wears a dark purple jacket patterned with white checkerboard squares across the chest, sleeve and all the way over the back. His dark purple trousers carry the same checkered patches down the legs.
identity_text: An unnamed boy with tall animal ears on his head, wearing a dark purple jacket and trousers patterned with white checkerboard squares.

head: long bright pink hair
green leaves in the hair
top: white top covered in little black spots
pink sleeves with green leaf edges

appearance_text: A girl with long bright pink hair that has green leafy shapes tucked into it and green eyes. Her top is white and speckled all over with tiny black spots like fruit seeds, with pink sleeves edged in green leaves that reach over her shoulders and down her back. She wears dark purple shorts, pink and white striped socks and dark boots.
identity_text: A girl styled after a pitaya, or dragon fruit: bright pink hair with green leafy tips, a white seed-speckled top with pink leaf-edged sleeves, dark purple shorts and striped socks. She is a girl in a fruit-themed outfit, not the fruit itself.

head: red mask
top: red suit top with a white lightning bolt

appearance_text: A hero in a bright red bodysuit with a big white lightning bolt across the chest. He wears a red mask that covers his face around his blue eyes, with short orange hair showing on top of his head. White stripes ring his wrists and the tops of his red boots, and the back of the suit is red with darker red shading.
identity_text: Wally West in his crimson Rebirth costume, a masked speedster in a red bodysuit with a white lightning bolt on the chest.

colors.item: space helmet print on the chest
colors.name: white

hair: messy black hair with a long fringe
top: white space helmet printed on the front

appearance_text: A boy with messy black hair falling over his eyes and pale skin. He wears a black hoodie with a white space helmet printed on the chest and a small red, white and blue flag printed across the back. His jeans are baggy and light blue, and his shoes have a black and white checked pattern.
identity_text: A boy with messy black hair in a black hoodie printed with an astronaut helmet on the front and a planted flag on the back, over baggy light blue jeans.

head: burning red and orange head
flames instead of hair
top: orange flame badge on the chest

appearance_text: A figure whose whole head is a blaze of red, orange and yellow flames, with dark hollow eyes and a wide dark mouth burning in the middle. The body wears a black hoodie with a bright orange flame badge across the chest. Glowing red and orange bands ring the wrists and ankles, and the trousers and shoes are black.
identity_text: A skin of the Minecraft YouTuber PrestonPlayz, drawn with a blazing creeper face for a head and his flame emblem on a black hoodie.

colors.item: stripes down the sleeves and legs
colors.name: white

head: bear head
round bear ears
furry winter hat with ear flaps

appearance_text: A brown bear standing on two legs with a rounded snout, a pale muzzle and small dark eyes. On its head is a grey furry winter hat with ear flaps and a red star on the front. It wears a dark navy tracksuit jacket with white stripes down the sleeves and a white drawstring at the waist, matching navy tracksuit trousers with white side stripes, and brown shoes.
identity_text: A brown bear standing upright in a navy tracksuit, a fur cap with a red star and a gold chain. 'Cool' describes the look; the animal itself is the only thing named.

head: tan dog head
pointed ears
cream cheeks
top: tan furry chest with a cream patch

appearance_text: A dog with soft tan fur, cream cheeks, cream eyebrows and a cream chest and belly. Its small black eyes sit close together above a black nose, giving it a slightly puzzled look. Its legs are tan with dark paw tips, and a curled tail sits against its back.
identity_text: Doge, the shiba inu of internet meme fame, as a soft tan dog with cream markings.

head: long brown hair falling over the shoulders

appearance_text: A girl with long wavy brown hair and light blue eyes. She wears an open cream knitted cardigan over a dark grey top, with blue denim shorts that leave her legs bare. Brown boots come up over her ankles.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with long wavy brown hair wearing a cream knitted cardigan over a dark top, denim shorts and tall brown boots.

face: grey mask over nose and mouth
head: purple headband
black hood

appearance_text: A figure dressed head to toe in black cloth and dark grey chest armour, with straps crossing the shoulders. A grey mask covers the nose and mouth so only sharp teal eyes show, and a purple headband is tied across the forehead. A purple sash is knotted at the waist above black trousers and boots.
identity_text: A ninja dressed head to toe in black cloth with dark grey chest armour, a grey mask covering the nose and mouth, and a purple headband and matching waist sash.

appearance_text: A grinning man with short black hair and wide black sunglasses covering his eyes. He wears a light blue suit jacket over a white shirt with a small black bow tie. His trousers are black and his shoes are white, and the light blue jacket covers his back too.
identity_text: Psy, the South Korean pop singer behind Gangnam Style, in his light blue suit jacket, white shirt and small black bow tie, with wide black sunglasses and short black hair.

face: one blue eye showing under the hood
head: blue hood pulled up
brown hair under the hood
top: bright blue hoodie worn open with the hood up
dark creeper face printed across the back

appearance_text: A boy with brown hair and the hood of his bright blue hoodie pulled up so only one blue eye shows. The hoodie hangs open over a plain white t-shirt, and across the whole back of it is a dark creeper face with square eyes and a frowning mouth. He wears dark grey jeans and white shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed boy with his blue hoodie open and the hood up so only one eye shows, a creeper face printed across the back. The creeper is a print on the garment, not the figure itself.

head: blue penguin head with a cap-like crest
white face

He has a bright red hoodie with a gold chain around his neck and a short dark navy cape draped over his shoulders and down his back. His jeans are dark navy with red cuffs at the ankles, above red and white shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed boy in a red hoodie, gold chain and gold crown, with a short navy cape over his shoulders. The listing says the outfit is themed after the migrator cape given to players who moved a Mojang account to Microsoft.

head: orange hood pulled up over the head

appearance_text: A pale boy with messy black hair falling over his blue eyes, with a bright orange hood pulled up over his head. His hoodie is the same bright orange with grey drawstrings hanging at the front and loose sleeves. He wears black jeans that are torn at the knees and plain white shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed teenage boy with the hood of his bright orange hoodie pulled up over his messy black hair, wearing ripped black jeans and plain white shoes.

hair: long white hair down the back
head: long white hair
pink flowers and green leaves in the hair

appearance_text: A slender figure with long white hair falling down the back, dotted with small pink flowers and green leaves. She wears a soft pale yellow robe that flows all the way to the ankles, with a collar of green leaves and a round brown pendant at the throat. Her eyes are bright blue and dark sandals show at her feet.
identity_text: A forest elf with long white hair full of pink flowers and leaves, in a soft pale yellow robe with a green leaf collar and a round brown pendant at the throat.

face: square black eyes with glowing blue-green light
head: bone creeper face
top: big skull painted on the chest

appearance_text: A bone-coloured monster whose head has two square black eyes with a glowing blue-green light inside them and a frowning pronged mouth. A huge grinning skull is drawn across the chest, with the same glowing eyes and a row of jagged black teeth. The arms and legs are pale bone with dark patches, and a knobbly spine runs down the back.
identity_text: A bone-white monster carrying the standard creeper face on its head and a huge fanged skull across its chest, with glowing blue-green eyes. It is a skull-themed creeper variant rather than a named character.

appearance_text: A boy with messy brown hair falling over pale blue eyes. He wears a big baggy pink jumper with wide sleeves that hangs loose over his body, plain pink all the way round the back. Underneath he has grey shorts with pink marks on them, and his legs go down into grey socks and pink shoes.
identity_text: A boy with messy brown hair in an oversized faded pink jumper, grey shorts and pink shoes.

head: short brown hair with a fringe

appearance_text: A boy with short brown hair and pale blue eyes. He wears a plain black long-sleeved jumper with no pattern on it. His jeans are light blue and ripped at the knees, and his shoes are black with white soles.
identity_text: An unnamed teenage boy with reddish-brown hair in a plain dark long-sleeved top and light blue jeans torn at the knees.

bottom: black legs with glowing white leg bones
head: pale white skull
top: black body with a glowing white ribcage and spine

appearance_text: A pale white skull sits on top of a body that is almost entirely black, with two big dark hollow eye sockets and a small row of teeth. Glowing white bones are drawn over the dark body: a curved ribcage and spine on the chest and back, and long bones running down the arms and legs. The hands and feet stay dark so only the bones seem to shine.
identity_text: A skeleton drawn so that only the skull and bones glow against an otherwise black body, like a glow in the dark skeleton costume.

head: round monkey ears on the sides of the head
top: brown fur with a lighter belly

appearance_text: A brown furry monkey with round ears sticking out at the sides of its head and a wide light brown face. Its small black eyes sit above a big grinning mouth. The chest and belly are a lighter tan than the darker brown fur of the arms and legs, and a curling brown tail hangs down its back.
identity_text: A monkey with brown fur, round ears out at the sides of its head, a wide grin and a curling tail down its back.

appearance_text: A tall figure whose head is a mass of burning orange and yellow flame, split by two glowing white eyes and a wide toothy white grin. Below the burning head it wears an ordinary brown jacket over a tan shirt. Dark brown trousers and heavy black shoes finish it off.
identity_text: A figure in ordinary brown jacket and trousers whose head is a mass of orange flame with glowing white eyes and a wide toothy grin. The title names a mood, not a character.

face: big white eyes with tiny black pupils
open mouth with a pink tongue hanging out
head: floppy dog ears
square yellow dog head

appearance_text: A stretchy yellow orange dog covered head to toe in the same warm colour, with no clothes at all. Its big square head has wide white eyes with tiny black dots for pupils, a rounded lighter snout and an open mouth with a pink tongue flopping out. Small floppy ears sit on top and the body and legs stay plain yellow all the way round.
identity_text: Jake the Dog from Adventure Time, the stretchy yellow cartoon dog with floppy ears and a lolling tongue.

appearance_text: An older man with a thick grey beard and blue eyes under dark brown hair. He wears a long brown coat with a grey cloth draped over his shoulders and a grey undershirt beneath. A small gold buckle holds his belt, and his brown trousers tuck into worn boots.
identity_text: An old man with drained grey skin and a shaggy pale beard, in a worn brown coat over a blue-grey shirt; the listing describes him as a drowned man who does not know he is dead.

head: big round black mouse ears
red bow with a white dot
top: red dress with white polka dots

appearance_text: A cartoon mouse with two big round black ears and a bright red bow with a white dot perched on top. The tan face has large black eyes, a white muzzle with a black nose and round pink cheeks. She wears a red dress covered in white polka dots, with black arms and black legs, and small yellow shoes.
identity_text: Minnie Mouse, the Disney cartoon mouse, in her red dress covered in white polka dots, with a red hair bow and yellow shoes.

appearance_text: A creature glowing orange and yellow all over, as if it were made of embers. Two small pointed horns sit on its head, its eyes shine white, and red marks streak its cheeks. Red flame-like patches speckle its chest, arms and legs, front and back.
identity_text: A Blazeborn, the fire-immune origin class from the Origins Mod, rendered as a horned humanoid glowing orange and yellow like embers.

head: plain white head with a black border

appearance_text: A simple white figure drawn with thick black outlines around every limb. Its head is a plain white block with two bright orange rectangle eyes and a tiny black smiling mouth. The rest of the body, arms and legs are the same flat white with no clothes or markings.
identity_text: The Reddit Alien, the white cartoon mascot from the Reddit logo, rendered as a flat white figure with heavy black outlines, orange rectangle eyes and a small black smiling mouth.

bottom: black leggings with white and red snowflake pattern
top: white knitted sweater with off-shoulder sleeves

appearance_text: A pale girl with long brown hair, one thick braid running down her back, and striking red eyes. She wears a chunky white knitted sweater that slips off the shoulders and a deep red scarf bunched at her neck. Black leggings patterned with white and red snowflake bands cover her legs down to short brown boots.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in winter knitwear: a white off-shoulder sweater, a deep red scarf and snowflake-patterned leggings above short brown boots.

head: blue hood down at the back
top: blue hoodie with light grey sleeves

appearance_text: A boy with short brown hair swept across his forehead and warm brown eyes. He wears a blue hoodie with pale grey lower sleeves and the hood resting down behind his shoulders. Dark grey jeans and white shoes finish the simple everyday look.
identity_text: An ordinary boy with short brown hair in a blue hoodie with pale grey sleeves, dark grey jeans and white shoes. The title describes the colour and mood, not a character.

colors.item: glowing trim on the sleeves and hem
colors.name: dark green

face: green creeper face with dark hollow eyes and a frowning mouth
head: big black hood

appearance_text: A tall figure wrapped in a long black hooded robe. Inside the deep hood is a green face with dark hollow eyes and a wide frowning mouth. Faint green edges glow along the sleeves, the hem of the robe and the feet.
identity_text: A creeper dressed as the grim reaper, its green creeper face looking out from deep inside a long black hooded robe edged in glowing green.

hair: long pale blonde hair down the back
head: long cream blonde hair
pink flowers tucked in the hair
top: pink and white striped top underneath

appearance_text: A girl with very long pale blonde hair falling all the way down her back, with small pink flowers tucked in above her blue eyes. She wears a brown checked shirt hanging open over a pink and white striped top. Dark blue jeans and short brown boots finish the outfit.
identity_text: An unnamed country girl with very long pale blonde hair and pink flowers tucked in it, in an open brown checked shirt, striped top, dark jeans and short brown boots.

accessories: straw poking out of the sleeves and trouser legs

colors.item: straw at the wrists and ankles
colors.name: tan

head: carved pumpkin head
ridged orange skin

appearance_text: A tall figure whose head is a big carved pumpkin with glowing eyes and a jagged toothy grin. It wears a dark navy suit jacket over a black shirt, with a belt and a round buckle at the waist. Bits of straw poke out from the ends of its sleeves and trouser legs.
identity_text: A scarecrow come to life, with a carved pumpkin for a head, a dark navy suit over a black shirt and straw poking out of its sleeves and trouser legs.

head: black top hat with a white band

appearance_text: A man wearing a tall black top hat with a white band and a monocle over one eye. He has brown hair and a big curled brown moustache. He is dressed in a smart black suit jacket over a white shirt with a white cravat, with black trousers and black shoes.
identity_text: A posh gentleman in a tall black top hat and black suit, wearing a monocle and a big curled handlebar moustache.

appearance_text: A girl with long orange-red hair spilling out from under a pointed green hood, with pointed ears and light blue eyes. She wears a green tunic belted at the waist with brown leather, and her arms and legs are bare down to tall brown boots. Strapped to her back is a round shield with a blue face and a red and gold crest.
identity_text: A female version of Link, the green-tunicked hero of The Legend of Zelda, with pointed ears, bright orange hair and a round crested shield on her back.

bottom: blue dungarees with shoulder straps and buttons
