head: cap that is half green and half red with white badges
top: long sleeve shirt split green on one side and red on the other

appearance_text: A moustached plumber whose clothes are split straight down the middle: the left side of his cap and shirt is green and the right side is red, with a white badge on each half of the cap. He wears blue dungarees with shoulder straps and round buttons, white gloves and brown shoes.
identity_text: A mash-up of the two plumber brothers in a single figure: the cap and shirt are green down one side and red down the other, worn with blue dungarees, white gloves and brown shoes.

accessories: wide brown belt with a buckle
head: messy ginger brown hair

appearance_text: A rugged man with short reddish brown hair and a thick brown beard, his mouth open in a shout. He wears a long dark blue coat over a grey shirt with a leather strap across his chest and a wide brown belt with a big buckle at his waist. Below he has dark red striped trousers tucked into brown boots.
identity_text: A generic pirate: a rugged, bearded man in a long dark blue coat over a grey shirt, with a strap across his chest, a big-buckled belt, dark red striped trousers and brown boots.

appearance_text: A chubby penguin standing upright, black across the head, back and wings with a bright white face and belly. A big orange beak sits in the middle of its face above two small black eyes. A round gold badge shines on its chest above a gold belt, and a long red cape falls down its back to its orange webbed feet.
identity_text: A penguin dressed up as a superhero, with a big orange beak, a gold chest badge and belt, and a long red cape.

appearance_text: A brown skinned man with very short black hair and big ears. He wears a black pinstriped suit jacket over a white shirt with a blue tie, and a tiny red pin on the lapel. His trousers and shoes are black to match.
identity_text: Barack Obama, the 44th President of the United States, in a black pinstriped suit with a blue tie and a small red lapel pin.

appearance_text: A tall hooded figure whose face is a bare white skull with deep black eye sockets, framed by a dark purple hood. The long purple robe has a line of white bones running down the chest and is tied with a thin brown belt at the waist. The ends of the sleeves glow pale green, and the robe falls plain and dark all the way down the back.
identity_text: A skull-faced spellcaster in a long deep purple hooded robe belted with brown leather, with green magic flaring at his sleeve ends. The title describes the type, not a named character.

appearance_text: A pale woman with short ginger hair and calm grey eyes. She wears a dark green jacket left open over a plain cream shirt, with the green also covering her arms and back. Her trousers are plain brown and tucked into tall black boots that come up over her shins.
identity_text: Claire Dearing from Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom, a short-haired redhead in an open green field jacket and tall black boots.

head: green hat with a red band on the back

appearance_text: A cheerful pale character with short orange hair and big blue eyes, wearing a green hat with a red band at the back. The tunic is green with a brown belt at the waist and matching green sleeves. Below it are long red and white striped stockings and green shoes.
identity_text: A cheerful red-haired boy dressed as a Christmas elf, in a green tunic belted at the waist, a green hat with a red band, red and white striped stockings and green shoes.

hair: hair down to the waist at the back
top: black top with a v neck

appearance_text: A pale girl with long silvery purple hair reaching her waist, and two different coloured eyes, one blue and one green. She wears a dark grey jacket over a black top with a v neck, and short black shorts. Her thighs are bare above long grey socks and white shoes.
identity_text: A teenage girl with long silvery lavender hair down to her waist, in an olive-grey jacket over a black top, black shorts and long layered socks.

colors.item: long hair down the back (no wings)
colors.name: pink

appearance_text: A girl with long light brown hair and a pair of soft pink and white animal ears on her head. She wears a dark purple pinafore top over a shirt with pastel blue and pink striped sleeves, and a striped pastel skirt. Striped socks and purple shoes cover her legs, and pale pink wings spread across her back.
identity_text: An unnamed pastel-themed girl with soft pink animal ears, a dark pinafore top over pink and blue gingham, striped pastel socks and purple shoes.

face: shadowy face with faint blue glow
head: dark blue hood
no face inside
top: glowing blue mark across the chest

appearance_text: A shadowy figure wrapped in a black hood and robe so dark that its face cannot be seen. A bright light blue mark glows across its chest like a strip of cold fire, and on its back a big blue flame burns and lights up the cloth around it. Its shoulders are covered by dark blue pads and its legs and boots are black with a faint blue shine.
identity_text: A hooded, faceless spirit in robes so dark they read as black, lit only by cold blue fire: a glowing band across the chest and a big blue flame burning on its back.

head: brown dog ears with pink insides
top: brown furry body with a white chest

appearance_text: A little dog covered in warm brown fur, with soft ears that have pink insides and shiny black eyes. Its muzzle is white with a small black nose, and a stripe of white runs down its chest and tummy. Its paws are white and a small brown tail sticks out at the back.
identity_text: A puppy covered in warm brown fur, with a white muzzle and black nose, pink-lined ears, a white stripe down its chest and a little tail at the back.

face: dark eye holes cut in the bag
head: brown paper bag pulled over the head
two cut out eye holes
subjects: person with a bag on their head

appearance_text: A person whose whole head is hidden inside a crumpled brown paper bag with two ragged holes cut out for the eyes. Below it they wear a crisp white short sleeved shirt with a narrow black tie hanging down the front, plain black trousers and clean white shoes. The bag is blank and brown all the way round, and the shirt is plain across the back.
identity_text: A smartly dressed man whose head is completely hidden inside a crumpled brown paper bag with two holes cut for the eyes. He wears a white shirt and black tie with black trousers and white shoes.

appearance_text: A girl with very long pale blonde hair and big blue eyes. She wears a mint green top under a dusty pink cardigan left hanging open, with white shorts below. Long white socks with light blue stripes come up her legs to white shoes.
identity_text: A pale blonde girl in a mint green top under an open dusty pink cardigan, with white shorts and long white socks striped in light blue. An everyday casual girl rather than a named character.

head: short brown hair
top: red orange yellow green blue and purple bands

appearance_text: A kid with short brown hair hanging over the eyes, wearing a jumper striped in rainbow bands from red at the shoulders down through orange, yellow, green and blue to purple at the hem. The rainbow stripes wrap right around the sleeves and the back. Dark blue jeans and grey shoes finish the outfit.
identity_text: A brown-haired kid wearing a rainbow-banded jumper with ripped dark blue jeans and grey shoes.

appearance_text: A teenager with brown skin and short curly black hair. They wear a dark red hoodie with white strings, left open over a plain black top, with the hood hanging behind. Below are black shorts with pockets, bare legs, and chunky black boots.
identity_text: A brown-skinned teenager in a dark red puffer jacket over a plain black top, with ripped black shorts and black hair tied into two small buns. The title describes the jacket colour rather than naming anyone.

head: short dark brown hair
hair swept over the forehead
top: gold star badge on the sleeve

appearance_text: A man with short dark brown hair swept over his forehead and purple eyes. He wears a buttoned tan uniform shirt with pockets on the chest and a small gold star badge pinned to one sleeve. His trousers are dark brown with a belt, and his boots are brown.
identity_text: A man in a buttoned tan uniform shirt with a gold star badge on the sleeve, dark brown trousers and boots. The listing gives him a job rather than a name.

colors.item: broken wing marks on the back
colors.name: dark red

appearance_text: A very pale figure dressed almost entirely in soft cream, so light that the clothes and the skin nearly blend together. The hair is the same pale cream and the eyes are faint brown. Down the back, dark red streaks spread out from the shoulders in the shape of two ragged broken wings. The legs are cream and darken into dark brown boots at the feet.
identity_text: An unnamed angel dressed almost entirely in pale cream, with dark red streaks spreading from the shoulders down the back in the shape of two ragged, broken wings.

head: grey goggles pushed up on the forehead

appearance_text: A man with short brown hair and a pair of grey goggles pushed up onto his forehead. He wears a long white coat over a blue tie, with a small red badge and a pen tucked into the chest pocket. His trousers are white and his shoes are black.
identity_text: An unnamed man dressed for pharmacy or lab work: a long white coat over a blue tie, white trousers and black shoes, with goggles pushed up on his forehead.

head: bright red braids hanging down
top: red, blue, yellow and green bands

appearance_text: A young man with brown skin and bright red braids hanging down around his head. He wears a jumper covered in wide rainbow stripes of red, blue, yellow and green, with a gold chain at his neck. Blue jeans and grey trainers finish the outfit.
identity_text: Lil Yachty, the American rapper, with his signature bright red braids, gold chain and a boldly striped rainbow jumper over blue jeans.

appearance_text: A stocky robot built from yellow and gold metal plates, with a grey face plate, a thin black mouth slit and glowing light blue eyes. A bright red heart badge is stamped on the middle of its chest. Grey armour caps its shoulders and knees, its legs are black and grey, and thick yellow plating covers its back.
identity_text: Bumblebee, the yellow Autobot from Transformers, built here as a stocky gold-and-black armoured robot with a grey face plate and glowing blue eyes.

appearance_text: A boy in a red baseball cap with a blue back, with short black hair poking out underneath. His t-shirt is yellow with wide blue stripes across it and leaves his arms bare. He wears blue shorts and red shoes with white soles, and a yellow backpack is strapped across his back.
identity_text: Ness, the boy hero of EarthBound, in his red baseball cap, blue-striped yellow t-shirt, blue shorts and red shoes, with a yellow backpack on his back.

head: round bear ears with pink insides

appearance_text: A round little bear covered in soft brown fur, with a big cream patch on its tummy and a cream muzzle with two tiny teeth. Its small black eyes sit above pink blushing cheeks, and round ears with pink insides stick up on top of its head. Cream paw pads show on its feet and a tiny cream tail pokes out at the back.
identity_text: A small round bear covered in soft brown fur with a cream tummy and muzzle, pink-lined ears and a tiny tail at the back.

accessories: brown teddy bear held at the front
head: pink hood with rounded animal ears

appearance_text: A girl with long blonde hair peeking out from under a soft pink hood with two rounded animal ears on top. Her blue eyes are shaded with purple and her cheeks are pink. She wears a cream dress trimmed in pink with pink cuffs at her wrists, and she hugs a little brown teddy bear against her front. Her boots are pink with white socks folded over the tops.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in a soft pink animal-eared hood and a cream and pink dress, holding a little teddy bear. The listing title describes the pastel look rather than naming anyone.

bottom: dark grey tracksuit bottoms with white side stripes
top: white tracksuit jacket with grey shoulders and a red collar stripe

appearance_text: A boy with messy brown hair and striking red eyes. He wears a white tracksuit jacket with grey shoulder panels and a red stripe running down from the collar, and the back is plain white and grey. His tracksuit bottoms are dark grey with white stripes down the sides, over white and grey trainers.
identity_text: An unnamed teenage boy in a white and grey tracksuit with a red stripe down the front, worn over white and grey trainers.

face: scarf pulled up over the mouth
hair: dark brown hair with a straight fringe
head: dark brown bowl cut hair

appearance_text: A boy with dark brown bowl cut hair and bright blue eyes, with a chunky grey and white striped scarf wrapped around his neck and pulled up over his mouth. He wears an open green jacket over a white shirt, tan trousers, and grey boots that come up over his ankles. The back of the jacket is plain green.
identity_text: An unnamed boy in an open green jacket with a thick grey and white striped scarf wound over his mouth, dressed for cold weather. 'Cool Green' names the colour, not the boy.

appearance_text: A grey-haired man wearing a crown of green laurel leaves around his head, with pale blue eyes and a clean-shaven face. He is dressed in a flowing orange and yellow robe that leaves his arms bare, gathered at the waist by a brown belt. A long red cape covers his whole back.
identity_text: Julius Caesar, the Roman general and statesman, shown in a flowing orange and gold robe with a brown belt, a long red cape and a green laurel wreath.

top: orange flame logo on the chest

appearance_text: A teenager with messy dark brown hair that hangs down over the eyes. They wear a big black hoodie with a bright orange flame-shaped logo printed across the chest, and the back and sleeves are plain black. Below that are black trousers with rips, white socks and chunky white sneakers.
identity_text: A teenager in an oversized black hoodie printed with an orange flame logo, ripped black jeans and white sneakers, with a long fringe hiding the eyes.

head: boxy red and black helmet
pale blue visor
top: red chest armour with a pale panel down the middle

appearance_text: A bulky machine suit plated in bright red with black joints showing between the panels. The head is a boxy helmet with a wide pale blue visor instead of a face. Down the middle of the chest runs a pale panel flanked by small yellow warning lights, and thick blocks sit on each shoulder. The legs are red and black and end in heavy dark boots, with a black harness across the back.
identity_text: The SCV, the bulky red armoured construction machine that builds for the Terrans in StarCraft.

head: black bow on top of the head

appearance_text: A girl with long orange hair that falls past her shoulders and a small black bow on top of her head. She wears a black top that leaves her shoulders bare. Her legs are covered in leggings striped in black and purple, and she has purple shoes.
identity_text: A girl with long orange hair in a black off-the-shoulder top, black leggings banded with orange, and lilac boots.

head: brown hair
thick brown beard
top: red and black checked shirt with the sleeves rolled up

appearance_text: A strong man with brown hair and a thick brown beard covering his chin. He wears a red and black checked shirt with the sleeves rolled up over a white vest, tucked into blue jeans with a gold buckled belt. His boots are sturdy brown leather.
identity_text: An unnamed lumberjack: a strong bearded man in a red and black checked shirt with rolled-up sleeves over a white vest, blue jeans with a gold-buckled belt and brown boots.

appearance_text: A chunky creature whose whole body looks like brown bark or dirt, with glowing pale yellow eyes and a wide dark mouth. Small pink flowers and patches of light green moss and leaves grow across its head, arms, chest and legs. The flowers and moss cover its back as well, so it is speckled with pink and green all over.
identity_text: A hulking creature built from bark and dirt, overgrown all over with pink flowers and patches of green moss, with two glowing pale yellow eyes.

face: dark cloth wrapped over the nose and mouth
head: white fur hood pulled over the head
top: grey fur cloak over the shoulders
brown leather straps across the chest
brown leather vest on the back

appearance_text: A figure hidden under a white fur hood, with a dark cloth wound over the nose and mouth and a shadowed band across the eyes, and pale green markings smudged on the cheeks. A grey fur cloak sits heavily over both shoulders, held by brown leather straps crossing the chest, with a brown leather back panel behind. Dark blue shorts are cinched with a gold buckle, and the legs are wrapped in brown cloth above scuffed dark brown boots.
identity_text: An unnamed hooded survivor wrapped in white and grey fur with leather straps across the chest and cloth wound over the face. The listing calls him a bandit in a nuclear winter but gives no name.

colors.item: logo on the back of the hoodie
colors.name: light grey

head: hood down at the back
top: dark blue hoodie with a grey logo on the back

appearance_text: A boy with messy light brown hair falling over brown eyes. He wears a thick dark blue hoodie with the hood down and a pale grey logo printed across the back. Slim black trousers and clean white trainers complete the look.
identity_text: A boy in a thick dark navy hoodie with a pale grey logo printed across the back, black trousers and white trainers. The title describes the everyday gamer look, not a character.

appearance_text: A tall figure encased head to toe in shining silver metal armour. Its helmet covers everything but the mouth and chin, with a bright red band running across the dark visor. The chest carries a black panel set into the plating, and the arms, legs and boots are all built from smooth armour segments.
identity_text: RoboCop, the armoured cyborg policeman of the 1987 action film. He is encased head to toe in pale metal plating with only his mouth and chin left bare, a red band across the helmet and a black panel on the chest.

appearance_text: A boy peeking out from under a bright green dinosaur hood, with two black dinosaur eyes on top and a ring of pointed white teeth framing his face. His brown fringe shows under the hood and his eyes are blue. He wears a shirt with thick yellow and white stripes, green trousers and green shoes.
identity_text: A boy peeking out from inside a green dinosaur hood, a ring of white teeth framing his face and two black dinosaur eyes on top, over a bold yellow and white striped shirt. Descriptive title, no character named.

head: green dinosaur hood
white eye patch on the side of the hood
top: row of cream spikes down the back

appearance_text: A person wearing a big green dinosaur hoodie with the hood pulled up, a pale patch on the side of it like an eye, and a row of cream spikes running all the way down the back. Green hair falls messily over dark eyes. The hoodie has a front pocket, and below it are dark blue jeans and white shoes.
identity_text: A boy in a dark green dinosaur hoodie with the hood pulled up, spikes down the back and a front pocket, worn with jeans and white trainers. Descriptive title, no character named.

footwear: dark brown boots with orange tops
head: long hair

appearance_text: A pale girl with very long dark teal hair falling down her back and bright pink eyes. She wears a red coat with white cuffs, cinched by a wide dark brown belt across her middle. Her legs are in red leggings tucked into dark brown boots with orange bands around the tops.
identity_text: Sabrina, the Gym Leader of Saffron City, in her FireRed and LeafGreen outfit — a belted red coat with red leggings and long teal hair.

bottom: black skirt with a pale band
head: animal ears
long hair

appearance_text: A pale girl with very long dark green hair that hangs over her eyes and down her back, with pointed animal ears the same green on top of her head. She wears a plain black hoodie with long sleeves over a short black skirt edged with a pale pink band. Her boots are black and come partway up her legs.
identity_text: A pale, goth-styled cat girl with very long dark green hair and matching pointed ears, dressed all in black — hoodie, short skirt and tall boots.

accessories: red pen in the coat pocket
hair: dark hair around the back of the head
subjects: bearded man in a lab coat

appearance_text: An older man with a huge bushy dark grey beard, thick grey eyebrows and a bald head with dark hair only around the back. He wears a long white lab coat with buttons down the front, a blue tie peeking out at the collar and a small red pen in the chest pocket. His trousers are dark navy, and the coat is plain white all across the back.
identity_text: An older, balding man with a huge bushy dark grey beard, wearing a buttoned white lab coat over a blue tie, with dark navy trousers.

appearance_text: A figure covered head to toe in dark grey armour flecked with black and white, like rough stone. The helmet hides the face behind a black covering with only two glowing white eyes showing. Streaks of blue run across the chest and shoulders, and the boots are the same speckled grey.
identity_text: A figure armoured head to toe in black and grey speckled plating like bedrock, with blue streaks over the chest and two glowing white eyes showing through the helmet.

head: dark animal ears
top: black jacket with dark red patches

appearance_text: A pale girl with long grey brown hair falling past her waist and covering one of her dark red eyes, with two furry dark ears on top of her head. She wears a black jacket with dull dark red patches at the shoulders and chest, and the hair sweeps down her whole back over it. Short black shorts sit above white and black socks that reach her knees, tucked into short black boots.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with dark horns rising from her head, waist-length grey-brown hair and a black jacket patched with dark red, over black shorts and long socks.

appearance_text: A boy with short brown hair and a small fringe. He wears a bulky black puffer jacket with padded panels and a zip up the front, its collar sitting high on his neck. His black tracksuit bottoms have two white stripes running down each side, and he wears black trainers.
identity_text: A teenage boy with short brown hair in a bulky black puffer jacket and black tracksuit bottoms striped white down each side. The brand in the description is on his clothes, and 'roadman' names a street style rather than a character.

head: long pointed ears with pink insides

appearance_text: A small blue furry creature covered in mottled blue fur with a pale blue belly and chest. Its head has two long pointed ears with pink insides, huge round black eyes and a black nose above a wide mouth. Short stubby arms and legs end in black claws, and the back is mottled blue all over.
identity_text: Stitch, the small blue alien creature from Lilo & Stitch, with his long pink-lined ears, huge black eyes and pale belly patch.

head: lumpy brown head
swirl shape on the back of the head
top: brown lumpy chest with a glowing teal swirl

appearance_text: A hulking creature whose body looks like lumps of brown flesh melted together, with no clear face and only dark hollows where eyes would be. A bright teal swirl glows on its chest and a purple glowing mark spreads across its back, with thin orange cracks running through the brown. Its arms and legs are mottled brown and teal and end without hands or feet.
identity_text: A hulking creature whose body looks like lumps of brown flesh melted together, lit from within by teal, purple and orange glow. Nothing in the listing gives it a name.

head: pale pink head
big pink heart shape where the face should be

appearance_text: A soft pink figure with long pale pink hair that fades to light purple at the tips and hangs all the way down the back. Instead of eyes and a mouth there is one big pink heart shape filling the face. She wears a light blue dungaree dress over pink skin, with a small dark band at the neck, pink socks and pale shoes.
identity_text: A soft pink figure whose head is a television set displaying a single big heart, dressed in a teal pinafore over pink skin.

appearance_text: A man with shaggy blonde hair and a blonde beard, wearing green tinted sunglasses across his eyes. His black hoodie is covered in orange camouflage blotches on the sleeves, shoulders and back, with a plain dark grey panel down the front. He wears black trousers and black boots.
identity_text: PewDiePie in the skin he used for his 2019 Minecraft let's play series, with shaggy blonde hair, green sunglasses and a black hoodie covered in orange camouflage.

face: wide mouth full of jagged white teeth
head: lumpy red head with green patches

appearance_text: A shapeless creature made of dark red lumpy flesh from head to toe. Its head has sickly green patches and splits open into a wide mouth crowded with jagged white teeth. Bright yellow spots dot its chest and back, with a small blue mark in the middle of its front.
identity_text: The shapeless creature from the horror game Carrion, a mass of lumpy dark red flesh with a jagged toothy maw, glowing green eyes and yellow spots down its body.

appearance_text: A tan-skinned man with short dark brown hair, a brown beard and completely blank, glowing white eyes with no pupils. He wears a plain light blue t-shirt with bare arms and blue-purple trousers. Grey shoes cover his feet.
identity_text: Herobrine, the Minecraft legend said to be the ghost of Notch's dead brother. He looks like the default miner in a light blue t-shirt and blue trousers, but with blank, glowing white eyes and no pupils.

head: round yellow head
big wedge shaped mouth
top: yellow chest with a red open mouth shape

appearance_text: A bright yellow round headed character with two small black eyes and a huge black wedge cut out of its face like an open mouth. Its chest is yellow with another wide red mouth shape across it, and the colour warms from yellow through orange down to deep red at the legs. The back is smooth glowing yellow and orange with no markings.
identity_text: Pac-Man from the arcade game, drawn as a glowing yellow figure with the black wedge mouth in his round head and a red mouth shape across his chest.

head: black bowl cut hair
pointed ear
top: blue uniform shirt with a black collar

appearance_text: A tan skinned man with a shiny black bowl cut, a straight fringe and sharply angled eyebrows over a serious face. One ear comes to a point. He wears a bright blue uniform shirt with a black collar, a small gold badge on the chest and two gold stripes around each cuff. His trousers and boots are black and the back of the shirt is plain blue.
identity_text: Spock from Star Trek, in the blue science-officer uniform with a gold badge, black bowl cut, angled eyebrows and pointed ears.

appearance_text: A broken fox-like animatronic burnt all over to a dark greenish grey. Its head has two pointed ears, one torn, a scorched brown muzzle full of sharp white teeth, and two big pale yellow eyes that glow out of the dark. Its chest is torn open to show rows of grey metal ribs, and more ribs show through the back. The arms and legs are the same charred green and worn down to bare parts.
identity_text: Phantom Mangle, the burnt, hallucinated version of the Mangle animatronic from Five Nights at Freddy's, shown as a scorched fox robot with its ribs showing front and back.

head: pointed dog ears
top: tan furry chest with a cream front

appearance_text: A fluffy tan dog standing on two legs, with a cream muzzle, chest and paws. Its little pink tongue hangs out below a dark brown nose and its eyes are small and black. Pointed ears stand up on its head and a curled cream tail curves up its back.
identity_text: A fluffy tan Shiba standing on two legs with its tongue out, the dog breed behind the doge meme.

bottom: dark red legs with black markings
head: grey curved horns
top: bare red chest with dark red markings

appearance_text: A red-skinned demon with two curved grey horns on its head, narrow black eyes and a wide mouth full of white fangs. Its bare chest and arms are red with darker red markings running across them. The legs are dark red with black patches, ending in black feet.
identity_text: The Devil: a red-skinned demon with curved grey horns, narrow black eyes and a wide mouth full of white fangs.

appearance_text: A man with short sandy blond hair and dark sunglasses hiding his eyes. He wears a black suit jacket open over a blue collared shirt. The matching black trousers and plain black shoes make the whole outfit dark except for the shirt.
identity_text: Horatio Caine, the lead investigator of the crime drama CSI: Miami, in a black suit over a blue collared shirt with his trademark dark sunglasses.

footwear: dark brown boots with cream tops
head: red hat with a cream fur band
top: dark red coat with cream fur edges and cuffs

appearance_text: A rosy nosed old man with a thick white beard, moustache and bushy eyebrows, wearing a red hat with a cream fur band. His deep red coat is trimmed with cream fur down the front and around the cuffs and belted with a gold buckle. Matching red trousers meet dark brown boots with cream tops.
identity_text: Santa Claus, in his deep red fur-trimmed coat and matching hat with a gold-buckled belt. A shaded, higher-detail take on the Christmas gift-bringer.

head: blond hair
white headband
top: white tennis shirt with a collar

appearance_text: A tanned athlete with short blond hair held back by a white sweatband, with purple eyes and a brown beard. He wears a white sports shirt with a small collar and short sleeves that leave his arms bare. His matching white shorts sit above bare legs and clean white trainers.
identity_text: A tanned, blond athlete in an all-white tennis kit with a white sweatband, listed as one of the default skins from Minecraft Xbox 360 Edition.

face: white mask with black dot eyes
head: white mask
brown hat tipped back

appearance_text: A figure whose whole face is a plain white mask with two small black dot eyes and a wide black smile, with a brown hat pushed back on the head. It wears a black tuxedo jacket over a white shirt with a row of buttons and a bright red bow tie. The trousers are black and the shoes are white with red soles.
identity_text: A figure whose whole face is a white mask with dot eyes and a wide grin, dressed in a black tuxedo with a red bow tie and a brown hat. The listing calls it a mashup of two YouTubers, so it is not either of them alone.

accessories: black sunglasses resting on the hat
head: red wide brimmed hat

appearance_text: A girl with long light brown hair wearing a wide red hat with a pair of black sunglasses perched on the brim. She has big brown eyes and a small smile. Her top is a black sleeveless piece with a red skirt below, and her arms are bare. Dark grey tights run down to red and black shoes.
identity_text: Serena, the female Pokemon trainer from the Kalos region in Pokemon X and Y, in her wide red hat, black top and red skirt.

face: blue mask over the nose and mouth
head: dark blue cap worn forwards
top: blue jacket with darker blue patches

appearance_text: A boy in a dark blue cap pulled low over brown hair, with bright blue eyes above a blue mask covering his nose and mouth. He wears a blue jacket patched with darker blue panels down the sleeves and back. Grey trousers and blue and white shoes let him move fast.
identity_text: An unnamed parkour runner in a blue cap and matching mask over the nose and mouth, with a panelled blue jacket, grey trousers and blue and white shoes.

top: small white name tag on the chest

appearance_text: An older man with short white hair, white stubble on his chin and startling red eyes in a tired brown-skinned face. He is dressed in a plain bright orange jumpsuit that covers him from shoulders to ankles, with a small white name tag on the chest and the same orange across the back. A black belt sits at his waist and his shoes are dark grey.
identity_text: An older prisoner in a bright orange jumpsuit with a small white name tag and a black belt, described in the listing as one of the default skins from Minecraft Xbox 360 Edition.

footwear: dark grey boots with brown tops

appearance_text: A pale girl with long wavy ginger hair that spills over her shoulders and right down her back, and bright green eyes. She wears a grey blue short-sleeved top cinched with a wide brown belt at the waist. Her short skirt is checked in black and white, and she has dark grey boots with brown cuffs at the top.
identity_text: A pale girl with long wavy ginger hair in a grey-blue short-sleeved top, a belted black and white checked skirt and dark boots.

head: brown hair with orange underneath
top: dark brown top with orange trim

appearance_text: A girl with long hair that is dark brown on top and glows bright orange underneath and down the back. Her eyes are a warm reddish brown. She wears a dark brown top with orange trim across the chest that leaves her shoulders bare, short black shorts and orange shoes with little black bands around her ankles.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in sunset colours, with gold-topped brown hair, a dark coral-trimmed top and short black shorts.

bottom: dark blue coat tails at the back
subjects: boy in a long dark coat

appearance_text: A pale figure with messy light blue hair and large purple eyes. A long dark blue coat hangs open from the shoulders all the way down the back, over a plain white shirt. Underneath are teal shorts and simple white shoes.
identity_text: A young warlock boy with messy light blue hair, wearing a long dark navy coat with pale orange trim open over a white shirt and a teal underlayer.

hair: hair around the sides of the head
head: white cap on top of the head
top: row of gold buttons down the front

appearance_text: A man with dark brown hair and a bushy dark red beard and moustache, with a white cap sitting on top of his head. He wears a dark yellow jacket with a row of gold buttons running down the front and wide sleeves. His trousers are dark red and he wears black shoes. The back of the jacket is plain dark yellow.
identity_text: Notch, the creator of Minecraft, imagined as an older man in a mustard jacket with gold buttons and dark red trousers.

head: gold helmet with a dark visor
top: gold chest armour over a dark teal suit

appearance_text: A warrior sealed inside shiny gold armour from head to toe, with a smooth gold helmet and no face showing. Big curved plates cover the chest, shoulders and knees, and dark teal cloth shows through at the neck, elbows and sides. The back carries the same shining gold plating.
identity_text: A warrior sealed head to toe in shining gold plate armour with a faceless helmet and dark teal cloth at the joints. No character is named; the title only describes the look.

hair: long brown hair falling to the shoulders

appearance_text: A tough looking character with long brown hair and glowing red eyes. They wear a green leather tunic with brown shoulder guards and a thick strap crossing the chest, fastened by a round metal buckle. More leather straps wrap around the green trousers, a pack is slung on the back, and heavy dark brown boots cover the feet.
identity_text: An unnamed woodland hunter in a green leather tunic with shoulder guards, buckled chest and leg straps and a pack slung on the back.

appearance_text: A player in full American football gear, with a navy blue helmet marked by a red stripe and a grey cage guarding the face. His navy jersey has padded shoulders and a big white number 10 on the chest and back. Grey trousers with a red and blue side stripe run down to black shoes with white stripes.
identity_text: An American football player in full pads and helmet, wearing the number 10 in the navy, red and grey colours of the team named in the listing. No individual player is named.

colors.item: night sky at the back of the head
colors.name: dark blue

face: sun and clouds where a face would be
head: sky head
yellow sun
white clouds
white moon at the back
top: green grass island across the chest

appearance_text: This character is a piece of the world walking about. Its head is a bright blue daytime sky with a yellow sun and white clouds on one side and a dark night sky with a white moon behind. Its chest and arms form a grassy island with little trees and a tiny hut, sitting on a thick brown layer of dirt. Below that the legs are grey stone with a dark cave mouth and a splash of red lava, ending in black rocky feet.
identity_text: The Minecraft Overworld built into a walking figure - daytime sky in front of the head and night sky behind, a grassy island with trees and a small hut for a chest, and cave-riddled stone legs.

hair: long blonde hair down the back
head: gold band in the hair

appearance_text: A woman with long blonde hair held back by a thin gold band, with green eyes and pink cheeks. She wears a flowing white gown that leaves her shoulders bare, edged and swirled with gold down the front and back. Gold bands circle her upper arms and the long white skirt falls to gold sandals.
identity_text: Aphrodite, the Greek goddess of love and beauty, shown as a blonde woman in a bare-shouldered white gown edged with gold, with gold arm bands and sandals.

face: open black mouth with a red tongue
head: white iced cake top with red berry spots
top: brown cake with white icing dripping over it

appearance_text: A walking cake with a white iced top dotted with little red berries, and a happy face with two small black eyes and an open mouth showing a red tongue. Its body and legs are brown sponge with thick white icing dripping down over the shoulders in points. The icing runs the same way all around the back.
identity_text: A walking cake with a happy face, its white iced top dotted with red berries above a brown sponge body with icing dripping over the shoulders.

accessories: red spiked saddle on the back
face: huge white eyes with black pupils
head: green dinosaur head
big white eyes on top
top: green chest with a white belly patch

appearance_text: A cheerful green dinosaur with a big rounded snout, huge white eyes sitting high on the head and a wide red mouth. A creamy white patch covers the belly, and a red shell with orange spikes rides on the back. The stubby green legs end in bright orange boots.
identity_text: A cheerful green cartoon dinosaur with a big rounded snout, huge eyes set high on the head and a red spiked saddle on its back, the rideable companion from Nintendo's long-running platform games.

accessories: orange scarf around the neck and hanging down the back
footwear: dark brown boots with cream tops

appearance_text: A girl with blonde hair down to her shoulders and blue grey eyes. A chunky orange scarf is wound round her neck and trails down her back, over a cream buttoned cardigan and a brown jacket worn open. Her skirt is cream and her dark brown boots have cream tops.
identity_text: A blonde girl bundled up for cold autumn weather in a brown jacket over a cream cardigan, a chunky orange scarf and a knitted beanie, with a cream skirt and brown boots. The title names the season and mood.

colors.item: hair on top of the head
colors.name: dark red

hair: dark red hair on top fading to long brown hair down the back
head: two small dark red animal ears

appearance_text: A girl with dark red hair on top that fades into long brown hair down her back, with two small pointed ears poking up. She wears a sage green jacket open over a white shirt with a red bow at the collar, and a light blue pleated skirt. Long white socks come up her legs above pale green shoes.
identity_text: A schoolgirl in a sage green jacket, white shirt with a red collar bow and a light blue pleated skirt, wearing a red beanie with little cat ears over long brown hair. 'Ava' is a personal name given to the skin, not a character who exists outside it.

hair: yellow plaits hanging under the helmet
head: silver helmet with white wings on the sides

appearance_text: A short warrior wearing a silver helmet with small white wings on each side, with yellow plaits hanging out beneath it and an enormous drooping yellow moustache covering his mouth. He wears a black sleeveless top that leaves his arms bare, a green belt with gold studs and bright red trousers tucked into brown boots. A sword is strapped across his back.
identity_text: Asterix, the small Gaulish warrior of the French comics, with his winged helmet, huge blond moustache, black sleeveless top and red trousers.

appearance_text: A character with a big brown dog head, floppy dark ears and a fluffy white muzzle with a black nose. A black band runs across the brow above two black eyes. It wears a bright red coat with white cuffs and a row of black buttons down the middle, and the red carries over the shoulders and down the back. Below that are black trousers and black boots with pale tops.
identity_text: An upright brown dog in a red kung-fu jacket with black knot fastenings, white cuffs and black boots. Not a named character.

bottom: black legs with glowing light blue cuffs
face: glowing light blue creeper face with two square eyes and an open mouth
head: dark head with a glowing creeper face
top: black body with glowing light blue chest ring

appearance_text: A dark figure whose head carries a bright glowing light blue monster face, two square eyes and a wide open mouth. The body is almost black with glowing light blue rings on the chest and back and glowing patches on the shoulders. Glowing bands wrap the wrists and the bottom of both legs.
identity_text: A creeper rendered in glowing neon style: an almost black body traced with light blue light, with the creeper's two square eyes and wide open mouth blazing on the head.

accessories: orange draped cloth down the back
bottom: long dark robe with an orange cord down the front

colors.item: trim and cords on the robe
colors.name: orange

face: blank mask split into pale and brown halves
head: dark hood
two-tone pale and brown mask

appearance_text: A tall figure hidden under a dark brown hood, its face covered by a blank mask split down the middle into a pale side and a brown side, with two black slits for eyes. It wears a long dark robe edged with glowing orange cords, orange bands around the arms and an orange cord hanging down the front. A long orange cloth trails down the back, and dark boots peek out at the bottom.
identity_text: An unnamed robed cultist: a hooded figure in a dark brown robe edged with glowing orange cords, its face hidden behind a blank two-tone mask.

face: dark blue mask around the eyes
head: brown animal head
small round ears
top: brown furry chest with a tan belly patch

appearance_text: A chunky brown furry animal with small round ears and a tan snout. A dark blue mask covers the top of its face around two big white eyes, and a red tongue flops out of its mouth. Its chest and tummy have a big tan patch, the rest of the body is brown fur, and its paws are dark brown.
identity_text: The animal avatar of the Minecraft YouTuber Callahan: a chunky brown antlered creature with a dark blue mask over its eyes, a red nose and a lolling tongue.

face: big orange eyes with black pupils
head: owl head
feather ear tufts
tan face
top: cream chest feathers with brown streaks

appearance_text: A round owl covered in soft brown feathers with two little feather tufts sticking up like ears. Its wide tan face holds two huge orange eyes with black pupils and a small dark hooked beak. The chest is pale cream with fine brown streaks, brown wings fold down the sides, and the back is all brown feathers. Thin yellow legs end in dark claws.
identity_text: A round brown bird of prey with huge golden eyes, a dark hooked beak, feather tufts on its head and a pale streaked chest.

top: white cardigan over a grey shirt

appearance_text: A girl with long wavy brown hair falling over her shoulders and big dark eyes. She wears a soft white cardigan over a grey top, with a short dark grey checked skirt. Her long socks are white with grey and black bands, and her shoes are white. Her hair hangs down her back in two thick strands.
identity_text: A girl with long wavy brown hair in a smart school uniform — a white cardigan over a grey top, a short checked skirt, long white socks and white shoes.

head: green hair with shaved sides
top: dark red and white striped shirt underneath

appearance_text: A boy with bright green hair cropped short on top and shaved down the sides, with dark eyes and pale skin. He wears an open grey-green jacket over a dark red shirt with thin white stripes across the chest. His jeans are faded grey-blue and he stomps around in chunky black boots.
identity_text: An unnamed teenage punk with bright green hair, wearing an open olive bomber jacket over a red and white striped shirt, faded grey-blue jeans and chunky black boots.

appearance_text: A girl with brown hair pulled back into a ponytail held by a purple band, with a short fringe over her eyes. She wears a green top over a white long sleeved shirt, with the white sleeves showing on her arms. Her shorts are pink and her legs are bare down to white socks and white shoes.
identity_text: Chihiro, the girl from the film Spirited Away, in her green and white top, pink shorts and purple hair tie.

colors.item: long blue-purple hair down the back and over both shoulders
colors.name: light blue

appearance_text: A girl with long blue hair streaked with purple that hangs all the way down her back, held off her face by a light blue band. She wears a dusty pink jacket with a pale blue scarf at the neck. Her trousers and tall boots are dark navy blue.
identity_text: An unnamed fantasy girl with very long blue hair streaked with purple, held back by a light blue band, in a dusty pink jacket and dark navy boots.

bottom: black legs with blue glowing streaks
head: black square head
top: black chest with a bright white and blue glowing core
blue lightning marks on the arms

appearance_text: A pitch black figure crackling with bright blue light. Its face is a pale blue pair of eye patches above a wide glowing white mouth, and a blazing white and blue ball of energy burns in the middle of its chest. Jagged blue and white streaks like lightning run down the arms, legs and back.
identity_text: Creeper, the Minecraft mob, in an electrified version: a pitch black figure with glowing blue eye patches and a wide white mouth, a burning blue-white core on its chest and lightning crackling down its limbs.

head: furry brown ears
brown furry head
top: red hooded top with a yellow A

appearance_text: A furry brown chipmunk standing on two legs, with round ears on top of its head, black eyes and two big white front teeth sticking out of a tan muzzle. It wears a bright red hooded top with a large yellow letter A on the chest, and the red hood bunches up at the back. Its arms and legs are covered in brown fur with no shoes.
identity_text: Alvin from Alvin and the Chipmunks, a brown chipmunk standing upright in his red hoodie with a big yellow A on the chest.

face: black breathing mask over the mouth
head: bald head
black mask straps

appearance_text: A huge bald man with a black mask strapped over his mouth and tubes running across his face. His arms are bare and very muscly, and he wears a loose olive green vest with laces at the neck. Dark blue jeans and brown boots finish the outfit.
identity_text: Bane, the masked Batman villain from The Dark Knight Rises: a huge bald man with a black breathing apparatus strapped over his mouth, in an olive green vest, dark blue jeans and brown boots.

appearance_text: A girl with long brown hair worn in two braids that hang all the way down her back, with a soft fringe over green eyes. She wears a loose white cardigan with puffy sleeves over a white top. Below that are light blue denim shorts and bare legs. Her feet are in dark red boots with a pale pink pattern and white socks folded over the tops.
identity_text: A summer-dressed girl wearing her long brown hair in two braids, in a pale puffy-sleeved cardigan, light denim shorts and dark red boots.

colors.item: hair at the back of the head
colors.name: brown

hair: brown hair around the sides and back
head: bald on top

appearance_text: An old man with a bald crown, brown hair around the sides of his head, a short white beard and bright blue eyes. He wears a long green robe with red trim down the front and around the sleeves, over a white undershirt, tied at the waist with a wide yellow sash and a small red pouch. The robe hangs to his knees over dark trousers and heavy dark grey boots, and the green and red trim continues down his back.
identity_text: An unnamed elderly trader in a long green robe with red and gold trim, tied with a wide yellow sash and a coin pouch over dark trousers and heavy boots.

appearance_text: A cat standing upright, covered in orange fur with darker orange tabby stripes down its arms, legs and back. Its tummy, muzzle and chest are creamy white, with round black eyes and a small dark red nose. Pointed orange ears sit on its head and each paw is tipped in white.
identity_text: A ginger tabby house cat standing on two legs, its orange fur banded with darker stripes over a creamy white front and white-tipped paws.

colors.item: badge and trim on the cap
colors.name: gold

head: black peaked captain's cap with gold trim

appearance_text: An officer in a black peaked cap with a gold badge and gold edging. The dark navy coat has two rows of shiny gold buttons down the front and gold stripes around the cuffs, worn over a cream waistcoat. The trousers are black with gold bands and the boots are plain black.
identity_text: A naval captain in full dress uniform, wearing a black peaked cap with gold badge and edging over a dark navy coat with two rows of gold buttons.

bottom: black shorts with white side stripes

colors.item: stripes down the sleeves and shorts
colors.name: white

head: spiky black hair
top: white sports top with a v neck

appearance_text: A light skinned boy with thick spiky black hair and bright blue eyes. He wears a plain white sports top with a v neck, and his sleeves are black with white stripes running down them. His shorts are black with white stripes on each side. Grey socks and white trainers finish the kit, and his back is plain white with the same striped sleeves.
identity_text: An unnamed boy in a football-style kit: white v-neck top, black striped sleeves and shorts, and white trainers.

head: dark red jester hood with pointed flaps

appearance_text: A tall figure with a blank chalk-white face and two narrow black slits for eyes, hidden under a dark red jester hood with pointed flaps hanging over the ears. It wears a dark red jacket with padded shoulders and small gold buttons in rows down the chest, dark red all around the back too. Below the waist a long dark grey robe hangs to the knees with gold trim at the hem, over dark grey boots.
identity_text: A medieval court jester in a dark red pointed hood and a blank white mask, wearing a gold-buttoned red jacket over a long grey robe. The title describes the costume, not a character.

head: fluffy white collar around the neck
top: puffy white and light blue winter coat

appearance_text: A girl with long light brown hair falling past her shoulders and dark eyes under a soft fringe. She is wrapped in a puffy white and light blue winter coat with a fluffy collar and a brown scarf tucked around her neck and trailing down her back. Her legs are in brown and white striped leggings and she wears white boots.
identity_text: A girl dressed for cold weather in a puffy white and pale blue coat with a fluffy collar, a dark scarf and striped stockings over white boots.

bottom: green grassy hill down the legs
head: old computer monitor head
screen showing green hills and blue sky
top: blue sky with white clouds across the chest

appearance_text: The whole body is painted like a photograph of a green grassy hill under a bright blue sky full of white clouds, with the clouds across the chest and the grass running down the legs. A small four coloured square logo sits on the chest. Instead of a face there is a chunky old beige computer monitor with the same hill and sky glowing on its screen.
identity_text: A monitor headed figure whose whole body is painted with the green hill and blue sky of the Windows XP desktop wallpaper, with the four colour flag logo on the chest. It personifies the operating system rather than being a named character.

hair: light blue hair under the helmet
head: white crash helmet
grey visor pushed up

appearance_text: A young driver in a white crash helmet with red stripes and a grey visor tipped up over pale blue hair. He wears a dark blue short sleeved shirt with white sleeves, a red scarf tied at his neck, and yellow gloves on his hands. His trousers are white and his boots are brown with a red band at the top. The back is plain white and dark blue with no printing.
identity_text: Speed Racer, the young racing driver from the Japanese manga and its film adaptations, in his white crash helmet, blue shirt and red scarf.

bottom: wide belt with a gold buckle
head: brown head wrap
brown hood

appearance_text: A big muscly fighter with a bare chest and brown cloth wrapped around his head, one eye hidden behind it. Leather straps cross his shoulders and a wide belt with a gold buckle holds up a shaggy brown fur kilt. Grey bands circle his arms and heavy brown fur boots cover his feet.
identity_text: A hulking bare-chested barbarian in a shaggy brown fur kilt with a wide gold-buckled belt, leather straps crossing his shoulders and brown cloth wrapped round his head.

head: icy blue head
top: icy blue body with frosty patches

appearance_text: A chunky monster made entirely of pale icy blue ice, with frosty lighter and darker patches all over its body. Its face has two dark eye holes and a wide open mouth picked out in white, like frozen glass. The arms hang flat at its sides and the legs are the same chunky ice, front and back.
identity_text: A creeper rendered entirely in mottled pale blue ice, with the classic creeper face picked out in frosty white. The listing calls it a frozen creeper from the snowy biomes.

accessories: red cloth at the back of the belt
head: olive green helmet
wide blue visor

appearance_text: A bulky fighter in olive green battle armour with big rounded shoulder plates. The helmet covers the whole head and has a wide glowing blue-green visor across the eyes. A grey plate sits in the middle of the chest with brown leather straps crossing over it, and a heavy brown belt is buckled at the waist with a red cloth hanging down behind. The armoured legs end in dark grey boots.
