head: small ears
tusks sticking out of the mouth

appearance_text: A shaggy pink boar-like beast covered in rough streaky fur from head to hoof. Two curved cream tusks curl up from the sides of its flat snout and tiny white eyes sit high on its blunt head. Its four legs end in solid black hooves and a short dark grey tail hangs at the back.
identity_text: A Hoglin, the boar-like hostile mob of Minecraft's Nether, shaggy pink with curved cream tusks and black hooves.

colors.item: grass on top of the head
colors.name: green

face: two big white eyes with black pupils
head: brown dirt head
green grass across the top

appearance_text: A figure made entirely of crumbly brown earth, speckled darker and lighter all over the body, arms and legs. A strip of bright green grass sits across the top of the head like a flat cap. Two big white eyes with black pupils and a small black mouth give it a startled look.
identity_text: A block of dirt with grass on top, walking around as a figure with two big startled eyes.

appearance_text: Someone with bright light blue hair sticking up on top and brown skin, with a red band running across their eyes. They wear a red checked shirt hanging open over a light blue top, with the checks carrying on across the back and sleeves. Blue jeans and light blue shoes finish the outfit.
identity_text: An unnamed teenage boy with bright turquoise hair, wearing an open red and orange plaid shirt over a teal top with a small chest motif.

head: long pale pink hair
soft cat ears
top: white top with a grey panel down the front

appearance_text: A very soft-looking girl with extremely long pale pink hair that reaches her knees, two matching furry ears on her head and dark purple eyes. She wears a white top with a grey panel down the front, tucked into a gently pleated purple skirt. Her legs are covered by long greyish purple socks.
identity_text: A pastel catgirl with very long pale pink hair and matching furry ears, in a white top, a soft purple skirt and long socks. The title names the colour scheme, not a character.

face: two big white eyes with black pupils
head: huge bulging eyes
wide open mouth
top: huge screaming mouth across the chest

appearance_text: A light blue creature covered in speckles, with two enormous white eyes bulging out on top of its head. A huge mouth ringed in red opens right across its chest, showing jagged white teeth and a dark throat. Its arms and legs are the same mottled light blue.
identity_text: A pale blue speckled cartoon monster with bulging white eyes and huge red lipped mouths on its head and chest, caught mid-scream. The title and description are a laser-firing catchphrase rather than a character name.

footwear: tall brown boots laced up the front
hair: long brown hair down the back
head: grey cat ears
long brown hair

appearance_text: A girl with long brown hair down to her waist and grey cat ears on top of her head, with big blue eyes. She wears an open blue denim jacket over a short cream top that leaves her middle bare, and dark denim shorts. Tall brown boots laced up the front come almost to her knees.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with grey cat ears and long brown hair, in an open denim jacket over a short cream top, denim shorts and tall laced brown boots.

bottom: dark purple onesie legs with orange pumpkins

colors.item: little pumpkins printed all over the onesie
colors.name: orange

head: brown hair
hood with small round ears
top: dark purple onesie with orange pumpkins

appearance_text: A child with brown hair falling over light blue eyes, dressed in a one-piece suit that covers the whole body. The suit is dark purple and printed all over with tiny orange pumpkins, front, back, arms and legs. The hood has two small round ears sticking up like a bear.
identity_text: A brown-haired child in a hooded one-piece onesie that covers the whole body, dark purple and printed all over with little orange pumpkins, with two small round ears on the hood.

appearance_text: A stocky tan man with short spiky black hair, a thick black moustache and a beard, and pale staring eyes. He wears a bright orange sleeveless vest with black straps, leaving his arms bare apart from black wraps around the wrists. His jeans are worn grey and his boots are brown.
identity_text: Salvador, the short, stocky gunfighter from Borderlands 2, in his orange sleeveless vest, wrist wraps and worn grey jeans.

colors.item: monster face on the back of the hoodie
colors.name: grey

hair: short orange hair with a fringe
head: orange hair
hood down at the back
top: grey monster face printed on the back

appearance_text: A boy with short orange hair and blue eyes. He wears an open light blue hoodie with the hood resting on his back, and a plain green shirt underneath. A grey monster face with square eyes is printed on the back of the hoodie. His trousers are dark blue and his white trainers have orange stripes.
identity_text: An unnamed orange-haired boy in an open light blue hoodie with a creeper face across the back, worn over a plain green shirt. The creeper is on the hoodie, not what he is.

footwear: long white socks with purple stripes
head: white animal ears with dark spots
top: light purple hoodie with white drawstrings

appearance_text: A pale girl with long straight white hair and two rounded white animal ears dotted with dark spots. She wears a baggy light purple hoodie with white drawstrings, and a matching spotted tail curls up the back of it. Her legs are bare down to long white socks with purple stripes at the top.
identity_text: An unnamed girl dressed as a white tiger, with spotted white ears, a matching tail on the back of her lavender hoodie and long striped socks.

head: white and orange mask covering the face

appearance_text: A hulking masked figure whose face is hidden behind a white mask marked with orange, leaving one pale eye showing. His chest is bare and heavily muscled with brown leather straps buckled across it and over his back, and one arm is wrapped in dirty cream bandages while the other is bare. Baggy orange trousers hang from a strapped belt down to heavy grey boots.
identity_text: Krieg, the Psycho class character from Borderlands 2, a masked bare-chested brute in leather strapping and baggy orange trousers.

appearance_text: A soft pastel character with fluffy pale blue hair that hides most of the face, leaving two gentle purple eyes peeking out. The top is white and pale blue with cloud-like puffs across the chest, back and sleeves. Pale blue trousers run down to small white shoes, and the whole outfit stays in the same misty blue and white.
identity_text: A soft pastel figure themed on clouds, with fluffy pale blue hair over the eyes and a white and blue outfit covered in cloud puffs.

head: short brown hair
top: black hoodie with a flame badge

appearance_text: A smiling boy with messy brown hair falling over reddish eyes. He wears a black hoodie with a curling orange and yellow flame badge across the chest, and the back of the hoodie is plain black. His jeans are dark grey and his shoes are black with pale soles.
identity_text: A brown-haired boy in a black hoodie carrying a YouTuber's flame badge — a fan in merch rather than the YouTuber himself.

appearance_text: A teenage boy with shaggy black hair that hangs over his face, and a red cloth tied across his eyes so you cannot see them. He wears a red jacket over a black shirt, with the jacket showing darker red panels down the back. His trousers are black with a white stripe across each knee, and his shoes are black.
identity_text: An unnamed teenage boy with shaggy black hair and a red cloth tied over his eyes, wearing a red jacket over a black shirt with black trousers.

hair: long brown hair with two little buns on top
subjects: girl in a striped tracksuit jacket
top: dark navy jacket with white stripes down the sleeves

appearance_text: A girl with long brown hair tied into two small buns on top of her head and big dark eyes. She wears an open dark navy tracksuit jacket with three white stripes down each sleeve over a short grey top that leaves her middle bare. Her black joggers have straps across the thighs and her trainers are white.
identity_text: An unnamed sporty girl in a striped tracksuit jacket over a grey crop top, with her hair in two flower-trimmed buns.

head: dark helmet
glowing blue visor
grey breathing grille
top: glowing blue lights on the chest

appearance_text: A soldier sealed inside a suit of dark navy armour with heavy shoulder plates. The helmet has a wide visor that glows bright blue across the eyes, with a grey grille over the mouth. Glowing blue strips run across the chest and down the legs, and a small lit panel sits on one arm. The boots and gauntlets match the rest of the dark armour.
identity_text: A soldier sealed inside dark navy powered armour with a wide glowing blue visor and lit strips down the body. The listing names no character or game.

head: blue wolf head with pointed ears

appearance_text: A standing wolf creature covered in blue and white fur, with pointed ears, a white muzzle and a small dark nose. Its chest, tummy, paws and lower legs are white while the head, arms and back stay icy blue. A long blue tail curls down the back and the fur is mottled like snow.
identity_text: A standing, human-shaped wolf creature covered in snowy blue and white fur, with pointed ears, a white muzzle and a long tail. The listing calls it a frosted humanoid wolf character without naming one.

appearance_text: A chunky grey scaly monster with a big reptile head, glowing orange eyes and a wide grin full of white teeth. Its chest and belly are a paler grey with soft ridges, and lumpy scales cover its arms, legs and back where a bumpy ridge runs down the spine. Its feet end in short white claws.
identity_text: Godzilla again, this time as a chunkier mossy grey-green lizard monster with glowing orange eyes and a wide toothy grin.

face: big white eyes with tiny black pupils
head: round pale green head

appearance_text: A shambling figure with pale green skin and a big round head, wide white eyes with tiny black pupils and a dark mouth showing a few crooked white teeth. It wears a tattered brown coat with a dark red necktie hanging down the front. Its trousers are worn blue jeans.
identity_text: The ordinary shambling zombie from the tower-defence game Plants vs. Zombies: a pale green cartoon zombie with a big round head, wide eyes and crooked teeth, in a tattered brown coat and red tie over worn jeans.

accessories: white sunglasses pushed up on the head
head: white sunglasses resting on the head

appearance_text: A pale character with short cream coloured hair sticking up in two little tufts, and a pair of white sunglasses pushed up on top of the head. They wear a plain white t-shirt with short sleeves and loose light blue shorts. Long light blue socks go up the legs into small white shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed pale character dressed for summer in a white t-shirt and loose light blue shorts, with cream hair in two little tufts and white sunglasses pushed up on the head.

accessories: blue cloak with a gold emblem on the back
bottom: blue and gold cloth over silver leg armour
face: dark eye slits in the helmet
head: silver helmet
small crest on top of the helmet
dark visor slits
top: blue and gold tabard hanging down the front

appearance_text: A warrior head to toe in polished silver plate armour, with a closed helmet showing only dark eye slits and a small crest on top. Over the chest plate hangs a deep blue tabard edged and patterned in gold, held by a brown leather belt at the waist. A matching blue cloth with a gold emblem covers the back. The legs are armoured in the same silver metal, ending in heavy steel boots.
identity_text: Oscar, Knight of Astora from Dark Souls, in full silver plate armour with a closed helm and a blue and gold tabard.

top: plain white t-shirt with short sleeves

appearance_text: A tan-skinned boy with thick fluffy dark brown hair that flops over his eyes. He wears a plain white short-sleeved t-shirt with nothing printed on it, front or back, leaving his arms bare. Light blue jeans and simple white shoes finish the everyday outfit.
identity_text: An unnamed tan-skinned boy in a plain white t-shirt with bare arms, light blue jeans and simple white shoes.

appearance_text: A grey-skinned figure with a big flat nose, a heavy dark brow and angry white eyes. It wears a dark grey jacket with two rows of round buttons down the front and a wide collar. Its trousers are teal and its boots are black, and the jacket buttons carry on across the back.
identity_text: A Vindicator, the grey-skinned illager raider added to Minecraft in the 1.11 update, in its buttoned dark coat and teal trousers.

head: blue sleep mask worn on the forehead
top: grey t-shirt with a white moon

appearance_text: A sleepy kid with dark brown hair and a blue sleep mask pushed up onto the forehead, eyes shut. The grey t-shirt has a white crescent moon on the chest. Soft light blue checked pyjama trousers reach down to white slippers.
identity_text: A sleepy boy ready for bed in a grey moon-print t-shirt, light blue checked pyjama trousers and white slippers, with a blue sleep mask pushed up on his forehead.

bottom: light blue jeans with pink flowers
hair: long brown hair down the back
head: furry brown animal ears

appearance_text: A girl with long brown hair and a pair of furry brown animal ears on top of her head, with big light blue eyes. She wears a cosy top striped in cream and brown, with the stripes carrying on down the sleeves and across the back. Light blue jeans dotted with small pink flowers reach down to short dark brown boots.
identity_text: An unnamed girl wearing furry brown animal ears, in a cosy cream and brown striped jumper with flower-dotted jeans and short boots.

face: dark empty face inside the hood
head: black hood with blue edges
top: black robe with glowing blue plates

appearance_text: A hooded figure in a black robe whose face is a dark empty space under the hood. Bright blue crystals and glowing lines run along the shoulders, chest, arms and knees, and a row of blue gems runs down the spine at the back. The boots are black with the same icy blue markings.
identity_text: A hooded magic user in a near-black robe studded with glowing ice-blue crystals, the face lost in shadow under the hood. The listing describes a hooded mage in ice robes and names no character.

top: big red s letter on the chest

appearance_text: A boy with brown hair and brown eyes wearing a bright red jacket left open over a white shirt. A large red letter S is printed in the middle of the shirt. His black jeans have rips torn across the knees and thighs, and his shoes are red with white soles.
identity_text: A teenage boy in a bright red open jacket over a white shirt marked with a big red S, with ripped black jeans and red trainers.

head: pale blue skull head
top: black galaxy hoodie with a blue skull

appearance_text: A figure with a pale blue skull for a head, its dark eye sockets and teeth showing clearly. It wears a black hoodie clouded with purple and pink like the night sky, with a glowing light blue skull on the chest and another on the back. The trousers are black with faint purple clouds and the shoes are white.
identity_text: A skeletal figure with a pale blue skull for a head, wearing a black galaxy hoodie whose glowing blue skull print matches its own face. The listing describes it without naming a character.

colors.item: patches on the head and body
colors.name: orange

appearance_text: A fluffy white cat standing on two legs, with orange patches on its head, arms and back and pointed orange-and-white ears. Its face has big blue-green eyes, a tiny pink nose and pink cheeks. A teal collar with round beads hangs around its neck. Its hands and feet end in little orange paws, and orange stripes run down its back and arms.
identity_text: A cartoon house cat standing upright, white with orange patches and a teal beaded collar.

colors.item: sky covering the head and chest
colors.name: blue

face: no face, just sky and clouds
head: blue sky with clouds instead of a face

appearance_text: A figure with no face or clothes at all, painted instead with a landscape. The head and upper body are a bright blue sky streaked with soft white clouds, and the lower body and legs are a rolling field of green grass. The same sky and grass wrap right around the back and sides so the picture never breaks.
identity_text: A faceless figure painted all over with a computer desktop wallpaper: clouded blue sky on the head and body, a rolling green field on the legs, wrapping unbroken around the back.

head: lumpy green blob head
top: lumpy green slime covering the head, shoulders and arms

appearance_text: A faceless creature whose head, shoulders and arms are a lumpy mass of green goo in many shades, with darker blotches where it clumps together. It has no eyes or mouth at all. Below the dripping green edges the body and legs are a dark shadowy purple.
identity_text: An unnamed faceless creature whose head and arms are swallowed by a lumpy mass of green goo, with a shadowy dark purple body and legs below.

head: frilly pink gills on both sides of the head
top: pink body with darker pink lines

appearance_text: A soft pink creature standing on two legs, with a wide flat head and frilly pink gills sticking out on both sides. Its face has two tiny dark purple eyes and a small smiling mouth. Darker pink lines run down its chest and back, its feet are darker pink, and a flat tail hangs behind it.
identity_text: The soft pink aquatic passive mob added to Minecraft in the Caves & Cliffs update, shown standing on two legs with frilly gills either side of its head, tiny dark eyes and a flat tail.

colors.item: splatters on the apron and shirt
colors.name: red

head: pale mask over the whole face
short black hair on top

appearance_text: A big man whose whole face is hidden behind a pale stitched mask with two dark eye holes and pink lips, with short black hair on top. He wears a purple shirt with a dark blue tie and a grubby yellow apron over it, both spattered with red marks. His trousers are dark brown and his boots are black.
identity_text: Leatherface, the masked villain of the 1974 film The Texas Chainsaw Massacre, in his stitched pale mask, purple shirt and tie, and a blood-spattered yellow butcher's apron.

head: red santa hat with a white trim
top: cream christmas sweater with a snowflake band

appearance_text: A bearded man in a floppy red hat with a white fur trim and a white bobble hanging down the back. He wears a cream winter sweater with a wide dark blue band of snowflakes across the chest, back and sleeves. Blue jeans and grey shoes finish the outfit.
identity_text: Steve, the default Minecraft character, dressed for Christmas in a snowflake jumper and a red Santa hat.

colors.item: steel armour on the shoulders and arms
colors.name: grey

face: dark eye slits in the helmet
head: closed steel helmet

appearance_text: A warrior covered head to toe in grey steel armour, with a closed helmet that shows only two dark eye slits. Over the chest plate sits a deep red tabard with a small gold pendant hanging at the collar, and a long red cape falls down the whole back. The arms and legs are wrapped in matching metal plates over black cloth, ending in heavy armoured boots.
identity_text: An unnamed holy warrior in full grey plate armour with a closed helm, a deep red tabard and a long red cape.

appearance_text: A boxy brown furry creature with no clothes, brown all over from head to feet. Its head has two tiny black eyes and an enormous wide-open red mouth filled with big square white teeth. A stripe of rainbow colours pours out of the mouth and runs down the front of its chest. The arms, legs and back are plain brown fur.
identity_text: Domo, the boxy brown Japanese TV mascot, mouth wide open with a rainbow spilling down his chest.

appearance_text: A young man with short dark brown hair and blue eyes, his mouth stretched wide open in a huge grin that shows a row of teeth and the dark red inside of his mouth. He wears a plain blue t-shirt with short sleeves and bare arms. His trousers are grey and his shoes are black.
identity_text: An unnamed boy in a plain blue t-shirt and dark grey jeans, drawn with his mouth stretched wide open as if yelling or about to eat. The title describes that pose rather than naming a character.

face: screen showing bright rainbow colour bars
head: dark grey television head
orange hood pulled up round the back
top: orange hoodie with a pouch pocket and white drawstrings

appearance_text: This character has an old dark grey television for a head, its screen showing bright bars of colour. It wears a bright orange hoodie with a front pouch pocket, white drawstrings and the hood bunched up behind the television. Below that are pale light blue jeans and white trainers with orange trim.
identity_text: A figure with an old dark grey television for a head, its screen showing bright bars of colour. It is dressed in streetwear: a bright orange hoodie with the hood bunched behind the set, pale blue jeans and white trainers.

appearance_text: A boy with short dark brown hair and dark green eyes. He wears a green hoodie with white drawstrings hanging at the neck and white lower sleeves, and the hood sits down on his back. His trousers are dark grey and his shoes are green with white edges.
identity_text: An unnamed boy in a green hoodie with white lower sleeves, worn with the hood up over dark brown hair, dark grey jeans and green trainers.

head: dried tan head with dark hair
top: bare dried chest with ribs showing

appearance_text: A shrivelled undead figure with dry tan skin, dark hair and sunken dark eyes above a grim straight mouth. Its chest and back are bare, with a pale ribcage showing through the withered skin. Only torn dark brown trousers remain, hanging in tatters down its legs.
identity_text: A dried-out zombie with its ribcage showing through withered tan skin, wearing a brown leather cap and torn matching trousers, and barefoot.

footwear: black thigh high stockings with straps
hair: long brown hair with a braid over the shoulder
head: white and green flower crown
top: white blouse with a row of black buttons
black bands around the upper arms

appearance_text: A light skinned girl with long brown hair, one side braided over her shoulder, crowned with small white and green flowers and tied at the back with a black bow. She wears a white blouse fastened with a row of black buttons, with black bands around her upper arms. A short black skirt sits at her waist and black stockings run up her thighs with thin straps.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in a white blouse with a row of black buttons, a short black skirt and black thigh-high stockings, her braided brown hair crowned with small white and green flowers.

head: blue headband tied around the forehead
brown hair
top: light blue jacket with a pale blue circle on the back

appearance_text: A boy with brown hair and a blue band tied around his forehead, with purple eyes. He wears a light blue jacket with white sleeves, and a large pale blue circle is printed across the back of it. His trousers are black and his shoes are white with blue soles.
identity_text: An unnamed boy wearing a blue band tied around his forehead and a light blue jacket with white sleeves and a big pale circle on the back.

appearance_text: A cat covered head to toe in purple fur with wavy pink stripes running across it. Its round head has dark red pointed ears, huge yellow eyes and an enormous grin stretching across a pink muzzle, packed with white teeth. A long striped tail curls up the back and its paws are dark.
identity_text: The Cheshire Cat from Alice in Wonderland, a purple cat covered in wavy pink stripes with an enormous toothy grin.

colors.item: long hair falling forward over the shoulders (no scarf present)
colors.name: brown

appearance_text: A boy with messy dark brown hair and teal eyes. He wears a mustard yellow jacket hanging open over a dark grey shirt, with a brown scarf wrapped around his neck. Grey trousers and scuffed brown boots finish the look, and the back of the jacket is solid yellow.
identity_text: An unnamed boy dressed for cold weather in an open mustard-yellow jacket over a dark grey shirt, with a brown scarf and grey trousers. The title names the garment he is wearing, not a character.

appearance_text: A man in a flat brown cap with short brown hair and an open mouth. He wears a plain white shirt with a heavy brown leather apron strapped over it, front and back. The trousers and boots are dark brown and worn-looking.
identity_text: An unnamed workman from the Broadway musical Hadestown, in a flat cap and a heavy patterned leather apron over a pale shirt, with dark brown trousers and boots.

head: purple hair down to the shoulders

appearance_text: A girl with purple hair that falls just past her shoulders and big blue eyes. She wears a blue denim jacket hanging open over a plain white top, with light blue shorts. Her legs and feet are bare.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with purple hair just past her shoulders, in an open blue denim jacket, a white top and light blue shorts.

appearance_text: A pale boy with messy dark brown hair falling over black eyes and a little pink blush on his cheeks. He wears a dark grey jacket open over a plain grey shirt, and across the back of the jacket sits a faint darker face with square eyes and a frowning mouth. His trousers are black and his shoes are black with white toes.
identity_text: A boy with messy dark hair in a dark grey jacket over a grey shirt, with a faint creeper face printed across the back.

face: glowing white eyes with yellow marks underneath
head: smooth pale purple head with a dark blue band across the face

appearance_text: A floating figure made of pale purple and white swirling air, with wisps of wind curling all over its body and arms. Its head is smooth pale purple with a dark blue band across the lower face and two glowing white eyes with small yellow marks beneath them. There is no clothing at all, just streams of pale wind running down its legs and around its back.
identity_text: The Breeze, the floating wind mob added to Minecraft in the Tricky Trials update, a body of pale purple air trailing white swirls with no clothing at all.

hair: short purple hair with lighter streaks
head: hood down over the back of the head
top: dark blue hoodie with a moon and stars

appearance_text: A pale girl with short purple hair streaked in lighter lilac and dark blue eyes. She wears a big dark blue hoodie with the hood down, printed with a pale crescent moon on the chest and scattered white stars over both sleeves and the back. Her jeans are black with rips at the knees, and her shoes are white.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with short purple hair in a night sky hoodie, a crescent moon across the chest and scattered stars, worn with ripped black jeans.

hair: black hair tied at the back

appearance_text: A tan skinned girl with short black hair tied back and pink eyes. She wears a dark grey sleeveless top that leaves her arms bare, and baggy orange trousers held high on the waist. Her boots are dark grey.
identity_text: Maki Oze from the Japanese manga and anime Fire Force, with short dark hair tied back, a dark grey sleeveless top and baggy orange firefighting trousers over dark boots.

face: two black eyes on pale green stalks
head: red crab head
eyes on stalks

appearance_text: A red crab-like character with a wide red head, a big mouth, and two black eyes sitting on pale green stalks. The arms are thick and red like claws, and the body wears a light blue shirt with a purple front. The legs are blue and the feet are red.
identity_text: Mr Krabs, the greedy red crab who runs the burger restaurant in SpongeBob SquarePants, with his eyes on stalks, claw arms and light blue shirt.

appearance_text: A man with short orange hair and a trimmed orange beard, with teal eyes. He wears a pale blue-white buttoned coat with a light collar over matching pale blue trousers. His shoes are brown and his coat looks the same plain pale blue from behind.
identity_text: Vincent Van Gogh, the Dutch painter named in the listing, shown as a ginger-haired, ginger-bearded man in a pale blue suit.

head: long pointed ears with black tips

appearance_text: A round yellow creature covered in soft fur, with two long pointed ears whose tips are dipped in black. Its face has shiny black eyes, a tiny mouth and two big round red circles on its cheeks. Brown stripes run across the top of its back and a brown zigzag tail is drawn there too. Its short arms and legs are the same bright yellow.
identity_text: Pikachu, the yellow electric mouse Pokemon, with black-tipped ears, round red cheek patches and its zigzag tail drawn on the back.

accessories: brown belt with a square buckle
head: grey head with a big nose

appearance_text: A grey-skinned raider with an enormous flat nose, tiny green eyes buried under a heavy dark unibrow and a sour downturned mouth. He wears a dark red checked shirt beneath a dark grey waistcoat with grey pads over his shoulders, and the checks carry on across his back. A brown belt with a square buckle is strapped round his middle, above dark teal trousers and scuffed brown boots.
identity_text: A Pillager, the grey-skinned crossbow-carrying illager mob from Minecraft, in its checked shirt, grey waistcoat and brown boots.

top: dark grey t-shirt with a white skull print

appearance_text: A fair-skinned boy with shaggy light brown hair over blue eyes. He wears a dark grey t-shirt with a white skull printed in the middle of the chest, layered over a white long sleeve shirt. His trousers are baggy olive green cargos and his shoes are grey.
identity_text: An unnamed boy in a dark grey skull-print t-shirt layered over a white long-sleeve top, with baggy camouflage cargo trousers.

colors.item: long plum skirt over a bare creeper-patterned chest
colors.name: dark purple

appearance_text: A slim creature with purple skin and long pink-purple hair that hangs down over its face and all the way down its back. Its eyes are big and glowing pink and it has a small dark mouth beneath them. It wears a plain dark purple dress and pale purple shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed purple-pink figure with long hair falling over her face and big glowing pink eyes, wearing a dark plum dress with a creeper face across the chest.

head: two dark bows on top of the head

appearance_text: A girl with long pink hair falling down her back, with dark navy strands hanging beside her face and two dark bows perched on top of her head. Her eyes are bright blue. She wears a dark navy jacket with white stripes around the sleeves over a white top, a white belt at the waist, and dark navy leggings and boots.
identity_text: A shaded version of the Minecraft YouTuber LDShadowLady's skin: long pink hair with navy front strands, a navy jacket with white striped sleeves, a white belt and navy legwear.

head: long wavy hair
flower tucked in the hair
top: blue denim dungarees with a bib

appearance_text: A tanned girl with long wavy red hair falling down her back and bright green eyes. A small pink flower is tucked into the hair at the back. She wears blue denim dungarees cut short, with the bib over her chest and her shoulders and arms bare. Short white socks show above chunky brown boots.
identity_text: A country girl in denim dungaree shorts over a yellow checked shirt, with flowers in her long auburn hair and chunky boots.

colors.item: trim on the chest and arms
colors.name: orange

appearance_text: A warrior sealed inside shining light blue armour from head to toe. The helmet has a narrow black T-shaped slit where the face would be, so nothing of the head shows. Bands of orange run across the chest plate and around the upper arms, and the legs end in dark blue armoured boots.
identity_text: A warrior sealed head to toe in crystal-blue plate armour trimmed with gold-orange, his face completely hidden behind a T-shaped visor slit. Descriptive title, no character named.

appearance_text: A boy with messy fluffy brown hair that flops over his forehead and blue eyes underneath. He wears a plain white short sleeved t-shirt with bare arms below the sleeves. His trousers are light blue jeans and his shoes are white sneakers.
identity_text: An unnamed boy with fluffy brown hair in a plain white t-shirt, light blue jeans and white sneakers.

face: two glowing orange eyes with dark streaks
head: square white head with grey patches
top: round hole in the chest with orange fire burning inside

appearance_text: A pale white blocky creature with a square head, glowing orange eyes streaked with dark marks and a small dark mouth. A round hole burns in the middle of its chest with bright orange fire inside. Long white tentacles hang down where its legs would be, and its back is a smooth pale white shell.
identity_text: A demonic take on the Ghast, the pale Nether mob, with fire burning through a hole in its chest and glowing orange eyes. White tentacles hang beneath it instead of legs.

accessories: dark blue wolf tail on the back
bottom: bare legs under the long hoodie
footwear: light blue boots with white cuffs
head: pale blue hair
blue grey wolf ears with white insides

appearance_text: A girl with short pale blue hair and two furry blue grey wolf ears with white insides standing up on her head. Her eyes are bright blue. She wears a baggy light blue hoodie with white trim that hangs long over her bare legs, and a dark blue furry tail curls on the back of it. Her boots are light blue with white cuffs.
identity_text: A child with pale blue hair, furry wolf ears and a wolf tail, wearing an oversized light blue hoodie with white trim and matching boots.

face: one huge blue eye with a black pupil
head: giant eyeball for a head
red veins on the back of the head

appearance_text: A person-shaped creature whose whole head is one enormous eyeball, white and blue with a big black pupil staring forward. Around the back of that head the eyeball turns red and stringy with veins. The body below is bare tan skin with no shirt, and the only clothing is a pair of dark grey shorts. The legs and feet are bare.
identity_text: An unnamed monster whose whole head is a single enormous eyeball, blue and white at the front and raw red at the back. Its body is bare tan skin with nothing on but dark grey shorts.

face: green face hidden behind the mask
head: dark grey welding mask with a black slit
top: light blue shirt with rolled sleeves

appearance_text: A green-skinned undead figure with a big dark grey welding mask pulled over its head, showing only a black viewing slit. It wears a light blue shirt with the sleeves pushed up over green arms, and thick black gloves on its hands. Blue trousers and grey shoes finish the outfit, and the back of the mask and shirt are plain.
identity_text: A green-skinned zombie kitted out as a welder, its face hidden behind a dark grey welding mask, in a light blue work shirt and thick black gloves.

accessories: glowing green orbs in the hands

colors.item: hair on top of the head
colors.name: dark green

face: one green eye and one blue eye
head: dark green hair covering the top of the head
top: dark green robe with a high collar

appearance_text: A pale skinned figure with long white hair and dark green hair over the top of the head, with one green eye and one blue eye. A dark green robe with a high collar hangs down the back like a long cloak, over black sleeves and black leggings with grey patches. Gold bands circle the arms and a gold belt sits at the waist. Small glowing green lights float around both hands and the boots are black with gold buckles.
identity_text: An unnamed young spellcaster with pale hair and mismatched eyes, in a dark green high-collared robe trimmed with gold, holding glowing green magic in both hands.

appearance_text: A pale girl with long light brown hair falling in waves down her back, and two different coloured eyes, one dark green and one blue. She wears short light green dungarees over a white short sleeved shirt, with a little pink bow at the neck. Her legs are bare above long pink and white socks and black shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in spring clothes: light green dungaree shorts over a short-sleeved white shirt with a little pink bow, bare legs above long pink and white socks. Her eyes are mismatched, one green and one blue.

head: dark purple cap
light pink purple hair falling over the face
top: purple hoodie with a high collar pulled up over the mouth

appearance_text: A shy-looking kid in a dark purple cap, with light pink-purple hair hanging down over the eyes so only blushed cheeks show. The purple hoodie has a tall collar pulled right up over the mouth and long sleeves that hang past the hands. Below are short black shorts, dark purple socks and clean white shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed kid hiding inside a purple hoodie with the collar pulled up over the mouth, wearing a dark cap with two small pointed ears, black shorts, purple socks and white shoes.

appearance_text: A man with dark brown hair and blue eyes pulling a huge grin that shows a row of white teeth. He wears a teal short-sleeved t-shirt with bare tan arms, and purple-blue trousers. Grey shoes cover the feet, and the shirt and trousers are plain across the back.
identity_text: Minecraft's Steve pulling an enormous toothy grin, in the classic teal shirt and purple-blue trousers, from CaptainSparklez's song Revenge.

head: small white and green flowers on top of the head
two little hair buns

appearance_text: A girl with long brown hair worn in a thick braid over one shoulder, with a few tiny white and green flowers tucked on top of her head. She wears a light blue checkered shirt open over a white top, with short black shorts underneath. Her legs are bare down to short black socks and black and white shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with a long brown braid and a small daisy crown, in a light blue checked shirt over a white top with black shorts and black and white shoes.

face: dark shadowed face behind the helmet
head: dark red helmet with grey edges
spiked sides on the helmet

appearance_text: A figure covered head to toe in heavy plate armour coloured dark red with grey edges and worn metal patches. The helmet wraps right around the head with small spikes at the sides and only a black shadow where the face should be. Chunky grey shoulder plates sit above the red chest and the legs end in grey armoured boots.
identity_text: A figure sealed head to toe in dark red and grey plate armour, with a spiked helmet and nothing but shadow where the face should be. The title names the armour, not a character.

colors.item: icing swirls on the arms and legs
colors.name: white

head: square golden gingerbread head
top: pink bow tie at the neck
white icing swirls on the arms

appearance_text: A round friendly character the warm golden colour of a fresh baked biscuit, with two big white eyes taking up most of its face and a tiny white mouth below them. A bright pink bow tie sits at its neck and two little sweets, one green and one blue, are stuck to its chest. Curls of white icing decorate its arms and legs, and its feet look dipped in white icing.
identity_text: A slime dressed up as a gingerbread man: a golden biscuit-coloured figure with two huge pale eyes and a tiny mouth, a pink bow tie, candy buttons on its chest and icing swirls down its arms and legs.

colors.item: patches on the face and ears
colors.name: dark brown

head: cream cat head with brown patches
pointy cat ears
top: light grey pinafore over a white dress

appearance_text: A girl wearing a cream cat head with pointy ears, brown and dark patches, pink cheeks and a tiny nose. Long light brown hair spills out from under it and hangs down past her waist at the back. She wears a light grey pinafore over a short white dress with puffy sleeves, plus long white socks and small grey shoes.
identity_text: A girl wearing a cream cat head hood patched with brown, with long light brown hair spilling out beneath it, a light grey pinafore over a short white dress, long white socks and small grey shoes.

accessories: quiver of arrows on the back
hair: brown hair in a side braid

appearance_text: A pale girl with brown hair pulled into a thick braid that falls over one shoulder, and light blue eyes. She wears a worn tan hunting jacket, open at the front over a black shirt, with a strap crossing her back that holds a bundle of arrows with black and white flights. A dark grey skirt sits over tan trousers, and brown boots with grey wraps cover her lower legs.
identity_text: Katniss Everdeen from the first Hunger Games film, a girl in a worn tan hunting jacket with a thick side braid and a quiver of arrows across her back.

appearance_text: A soft light blue bear standing on two legs, with round ears that have white insides. Its face has tiny black eyes, a white muzzle and a small black nose. A little white patch sits on its chest, and the pale blue fur covers the rest of its body, arms and legs.
identity_text: Wallibear, the Minecraft content creator and streamer named in the listing, drawn as a soft pale blue bear standing on two legs with a white logo patch on its chest.

bottom: black trousers with white stripes down the sides
head: black hair
white headband tied at the back
top: white t-shirt with an orange flame

appearance_text: A tan boy with messy black hair held back by a white headband that ties at the back, and bright blue eyes. He wears a white t-shirt with a small orange flame on the chest over black long sleeves. His black trousers have white stripes down the sides and his shoes are black and white checkerboard.
identity_text: Sapnap, the Minecraft YouTuber and streamer, in his usual white headband and white flame t-shirt over black sleeves.

bottom: white thigh socks with red stripes
hair: two small pointed tufts on top
subjects: girl in a red pinafore dress
top: white blouse with puffy sleeves under a red pinafore

appearance_text: A girl with long light brown hair and big green eyes, with two small pointed tufts standing up on top of her head. She wears a white blouse with puffy sleeves under a red pinafore dress tied with a red ribbon at the neck, and the red carries down the back too. Her skirt is white, her long socks reach her thighs with red stripes at the top, and her shoes are dark brown.
identity_text: A girl in a red pinafore dress over a white blouse, tied with a red ribbon at the neck, with long white socks and dark brown shoes.

appearance_text: A young person with short fluffy pink hair topped by a little gold crown, blue eyes and pink blushing cheeks. They wear a plain yellow jumper with a small white patch on the chest, dark blue jeans and dark brown boots.
identity_text: A young person with short fluffy pink hair topped by a small gold crown, wearing a plain yellow jumper with a white patch, dark navy trousers and dark brown boots.

bottom: dark purple trousers with orange streaks

colors.item: flames on top of the head
colors.name: orange

colors.item: glowing lava cracks on the body
colors.name: orange

head: small orange flames on top of the head
top: dark purple top with glowing orange cracks

appearance_text: A girl whose dark purple hair has little orange flames burning at the top of it, over a pale pink face with pale pink eyes. Her clothes are dark purple and split all over by glowing orange cracks, as if lava were shining through from inside. Her arms glow bright orange and the same cracks run down her legs and across her back.
identity_text: A girl who looks made of cooling lava: dark purple hair and clothes split by glowing orange, with little flames on her head and orange light down her arms and legs. Nothing names a character; magma is the theme.

appearance_text: A pale boy with bright yellow blond hair swept over his forehead and big blue eyes with blushing cheeks. He wears a black zip hoodie with light blue drawstrings and a white shirt showing down the middle, and the hood hangs behind his head. His trousers are black and he has white trainers.
identity_text: An anime-styled blond boy in a black zip hoodie over a white shirt, with black trousers and white trainers. The title only describes his golden hair, so no character is named.

hair: darker navy hair at the back of the head
top: brown short sleeved shirt with red bands at the cuffs

appearance_text: A young man with short brown hair that turns dark navy round the back of his head, with narrow dark eyes and pale tan skin. He wears a plain brown short sleeved shirt, the same brown across the back, with red bands wrapped round both wrists. Faded blue jeans and white shoes finish the outfit.
identity_text: An unnamed boy in a dark blue knitted beanie, a plain brown t-shirt and faded blue jeans. The title is a bare first name and the listing only describes the outfit, so no character is identified.

appearance_text: A bright yellow-skinned man with spiky yellow hair, huge pale glasses hiding his eyes and big front teeth. He wears a long white lab coat with a blue bow tie at the collar and a pink apron showing below the coat. His trousers are white and his shoes are black.
identity_text: Professor Frink from The Simpsons, the yellow-skinned scientist in a white lab coat, oversized glasses and a blue bow tie.

head: long ginger hair
top: mint green top with little bees

appearance_text: A girl with long ginger hair and big pale blue eyes. Her mint green top has little yellow and black bees dotted across it, and more bees drift around her hair at the back. She wears blue jeans and mint green shoes.
identity_text: A ginger-haired girl dressed for a bee theme, wearing a pale blue flower crown with bees drifting around it, a mint top scattered with bees, and blue jeans.

footwear: grey boots with light blue tops
hair: spiky gold hair at the front
head: spiky hair
no helmet

appearance_text: A young fighter with tan skin and spiky hair, gold at the front and black at the back, wearing no helmet. His chest is protected by white and grey plates with big gold pads capping both shoulders and gold bands around the upper arms. Light blue cuffs sit at his wrists, and dark grey leg armour with gold plates at the waist runs down to grey boots with light blue tops.
identity_text: An unnamed young fighter with spiky gold and black hair, bare-headed, in white and grey armour with gold shoulder pads and pale blue trim.

colors.item: square lens on the eye patch
colors.name: red

face: red square lens over the other eye
head: grey metal plate over one side of the face
top: red gem in the middle of the chest

appearance_text: A boy with brown hair whose right side of the face is covered by a grey metal plate holding a glowing red square lens, leaving one blue eye showing. He wears a dark blue armoured vest with grey shoulder plates and a red gem set in the middle of the chest, with a red stripe running down the back. His trousers are dark grey and his boots grey.
identity_text: A brown-haired boy with half his face behind a grey metal plate holding a glowing red lens, wearing a dark blue armoured vest set with a red gem. 'Redstoner' describes what he does rather than naming him.

appearance_text: A muscly man with shoulder-length brown hair and a thick brown beard and moustache. He wears a blue denim vest with no sleeves, left open so his bare chest and strong arms show, and the same denim covers his back. His jeans are blue and held up by a black belt with a gold buckle, and he has dark brown boots.
identity_text: Chuck Norris, the American martial artist and actor, shown as a muscular bearded man in an open sleeveless denim vest, blue jeans and brown boots.

appearance_text: A very pale girl with long white hair falling down her back, crowned with pointed light blue crystals like ice. Her outfit is made of the same glassy pale blue crystal: a small chest piece, a short skirt and matching bands around her upper arms, leaving her shoulders, middle and legs bare. Dark grey trim edges each crystal piece, and the crown spreads wide behind her head.
identity_text: An unnamed ice- or frost-themed girl wearing a glassy turquoise chest piece, armbands and hip band with bare shoulders and legs, crowned in pale blue. Nothing in the listing names a character.

appearance_text: A big orange dragon standing on two legs, with a pale cream belly plate running down its front. Its head has a blunt snout, a wide mouth full of white teeth and bright teal eyes, with two short cream horns pointing back. Large blue green wings edged in red are folded against its back, and it stands on orange feet with white claws.
identity_text: A large orange dragon standing on two legs, with a cream belly plate, a wide fanged mouth, teal eyes and blue green wings edged in red folded against its back. The listing calls it a dual-type fire and flying starter Pokemon and the final form of Charmander.

bottom: tan leg armour with dark red stripes
head: tan helmet
dark red face mask
top: tan chest armour with dark red bands

appearance_text: A broad warrior clad head to toe in tan plating that looks like bone. A dark red mask covers the face, showing only two black eye slits and a pair of white fangs at the mouth. Dark red bands run across the chest and down the arms and legs, and long stripes of the same colour stretch down the back. Straps hold the plates together at the waist.
identity_text: An unnamed broad warrior encased head to toe in tan plating that looks like bone, his face hidden behind a dark red mask showing only black eye slits and white fangs.

bottom: dark navy trousers with pale blue patches
hair: pale blue hair falling over the face
head: dark navy snapback cap
top: dark navy hoodie with a hood
icy blue flecks on the sleeves

appearance_text: A pale figure with light blue hair that sweeps down over the eyes, wearing a dark navy cap with a flat brim. The hoodie is dark navy with icy pale blue flecks scattered down the sleeves and around the cuffs. Matching dark trousers have the same frosty patches, and the shoes are white with pale blue trim.
identity_text: A boy in a dark navy cap and a matching navy hoodie speckled with icy blue, with pale blue hair sweeping over his eyes. The title describes the outfit.

hair: long dark brown hair down to the shoulders
subjects: long haired man in a black suit
top: black suit jacket over a white shirt with a black tie

appearance_text: A pale man with long dark brown hair swept back to his shoulders and a full dark beard and moustache. He wears an all black suit jacket over a white shirt with a thin black tie, and the jacket is plain black across the shoulders and back with his hair falling over it. Black trousers and black shoes complete the head to toe dark outfit.
identity_text: John Wick, the hitman played by Keanu Reeves, in his all black suit with a white shirt and thin black tie.

appearance_text: A shaggy monster covered head to toe in dark blue fur. Two big white googly eyes with tiny black dots sit high on its head, and a huge open black mouth stretches across the rest of its face. The fur is bumpy and uneven all the way down the arms, back and legs, with no clothes at all.
identity_text: Cookie Monster, the shaggy blue Muppet from Sesame Street, with his big googly eyes and huge open mouth.

colors.item: patch on the back of the head
colors.name: red

head: red and black patch at the back of the head

appearance_text: A man with shaggy blonde hair and light stubble, with a small red and black patch on the back of his head. He wears a baggy white hoodie with big rainbow-coloured letters printed across the chest and the hood hanging down his back. His trousers are black and his shoes are white with dark soles.
identity_text: PewDiePie in his white LWIAY merchandise hoodie with rainbow lettering and a gaming headset, worn with black trousers and white shoes.

appearance_text: A light-skinned boy with short brown hair swept across his forehead and warm brown eyes. He wears a soft white knitted sweater with a faint pattern in the wool, covering him to the wrists. Plain grey trousers and grey shoes go with it, and the sweater is the same white across the back.
identity_text: An unnamed light-skinned boy with short brown hair, in a plain white knitted sweater with grey trousers and grey shoes.

appearance_text: A boy with messy short black hair hanging over his forehead and bright blue eyes. He wears a plain blue hoodie with the hood resting down on his back and long sleeves to the wrist. Below that he has dark blue jeans and black sneakers with white soles.
identity_text: A boy with messy black hair in a plain bright blue hoodie with the hood down, dark blue jeans and black and white trainers.

head: messy brown hair
top: open light blue shirt with pink and green flowers

appearance_text: This boy has short messy brown hair and light skin. He wears an open light blue shirt covered in pink and green flowers, with a plain white vest showing underneath. Below that are tan shorts, and his legs and feet are bare. The flower pattern carries all the way round the back of the shirt.
identity_text: An unnamed boy dressed for the beach in an open flowery blue holiday shirt over a white vest, with tan shorts and bare feet.

bottom: red suit legs with a gold belt
head: red mask covering the whole head
gold lightning bolts at the ears
top: red suit with a gold lightning bolt on the chest

appearance_text: A hero in a head-to-toe red suit with a red mask that covers the whole head, leaving white eye slits and a bare chin. Small gold lightning bolts stick out at the ears and a big gold lightning bolt in a circle sits on the chest. A gold belt circles the waist and the boots are gold too.
identity_text: The Flash, the comic-book speedster, in a head-to-toe red suit with a white-circled gold lightning bolt on the chest and gold boots.

face: dark lens instead of a face
head: brown camera for a head
black lens in the middle
small white flash

appearance_text: A figure whose whole head is a chunky brown camera with a dark round lens where a face should be and a tiny white flash beside it. A bright rainbow stripe runs across the front of the camera. Below it the body is plain pale cream with brown caps on the shoulders, and the camera looks the same plain brown from behind.
identity_text: A figure whose whole head is a brown retro camera with a rainbow stripe and a dark lens, standing on a plain pale cream body. The listing describes it as a robot built from a social media app's camera icon.

hair: very long pale blonde hair down the back
head: long pale blonde hair

appearance_text: A girl with very long pale blonde hair that falls in strands all the way down her back, with a straight fringe over grey eyes. She wears a blue denim jacket open over a dark blue top and a short black skirt. Her thighs are bare above long black socks that come up over the knee.
identity_text: An unnamed teenage girl with very long pale blonde hair and a straight fringe, in an open blue denim jacket over a blue top, a short black skirt and tall dark boots.

face: pink patch where the mouth is
stitched mask covering the whole face
head: pale stitched mask worn over the head

appearance_text: A heavy man whose whole face is hidden under a pale stitched mask with blank dark eye holes and a small pink patch at the mouth, with tufts of messy black hair sticking out above it. He wears a red and black plaid shirt with the sleeves pushed up, and over it a grubby tan apron marked with dark red stains that runs down his chest. His trousers are dark grey and he wears heavy brown boots.
identity_text: Leatherface, the masked chainsaw killer, in the guest fighter look the listing attributes to Mortal Kombat X: stitched pale mask, red plaid shirt and a bloodied butcher's apron.

appearance_text: A figure with dark brown skin and a big round black afro. They wear a bright white jacket with purple shoulders and sleeves, a vivid orange panel down the front and green trim at the collar and waist. The trousers are white with orange stripes running down them, ending in white shoes.
identity_text: Dawn, a character from the Minecraft movie, in a white jacket with purple shoulders, a bright orange front panel and green trim.

colors.item: dark tactical armour back with painted red and blue panel stripes; no cape
colors.name: dark red

head: black bat mask with pointed ears
top: dark bat shape on the chest

appearance_text: A hero armoured head to toe in black, with a mask that has short pointed ears and leaves only the mouth and chin bare. Heavy plates cover the chest and arms with a darker bat shape spread across them. A long cape streaked with dark red hangs down the back, and the boots and gloves are black.
identity_text: Batman in the heavy black tactical armour of the 2022 film, with a short-eared cowl covering all but the mouth and a dark red streaked cape down the back.

appearance_text: A blackened creature that looks made of burnt rock, with dark red cracks running all over its body. Its only bright parts are two glowing eyes, red around the outside with hot yellow in the middle. It has no mouth, and the burnt cracks continue down its back and legs.
identity_text: A magma cube, the hostile mob that lives in the Nether, drawn here as a blackened burnt-rock figure with dark red cracks and glowing red and yellow eyes.

appearance_text: A figure in a padded black puffer jacket with the hood pulled right up, so the face is lost in shadow apart from a pale mask across the mouth. The jacket is quilted into thick bands across the chest and back. The jeans are pale grey and the shoes are white.
identity_text: An unnamed figure in a quilted black puffer jacket with the hood up so the face is lost in shadow apart from a pale mask, worn with pale grey jeans and white shoes.

appearance_text: A blocky creature made of dark grey stone with hot orange and yellow lines glowing along every edge, as if cracks are opening in it. Its face has two small dark red glowing eyes and a wide black mouth. The same glowing outlines run down its arms, legs and back.
identity_text: A blocky dark grey figure built from plates, with molten orange and yellow light glowing along every edge as if a fire burns inside it. The listing describes it as a mechanical robot demon with a core of fire.

appearance_text: A stocky knight covered head to toe in light blue plate armour. The helmet has two small horns at the sides and a dark T shaped slit where the face would be. Chunky shoulder plates sit above the armoured arms, a gold belt crosses the waist, and the legs and boots are darker blue plates.
identity_text: Shovel Knight, the blue-armoured hero of the Shovel Knight games, in his horned helmet with its T-shaped visor and gold-trimmed plate armour.

appearance_text: A figure sealed inside teal plated armour from head to toe. The helmet is a round shell whose whole front is a big pale glowing visor, so no face shows. Faint glowing lines run down the chest and belly of the armour, and the same teal plates cover the arms, legs and back.
identity_text: The Vortex armour set from Terraria, worn as a sealed teal suit whose helmet front is a single glowing visor.

appearance_text: A suit of armour standing up with nobody inside it: the open helmet shows only blackness where a head should be. Everything is deep purple with brighter violet edges, and jagged spikes stick out from the shoulders and run down the back. A tiny white light glimmers at the collar, and the purple plates carry on down the legs to armoured boots.
identity_text: The Possessed Armor enemy from Terraria: a spiked deep purple suit of armour standing upright with nobody inside it.

appearance_text: A pale woman with short wavy red hair, green eyes and red lips. Her shoulders and arms are bare, and she wears a green leafy one-piece that shades from light green at the chest to dark green at the legs. The leafy green pattern wraps all the way around her back and down to her feet.
identity_text: Poison Ivy, the plant-themed villain from the Batman comics, in a leafy green bodysuit that wraps from her chest down to her feet, with short wavy red hair.

head: small brown antlers
long blonde hair
top: green holly wreath around the collar

appearance_text: A girl with long blonde hair and small brown antlers poking up from her head. Around the collar of her white puffy-sleeved blouse sits a ring of green holly leaves dotted with red berries. Brown shorts with a gold buckle sit at her waist, and frilly white socks show above dark brown boots. A big red bow is tied at her back.
identity_text: A blonde girl dressed for Christmas with small reindeer antlers, a holly-and-berry wreath around the collar of her white blouse and a red bow at her back.

bottom: cream skirt with a woven pattern
hair: very long wavy dark brown hair down the back
head: crown of pink flowers and green leaves

appearance_text: A brown skinned girl with very long wavy dark brown hair reaching down her back, topped by a crown of pink flowers and green leaves. She wears a red wrapped top with a small necklace at her throat, leaving her middle bare. Her skirt is cream with a woven diamond pattern along the bottom, and her arms and legs are bare.
identity_text: Moana, the young voyager from the Disney film, with very long dark wavy hair, a pink flower crown, a red wrapped top and a woven cream skirt.

head: colourful sprinkles in the hair
top: light blue band at the neck

appearance_text: A girl whose hair is cream at the front and brown at the back, dotted all over with tiny pink, green and blue sprinkles. She has purple eyes and pink cheeks, and a light blue band sits round her neck above a brown strappy top with pale cream sleeves. Her legs are striped in pink and cream like a sweet, ending in pale striped boots.
identity_text: An unnamed girl styled after ice cream and sweets, her hair dotted with pastel sprinkles and her legs striped like candy. The title names the theme, not a character.

bottom: blue and orange bands at the ankles
face: black mask over the nose and mouth
head: black hood pulled up
top: light blue flame pattern on one sleeve
orange flame pattern on the other sleeve

appearance_text: A boy with a black hood pulled over his brown fringe and a black mask covering his nose and mouth. His black hoodie has light blue flames curling up one sleeve and orange flames up the other, with matching glowing dots on the chest and a big pattern of both colours across the back. His black trousers have blue and orange bands at the ankles, and one shoe is blue while the other is orange.
identity_text: An unnamed boy in a black hood and face mask whose hoodie carries icy blue fire on one arm and orange fire on the other, with matching flames across the back.

bottom: blue jeans with rips at the knees
head: messy brown hair
fringe over the eyes

appearance_text: A boy with messy brown hair falling over his eyes and light skin. He wears a baggy dark green hoodie with the hood resting on his shoulders, and a grey backpack sits on his back. His blue jeans are torn open at the knees, and he wears chunky white trainers.
identity_text: An everyday teenage boy with messy brown hair over his eyes, in a baggy dark green hoodie, blue jeans ripped at the knees and chunky white trainers. The title describes his clothes rather than naming anyone.

face: only the chin and mouth show under the hood
head: deep brown hood
face in shadow

appearance_text: A figure wrapped in a deep brown hood that leaves only the chin and mouth showing. The body is covered in brown leather armour with straps and buckles across the chest and grey metal plates over the shoulders. Metal bracers guard the forearms, and the leather trousers end in sturdy grey and brown boots.
identity_text: A hooded rogue in brown leather armour with grey metal shoulder guards and forearm bracers. The title describes the look rather than naming any character.

hair: long blonde hair down the back
top: fluffy pink jumper with long sleeves

appearance_text: A girl with long blonde hair that falls past her shoulders and down her back, with green eyes and pink cheeks. She wears a soft fluffy pink jumper with long sleeves over short cream shorts. Her legs are bare down to pink socks and matching pink shoes.
identity_text: Atom Eve, the Image Comics superhero, drawn here out of costume as a blonde girl in a fluffy pink jumper and cream shorts.

top: light blue and white striped football shirt

appearance_text: A tanned man with short brown hair and stubble on his chin, wearing a football kit. His shirt has broad light blue and white stripes with a small gold badge on the chest and a big number 10 printed across the back. He wears dark blue shorts, white socks pulled up his shins and dark boots.
identity_text: Lionel Messi, the Argentine footballer, in the light blue and white striped national kit with a gold badge on the chest and the number 10 on the back.

appearance_text: A pale boy with short brown hair and bright green eyes. He wears a vivid orange jacket with white cuffs, open at the front over a plain white shirt. His jeans are dark blue and his shoes are red with white soles. The back of the jacket is plain orange.
identity_text: An ordinary boy in a bright orange open jacket over a white shirt, with dark blue jeans and red trainers. The title describes the outfit, not a character.

hair: short brown fur on the head
head: heavy brow ridge
flat ape face

appearance_text: A large brown ape standing upright, with a heavy brow ridge over small black eyes and a wide flat nose above a dark mouth. Its face and chest are lighter tan while the rest of its short fur is deep brown, darkest across the shoulders and back. Its arms and legs are thick and muscly and covered in the same fur.
identity_text: Harambe, the gorilla from Cincinnati Zoo whose death made him famous. He is shown as a heavy brown ape standing upright, with a tan face and chest and thick furry arms and legs.

appearance_text: A stocky man with messy curly brown hair, a full brown beard and mustache, and brown eyes. He wears a dark grey long-sleeved shirt under a brown leather vest with padded shoulders and a gold cord tied at the collar. His trousers are black and his boots are brown, and the leather vest continues across his back.
