appearance_text: This character has an old grey television for a head, its screen filled with soft pastel rainbow bars. Around the back of that head sit two small dark horns and a ring of pink and white flowers. It wears a cream long sleeved shirt with brown braces looping over the shoulders and crossing the back, dark blue jeans, and brown boots with grey cuffs.
identity_text: A soft, pastel character whose head is an old grey television showing rainbow colour bars, ringed at the back with pink and white flowers and a pair of small dark horns. It wears a cream shirt held up by brown braces, dark blue jeans and brown boots.

head: navy peaked cap with a black brim
gold band on the cap

appearance_text: A man with short brown hair wearing a navy blue peaked cap with a black brim and a gold band across the front. His navy uniform jacket is buttoned with two gold buttons over a white shirt and a black tie, and gold stripes ring both sleeves near the wrists. He wears matching navy trousers and dark shoes.
identity_text: An airline pilot in a navy uniform with a gold-banded peaked cap, white shirt and black tie, and gold rank stripes at the wrists.

appearance_text: A tall creature whose whole body is made of brown bark with dark wood-grain lines running down it. Bunches of green leaves sit on top of its head like hair and bristle out over its shoulders and arms. Two glowing yellow eyes stare out of the bark face above a dark hollow mouth. Its legs look like tree trunks and more leaves cover its shoulders from behind.
identity_text: A walking tree: a humanoid figure made entirely of bark, with leaves growing where hair would be and trunk-like legs ending in root feet.

head: bee hood with two antennae
bee face on the hood
top: yellow and brown striped hoodie with a white drawstring

appearance_text: A kid wearing a hood shaped like a bee's head, with two curved antennae sticking up and dark eye patches on the front. The hoodie is striped in yellow and brown with a white drawstring at the neck. Short black shorts and white shoes finish it.
identity_text: A humanoid take on the Minecraft bee: a small figure in a yellow and brown striped hoodie whose hood is shaped like a bee's head, with antennae and dark eye patches.

appearance_text: A light-skinned boy with short dark brown hair swept across his forehead and bright green eyes. He wears an open dark red jacket over a plain light grey t-shirt, with the jacket sleeves reaching his elbows and his bare forearms showing. The back of the jacket is one solid dark red panel. Black jeans go down to bright blue trainers with white soles.
identity_text: A light-skinned teenage boy with short dark brown hair in an open dark red jacket over a grey t-shirt, black jeans and blue trainers. 'Justin' is a first-name label for a generic boy skin, not a character.

appearance_text: A smiling boy with short brown hair and bright blue eyes. He wears a red and black short-sleeved football shirt with bare arms, and a white number is printed on the back. He also has black shorts, black socks with yellow stripes and black football boots.
identity_text: Thomas Muller, the German footballer, in a red and black Germany kit with the number 13 printed on the back.

appearance_text: A man with brown hair and a thick brown beard, wearing a pair of brass goggles with dark lenses strapped across his forehead. He has a white shirt with the sleeves rolled up, a brown leather vest over it and a red tie hanging down the front. Leather straps cross the back, and dark grey striped trousers lead down to brown boots.
identity_text: An unnamed doctor in steampunk dress, goggles pushed up on his forehead over a waistcoat, tie and rolled-sleeve shirt.

bottom: light blue jeans with little snowflakes
head: cream hood on the back
top: thick cream and brown striped winter coat

appearance_text: A pale boy with short mauve-brown hair and bright light blue eyes. He is bundled into a thick cream winter coat banded with brown stripes, a soft collar up around his neck and the hood hanging behind him. Light blue jeans dotted with tiny pale snowflakes and sturdy brown boots keep out the cold.
identity_text: An unnamed boy bundled in a cream nordic-patterned winter sweater with a soft collar, light blue snowflake-flecked jeans and brown boots.

appearance_text: A brown-skinned boy with short curly brown hair and bright blue eyes. A dark grey neck warmer is pulled up around his chin, and he wears a roomy white hoodie with a drawstring at the neck and dark cuffs. His trousers are cream and he has dark red and white shoes.
identity_text: A boy in a baggy white hoodie with a dark neck warmer pulled up to his chin, cream trousers and dark red and white trainers.

top: khaki short sleeved safari shirt with chest pockets

appearance_text: A cheerful man with messy blond hair and a wide grin. He wears a khaki short-sleeved safari shirt with buttoned chest pockets and matching khaki shorts, leaving his tan arms and legs bare. The shirt is the same khaki all the way round the back, and he goes without shoes.
identity_text: Steve Irwin, the Australian zookeeper and wildlife television presenter, in his trademark khaki safari shirt and shorts.

appearance_text: A pale young man with floppy brown hair falling across his forehead and bright blue eyes. He wears a light brown tweed jacket over a white shirt with a dark red bow tie at his neck. His trousers are dark navy and his shoes are dark, and the jacket is plain light brown across the back.
identity_text: The 11th Doctor from Doctor Who, the incarnation played by Matt Smith. He is shown in his tweed jacket, white shirt and red bow tie.

appearance_text: A tall pink cat with a big head, pointed ears and a wide light pink muzzle with a dark pink nose and a broad grin. Its yellow eyes are half closed under heavy black lids. The whole body is pink with a lighter pink chest and belly, and a long thin pink tail hangs down the back.
identity_text: The Pink Panther, the tall pink cartoon big cat from the animated title sequences of the film series, drawn all in pink with a lighter chest, pointed ears and a long thin tail.

hair: long orange hair down the back
subjects: red haired figure in a cream robe
top: cream robe with red bands on the sleeves

appearance_text: A figure with fluffy orange red hair and bright purple eyes, the hair falling long down the back. They wear a loose cream robe with red bands around the upper sleeves and a dark strip running down the middle of the chest. The trousers are white and the shoes are black.
identity_text: Alder, the Champion of the Unova region in Pokemon Black and White, shown as a red haired man in a cream robe with red arm bands.

head: brown hair
small dark bun with an orange tie at the back

appearance_text: A girl with long brown hair and big blue eyes, with a small dark bun tied by an orange band at the back of her head. She wears a red short sleeved top with a white collar and white cuffs, and a light blue denim skirt. Her legs are bare down to short black shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in a red white-collared top and light denim skirt, wearing headphones over her long brown hair.

colors.item: flower prints on the jacket back
colors.name: white

head: long black hair
red roses tucked in the hair

appearance_text: A pale girl with long straight black hair falling down her back and dark red eyes, with small red roses tucked into the hair near her ear. She wears a black jacket over a short white top, and the back of the jacket is printed with pale flower shapes. Her skirt is grey, her legs are covered by grey blue leggings, and she has dark grey shoes.
identity_text: A pale goth-styled girl with long straight black hair ringed by red and white roses, wearing a black jacket over a white crop top with a grey skirt.

bottom: green cactus legs with pale spines
head: green cactus head
small red flower on top
top: green cactus body with pale spines

appearance_text: A cheerful green cactus shaped like a person, with pale cream spine dots scattered all over its arms, legs and body. Its face has two small black eyes and a wide open mouth with a red tongue poking out. A tiny red flower blooms on top of its head. The back and sides are the same rounded green with more little spines.
identity_text: A cheerful green cactus shaped like a person, speckled all over with pale spines and topped by a small red flower, grinning with its tongue out.

head: bright red bandana tied round the head

appearance_text: This man has dark brown skin, a short goatee beard and a bright red bandana tied tightly round his head. His chest and arms are bare and muscled, with a thin silver chain hanging round his neck. He wears plain white shorts and nothing on his feet.
identity_text: Tupac Shakur, the American rapper and actor also known as 2Pac. He is shown bare-chested and muscled with a red bandana round his head, a goatee and a thin silver chain.

accessories: gold sword slung across the back
bottom: brown belt with a gold buckle
head: gold crown with tall points
brown hair
top: blue royal coat with gold buttons
dark red tunic down the front

appearance_text: A man with brown hair and a full brown beard, wearing a tall gold crown with pointed tips. His long blue coat is fastened with gold buttons over a dark red tunic that runs down his chest, and a brown belt with a gold buckle circles his waist. A golden sword is slung diagonally across his back and his boots are dark brown.
identity_text: An unnamed king in a tall pointed gold crown and a blue coat with gold shoulder plates over a dark red tunic, a gold sword slung across his back.

bottom: long pink skirt with a purple front panel
hair: hair reaching the ankles at the back
head: gold tiara with a pink gem

appearance_text: A girl with very long blonde hair reaching down her back, wearing a gold tiara set with a pink gem on her forehead. Her purple bodice is edged in gold with gold plates on the shoulders and long white sleeves covering her arms. The gown falls into a soft pink skirt with a purple and gold panel down the front, ending in blue and white shoes.
identity_text: Princess Zelda from The Legend of Zelda, in a gold tiara and a long royal gown with gold shoulder plates and white gloves.

head: long white hair with lavender streaks
white cat ears
top: purple dress with white puffy sleeves

appearance_text: A soft pastel girl with long white hair streaked with lavender, two fluffy white cat ears on top and gentle purple eyes. She wears a purple dress with big white puffy sleeves at the shoulders. Her legs are covered by light purple checked stockings and she wears little purple shoes over white socks.
identity_text: An unnamed pastel girl with long white hair streaked with lavender and fluffy white cat ears, wearing a purple dress with puffy white sleeves, checked stockings and little purple shoes.

bottom: red and dark grey armoured legs
hair: very long blonde ponytail down the back
head: red helmet with a blue jewel on the front
top: red chest armour with grey shoulder plates

appearance_text: An armoured fighter in bright red plate armour with grey shoulder and arm guards. A red helmet with a shining blue jewel on the forehead frames a pale face with light blue eyes, and a very long blonde ponytail hangs all the way down the back. An orange gem sits in the middle of the chest, and the legs are red with dark grey boots.
identity_text: An armoured hero in bright red plate with grey shoulder guards, a blue jewel set into the helmet and a very long blonde ponytail down the back, a character from the Mega Man series.

appearance_text: A broad, tough man with brown skin, a black mohawk strip of hair and a thick black beard and moustache, with a small gold earring. He wears a red jacket with the sleeves rolled over blue denim dungarees, and thick gold chains hang across his chest. His shoes are black with white socks showing above them.
identity_text: Mr. T in his A-Team look as B. A. Baracus, with a black mohawk, thick beard, gold chains and a red jacket over denim dungarees.

colors.item: creeper face patch on the chest
colors.name: green

head: hood down at the back
top: green creeper face patch on the chest
big creeper face across the back

appearance_text: A boy with short messy brown hair and pink cheeks, wearing a bright red hoodie with the hood resting on his shoulders. A small green square with a creeper face sits on the chest and a much bigger pale creeper face is printed across the back, with another green creeper face on the side of the hood. He wears dark grey jeans and red shoes with white soles.
identity_text: A brown haired boy in a bright red creeper-print hoodie with green headphones on, grey jeans and red shoes with white soles.

hair: long pale blonde hair over the shoulders
head: cream animal hood
rounded ears with dark tips
top: cream fur panel down the back

appearance_text: A girl wearing a soft cream hood shaped like an animal head, with two rounded ears that have dark brown tips. Long pale blonde hair spills out of the hood over her shoulders. She wears an open brown jacket over a black crop top, with a pale cream furry panel running down the back like an animal's belly. Black shorts, cream sock cuffs and short dark brown boots finish the outfit.
identity_text: A girl in a cosy autumn costume: a cream animal-ear hood with a fur panel down the back, an open tan jacket over a black crop top, black shorts and short brown boots.

head: white head with a giant painted grin
subjects: grinning white face in a suit
top: black suit jacket over a white shirt

appearance_text: A figure with a chalk white head taken up almost entirely by an enormous black toothy grin, with squinting black eyes above it. It wears a smart black suit jacket over a white shirt with a bright red tie down the front. The trousers are the same black and the back of the suit is plain dark.
identity_text: The grinning white internet meme face worn as a head, an enormous black toothy grin under squinting eyes, on a figure in a smart black suit with a red tie.

appearance_text: A pale grey figure with long, dull brown hair and huge blank white eyes staring out of a sunken face. Dark red blood is smeared around the mouth and splattered down the chest, arms and legs. A ragged white top hangs in strips over the torso, and the grey trousers are stained with more red patches, front and back.
identity_text: A zombie girl with grey sunken skin, blank white eyes and long dull brown hair, her ribs showing through a blood-smeared chest.

appearance_text: A stern man with dark brown hair swept back, bushy eyebrows and a thick dark moustache under his nose. He wears a white shirt with the sleeves rolled up, a red tie down the front, and dark brown braces stretching over his shoulders and crossing his back. His brown trousers are held by a belt with a gold buckle, and he wears dark brown shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed, stern police commissioner: a moustachioed man in a white shirt with rolled sleeves, a red tie and brown braces over brown trousers.

appearance_text: A girl with long blonde hair streaked with green and teal, and a small green leaf standing up at the side of her head. She wears a soft green jumper with pale stripes across it, and her arms are bare below the sleeves. From the waist down her legs are covered in shaggy brown fur that ends in dark hooves.
identity_text: A mythical half-goat girl, human from the waist up in a striped green jumper, with shaggy brown legs ending in hooves below.

appearance_text: A boy with fluffy brown hair falling in a messy fringe over dark green eyes and pale skin. He wears a baggy light blue sweater with long sleeves that hangs loose over his hips. His trousers are dark brown with a rough streaky pattern, and his shoes are white with white socks.
identity_text: A boy with fluffy brown hair in a baggy light blue sweater carrying a small dark emblem on the chest, worn with dark brown trousers and white shoes. The title only names the garment.

head: cream cat head
pointy ears with pink insides
top: cream furry chest with a white patch

appearance_text: A soft cream coloured cat standing upright, with faint tan tabby stripes over its fur. Its face has closed happy eyes, pink cheeks, a white muzzle and pointy ears lined with pink, and a pale blue collar sits round its neck. A curling white tail runs up its back, and its chest and all four paws are white.
identity_text: A cream tabby cat standing upright on two legs, with faint tan stripes, pink cheeks and closed happy eyes, a blue bandana at its neck and a curling tail up its back.

hair: red ribbon tying the hair at the back
head: black hat pulled low

appearance_text: A serious looking man with pale blonde hair tied at the back with a red ribbon, wearing a black hat pulled low over his brow. He is dressed in a long dark grey coat that opens over a light blue waistcoat and a white cravat at the throat. His trousers are dark grey and he wears tall black boots.
identity_text: George Washington, the first President of the United States, in colonial dress with a dark long coat, pale blue waistcoat and a black hat.

head: grey green peaked cap
white band and black brim
top: brown leather strap over the shoulder

appearance_text: A stern man in a grey-green peaked cap with a white band and a black brim, his eyes hidden behind dark sunglasses. His uniform jacket is the same grey-green with a silver star medal pinned to the chest, white cuffs at the wrists and a brown leather strap running over one shoulder and across his back. Grey-green trousers with small brown pouches at the belt go down into tall brown boots.
identity_text: An unnamed military officer in an olive-green dress uniform: peaked cap, dark sunglasses, a star medal on the chest, a leather shoulder strap, belt pouches and tall brown boots.

bottom: short grey skirt of the dress
head: long brown hair with a fringe
top: pale grey dungaree dress with straps

appearance_text: A girl with long straight brown hair that hangs down her back and a short fringe over green eyes. She wears a pale grey dungaree dress with thin straps that leaves her shoulders and arms bare. The dress ends in a short skirt above her legs, and she has short white socks with light pink shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with long brown hair and green eyes wearing a pale grey strappy pinafore dress, white socks and pink shoes.

appearance_text: A bony figure with a pale skull for a head, deep black eye sockets and a wide line of teeth. Its chest and back show grey ribs and a spine, and its arms are thin and bony. From the waist down it wears blue jeans held up by a brown belt.
identity_text: A Minecraft skeleton dressed from the waist down in blue jeans and a brown belt, bare skull, ribs and bony arms above. The title is a nickname for this dressed-up version rather than a separate character.

colors.item: accessory:drawstrings hanging from the jacket collar (no scarf)
colors.name: light blue

colors.item: swirl design on the back of the jacket
colors.name: light blue

motifs: swirling design on the back of the jacket
top: dark navy jacket over a white shirt

appearance_text: A pale boy with short spiky ice blue hair and matching light blue eyes. He wears a dark navy jacket with big shoulders, open over a white shirt with a light blue scarf hanging down his chest. On the back of the jacket is a swirling pale blue design. His trousers are black and his sneakers are white with black soles.
identity_text: A boy with spiky ice blue hair in a dark navy jacket over a white shirt, with a pale blue swirl design on the back. 'Moon Boy' is a mood label, not a character name.

bottom: blue trousers up where the head would normally be
head: brown hair
head sitting at the bottom of the body

appearance_text: This character is built the wrong way up. The blue trousers and shoes sit at the top where a head would normally be, and the teal shirt runs down the middle with tan arms at its sides. The head with short brown hair, white eyes and a small mouth hangs at the very bottom, facing downwards.
identity_text: The default Minecraft player skin built the wrong way up. The indigo trousers and shoes sit on top where a head would normally be, the cyan shirt runs down the middle with tan arms at its sides, and the brown-haired head hangs upside down at the very bottom.

head: red machine lid
flat red top
top: clear globe packed with coloured gumballs

appearance_text: A tall red machine with a flat red lid on top and a chunky red base at the bottom. In the middle is a big clear globe crammed with round sweets in red, blue, yellow, green, orange and purple. A small grey coin slot and a dispenser flap sit on the front of the base. The arms are red with a few of the same coloured sweets showing through.
identity_text: A gumball machine standing on its own: a flat red lid, a clear globe crammed with red, blue, yellow, green, orange and purple sweets, and a red base with a coin slot.

head: pink bonnet with white frill
subjects: girl in a pink frilly dress
top: pink dress with puffy sleeves and white frills

appearance_text: A girl with long blonde hair wearing a soft pink bonnet edged in white frills. Her pink dress has puffy sleeves, white cuffs and a white frilly hem over a pink skirt. Underneath she wears white and pink striped stockings and little pink shoes, and her hair hangs long down her back.
identity_text: A blonde girl in a frilly pink dress with a matching bonnet and striped stockings. The title describes the colour scheme rather than naming anyone.

head: purple hood
top: purple straps crossed over the chest

appearance_text: A tall figure with a bare yellow skull for a face, black holes where the eyes should be, hidden under a deep purple hood. The chest and arms are light blue bare skin crossed by two purple straps that meet in the middle. Purple briefs and purple boots finish the outfit, and the straps cross over the back as well.
identity_text: Skeletor, the skull-faced sorcerer villain of Masters of the Universe, in his deep purple hood with straps crossed over a bare blue chest.

head: flat iron head
brown band across the brow
top: green vines trailing across the metal

appearance_text: A hulking figure made of pale grey iron plates, with a flat head, a long flat nose hanging over its mouth and tiny dark red eyes. Green vines creep across its chest, arms and legs with little yellow buds along them. Its arms are enormously long and heavy and the vines wind up its back too.
identity_text: An Iron Golem, the heavy iron guardian mob that protects Minecraft villages, here with flowering green vines growing across its plating.

head: long brown hair
thick braid hanging down the back

appearance_text: A girl with long brown hair pulled into a thick braid that hangs right down her back, and blue eyes. She wears a jumper striped in blue and white over a light blue shirt. Below she has a grey skirt and tall grey boots that reach her knees.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with brown braided hair in a blue and white striped jumper, a grey skirt and tall grey boots.

appearance_text: A huge red creature with bulging muscles all over its chest, arms and legs. Its head is lumpy and red with tiny yellow eyes and a wide black mouth full of big white fangs. It wears only a pair of ragged dark blue shorts and walks on bare red feet.
identity_text: An unnamed red demon-like monster: a hulking, heavily muscled brute with a lumpy head, big white fangs and only torn shorts. 'Demonic Mutation' describes what it is, not a character who exists outside this skin.

hair: long dark red hair down the back
head: dark red hood

appearance_text: A hooded figure whose face is completely lost in shadow apart from one tiny glowing red eye. The hood is dark red and long dark red hair hangs down the back. A ragged light grey tunic covers the body with dark purple shoulder pieces, and light grey trousers run down to dark purple boots.
identity_text: A rogue returned from the dead: a hooded figure in dark red and pale rags whose shadowed face shows only one small glowing red eye.

accessories: white number printed on the back of the jacket
top: green tracksuit jacket over a white striped shirt

appearance_text: A man with messy black hair wearing a green tracksuit jacket zipped part way over a white and dark striped shirt. The matching green tracksuit trousers have a light stripe down the side and his trainers are white. A white number is printed across the back of the jacket.
identity_text: Seong Gi-Hun, the Squid Game contestant known as Player 456, in the show's green numbered tracksuit.

appearance_text: A boy with messy brown hair falling over his forehead and pale peach skin. He wears a dark grey hoodie with gold bands around the cuffs, a gold cord at the neck and gold lining inside the hood that hangs down his back. His legs are in light blue jeans and his black shoes have a gold stripe across the top.
identity_text: A brown-haired boy in a dark grey-black hoodie trimmed with gold, worn with light blue jeans. The title describes the garment rather than naming anyone.

head: short black hair
top: light blue shirt with mud stains

appearance_text: A man with short black hair and a small smile, dressed for the outdoors. His light blue shirt is smudged with brown mud and a black strap runs diagonally across his chest and over his back. He wears dark brown trousers and black boots.
identity_text: Bear Grylls, the British adventurer and television survival presenter, dressed for the outdoors in a mud-smudged blue shirt with a strap across his chest.

colors.item: star on the back of the jacket
colors.name: white

appearance_text: A girl with brown skin and shoulder length brown hair. She wears an open blue denim jacket with red patches on the sleeves and a big white star across the back, over a plain grey shirt. Her trousers are dark blue jeans and her shoes are black with white soles.
identity_text: America Chavez, the young Marvel hero from Dr. Strange in the Multiverse of Madness, a brown-haired teenager in a denim jacket with a white star on the back.

top: blue shirt worn open over a white t-shirt

appearance_text: A boy with brown hair falling over his ears and dark eyes. He wears a blue shirt open over a plain white t-shirt, with a dark red scarf looped around his neck and trailing down one side. His shorts are tan, his legs are bare below the knee, and he wears simple black shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed boy in an everyday autumn outfit: a blue shirt open over a white t-shirt, a dark red scarf round his neck, tan shorts and black shoes.

accessories: light blue harness straps on the back
head: brown hair

appearance_text: A man with bright yellow toy-like skin, short swept brown hair and a matching stubble beard. He wears a dark blue sleeveless vest covered in pockets, leaving his yellow arms bare, with light blue straps crossing his back. His trousers are dark blue with pocket details and his shoes are grey.
identity_text: Rex Dangervest, the main antagonist of The LEGO Movie 2, built as a yellow toy figure with swept brown hair and stubble. He wears a pocket-covered dark blue vest over bare yellow arms with matching blue trousers.

top: pink collar showing at the neck

appearance_text: A cartoon man with bright yellow skin, neat brown hair and a very thick brown moustache under his nose. He wears a green jumper with a pink shirt collar poking out at the neck and yellow hands showing at the cuffs. His trousers are grey and his shoes are black.
identity_text: Ned Flanders, the cheerful moustached neighbour from The Simpsons, in his green jumper with a pink collar showing at the neck and grey trousers.

motifs: pale marking on the back of the jacket

appearance_text: A girl with very long dark brown hair falling around her shoulders and down her back, and dark eyes. She wears a dark olive green jacket over a lighter green top, with a faint pale marking printed across the back. Her jeans are baggy and light blue, sitting low and wide over her legs.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in grunge streetwear: a dark olive green jacket over a green top with a pale print, baggy light blue jeans and very long dark brown hair. The title names a style, not a character.

appearance_text: A traveller with brown hair wearing a bright crown of red and yellow flowers around their head. They wear a light grey shirt under a dark blue sleeveless vest, with a leather strap running across the chest and over the shoulder. Brown trousers and short black boots cover the legs, and a pale rolled bundle is strapped down the back.
identity_text: An unnamed deer-eared traveller in a crown of red and yellow flowers, a dark laced vest over cream sleeves, and tall brown boots. The title describes the look rather than naming a character.

face: tentacle beard hanging from the chin
head: dark blue tricorn pirate hat

appearance_text: A broad sea creature in pirate clothes, with a wide tan face and a thick beard of dangling tentacles instead of hair. A dark blue pirate hat sits low over the pale eyes. He wears a dark blue captain's coat over a dark shirt, with a red belt at the waist, grey trousers and dark boots.
identity_text: Davy Jones, the tentacle-bearded sea-monster captain of the Flying Dutchman from Pirates of the Caribbean, in his blue tricorn hat and captain's coat.

motifs: fishnet criss-cross pattern on the legs
subjects: girl with very long blonde hair
top: dark purple off the shoulder top with long sleeves

appearance_text: A pale girl with very long soft blonde hair that hangs in a fringe over her big blue eyes and falls all the way down her back past her waist. She wears a dark purple off the shoulder top with long sleeves, leaving her shoulders bare, above a short light blue skirt. Her legs are covered in dark criss-cross fishnet tights that stop at little white ankle socks.
identity_text: A pale girl with extremely long blonde hair, in a dark purple off-the-shoulder top, a short light blue skirt and criss-cross fishnet tights. The title is a first name attached to this one skin.

head: dark wide-brimmed hat with a red flower
top: dark brown coat with gold trim

appearance_text: A pale girl with very long dark brown hair and bright red eyes, wearing a wide dark hat with a red flower tucked into it. Her dark brown coat has gold buttons and gold trim down the front, with a red tassel hanging at her chest and long sleeves over her hands. Below the coat are dark shorts, tall white socks marked with small red crosses, and black shoes.
identity_text: Hu Tao from the role-playing game Genshin Impact, in her tall wide-brimmed hat with a red flower, a dark gold-trimmed coat with a red tassel, and white cross-marked socks.

appearance_text: A man with light brown hair and a short beard, wearing a bright red hoodie with the hood pulled up over his head and a small headset microphone at his mouth. Two dark red straps cross over on the back of the hoodie. He wears light blue jeans and red trainers with white soles.
identity_text: PewDiePie, the Swedish video game commentator named in the listing, wearing a red hood-up hoodie with a headset microphone, blue jeans and red trainers.

face: no face, only a dark red visor slit
head: silver helmet
dark red T-shaped visor slit

appearance_text: A warrior encased head to toe in silver plate armour, with a helmet whose only opening is a dark red cross-shaped visor slit. Dark red cloth shows under the chest plate and around the waist, and the arms are banded in red and silver. A long purple cape falls down the back over silver leg armour and heavy silver boots.
identity_text: An unnamed knight sealed head to toe in silver plate armour, with a dark red cross-slit visor and a purple cape.

appearance_text: A boy with short brown hair wearing wide black sunglasses that cover his eyes. His white hoodie has thick yellow and black stripes wrapped around the sleeves and two black letters printed on the chest, with the hood bunched behind his neck. He wears plain black trousers and white trainers.
identity_text: A boy in an oversized white hoodie with black and yellow striped sleeves and two black letters across the chest, wearing wide black sunglasses, black trousers and white trainers.

face: white skull with black eye sockets
head: dark purple hood

appearance_text: A hooded figure with a bone-white skull face, black eye sockets lit by glowing pink dots and a wide row of teeth. A dark purple hood frames the skull and matching purple sleeves cover the arms. A long dark grey robe reaches past the knees over a brown belt, ending above chunky grey boots.
identity_text: A hooded death figure with a bone-white skull face and glowing pink eye sockets, dressed in a long dark robe over purple sleeves. The title describes the look rather than naming a character.

accessories: black belt with a gold buckle
head: red hat with white fluffy trim

appearance_text: A round cheerful old man in a bright red hat with a fluffy white trim and a matching bobble. A huge white beard covers his chin and cheeks, with pink cheeks and small black eyes above it. His red coat has white fluffy cuffs and a broad black belt with a gold buckle, and his red trousers end in dark brown boots.
identity_text: Santa Claus drawn in an anime style, in the red white trimmed suit with a black gold buckled belt, brown boots and a full white beard.

appearance_text: A girl with long wavy light brown hair and small animal ears, wearing a crown of pink flowers around her head. Her white blouse sits off both shoulders with puffy sleeves down her arms, tucked into a light blue denim skirt. Her legs are bare above short brown boots, and a slim black case is slung across her back.
identity_text: An unnamed countryside girl with small animal ears and a pink flower crown, in a white off-the-shoulder blouse, light blue denim and short brown boots.

bottom: dark grey trousers under the coat

appearance_text: A tall figure dressed entirely in dark grey, with a wide brimmed hat pulled low and a long coat that reaches past the knees. The face underneath is lost in shadow apart from two pale glowing eyes. The coat has a raised collar and hangs plain and dark all the way around the back.
identity_text: A tall figure dressed all in dark grey, with a wide-brimmed hat and a long coat past the knees, its face hidden in shadow except for two glowing pale eyes. The title describes the disguise rather than naming anyone.

appearance_text: A fair-skinned girl with short brown hair tied into two little buns at the back and bright blue eyes. She wears a baggy grey knitted sweater with long sleeves, dark navy trousers and white shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed child in a baggy grey knitted sweater, dark navy trousers and white shoes, with reddish-brown hair gathered into two small buns at the back. The title names the outfit, not a character.

hair: long blonde hair down past the shoulders
head: bright red hood pulled over the head

appearance_text: A girl with long blonde hair and big blue eyes, her head covered by a bright red hood that flows into a red cape hanging all the way down her back. Under it she wears a simple white dress with long sleeves. Her legs are covered by light blue stockings above dark brown shoes.
identity_text: Little Red Riding Hood from the fairy tale, shown as a blonde girl whose bright red hood runs into a cape down her back over a white dress.

appearance_text: Instead of a head this character has a boxy old television set with a chunky grey frame. The screen faces forward showing bright test bars in red, orange, yellow, green, blue and purple, while the back of the set is black with a row of little buttons. The body wears a white shirt with a band of pastel rainbow stripes across the chest, and loose tan trousers with a soft check pattern over brown shoes.
identity_text: A figure whose head is an old boxy television set, its screen showing rainbow colour bars and its black back covered in little buttons, dressed in a pastel-striped shirt and checked trousers.

appearance_text: A stuffed bear in dark grey fur, with two round ears sticking up from its head and small black button eyes. Its muzzle is a lighter grey with a black stitched line for a smile, and a paler grey patch covers its tummy. Its short arms and stubby legs are the same dark grey all the way round.
identity_text: A stuffed bear in dark grey fur standing upright, with round ears, a lighter grey muzzle and a pale grey patch on its tummy.

hair: long black hair down the back
head: gold tiara

appearance_text: A woman with long black hair and a gold tiara across her forehead. She wears a dark red armoured top edged in gold, a short blue armoured skirt and silver bracers on both wrists. Her arms and shoulders are bare, and tall dark red boots with straps rise up her legs.
identity_text: Wonder Woman as she appears in the 2017 film, in dark red battle armour with gold trim, a blue armoured skirt, arm bracers and tall boots.

head: white hair swept back
top: tan jacket with an open front

appearance_text: An older man with white hair swept back and a thick white moustache, wearing brown tinted glasses that cover his eyes. He has a soft tan jacket open over a dark grey shirt with a pale collar. His trousers are cream and his shoes are black. The back of the jacket is plain tan.
identity_text: Stan Lee, the American comic book writer, drawn as an older man with swept-back white hair and a thick white moustache, in tinted glasses and an open tan jacket.

appearance_text: A figure in a bulky white space suit with a big round helmet whose dark visor hides the face completely. The suit has grey panels down the chest and arms, small red and blue patches on the shoulders and little coloured buttons on the chest. The legs and boots are white with grey bands, and a life support pack is fitted to the back.
identity_text: An astronaut in a bulky white space suit, face completely hidden behind a dark bubble visor, with grey panels down the chest and a life support pack on the back. No particular mission, agency or person is identified.

appearance_text: A person zipped into a soft brown animal onesie. The hood is shaped like a reindeer head with a tan face, small ears and a bright red nose, and their own pale face with dark eyes peeks out from underneath. The front of the onesie has a cream belly panel, and a tiny white tail sticks out at the back.
identity_text: A person zipped into a dark brown reindeer onesie, their own pale face peeking out from under an animal hood with ears, with a cream belly panel and a little white tail.

appearance_text: A pale girl with long light brown hair that falls past her shoulders and big pale blue eyes. Fluffy grey earmuffs sit over her ears and a soft white scarf is wrapped round her neck. She wears a dark brown winter coat with white fluffy cuffs, a short black skirt and bare legs, with white socks and black shoes. Small white snowflakes are dotted over the back of her hair.
identity_text: An unnamed girl bundled up for winter in fluffy earmuffs, a white scarf and a dark brown coat, with snowflakes caught in her long light brown hair.

face: wide grin full of pointy white teeth
head: blue grey shark head with a rounded snout
top: gold collar with a bell at the neck

appearance_text: A chubby little shark standing upright, blue grey on top with a soft white belly running down the front. Its rounded head has big dark eyes and a very wide grin packed with pointy white teeth over pink gums, and a gold collar with a small bell sits at its neck. A tall fin runs down its back and the short legs end in little tail fins.
identity_text: Jeff the Land Shark, the little comic book pet shark, standing upright with a wide toothy grin and a bell collar.

appearance_text: A bearded man in a tall black top hat, with a thick dark red beard and moustache covering most of his face. He wears a plain black jacket with a row of small orange buttons down the front. Below it he has white shorts dotted with little red squares and bare legs.
identity_text: A fan skin of Notch, the creator of Minecraft, drawn as a bearded man in a tall black top hat and black jacket with red-spotted white shorts.

appearance_text: A grinning man with short brown hair and big black sunglasses covering his eyes. He wears an open light blue denim jacket over a blue shirt. Below that are salmon plaid shorts and bare tan legs and feet.
identity_text: That Damn Neighbour, a recurring character from Smosh videos: a grinning man in black sunglasses, an open denim jacket and plaid shorts.

appearance_text: A girl with very long black hair streaked with purple, falling all the way down her back. She wears an open purple hoodie over a short white top that leaves her middle bare, with light blue denim shorts below. Her legs are covered by long purple and white striped socks that reach above the knee.
identity_text: Aphmau, the Minecraft YouTuber, recreated in her signature purple hoodie, white crop top, denim shorts and striped over-knee socks.

appearance_text: A strange mixed-up character with a different face on every side of its head: a brown furry animal muzzle with big white teeth at the front, a grinning face in dark sunglasses behind it, and a green cartoon face with white eyes beside that. Its body swaps too, from a plain cream shirt to a red shirt printed with a big green frog face and a black cross. The legs are part blue jeans, part grey trousers, with orange flames licking up the arms and thighs.
identity_text: A mash-up skin that stitches several well-known Minecraft youtuber outfits into one figure, with a different face on each side of the head and a body that changes from panel to panel.

appearance_text: A pale girl with very long light blue hair that reaches almost to her knees, held with a white flower on one side. She has soft blue eyes and wears a white dress with a small light blue tie at the neck and puffy white sleeves that leave her shoulders bare. Long white socks with pale blue tops cover most of her legs.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with very long light blue hair and a white pastel dress. 'Blue Paradise' describes the look and fails the test of naming something that exists outside this texture file.

appearance_text: A clown with a chalk white painted face, tiny purple eyes, a big round red nose and a wide red painted grin. Its hair is a band of rainbow colours running from red and yellow through green and blue to purple and pink all the way round the head. It wears a dark blue jacket with a single orange button, trousers with one red leg and one yellow leg, and plain white shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed circus clown with chalk-white face paint, a round red nose and painted grin, rainbow hair and mismatched red and yellow trouser legs.

top: red and pink beach shirt worn open

appearance_text: A tanned boy with short brown hair and dark sunglasses, one cheek pink from the sun. He wears a white tank top under a red and pink beach shirt left hanging open, with a bright orange and yellow flower necklace around his neck. His shorts are black, his flip flops are black, and a black backpack is strapped across his back.
identity_text: An unnamed boy dressed for a beach holiday in an open red beach shirt, flower lei, sunglasses, black shorts and flip flops, with a backpack on his back.

appearance_text: A warrior whose head is completely covered by a battered silver helmet with a thin dark eye slit and small breathing holes. Silver plates sit on the shoulders and arms over a blue padded tunic, with worn brown leather straps crossing the chest and back. A dark tabard hangs down the front over blue leggings, and the legs and feet are wrapped in silver armour.
identity_text: An unnamed knight in battered silver plate over a blue padded tunic, his face completely hidden behind a helmet with a thin eye slit, with a dark tabard over blue leggings and armoured boots.

appearance_text: A girl with very long peach-coloured hair that falls down her back, topped with matching cat ears and a small blue flower clip on one side. She has big light blue eyes. She wears a short cream top with a dark brown middle and blue-grey bands around her arms, plus white shorts with a blue-grey waistband. Her boots are dark grey with white cuffs.
identity_text: A pastel-styled girl with peach cat ears and very long peach hair, in a cropped cream top and white shorts.

appearance_text: A short bright yellow creature with one huge round eye behind a goggle, held on by a grey metal strap that runs all the way around its head. Its mouth is wide open showing a row of white teeth. It wears blue denim dungarees with a rounded pocket on the chest marked with a letter, black gloves on its hands and chunky black shoes. The dungarees are the same blue with crossed straps over its back.
identity_text: A Minion, the small yellow one-eyed helper from Despicable Me, in a strapped goggle, black gloves and blue denim dungarees.

appearance_text: A slim young person with soft light blue hair falling around their face and blue eyes. They wear a dark navy school jacket buttoned over a white shirt whose sleeves show at the arms with black cuffs. The trousers are the same dark navy and the shoes are white with black soles.
identity_text: Nagisa Shiota, the main character of the anime Assassination Classroom, wearing the navy school uniform of his class.

appearance_text: A girl with long blonde hair and mismatched eyes, one pink and one orange, with little clips of the same colours in her hair. Her jacket is split down the middle, pink on one side and orange on the other, over a short red skirt. Patterned tights cover her legs, and her shoes match her eyes with one pink and one orange.
identity_text: A girl dressed in a sweet-shop outfit - a jacket that is pink on one side and orange on the other over a short red skirt, with mismatched pink and orange eyes and shoes to match.

appearance_text: A big nosed figure with a thick black unibrow and purple eyes, wearing a gold and dark red wrap around the head. The body is covered by a long blue robe edged with gold, with a green stripe running down the front and a brown apron tied at the waist. The blue robe continues down the back and legs, ending in short brown boots.
identity_text: The Wandering Trader, the blue-robed travelling merchant mob from Minecraft, in his gold-trimmed robe, red head wrap and brown apron.

appearance_text: A pale girl with long pink hair falling over her shoulders and bright green eyes, smiling with an open mouth. She wears a white top under an open blue and black plaid shirt, with a big white crescent moon printed across the back of it. Her skirt is grey over black tights, and she wears chunky black boots.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in an open blue and black plaid shirt with a large white crescent moon printed on the back. "Moon Girl" describes the look rather than naming a character that exists outside this file.

appearance_text: A girl dressed nearly all in soft yellow, with long pale yellow hair falling down her back and brown eyes. Her yellow top has a light green bow at the chest and another tied on the back. Cream shorts and matching cream boots finish the outfit.
identity_text: A girl dressed almost entirely in soft lemon yellow with pale green bows front and back, finished with cream shorts and boots. The title names the colour scheme, not a character.

appearance_text: A young man with messy spiky black hair falling over pale blue eyes. He wears a sharp black suit jacket over a white dress shirt with a dark tie down the middle. Matching black trousers and black shoes keep the whole outfit dark, and the back of the jacket is plain black.
identity_text: Sung Jinwoo from the anime series Solo Leveling, shown in a sharp black suit with a white dress shirt and dark tie.

appearance_text: One half of this character looks like an ordinary man with short brown hair, a brown beard, a blue eye, a teal shirt and blue trousers. The other half is swallowed by solid black, with a single glowing green bar where the eye should be. Glowing cyan cracks run across the black parts of the chest, arms and legs. The back shows the same split, black on one side and brown hair and teal shirt on the other.
identity_text: A half-and-half figure: one side of the head is an ordinary bearded man with brown hair, the other is swallowed by blackness with a single glowing green bar for an eye, and turquoise light spreads in jagged cracks across the body.

appearance_text: A dark-skinned man in a black knitted beanie, with one wide white eye and a black patch strapped over the other. He wears a red uniform shirt with white cuffs under a black vest hung with a row of fat orange grenades, and the straps cross over his back. His red trousers are scuffed dark at the knees above heavy boots.
identity_text: The Demoman from Team Fortress 2 in red team colours, a dark-skinned man in a beanie and eyepatch with a grenade-strapped vest over a red uniform shirt.

appearance_text: A tall figure wrapped in a flowing purple robe, hood pulled up so deeply that only blackness shows where a face should be. Glowing pink light runs along the edge of the hood and down the front of the robe in a thin line. The robe darkens toward the hem and ends in dark purple boots, and the back is plain shifting purple.
identity_text: A faceless hooded spellcaster in a long purple robe lit by pink glowing trim. A generic fantasy mage, not a named character.

appearance_text: A soldier in a green and brown camouflage uniform with a matching soft cap pulled over his head. His face is pale with dark stubble around the jaw. A black vest is strapped across his chest, white bands circle his forearms, and the camouflage continues down the trousers into dark brown boots.
identity_text: A modern soldier in green and brown camouflage with a soft cap, a black chest vest and dark boots, with stubble around the jaw. The title names the job rather than a character.

appearance_text: A character with a pink pig head, black dot eyes and a broad snout, wearing a shiny gold crown with a little blonde hair poking out beneath it. A bright red royal jacket with gold trim and a grey sash crosses the chest, and the sleeves are patterned in white and grey checks. Deep blue trousers with worn patches lead to dark shoes.
identity_text: Technoblade, the Minecraft YouTuber, in his signature look: a pink pig head under a gold crown with a red royal jacket and blue trousers.

appearance_text: A boy with short brown hair wearing a green creeper mask with dark square eyes and a wide dark mouth over his face. He has on a light blue short-sleeved t-shirt with bare tan arms. Blue jeans with a grey belt cover his legs and he wears dark grey shoes.
identity_text: A blocky man wearing a green mob head as a mask, with his short brown hair showing at the back. Under the mask he wears the plain cyan t-shirt and blue jeans of the default Minecraft player.

appearance_text: A snarling cat beast with dark red fur, pointed ears and glowing green eyes set in a black mask. Its chest is black like a wrestler's outfit with a belt across the middle, and heavy black stripes band the arms and legs. Yellow claws stick out from its hands and white fangs show in its open mouth.
identity_text: Incineroar, the fire-type final evolution of the Alola starter line, shown as a dark red tiger-like beast dressed like a wrestler with a flame belt.

appearance_text: A character with the white feathered head of a chicken, an orange beak, a red wattle underneath and a wide black band across its eyes like dark glasses. It wears a smart black suit jacket over a white shirt with a red tie. The trousers and shoes are black and the suit is plain black across the back.
identity_text: A chicken dressed as a secret agent: a white-feathered chicken head with an orange beak and red wattle above a black suit, white shirt and red tie, with a dark band across the eyes standing in for sunglasses.

appearance_text: A blocky character with a bright gold square head, two deep black square eyes and a wide open frowning mouth. Below the head it wears a dark gold suit jacket over a yellow shirt with a black tie hanging down the chest. Matching dark gold trousers cover its legs and its blocky hands are pale yellow.
identity_text: A creeper, Minecraft's exploding mob, rendered all in gold and dressed in a dark gold suit jacket with a black tie.

appearance_text: A girl with very long pale mint green hair that hangs past her shoulders and soft pale eyes. She wears a long grey apron over a white shirt, and the apron and her sleeves are dotted with splashes of pink, yellow, orange and purple paint. Below the apron she has dark blue trousers and black and white shoes, and her long hair covers most of her back.
identity_text: An unnamed girl artist in a grey smock apron flecked all over with pink, yellow, orange and purple paint, with very long pale mint-green hair.

bottom: light blue and white checked shorts

appearance_text: A girl with very long light brown hair falling to her knees and two furry brown ears standing on top of her head. She wears a short light blue jumper with a little white bow at the collar, cut off above her waist so her tummy shows. Her legs are covered by light blue and white checked leggings, and she has small brown shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with two furry brown animal ears on her head and very long light brown hair, in a cropped pale blue jumper and checked leggings. 'Cookie Dough' is a flavour-styled aesthetic label, not a name.

blue stripes on the arms and legs

appearance_text: A person in a black wetsuit that covers them from neck to feet, with blue stripes running down the arms and legs and a blue collar. A yellow air tank with black straps is strapped across their back. They have dark brown hair and a plain face with pale eyes.
identity_text: A diver in a full-length black wetsuit with a yellow air tank on the back, dressed for underwater exploring.

appearance_text: A rugged man with short messy brown hair and stubble on his chin. He wears a well-worn tan shirt with the sleeves pushed up and brown straps crossing over his chest and back. Blue jeans held by a brown belt and dark scuffed boots complete the look.
identity_text: Nathan Drake, the treasure-hunting hero of the Uncharted games, in his usual field kit of a worn tan shirt, crossed shoulder holsters and jeans.

head: yellow cap with a white band

appearance_text: A stout man with a huge pink nose and a wide jagged black moustache, wearing a yellow cap with a white band across the front. He has a yellow long sleeved shirt with purple overalls buckled over it with round yellow buttons. His hands are in white gloves and his feet are in chunky green shoes.
identity_text: Wario, the greedy rival character from the Mario games, in his yellow cap and shirt, purple overalls, white gloves and green shoes.

appearance_text: A young hero in a tight suit of yellow, blue and black, with short black hair above a yellow mask and two blank white eye lenses. The chest and middle of the suit are black while the arms are bright yellow with blue pads capping the shoulders. The legs are black down to blue boots, and the same colours wrap around the back.
identity_text: Invincible, the young comic book superhero, in his yellow, blue and black costume with a yellow eye mask and blank white lenses.

appearance_text: A pale boy with fluffy white hair that spikes out around his head and hangs over bright blue eyes. He wears a long sleeved shirt in a black on black checked pattern, buttoned up to the neck. His trousers are plain black and he has small white shoes.
identity_text: An ordinary boy in a black-on-black checked shirt buttoned up to the collar, with spiky white hair, plain black trousers and small white shoes.

hair: two small buns at the back of the head

appearance_text: A young person with brown hair tied into two small buns at the back and bright blue eyes under a fringe. They wear a plain red sweater with long sleeves that covers the arms to the wrists. Blue jeans and white shoes finish the simple outfit.
identity_text: An unnamed young person in a plain red sweater, blue jeans and white shoes, with brown hair tied up in two small buns.

appearance_text: A bearded man in a dark grey hard hat with a round white lamp on the front. His skin is brown and smudged and a dark beard covers his chin. He wears a cream work shirt with the sleeves pushed up and a brown leather strap running over one shoulder and across his back. His trousers are brown with big pockets, and his boots are dark grey with yellow toe caps.
identity_text: A miner: a bearded workman with a smudged face, a hard hat carrying a lamp, a cream work shirt and heavy boots with yellow toe caps.

appearance_text: A big muscly creature whose whole body looks like cracked rock with hot orange lava glowing between the pieces. Two short orange horns curve out of the top of its head and pale glowing eyes sit above a wide dark mouth. Dark brown crusted patches cover its chest, back and legs.
identity_text: A hulking, muscular demon whose body is cracked rock lit from inside by orange lava, with short horns and a wide dark mouth. The listing presents it as a remade version of the artist's earlier Nether warlord, with no character name.

appearance_text: A fighter in a rounded orange helmet with a wide glowing orange visor where the face should be, and a dark blue guard around the neck. Grey and brown camouflage armour covers the chest and arms, with green pads on the shoulders and a strap running across the chest. A green monster face is painted across the back. The trousers carry the same grey and brown camouflage down to dark boots.
identity_text: An armoured fighter whose face is a wide glowing orange visor set in a rounded orange helmet, with a dark blue neck guard and grey-brown camouflage armour. The title names what he hunts, not who he is.

identity_text: Clank, the small robot sidekick from the Ratchet & Clank games, built from silver-grey metal plates with glowing green eyes and a red light on his head.

appearance_text: A man with dark brown hair, a black moustache and small pointed beard, and a pair of pale blue goggles strapped across his forehead. He wears a long white coat over a bright red waistcoat with gold buttons and a black cravat at the throat, and a black strap crosses the back. Dark grey pinstriped trousers reach down to plain black shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed Victorian-looking gentleman in a red waistcoat and pale coat, with goggles pushed up on his forehead.

appearance_text: A man with short brown hair, blue eyes and a neat ginger brown beard and moustache. He wears a cream coloured robe that wraps over at the chest with wide loose sleeves, tied at the waist with a dark brown belt. Tan trousers tuck into dark reddish brown boots.
identity_text: Obi-Wan Kenobi, the Jedi Master from Star Wars, in the cream Jedi robes and brown belt he wears in Episode III.

His trousers are black with red edges and he wears green and black shoes.
identity_text: Brendan, the male player character of Pokemon Emerald, in his white beanie, red and black shirt and green shoulder pack.

She wears a dark red top with a white stripe across the chest and puffed sleeves, one of them marked with a red rose, and a green band on her wrist. Her skirt is the same dark red and she wears tall brown boots with dark cuffs.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with hair falling white all the way down her back, dressed in dark red with a rose at her ear and another on her sleeve.

identity_text: A beach girl with long brown hair streaked pink at the front, wearing a brown swim top under a loose open pale blue shirt, with bare legs. The title is a bare first name, not a character.

identity_text: An unnamed teenager with bright light blue hair, wearing a pale blue jacket over a white shirt with a teal necktie, dark green trousers and light blue shoes.
