identity_text: An unnamed girl kitted out for exploring the woods in a grey-green jacket, belted brown skirt, backpack and heavy brown boots.

appearance_text: A boxy black blob creature with a smaller dark grey face cube peeking out of its front. Two bright purple square eyes and a tiny purple mouth sit on that inner face. The arms, body and legs are all the same soft black, with small pointed corners on top of the head. The back is plain black with no markings.
identity_text: A slime, drawn in black as an End-themed version of the mob: a boxy body with a smaller dark face cube peeking out of the front and glowing purple square eyes.

head: brown hair
top: brown robe over a black tunic

appearance_text: A young man with brown hair down to his shoulders, a thin braid at one side, blue eyes and a little stubble on his chin. He wears a brown robe over a black tunic, tied with a belt that has a small silver handle clipped to it. The robe hangs in dark folds all down his back, and his black trousers end in dark boots.
identity_text: Anakin Skywalker from the Star Wars films, in his brown Jedi robe over a black tunic, with a padawan braid and a lightsaber hilt on his belt.

head: small horns
hollow skull-like head
top: bare bony chest with showing ribs

appearance_text: A tall, starving-looking creature with pale grey skin stretched over its bones. Its head is dark and sunken with two huge glowing yellow eyes and a pair of short pale horns sticking up. The chest and back show bumpy ribs through the skin, and the arms and legs are thin and mottled grey and brown.
identity_text: A wendigo, the starving horned monster of Algonquin folklore, with huge glowing yellow eyes, a sunken dark face and ribs showing through its skin.

accessories: red sash tied at the waist
head: green and white striped bucket hat

appearance_text: A man with blonde hair and bright blue eyes under a wide bucket hat striped in green and white. He wears a long green robe with a yellow tassel at the chest, tied at the waist with a red sash, and a loose black jacket over the shoulders and arms. A small pouch hangs at his leg and he wears open brown sandals.
identity_text: Ph1LzA, the Minecraft YouTuber named in the listing, in his striped green and white bucket hat, green robe with a red sash and a loose black overcoat.

head: gold crown with a green gem
brown hair

appearance_text: A grinning man wearing a tall gold crown set with a green gem over short brown hair. His long red coat is edged in gold with gold buttons down a dark green front panel, and the red carries all the way round his back. He wears white trousers and short black shoes.
identity_text: A king character from a Minecraft parody of the Coldplay song Viva la Vida: a grinning bearded man in a gold crown and a red, gold-trimmed royal coat. The listing calls him only 'the king character', so he has no name of his own.

head: cream bunny hood with floppy ears

appearance_text: A girl with very long dark brown hair falling to her waist and blue-green eyes peeking out from under a long fringe. She is zipped into a soft cream all-in-one animal suit with a hood that has floppy rabbit ears. A round white fluffy tail sits at the back of the suit, which covers her right down to her feet.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in a soft cream animal onesie with very long dark brown hair. The rabbit is the costume, so this is a girl in a bunny suit rather than a rabbit.

head: grey hood down behind the head

appearance_text: A boy with messy brown hair falling over big dark eyes and pale skin. He wears a grey hoodie with darker grey sleeves and drawstrings at the neck, with the hood resting on his shoulders. His trousers are plain black and his shoes are white at the toes.
identity_text: An unnamed teenage boy in a grey hoodie with darker sleeves, black trousers and white-toed shoes.

appearance_text: A big blue character with bright blue skin all over and thick black hair and a black beard. He has huge white eyes and a wide happy grin. He is bare chested with muscly arms, wears shiny gold cuffs on both wrists, a red sash around his waist and dark red shoes.
identity_text: The Genie from Aladdin, a big grinning blue wish-granter with gold wrist cuffs and a red sash.

appearance_text: A girl with long wavy black hair that hangs down past her shoulders and green eyes. She wears a dark red jacket left open over a grey hoodie, with the hood bunched at her neck. Light blue jeans with rips at the knees run down to clean white trainers.
identity_text: An unnamed teenage girl in ordinary casual clothes: a dark red jacket over a grey hoodie, ripped jeans and white trainers. 'Farm Girl' describes a role rather than naming her.

hair: long grey hair with a fringe over the eyes

appearance_text: A very pale figure with long grey hair that hangs down over the eyes so the face is mostly hidden. The whole outfit is grey: a grey jacket over a black shirt, matching grey trousers and dark grey shoes. The long grey hair spreads down the back too.
identity_text: A very pale teenage boy whose long ash grey hair hangs over his eyes, dressed head to toe in matching greys. The title names his colour scheme, not a character.

appearance_text: A creature with a boxy teal-green scaly head, one huge eye with a dark red centre, and short orange spikes poking out of the top, sides and bottom of its head. It wears a sharp black business suit over a white shirt with a bright orange tie. The trousers are black with orange bands near the ankles. From behind, the head is covered in the same mottled teal scales and the jacket is plain black.
identity_text: A Minecraft Guardian, the spiky one-eyed sea mob, dressed up in a business suit with a white shirt and a bright orange tie.

face: dark eyes under a long fringe
hair: light blue hair in two long strands
head: soft pink checked hat
top: off the shoulder pale pink dress

appearance_text: A pale girl with light blue hair hanging in two long strands over her chest, and a soft pink checked hat pulled down over her fringe. Her long pale pink dress slips off both shoulders, leaving her arms bare, and reaches down past her knees. Pink bands circle her lower legs above white shoes.
identity_text: A pastel-styled girl with light blue hair in a long pale pink dress that slips off both shoulders, topped with a pink checked beanie. The title only describes the outfit.

appearance_text: A girl with a short grey-blue bob and two pointed animal ears of the same colour on top of her head. Her eyes are teal and pink marks sit high on her cheeks above a small brown nose. She wears a bright red jacket open over a white top with a teal collar, and brown shorts. Her legs are covered in tan and brown fur with dark stripes, ending in white and red shoes, and a big grey-blue tail hangs down her back.
identity_text: Michiru Kagemori from the anime BNA: Brand New Animal, in her beast form: grey-blue animal ears and tail, a bright red jacket over a white top, and striped furry legs.

appearance_text: A green-skinned undead figure with blank white square eyes and a dark gaping mouth, with a raw red wound on one side of its head. It wears a ragged blue shirt full of holes and green patches. Its brown trousers are torn as well, and it walks on bare green feet.
identity_text: The Minecraft zombie in a simplified, chunky style: green skin, blank white square eyes, a dark open mouth, a torn blue shirt and brown trousers, with a red wound on the side of its head.

hair: curly brown hair sticking out under the cap
head: white and red cap with a navy back
top: light green shirt with a pattern

appearance_text: A young boy with bushy curly brown hair poking out from under a cap that is white at the front, dark red along the brim and navy round the back. He wears an open blue denim jacket over a light green shirt with a pale leafy pattern down the front. Tan trousers cover his legs, ending in white shoes.
identity_text: Dustin Henderson from Stranger Things, in his trucker cap, denim jacket and tan trousers, with curly hair sticking out under the brim.

appearance_text: A person-shaped machine covered in blue plating over a grey metal body. A pale blue light glows behind the slot in its helmet where eyes would be, and a matching gem shines on the chest and on the back. Banded grey and blue plates wrap the arms and legs down to heavy blue boots.
identity_text: A person-shaped frost robot: a grey metal frame plated in blue armour, with a pale blue light glowing behind the slot in its helmet and a matching gem set in its chest. The listing presents it as a prototype elemental machine rather than a character that exists elsewhere.

face: big red patches on the cheeks
head: heavy plated helmet

appearance_text: A heavy, blocky creature encased in pale green armour plates. Its helmet-like head has two glowing white eyes and big red patches across the cheeks. Chunky plates sit on the shoulders and red panels run down the sides of the chest and back. The legs are red with dark purple showing between them.
identity_text: A heavy, blocky creature encased in pale green armour plates with glowing white eyes and red panels down its sides, presented by the listing as the ruler of a fantasy kingdom. No name is asserted because the title looks like an original character invented for this skin.

bottom: orange furry legs with black stripes
face: open smiling mouth with a red tongue
head: orange tiger head
black ears
top: black stripes across the back and arms

appearance_text: A cheerful orange tiger with a white muzzle, a big blue nose and a wide smiling mouth. Black stripes run across its arms, legs and all the way down its back, and it has black-tipped ears on top of its head. A bright red scarf is tied around its neck, and its paws are white.
identity_text: Tony the Tiger, the cartoon tiger mascot of Frosties cereal: a cheerful orange tiger with black stripes, a white muzzle and a red neck scarf.

face: green rot across one side of the face
head: pink pig head with a snout
top: bare pink chest with exposed white ribs

appearance_text: A pig-faced creature with pink skin blotched all over with green rot. Its chest is torn open so a row of white ribs shows through, and more bone pokes out of one leg. It wears only a pair of tattered brown shorts, and its snout and small black eyes sit on a half-rotted pink head.
identity_text: The nether's zombified pig mob: pink skin blotched with green rot, a torn chest showing a row of white ribs, bone poking out of one leg and a pair of tattered brown shorts.

appearance_text: A girl with brown skin and very long dark brown hair that hangs down past her waist, with a small pink bow sitting on top of her head. She wears a top with pink and white stripes down the sleeves and a big pink heart in the middle of the chest. Her grey jeans are held by a dark belt and she has white shoes.
identity_text: A brown skinned girl with very long dark brown hair and a small pink bow, wearing a pink and white striped top with a big pink heart, grey jeans and white shoes.

hair: long red hair at the back
head: red hair with a fringe
hair down the back

appearance_text: A pale young woman with red hair cut in a fringe at the front and hanging in a long point down her back, with big blue eyes and pink cheeks. She wears a plain brown dress with short sleeves that leave her arms bare. The dress darkens to a deeper brown skirt at the bottom, and she has short black boots.
identity_text: Granny Bacon as a young woman, the character from the Yogscast's Minecraft series on YouTube, with long red hair and a plain brown dress.

head: red hood resting on the shoulders

appearance_text: A boy with dark brown hair falling over his eyes, wearing a bright red hoodie with the hood down behind his neck and two black drawstrings at the collar. The hoodie has a pocket across the front and is plain red all over the back. His trousers are black and his shoes white.
identity_text: An unnamed boy with dark brown hair over his eyes, wearing a plain bright red hoodie with the hood down, black trousers and white shoes.

head: white cap with a black band
top: dark grey vest over the chest

appearance_text: An older fighter with white hair and a full white beard, wearing a white cap with a thick black band pulled low over blue eyes. His jacket is speckled light blue and grey camouflage with a dark grey vest and straps across the chest, and the back is covered in dark mottled patterning. He wears matching grey camouflage trousers and heavy black boots.
identity_text: A Rebel Trooper, one of the front-line soldiers of the Rebel Alliance in Star Wars, here an older white-bearded man in a black-banded white helmet and a strapped vest.

appearance_text: A girl with very long pale pink hair that reaches almost to her waist, front and back, and soft grey eyes. She wears a loose grey and white checked jacket over a short white top that leaves her middle bare. Below she has small blue denim shorts and grey checked leggings that run down into dark grey shoes.
identity_text: A teenage girl in casual street clothes, a grey chequered jacket over a white crop top with denim shorts, and very long pale pink hair. Nothing in the listing names her.

top: light blue checked shirt open over a black and white striped top

appearance_text: A girl with long wavy reddish brown hair that sweeps over one blue eye and falls right down her back. She wears a light blue checked shirt hanging open over a black and white striped top. Below she has a short dark red skirt, bare legs and little green shoes.
identity_text: A girl with long wavy reddish brown hair in a light blue checked shirt hanging open over a black and white striped top, with a short dark red skirt, bare legs and green shoes.

hair: black hair with a pointed hairline

appearance_text: A stern looking man with short black hair, thick black eyebrows, blue eyes and a very big bushy black moustache. He wears a white bodysuit with bright red sleeves and a red emblem across the chest, and a long red cape hanging down his back. His trousers are red and he wears tall white boots.
identity_text: Omni-Man, the moustached superhero from the Image Comics series Invincible, in his white and red suit with a long red cape and white boots.

face: big white eyes with black pupils
head: black floppy dog ears
small green hat
long tan muzzle

appearance_text: A tall cartoon dog with a white face, big round eyes and long black floppy ears hanging down each side, topped by a tiny green hat. Its long tan muzzle sticks out under a black nose with two big white front teeth showing. It wears an orange shirt with black straps over the shoulders that cross on the back, white cuffs at the wrists, blue trousers and brown shoes.
identity_text: A tall Disney cartoon dog with a white face, long black floppy ears and a long tan muzzle, wearing a tiny green hat, an orange shirt with black braces and blue trousers.

appearance_text: A boy with messy dark brown hair falling over his blue eyes, held back by a navy blue bandana tied round his head. His shirt is navy blue over the shoulders and white across the chest and sleeves. He wears black trousers and navy blue shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed teenage boy in streetwear, marked out by a navy blue bandana tied round his head over messy dark brown hair, with a navy and white shirt and black trousers.

accessories: pulled off red mask behind the head
head: messy black hair
red mask hood pushed back
top: red suit top with web lines

appearance_text: A pale boy with messy short black hair and a red hood pushed back off his head. He wears a red top covered in thin web lines with a black spider in the middle of the chest. His sleeves and trousers are blue and his boots and lower legs are red. The back shows the same red top with blue arms and a red mask shape behind the head.
identity_text: A pale, dark-haired boy wearing a red and blue spider-hero suit with the mask pulled off and hanging behind his head.

accessories: little white animal face on the back of the hood

colors.item: animal face patch on the chest
colors.name: white

head: long grey hair
small grey animal ears
top: white animal face on the chest

appearance_text: A slim character dressed all in very pale pink, with long straight grey hair and small grey animal ears poking up. On the chest sits a little round white animal face with dots for eyes, and the same face shows again on the back of the hood. The sleeves, shorts and legs are all the same soft pink, and the face has happy closed eyes.
identity_text: An unnamed girl dressed head to toe in pale pink, with long greyish hair, a hood with little ears and a small white printed character on the chest.

appearance_text: A slim light green creature with a big smooth head and two huge slanted black eyes that take up most of its face, above a tiny nose and a small dark mouth. It wears no clothes at all, and the same pale green skin covers its chest, back, arms and legs with slightly yellower patches here and there.
identity_text: A slim light green alien with a big smooth head and huge slanted black eyes, wearing nothing at all.

hair: short blond hair under the hat
head: yellow hat with a blue band

appearance_text: A small boy in a yellow hat with a blue band and a bright red feather stuck in it. He has big blue eyes and rosy cheeks, and wears a blue top with a wide white collar and a red bow at the neck. His arms are bare with white gloves on his hands, and he has short red shorts with bare legs below.
identity_text: Pinocchio, the puppet boy from the 1940 Disney film, in his yellow feathered hat, blue top with a wide white collar and red bow, white gloves and short red shorts.

appearance_text: A boy with messy dark brown hair falling in a fluffy fringe over his brown eyes. He wears a black t-shirt with a dark brown jacket hanging open over it, leaving his forearms bare. His trousers are cream coloured and he has chunky black boots.
identity_text: A boy with messy dark hair in a black t-shirt under an open dark brown jacket, with cream trousers and black boots. The title names the jacket.

bottom: tan waffle cone with a criss-cross pattern
head: pink ice cream scoop for a head
drippy melted top
top: pink ice cream dripping over the shoulders

appearance_text: A cheerful cone-shaped character whose head is a big scoop of pink ice cream with tiny black eyes and a wide open mouth. The pink ice cream drips down over the shoulders and arms like it is melting. Below that the whole body is a tan waffle cone covered in a criss-cross grid, and the drips run down the back too.
identity_text: A walking strawberry ice cream: a big pink scoop for a head with a wide grinning mouth, melting down over a tan waffle-cone body.

appearance_text: An old man with messy grey hair and a full grey beard and moustache, with bright blue eyes in a wrinkled face. He wears a teal short sleeved t-shirt that is scuffed and torn with a dark red stain across the chest and more marks on the arms. His trousers are dark blue and faded, and his shoes are grey. The back of the shirt is the same worn teal.
identity_text: Steve, the default Minecraft player character, shown grown old after a long survival run: grey haired and bearded, his teal shirt torn and stained.

head: thick black dreadlocks
top: green t-shirt with a yellow cross flag on the chest

appearance_text: A dark-skinned man with thick black dreadlocks framing his face and a short black beard around his mouth. He wears a green t-shirt with a small flag on the chest made of a yellow cross with black corners. His shorts are black and his lower legs are bare.
identity_text: Bob Marley, the Jamaican reggae singer-songwriter, with thick dreadlocks, a short beard and a green shirt bearing a Jamaican flag.

hair: long black hair down the back
head: white cap with a red band

appearance_text: A girl with long straight black hair falling down her back, wearing a white cap with a red band pulled over her fringe. Her top is a red sleeveless sports vest over a black undershirt, leaving her tan arms bare. Red tracksuit trousers with a white stripe running down the outside of each leg reach chunky white trainers.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in gym kit: a red sleeveless top, red tracksuit trousers striped in white, chunky white trainers and a white cap over long black hair.

head: yellow hard hat
white head lamp on the front

appearance_text: A tan man with a big grey beard and moustache, wearing a bright yellow hard hat with a round white lamp on the front. He wears an orange high visibility vest with straps over his shoulders and brown sleeves underneath, and there is a pack on his back. His trousers are khaki and his boots are brown.
identity_text: An unnamed miner kitted out for work underground in a yellow hard hat with a head lamp, an orange high visibility vest and khaki work trousers.

accessories: large pale blue wings on the back
head: dragon snout
small horns

appearance_text: A slim creature made of pale icy blue, with a long dragon snout, tiny horns and small black eyes. Its chest and legs are the same frosty blue and its hands and feet end in white claws. Two big pale blue wings are spread across its back with a ridge running down the spine between them.
identity_text: A slender ice-blue creature with a long snout, tiny horns, white claws and big pale wings spread across its back. No particular character is named.

head: dark blue alien head
gold crest on the forehead
top: blue gems set in the plates

appearance_text: A broad warrior wrapped in heavy gold armour, with wide plates over the shoulders and chest studded with glowing blue gems. Its head is dark blue with a gold crest and two glowing pale blue eyes, and there is no mouth. The gold plating continues down the arms and legs, banded with grey at the waist.
identity_text: A Protoss Zealot from StarCraft: an alien warrior in heavy gold armour set with glowing blue gems, with a crested head and no mouth.

subjects: young man in a blue jacket
top: white shirt with gold buttons underneath

appearance_text: A pale young man with curly dark brown hair falling over his forehead and dark eyes. He wears a dark blue jacket left open over a white buttoned shirt with small gold buttons down the front, and the jacket is plain dark blue right across the back. Dark navy trousers run down to black shoes.
identity_text: Joe Goldberg from the Netflix series You, shown as a pale young man with dark curly hair in an open navy blazer over a white shirt.

head: messy black hair covering the forehead

appearance_text: A boy with messy black hair that hangs over his blue eyes. He wears an oversized dark blue hoodie that reaches past his hips, with grey drawstrings and the hood down. Black shorts, black socks and chunky white trainers finish the outfit.
identity_text: An unnamed teenage boy with messy black hair in an oversized dark blue hoodie worn with the hood down, black shorts and chunky white trainers.

appearance_text: A girl with very long light brown hair that falls past her waist front and back, with a small orange clip at one side. Her eyes are pale green and her cheeks are pink. She wears a soft pale yellow short sleeved top over a long flowing cream skirt that reaches almost to her ankles, and plain white shoes.
identity_text: A girl in a gentle pastel outfit, a pale yellow short-sleeved top over a long skirt that reaches almost to her ankles, with very long light brown hair and plain white shoes.

head: pointed cat ears with pink insides

appearance_text: A cream white cat standing upright, with a dark grey mask across its face, dark ears with pink insides and striking blue eyes. Its paws and lower legs fade from white into dark grey, and a dark grey tail runs down its back. Its chest and belly stay soft creamy white.
identity_text: A Siamese cat standing upright, its creamy white coat marked with dark grey points on the face, paws and tail, with bright blue eyes.

accessories: grey shark teeth around the hood
hair: black hair peeking out of the hood
head: shark hood with teeth and fins

appearance_text: A boy wearing a dark blue grey shark hoodie with the hood pulled up, so a ring of white shark teeth frames his face and small fins stick out at the sides. Black hair and grey eyes show under the hood and his cheeks are pink. His trousers are black and his shoes are white with black soles. A shark fin runs down the back of the hoodie.
identity_text: A boy wearing a dark blue-grey shark hoodie with the hood up, so rows of white teeth frame his face.

hair: soft pink and light purple hair
top: pale pink and light blue top

appearance_text: A very pale girl whose soft hair is pink on one side and light purple on the other, falling in a long fringe over small grey eyes. She wears a pale top mixing pink and light blue, with faint light blue markings spreading across her back. Her leggings are pale pink and her shoes are white.
identity_text: A very pale girl built around a pastel bubblegum palette: hair pink on one side and lilac on the other, a washed pink and light blue top, pale pink legwear and white shoes.

appearance_text: A boy with dark brown hair and dark eyes dressed for school. He wears a navy blue knitted tank top over a white shirt with long white sleeves and a collar, with a red tie hanging down the front. Dark blue trousers reach down to brown shoes, and the navy tank top covers his back too.
identity_text: A schoolboy in uniform - a navy knitted sweater vest with a diamond pattern over a white shirt and red tie, with dark trousers and brown shoes.

appearance_text: A pale girl with long light blue and lavender hair that falls past her shoulders, with straight bangs over her forehead. Her outfit is covered in soft swirls of pink, purple and teal that blur together like clouds. The same pastel swirls run down her arms and legs, and the pattern carries all the way around her back.
identity_text: An unnamed girl whose entire outfit is a soft tie-dye swirl of pink, purple and teal, with long pastel blue hair. 'Fallen Flight' describes a look, not a character.

accessories: purple bow at the back of the head
bottom: tan checked band at the knees
hair: pale pink hair fading to white

appearance_text: A pale girl with extremely long pink hair that fades from soft pink at the top to almost white at the tips, hanging down past her knees, with a purple bow tied at the back of her head. Her eyes are light purple. She wears a blue grey jacket with a dark blue collar and long sleeves. Her trousers are the same blue grey with a tan checked band around the knees, and her shoes match.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with extremely long pink hair fading to white, in a blue grey checked jacket and matching trousers with a purple bow at the back of her head.

head: white beanie hat with a pink badge

appearance_text: A girl in a soft white beanie with a round pink badge on the front, with long pale bluish hair falling well past her shoulders. She wears a black sleeveless top with a pink scarf tied at the neck, leaving her arms bare apart from dark bands. Below is a short pink skirt, long pink socks and short black boots.
identity_text: Dawn, the girl Pokemon trainer from the Sinnoh region in Pokemon Diamond and Pearl, in her white beanie, pink scarf, pink skirt and long pink socks.

face: glowing yellow visor instead of eyes
head: pink helmet with a pointed crest
glowing pale yellow visor
top: round pale yellow gem in the middle of the chest

appearance_text: A figure sealed in bright pink armour from head to foot, with a pointed helmet crest and a band of glowing pale yellow across the eyes instead of a face. Its shoulders rise into pink plates and a round pale yellow gem shines in the middle of its chest. The legs are a softer pink with little yellow spots at the knees, and dark purple trim edges the plates.
identity_text: A figure sealed head to foot in bright pink armour with a glowing visor instead of a face and a gem in the chest. The listing describes the skin as belonging to the wife of the YouTuber BebopVox.

accessories: wide red sash belt with a gold buckle
footwear: navy blue boots with brown tops
top: navy blue robe with a white collar

appearance_text: A girl with brown hair and a fringe, tied back in a long ponytail that runs down her back, and bright pink eyes. She wears a navy blue robe with a white collar and a white cravat at the throat, cinched with a wide red sash and a gold buckle. Her skirt is navy blue and she wears tall navy boots with brown tops.
identity_text: Atsuko Kagari, the witch-in-training from the anime Little Witch Academia, in her navy magic-school uniform with a red sash and a long brown ponytail.

top: teal t-shirt with a white bunny on the front

appearance_text: A girl with long brown hair down her back and warm brown eyes. She wears a teal t-shirt with a little white bunny printed on the front and matching teal shorts. Her legs are bare down to teal shoes with purple soles.
identity_text: A long brown-haired girl in a teal t-shirt printed with a little white bunny, with matching teal shorts and teal shoes with purple soles. The rabbit is a picture on her shirt, not what she is.

bottom: black robe skirt over black trousers
top: long black robe with wide sleeves

appearance_text: A teenager with bright spiky orange hair and brown eyes. He wears a long black robe with wide sleeves and a white collar showing at the neck, tied with a white sash at the waist. A red strap runs diagonally across his chest and over his back, and the robe falls to black sandals.
identity_text: Ichigo, the orange-haired main character of the anime Bleach, in his long black soul reaper robe with a white sash at the waist and a red sword strap across his chest.

top: white and yellow patterns on the jumper

appearance_text: A girl with long brown hair that hangs past her shoulders and bright green eyes. She wears a dark green knitted jumper covered in little white snowflakes and yellow stars, with a red and white stripy scarf hanging down the front and back. Underneath she has a dark brown skirt over green checked leggings, and red and white stripy socks tucked into dark boots.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in a snowflake-patterned green Christmas jumper, with a striped scarf, a brown skirt over checked leggings and candy cane socks.

appearance_text: A wolf standing upright, covered in blue fur that is dark on the back and much lighter down the chest and tummy. It has pointy ears, bright blue eyes and a small black nose. Each paw is white with tiny claws, and a fluffy tail hangs behind.
identity_text: A wolf coloured like lapis lazuli, dark blue over the back and much lighter underneath, standing upright on the usual player shape with white paws and a tail.

appearance_text: A girl with long blonde hair that falls past her shoulders, with a small black bow sitting on top of her head. She has big blue eyes, pink cheeks and a little smile. She wears a light blue dress with a white apron tied over the front, and the long skirt reaches down to black flat shoes. Her hair hangs down her back as well.
identity_text: Alice from Alice in Wonderland, a blonde girl in a light blue dress with a white pinafore apron and a black hair bow.

head: short black hair
top: black tuxedo jacket with a white shirt front

appearance_text: This man has short black hair, light skin, a black moustache and a little beard along his jaw. He wears a black tuxedo jacket that opens over a crisp white shirt front, with a small red flower pinned to the lapel. The jacket runs plain black across the back, and he wears black trousers with grey shoes.
identity_text: A man in a formal black tuxedo with a white shirt front and a small red flower in his lapel, with black trousers and grey shoes. No character is named.

head: long peachy hair
white flowers tucked in the hair
top: pale green top with soft frills

appearance_text: A girl with long peachy orange hair that falls over her face, with little white flowers tucked into it and pink blush on her cheeks. Her clothes are all soft pale green: a light top with frilly edges and a matching skirt. Cream coloured long socks cover her legs.
identity_text: A peach haired girl in a soft pastel green top and skirt with cream socks and little white flowers in her hair. The title describes the outfit.

hair: long fringe swept over one eye

appearance_text: A pale boy with dark brown hair swept in a long fringe across one eye. He wears a black jacket with grey stripes wrapped round the lower sleeves, and dark grey jeans. His shoes are bright red with white edges.
identity_text: A teenage boy in emo style, wearing a black jacket with grey striped sleeves and dark grey jeans, his brown fringe swept across one eye, finished with bright red trainers.

accessories: wooden bow slung across the back
top: red and white stripes on the sleeves

appearance_text: A boy with short brown hair and bright blue eyes. He wears a black jacket with red and white stripes around the sleeves and a strap running across his chest, plus plain black trousers and black shoes. A wooden bow is slung across his back.

appearance_text: A figure whose head is a red block striped like dynamite, with a wide glowing orange visor and a black gas mask with round filters over the mouth. The chest and back are the same red block pattern, crossed by a white band with big letters on the front. The arms are banded red and white, and the legs and boots are heavy dark grey armour.
identity_text: An unnamed demolition soldier whose head and torso are built from a red explosive block lettered in white, worn with an orange visor, a gas mask and heavy dark armour on the legs.

face: eyes hidden by the long fringe
hair: very long cream white hair down past the waist
head: black cat ears
top: black hoodie with white striped sleeves

appearance_text: A girl with very long cream white hair that falls past her waist and a heavy fringe hiding her eyes, with small black cat ears on top of her head. She wears a black hoodie with white stripes banded around the sleeves and a short black and white checked skirt. Her legs are bare above chunky black boots, and a thin dark tail hangs behind her.
identity_text: A girl in a cat-ear headband with a thin tail, wearing a black hoodie with white striped sleeves over a black and white checked skirt, with very long cream-white hair and chunky black boots.

appearance_text: A pale-skinned man with short brown hair parted at the side and a huge open laughing mouth showing red inside. His eyes are two big black squares. He wears a pink short-sleeved shirt with a line of buttons down the front and a small black bow tie at the collar. Brown trousers held by a dark belt run down to plain white shoes, and the back of the shirt is plain pink.
identity_text: A pale man laughing with his mouth wide open, dressed in a pink buttoned shirt with a black bow tie and brown trousers. Not a specific character.

accessories: blue and pink dial on the chest
face: glowing blue and yellow shape on the screen
small green squares in the corners
head: pink television head
black screen with a blue and yellow glow
purple frame around the screen
top: white shirt with pink puffy sleeves

appearance_text: This character has a chunky pink television set instead of a head, with a black screen glowing with a blue and yellow blob in the middle and tiny green squares in the corners. It wears a white shirt with puffy pink sleeves under a black dungaree dress with a green button and a little blue dial on the chest. Black bands sit on the legs above black shoes with blue soles, and a blue round dial is fitted on the back.
identity_text: An unnamed TV-head character: a chunky pink television set in place of a head, its dark screen glowing cyan and yellow, on a girl's body in a black pinafore dress over a white puff-sleeved shirt.

head: black goggles pushed up on the head

appearance_text: A man with dark hair, a neat moustache and small beard, wearing black goggles pushed up on top of his head. His blue-grey vest sits over a white long-sleeved shirt, with a brown strap slung from one shoulder across his chest and around to his back. His trousers are pale blue and his boots are black.
identity_text: Skylord Lysander, a moustached airship captain from the Yogscast's Minecraft series on YouTube, in a blue-grey vest with flying goggles pushed up on his head.

face: small white bow at the collar
head: blue grey frog hat with dark eyes and bumpy grey lumps
top: blue grey pinafore over the shirt

appearance_text: A person wearing a rounded blue grey hat shaped like a frog, with two dark eyes on the front and bumpy pale lumps along its sides. Short grey hair pokes out underneath. They wear a white shirt with puffy sleeves and a small white bow at the collar, under a blue grey pinafore. The trousers are brown with a checked pattern, tucked into white socks and black shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed person in a blue grey frog hat, wearing a white puff-sleeved shirt under a pinafore with brown checked trousers.

appearance_text: A pale girl with very long cream-white hair that falls all the way down her back, and two soft cat ears poking up from her head. Her eyes are gentle and half-closed and she has a tiny mouth. She wears a soft white dress with a small pink bow at the chest, white cuffs on the sleeves, and long white socks that come up over her knees.
identity_text: An unnamed pastel cat-eared girl in a soft white dress with a pink bow, very long cream-white hair and white over-the-knee socks.

head: orange carved pumpkin head
top: dark blue and black plated armour with orange trim

appearance_text: A broad-shouldered fighter whose head is a carved orange pumpkin with eyes and a jagged mouth glowing bright yellow. The body is wrapped in heavy dark blue and black plated armour with thin orange lines tracing the edges and big plates over the shoulders. The armour continues down the legs to heavy boots, and the back is plated the same way.
identity_text: An unnamed fighter whose whole head is a carved pumpkin lit from inside, wearing heavy dark blue and black plate armour edged with glowing orange lines down to armoured boots.

appearance_text: A hairless figure with a smooth deep red face and glowing gold eyes, with a gold gem set into the forehead. The body wears a green suit lined with gold, with a gold diamond shape on the chest and gold bands at the shoulders and waist. A long pale yellow cape hangs down the whole back, and the legs and boots are green with gold trim.
identity_text: Vision, the Marvel synthezoid, with his smooth red face, forehead gem, green and gold suit and long yellow cape.

bottom: black trousers with rips at the knees
top: dark green jacket with rolled sleeves

appearance_text: A boy with short dark brown hair falling over his forehead and bright green eyes. He wears an open dark green jacket with the sleeves rolled up over a plain white shirt, and the jacket is dark green all across the back. His black trousers are ripped at the knees. On his feet are white trainers with black tops.
identity_text: An ordinary teenage boy in a dark pine-green jacket over a white shirt, with ripped black jeans and white trainers. No character is identified.

appearance_text: A tan-skinned man with a thick brown beard, moustache and purple eyes, wearing a shining light blue helmet over his head. A matching light blue chestplate covers his chest and shoulders, leaving his bare brown arms sticking out. Light blue leg armour and boots cover the rest of him, with pale shine marks on every plate.
identity_text: A bearded, tan-skinned man wearing a full set of cyan diamond armour with his forearms left bare. The listing names no character, so none is asserted, though the face is the familiar default-player one.

head: trumpet shaped ears sticking out from the head
bald green head

appearance_text: A big green-skinned creature with a wide flat face, heavy brows over white eyes and a squashed nose. Little trumpet-shaped ears stick straight out from the sides of its bald head. It wears a cream shirt with the sleeves rolled up and laces at the collar, with a dark brown waistcoat over the front and back, brown trousers with a belt and heavy dark brown boots.
identity_text: Shrek, the green ogre, giving a sideways look; he wears his usual laced cream shirt, brown waistcoat, brown trousers and heavy boots.

head: green head wearing a gold crown
top: red royal coat with gold trim

appearance_text: A green-skinned creature with a flat face and two empty black eyes, wearing a gold crown pushed down over its head. It is dressed in a long red royal coat with gold trim, gold buttons and a dark strip running down the front, and a gold streak marks the back of the coat. Below the coat are dark grey trousers, and its bare feet are pale tan.
identity_text: A Minecraft zombie dressed as a king, wearing a gold crown and a long red royal coat trimmed and buttoned in gold over dark grey trousers.

accessories: black bands round the upper arms
hair: flat black hair on top of the head
subjects: bearded man in a white shirt
top: white short sleeved shirt with black bands around the upper arms

appearance_text: A tan skinned man with flat black hair, small dark eyes and a thick brown beard and moustache covering most of his chin. He wears a plain white short sleeved shirt with black bands round the upper arms, white right across the back too, tucked into dark grey trousers held by a gold buckle. Tall black boots cover the lower legs.
identity_text: Jamie Hyneman, co-host of the television series MythBusters, in his black beret and plain white shirt.

footwear: white sneakers with a red stripe
head: long light brown hair
small green and white clip at the back
top: brown top underneath with a red and white patch

appearance_text: A girl with long light brown hair and a straight fringe, with big teal eyes and an open red mouth. A small green and white clip sits at the back of her hair. She wears a thick dark red winter jacket left open over a brown top with a red and white patch in the middle. Light blue jeans and white sneakers with a red stripe finish the outfit.
identity_text: An unnamed girl dressed for Christmas in a thick dark red winter coat, with little reindeer antlers and holly in her hair and a reindeer face on her top.

appearance_text: A woman in a bright orange jumpsuit with pale reflective stripes across the sleeves and chest. Her brown hair is tied back into a ponytail that hangs down her back, and she has green eyes and a calm face. The jumpsuit ends in shorts so her legs are bare above black boots, and grey and blue braces are strapped around her lower legs.
identity_text: Chell, the silent player character of the Portal games, in her bright orange Aperture test subject jumpsuit with reflective bands, a brown ponytail and long fall braces strapped to her lower legs.

colors.item: red dots on the hood and top
colors.name: red

head: white hood with red dots
motifs: red dots like sprinkles or strawberries
top: white hooded top with red dots

appearance_text: A girl with long dark brown hair that falls well past her shoulders. She wears a puffy white hooded top covered all over in red dots, with the same dots on the hood and sleeves, and the dotted pattern wraps right around her back. Her legs are bare and she wears small red shoes.
identity_text: A brown-haired girl in a dessert-themed outfit: a white hooded top spotted with red, finished with a sponge-coloured band at the waist. The listing gives only a descriptive title.

head: red mask with two small horns

appearance_text: A muscular figure in a dark red armoured suit covered head to toe in panel lines and shading. A red mask covers the top of the head and eyes with two small pointed horns sticking up, leaving the chin and mouth bare. The suit continues into matching red gloves and boots with a belt at the waist.
identity_text: Daredevil, the horned Marvel vigilante, in a dark red armoured suit with matching gloves and boots and a mask that covers everything above the jaw.

head: gold and dark red headpiece
light blue tufts
top: glowing round blue gem on the chest

appearance_text: A stocky man almost hidden behind a huge bushy dark red beard, with a gold-trimmed dark red headpiece and pale blue tufts at the sides of his head. He wears a dark red coat with cream shoulders and sleeves, and a large round pale blue gem set in the middle of the chest. His trousers are navy and his boots are brown, and the coat is plain dark red across the back.
identity_text: A stocky, heavily bearded sky captain in steampunk dress: a gold-trimmed dark red helmet, a dark red coat with cream sleeves and a glowing blue gem at the chest. The title gives his rank rather than a name.

appearance_text: A man with short brown hair and a wide pair of black sunglasses covering his eyes. He wears a dark grey and black suit with plated-looking shoulders and arms, a black and white checked band at the collar and a bright gold amulet hanging at his throat. His trousers are the same dark grey and his boots are dark red.
identity_text: SkyDoesMinecraft, the Minecraft YouTuber and Team Crafted member, in his trademark black sunglasses, dark grey armoured suit and gold amulet.

bottom: cream fluffy fur around the hips
head: short folded rabbit ears with cream fluff

appearance_text: A small brown rabbit-like creature covered in short brown fur, with a pink nose and tiny black eyes. Its short ears fold over and end in tufts of cream fluff, and more of the same cream fluff wraps around its hips like a puffy skirt. Its lower legs and feet are pale cream.
identity_text: Buneary, the small brown rabbit Pokemon, covered in short brown fur with a pink nose, cream tufts on its ears and a ring of cream fluff around its hips.

appearance_text: A man with washed-out grey skin, short black hair and blank glowing white eyes. His shirt is a faded pale blue with short sleeves, leaving his grey arms bare. He wears dull dark blue trousers and grey shoes, and the whole figure looks drained of colour.
identity_text: Herobrine, the blank white-eyed figure of Minecraft legend, drawn here as a colour-drained version with grey skin and a faded pale blue shirt.

head: plain black block head
top: black body with a bright blue glowing core

appearance_text: A completely black figure with a plain block head and two small white glowing eyes. In the middle of its chest a bright blue light burns like a power core, fading out into the black body around it, and the same glow shows on the back. Its arms and legs are solid black with no other markings.
identity_text: A near-black humanoid figure with small white eyes and a bright cyan energy core glowing out of its chest and back.

head: yellow hood with dark blue side panels

appearance_text: A figure covered head to toe in a bright yellow suit with orange armour plates over the chest, shoulders and legs. Dark blue panels sit on both sides of the head like ear covers, and pale blue eyes look out from a yellow face. A grey belt crosses the waist and grey boots finish the legs, with striped brown panels down the back of the head.
identity_text: Xisumavoid, a British Minecraft YouTuber, whose skin is a head-to-toe yellow-gold suit with orange armour plating, dark blue side panels on the head and grey boots.

head: hair split into pink and dark brown halves
top: black crop top with thin straps

appearance_text: A tanned girl whose hair is split down the middle, pink on one side and dark brown on the other, hanging to her shoulders. Big black sunglasses cover her eyes. She wears a black strappy crop top that leaves her shoulders, arms and middle bare, with short black shorts. On her feet are light purple shoes with mint green bands at the ankles.
identity_text: An unnamed tanned girl with half-pink, half-brown hair and big black sunglasses, in a black strappy crop top and short black shorts.

head: heavy bull head
curved cream horns on the sides

appearance_text: A heavy horned beast with a wide bull-like head, two curved cream horns sticking out at the sides and two big tusks under a dark snout. Its eyes are sunken and dark, and small teal spots dot the sides of its head. The whole body is shaggy mottled fur in dark grey, purple and green, with thick arms and legs ending in pale cream claws.
identity_text: A minotaur, the bull-headed beast of Greek myth, drawn as a heavy shaggy monster with curved horns, tusks and clawed limbs.

top: red jacket open at the front

appearance_text: A boy with short brown hair and bright green eyes. He wears a red jacket hanging open over a white shirt, with two white stripes banding each sleeve and white drawstrings at the collar. A large letter shape is picked out in darker red on the back, and he wears tan trousers with teal shoes.
identity_text: A teenage boy in an open red varsity-style jacket with white sleeve stripes over a white shirt, with tan trousers and teal shoes. The title names the garment, not a character.

colors.item: dot on the back of the head
colors.name: red

appearance_text: A character whose head is a dark grey block with two black square eyes and a grey band across the middle. On the back of that head sits a single glowing red dot. Below it is a sharp black suit jacket with a white shirt collar and a bright red tie, matching black trousers and black shoes.
identity_text: A Minecraft observer block used as the head of a figure in a sharp black suit and red tie, with the observer's red dot showing on the back of the head.

appearance_text: A warrior wearing a wide gold helmet with a dark red crest across the brow, showing only pale skin and dark blue eyes underneath. Layered dark red armour covers the chest and back, with heavy grey plates over the shoulders and guards down the arms. The legs are armoured in gold banded with red, ending in grey boots.
identity_text: An unnamed samurai in layered dark red armour under a wide gold helmet, with grey shoulder plates and gold leg armour banded in red.

appearance_text: A man with dark brown skin and very short black hair. He wears a white button up shirt with the sleeves rolled up to his elbows and a red tie hanging down the front. Below he has plain dark grey trousers and dark shoes.
identity_text: Louis, one of the four survivors from the video game Left 4 Dead, in his white office shirt with rolled sleeves and a red tie.

appearance_text: A weathered man with messy brown hair and a thick dark grey beard covering most of his face. He wears black padded armour with leather straps and a round buckle on the chest, and a single grey metal plate over one shoulder. His trousers are dark brown leather and his boots are brown and worn. The dark armour continues in overlapping plates down his back.
identity_text: An unnamed medieval traveller in dark padded leather armour with a single shoulder plate and a round chest buckle, his lower face covered by a dark cloth mask.

bottom: black trousers with white side stripes
footwear: red and black sneakers with white soles
head: short black hair

appearance_text: A boy with brown skin and short black hair, wearing a black puffer jacket with thick padded rolls, left open over a cream shirt. The jacket is plain black all the way round the back. His trousers are black with a white stripe down each side and his sneakers are red and black with white soles.
identity_text: A brown-skinned teenage boy with short black hair, wearing a black puffer jacket open over a cream shirt, black trousers with white side stripes and red and black sneakers. He is a generic streetwear teenager rather than a named character.

bottom: red and black striped leg warmers

colors.item: creeper face print on the back
colors.name: red

head: dark hood pulled up
top: red creeper face on the chest and back

appearance_text: A girl with long dark red hair and yellow green eyes, her hood pulled up over her head. Her black hoodie carries a bright red creeper face across the chest and a larger one across the back. She wears short black shorts, red and black striped leg warmers pulled up to the knee, and black shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with long dark red hair and yellow green eyes, hood up, wearing a black hoodie printed with a red creeper face front and back over black shorts and striped leg warmers. She is a person in creeper-themed clothing rather than a creeper.

head: white helmet with a wide dark eye slit
tan brim around the helmet

appearance_text: A figure covered head to toe in pale, chipped white plate armour. The helmet is rounded with a tan brim and a wide black slit where the eyes would be, hiding the face completely. Broad armoured shoulders, a brown belt at the waist and heavy armoured legs and boots complete the suit, which is the same worn white all the way round the back.
identity_text: An unnamed knight encased head to toe in pale, worn white plate armour, the face completely hidden behind a brimmed helmet. "White Knight" describes the armour rather than naming a character.

head: shaggy grey brown hair
top: pale yellow knitted jumper with a black jack o lantern face

appearance_text: A child with shaggy grey-brown hair falling over the eyes. The jumper is soft pale yellow and knitted, with a big black pumpkin face grinning across the chest, while the back is plain. Short black shorts and simple black shoes finish the outfit.
identity_text: A child with shaggy hair in a knitted jumper printed with a black jack-o'-lantern face, worn with black shorts. The listing names the garment, not a character.

head: pale grey stone mask covering the whole face

appearance_text: A figure whose whole face is hidden behind a chipped pale grey mask with narrow angry black eye holes and a wide black grin stretched across it. Orange hair shows at the back of the head. It wears a dark navy shirt buttoned up the front, tan trousers and grey shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed masked figure whose face is hidden behind a chipped pale grey-green mask with angry slit eyes and a wide black grin, wearing a dark navy buttoned shirt and tan trousers.

face: clouds where a face would be
head: blue sky head
white clouds
yellow sun at the back
top: sky and forest scene across the chest

appearance_text: Instead of a person this is a whole landscape stood upright. The head is a bright blue sky with fluffy white clouds and a yellow sun glowing round the back, and there is no face at all. The chest and arms show dark green pine trees standing on a strip of grass over brown dirt, with tiny orange lights glowing in the ground. The legs are grey stone shot through with blue ore specks and orange lava, ending in dark rocky feet.
identity_text: The Overworld of Minecraft standing upright as a figure: a blue sky head with clouds and a sun behind, a pine forest over dirt across the chest, and stone legs shot through with lava and ore.

colors.item: creeper face print on the back
colors.name: dark blue

head: messy dark brown hair
top: blue jacket with rolled up sleeves

appearance_text: A boy with messy dark brown hair hanging over his blue eyes and pale skin. He wears a blue jacket with rolled up sleeves over a grey shirt, and on the back of the jacket is a big dark creeper face with square eyes and a frowning mouth. His trousers are black with blue patches at the knees, and his shoes are blue and black.
identity_text: An unnamed boy in a blue jacket with a big creeper face printed across the back, worn over a grey shirt. The creeper is on his clothing, not what he is.

appearance_text: A girl with long blonde hair pulled into a braid down her back and bright green eyes. She wears a red top with a white rescue cross on the chest, leaving her shoulders and arms bare. Her white shorts leave her legs bare, and she wears little white shoes.
identity_text: A blonde lifeguard girl in a red rescue top marked with a white cross, white shorts and little white shoes. The title is her job rather than a name.

bottom: blue denim dungarees with shoulder straps
footwear: cream and brown striped long socks
hair: long reddish brown hair down the back
top: orange and brown striped long sleeved jumper

appearance_text: A girl with long reddish brown hair and a soft fringe over her eyes. She wears an orange and brown striped jumper with long sleeves under blue denim dungarees with shoulder straps buckled at the front. Her long socks are striped cream and brown, and her shoes are dark red.
identity_text: A girl with long reddish brown hair in an orange and brown striped jumper under buckled blue denim dungarees, with striped long socks. The title is a mood label for the autumn colour scheme.

hair: long pink hair falling down the back
head: long pink hair with a straight fringe
light blue bow and a red heart clip at the side
top: cream frilly dress with white ruffled sleeves

appearance_text: This girl has long pink hair with a straight fringe, a light blue bow and a little red heart clip pinned at one side. Her skin is very pale, her eyes are closed and her cheeks are pink. She wears a soft cream dress covered in ruffles, with big frilly white sleeves at the shoulders and a short skirt, leaving her legs bare above small pale shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with long pink hair in a soft cream and pink ruffled dress, with a blue bow and a heart hair clip, themed for Valentine's Day. The title describes her, it does not name her.

hair: light brown hair to the shoulders

appearance_text: A girl with light brown hair falling to her shoulders and grey eyes. She wears a reddish brown jacket left open over a plain white top, and a brown skirt with a check pattern. Dark brown boots come up her lower legs.
identity_text: A light brown haired girl dressed for autumn in a rust brown jacket, white top, checked skirt and dark boots. The title names the season, not a person.

head: white hood down on his back

appearance_text: A light-skinned boy with short brown hair swept over his forehead. He wears a puffy white hooded jacket left open, with two black stripes around each sleeve, over a dark grey shirt with a black collar. Black trousers with a grey belt and white shoes go underneath, and the big white hood hangs down over his back.
identity_text: An unnamed boy in streetwear: a puffy white hooded jacket left open over a dark bat-marked shirt, with black trousers and white shoes.

colors.item: curly moustache and eyebrows on the mask
colors.name: black

face: cream mask with a big curly black moustache
head: cream painter mask covering the whole face

appearance_text: A figure dressed head to toe in a plain red jumpsuit, with black straps crossing the back. The whole face is hidden behind a cream mask painted with thick black eyebrows, blank white eyes and a big curling black moustache and beard. Black boots finish the outfit.
identity_text: One of the red jumpsuited, moustache masked robbers from the Netflix series named in the listing. The listing names the show but not which robber this is, so the figure is left unnamed.

head: big fluffy black hair
top: yellow lemon printed on the chest

appearance_text: A tan skinned kid with a big mop of black hair hanging over the eyes. The white t-shirt has a bright yellow lemon printed on the chest and short sleeves that leave the arms bare. The shorts are orange with black camouflage patches, and plain white socks come up the ankles.
identity_text: A tan-skinned boy in a white lemon-print t-shirt, orange camo shorts and plain white socks. The title names the fruit on his shirt rather than the character.

head: white and light blue cap with a red stripe
top: red and white striped long sleeve shirt

appearance_text: A man with short brown hair and thick black glasses, wearing a small white and light blue cap with a red stripe. His shirt has bold red and white horizontal stripes that carry all the way down the sleeves and around his back. He wears plain blue jeans that go down to his feet.
identity_text: Waldo, called Wally outside the US, the striped-shirt figure hidden in the picture books, here in his red and white stripes, round black glasses and blue jeans.

appearance_text: A boy with short brown hair swept over his forehead and dark eyes. He wears a bright green hoodie with two little black strings hanging at the neck, green all the way round the back too. Below it he has black shorts, bare knees, and green shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed brown-haired boy in a bright green hoodie with black shorts and matching green shoes.

hair: blue hair with a white streak
head: blue hair cut straight across
top: blue jacket over a blue shirt

appearance_text: A brown-skinned man with a square brown beard and purple eyes, with blue hair cut straight across that has a white band running through it. He wears an all-blue outfit: a blue jacket over a blue shirt with a narrow white tie down the middle. His trousers and shoes are the same blue, and his back is plain blue.
identity_text: The Minecraft default character Steve, recoloured into an all-blue suit with a narrow white tie and topped with a blue hat. The classic Steve head - brown beard, purple eyes - is kept underneath.

hair: dark brown hair with a straight fringe

appearance_text: A man with dark brown hair cut in a straight fringe, bright blue eyes and a brown beard. He wears a teal short-sleeved t-shirt with bare tan arms and dark blue trousers. The shoes are grey, and the back of the outfit is plain teal and blue to match the front.
identity_text: Steve, the default Minecraft character, drawn here with extra shading on the teal shirt and blue jeans.

bottom: dark blue armoured legs with white ice bands
head: dark blue helmet with a pale icy band
top: dark blue chest armour with white icy plates

appearance_text: A warrior sealed in dark navy armour with sheets of pale icy white spreading across the chest, arms and legs like frost. The helmet is dark with a bright pale band across the brow and no face showing. The same frosted plating covers the back, and the boots are icy white.
identity_text: An armoured figure sealed head to foot in dark navy plate spreading with white frost, presented as a prince of an ice realm.

accessories: pink spotty bow at the neck
head: round furry head
pointed ears with white tips

appearance_text: A soft, fluffy animal covered in dusty pink fur with a cream belly and chest and pointed ears tipped with white. Its face has huge pale blue eyes, a little dark pink nose and a tiny mouth. A pink bow covered in white spots is tied around its neck, with the knot showing at the back. Its paws are cream and its fur looks patchy and cuddly all over.
identity_text: A fluffy dusty-pink cat with a cream belly and a polka-dotted bow at its neck, described in the listing as a circus cat.

head: wide brimmed cream hat
mesh veil hanging from the hat

appearance_text: A person in a full cream coloured protective suit with a wide brimmed hat. A dark mesh veil hangs from the hat brim and hides the face, with only the eyes showing through. Yellow bands circle the arms and waist, and heavy black boots cover the feet.
identity_text: A beekeeper in a full cream protective suit with a wide brimmed hat and dark mesh veil hiding the face, yellow bands at the arms and waist, and heavy black boots.

appearance_text: A big farm animal standing on two legs, with a black hide splashed with grey patches. Its boxy head has a wide grey snout with two dark nostrils, blank white eyes, pink lined ears and two short grey horns. A pink udder shows on its belly, and the same grey patches run down its arms, back and legs.
identity_text: A Minecraft cow standing upright as a player character, with a black and grey patched hide, short horns and a pink udder.

hair: light brown hair with a straight fringe

appearance_text: A boy with light brown hair cut in a straight fringe and bright blue eyes. He wears a light blue hoodie with a grey panel down the front and the hood lying flat against a big blue square on the back. Black jeans cover his legs, ending in blue and white shoes.
identity_text: A teenage boy in casual streetwear: a bright cyan hoodie with a grey front panel, black jeans and blue trainers. He is not a character - the title is only a first name attached to the file.

head: dark red hood over the back of the head

appearance_text: A boy with messy dark brown hair and dark eyes. He wears a dark red jacket with the hood resting over the back of his head, open over a white and grey hoodie with grey drawstrings. His jeans are black and his shoes are white.
identity_text: An unnamed teenage boy in a maroon hooded jacket layered over a white and grey hoodie, with black jeans and white shoes.

face: big white eyes with black pupils
head: yellow dog head
long dark floppy ears

appearance_text: A friendly yellow dog standing on two legs, with long dark floppy ears hanging down each side of its head. It has big white eyes with black pupils, a black nose and an open smiling mouth. A red collar is buckled around its neck and its body, legs and paws are all the same warm yellow.
identity_text: Pluto, the yellow cartoon dog from Disney, standing upright with his long dark floppy ears, black nose and red collar.

hair: red orange yellow green blue and purple stripes
head: long rainbow hair

appearance_text: A girl with very long hair striped in every rainbow colour, red at the front through to purple at the back, with one eye hidden behind her fringe and pink cheeks. She wears a light blue hoodie with a small rainbow picture on the chest, and the rainbow stripes run all the way down her back. Her jeans are dark grey and her shoes are white.
identity_text: A girl whose very long hair is striped in every rainbow colour, wearing a light blue hoodie printed with a small rainbow bolt, dark grey jeans and white shoes. The listing calls it a My Little Pony outfit, so the pony theme sits on her clothes rather than being who she is.

appearance_text: A tall figure with a blue face, glowing white eyes and a long grey blue beard and hair that hangs down its back. It wears a long dark blue robe scattered with tiny white stars like the night sky, with lighter blue sleeves on the arms. The stars carry on all around the robe, and the whole body glows faintly.
identity_text: An unnamed cosmic deity: a blue-faced bearded figure with glowing white eyes, wrapped in a long robe patterned like a starry night sky.

accessories: dark red flower on the lapel
hair: black hair swept to one side

appearance_text: A young man with black hair swept to one side and dark brown eyes. He wears a crisp white shirt with the sleeves rolled up over a dark navy waistcoat, with a small dark red flower pinned near the collar. His trousers are the same dark navy and reach down to dark shoes.
identity_text: Brendon Urie, the singer named in the listing, dressed for the stage in a white shirt with rolled sleeves, a dark navy waistcoat and a red flower at the collar.

footwear: light blue and white striped socks
head: light purple hair

appearance_text: A girl with soft lavender hair falling to her shoulders and gentle blue eyes. She wears an open white cardigan over a pale pink top, with a short pink skirt below. Long light blue and white striped socks come up her legs to white shoes. A pale blue backpack is strapped across her back.
identity_text: A girl in a soft pastel school outfit of white cardigan, pink skirt and striped socks, with shoulder-length lavender hair and a pale blue backpack.

head: spiky purple helmet
horns
motifs: glowing purple stripe down the back

appearance_text: A menacing armoured figure covered head to toe in black plates edged with bright purple. The horned, spiky helmet hides everything but two glowing pink eyes. Purple glows through the chest plate and along the spikes on the shoulders. A wide glowing purple stripe runs all the way down the back, and the legs and boots are black with purple trim.
identity_text: An original armoured warlord themed on the End: black plate edged and lit with purple, a horned spiky helmet and glowing pink eyes. The title describes the archetype rather than naming a character who exists elsewhere.

bottom: grey ripped trousers with green patches

colors.item: monster face print on the back
colors.name: green

top: monster face printed on the back

appearance_text: A girl with long ginger hair that falls past her shoulders and a soft fringe over her forehead. She has big pale purple eyes and light skin. She wears a baggy light green sweater with grey striped sleeves, and a green monster face with black eyes and a frowning mouth is printed across the back. Her grey trousers are ripped with green patches showing through, and she wears light green shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with long ginger hair wearing a baggy pale green hoodie that has a Minecraft creeper face printed across the back. The creeper is on her clothes, not what she is.

head: long flowing hair down the back

appearance_text: A girl with very long hair that mixes soft pink and pale purple, falling all the way down her back. Her eyes are light blue and her skin is pale. She wears a purple long sleeve jumper, matching purple leggings and purple boots with white cuffs.
identity_text: An unnamed girl dressed head to toe in purple, with very long hair mixing soft pink and pale lilac.

hair: short brown hair with a fringe
head: brown hair
floppy pink puppy ears on top

appearance_text: A girl with short brown hair and bright green eyes, with two floppy pink puppy ears sitting on top of her head. A little pink dog nose covers hers and a pink tongue hangs out of her mouth. She wears a baggy light blue jumper, blue jeans with lighter patches, and dark red shoes.
identity_text: A child wearing the Snapchat puppy filter: floppy pink dog ears on the head, a pink dog nose and a tongue hanging out. Under it is an ordinary kid in a baggy light blue jumper, patched blue jeans and dark red shoes.

face: no face, just black and white lines
head: head covered in black and white square spirals
top: black and white maze lines across the chest and arms

appearance_text: A figure with no face or clothes, wrapped entirely in a bold black and white pattern. Square spirals wind around the head and chest while tight stripes run down the arms and legs. The same twisting lines continue around the back so the whole body looks like one big maze.
identity_text: Not a character but a pattern: a figure with no face and no clothing, wrapped head to foot in bold black and white maze spirals and stripes that continue around the back.

bottom: blue and green scaly fish tail
hair: hair over the shoulders and chest
head: cream shell tucked in the hair
top: bare torso with hair falling over the chest

appearance_text: A girl with long brown hair that falls forward over her shoulders and chest, with big teal eyes and tanned skin. A pale cream seashell is tucked into the back of her hair. From the waist down her body becomes a fish tail shaded in blue and green scales that gets brighter towards the bottom. Her upper body has no clothing, only her long hair covering it.
identity_text: A mermaid: a girl from the waist up with long brown hair falling over her chest, and a blue-green scaled fish tail below, with a cream seashell tucked in her hair.

colors.item: pink pop-tart print on the torso (Nyan Cat body); no scarf
colors.name: pink

head: grey cat hood
cat ears with pink insides
top: pink pastry top with white sprinkles

appearance_text: A girl wearing a light grey hood with pointed cat ears lined in pink, her long light brown hair spilling out underneath and blue eyes showing on her pale face. Her top looks like a pink frosted pastry covered in tiny sprinkles, front and back, with soft grey sleeves. Her legs are wrapped in pastel rainbow stripes of pink, blue, yellow and green.
identity_text: A girl dressed in a meme-cat costume: a grey cat-eared hood with her long light brown hair spilling out, a pink frosted pastry top sprinkled with dots, and pastel rainbow striped leggings.

appearance_text: A tall bird creature standing on two legs, mostly red with soft cream feathers on its head and puffing out over its chest. Its face has a small yellow beak, bright blue eyes and red streaks running back from them. Grey bands circle its wrists and its feet are big and yellow with heavy claws.
identity_text: Blaziken, the fire and fighting Pokémon, a tall two-legged bird creature that is mostly red with cream head and chest feathers and heavy yellow clawed feet.

top: green backpack straps over the shoulders

appearance_text: A pale young person with short brown hair, green eyes and freckled cheeks. They wear a dark red long sleeved shirt with a green backpack strapped over both shoulders and hanging down the back. Blue jeans and simple black shoes finish the outfit.
identity_text: Ellie, the teenage survivor from the video game The Last of Us, in a dark red top with a backpack harness, blue jeans and black shoes.

face: white and light blue face patch
head: dark blue penguin head

appearance_text: A penguin standing upright with a dark blue head, a white and light blue face patch and a bright orange beak. It wears a red and black checked shirt over a dark undershirt, blue jeans and brown boots. A red backpack is strapped across its back.
identity_text: Penguin — an upright penguin with a dark blue head, pale face patch and bright orange beak, dressed like a traveller in a red checked shirt, jeans and boots.

top: black jacket with blue stripes on the arms

appearance_text: A boy with black hair falling over bright blue eyes, wearing a big blue scarf wrapped around his neck that hangs down his back. His black jacket is zipped up and has blue stripes around the upper arms. He wears tan trousers and black boots with pale toe caps.
identity_text: An unnamed boy dressed for cold weather in a zipped black jacket and a large blue scarf wrapped round his neck. The title only describes the scarf, so no character is named.

bottom: yellow green swim shorts with sunflowers
head: cat ears
striped orange head

appearance_text: A chunky orange cat standing on two legs, its fur crossed by bold black stripes down the back of the head and spine. Sleepy half closed eyes sit above a cream muzzle with a little pink nose, and small rounded ears poke up from the head. It wears baggy yellow-green swim shorts covered in sunflowers and nothing else.
identity_text: Garfield the cartoon cat in summer gear - a chunky orange tabby with black stripes down his head and back, sleepy half-closed eyes, wearing flowery green swim shorts and nothing else.

bottom: long dark brown skirt with gold studs
hair: hair down to the knees at the back
head: pointed elf ears
gold clips in the hair

appearance_text: A pale woman with very long cream blonde hair that falls almost to her knees at the back, held with small gold clips, and pointed ears poking through. Her eyes are big and blue. She wears a green top with gold plates over the shoulders and a pale cloak hanging behind her, above a long dark brown skirt studded with gold and dark brown boots.
identity_text: An unnamed elf queen with very long cream blonde hair held by small gold clips, wearing a green top under gold shoulder plates with a pale cloak behind her, a long gold-studded brown skirt and dark brown boots.

top: purple sweater with a white collar

appearance_text: A person with fluffy brown hair and purple eyes, with a red bow tied at the back of the head. They wear a chunky purple sweater with a white collar and white cuffs peeking out at the wrists. Plain dark navy trousers go all the way down to matching dark shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed child in a chunky purple sweater with a white collar, with a red and white Santa hat pushed back on the head.

accessories: yellow air tanks on the back
head: black helmet
grey visor across the eyes
top: black straps crossed over the chest

appearance_text: A worker zipped into a bright orange jumpsuit with black straps crossed over the chest and buckled around the knees. The head is covered by a chunky black helmet with a wide grey visor, so no face shows. Two yellow air tanks are strapped to the back, and the boots are black.
identity_text: The default orange employee suit from the horror game Lethal Company: a faceless worker in a black visored helmet with yellow air tanks on the back and black boots.

hair: short brown hair swept to one side
head: swept brown hair

appearance_text: A boy with short brown hair swept over to one side and bright blue eyes. He wears a short sleeved shirt in a bold black and white check pattern that covers his arms and back. His trousers are plain tan and he has black shoes.
identity_text: A boy with brown hair swept to one side, in a bold black-and-white checked short-sleeved shirt, tan trousers and black shoes.

head: messy hair
top: black and white striped long sleeve shirt

appearance_text: A young man with messy blond hair falling over his ears and red framed sunglasses across his eyes. He wears a long sleeve shirt striped in black and white, and pale blue jeans torn at the knees. Plain black shoes finish the outfit.
identity_text: Kurt Cobain, guitarist and frontman of the band Nirvana, in a black and white striped long-sleeve shirt, ripped light blue jeans and red sunglasses.

appearance_text: A warrior whose whole face is hidden behind a white demon mask with two curved red horns, red markings and a dark grinning mouth. He wears heavy dark grey and black armour with light grey shoulder plates, glowing red lines down the arms and legs and a round red and white emblem on the chest. An olive green hood hangs over his back and shoulders, and he has dark armoured boots with red spots at the knees.
identity_text: Genji in his Oni skin from Overwatch, an armoured ninja whose face is hidden behind a horned white demon mask.

appearance_text: A girl whose long hair is split down the middle, deep red on one side and pale cream on the other with pink streaks running through it, hanging well down her back. Her eyes do not match: one is yellow and one is red. She wears a short black top with white marks that leaves her arms and middle bare, light blue denim shorts, and tall black boots with white tops on her bare legs.
identity_text: A goth-styled girl in a summer outfit, with long hair split red and cream, a short black top, light blue denim shorts and tall black boots.

appearance_text: A smiling cowboy in a wide brown hat with brown hair peeking out underneath. He wears a yellow checked shirt with a black neckerchief and a white cow-spotted vest that covers most of the back. Blue jeans with a belt lead down to brown cowboy boots.
identity_text: Sheriff Woody from Toy Story, the pull-string cowboy doll in his yellow plaid shirt, cow-print waistcoat, blue jeans and brown hat.

head: messy black hair with a long fringe
top: open blue jacket with rolled sleeves

appearance_text: This boy has thick messy black hair that flops over his eyes, light skin and pale blue eyes. He wears a blue jacket left open, with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, over a plain white t-shirt. The back of the jacket is plain blue. His trousers are black and his shoes are blue.
identity_text: An unnamed teenage boy in casual street clothes: an open blue jacket with rolled sleeves over a white t-shirt, black trousers and blue shoes. The title describes the look, not a character.

appearance_text: A girl with long brown hair and brown eyes, with small green leaves tucked into her hair at the back. She wears an olive green pinafore dress over bare arms, with clusters of green leaves sprouting at each shoulder. Long white socks come up her legs above dark brown shoes.
