identity_text: A brown-haired girl dressed for the woods in an olive green pinafore with leaf clusters sprouting at her shoulders and leaves tucked into her hair, with long white socks and dark brown shoes.

colors.item: bands on the cuffs and waist
colors.name: red

appearance_text: A cheerful boy with tan skin, big brown eyes and thick dark green hair that sticks straight up in sharp spikes. He wears a green jacket with red bands at the cuffs over an orange shirt that shows down the middle of the chest. His green shorts have a red band at the waist, his knees are bare, and he wears chunky green boots with white laces.
identity_text: Gon Freecss from Hunter x Hunter, a cheerful tan-skinned boy with tall spiky dark green hair, in a green jacket and shorts with red trim over an orange shirt.

bottom: white stripe down the front of the legs
head: plain pale lime green head
black band under the chin
top: big white smiley blob across the chest

appearance_text: A plain figure coloured pale lime green all over, with a blank head marked only by a black band beneath the chin. Across the front of its body sits a large white rounded blob outlined in black, drawn with two dot eyes and a big curving smile. A narrow white stripe carries on down the front of the legs. The arms and the whole back stay plain pale green.
identity_text: A minimal, abstract take on the Minecraft YouTuber Dream: a featureless pale lime figure with his white smiley face blown up across the front.

head: red and purple flower crown
top: black top with a small cross

appearance_text: A pale girl with long wavy light pink hair that falls past her shoulders and covers one eye, wearing a crown of red and purple flowers. Over a black top marked with a small pale cross she wears an open red checked flannel shirt with the sleeves reaching her wrists. A short black skirt sits over black leggings, and small white shoes finish the look. The flannel covers her whole back in red and dark check.
identity_text: A pale girl with long wavy light pink hair wearing a crown of red and purple flowers, an open red plaid flannel over a black top, and black bottoms with small white shoes.

head: curly brown hair
top: pale blue shirt with rolled sleeves

appearance_text: A young person with curly brown hair falling over the forehead, purple eyes and pink blushed cheeks. They wear a pale blue shirt with the sleeves puffed at the shoulders, held up by dark brown braces that cross over the back and meet a belt with a round buckle. Dark brown trousers go all the way down into matching boots.
identity_text: A young farmhand in a pale blue shirt held up by dark brown braces and a buckled belt, dressed for a long day of work.

head: short brown hair
top: light blue t shirt with short sleeves

appearance_text: A boy with short brown hair cut in a straight fringe over pale eyes. He wears a plain light blue t shirt with short sleeves that leave his arms bare. Black jeans go down to white and grey trainers, and two black straps run down his back.
identity_text: An ordinary boy with short brown hair in a plain light blue t-shirt, black jeans and white trainers. Nothing in the listing or the render points to a particular character.

appearance_text: An orange fox standing on two legs, with pointed ears tipped in dark brown, a cream muzzle and half-closed green eyes. He wears a loose green patterned shirt with the collar open and a purple and blue striped tie hanging down the front. Grey trousers cover his legs.
identity_text: Nick Wilde, the fox from Zootopia, standing on two legs in his loose green patterned shirt and striped tie, with pointed dark-tipped ears and a cream muzzle.

accessories: red bow at the back of the hair
head: red bow tied in the hair

appearance_text: A girl with very long orange hair tied with a red bow at the back and bright green eyes. She wears a green and white striped shirt with a small brown shoulder bag hanging at her front. A grey skirt, white socks and black boots complete the outfit.
identity_text: A casual, everyday-clothes remake of Minecraft's Alex: very long orange hair tied with a big red bow, a green and white striped shirt, brown shoulder bag, grey skirt and black boots.

colors.item: creeper face print on the back
colors.name: dark grey

head: brown hair
top: creeper face printed on the back

appearance_text: A teenage boy with brown hair falling in tufts around his face and small black eyes. He wears a faded blue grey jacket with pale cuffs at the wrists, and on the back is a big dark grey face with square eyes and a frowning mouth. His jeans are plain grey and his shoes are white.
identity_text: A teenage boy in a faded blue denim jacket that carries a big creeper face printed across the back, worn with grey jeans and white shoes. The creature is only a print on his clothes, not what he is.

appearance_text: A character with soft grey hair that sticks up in two little tufts and hangs in a fringe over big black eyes. A plain white mask covers the lower half of the face. The whole outfit is dark red: a baggy hoodie with a hood at the back, matching trousers and dark red shoes.
identity_text: A grey-haired kid in a dark red hoodie and matching trousers, with a plain white mask over the lower half of the face. The title describes the look, not a character.

colors.item: bulging eyes on the sides of the head
colors.name: orange

appearance_text: A green scaly creature shaped like a chameleon, with mottled light and dark green skin all over. Its head has a raised crest at the back and round bulging orange eyes that sit on the sides. A pale white patch glows on its chest and belly, and a dark spiky ridge runs all the way down its back.
identity_text: A mottled green scaly reptile with a raised crest at the back of its head, round bulging orange eyes on the sides of its head, a spiky ridge down its back and a pale patch on its belly.

appearance_text: A short figure with a smooth blue head, two black square eyes and a little white dot on the forehead. Its body is wrapped in white and grey armour plates with rounded shoulder pieces and a panel down the back. The lower legs and boots are pale blue.
identity_text: The Leviathan outfit from Fortnite Battle Royale, shown as a compact figure in white and grey space armour with a smooth blue head.

hair: reddish brown bob with a fringe

appearance_text: A girl with a reddish brown bob and a straight fringe over warm brown eyes. She wears a teal jumper with a soft red scarf bunched at her neck, and loose cream trousers. Her shoes are dark brown, and her hair curves in around her cheeks and covers the back of her neck.
identity_text: Shizuku Tsukishima, the girl at the centre of the animated film Whisper of the Heart, in a teal jumper with a red scarf, loose cream trousers and dark brown shoes.

head: brown army helmet
top: dark green army vest with straps

appearance_text: A green-skinned creature with a flat face and two empty black eyes, wearing a battered brown army helmet. Its body is wrapped in a dark green combat vest with straps across the chest and padded shoulders, patched with mottled camouflage. The trousers are almost black with more camouflage blotches, ending in heavy dark green boots.
identity_text: A Minecraft zombie kitted out as a soldier, in a battered brown helmet, a strapped combat vest and mottled camouflage trousers with heavy boots.

appearance_text: A big brown robot bear with round ears, blue eyes and bright red circles on its cheeks. Its tan muzzle shows a row of square white teeth, and a small purple top hat tips over the back of its head. A purple bow tie sits under the chin above a shiny gold star badge on the chest, and the arms and legs are built from jointed brown segments with red bands.
identity_text: Rockstar Freddy, the animatronic bear from the Five Nights at Freddy's games, with a purple top hat and bow tie and a gold star badge on his chest.

hair: fluffy dark brown hair with a fringe
top: orange and red flames along the bottom and the sleeves

appearance_text: A boy with fluffy dark brown hair that hangs over his eyes. He wears a black short-sleeved t-shirt with big orange, red and yellow flames licking up from the hem and around the sleeves, plus a thin silver chain around his neck. Below that are plain black shorts, bare legs and chunky white trainers, and the flames carry on across the back of the shirt.
identity_text: An unnamed boy in a black t-shirt printed with big orange and yellow flames and a thin silver chain, with fluffy dark brown hair over his eyes and chunky white trainers.

hair: long white hair with pale purple shading
head: long silvery white hair
top: soft pale purple fluffy jacket worn open

appearance_text: A girl with very long silvery white hair that falls all the way down her back. She wears a soft fluffy jacket in pale purple, left open over a white top. Below she has a short black skirt, bare legs, tall white socks and little black shoes.
identity_text: A girl with very long silvery-white hair in a soft pale purple jacket worn open, a short black skirt and tall white socks. The title is an evocative label rather than anyone's name.

bottom: pale gold legs banded with red
head: pale gold helmet with a red stripe on top
top: pale gold chest armour with red panels
white glowing square in the middle

appearance_text: A hero in sleek armour that is mostly pale gold with bright red bands and panels. The helmet is gold with a red strip over the top and two glowing white slits for eyes, and a white square of light glows in the centre of the chest. Red stripes wrap the arms and legs and the same gold and red plating covers the back.
identity_text: Iron Man in the Mark 42 armour from the third Iron Man film, mostly pale gold with red bands and a glowing square light in the chest.

head: white pointed hood
top: brown leather straps across the chest

appearance_text: A figure hidden under a big white pointed hood, with only the lower part of the face showing. White robes hang down over the body with brown leather straps crossing the chest and back and a bright red sash knotted at the waist. Grey plates sit on the shoulders and arms, and the legs end in black boots.
identity_text: Altair, the hooded assassin from Assassin's Creed, in white robes with a red waist sash, brown chest straps and shoulder armour.

hair: long black hair down the back
head: orange fox hat with pointed ears and a snout

appearance_text: A girl with long black hair wearing an orange fox hat, complete with pointed ears and a little snout over her forehead. Her top is orange with red and white striped sleeves and brown straps crossing her shoulders, tucked into a brown skirt with a buckle. She has long cream socks and short dark brown boots.
identity_text: An unnamed black-haired girl wearing an orange fox hat with ears and a snout, an orange top with striped sleeves and a buckled brown skirt.

appearance_text: A muscly fighter with a giant orange moustache and beard, blue eyes and a grey spiked crown on his head. His chest is bare with a brown leather strap crossing it and a wide brown belt at his waist. He wears brown boots and his skin is pink.
identity_text: The Barbarian King, the hero unit from Clash of Clans: a muscular bare-chested fighter with an enormous orange beard and moustache, a spiked crown and brown leather straps.

head: long cream hair
soft cat ears
top: light purple jumper with a small purple heart on the chest

appearance_text: A girl with long creamy white hair and two soft ears the same colour on top of her head, with quiet grey eyes. She wears a cosy light purple jumper with a small purple heart stitched on the chest, and short white shorts. Chunky light purple leg warmers cover her lower legs above little white shoes.
identity_text: A pastel girl with soft cat ears wearing a lilac jumper with a little heart stitched on the chest. Not a named character.

top: open red and white striped shirt

appearance_text: A pale girl with very long blue hair that hangs past her waist at the back, with a soft fringe and warm brown eyes. She wears a loose red and white horizontally striped shirt hanging open over a plain brown top. Short white shorts sit at her hips, her legs are bare, and she wears light blue and white shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with waist-length blue hair, wearing an open red and white striped shirt over a brown top, white shorts and light blue trainers.

appearance_text: A furry creature covered in bright orange fur with a round head, pointed ears tipped in white and a white patch around a small black nose. Its eyes are black buttons and a tiny red tongue pokes out below the muzzle. The chest and arms are dark brown with a pale grey belly, and a long orange tail with darker bands runs down the back.
identity_text: A red panda: an orange furry creature with white-tipped ears, a white muzzle around a small black nose, a tiny red tongue and a long banded tail, with a dark brown chest and pale grey belly.

bottom: light blue shorts with little flowers

appearance_text: A tan skinned boy with short blonde hair and dark eyes. He wears a plain green t-shirt with bare arms and a thin necklace round his neck. His shorts are light blue with tiny white and pink flower spots, and his boots are striped black and white.
identity_text: A tan-skinned blond boy in a green t-shirt, floral light blue shorts and striped boots. The listing says he is the dancing man from the elevator scene of the Gangnam Style video, but nothing in the render shows that character.

head: brown cat ears with pink inside

appearance_text: A pale girl with very long dark brown hair that reaches her knees, with fluffy brown cat ears on her head and a big pink flower tucked into her hair. She wears a white top with a pink bow at the chest and pink cuffs on her shoulders and wrists, leaving her middle bare. Pink and grey striped socks come up over her knees and end in grey boots. Small white flowers are scattered down the back of her outfit.
identity_text: An unnamed cat eared girl in a cherry blossom themed outfit: a white top with a pink bow, striped thigh high socks and flowers in her very long brown hair.

appearance_text: A bone white skull sits on top of a smartly dressed body, with two big hollow black eye sockets and a small dark nose hole. The body wears a sharp black suit jacket with gold buttons over a bright red tie, and little white shirt cuffs show at the wrists. Black trousers and black shoes finish the outfit, and the whole back of the jacket is plain black.
identity_text: A skeleton dressed in a black pinstripe suit with a red tie and white shirt cuffs. 'Smart' in the title describes the tailoring rather than naming a character.

appearance_text: A traveller bundled up in a thick brown fur hat pulled low over bright blue eyes, with a dark red scarf wrapped round the neck. The heavy dark brown coat has padded shoulders and worn patches, and hangs down over dark grey trousers. Chunky dark brown boots finish the outfit, and dark red straps cross the back of the coat.
identity_text: A traveller bundled up for extreme cold in a fur cap, dark red scarf and heavy brown coat over sturdy boots. The title says where he is headed, not who he is.

head: long blonde hair
pink bow at the back of the head

appearance_text: A girl with very long blonde hair that hangs down her back, tied with a pink bow near the top. Her eyes are blue. She wears a plain cream sleeveless top that leaves her arms and shoulders bare, with brown bracelets on both wrists, and a short light blue denim skirt. Her legs are bare down to brown strappy sandals.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with very long blonde hair tied with a pink bow, in a cream sleeveless top, a short light blue denim garment and brown strappy sandals.

head: bare head with white hair
top: gold shoulder armour over a gold tunic

appearance_text: An old man with fluffy white hair, a long white beard and glowing white eyes. He wears gold shoulder armour over a gold tunic with a white sash crossing his chest and a blue stone set into his belt. Below that is a light blue and white skirt, white wraps around his shins and heavy brown boots.
identity_text: Zeus, the Greek god of sky and thunder, shown as a white-haired elder in gold shoulder armour with a white sash across his chest and a light blue and white skirt.

appearance_text: A tall shadowy figure whose whole body is smooth black with no clothes or details, front and back. Where its face should be sits a pale white oval mask with two thin dark slits for eyes, a small dark mouth and soft purple marks on the cheeks and forehead. The black of its head wraps around the mask like a hood, and its arms and legs fade into the same darkness.
identity_text: No-Face from the film Spirited Away, a tall shadowy black figure whose face is a pale oval mask with two narrow eye slits, a small dark mouth and purple markings.

accessories: flowers in the hair at the back
bottom: long green skirt split at the front
head: pink flower crown on one side of the head

appearance_text: A pale girl with long wavy brown hair, one thick braid over her shoulder and soft pink flowers tucked in above her ear and at the back of her head. Her eyes are green. She wears a long sleeveless green dress with a white sash, the skirt split at the front to show a white underskirt, and green boots on her feet.
identity_text: An elf girl in a long green medieval dress with a white sash and a split skirt over a white underskirt, her brown hair braided and threaded with pink flowers.

head: long blonde hair
top: white top with red striped sleeves

appearance_text: A girl with long blonde hair that falls past her shoulders, with a few grey strands and a fringe over light green eyes. She wears a white top whose short sleeves are banded with red stripes, and a plain black skirt. Her legs are covered by dark brown thigh high socks over black shoes, and her long hair hangs down her back.
identity_text: A girl with long blonde hair in a white top with red banded sleeves, a black skirt and brown thigh-high socks. The title describes the stripes rather than naming her.

accessories: small pink tail on the back
head: pink hood with round animal ears

appearance_text: A girl with long straight black hair that falls down her back and a straight fringe over pale skin. She is dressed in a soft pink animal onesie with a white patch on the chest and belly and a hood with round ears on top. The legs of the onesie are pink too, and a small round pink tail sticks out at the back.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with long straight black hair wearing a pink panda onesie with a white belly patch, an eared hood and a little round tail. She is a girl in a costume, not a panda.

appearance_text: A brown bear standing on two legs, with round ears on top of its head, small black eyes and a big black nose on a lighter muzzle. It wears blue dungarees with a bib and a small pocket, straps crossing over its furry back. The trousers run down to chunky black boots, and thick brown fur covers its arms.
identity_text: A brown bear standing on two legs in blue denim dungarees, dressed ready for work on the farm.

face: two glowing red lights stacked where the eyes go
head: boxy tan head
dark face panel

appearance_text: A sturdy robot built from tan metal plates over dark brown limbs. Its boxy head has a dark panel across the middle with two glowing red lights stacked where its eyes would be, and no mouth. A round gold emblem sits in the centre of its chest and again on its back, and heavy plating covers its shoulders, arms and legs down to dark metal feet.
identity_text: A Tau Pathfinder from the Warhammer universe, shown as a fully armoured figure in tan plating with a gold emblem on the chest and two red lights where its eyes would be.

appearance_text: A tall creature covered all over in green watermelon skin with lighter green stripes running down its body, arms and legs. Its big square head has two glowing red eyes and a wide red mouth stretched across it. The hands are bright red like the inside of a melon, and the striped pattern carries around to the back.
identity_text: A tall monster whose entire body is patterned like watermelon rind, with glowing red eyes, a wide red grin and red hands like melon flesh.

bottom: grey rocky legs with green glowing cracks
face: no face, only stone and glowing cracks
head: grey stone head with green glowing cracks
top: glowing green cracks across the arms

appearance_text: A blocky creature whose whole body is built from chunks of dark grey stone, with no eyes or mouth to be seen. Bright glowing green cracks snake between every rock, over the head, chest, arms and legs. The same glowing green lines run all the way down the back, making it look like something cracked open and lit from inside.
identity_text: A faceless creature made entirely of dark grey stone blocks, with bright green light glowing out of the cracks between them, front and back. The title is a mood word rather than a name for the creature.

head: pale bone skull mask with pointed sides

appearance_text: A fighter whose whole head is hidden inside a pale cream skull mask with two deep dark eye holes and a dark snout. Green camouflage plates cover the shoulders and arms, while the chest is bare orange-brown skin crossed with straps. Around the waist are green camouflage shorts with a shaggy dark brown fringe hanging down, and the legs below are bare.
identity_text: A pig-snouted humanoid warrior in green camouflage armour, with a bare orange-brown chest, chest straps and a shaggy fringed skirt over bare legs.

head: long hair falling past the shoulders

appearance_text: A slim girl with extremely long pink hair streaked with lavender that hangs all the way down her back to her ankles. She has big light blue eyes and pale cream skin, and wears a blue off-shoulder top with a little flower at the chest and bands around her arms. Below that is a long soft pink skirt, and her bare feet have dark blue straps around the ankles.
identity_text: An unnamed pastel girl with extremely long pink and lavender hair, a blue off-shoulder top and a long pink skirt. 'Goddess' is a flattering title, not a character.

motifs: stripes on the sleeves and legs
subjects: girl with long light blue hair
top: pink top with a white panel across the chest

appearance_text: A very pale girl with extremely long light blue hair that hangs in a straight fringe over purple eyes and falls all the way down her back. She wears a pink top with a white panel and a small gold clasp at the chest, with dark purple striped sleeves on both arms. Striped shorts and matching striped stockings cover her legs down to dark purple boots.
identity_text: Jinx from League of Legends, drawn here as a pale girl with extremely long light blue hair in a pink and purple striped outfit.

appearance_text: A skinny stick figure drawn in black lines, as if sketched onto a page. Its whole body is white and covered in pale blue ruled lines with a red margin stripe running down one side and down the back. The head is a plain white square with a small drawn smiley face and two dot eyes. Thin black outlines mark out the arms, body and legs.
identity_text: A stickman doodle: the whole figure is white notebook paper with pale blue rules and a red margin stripe, with a black pen outline and a small smiley face. Not a named character.

hair: long dark brown hair down the front and back
head: cream animal hood with rounded ears
pink inner ears

appearance_text: A pale girl with long dark brown hair falling over her shoulders and down her back, snuggled in a soft cream animal onesie. The hood has rounded ears with pink insides, and a slightly paler patch covers the tummy. The sleeves end in white paws and so do the feet, with a small tail at the back.
identity_text: A girl with long dark brown hair snuggled into a soft cream animal onesie with rounded ears, paw cuffs and a little tail.

appearance_text: A pale man with short brown hair combed forward and small dark eyes, with a plain calm face. He wears a short sleeved shirt with a collar, striped in blue and grey bands that wrap all the way around. His trousers are plain black and so are his shoes. The back of the shirt carries the same stripes.
identity_text: An unnamed ordinary man in a blue and grey striped collared shirt with plain black trousers.

accessories: brown leather straps across the chest
head: red bandana tied round the head
small bead hanging by the face
top: off white shirt under a dark blue waistcoat

appearance_text: A scruffy pirate with long brown dreadlocked hair held back by a red bandana, a drooping moustache and a small pointed beard, with a little bead dangling beside his face. He wears a grubby off white shirt under a dark blue waistcoat, with two brown leather straps crossed over his chest and a belt at his waist. Brown trousers and dark brown boots finish it off.
identity_text: Captain Jack Sparrow from the Pirates of the Caribbean films, with his red bandana, dreadlocked hair, beaded beard and crossed leather straps.

face: face hidden behind a dark mask
head: deep dark hood

appearance_text: A tall figure hidden inside a deep dark grey hood, with only two pale glowing eyes showing above a black cloth mask. The heavy cloak has layered armour panels across the chest and grey bands wrapped around the upper arms. Brown leather straps cross the forearms and a brown belt holds the dark grey trousers, which end in heavy brown boots.
identity_text: A tall figure buried in a dark grey hood and cloak, face hidden behind a black mask with only pale glowing eyes showing, with leather straps on the forearms and heavy brown boots. A generic fantasy assassin, not a named one.

top: black and white striped long sleeves

appearance_text: A pale boy with messy pink hair and green eyes. He wears a dark brown t-shirt pulled over a long sleeve top with black and white stripes on the arms. His light blue jeans are ripped at the knees and he has chunky black shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed teenage boy in e-boy street style, with dusty pink hair, a dark brown tee pulled over black and white striped sleeves, ripped light blue jeans and chunky black shoes.

appearance_text: A girl with long black hair and green sunglasses covering her eyes. She wears a black sleeveless top that leaves her tan arms bare, with a small gold clasp at the waist. Her skirt is green tartan check with a white chain looping down one side, and she wears chunky black boots with gold buckles.
identity_text: An unnamed punk-styled girl with long black hair, in a black sleeveless top, a green tartan skirt hung with a chain, and chunky black buckled boots.

face: screen showing green hills under a blue sky
head: boxy computer monitor for a head

appearance_text: A slim girl whose head has been replaced by a chunky grey computer monitor. Its screen shows a bright blue sky above rolling green hills. Long light brown hair falls from behind the monitor down her back. She wears a simple cream dress with short sleeves, white socks and small grey shoes.
identity_text: A girl whose head is an old beige computer monitor showing the classic Windows XP desktop wallpaper of green hills under a blue sky.

accessories: dark red cape down the back
head: dark helmet with two pointed ears
full face mask

appearance_text: A dark helmeted figure with two pointed ears on top of the head and big glowing yellow goggle eyes above a grey grille over the mouth. The body is covered in grey metal plate armour with brown leather straps and gold buckles across the chest and shoulders. The legs are armoured too, ending in dark metal boots. A long dark red cape hangs all the way down the back.
identity_text: Batman reimagined in steampunk armour: an eared helmet with glowing goggle eyes and a mouth grille, riveted plating, and a long dark red cape.

appearance_text: A boy with short black hair and bright blue eyes. He wears an open black jacket over a white hoodie, with the white hood bunched at the back of his neck. His shorts are dark grey and torn at the edges, and he has white socks and white shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed boy with short black hair in an open black jacket over a white hoodie, with torn dark shorts and white shoes.

head: red mushroom cap helmet with white spots

appearance_text: A short stocky fighter whose head is a big red mushroom cap dotted with white, with a pale white underside where two small dark eyes peek out. The body wears worn brown leather armour with a strap running across the chest and padded shoulders. Brown trousers and tall dark brown boots finish the outfit.
identity_text: A short, stocky fighter whose whole head is a red spotted toadstool cap, kitted out in worn brown leather armour and tall boots. The title describes the figure rather than naming a particular character.

head: dark red bandana tied round the head
top: dark blue waistcoat over the shirt

appearance_text: A tanned man with long dark dreadlocked hair under a dark red bandana, black rimmed eyes and a braided beard and moustache, with tiny beads tucked into his hair. He wears a loose cream shirt with a dark blue waistcoat over it and a wide brown belt with a buckle at the waist. Dark blue trousers tuck into scuffed dark brown boots.
identity_text: Captain Jack Sparrow, the pirate captain from the Pirates of the Caribbean films, in his red bandana, dreadlocks and dark waistcoat.

accessories: small yellow and blue hair clip
hair: very long flowing pink hair reaching past the waist
head: pink hood down at the back

appearance_text: A girl whose very long pink hair flows all the way down past her waist, covering most of her back. She wears a soft pink zip-up hoodie with the hood resting behind her head, and a tiny yellow and blue clip in her hair. Below is a short dark blue skirt over pink leggings, ending in brown boots. Her eyes are pale blue with dark liner.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with very long flowing pink hair, dressed to match in a pink zip-up hoodie, a dark blue skirt over pink leggings and brown boots.

head: red visor
black headpiece
top: pink glowing spider shape on the chest

appearance_text: A tall woman with pale blue skin and a very long dark blue ponytail that hangs all the way down her back. A red visor sits across her forehead under a black headpiece, and her eyes glow white. She wears a tight purple and grey suit with armour plates on the shoulders and a glowing pink spider shape spread across the chest, with grey armoured legs and boots.
identity_text: Widowmaker, the blue-skinned sniper from Overwatch, in her purple and grey armoured bodysuit with the glowing spider mark on the chest.

head: white helmet with pointed ears
glowing light blue visor
top: glowing blue panels on the arms

appearance_text: A tall armoured figure with a white helmet that has two pointed ears and a wide glowing light blue visor where the eyes should be, with a red grille across the mouth. White and grey plates cover the chest, shoulders and back over a black under-suit, and bright blue panels glow along the arms. The legs are armoured in grey with glowing blue strips running down to heavy boots.
identity_text: An unnamed armoured figure in a white and grey powered suit over a black under-suit, with glowing cyan panels and a red mouth grille. The listing sells it as high-tech diamond armour rather than any particular character.

footwear: brown strappy sandals laced up the legs
head: orange and teal flowers in the hair
top: teal and orange flowers on the chest

appearance_text: A girl with long wavy brown hair, tan skin and dark eyes, with bright orange and teal flowers tucked into the top and back of her hair. She wears a white top that sits off the shoulders with a few teal and orange flowers across the chest, and short blue denim shorts. Brown strappy sandals lace part of the way up her legs.
identity_text: A tanned girl dressed for summer in a white off-the-shoulder top scattered with teal and orange flowers, blue denim shorts and woven brown sandals, with a matching flower crown in her hair.

head: tall pink and white bunny ears

appearance_text: A girl with long wavy light brown hair and two tall pink and white bunny ears standing up on her head. Her cheeks are pink and her eyes are dark. She wears a long pink hoodie with white cuffs at the wrists that reaches down over the tops of her bare legs, with white socks and black and white shoes.
identity_text: A girl in a long pink hoodie with white cuffs and stripes, wearing tall pink and white bunny ears on her head, with white socks and black and white shoes.

head: white flower crown
top: pale blue and white dance dress

appearance_text: A girl with brown hair pinned up under a ring of little white flowers. She wears a sleeveless dance dress that is pale blue on top and white in the short frilly skirt, leaving her arms and legs bare. Light blue ballet slippers cover her feet, and the back of the dress is laced up.
identity_text: A ballet dancer in a pale blue and white tutu dress with light blue slippers and a ring of white flowers in her pinned-up brown hair. The title names her art form rather than a character.

appearance_text: A smiling kid in a red and blue striped beanie with a matching striped shirt. He has a round red nose, rosy cheeks and a wide grin across his face. Blue denim overalls cover his legs and he wears brown shoes.
identity_text: Balloon Boy, the grinning animatronic child from Five Nights at Freddy's, in his red and blue striped propeller beanie and matching shirt with blue denim overalls.

head: dark grey blank head
top: white shirt with a red tie

appearance_text: A dark figure with a rough grey stone-like face marked only by two black slots for eyes and a straight black line for a mouth. It wears a smart black suit jacket over a white shirt with a bright red tie, with white cuffs and tiny gold buttons at the wrists. The trousers are the same black as the jacket.
identity_text: The avatar of the Minecraft YouTuber Grox: a figure in a black suit and red tie whose face is a blank dark grey slab with slot eyes.

head: deep blue hood pulled up over the head
top: dark gold panel down the front
glowing light blue lightning bolt across the back

appearance_text: A hooded figure in a blue robe whose face is swallowed by shadow apart from two glowing yellow eyes. A dark gold panel runs down the front of the robe from the chest to the hem. Across the whole back is a bright light blue lightning bolt that seems to glow, and the boots at the bottom are blue.
identity_text: An unnamed hooded mage in a blue robe with a dark gold panel down the front and a glowing lightning bolt across the back.

hair: hair covering the forehead and the back of the neck
top: red and white patterned hoodie underneath

appearance_text: A young person whose hair is a bright checkerboard of red, green, orange, blue and yellow, covering the forehead and hanging down the back of the neck. They wear an open light blue denim jacket over a red and white patterned hoodie. Their trousers are dark green with a small orange mark low down, and their shoes are white.
identity_text: The American rapper 6ix9ine, recognisable by his rainbow checkerboard hair, wearing a denim jacket over a red and white patterned hoodie.

head: eyeless head
two short horns
glowing orange band across the face
top: bare purple chest with glowing orange ribs

appearance_text: A tall hulking creature with a dark purple body and no eyes at all. Its head has two short horns and a glowing orange band across the face, and glowing orange stripes run over its shoulders and down its chest like ribs. The heavy arms and legs are mottled grey purple, and more glowing orange marks show on its back.
identity_text: The Warden, the blind boss mob of Minecraft's Deep Dark, recoloured here in dark purple with orange glow in place of the usual blue-green.

colors.item: stripes on the sleeves and hem
colors.name: white

motifs: small white chevron on the chest
top: black long sleeve top with white stripes

appearance_text: A pale boy with dark brown hair falling in a fringe over black eyes. He wears a black long sleeve top with white bands around the sleeves and hem and a small white chevron marking on the chest. His jeans are grey and his shoes are black with white flecks.
identity_text: An unnamed boy in a black long sleeve top banded with white at the sleeves and hem, with grey jeans and black shoes.

head: long dark blue hair down the back

appearance_text: A girl with very long dark blue hair that hangs straight down past her waist, front and back. She wears a baggy bright yellow tracksuit with loose long sleeves and matching loose yellow trousers. Her face is pale with dark eyes, and she has white trainers.
identity_text: The singer Billie Eilish in the oversized yellow tracksuit from the Bad Guy music video, with long straight dark blue hair.

appearance_text: A farmer whose head is a big orange carved pumpkin with glowing yellow triangle eyes and a wide grin, topped by a brown hat brim. He wears a red and black checked shirt with the sleeves rolled to the wrists and blue dungarees over it, the straps crossing his back. Blue trousers tuck into heavy dark brown boots.
identity_text: A farmer whose head is a big carved pumpkin with glowing eyes and grin, wearing a red checked shirt under blue dungarees for Halloween.

appearance_text: A pale girl with long grey hair falling over her shoulders and dark blue eyes. She wears a puffy white coat with a fluffy collar over a grey vest, with a grey and white checkered skirt. Long white socks come up past her knees and she has light grey shoes. Her grey hair covers most of her back.
identity_text: An unnamed girl dressed for winter in a puffy white coat over a grey vest, with a chequered skirt and long white socks. The title describes her outfit rather than naming a character.

appearance_text: A tall thin figure in a smart dark grey suit with a crisp white shirt and a dark red tie. Where the face should be there is nothing at all: just a smooth blank grey head with no eyes, nose or mouth. The hands are the same pale grey, and the trousers and shoes are almost black, with the suit plain and dark across the back.
identity_text: Slenderman, the tall thin faceless figure of internet horror stories, in a dark suit and red tie with a smooth blank head where a face should be.

hair: long dark brown hair down the front and back
head: light blue dinosaur hood
white teeth around the face
white eye patch on the side

appearance_text: A brown-skinned girl with long dark brown hair falling over her shoulders and down her back, wearing a soft light blue dinosaur onesie. The hood is ringed with pointed white teeth and has a white eye patch on the side. A line of white spikes runs down the back of the onesie, which covers her all the way to her feet.
identity_text: A brown-skinned girl zipped into a soft light blue dinosaur onesie, her long dark hair falling out of a hood ringed with white teeth. No character is named.

face: big white square eyes with blue pupils
head: plain green head

appearance_text: A figure with a plain green head, no hair, and two big white square eyes with small blue pupils. It wears a smart dark blue suit jacket over a white shirt with a red tie, with white cuffs at the wrists and a tiny yellow pin on the front. The trousers are the same dark blue and the shoes are brown.
identity_text: Alsmiffy of the YouTube group Hat Films, whose skin is a green-headed figure in a navy pinstripe suit with a white shirt and red tie.

appearance_text: A girl whose long hair is bright green shot through with yellow strands, hanging down her back with dripping looking tips. Her eyes are big and green. She wears a dark green jacket open over a shirt splashed with yellow and green like spilled slime, short dark shorts, and tall dark green boots. Green splashes run down her arms and legs too.
identity_text: A girl covered in glowing toxic green and yellow slime, with long green hair whose tips look like they are dripping.

appearance_text: A cartoon cat with a big white face, two huge black eyes and a bright red nose above a wide yellow muzzle. Its body is covered in mottled brown fur with a yellow patch in the middle of the chest and another on the back. The arms and legs are the same brown with no clothes at all.
identity_text: Gaturro, the cat from the Argentine comic strip, with his oversized white face, red nose and yellow-patched fur.

accessories: plaid shirt tied round the waist
footwear: dark red shoes with white soles
head: grey hood down on the back

appearance_text: A pale boy with messy black hair and bright blue eyes. He wears a dark navy denim jacket open over a grey hoodie, with the grey hood resting on his back. A blue checked shirt is knotted around his waist, and below it his black jeans are torn at the knees. His shoes are dark red with white soles.
identity_text: An unnamed teenage boy in grunge streetwear: a navy denim jacket over a grey hoodie, a plaid shirt tied round the waist, ripped black jeans and dark red shoes. The title names a style, not a character.

appearance_text: A boy with black hair that sweeps across his forehead and dark eyes. He wears a plain blue sweater with long sleeves that covers him to the hips. His jeans are dark navy and he has white shoes.
identity_text: An ordinary boy in a plain blue long-sleeved sweater with dark navy jeans and white shoes. The title describes the sweater rather than naming anyone.

appearance_text: A very muscular man with tan skin, short dark brown hair and light blue eyes. His chest, arms and legs are drawn with big bulging muscles and he wears nothing but a pair of small blue briefs. He is barefoot, and his broad muscled back shows from behind.
identity_text: Arnold Schwarzenegger in his bodybuilding form: a heavily muscled tan man wearing nothing but a pair of small blue briefs.

appearance_text: A warrior in heavy dark red armour with a wide horned helmet crowned by a gold crest. Their face is completely hidden behind a black mask. Layered plates cover the chest and shoulders with gold trim along the edges, and the legs are armoured down to dark boots.
identity_text: A Japanese armoured warrior in dark red lacquered plate with a gold-horned helmet and a black face mask that hides the face completely. No individual is named; the listing describes the class of warrior.

appearance_text: A pale boy with spiky blue black hair and glowing red eyes. He wears a short sleeved blue shirt with cream sleeves banded in blue, and on the back is a large round crest that is red on top and white below. His shorts are cream and his lower legs are wrapped in cream and blue down to blue sandals.
identity_text: Sasuke Uchiha from Naruto, in his blue short-sleeved shirt with the red and white Uchiha fan crest across the back, cream shorts and wrapped lower legs.

face: big white eyes with black pupils
head: orange cat head with small ears

appearance_text: A round orange cat standing upright, with small pointed ears and a white muzzle holding a pink nose and big white eyes. Thick black stripes run in a row all the way down its back. Its tummy is a lighter orange and its feet are pale cream.
identity_text: Garfield, the lazy orange cat from the comic strip, drawn as a round tabby with a striped back and a white muzzle.

footwear: dark red shoes with white soles
motifs: small grey print on the chest
top: green t-shirt with a small grey print

appearance_text: A boy with short spiky dark brown hair, brown eyes and a small round open mouth. He wears a plain green t-shirt with a small grey shape printed on the chest, leaving his arms bare. His shorts are brown and reach his knees, and he wears dark red shoes with white soles.
identity_text: The YouTuber Toby Turner, drawn as an ordinary boy in a plain green t-shirt with a small grey chest print, brown legwear and dark red shoes.

appearance_text: A bearded man in a wide brimmed brown cowboy hat, with tan skin and purple eyes. A red neckerchief is tied around his neck and spreads over his shoulders, worn with a brown leather waistcoat over a white shirt with rolled up sleeves. He wears blue jeans held by a brown belt with a holster at the hip, and brown boots with little yellow spurs.
identity_text: Minecraft's Steve dressed as a cowboy, in a wide brimmed brown hat and red neckerchief, leather waistcoat over rolled white sleeves, blue jeans and spurred boots.

bottom: yellow black-and-gold striped thigh-high socks with brown stripes

appearance_text: A girl with long red hair that falls right down her back and big dark eyes in a pale face. She wears a bright yellow jacket marked with brown stripes over a black top, with black shorts underneath. Her legs are covered by yellow leggings with matching brown stripes and she wears chunky black boots.
identity_text: A girl kitted out as a fan of the yellow electric mouse, in a bright yellow jacket striped with brown over a black top and shorts, matching yellow striped legs and chunky black boots. Her long red hair falls all the way down her back.

head: flat purple and pink speckled head

appearance_text: A tall speckled creature with a flat blank head, two dark square eyes and a wide frowning mouth. Its colours fade all the way down like a rainbow: pink and purple over the head, blue across the shoulders and chest, green over the belly and yellow and orange down the legs. The same speckled fade covers its back.
identity_text: A creeper, the exploding Minecraft mob, recoloured as a speckled rainbow that fades from purple at the head down to orange at the feet.

bottom: fishnet fishnet-patterned thigh band above knee-high boots

colors.item: fishnet fishnet-patterned thigh band above knee-high boots
colors.name: dark grey

appearance_text: A girl with brown hair down to her shoulders and a straight fringe, big blue eyes and pink blush on her cheeks. She wears a dark grey t-shirt under light blue denim dungaree shorts with straps over the shoulders. Her legs are covered in dark fishnet tights and she has light blue boots.
identity_text: An everyday girl in a dark grey tee under light blue denim dungaree shorts, with fishnet-patterned legs and pale boots. Two small dark ears sit on top of her brown hair, which the listing calls bear ears.

head: orange hood resting on the back of the head
top: white eye printed on the back

appearance_text: A brown skinned character with bright blue hair cut in a short fringe over blue eyes. They wear a vivid orange hoodie with grey stripes around the sleeves and a pouch pocket at the front. The hood sits at the back of the head with a small yellow star on it, and a big white eye is printed across the back of the hoodie. Below are light faded blue jeans and dark grey shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed brown skinned teenager with bright blue hair and gold headphones, wearing a vivid orange hoodie with grey stripes around the sleeves and a white print across the back over faded light blue jeans.

appearance_text: A tall figure hidden inside a long black hooded robe, with a pale bony skull grinning out from under the hood. Grey armoured gauntlets cover the hands and a gold buckle holds the robe at the waist. A long scythe with a brown handle is strapped across the back, and dark red stains mark the robe near the legs.
identity_text: Death the reaper: a skull-faced figure in a long black hooded robe with a scythe strapped across its back.

colors.item: tattoo across the face and body
colors.name: red

head: bald head with a red tattoo

appearance_text: A big bald warrior with pale ash-white skin and a bold red tattoo that slashes over one eye, down his shoulder and across his chest, with a red stripe running the length of his back. His chest and arms are bare and muscled, with gold bands at his forearms. Around his waist hangs a red and gold armoured skirt with a pale emblem on the front, and gold and red wrapping covers his legs down to his feet.
identity_text: Kratos, the Spartan warrior of the God of War games, bald and ash-white with his red tattoo running down one side and a red and gold armoured skirt.

accessories: pink flowers and green leaves on the head, arms and legs
face: big white eyes with small black pupils
head: wide round grey head
two small pointed ears
pink flowers on top
top: cream belly with grey chevron markings

appearance_text: A big round grey furry creature with a wide head, two small pointed ears and huge white eyes with tiny black pupils. Its belly is cream coloured and marked with rows of grey chevrons. Pink flowers and little green leaves are scattered over its head, shoulders, arms and legs, and the same soft grey fur covers its back.
identity_text: Totoro, the big round grey forest spirit, with huge white eyes, small pointed ears, a chevron-marked cream belly and flowers strewn over his fur.

bottom: orange and yellow flame patterned black shorts
head: orange fox ears

appearance_text: A girl with two orange fox ears on her head and bright green eyes. She wears a fluffy orange jacket with a small white collar over a black top. Her leggings are patterned with orange and yellow flames, with a black band around one thigh, and she has short brown boots over white socks.
identity_text: A girl with pale tan animal ears and small flowers tucked in her hair, wearing a fluffy mustard yellow jacket over a black top and flower-patterned leggings.

accessories: bushy brown tail on the back
head: brown squirrel head
small round ears
red flower on top
top: white suit with red and blue arm stripes

appearance_text: A brown squirrel standing on two legs, with round ears, black eyes, a red nose, big white front teeth and a tiny red flower on its head. It wears a white all in one suit with red and blue stripes running round the upper arms and a collar at the neck. A big bushy brown tail sticks out from the back and its boots are grey.
identity_text: Sandy, the squirrel from SpongeBob SquarePants, standing upright in her white air suit with striped arms and her bushy tail behind her.

appearance_text: A pale girl wearing a bright pink axolotl hood with frilly gills sticking out at the sides, and long white hair spilling out from under it down her back. She wears a small pink top and purple shorts, leaving her arms, tummy and legs bare, with pink bands around her upper arms and purple bands around her legs.
identity_text: An unnamed girl wearing a pink axolotl costume: a gilled hood over long white hair, a small pink top and purple shorts, and no shoes.

head: long brown hair
purple hood up at the back

appearance_text: A girl with long dark brown hair falling over her shoulders and bright blue eyes. She is bundled into a one-piece hooded suit that starts purple at the hood and shoulders and fades down to soft light blue at the ankles. The baggy hood hangs behind her head and she wears simple black shoes.
identity_text: A brown-haired girl bundled into a purple-to-blue hooded onesie. Not a specific character.

appearance_text: A young man with brown hair falling over blue eyes. He wears a brown leather jacket, open over a dark blue shirt, with a brown belt at the waist. His trousers and tall boots are black.
identity_text: Leon Kennedy from the Resident Evil games, a young man with a brown fringe in an open brown leather jacket over a dark blue shirt.

face: a glowing screen instead of a face
head: purple television set for a head
screen showing colour bars
round dial on the back

appearance_text: Instead of a head this character has a chunky purple television set, its screen filled with soft pastel bars of pink, blue and cream where a face should be, and a round dial on the back panel. Below it they wear a pale pink top with a deeper pink collar and a short pink skirt. Tall dark grey boots cover the lower legs, leaving the thighs bare.
identity_text: A figure whose head is a chunky purple television, its screen showing pastel colour bars in blue, cream and pink that spill down over the chest like coloured tears. Below it wears a pale pink top and a dark short garment.

bottom: black pants with white side stripes
hair: dark brown hair with a fringe
top: plain white t-shirt with short sleeves

appearance_text: A boy with dark brown hair swept over his forehead and blue eyes. He wears a plain white t-shirt with short sleeves and long black shorts with white stripes running down the outside of each leg. His trainers are white with black soles.
identity_text: An unnamed sporty boy in a plain white t-shirt, black tracksuit bottoms with white side stripes and white trainers.

head: black animal ears with pink insides

appearance_text: A pale girl with very long bright red hair and dark green eyes, with two black animal ears with pink insides poking up from her head. She wears an open black and grey checked jacket over a white top. A short black skirt leaves her legs bare above little white socks and shoes.
identity_text: A pale girl with very long bright red hair and black animal ears, wearing an open black and grey checked jacket over a white top with a short black skirt and white shoes.

appearance_text: A tan skinned boy with spiky brown hair held back by a bright orange headband. He wears a dark teal short sleeved football shirt with a big white number 1 across the back, and matching dark teal shorts. Orange goalkeeper gloves cover his hands, and his socks are white with teal stripes above orange boots.
identity_text: Mark Evans, the goalkeeper and captain named in the listing, in a dark teal keeper's kit with the number 1 on the back, an orange headband and orange gloves.

head: tall black hat with a wide brim
gold buckle on the hat band

appearance_text: A man in a tall black hat with a wide flat brim and a gold buckle on the band. Orange hair pokes out beneath it and a bushy orange beard covers his chin. He wears a long dark brown coat with a plain white collar at the neck and white cuffs at the wrists, over dark brown breeches. His lower legs are wrapped in white stockings and his black shoes have square buckles on the front.
identity_text: A bearded man in traditional pilgrim dress — buckled black hat, long brown coat with a white collar, white stockings and buckled shoes. The title names his role, not a person.

appearance_text: A pale blue jelly creature with a small square head, two big dark eyes and a tiny dark square mouth. Its body and thin arms and legs are the same soft blue, a little lighter in places like light shining through jelly. The back is plain blue with faint darker edges.
identity_text: A slime, the blocky jelly mob, rendered in the pale sky-blue colouring of the Aether mod version rather than the usual green.

appearance_text: A young man with brown bowl-cut hair, blue eyes and a small smile. He wears a white shirt with big puffy sleeves under a brown leather vest laced at the front with grey cord. Dark brown trousers and black boots finish the outfit, and the vest laces show as plain brown across his back.
identity_text: An unnamed young medieval villager or peasant in a laced brown leather vest over a white puffy-sleeved shirt, with dark brown trousers and black boots.

appearance_text: A bald man with a bright pink face, heavy dark eyebrows and a hard frown. He wears an olive green jacket, open at the front so a grey striped shirt shows underneath, with black gloves on his hands. His jeans are faded blue and his boots are black. The jacket is plain olive across the back.
identity_text: Heat Wave, a supervillain from DC comics, drawn in ordinary clothes rather than costume: a bald man with heavy dark eyebrows in an olive green jacket over a grey striped shirt and jeans.

colors.item: trim down the front of the dress
colors.name: gold

head: gold headband with blue gems
top: wide gold and turquoise collar necklace

appearance_text: A woman with brown skin and straight black hair cut in a neat bob, wearing a gold headband set with bright turquoise gems. Around her neck sits a wide gold collar necklace beaded with turquoise, and gold bands circle her bare upper arms. She wears a long white dress with a gold stripe running down the front, falling to a plain cream skirt around her legs.
identity_text: Cleopatra, the last pharaoh of Ancient Egypt, in a long white dress with gold trim, a wide turquoise-beaded gold collar and a jewelled gold headband.

appearance_text: A man with short brown hair, a neat brown beard and moustache, and simple purple eyes. He wears a plain teal short sleeved shirt with his tanned arms bare. Purple trousers reach down to grey shoes, and the whole outfit is plain with no pattern front or back.
identity_text: Steve, the default Minecraft player character, with his brown hair and beard, teal short-sleeved shirt and purple trousers.

appearance_text: A soft-looking character with dusty pink hair and two rounded animal ears on top of the head. Big brown eyes sit above a small smile. A brown jacket hangs open over a cream shirt, with dark brown trousers below and chunky white shoes. The back shows the same long pink hair down over the brown jacket.
identity_text: An unnamed character in a cosy autumn outfit — brown jacket over a cream shirt with dark brown trousers — with dusty pink hair and rounded animal ears.

footwear: black boots with cream fur tops
top: light blue and white striped sweater

appearance_text: A pale girl with long brown hair worn in a thick braid that hangs all the way down her back, and big green eyes. She wears a warm sweater striped in light blue and white with long striped sleeves. Below it is a short dark grey skirt, and black boots with soft cream cuffs at the top.
identity_text: An unnamed girl dressed for cold weather in a blue and white striped sweater, a short dark skirt and fur-topped boots, with her brown hair in a long braid.

colors.item: vine speckles on the arms and legs
colors.name: dark green

head: square pumpkin head
top: orange pumpkin body with green leaves on the shoulders

appearance_text: A tall boxy monster whose whole body looks like an orange pumpkin, with darker orange ribs running down it. Its face has two black square eyes and a big black frowning mouth. Green leaves sit on its shoulders and green vines speckle its arms, legs and back.
identity_text: A Creeper, the exploding Minecraft mob, reskinned as a pumpkin: the same boxy body and square black eyes and frowning mouth, but coloured like ridged orange pumpkin flesh with green leaves and vines over its shoulders and limbs.

head: black bandana with pale spots
top: white and dark green striped sleeveless shirt

appearance_text: A boy with short dark brown hair and big blue eyes, wearing a black bandana with pale spots tied around his head. His sleeveless shirt is striped in white and dark green, leaving his arms bare, and a belt with a yellow buckle sits at his waist. He has ragged brown shorts and goes barefoot.
identity_text: A boy dressed as a pirate - spotted bandana, green and white striped sleeveless top, ragged brown shorts and bare feet. A cabin-boy type rather than any particular character.

appearance_text: A chubby yellow-orange bear standing on two legs, with round ears on top of its head, tiny black eyes and a black nose over a wide muzzle. It wears a short red shirt that only covers its chest and shoulders, leaving its round yellow tummy showing. The arms and legs are the same soft yellow, and the red shirt carries around the back.
identity_text: Winnie The Pooh, the yellow bear from A. A. Milne's stories, standing on two legs in his short red shirt with his tummy showing.

top: light blue bands on the sleeves

appearance_text: A gruff man with short black hair and a thick black beard that covers his chin and mouth. He wears a dark red leather coat with brown straps and buckles over his chest and pale blue bands around the upper sleeves. His trousers are dark brown with small pouches at the hips, and he wears scuffed brown boots. The coat is the same dark red across his back.
identity_text: An unnamed travelling medieval trader, a gruff black-bearded man in a dark red leather coat with chest straps and buckles, brown trousers with belt pouches and scuffed boots.

appearance_text: A short round spaceman in a bright yellow suit, drawn with heavy black outlines. A wide light blue glass visor covers most of the front of the head, while the back of the head is plain yellow. The body is one rounded yellow piece with stubby arms and two short yellow legs.
identity_text: A small spacesuited figure from the game Among Us, its suit bright yellow and its helmet fronted by a wide pale blue visor.

head: short brown hair
top: black jacket with brown leather straps crossing the chest and back

appearance_text: This man has short brown hair, light skin and bright blue eyes. He wears a black jacket with brown leather straps buckled across his chest, over his shoulders and crossing again down his back. Brown bands wrap his upper arms, and he wears dark blue jeans with sturdy brown boots.
identity_text: A young man kitted out as a vampire hunter, in a black jacket with brown leather straps crossing his chest and back over dark jeans and boots. The listing describes the kit rather than naming a character.

colors.item: smiling face on the back of the head
colors.name: orange

hair: light blonde hair to the shoulders
head: back of the head painted orange with a black smiling face
top: black and white striped crop top

appearance_text: A girl with light blonde hair falling to her shoulders and grey green eyes. She wears an open dark grey jacket over a short black and white striped top, light blue denim shorts and long grey socks with grey shoes. The back of her head is orange with a big black smiling face drawn on it.
identity_text: A blonde girl in a street outfit of open grey jacket, striped crop top and denim shorts, with the whole back of her head painted as a grinning orange pumpkin. The title is a personal name invented for this skin rather than a character who exists elsewhere.

head: tan lion skin pulled over the head with grey ears
motifs: spiral pattern on the golden back plate

appearance_text: A broad muscular warrior with a dark beard, blue eyes and a tan animal skin pulled over his head with little grey ears sticking out. His chest is bare and tanned with a red sash running over one shoulder, held by a wide brown belt with a buckle. He wears a short red kilt, brown bands on his arms and laced brown sandals, and a golden plate marked with a spiral covers his back.
identity_text: Hercules, the Greek mythical hero, shown as a bare chested muscular warrior in a lion skin hood, red sash and red kilt.

bottom: pink and cream suit trousers with checked patches
face: pale blue visor instead of a face
head: pink helmet with a big square visor
top: pink and cream suit with grey straps

appearance_text: A figure sealed inside a protective suit, its head hidden by a pink helmet with a large pale blue square visor. Grey straps cross the chest and hold a tank shape on the back. The suit is pink and cream with checked patches on the legs, and it ends in chunky grey boots.
identity_text: A casual figure whose head is a boxy pink television with a pale glowing screen for a face, wearing a pastel pink suit crossed with dark green straps and teal boots.

colors.item: glowing infection spreading over the body
colors.name: light blue

head: dark lumpy head
no eyes
top: open mouth with pale teeth in the chest

appearance_text: A hunched creature whose whole body looks rotten and dark brown, with a shadowed lumpy head that has no eyes at all. Bright light blue growths glow across its chest, arms and legs like something spreading under the skin. A ragged mouth full of pale teeth gapes open in the middle of its chest and again on its back. Its legs are blotched dark and blue right down to the ground.
identity_text: A hunched, rotting humanoid overtaken by a parasitic infection, with glowing turquoise growths spreading under its skin and a toothed mouth gaping open in its chest. The listing calls it an infected patient but gives it no name.

hair: very long dark green black hair
subjects: pale sea creature with a scaly lower body

appearance_text: A pale bone-white figure with very long dark green black hair that hangs over her face and down her back. Dark swirling marks curl across her bare chest and shoulders, and jagged red and white patches cover her lower arms. From the waist down her body turns into dark green scales like a fish tail. Her eyes are hidden behind dark bands.
identity_text: Sedna, the sea goddess of Inuit myth, shown as a bone-white figure with long dark hair over her face and a green scaled lower body.

colors.item: patches over the chest, arms and legs
colors.name: black

head: plain orange head with no hair
top: orange body covered in black splotches

appearance_text: A creature whose whole body glows warm orange, with big black patches spreading over its chest, arms and legs like burnt spots. Its bald orange head has two glowing white eyes and a wide white grin stretched across the face. The black patches also cover its back and shoulders, and it has no clothes or shoes.
identity_text: A figure with a glowing orange pumpkin head, white glowing eyes and a wide white grin, wearing a black hoodie and black trousers speckled all over with glowing orange embers. The listing calls him a gamer wearing a pumpkin head, and gives no name.

head: light blue hood down at the back

appearance_text: A girl with long light brown hair falling down her back and big purple eyes. She wears a blue checkered plaid shirt open over a plain black top, with a light blue hood hanging behind her neck. Her jeans are dark blue and her shoes are blue and white.
identity_text: An everyday teenage girl in a bright blue plaid shirt worn open over a black top, with a light blue hood down at her back. The listing names no character.

appearance_text: A pale young person with fluffy white hair, bright red eyes and pink blush across the cheeks. They wear a light green zip-up tracksuit jacket with a white shirt showing at the collar and chest, and little red cuffs at both wrists. Matching light green tracksuit trousers have dark green bands at the knees and ankles, and small white shoes are on the feet. The back is plain light green all over.

identity.franchise: The Disastrous Life of Saiki K.
identity.name: Kaidou Shun

identity_text: Kaidou from The Disastrous Life of Saiki K., shown in a light green school tracksuit worn over a white shirt.

face: pale face peeking out of the hood
head: light brown animal hood
pointed animal ears
cream fringe on the hood

appearance_text: A girl zipped into a soft light brown animal onesie. The hood is pulled up with two pointed ears on top and a cream fringe framing her pale face, which has big grey eyes and long black lashes. A cream fluffy patch covers the chest and belly, the arms and legs are plain light brown, and a matching tail hangs down the back.
identity_text: A girl zipped into a soft light brown animal onesie themed after a Pokemon, hood pulled up with pointed ears, a cream fluffy chest patch and a tail down the back.

face: blue mask over the nose and mouth
head: black hood covering the head

appearance_text: A fighter dressed in black from head to toe with icy blue armour over the top. A black hood covers the head, leaving only narrow eyes above a bright blue mask that hides the nose and mouth. Blue plates sit on the chest and shoulders with black arms below, and a blue belt crosses the waist. The black trousers carry blue stripes down to the black boots.
identity_text: Sub Zero from the Mortal Kombat fighting games: an ice ninja in a black bodysuit with pale blue armour plates, a blue face mask and a black hood.

head: furry cat head with pointed ears

appearance_text: A big cat covered in pale grey fur scattered with black spots, with a soft white chest and belly. Its face has bright light blue eyes, a pink nose, a white muzzle and dark ears with pink insides. A long spotted tail curls across the back, and each paw ends in small black claws.
identity_text: A snow leopard, the big cat of the Central and South Asian mountains, with a pale spotted grey coat, white underside and a long thick tail.

head: curly hair
top: cream shirt with an open collar
dark green cloak fastened at the neck

appearance_text: A short pale figure with curly sandy brown hair and brown eyes. He wears a loose cream shirt with an open collar, brown shorts and grey wraps around his knees. A long dark green cloak is fastened at his neck and hangs all the way down his back, and his feet are bare.
identity_text: Samwise Gamgee, the hobbit from The Lord of the Rings, in a cream shirt and brown shorts under a long green travelling cloak, barefoot as hobbits are.

appearance_text: A boy with shaggy dark brown hair that sticks out around his head and covers his ears, with dark eyes peeking through the fringe. He wears a black jacket over a black shirt, both plain with no pattern. Loose cream coloured trousers go down to short black shoes.
identity_text: The listing calls this a normal Minecraft villager in a long brown coat, but the figure rendered is an ordinary teenage boy with shaggy dark brown hair, a black jacket and loose cream trousers.

top: red square badge with a white mark

appearance_text: A boy with short brown hair and dark purple eyes. He wears a white t-shirt with grey shoulders and a bright red square badge printed in the middle of the chest, with green bands around both wrists. His jeans are dark navy and his shoes are dark with white tips. The back of the shirt is plain white.
identity_text: An unnamed boy dressed as a typical Minecon convention attendee, in a white t-shirt carrying the red Mojang logo and green event wristbands.

head: short brown hair with a fringe

appearance_text: A boy with short brown hair swept over his forehead and bright blue eyes, with his mouth hanging wide open in shock so his white teeth show. He wears a blue jacket with a hood on the back over a white shirt. His trousers are black with blue cuffs at the ankles and his shoes are black.
identity_text: An unnamed boy caught mid-shock with his mouth hanging wide open, wearing a blue hooded jacket over a white shirt and black trousers.

face: big white eyes with dark pupils
head: red feathered head
tuft of feathers on top
motifs: black tail feathers on the back

appearance_text: A round red bird covered in feathers, with huge white eyes under thick black frowning eyebrows and a bright yellow pointed beak. A cream coloured patch runs down its chest and belly, and small black tail feathers stick out from the back. Its thin legs are orange and scaly.
identity_text: The listing names this as Red, the red bird from the Angry Birds Movie: a round red bird with a yellow beak, scowling black brows and thin orange legs.

hair: two big hair bunches with red ribbons
head: goggles on top of the head
hair tied in two bunches

appearance_text: A girl with dark brown hair tied into two big bunches held by red ribbons, with a pair of goggles resting on top of her head. She wears a short red and brown jacket over a white frilly shirt, with red shorts and a brown belt at her waist. Long white stockings cover her legs up to the thigh and end in short brown boots.
identity_text: Amber from Genshin Impact, a brown-haired girl with her hair tied in two ribboned bunches, goggles on her head and a red adventuring outfit.

head: black box head with bright green bars across it
top: orange body patterned like brick blocks

appearance_text: A stocky figure whose head is a black box crossed with bright green bars, with no face at all. Its chest and arms are orange with a pattern like stacked bricks, all outlined in heavy black. Two tiny green and white game figures are printed on its back, and its legs go from orange down to pale pink.
identity_text: A person-shaped figure built out of objects from a platform game: a green pipe for a head, a body of orange brick blocks drawn in heavy black outline, and two little green and white mushrooms on its back. It is a set of props in human form, not a character.

hair: long black hair down to the shoulders
head: dark red headband tied round the forehead
motifs: muscles drawn on the chest and back

appearance_text: A muscular tan skinned man with long black hair held back by a dark red headband tied round his forehead. His chest, arms and back are completely bare, with muscles shaded across them. Below the waist he wears loose dark green trousers that run all the way down to his feet.
identity_text: John Rambo, the soldier played by Sylvester Stallone, shown bare-chested with long black hair, his dark red headband and loose green army trousers.

face: big open black mouth with a red tongue
head: red and orange head
white patch above one eye

appearance_text: A figure whose whole body fades through the rainbow, red and orange at the head, green and blue through the chest and arms, and blue into purple down the legs. The face is silly, with two tiny black dot eyes at different heights, a white patch above one of them, and a wide open black mouth with a red tongue. Small white square marks sit at the corners of the arms and legs.
identity_text: A goofy humanoid coloured as one continuous rainbow gradient, red at the head and purple at the feet, with a lopsided derp face and a wide open mouth.

bottom: black suit legs with gold lines
head: black cat mask
pointed cat ears
gold face markings

appearance_text: A fighter in a tight black cat suit with pointed cat ears on the mask and glowing gold markings across the face. Thin gold lines trace the chest, arms and legs, and gold claw shapes curve over both shoulders. The black suit continues down the back and into matching black boots trimmed with gold.
identity_text: A masked fighter in a tight black big-cat suit traced with gold lines and gold shoulder claws, listed as the main villain of the Black Panther film. The listing never writes the character's own name, so it is left unasserted.

accessories: blue sleeveless hoodie worn over the suit

colors.item: bands on the wrists and ankles
colors.name: grey

face: big white eye lenses on a full face mask
head: red full face mask
subjects: masked superhero in a red suit

appearance_text: A masked hero covered head to toe in a bright red suit with big white eye lenses on the mask. Over the suit he wears a blue sleeveless hoodie with a black spider shape printed on the chest and another on the back. Grey bands circle his wrists and ankles, and the hood of the blue top sits behind his shoulders.
identity_text: The Scarlet Spider suit from Marvel's Spider-Man: a full red mask and bodysuit with big white eye lenses, worn under a blue sleeveless hoodie carrying a black spider on the chest and back.

appearance_text: A boy with brown hair swept across his forehead and brown eyes. He wears a blue checkered shirt left open over a plain white t-shirt. His jeans are a soft grey blue and his sneakers are white with blue soles.
identity_text: An unnamed boy in an oversized blue checked shirt over a white top, with grey-blue jeans and white sneakers with blue soles.

footwear: tall boots with a black and blue checked pattern
head: long blue hair with a purple streak

appearance_text: A girl with long blue hair streaked with purple, big purple eyes and blushed cheeks. She wears a purple top with soft pink sleeves and a short dark blue skirt, leaving her legs bare. Her tall boots are patterned with black and blue checks.
identity_text: An unnamed anime-styled girl with long blue hair, a purple top with pink sleeves, a short dark blue skirt and chequered thigh-high socks.

appearance_text: A teenager with fluffy brown hair hanging over the eyes. They wear a plain grey t-shirt with short sleeves and nothing printed on it, front or back. The shorts are black, the socks pulled up long and black, and the shoes white.
identity_text: An unnamed teenager in deliberately plain everyday clothes: a blank grey t-shirt, black shorts with long black socks, and white shoes.

accessories: checkered scarf hanging down the back
bottom: long white robe down to the ankles
hair: dark brown hair hidden under the scarf
head: red and white checkered headscarf
black band around the head

appearance_text: A man with tan skin, a dark brown beard and a moustache. He wears a red and white checkered headscarf held on by a black band, and the scarf hangs down his back and over one shoulder. His body is covered by a long plain white robe that reaches his ankles, and brown sandals show at the bottom.
identity_text: An unnamed bearded man in traditional Arab dress: a long plain white robe with a red and white checkered headscarf held on by a black band.

accessories: knobs and dials on the back of the television head
face: dark green glass screen instead of a face
head: grey boxy television head
top: black suit jacket over a dark shirt

appearance_text: Instead of a head this character has a chunky grey television set with a dark green glass screen where a face would be, and knobs and vents on the back of it. It wears a black suit jacket with wide lapels over a dark shirt and a grey tie. The trousers are dark grey and the boots are dark.
identity_text: An unnamed television-headed character in formal dress: a grey TV set with a dark green screen where a face would be, above a black suit jacket, grey tie and dark grey trousers.

appearance_text: A girl with long purple hair streaked with pink and a crown of tiny yellow and pink flowers around her head. She wears a mint green top that leaves her shoulders and tummy bare, with a single flower pinned on the chest. Light purple shorts and tall mint green boots finish the outfit, and her hair falls all the way down her back.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with long purple hair streaked pink, wearing a flower crown, a mint green off-shoulder top and tall mint boots.

head: long brown hair
sunflowers at the back of the hair

appearance_text: A girl with long brown hair, one green eye and one blue eye, and bright yellow sunflowers tucked into the hair at the back of her head. She wears a soft cream sweater under light blue denim overall shorts, with a sunflower sitting on the front pocket. White socks and white shoes finish the look.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in light blue denim overalls and a pale green sweater, with sunflowers in her hair and one on her bib.

head: brown hair swept to one side
top: grey jumper with dark red stripes

appearance_text: A boy with brown hair swept across his forehead so it hangs over one eye. He wears a grey jumper with dark red stripes running round the chest, arms and back, with a white shirt showing at the collar and down the front. His jeans are dark blue and his shoes are black.
identity_text: Anthony Padilla, one half of the internet comedy duo Smosh, shown as a teenage boy in a red-striped grey jumper with a dark jacket over it and blue jeans.

head: red strawberry clipped in the hair
green leaf on the strawberry

appearance_text: A pale girl with very long cream blonde hair that hides her eyes at the front and covers her back, with a bright red strawberry and green leaf clipped in at one side. She wears a red dress speckled with little yellow seed dots and a white frilled collar at the neck. Her legs are bare above light green socks and small cream shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in a strawberry costume dress, red with yellow seed dots and a white frill, with a strawberry clipped into her very long pale blonde hair.
