appearance_text: A very pale character with short, soft light blue hair falling over purple eyes. They wear a thick fluffy white winter coat that puffs out at the shoulders and hangs to the hips. Light blue trousers and white boots go underneath, keeping the whole outfit in icy blues and whites front and back.
identity_text: An unnamed very pale character with short light blue hair, bundled into a fluffy white winter coat with light blue trousers and white boots.

face: wide open mouth showing a dark red inside
head: small round ears on top of the head

appearance_text: A chubby grey hippo with a big pink muzzle and pink cheeks, its mouth wide open to show a dark red inside and two tiny white teeth at the bottom. Small black eyes sit high on its face with little round ears above them. The body, arms and legs are all smooth grey with faint darker patches.
identity_text: Moo Deng, the famous baby hippopotamus from Thailand, drawn as a chubby grey-pink hippo with its mouth wide open.

head: gold helmet
dark eye slit
light blue crest on the forehead

appearance_text: A warrior covered head to toe in shiny gold plate armour with a dark slit across the helmet where the eyes would be and a light blue crest above it. A round blue gem sits in the middle of the gold chest plate, and grey bands wrap the arms and waist. A long dark red cape hangs down the whole back, and gold armour continues down the legs to the boots.
identity_text: An unnamed fantasy knight sealed head to toe in gold plate, with a blue gem on the chest and a long dark red cape.

footwear: orange rocket flames instead of feet
head: silver helmet with a pink visor

appearance_text: A robot made of silver metal plates with bright pink trim running over its helmet, shoulders and arms. A glowing pink visor covers the front of its head. Little coloured lights dot the belt at its waist and orange rocket flames burst from under its legs.
identity_text: The avatar of the Minecraft YouTuber BebopVox, redrawn as a silver armoured robot with a glowing visor and rocket flames where its feet would be.

hair: long pale pink hair with a fringe
top: soft pale pink jumper with baggy sleeves

appearance_text: A girl dressed almost entirely in soft pale pink, with long pink hair falling past her shoulders and tiny dark pink eyes. Her jumper is fluffy pink with wide baggy sleeves that cover her hands. Below it she wears grey trousers with a checked pattern and small white shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed girl dressed almost entirely in pale pink — long pink hair and an oversized pink jumper — over grey checked trousers and small white shoes.

head: white clown mask with red and blue markings

appearance_text: A man in a light tan suit with a white shirt and a dark tie. His whole face is hidden by a white clown mask with black eye holes, a red nose and a wide red painted smile, and blue and red stripes run across the top of it. Blue gloves cover his hands and he wears dark brown shoes.
identity_text: Dallas, the clown-masked heist crew leader from Payday 2, in a tan suit and dark tie with blue gloves, his face hidden behind a white clown mask painted in red and blue.

accessories: white feathered wings on the back

appearance_text: A girl with long golden blonde hair that falls over her eyes and all the way down her back. She wears a flowing gold robe covered in feather shapes, with white feathery trim across the chest and shoulders. Big white feathered wings spread out from her back. The robe ends in a grey hem above brown boots.
identity_text: A guardian angel: a girl in a flowing gold robe patterned with feathers, big white feathered wings on her back and long golden hair over her eyes.

appearance_text: A broad shouldered man wearing a bright yellow hard hat and sporting a short black beard. His chest is bare and tanned, crossed by two red braces that run over his shoulders and down his back. He wears dark blue jeans held up by a belt with a gold buckle, and dark boots.
identity_text: A bare-chested miner in a yellow hard hat, wearing red braces and dark blue jeans. The listing dedicates the skin to the 33 Chilean miners trapped in the San Jose mine.

appearance_text: A boy with messy blonde hair falling over pale blue eyes. He wears a short-sleeved dark red button-up shirt covered in little orange leaf shapes, left open over a plain white vest top. His shorts are dark grey, his legs are bare, and his shoes are bright pink and yellow.
identity_text: A boy dressed for the beach in an open dark red floral shirt over a white vest, with grey shorts, bare legs and bright pink and yellow shoes.

face: black mask covering the whole face
head: tan combat helmet
black balaclava

appearance_text: A soldier in full combat gear with a tan helmet strapped over a black balaclava, leaving only two narrow white eyes showing. Over a blue camouflage jacket sits a black tactical vest with pouches and straps across the chest and back. The trousers are the same blue camouflage with black knee pads, ending in heavy black boots.
identity_text: A Counter-Terrorist operative from Counter-Strike Global Offensive, fully masked and helmeted, in a black tactical vest over blue camouflage combat fatigues and heavy boots.

face: glowing yellow carved eyes and grin
head: carved pumpkin head with a stalk on top
top: dark brown robe with dark red edging

appearance_text: A figure whose head is a big carved orange pumpkin with a short stalk on top and a glowing yellow face grinning out of it. The body is wrapped in a heavy dark brown robe with dark red edging that hangs past the waist. The legs are dark brown too, ending in dark boots.
identity_text: A Halloween monster whose head is a glowing carved pumpkin, wrapped in a heavy dark robe. The listing title reads as a description of the figure rather than a character that exists outside this skin.

accessories: small orange tie at the collar
head: short brown hair

appearance_text: A young traveller with short brown hair and pale skin, wearing an olive green jacket over a white shirt with a small orange tie at the collar. Brown shorts come down to the knee, and long brown socks are pulled up beneath them. The shoes are white with brown soles, and the back of the jacket is plain green.
identity_text: An unnamed boy dressed for the outdoors in an olive green jacket with an orange neck tie, a white shirt, brown shorts, long socks and white shoes.

head: brown cat ears
flower crown of white and pink flowers
long brown hair
top: black jacket with white striped sleeves

appearance_text: A girl with long brown hair, small brown cat ears and a crown of white and pink flowers around her head. She wears a black jacket with white stripes banding the sleeves, open over a pink crop top that leaves her tummy showing. Light blue jeans with torn rips at the knees run down to chunky white shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in a summery street outfit, wearing a crown of white and pink flowers and small brown cat ears.

appearance_text: A robot girl with bright orange hair tied into two big puffy pigtails and a white clown face with round red cheeks and huge black eyes. A red bow sits under her chin above a white body with red shoulder pads and a red plate on her chest and back. She wears a short red skirt over red and white striped legs and small black shoes.
identity_text: Circus Baby, the clown animatronic from Five Nights at Freddy's, with orange pigtails, a white clown face and a red and white striped body.

appearance_text: A dragon standing upright on two legs, covered in blue-grey scales from head to tail. Its head has a long snout, small pointed horns, narrow black eyes and two white fangs poking up from its jaw. The front of its body shows a striped tan belly, while the back and arms stay scaly blue-grey. Its hands and feet end in small white claws.
identity_text: A dragon standing on two legs, covered in blue-grey scales with a ridged tan belly, small horns, white fangs and clawed hands and feet.

appearance_text: A pale teenager with messy light brown hair and big blue eyes. They wear a black hoodie with two white drawstrings hanging at the neck, and a brown backpack with straps over both shoulders sits on their back. The jeans are light blue with rips at the knees, and the shoes are plain black.
identity_text: An unnamed teenager in everyday school clothes: a black hoodie with white drawstrings, ripped light blue jeans and a brown backpack.

head: gold helmet with a tall red crest
cheek guards

appearance_text: A warrior wearing a tall gold helmet topped with a bright red crest, with cheek guards leaving only dark eye slits. Gold plate armour covers the chest and arms, and a red cape hangs from one shoulder all the way down the back. Below the chest is a dark armour skirt with gold leg plates and black boots.
identity_text: Ares, the Greek god of war, in gold plate armour with cheek guards and a tall red-crested helmet, a red cape down his back and a dark armour skirt.

head: pink pig head
floppy pink ears
pig snout

appearance_text: A pink pig head with floppy ears, a wide snout and small black and white eyes sits on a hero body. The body wears a red suit covered in web lines with a blue panel across the chest and a black spider in the middle. The trousers are blue and the boots are red with the same web pattern. The back has a blue panel with a red spider shape on it.
identity_text: Plopper, the pig from The Simpsons Movie, drawn with his pink pig head on a red and blue spider-hero suit.

appearance_text: A scruffy man with light brown hair and a short beard, wearing a pair of dark goggles strapped across his forehead. He has a cream shirt with rolled sleeves under worn dark brown overalls with straps over the shoulders and crossing the back. Dark brown trousers cover the legs down to heavy black boots.
identity_text: An unnamed scruffy miner in worn overalls and heavy boots, with mining goggles pushed up on his head.

face: black cloth mask over the nose and mouth
head: dark green hood

appearance_text: A sneaking figure hidden under a deep green hood, with a black cloth mask pulled up over the nose and mouth so only narrow teal eyes show. The body is wrapped in dark green leather armour with padded shoulders and brown straps crossing the chest and back. Dark brown trousers with leather thigh guards run down into black boots.
identity_text: A stealthy hooded figure in dark green leather armour, masked so only narrow eyes show. The title names a fantasy class, not a character.

head: black peaked cap with a red and yellow badge

appearance_text: A bearded figure with blank glowing white eyes and no pupils, wearing a black peaked cap with a small red and yellow badge. His jacket and trousers are white with grey camouflage blotches all over, front and back. He wears black boots and has a small gold buckle at the waist.
identity_text: Herobrine, the white-eyed Minecraft legend, dressed as a Russian army officer in white winter camouflage and a black peaked cap.

bottom: short pale blue skirt with a checked pattern
hair: streaks of teal and dark blue
head: long blue hair with a heavy fringe

appearance_text: A girl with long blue hair streaked with teal and darker blue, cut in a heavy fringe above big pale blue eyes. She wears a dark navy jacket that slips off her shoulders, with black sleeves down her arms. Underneath is a short pale blue skirt with a soft checked pattern, and her legs end in pale blue leg warmers over dark navy shoes. Her hair hangs almost to her knees at the back.
identity_text: An unnamed anime-styled girl in an icy blue winter outfit, with very long blue hair and a navy jacket slipping off her shoulders.

appearance_text: A girl with long dark brown hair, small dark animal ears and a ring of big yellow sunflowers crowning her head. She wears a soft yellow sweater with white cuffs at the wrists. Light blue jeans reach down to small white shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed girl wearing a crown of sunflowers and small dark animal ears, in a mustard sweater and light blue jeans.

head: blue grey hair with two pointed tufts like ears
top: dark grey jacket with light grey panels

appearance_text: A pale character with blue-grey hair swept into two pointed tufts that stick up like little ears, with big black eyes and pink blushing cheeks. A dark grey jacket with light grey panels and a grey scarf covers the top half, and a bright orange emblem is stitched across the back. The trousers are striped in grey and black, ending in dark grey boots.
identity_text: Cyrus, the boss of Team Galactic from the Pokemon Diamond and Pearl games, drawn in a soft chibi anime style.

top: open white and grey checked shirt

appearance_text: A pale boy with messy black hair hanging over his eyes. He wears a loose white and grey checked shirt left open over a plain light blue t-shirt, the checks carrying round the back and down both sleeves. Ripped grey jeans with holes at the knees and white shoes finish the outfit.
identity_text: An unnamed black-haired boy in an open pale checked shirt over a light t-shirt, with ripped jeans and white shoes.

head: black beret with a gold badge

appearance_text: An older man with a grey moustache and a lined, tired face, wearing a black beret with a small gold badge on the front. He has on a worn olive green army jacket open over a tan shirt. His trousers are dark green army trousers and his boots are dark.
identity_text: Bill, the old army veteran among the four survivors in Left 4 Dead, in his black beret and worn olive green field jacket.

appearance_text: A figure with a bare white skull for a face, dark hollow eye sockets and grey teeth, hidden inside a black hood pulled right up. The black hoodie hangs open over a grey shirt, and a white skull is printed in the middle of the back. Dark blue jeans and black shoes finish the outfit.
identity_text: A skull-faced figure hidden inside a pulled-up black hood, wearing a hoodie with a white skull printed on the back over dark jeans. The listing calls it a skeleton but gives no name.

appearance_text: A girl with soft purple hair streaked with pink, worn in a thick fringe that hides her eyes and two little buns at the sides. She wears a fluffy pink jacket dotted with pale orange over a plain white top, with a small orange collar at her throat. A dark purple skirt sits at her waist above long cream socks banded with pink.
identity_text: An unnamed pastel girl with purple hair streaked pink, in a fluffy pink jacket, a dark purple pinafore and long banded socks.

footwear: dark brown bands around the ankles
top: small dark red bow at the chest

appearance_text: A girl with short light brown hair and big blue eyes. Her body is mostly bare tan skin with thin brown straps crossing her shoulders and back and a small dark red bow at the chest. A brown belt sits at her hips and dark brown bands wrap around her ankles.
identity_text: A girl in a strappy brown outfit over mostly bare tan skin, with a dark red bow at the chest; the listing gives no name I can rely on.

bottom: light blue jeans ripped at the knees
head: shaggy brown hair covering the eyes
top: light shirt showing at the front

appearance_text: A teenager with shaggy brown hair that hangs right over the eyes. They wear a bright red hoodie with white cuffs and hem, the hood lying flat against the back, with a pale shirt showing at the chest. Light blue jeans torn at the knees hang loose over black and white checkerboard shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed teenage boy with shaggy brown hair over his eyes, in a red hoodie with white trim, ripped light blue jeans and checkerboard sneakers.

appearance_text: A soft brown teddy bear standing up, with round ears, huge white eyes, a black stitched nose and a cream muzzle with a little red tongue showing. A bright red scarf is knotted at its neck and trails down its back. It holds a red and white striped candy cane against its chest, and its arms and legs are the same fuzzy brown all over.
identity_text: A brown plush teddy bear standing upright with a red scarf and a candy cane, given a Christmas feel. The listing calls it Ted the Forgotten Teddy Bear.

appearance_text: A boy with brown hair and rosy cheeks, with a dark blue hood pulled up over his head. He wears a warm brown coat with dark blue cuffs and a light blue chequered scarf wound around his neck and hanging down the front. Black trousers run down to dark blue shoes, and the hood covers the whole back of his head.
identity_text: A boy dressed for the cold in a tan-brown winter coat with a navy hood up and a blue chequered scarf. The title describes the outfit, not a character.

appearance_text: A muscular warrior wearing the head of a lion pulled over his own like a helmet, with the ears still sticking up. He has blue eyes and a grey beard, a bare chest crossed by a red sash, and a wide brown belt above a short red skirt. A gold plate with swirl patterns covers his back and he wears dark strapped sandals.
identity_text: An ancient warrior who wears a lion's head as a helmet, with a red sash and short red skirt and a gold patterned plate covering his back. The title describes the look rather than naming a character.

face: tan muzzle with a black nose

appearance_text: A brown bear with round ears, small black eyes and a tan muzzle with a black nose, standing upright like a person. It wears a buttoned blue work jacket with a little white name tag on the chest, and matching blue trousers. Brown furry paws poke out of the sleeves and dark brown shoes cover its feet.
identity_text: An upright brown bear dressed in a blue buttoned uniform with a little white name tag. The title describes it rather than naming a character.

bottom: long white skirt of the robe
head: round brown hair buns at the sides
top: long white robe with wide sleeves

appearance_text: A woman in a long plain white robe that falls from the shoulders to the ankles with wide sleeves over the hands. Her brown hair is rolled into round buns on each side of her head. A white belt sits at the waist, and two light blue panels show on the shoulders at the back.
identity_text: Princess Leia from Star Wars in her long plain white robe, with her hair wound into the round side buns.

appearance_text: A girl with long straight pink hair and matching pink cat ears on top of her head, with light blue eyes and small colourful clips in her hair. Her top is striped in pink and white with puffy striped sleeves, worn above a short dark grey skirt. Long pink and white striped socks reach up her legs and end in brown boots.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with long pink hair and pink cat ears, dressed in a pink-and-white striped top with matching striped thigh socks and brown boots.

She wears a simple light tan dress with one strap over the shoulder and a blue beaded necklace at her throat. The short skirt is edged with a cream fringe and her arms, legs and feet are bare.
identity_text: Pocahontas as she appears in the Disney film, in her one-shouldered tan dress with a fringed hem, blue beaded necklace and very long black hair.

head: tall black top hat with a white band
top: black tailcoat with a white shirt and yellow buttons

appearance_text: A round faced old man with a huge bushy white moustache, wearing a tall black top hat with a white band around it. He is dressed in a black tailcoat over a white shirt with a row of yellow buttons and a big red bow tie at his throat. His trousers are grey and his shoes are black.
identity_text: The Monopoly Man, the white moustached mascot of the board game, in his tall top hat, black tailcoat, red bow tie and grey trousers.

appearance_text: A bald boy with a light blue arrow tattooed down the middle of his forehead and more blue arrows running down the backs of his arms. He wears an orange robe wrapped over one shoulder with a yellow sash, leaving the other shoulder bare. His trousers are dark red and his boots are dark brown.
identity_text: Aang, the young airbending hero of Avatar: The Last Airbender, bald with blue arrow tattoos and orange air nomad robes.

identity_text: The Red Knight, an outfit from the game Fortnite: a fully armoured figure in ridged dark red plate shading into blue black, with a crested helmet and glowing white eyes.

appearance_text: A girl with long dark brown hair and grey eyes, with a small orange bow tucked into the back of her hair. She wears a black sleeveless dress with a white, orange and yellow candy corn printed on the chest, leaving her arms bare. Her legs are bare down to chunky black boots ringed with orange and white stripes.
identity_text: A girl with long dark brown hair and a small orange bow, in a black sleeveless dress printed with a candy corn on the chest, bare legs and chunky striped black boots.

appearance_text: A black furry hedgehog with spiky quills striped in bright red and glowing red eyes over a tan muzzle. A puff of white fur covers its chest. It wears white gloves with red cuffs and red, white and black shoes, and red stripes run down its arms and legs.
identity_text: Shadow the Hedgehog from Sonic Adventure 2, the black hedgehog with red-striped quills, red eyes and a white chest tuft.

appearance_text: A tall figure with the head of a pale blue grey wolf, with pointed ears, a white muzzle and dark eyes. He wears a long tan coat open over a black shirt, with matching tan trousers and heavy black boots. A pale fluffy tail curls up his back and a blue and white striped item is strapped there too.
identity_text: Shirou Ogami, the wolf beastman from the anime BNA: Brand New Animal, in a long open tan coat over a black shirt with heavy black boots and a pale tail up his back.

appearance_text: A man wearing a black and white checkered cap over brown hair, with a thick brown moustache and short beard. He is dressed in a black suit jacket over a white shirt with a bright green striped tie hanging down the front. His trousers are dark grey with lighter stripes and his shoes are white and grey.
identity_text: CavemanFilms, a Minecraft and gaming YouTuber, shown as a moustached, bearded man in a black suit with a green striped tie and a black and white checkered cap.

appearance_text: A tall figure completely covered in dark grey plate armour, with a heavy steel helmet that has short spikes along the top and a narrow slit where two orange eyes glow out. Broad grey shoulder plates sit above a chest plate with a small orange gem set in the middle. The legs are armoured too, wrapped with brown leather straps, ending in heavy grey boots. Another orange gem glows on the back of the helmet.
identity_text: An unnamed knight sealed head to foot in dark grey plate armour, with a spiked helmet whose narrow visor glows orange and brown leather straps around the armoured legs.

appearance_text: A boy with short dark brown hair swept across his forehead, big blue eyes and pink cheeks. He wears a short sleeved t-shirt with wide red and white stripes across the chest, arms and back. His trousers are blue jeans and his shoes are white with black soles.
identity_text: A dark brown-haired boy in a red and white striped t-shirt with blue jeans and white shoes. The title is a colour description, not a name.

ridged pumpkin back

appearance_text: A tall figure whose head is a big round orange pumpkin with glowing red eyes and a grin full of pointed white fangs. Below the neck it wears a smart black suit jacket over a grey shirt and dark tie. The trousers and shoes are black, with orange cuffs peeking out at the wrists, and the pumpkin's ridges show at the back of the head.
identity_text: An evil pumpkin monster in smart human dress: a round carved orange pumpkin head with glowing red eyes and a grin full of pointed white fangs, above a black suit jacket, grey shirt and dark tie.

head: black helmet with two pointed ears
top: ridged armour plates on the arms

appearance_text: A tall figure sealed in black armour from head to toe. The helmet has two pointed ears on top and two glowing pale blue slits for eyes, leaving only the chin and mouth uncovered. Ridged plates run down the arms and legs, and a long black cape hangs all the way down the back.
identity_text: Batman in the heavy armoured mech suit from Batman V Superman, plated in black from head to toe with a pointed-eared helmet, glowing blue eye slits and a long cape.

hair: messy black hair with a long fringe
head: light blue hood down at the back

appearance_text: A boy with messy black hair that falls over his blue eyes. He wears a baggy light blue hoodie with black drawstrings and the hood resting on his back. His trousers are plain black and his trainers are white.
identity_text: An unnamed boy in casual streetwear: a baggy light blue hoodie worn over black jeans with white trainers, his messy black fringe hanging over his eyes.

top: bright orange cracks glowing across the chest and back

appearance_text: A hulking figure whose whole body looks made of rough dark red stone. Bright orange cracks glow across its chest, back and arms like molten rock showing through, and two red eyes burn in its blank face. Around its waist it wears dark grey shorts held with a grey belt, and its legs are the same cracked red stone.
identity_text: A hulking demon whose whole body is rough dark red stone with molten orange cracks glowing through it and two burning red eyes. The listing describes it as a being from the Nether but names no character.

bottom: green socks patterned with clover leaves
hair: long ginger hair down the back

top: green jumper with clover leaf patches

appearance_text: A girl with long ginger hair falling all the way down her back and a green clover leaf tucked above one ear. She wears a soft green jumper that slips off her shoulders, patterned with pale clover leaves. Long green socks with more clover leaves cover her legs, ending in dark green shoes, and her eyes are bright green.
identity_text: An unnamed girl dressed head to toe in green with clover leaves on her jumper, socks and hair. The four-leaf clover is the outfit's theme, not the figure's identity.

appearance_text: A robot built out of matte black plates with bright glowing green strips running along the arms, chest and legs. The helmet is black with a dark blank visor instead of a face, edged with more green light. Green bands wrap the shoulders, wrists and lower legs, and the glowing lines continue in a pattern across the back.
identity_text: An unnamed cyberpunk robot in matte black armour lit by glowing slime-green strips, with a blank dark visor instead of a face.

appearance_text: A hard-shelled bug creature with a rounded orange head and tiny blue eyes. Bright orange shell plates cover the chest and shoulders, edged in dark blue lines. The arms and legs are blue with segmented banding, like a beetle's jointed limbs. The back is the same orange shell with a dark ridge down the middle.
identity_text: A hard-shelled bug creature built from bright orange shell plates outlined in dark blue, with blue segmented arms and legs and a ridged orange head.

head: green frog hat with eyes
top: cream oversized shirt with a frog face print

appearance_text: A pale kid with short dark brown hair under a green frog hat that has big round eyes and pink cheeks on the sides. He wears a baggy cream shirt with a little green frog face on the chest, and green checked shorts. Pink socks poke out of his black shoes, and the back of the outfit is plain cream and green.
identity_text: A boy in a frog-themed outfit: a green frog hat with eyes, a baggy cream shirt printed with a little frog face, and green checked trousers.

appearance_text: A bald man with pink skin, small black square eyes and a huge white grin framed by a thick black beard. He wears a brown jacket hanging open over a dark red shirt. Grey trousers and black shoes finish the look.
identity_text: Notch, the creator of Minecraft and founder of Mojang: a bald, pink-skinned man with a thick black beard and an enormous white grin, in an open brown jacket over a dark red shirt.

appearance_text: A smooth green frog with a wide head and big golden eyes with dark slit pupils. Its throat, chest and belly are pale cream, and darker green spots run down its back. The arms and legs are the same bright green, ending in little cream toes.
identity_text: A plain green frog with a pale cream throat and belly, darker spots down the back and big golden eyes, drawn as a whole-body animal skin.

top: orange and cream striped t-shirt with short sleeves

appearance_text: A person with short brown hair wearing a t-shirt striped in orange and cream across the chest, arms and back. The short sleeves leave the lower arms bare. Light blue jeans cover the legs, with a lighter band round the knees, and simple grey shoes finish the outfit.
identity_text: An unnamed person in an orange and cream striped t-shirt with pale trousers and plain shoes.

appearance_text: A masked warrior whose head is covered by a helmet with a rounded gold crest on top and a grey face guard with dark slits for eyes. Red armour banded with darker red stripes wraps the arms, chest and legs, and a broad tan panel runs down the front and back of the body. The feet end in black boots with white bands at the ankles.
identity_text: Hit The Target, a main antagonist from StampyLongNose's Lovely World series, shown as a masked warrior in red and gold armour.

appearance_text: A girl with soft cream hair and big blue eyes, wearing a crown of bright red roses and green leaves. She has a white blouse with puffy long sleeves under a red checked pinafore dress fastened with little yellow buttons. A green vine with more red roses trails down her back, and she wears red socks and red shoes.
identity_text: A girl in a crown of red roses, wearing a white puffy-sleeved blouse under a red checked pinafore with red socks and shoes. The title describes the flowery look rather than naming anyone.

appearance_text: A figure sealed in bulky orange power armour with a rounded red helmet and a wide glowing green visor where the face should be. Big round shoulder pads sit above a dark red chest plate with a yellow circle in the middle. The arms and legs are armoured in orange plates down to heavy boots, and a large glowing circle sits on the back.
identity_text: Samus, the armoured bounty hunter who leads Metroid, sealed in bulky orange power armour with a red helmet and a wide green visor.

appearance_text: A girl with very long dark brown hair that hangs in a thick braid all the way down her back, topped with a little crown of green leaves like a pumpkin stalk. Her eyes are bright orange in a pale face. She wears a black off-shoulder top with orange panels over the shoulders and an orange band around her middle. Below that are black shorts and orange-and-black wraps down her legs, ending in small white shoes.
identity_text: A girl dressed for Halloween in a black off-shoulder top with orange panels and a green leaf crown like a pumpkin stalk, her hair in a long braid. The title describes the costume.

head: dark grey helmet with pale curved horns

appearance_text: A fighter wearing a dark grey helmet with two pale curved horns sweeping back, leaving only green eyes and tan cheeks showing. Brown leather armour covers the chest with a round grey plate in the middle and shaggy cream fur over the shoulders and upper arms. Leather straps and fur hang down over the legs like a kilt. His boots are striped grey and white.
identity_text: The Dragonborn, the player hero of Skyrim, in a horned helm and fur-trimmed brown leather armour.

footwear: dark red boots with white fluffy tops
head: long pink hair
holly and berries in the hair

appearance_text: A girl with long pink hair worn in bunches, with sprigs of green holly and red berries clipped in on both sides, and soft purple eyes. She wears a bright red dress with fluffy white trim around the hem, collar and cuffs. Her legs are bare below the short skirt down to dark red boots with fluffy white tops.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in a full Christmas outfit — a short red dress with white fur trim and matching red boots, with holly clipped into her long pink hair.

hair: short brown fur on the head

appearance_text: A soft brown furry creature standing on two legs, with pointed ears tipped in dark teal and dark markings around its eyes and cheeks. It wears a white shirt with a small black bow tie and light blue shorts. Brown boots cover its feet, and a long dark teal tail curls down behind it.
identity_text: An anthropomorphic brown furry creature in a white shirt and bow tie; the listing gives it no name.

head: red hat with bobbles along the top

appearance_text: A small boy with a plain cream face, two narrow black slit eyes and a red hat with round bobbles along the top. His shirt is blue grey with a big yellow star on the chest and a red scarf at the collar. He wears green shorts, red and white striped socks and grey shoes.
identity_text: Maxwell, the star-shirted boy who is the main character of the Scribblenauts games, in his red bobbled hat, green shorts and striped socks.

appearance_text: A pale boy with messy black hair falling over his forehead and bright light blue eyes. A thick red scarf is wrapped around his neck. He wears an open black leather jacket with grey cuffs over a white shirt. His jeans are faded blue denim and his shoes are black with white soles.
identity_text: An unnamed teenage boy with messy black hair, wearing an open black leather jacket over a white shirt with a thick red scarf, blue jeans and black shoes.

appearance_text: A big brown dinosaur covered in mottled scaly hide, with a huge head whose jaws hang open to show two rows of blunt cream teeth and a dark red mouth. Its eyes are tiny black dots high on the head. The chest and belly are a lighter tan, its arms are short and stubby, and a curling tail is drawn down its back.
identity_text: A tyrannosaurus rex: a big brown dinosaur with mottled scaly hide, tiny eyes set high on a huge head, stubby arms and jaws hanging open on rows of blunt teeth.

Blue goggles sit over the eyes and a dark scarf covers the mouth, with brown hair peeking out at the sides. A brown belt cinches the coat at the waist, and blue trousers tuck into dark brown boots with white cuffs.
identity_text: A bundled-up hiker in a mottled blue parka with a white fur hood, goggles over the eyes and a scarf across the mouth. The title describes the outfit rather than naming anyone.

identity_text: A girl in a soft blue and pink outfit with long pastel blue hair gathered into two round buns on top of her head. The title names only her colour scheme.
