hair: two long plaits over the shoulders
head: red and white striped hood with little ears
top: red and white striped top with striped sleeves

appearance_text: A girl with big blue eyes and light brown hair worn in two long braids that fall over her shoulders. She wears a hood striped in red and white with little ears on top, and her top and sleeves carry the same bold candy stripes, with a wide stripey band running down her back. Underneath is a pale blue skirt, and she has white socks inside red and white striped boots.
identity_text: A girl dressed as a candy cane, in a red and white striped eared hood and matching striped top and sleeves, with a pale blue pinafore skirt and striped boots.

head: black mohawk strip
top: bare muscular chest with brown straps

appearance_text: A huge muscular brown-skinned man with a tall black mohawk and an enormous black beard covering the lower half of his face, split by a wide grin of white teeth. His chest is bare apart from two crossed brown straps, and gold bands circle his thick arms. A red sash wraps his waist above baggy yellow and brown trousers tucked into brown boots.
identity_text: The Hog Rider from Clash of Clans, a huge bare-chested brawler with a black mohawk, a vast beard, gold arm bands and a red waist sash.

colors.item: pumpkin face print on the chest
colors.name: orange

head: orange pumpkin shaped hat
top: purple hoodie with a big orange pumpkin face on the chest

appearance_text: A pale kid in an orange pumpkin shaped hat with dark purple hair poking out underneath and dark red eyes in shadow. The purple hoodie has a big round orange pumpkin face printed on the chest and is plain purple across the back. The legs are covered in orange checkered trousers above chunky orange and white shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed teenager dressed for Halloween in a purple hoodie printed with a jack o' lantern, an orange cap and orange checked trousers. The pumpkin is a print on the clothing, not the figure itself, so the title is not a name.

head: long hair with a side fringe
top: light blue gown with wide collar

appearance_text: A pale girl with very long pale blonde hair that sweeps over one eye and hangs down her back. She wears a long light blue gown that reaches the floor, with a wide pale collar and a small round gold brooch at the throat. Her hands are covered by short white gloves and her eyes are light blue.
identity_text: Rosalina from Super Mario Galaxy, in her floor-length pale blue gown with a gold brooch at the throat and long blonde hair covering one eye.

colors.item: pom pom buttons on the jacket
colors.name: yellow

hair: messy orange hair sticking out at the sides
head: fluffy orange clown hair

appearance_text: A clown with messy bright orange hair sticking out at the sides and a face painted pale, with green paint smeared over the eyes, a round red nose and a wide toothy grin. Around his neck is a big frilly collar in purple, orange and yellow, over a blue jacket dotted with round yellow pom pom buttons front and back. He wears baggy green trousers and dark red shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed circus clown with wild orange hair, a painted face with green eye paint and a red nose, wearing a blue pom-pom jacket, a frilled collar and baggy green trousers.

colors.item: big glowing patch down the back
colors.name: pink

appearance_text: A slim girl-shaped creature with dark purple skin and short dark hair, with two pointy ears sticking up from her head. Her eyes glow bright pink and there is a pink heart shape on the chest of her black hooded top. Down her back runs a big glowing pink patch. She wears black trousers with a grey belt and white cuffs around her ankles.
identity_text: A slim girl-shaped creature with dark purple skin and glowing eyes, in a black hooded top with a pink mark on the chest and a big glowing patch down her back. Small dark wither roses are dotted over her head and legs.

head: messy brown hair
top: brown leather straps crossing the chest

appearance_text: A young adventurer with messy brown hair and blue eyes, with a blue scarf bunched around his neck and a long blue cape hanging down his whole back. He wears a dark grey tunic crossed with brown leather straps and a brown belt at the waist. His trousers and tall boots are brown.
identity_text: An unnamed young explorer in a long blue cape and blue scarf, with leather straps crossing a dark grey tunic and tall brown boots.

appearance_text: A boy with short brown hair and bright green eyes. He wears a dark blue suit jacket over a white dress shirt with a long black tie hanging down the middle. His trousers are black and his shoes are white, and the jacket is plain dark blue all the way around the back.
identity_text: A teenage boy wearing a navy hooded jacket over a white shirt and black tie, with black trousers and white shoes - smart clothes under casual outerwear.

head: long silvery hair covering the eyes

appearance_text: A girl with very long silvery white hair, streaked with pale blue, that hangs over her eyes so only a small pink mouth shows. She wears a black long sleeve top with a white collar and white pieces on the shoulders, plus short black shorts. Tall white boots come up over her knees.
identity_text: An anime style girl whose very long silvery hair falls over her eyes, dressed in a black top with white trim, black shorts and tall white boots. The title is a decorative colour word, not the name of a character.

appearance_text: A pale girl with very long dark brown hair, worn loose at the front and plaited into a single braid that runs all the way down her back, with small white clips near the top. She wears a soft mint green top that sits off her shoulders with frilly sleeves, over a short white frilly skirt. Long pink socks come up her legs to light purple shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed pastel girl with a very long dark braid, wearing a mint off-shoulder top, a white frilly skirt and long pink socks.

head: small black horns
top: red and black shape on the back

appearance_text: A girl with long brown hair that falls past her shoulders and two small black horns poking out of the top of her head. Her eyes are bright red and her skin is pale. She wears a white jacket with red stripes around the sleeves over a black shirt, grey trousers and white shoes. The back of the jacket has a red and black shape down the middle.
identity_text: A girl with long brown hair, red eyes and two small black horns, dressed in a white jacket with red-striped sleeves over dark leggings.

head: brown fedora with a wide brim

appearance_text: A rugged man in a battered brown fedora with a wide brim, his face stubbled and serious. He wears a worn brown leather jacket over a cream shirt with a pale bag strap slung across his chest. His trousers are dusty tan and his boots are brown, and the jacket is plain brown across the back.
identity_text: Indiana Jones, the adventuring archaeologist named in the listing, in his battered brown fedora and worn leather jacket with a satchel strap across his chest.

head: green frog hat with big white eyes

appearance_text: A pale girl with very long cream-white hair falling down her back, big purple eyes and pink blush. On her head sits a green frog hood with two big white eyes on top. She wears a tiny green top with green bands on her arms and a short purple and green skirt, leaving her arms, tummy and legs bare, and she has no shoes.
identity_text: A pale girl with very long cream-white hair wearing a green frog hood and a small green and purple outfit, with no shoes.

colors.item: long silver-white hair flowing down the back (no cape)
colors.name: white

appearance_text: A pale girl with long silvery white hair and big purple eyes. Her dress is white and covered in frills and layers, tied with purple ribbons, and it leaves her shoulders bare. A soft white cape hangs down her back. Below the short skirt she wears pale purple and white stockings and light boots.
identity_text: A pale girl with very long silver-white hair in a frilly white dress trimmed with purple ribbons, over pale purple stockings. The listing gives only a bare first name, so no character is asserted.

hair: light blue hair covering the face
head: blue axolotl hood with frills on top
dark eyes and pink cheeks on the hood

appearance_text: A girl wearing a pale blue animal hood shaped like an axolotl, with little frills sticking up on either side, dark dot eyes and pink cheeks. Her own light blue hair hangs down over her face so you cannot see it. She wears a matching light blue hoodie, white trousers and white shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed girl wearing a pale blue axolotl hood with frills sticking up on either side, a matching light blue hoodie and white trousers.

head: dark red cap with a brim
white hair sticking out under the cap
top: dark red scarf around the neck

appearance_text: A slim figure in a dark red brimmed cap with pale white hair poking out underneath and dark eyes. A dark red scarf is wrapped round the neck above a white shirt with rolled sleeves and a buttoned dark red vest. The trousers are dark red with a small gold buckle at the waist, and the boots are black.
identity_text: Quote, the main character of the adventure game Cave Story, wearing his dark red cap, scarf and vest over a white shirt.

head: wide green turtle head
bulging eyes
top: brown shell on the chest and back

appearance_text: A chubby green turtle with a wide head, two big bulging white eyes with tiny dark pupils and a long flat mouth line beneath them. Its green skin is speckled with paler yellow green spots all over the arms and legs. A rounded brown shell covers its chest and the same shell shape sits across its back.
identity_text: Gonzossm, a YouTube animator, drawn as his turtle character: a chubby speckled green turtle with big bulging eyes, a long flat mouth and a brown shell.

face: goggles pushed up on the head
head: cyan goggles worn on top of the head
top: red shirt striped like an explosive block with a white band reading tnt

appearance_text: A boy with short brown hair and bright cyan goggles pushed up on his forehead. His shirt is red with darker red stripes and a wide white band across the chest and back with big black letters on it. He wears dark grey shorts and red and black shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed boy dressed as a walking block of dynamite, in a red and white shirt lettered TNT with cyan safety goggles pushed up on his forehead.

head: black headphones pulled down over the eyes

appearance_text: A boy with short brown hair and big black headphones pulled down so they cover his eyes, with small green marks on the cups. He wears a white shirt with black bands around the upper arms and a purple belt at the waist. His trousers are grey and his shoes are black.
identity_text: Deadlox, a Minecraft YouTuber and member of Team Crafted, drawn with his trademark black headphones pulled down over his eyes.

face: no face, only darkness inside the hood
head: deep hood with a pale rim

appearance_text: A tall figure in a long dark red hooded robe. The hood is edged in tan and there is only blackness where a face should be. A gold cord crosses the chest and a gold buckle holds the brown belt, with more gold trim running down the front of the robe. Brown gloves cover the hands and brown boots show at the bottom.
identity_text: A mage: a tall hooded figure in a long dark red robe trimmed with gold, with nothing but blackness where the face should be, brown gloves and brown boots.

appearance_text: A pale young man with short blonde hair, thick dark eyebrows and grey eyes. He wears a cream shirt laced up the front with yellow cord, under a long open brown coat with padded shoulders. His trousers are dark brown and tucked into brown boots, and the coat hangs down his back in the same brown.
identity_text: An unnamed blonde young man in medieval dress: a laced cream shirt under a long brown coat, with dark brown trousers and boots.

head: pink hood with little ears
top: pink onesie with a white chest patch

appearance_text: A girl bundled up in a soft pink onesie with a hood that has little rounded ears on top. Long white hair spills out from under the hood and grey shadows sit around her eyes. The onesie is pink all over with a white patch on the chest and a darker pink stripe running down the back, and it covers her right down to her feet.
identity_text: A girl bundled into a pink hooded onesie themed after a character from Lilo & Stitch - she is the wearer of the costume, not the character.

appearance_text: A pale man with messy spiky brown hair and a long brown overcoat hanging open. Underneath he wears a blue suit with a matching waistcoat, a white shirt with cuffs showing at the wrists and a red tie. His trousers are blue and, oddly with a suit, his trainers are red and white.
identity_text: The tenth Doctor Who, in his long brown overcoat over a blue suit and red tie, finished off with red trainers.

head: orange fox ears with white insides
tuft of orange fur

appearance_text: A furry orange fox standing on two legs, with a white muzzle, chest and inner ears and big blue eyes. It wears chunky white gloves with rounded cuffs on both hands. A double orange tail, two thick brushes of fur, comes off its back, and its feet are in bright red shoes with white stripes.
identity_text: Tails, the two-tailed orange fox sidekick from the Sonic the Hedgehog games, with his white muzzle and chest, big blue eyes, white gloves and red shoes.

head: hood pulled up over long hair
top: red hooded cloak over a cream dress

appearance_text: A girl with long reddish brown hair under a red hood. She wears a red cloak over a cream dress laced up the front, with a cream skirt and pale leggings. Dark brown boots cover her feet, and her cheeks are lightly blushed.
identity_text: A modern take on Little Red Riding Hood, the fairy tale girl in a red hood and cloak over a laced cream dress, with striped leggings and dark brown boots.

colors.item: creeper face print on the back
colors.name: green

appearance_text: A kid with short brown hair and a fringe hanging over the eyes. He wears a soft green hoodie with the strings hanging down and a big green creeper face printed across the back. His trousers are white and his shoes are the same green as the hoodie.
identity_text: A brown-haired boy in a soft green hoodie with a creeper face printed across the back, worn with white trousers and green shoes.

hair: long orange flame-like hair down the back
head: fiery orange hair framing a pale face
top: black robe with an orange collar

appearance_text: A tall figure with a blank pale grey face and dark hollow eyes, framed by long fiery orange hair that streams all the way down its back like flames. It wears a black robe with an orange collar around the shoulders and a gold band at the waist. Its sleeves end in grey cuffs and it stands on pale white and grey boots.
identity_text: A tall, spooky robed figure with a blank pale face and long fiery orange hair down its back. The title does not name anything that exists outside this skin.

head: short brown hair
top: dark red uniform shirt with black shoulder panels

appearance_text: A man with short brown hair, blue eyes and a dark trimmed beard. He wears a deep red uniform shirt with black panels over the shoulders and down the arms. Black trousers and shoes finish it, and the back of the shirt is the same red.
identity_text: Xephos, the skin worn by one of the Yogscast in their Minecraft series on YouTube: a bearded man in a deep red uniform shirt with black shoulders and black trousers.

hair: long black hair down the back
head: long black hair
top: blue and white striped top with white sleeves

appearance_text: A girl with long black hair falling down her back and pale skin. She wears a blue and white striped top with plain white sleeves, and a short white skirt. Her legs are bare above tall white socks, and her shoes are a soft pale yellow.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with long black hair in a blue and white striped top, a short white skirt and tall white socks, finished with pale yellow shoes. The title picks out the shoes.

colors.item: bunny face on the back of the jacket
colors.name: pink

footwear: pink and purple checked knee socks
head: light purple hair with a fringe
top: purple top with a bow at the neck

appearance_text: A girl with soft light purple hair and bright blue eyes. She wears a black jacket edged in pink over a purple top with a little bow at the neck, and on the back of the jacket is a big pink bunny face with long ears. Her skirt is purple checked and her knee socks are pink and purple checked to match.
identity_text: A girl in a purple bunny themed outfit with a big pink bunny face across the back of her jacket; no name is given for her.

bottom: dark grey trousers with paint marks
top: grey t-shirt covered in colourful paint splashes
white skull print on the back

appearance_text: A smiling boy with messy brown hair and blue eyes. His grey t-shirt is covered in bright splashes of red, green, yellow and purple paint, with darker grey sleeves, and a pale skull shape is printed across the back. His dark grey trousers have paint marks too, and his shoes are white and grey.
identity_text: An unnamed young painter: a smiling boy with messy brown hair in a grey t-shirt splashed with bright paint, a skull print on the back and paint-marked trousers.

face: many green tentacles hanging over the mouth
head: big green head with a heavy brow

appearance_text: A hulking green creature with a heavy square head and two glowing yellow eyes. A thick bunch of green tentacles hangs down over its mouth like a beard. Its whole body is dark green and covered in overlapping scales, and a big pair of folded wings is tucked against its back.
identity_text: Cthulhu, the winged tentacle-faced monster of Lovecraft's stories, drawn as a hulking dark green scaly figure with glowing yellow eyes.

bottom: black trousers with yellow side stripes
hair: thick black hair with yellow streaks
head: big fluffy black hair with yellow streaks
top: yellow hoodie with a dark shape on the chest

appearance_text: A kid with a big mop of fluffy black hair streaked with yellow. The bright yellow hoodie is baggy with a dark shape printed on the chest. Black trousers with yellow stripes down the sides lead to black and white checked shoes.
identity_text: A bee-coloured remake of a Minecraft YouTuber's skin: a boy with a big mop of black hair streaked yellow, in a bright yellow hoodie with a flame emblem on the chest.

subjects: man in a brown leather jacket
top: open brown leather jacket over a dark red shirt

appearance_text: A scruffy man with messy dark brown hair and tired eyes. He wears a worn brown leather jacket hanging open over a dark red shirt, with a red belt at the waist. Below that are dark blue jeans and heavy brown boots, and the back of the jacket is plain worn brown.
identity_text: A weary, stubbled traveller in an open brown leather jacket over a dark red shirt, with dark blue jeans, heavy boots and a big pack on his back. The title describes him rather than naming him.

appearance_text: A girl with long black hair and red lips, wearing a light blue top that leaves her shoulders and tummy bare and a gold necklace at her throat. Wide puffy light blue trousers start at a gold waistband and fall to pale slippers. Light blue bands circle her upper arms and her long black hair covers most of her back.
identity_text: Princess Jasmine from the cartoon Aladdin, in her light blue crop top and puffy trousers with long black hair.

bottom: pink and white striped long socks
hair: short white hair with a fringe
head: white hair with pale pink cat ears
pink bow on the side
top: white frilly dress with pink trim

appearance_text: This girl has short white hair with a fringe, a fluffy pink bow at the side and pale pink cat ears on top of her head. Her eyes are closed in a happy curve. She wears a soft white dress with pink frilly trim and a pink ribbon tied at the neck, with puffy sleeves. Her legs are in pink and white striped long socks and she wears little white shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed kawaii cat-girl in a white and pink frilly dress with cat ears, a side bow and striped socks. "Uwu" is a cute expression, not the name of anyone.

face: light blue tear streaks down the cheeks
head: long blonde hair
green square hair clip
top: cupcake with white frosting and sprinkles on the front

appearance_text: A girl with long pale blonde hair and a small green clip in her fringe. Her eyes are big and black with light blue streaks running down her cheeks like tears. She wears a bright pink t-shirt with a big cupcake printed on the front, iced with white frosting and coloured sprinkles. Dark navy jeans and green shoes finish the outfit, and her blonde hair falls all the way down her back.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in a bright pink cupcake t-shirt, dark navy jeans and green-soled shoes, with pale blonde hair and blue streaks down her cheeks.

colors.item: star shape on the back of the jacket
colors.name: black

hair: messy brown hair with a fringe
head: messy brown hair

appearance_text: A teenage boy with messy brown hair and green eyes. He wears a red jacket left open over a grey shirt, with a white scarf looped around his neck. His jeans are faded blue and his shoes are red with white soles. A dark star shape is printed across the back of the jacket.
identity_text: An unnamed teenage boy with messy brown hair in an open red jacket over a grey shirt, a white scarf, faded blue jeans and red trainers.

accessories: red bow on the back of the head
footwear: white knee socks with black stripes
hair: orange on one side and dark brown on the other
head: animal ears

appearance_text: A girl with long hair split down the middle, orange on one side and dark brown on the other, with matching animal ears on top of her head and a big red bow tied at the back. Her eyes are purple and a bright red ribbon is knotted at her collar. She wears a white blouse with a short black skirt, and a small fluffy white tail sits behind her. Her long white socks have black bands near the top and her shoes are black and white.
identity_text: A cat girl in a school-style outfit, with long two-tone orange and dark brown hair, matching animal ears, a small fluffy tail, a red neck ribbon and a big red bow behind her head.

appearance_text: A pale boy with dark red hair falling in a messy fringe over red eyes. His jacket is red down the front with black sleeves banded in red, worn over a white shirt that shows in a strip down the middle, and a big red circle covers the back. Black trousers with red bands lead to plain white shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed boy with a messy dark red fringe and red eyes, wearing a red jacket with black sleeves over a white shirt, black trousers with red bands and white shoes.

footwear: dark blue shoes with white toe caps
head: dark blue cap
brown hair under the cap
top: navy shirt with bright blue stripes across it

appearance_text: A boy wearing a dark blue cap pulled down over his brown hair, with bright blue eyes. His shirt is navy with brighter blue stripes running across the chest, arms and back. His trousers are the same navy and his shoes are dark blue with white toe caps.
identity_text: A boy in a dark blue cap and a navy shirt striped in brighter blue, with matching trousers and dark blue shoes. The title only names the colour.

appearance_text: A brown skinned girl with short fluffy brown hair, bundled up in a thick white winter coat with a furry hood and a row of dark buttons. A grey checked scarf is wrapped around her neck and hangs down her chest. She wears a short black skirt over white leggings printed with little snowmen with orange carrot noses, and chunky white boots.
identity_text: A brown skinned child bundled up for winter in a thick white coat with a fluffy hood, dark buttons and a checked scarf, over a short dark skirt, white leggings printed with little carrot nosed snowmen, and chunky white boots.

hair: dark brown hair in a topknot
head: red headband

appearance_text: A tan-skinned kid with dark brown hair tied up in a little topknot and a bright red headband across his forehead, with big dark eyes. He wears a blue sleeveless vest over a white shirt, leaving his arms bare apart from red bands at both wrists. Teal shorts sit at his hips and pink and white striped socks run up his legs, with bare feet at the bottom.
identity_text: K.O., the young hero of the Cartoon Network series named in the listing, a barefoot kid in a red headband, blue vest and pink striped socks.

bottom: dark brown rocky legs with lighter bands
head: dark brown rocky head
two small horns
glowing green mark on the back of the head
top: glowing green cracks across the chest and back

appearance_text: A hulking figure made of dark brown rock with two small horns on its blocky head and pale green eyes that glow out of the darkness. Bright green cracks of light run in jagged lines across its chest and spread over its back like glowing veins. Its thin arms and thick legs are the same dark stone, banded with lighter brown.
identity_text: A hulking golem built out of dark brown rock, with green plasma light burning out of the cracks in its chest, back and arms. Its blocky head carries two small horns.

appearance_text: A red-skinned creature with a big square head, two tiny white eyes and a wide dark mouth, dressed like it is going to work. It wears a dark grey suit jacket over a white shirt with a dark red tie, with white cuffs showing at the wrists. Matching dark grey trousers and black shoes cover the legs, and the jacket is plain dark grey across the back.
identity_text: A Strider, the red Nether mob from Minecraft, dressed up in a dark grey business suit with a white shirt and dark red tie.

accessories: red scarf wrapped around the neck
bottom: blue jeans with rolled red cuffs
head: cream cap with a dark red band

appearance_text: A boy in a cream cap with a dark red band, with brown hair showing beneath it. A thick red scarf is wrapped around his neck above a dark blue vest worn over a cream long sleeved shirt. His blue jeans are rolled up at the ankles to show red cuffs over dark shoes.
identity_text: A boy dressed for travelling in a cream cap, a thick red scarf and a dark blue vest over a cream shirt. Unnamed — the title describes the scarf.

head: green holly leaves with a red berry
top: red dress with white fur trim
white apron with a red heart

appearance_text: A cheerful old woman with curly white hair, green eyes and pink cheeks, with a sprig of green holly and a red berry tucked into her hair. She wears a red dress edged with white fur and a white apron with a red heart on the front, with green cuffs at the wrists. Her legs are covered in red and white candy-striped stockings and she wears short black boots.
identity_text: Mrs. Claus, the wife of Santa Claus, shown as a white haired old woman in a fur trimmed red dress and apron with candy striped stockings.

appearance_text: A snowy white figure with a carved orange pumpkin for a head, its dark triangle eyes and jagged smile cut into the front. Rough brown wooden arms hang at its sides in place of sleeves. Four round black lumps of coal run down the smooth white chest like buttons, and the back and legs are plain white.
identity_text: A humanoid take on the Snow Golem, the Minecraft snow mob: a white snowy body with a carved pumpkin for a head, wooden stick arms and coal buttons.

accessories: small red patch on the sleeve
subjects: young man in a green jacket

appearance_text: A pale young man with messy sandy blond hair falling over one dark green eye. He wears an open dark green jacket with a small red patch on one sleeve, over a plain grey shirt, and the jacket is the same green all over the back. Blue jeans held by a buckled belt run down to dark brown shoes.
identity_text: James Sunderland, the protagonist of the survival horror game Silent Hill 2, in his open green jacket and blue jeans.

hair: long brown hair with a fringe
head: small white and yellow flowers tucked in the hair

appearance_text: A girl with long brown hair and a straight fringe, with little white and yellow flowers tucked in at the sides and more scattered across the back of her head. She wears a soft pale green cardigan over a white shirt, with light blue denim dungaree shorts buckled at the shoulders and a tiny yellow heart on the bib. Long pale green socks come up her legs to white shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in a spring outfit: a pale green cardigan over a white shirt with light blue denim dungaree shorts, and small white and yellow flowers tucked through her brown hair.

hair: hair spilling out of the hood
head: pink bunny hood with tall ears

appearance_text: A girl wearing a soft pink bunny suit, with a hood that has two tall pink rabbit ears standing up at the back and a round white fluffy tail behind. Her long blonde hair spills out of the hood over her chest and her eyes are pale blue. Her legs are in pink and white striped stockings and her pink shoes have little paw prints on them.
identity_text: A blonde girl wearing a pink bunny onesie with a tall-eared hood and a round white tail, with pink and white striped legs and paw-print shoes. She is a child in a costume, not a rabbit.

appearance_text: A woman with long brown hair pulled into a braid that hangs right down her back. She wears a light grey sleeveless top that leaves her arms bare, with a dark brown strap running across her chest and over one shoulder. Her trousers and tall boots are dark brown.
identity_text: Lara Croft, the explorer from the Tomb Raider games, in a grey tank top with a strap slung across her chest, brown trousers and tall boots, her hair in a long braid.

appearance_text: A tan-skinned man with short black hair, a thick brown beard and moustache, and blank glowing white eyes with no pupils. He wears a plain teal short-sleeved shirt that leaves his arms bare, and dark blue trousers. His shoes are grey.
identity_text: Herobrine, the blank white-eyed figure of Minecraft legend, in a more heavily shaded rendition with tan skin and a full brown beard.

top: dark purple jacket with long sleeves

appearance_text: A girl with long light brown hair falling well past her shoulders and a fringe over big blue eyes, smiling with her mouth open. She wears a dark purple jacket with long sleeves over a purple top. Her light blue jeans are ripped with holes at the knees and thighs, and she has chunky white sneakers.
identity_text: A long-haired teenage girl in a dark purple jacket, ripped light blue jeans and chunky white trainers. 'Rebel Tomboy' describes the look rather than naming anyone.

appearance_text: A pale-faced character with purple hair and big white eyes, wearing a purple crown set with a green gem. The chest is covered by dark purple armour with grey shoulder plates and grey armoured sleeves. A black belt sits at the waist above grey armoured trousers and boots. The back of the armour is dark purple with the same plated pattern.
identity_text: A young king in dark purple and silver plate armour with a small crown set with a green gem, and purple hair falling over his forehead.

appearance_text: A short stocky man in a bright red cap with a big brown moustache under his nose. He wears red dungarees with orange straps and buttons over a brown shirt with long sleeves. His hands are peach and his shoes are chunky brown, and the whole outfit uses just a few flat, old-fashioned colours.
identity_text: Mario drawn in his original NES colours, a short stocky plumber in a red cap and red dungarees over a brown shirt with chunky brown shoes. The listing places him in Super Mario Bros. on the NES.

bottom: black joggers with a white stripe down each side
head: light brown hair
top: hoodie that fades from white at the shoulders to bright blue at the hem

appearance_text: A boy with light brown hair and brown eyes wearing a hoodie that starts white at the shoulders and fades down into bright blue at the bottom, with white drawstrings at the neck. A dark red backpack is strapped over both shoulders and sits on his back. He wears black joggers with a white stripe down each leg and white trainers.
identity_text: An unnamed teenage boy in a white-to-blue gradient hoodie, carrying a dark red backpack, with striped black joggers and white trainers.

colors.item: skull painted on the back of the jacket
colors.name: white

head: shaved head with a pink mohawk
top: white skull painted on the back

appearance_text: A tough-looking figure with a shaved head and a tall bright pink mohawk running down the middle. The dark grey jacket is covered in white studs along the sleeves, worn over a purple shirt, and a big white skull is painted across the back. Ripped green trousers and heavy black boots with white studs finish the look.
identity_text: An unnamed punk rocker with a tall pink mohawk, wearing a stud-covered dark jacket painted with a white skull on the back over a purple shirt, with ripped green trousers and studded black boots.

accessories: blue flower pin on the lapel

appearance_text: A grown man in a light cream suit jacket over a bright purple dress shirt with a darker purple tie. He has short brown hair with a side part, thick eyebrows and a small smile, and a little blue flower pin on his jacket. The matching cream trousers go down to shiny black dress shoes, and the jacket is plain cream all across the back.
identity_text: Saul Goodman, the flashy criminal lawyer from Breaking Bad and Better Call Saul, in a cream suit worn over a bright purple shirt and tie.

face: light blue patches around the eyes
head: two-pointed jester hood
half red and half black hood

appearance_text: A performer in a floppy two-pointed hood that is red on one side and black on the other. The face is painted white with pale blue patches around two tiny eyes. The jacket is split red and black with an orange and yellow front, the trousers are a black and white checkerboard, and the boots are red.
identity_text: Shaco, the demon jester champion from League of Legends, in a split red and black hood and jacket over chequerboard trousers, his face painted white with pale blue patches.

accessories: red hood hanging down the back
face: white animal mask with black eye holes
head: white bunny mask with small dark red ears

appearance_text: A figure whose face is completely hidden behind a white animal mask with two black eye holes and small dark red ears on top. A mint green jacket sits over dark red straps crossing the chest, and a long dark red hood hangs all the way down the back. Grey shorts, red and white striped socks and scuffed brown boots finish the look.
identity_text: A person whose face is completely hidden behind a white animal mask with black eye holes and small dark red ears, wearing a mint green jacket over dark red chest straps with a long red hood down the back.

hair: dark purple hair over the head
head: furry purple head

appearance_text: A furry creature covered in purple and pink stripes from shoulders to feet. Its round face is pale pink with a dark purple muzzle and tiny dark eyes, framed by dark purple hair that hangs down the sides and back of the head. The chest and back carry pale streaky markings, and the arms and legs are ringed with pink bands.
identity_text: A sloth got up as a wizard, its pale muzzled face framed by dark purple hair above purple and pink striped robes.

appearance_text: A simple figure that is white all over with a faint icy blue tint and soft shading. The face has two tiny grey dots for eyes, a small grey mouth and a little pink tongue poking out below it. There is nothing else on the body, arms or legs, and the back is plain white too.
identity_text: A remade version of the skin worn by the Minecraft YouTuber Skeppy, drawn here as a featureless pale figure with two dot eyes and a small tongue sticking out.

footwear: long black socks with white tops
head: orange hood with animal ears
cream patch on top of the hood

appearance_text: A girl with long dark brown hair peeking out from under a big orange hood shaped like an animal head, with rounded ears on top and a cream patch across the front. The baggy orange hoodie covers her arms and body. She wears short black shorts and long black socks with white bands at the top, ending in black shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with long dark brown hair in a baggy orange animal hoodie, black shorts and long black socks.

bottom: green boxing shorts with a white waistband
head: short spiky black hair

appearance_text: A young fighter with short spiky black hair and blue eyes. He wears a grey vest that leaves his arms bare, with green bands around both wrists. His shorts are green with a white waistband, and he has plain grey boots.
identity_text: Little Mac, the young boxer from the Punch-Out!! games, in his grey vest, green trunks with a white waistband and green wristbands.

footwear: dark red sneakers with yellow checkered trim
head: dark green beanie

appearance_text: A boy in a dark green beanie pulled down over black hair, with dark eyes and tan skin. He wears a plain white t-shirt with black bands round his wrists and a black waistband at the top of his blue jeans. His sneakers are dark red with a yellow checkered strip above the sole.
identity_text: An unnamed boy in streetwear - a plain white t-shirt, blue jeans and dark red checked sneakers - with dark green goggles pushed up over his forehead.

accessories: red bow on the back of the head
head: duck head with a wide orange beak
top: grey feathered body with a white chest

appearance_text: A chubby grey bird with a wide flat orange beak and tiny black dot eyes. A red neckerchief is tied at its neck and a small red bow sits on the back of its head. Its chest is white, its wings are grey and folded at its sides, and it stands on bright orange webbed feet.
identity_text: A chubby grey duck with a wide flat orange beak, wearing a red neckerchief and a little red bow on the back of its head.

hair: blonde hair with a quiff sticking up at the front
top: light blue collared shirt with rolled sleeves

appearance_text: A young boy with pale skin and blonde hair swept up into a little quiff at the front. He wears a light blue collared shirt with a white collar and slightly darker blue sleeves. His trousers are reddish brown and stop short above white socks and brown shoes.
identity_text: Tintin, the young reporter from The Adventures of Tintin comics, with his blond quiff, pale blue jumper and reddish brown trousers.

accessories: flag cape with red and white stripes and white stars
top: blue superhero suit with red trim

appearance_text: A blond man with blue eyes and thick brows in a snug blue superhero suit trimmed in red at the shoulders, wrists and waist. A long cape hangs from his shoulders, striped red and white with a blue panel of white stars at the top. His boots are red and reach the ankles.
identity_text: Homelander from The Boys, a blond superhero in a blue bodysuit with a stars-and-stripes cape hanging from his shoulders.

head: long grey rabbit ears with pink insides

appearance_text: A tall grey rabbit standing upright, with long ears that have soft pink insides and a big white muzzle. Its mouth is open in a wide grin showing a pink tongue, and it has a small orange nose and beady black eyes. Its chest and tummy are white, its paws are white, a round white tail sits on its back, and it holds an orange carrot in one hand.
identity_text: Bugs Bunny, the grey cartoon rabbit with a big white muzzle and a wide open grin, standing upright and holding a carrot.

bottom: grey and black striped long socks
head: grey wolf hood with pointed ears

appearance_text: A girl with long brown hair and brown eyes wearing a grey hoodie with a wolf hood pulled up, its pointed ears lined in pink. She has black shorts and grey and black striped socks that reach above the knee, ending in black boots. Her long hair falls down over the front and the back of the hoodie is plain grey.
identity_text: An unnamed girl wearing a grey wolf hoodie with pointed ears, over the knee striped socks and black boots. The wolf is her hood, not what she is.

face: face fully hidden by a mask
head: shiny black helmet
breathing mask over the mouth
dark eye lenses

appearance_text: A tall figure dressed entirely in black shiny armour with a long cape falling down the back. The head is a smooth black helmet with dark lenses over the eyes and a ribbed breathing mask across the mouth. A grey control panel with tiny red and green lights sits on the chest above a wide belt, and the legs end in heavy black boots.
identity_text: Darth Vader, the black-armoured chief villain of Star Wars, with his helmeted breathing mask, lit chest control panel and long cape.

appearance_text: A pale girl with long white hair falling down her back and a crown of purple flowers on her head. Her eyes are purple and her cheeks are pink. She wears a short purple top that leaves her middle bare and a short purple skirt, with purple bands around her upper arms. Her arms, legs and feet are bare.
identity_text: An original fantasy girl with long white hair under a crown of purple flowers, in a matching purple top and skirt, barefoot. The title describes the look and the theme rather than naming anyone.

hair: long light brown hair down the back
head: cream hood with round bear ears

appearance_text: A girl with long light brown hair spilling out of a soft cream hood with round bear ears on top. She wears a fluffy cream cardigan over a dark brown top, cinched with a brown belt at the waist. Below is a short black skirt, and her legs go down into white socks and black boots.
identity_text: A girl with long light brown hair in a soft cream bear-eared hood and fluffy cardigan, with a short dark skirt and boots.

appearance_text: A tan-skinned boy with short brown hair falling over his forehead and dark eyes. He wears a dark blue hoodie with pale drawstrings hanging at the neck, and across the whole back of the hood and shoulders is a big darker creeper face with square eyes and a frowning mouth. His dark grey jeans are torn with light rips down both legs, and he wears clean white trainers.
identity_text: A tan-skinned boy with short brown hair in a dark navy hoodie that carries a big creeper face printed across the back, with ripped grey jeans and white trainers. The creeper is on his clothing, not what he is.

face: dark chin beard with no moustache
top: black suit jacket with gold buttons

appearance_text: A pale faced man with dark brown hair and a beard that runs along his jaw and chin but leaves his top lip bare. He wears a black suit jacket with two small gold buttons over a white shirt with a dark bow tie. His trousers and shoes are black and the whole back of the suit is plain black.
identity_text: Abraham Lincoln, the 16th President of the United States, in a plain black suit with a white shirt and dark bow tie.

appearance_text: A girl with long brown hair and big blue eyes, with a thick dark navy scarf wrapped around her neck. Her jumper is cream with red and white stripes running around the sleeves. She wears short black shorts and brown boots that come up her calves.
identity_text: A girl dressed for cold weather in a red and white striped jumper with a heavy navy scarf, short shorts and tall brown boots.

face: red mask covering the nose and mouth
head: brown hair
dark red cloth over the mouth

appearance_text: A man with messy brown hair and a dark red cloth pulled up over his nose and mouth. His white shirt is splashed with red and a dark red scarf hangs from his neck. He wears grey trousers and black boots, and a screaming white face with red eyes is printed across his back.
identity_text: A masked robber in a red-splashed cream shirt with a dark red cloth pulled over the lower half of his face, grey trousers and black boots. A white Creeper face is printed across his back, which the listing calls a 'creeper hoodie'.

face: white mask with hollow black eyes
head: blank white mask

appearance_text: A tall figure whose face is hidden behind a blank white mask with hollow black eye holes and no expression at all. Messy dark brown hair sits on top of the mask. The rest of the body is covered by a plain dark navy boiler suit with long sleeves, worn with heavy black boots. The suit stays the same dark navy all the way around.
identity_text: Michael Myers, the masked killer of the Halloween films, in his expressionless white mask and plain dark navy boiler suit.

colors.item: glowing edge down the other side
colors.name: red

appearance_text: A completely black figure in a black suit, with one glowing cyan bar eye and one glowing yellow bar eye and no mouth. A red tie hangs down a white shirt front under the buttoned jacket. Thin blue and red glowing edges run down opposite sides of the whole body, giving it a glitchy look. White cuffs show at the wrists and the shoes are white.
identity_text: An Enderman dressed up in a smart black suit with a red tie, its whole body black and edged in blue on one side and red on the other like a 3D-glasses glitch.

colors.item: chicken face printed on the hoodie
colors.name: white

appearance_text: A boy with fluffy brown hair and blue eyes, wearing a light blue hoodie with the hood resting on his back. On the front of the hoodie is a big white chicken face with an orange beak and a red wattle. He wears blue jeans with rips at the knees and clean white trainers.
identity_text: A boy in a light blue hoodie printed with a big white chicken face with an orange beak and red wattle, wearing ripped blue jeans, white trainers and a blue backpack.

footwear: pink and white striped long socks
top: pink and white striped long sleeve top

appearance_text: A girl with long wavy brown hair falling past her shoulders and big light blue eyes with dark lashes. She wears a pink and white striped long sleeve top with light blue denim shorts, leaving her legs bare. On her feet she has tall pink and white striped socks.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with long wavy brown hair, wearing a pink and white striped top with denim shorts and matching striped knee socks.

head: horned helmet
gold on one side and grey on the other
top: split gold and grey plate armour

appearance_text: A warrior in full plate armour split down the middle, glowing gold on one half and dull grey on the other. The helmet has short curved horns and hides the face behind a visor, matching the same split colours. A long red cape and tabard hang from the shoulders down the front and back, over armoured legs and dark boots.
identity_text: A knight in full plate armour split gold down one side and grey down the other, with a short-horned helmet and a long red cape and tabard. The title names the mood of the skin, not a character.

appearance_text: A light-skinned girl with shoulder-length reddish brown hair and big bright blue eyes. She wears a red sleeveless dress with a white collar at the neck and a dark belt around the middle, leaving her arms bare apart from blue bands at each wrist. The skirt of the dress is short and red, her legs are bare, and she wears white shoes with purple trim.
identity_text: Kairi from the Kingdom Hearts games, a girl with shoulder-length reddish brown hair in a red sleeveless dress with a white collar, a dark belt and blue wristbands.

appearance_text: A golden yellow rabbit machine with two tall ears standing up from its head. Its eyes are pale green and its wide muzzle is full of square white teeth. Dark seams show where the metal parts of its arms, chest and legs join together. A purple bow tie sits under its chin with two round buttons below it, and its back is plain gold with a black panel.
identity_text: Spring Bonnie, the golden yellow rabbit animatronic from Five Nights at Freddy's. The suit is whole and clean, with a purple bow tie and two round buttons below it.

appearance_text: A bearded fighter wearing a dark grey helmet with a hood and two curved horns, showing only pale blue eyes and a short brown beard. His chest is covered by a dark brown leather armour vest with straps, leaving his strong tan arms bare. Grey armoured trousers with hanging leather straps cover his legs. He wears dark grey boots with pale fur around the tops.
identity_text: The Dovahkiin, the horned-helmeted hero of Skyrim, in a hooded horned helm and brown leather armour over bare arms.

top: orange trim down the front and around the sleeves

appearance_text: A tan skinned boy with messy brown hair and bright orange eyes. He wears a long black coat with orange trim running down the front and around the cuffs, hanging open over a brown shirt with darker stripes. His shorts are grey and his legs are bare beneath them, with plain white shoes on his feet.
identity_text: A brown-haired boy in a long black coat trimmed in orange over a striped brown shirt, with grey shorts, bare legs and white shoes. The title describes the coat.

footwear: long white socks with pink stripes
hair: light brown hair past the shoulders
head: pink hood on the back

appearance_text: A pale girl with light brown hair falling past her shoulders and dark red eyes. She is wrapped in a big soft pink hoodie that hangs down past her hips, with the hood resting on her back and the sleeves swallowing her hands. Long white socks with pink stripes cover her legs below the hem.
identity_text: An unnamed girl wrapped in a big soft pink hoodie that swallows her hands, over long white socks. 'Winter Rose' names the colour and season rather than a character.

face: dark slit where the eyes are
head: helmet with a bristly orange crest
closed face plate

appearance_text: A warrior sealed in mottled brown and tan armour from head to toe, with no skin showing anywhere. The helmet is closed with a dark slit across the eyes and a bristly orange crest running over the top. The plates cover the chest, shoulders, arms and legs in the same rough pattern.
identity_text: A soldier sealed in Spartan armour from Halo, rendered in mottled brown and tan plating with a wide orange visor.

head: grey wolf fur hood with pointed ears
top: grey fur cape over the shoulders

appearance_text: A rugged figure with a beard, peering out from under a shaggy grey and white wolf-fur hood that still has its pointed ears. A grey fur cape covers the shoulders over a rough brown fur tunic tied at the chest. Striped tan fur trousers and dark brown boots complete the outfit, and the thick fur covers the back too.
identity_text: A bearded figure dressed for cold country in a wolf-fur hood that keeps its ears, a fur cape and a rough brown fur tunic. No character is named.

colors.item: long pale hair down the back
colors.name: cream

hair: pale cream hair down the back
head: black headband

appearance_text: A figure with a tan and brown painted face, white eyes with tiny red centres and stripes running down the cheeks. It wears a long dark brown robe with red and brown padded shoulders and a black band across the head. Pale cream hair hangs down the back and the feet are bare.
identity_text: A witch doctor or tribal shaman with a striped painted face, white eyes with tiny red centres, padded red-brown shoulders over a long dark robe, and bare feet.

appearance_text: A pale boy with short brown hair falling in a fringe over green eyes and pink blushing cheeks. He wears an open black hooded jacket with white drawstrings over a plain white shirt, the hood bunched up behind his neck and the jacket plain black across the back. Loose tan trousers and grey shoes finish the outfit.
identity_text: An ordinary boy with short brown hair and green eyes in an open black hoodie, a white t-shirt and loose tan trousers.

colors.item: wound on the head and chest
colors.name: dark red

head: dog head with pointed ears
top: grey-green furry chest with a torn open wound

appearance_text: A dog-like creature covered in dull grey-green fur, with pointed ears, tiny black eyes and a pink tongue lolling out of its mouth. A red gash tears across one side of its head, and a bigger rip in its chest shows pale white bones underneath. A curled tail sits on its back and its paws are the same grey-green as the rest of it.
identity_text: The internet meme dog Doge done up as a zombie: dull grey-green fur, a red gash across the head, a ripped chest with bone showing and a pink tongue lolling out.

appearance_text: A man in a wide-brimmed brown hat and dark sunglasses. He wears a red shirt with a red tie under an open brown vest, and a strap crosses his back. His trousers are dark grey and he wears matching dark boots.
identity_text: The Sniper from Team Fortress 2, in RED team colours: a man in a wide-brimmed hat and dark glasses wearing a red shirt and tie under a vest.

head: orange hat with little animal ears
white brim

appearance_text: A small child with brown hair and light blue eyes, wearing a soft orange hat with little animal ears and a white brim. The jumper is orange with wide white stripes and long baggy sleeves, and an orange tail hangs down at the back. Below it are blue denim shorts, orange and white striped socks and black shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed child in a fuzzy orange animal-eared hood and a baggy orange and white striped jumper, with blue jeans and orange striped socks.

head: fluffy light ginger hair
top: bright orange hoodie with white cuffs

appearance_text: A boy with fluffy light ginger hair and bright blue eyes. He wears a warm orange hoodie with white cuffs and two white drawstrings hanging at the front. His trousers are plain brown and his shoes are orange with white soles, and the hoodie is plain orange across the back.
identity_text: A ginger-haired boy in a plain warm orange hoodie with white cuffs and two white drawstrings, brown trousers and orange shoes with white soles. The pumpkin in the title refers only to the hoodie colour.

appearance_text: A small white furry creature standing on two legs, with two brown ears on top of its head and brown patches above its black dot eyes. Its mouth is a wide open black shape and a bright red bandana is knotted around its neck. Its paws are brown and a big bushy brown tail hangs down its back.
identity_text: Chipflake, a cat character from a YouTube cartoon series, shown as a small white creature with brown ears and a red bandana.

appearance_text: A bare-chested, muscular figure whose whole face is hidden behind a cream coloured mask held on with brown straps, with two glowing blue eye holes and a dark patch over the mouth. Dirty white bandages wrap around both arms. The trousers are bright orange striped with black, tucked into black boots.
identity_text: A Psycho, the masked bandit enemy from Borderlands: bare-chested and muscular, with a strapped-on cream mask hiding the whole face, bandaged arms and black-striped orange trousers tucked into boots.

head: blue animal ears
blue bow at the back of the hair

appearance_text: A girl with long brown hair falling all the way down her back and bright blue eyes, with two blue animal ears poking up from her head and a blue bow tied in the hair behind. Her top is striped in blue and white with a blue hood at the neck. She wears grey shorts, bare legs and blue shoes.
identity_text: A girl dressed as a fan of the YouTuber Slamacow; the skin depicts the fan, not the YouTuber himself.

bottom: cream and brown striped cream and olive striped over-the-knee socks

colors.item: striped cream and olive striped over-the-knee socks
colors.name: cream

hair: long brown hair down the back
head: small brown animal ears on top of the head
leaf and flower clip on one side

appearance_text: A girl with long brown hair and two small brown animal ears on top of her head, with a green leaf and flower clipped by one ear. She wears a soft cream jumper with long sleeves over a dark brown skirt, and cream and brown striped leggings on her legs. Her shoes are black and a little bag hangs at her waist.
identity_text: A girl in warm autumn layers - cream jumper, dark brown skirt and striped over-the-knee socks - with small brown animal ears and a green leaf clipped by one ear. The title names the outfit, not a character.

colors.item: pink long-sleeved top under a black bodice (no cape)
colors.name: pink

appearance_text: A girl with strawberry blonde hair worn in two long braids that hang over her shoulders and down her back, with big blue eyes. A bright pink cape is draped over her shoulders, covering most of her back. Underneath she wears a long blue dress with a black bodice patterned with little flowers and a gold belt, ending in black shoes.
identity_text: Anna, the main character of the Disney film Frozen, in her long blue dress with a flowered black bodice, a gold belt and a pink cape.

face: two glowing yellow eyes in the shadow
head: deep black hood
gold band across the hood

appearance_text: A tall figure wrapped in a long black hooded robe, with nothing but two glowing yellow eyes showing inside the dark hood. A gold band crosses the front of the hood and thin gold edging runs down the front of the robe and around the wide sleeves. On the back of the robe is a big gold crescent moon, and gold rings circle the tops of the black boots.
identity_text: A dark spellcaster in a full-length black hooded robe edged with gold, with nothing but two glowing yellow eyes showing inside the hood and a gold crescent moon on the back.

head: long brown hair with orange at the back

appearance_text: A girl with long straight hair, brown at the front and warm orange down the back, and big purple eyes. She wears a grey jacket with roomy sleeves over an orange top, and dark blue shorts. Her legs are bare above tall dark grey boots that reach her knees.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in an autumn outfit: a grey jacket with orange trim over an orange top, dark blue shorts and tall boots, with brown hair that turns pumpkin-orange at the back of her head.

appearance_text: A pale young man with dark blue hair that falls over his purple eyes and down to his shoulders. He wears a long dark blue coat with a crisp white collar at the throat and white cuffs at the wrists, and the coat hangs down past his hips at the back. His dark blue trousers have straps buckled around the thighs and he wears black boots.
identity_text: An unnamed pale young nobleman with shoulder-length dark blue hair, wearing a long navy coat with a pale collar and white cuffs over strapped trousers and black boots.

head: flower crown in pink, blue and yellow

appearance_text: A girl with long pale grey hair wearing a ring of bright pink, blue and yellow flowers on her head. Her short pink strapless dress leaves her shoulders, arms and legs bare, and a wide pink band crosses her back. She wears light blue sandals on her feet.
identity_text: A girl dressed for a summer beach party in a short strapless magenta dress, a crown of bright multicoloured flowers and pale lilac hair.

appearance_text: A soft-looking girl with fluffy pink hair that fades to white at the tips and big blue eyes above pink cheeks. She wears light blue denim dungarees with tiny green and blue flowers dotted on them, over a pink top that shows at her shoulders and arms. The dungarees end in short denim legs above long white socks and little pink shoes.
identity_text: A soft pastel-coloured girl in flowered denim dungarees over a pink top; the title is a mood label rather than a name.

face: gas mask instead of a face
head: black rubber gas mask
big round white lenses
round breathing filter
top: yellow air tank strapped to the back

appearance_text: A figure completely hidden inside a black rubber gas mask with two big round white lenses and a fat filter over the mouth. The body is wrapped in a red fireproof suit with orange straps crossing the chest and a yellow air tank strapped to the back. Red trousers run down into scuffed dark grey boots.
identity_text: The Pyro from Team Fortress 2, in RED team colours: a figure sealed inside a black gas mask and a red fireproof suit with an air tank on its back.

appearance_text: A teenager with soft light brown hair swept across the forehead and bright blue eyes. The shirt is cream in the middle with one red sleeve and one blue sleeve, so each arm is a different colour. Dark blue jeans go down to chunky shoes that are red on one foot and blue on the other.
identity_text: A teenager in a cream shirt with mismatched red and blue sleeves, dark blue jeans and shoes that are red on one foot and blue on the other. The title only describes the outfit.

footwear: black and white striped long socks
head: grey koala hood with round ears

appearance_text: A pale girl with long brown hair and green eyes peeking out from under a grey koala hood with round ears and pale fluffy patches at the sides. The matching grey hoodie is baggy with wide sleeves and covers her whole back, worn over a white top. Short black shorts sit underneath, and long black and white striped socks dotted with tiny colours reach up over her knees.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in a grey koala onesie, its hood pulled up with round ears, worn over a white top and black shorts with long striped socks.

accessories: gold crescent emblem on the chest
head: white wrapped hood covering the whole head
top: white wrapped suit with a gold crescent on the chest

appearance_text: A figure dressed entirely in white and grey wrapped cloth, with a hood and mask covering the whole head except two blank white eye slits. A gold crescent emblem sits in the middle of the chest, and a long white cape hangs down the back. The wrapped white suit continues over the arms and legs down to white boots.
identity_text: Moon Knight, the white wrapped Marvel vigilante, in his hooded cloth suit with a gold crescent on the chest and a long cape down the back.

appearance_text: A young man with dark brown hair swept across his forehead and bright blue eyes, with a little stubble on his chin. He wears a dark green jacket open over a dark grey shirt. His jeans are deep blue and his shoes are black.
identity_text: Ian Hecox, one half of the internet comedy duo Smosh, in a dark green jacket and deep blue jeans.

head: white captain cap with a black band and gold badge
top: white captain jacket with gold buttons

appearance_text: A man in a crisp white uniform with a row of gold buttons down the front of his jacket and gold bands around the cuffs. He wears a white peaked cap with a black band and a small gold badge above the brim, and has blue eyes. His trousers are white to match and his shoes are black.
identity_text: A ship's captain in full white naval dress uniform with gold buttons, gold cuff bands and a peaked cap. 'Boat Captain' is his job, not a name.

hair: short silver hair with a fringe

appearance_text: A pale young person with short silver hair falling over light blue eyes and pink cheeks. They wear a smart dark purple suit jacket over a purple shirt, with a dark red cravat tied at the throat and white cuffs at the wrists. Dark grey trousers and grey shoes complete the outfit, and the jacket is plain dark purple across the back.

keywords: Pokemon Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire
identity.name: Steven Stone

identity_text: Steven Stone, the Champion of the Hoenn region in Pokemon Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire, in his dark purple suit with a red cravat.

face: dark shadow where the eyes are
head: round orange hood with ridges like a pumpkin
hood pulled right down over the eyes

appearance_text: A figure wrapped in a heavy dark green coat, with a big round orange hood ridged like a pumpkin pulled all the way down over its head so only a pale chin shows underneath. The coat has thick padded shoulders and a strap running down one side. The trousers and boots are the same dark green, and the back of the hood shows the same orange ridges.
identity_text: A faceless figure in a heavy dark green rubber suit, the head swallowed by a round ridged orange covering that leaves only a pale chin showing. The title is an atmospheric label rather than a name.

appearance_text: A boy whose head is covered by a white hat with two little rounded ears, leaving only his round face showing with two black dot eyes and a wide open mouth. He wears a light blue t-shirt with short sleeves and dark blue shorts, his arms and legs bare. A green backpack sits on his back and black shoes cover his feet.
identity_text: Finn from Adventure Time, the boy adventurer in his white bear-eared hood, light blue t-shirt, dark blue shorts and green backpack.

appearance_text: A pale girl with very long light blue hair that falls straight down her back past her waist, with a soft fringe over light purple eyes. She wears a sweater striped in dark blue and white with matching striped sleeves. Her grey jeans have rips at the knees and she has dark grey shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with very long pale blue hair, wearing a navy and white striped sweater and torn grey jeans.

bottom: dark red shorts with black bands
head: blue headband across the forehead

appearance_text: A pale boy with short black hair and a bright blue headband tied across his forehead. He wears a white shirt with blue stripes and short sleeves, with straps crossing his chest that hold a dark grey backpack on his back. His shorts are dark red with black bands, and his shoes are blue and white.
identity_text: The boy player character of the Alola-region Pokemon games, in a blue-striped white shirt with backpack straps across the chest, dark red shorts and blue and white shoes, a dark grey pack on his back.

appearance_text: A girl with enormous turquoise twintails tied near the top with red bands, so the hair trails all the way down past her knees at the back. Her eyes are the same bright turquoise. She wears a black sleeveless top with a small white collar and a turquoise tie, with separate grey sleeves pulled up her arms. A short black skirt with a grey belt sits above long black boots that reach her thighs.
identity_text: Hatsune Miku, the Japanese Vocaloid singing idol, in her usual outfit. Enormous turquoise twintails hang past her knees over a black top with a turquoise tie, detached grey sleeves and tall black boots.

head: small red bow on top of the head

appearance_text: A girl with very long pale sandy hair that falls past her shoulders and down her back, with a small red bow perched on top. Her eyes are big and red and her cheeks are pink. She wears a dark red jacket with a soft cream panel down the front and a red shirt showing underneath. A short black skirt sits above tall dark red boots that come up over her knees.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with very long pale sandy hair, a red bow and big red eyes, in a dark red jacket with a cream front panel, a short black skirt and tall dark red boots. The sweet is the theme of the outfit, not what she is.

bottom: blue trousers fading to icy white

appearance_text: A cheerful little figure with a white hood pulled right around a pale face with big dark blue eyes, pink blushing cheeks and a tiny open mouth. The jacket is deep blue at the shoulders and fades to pale icy blue, tied with a thin white belt and small grey pockets on the arms. The trousers carry the same blue to white fade down to the feet.
identity_text: A small cheerful child in a white hood and a blue winter jacket that fades to pale ice blue, tied with a thin white belt. The title describes the outfit; no character is named.

accessories: big light blue bow on the back

appearance_text: A girl with very long dark brown hair falling right down her back, with a light blue bow clipped near the top. She wears a light blue jacket open over a plain white top, held at the waist with a black belt, and a big matching blue bow sits behind her. Her cream trousers are patched with light blue and her shoes are black and blue.
identity_text: A girl with very long dark brown hair in a soft blue outfit - an open light blue jacket over a white top with a black belt, and patched cream trousers - with a big blue bow in her hair. The title is a mood phrase for the colour scheme.

head: dark shaggy hair
rotting dark brown face

appearance_text: A rotting figure with dark messy hair and a ruined brown face, lit by a single glowing white eye. Its shirt is a filthy torn grey rag soaked with dark red stains down the chest and shoulders. Below that it wears ragged black trousers and dark boots, and the same dark stains streak across its back.
identity_text: A rotting zombie with a bloodied face and one glowing eye, in a torn bloodstained shirt and ragged black trousers.

head: red santa hat with a white brim
brown hair
top: white snowflake patterns on the sleeves

appearance_text: A boy wearing a red hat with a fluffy white brim pulled over his brown hair, with bright blue eyes underneath. His green knitted jumper has white snowflake patterns on the sleeves and a red scarf wrapped around his neck and hanging down. He wears dark brown trousers and white shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed boy in a green knitted Christmas jumper and a red santa hat, with a red scarf and dark brown trousers.

appearance_text: A boy with messy brown hair that flops down over his eyes. He wears a baggy red hoodie with white drawstrings and the hood folded down behind his neck. His shorts are dark grey and his shoes are white.

identity_text: Marco Diaz, the boy in the red hoodie from the animated series Star vs. the Forces of Evil.

appearance_text: A small girl with a short brown bob and a straight fringe, big brown eyes and a friendly smile. She wears a pink short-sleeved top and bright orange shorts, with bare arms and legs. A round purple backpack with straps over both shoulders is carried on her back. Her feet are in white shoes with yellow socks.
identity_text: Dora the Explorer, the cartoon girl with the brown bob, pink top, orange shorts and purple backpack.

appearance_text: A tan skinned young man with short dark brown hair and thick eyebrows. He wears a bright green t-shirt with a big grinning light green blob face printed across the chest, and a paler green blob shape on the back too. Blue jeans and clean white shoes finish the outfit.
identity_text: The gaming YouTuber Jelly, shown as a brown haired young man in his green t-shirt printed with a grinning green blob face.

hair: hair fading to blonde at the tips

appearance_text: A pale girl with long wavy hair that is brown at the roots and fades to blonde at the tips, falling over her shoulders, and calm grey eyes. She wears a grey green jacket left open over a cream coloured top. Her shorts are light blue denim and her legs are bare below them. On her feet are short brown boots.
identity_text: An unnamed teenage girl with long ombre hair, brown at the roots and blonde at the tips, wearing an open grey green military style jacket over a cream top with light blue denim shorts.

head: white hair
big white beard
top: white S badge on the chest

appearance_text: A cheerful old man with white hair, rosy cheeks and a huge white beard and moustache that hides most of his face, with bright blue eyes peeking over the top. His suit is red with a check pattern, with a green panel down the front carrying a white letter badge on the chest, and the back of the suit is olive green with another red letter. Red checked trousers reach into heavy dark brown boots.
identity_text: Santa Claus reimagined as a superhero: an old man with a big white beard in a red checked suit with a lettered badge on the chest and heavy brown boots.

appearance_text: A charred black skeleton with glowing white eyes and a row of white teeth. Pale bones and ribs show through the blackened body on the chest and back. The arms and legs are thin black bones with faint white streaks.
identity_text: A humanoid form of the Wither, the Minecraft boss mob: a charred black skeleton with glowing white eyes, a white grin and pale bones showing through the burnt body.

top: white shirt with a dark tie

appearance_text: A stern looking man with short brown hair, heavy eyebrows and blue grey eyes. He wears a well cut dark grey suit jacket over a white shirt with a dark tie, and the jacket is plain charcoal across the shoulders and back. Matching grey trousers taper down to plain black shoes.
identity_text: James Bond in the sharp charcoal grey suit he wears in Skyfall, with a white shirt and dark tie.

appearance_text: A girl bundled into a soft all white animal onesie, with the hood pulled up so two little round ears with pink insides sit on top of her head. Her light brown fringe peeks out under the hood, her eyes are closed in a happy curve and her cheeks are pink. The suit is plain white from head to toe, front and back, with white sleeves and feet.
identity_text: An unnamed girl bundled into an all-white polar bear onesie with the hood pulled up, two round pink-lined ears sitting on top of her head.

appearance_text: A boy with bright spiky gold hair standing up in points, big blue eyes and tan skin. He wears a black long sleeved top with a bold gold swoosh curving across the chest and gold bands ringing both sleeves. Matching black trousers carry gold bands at the knees and ankles above black shoes, and the back of the top has the same gold stripes.
identity_text: The skin of the Minecraft YouTuber GoldSolace: a boy with spiky gold hair in a black top and trousers marked with a gold swoosh and gold bands.

bottom: legs covered in the same speckled pattern
face: dark purple band across the eyes

top: chest and arms covered in scattered pastel squares

appearance_text: A figure with no clothes or features, covered from head to toe in scattered pastel squares like coloured static. The head is split down the middle, blue grey and cream on one side and pink and peach on the other, with a dark purple band running across where the eyes would be. The speckling covers the arms, legs and back in the same mix of pink, cream, purple and blue grey.
identity_text: An abstract pattern skin rather than a character: a figure speckled all over in pastel static, with a two-tone head and a dark band where the eyes would be.

colors.item: long white hair down the back
colors.name: white

appearance_text: A very pale girl with long white hair that falls down her back, and two tall white bunny ears standing up from her head. Her eyes are soft grey. She wears a pale pink coat with a fluffy white scarf bunched at her neck, and pink trousers with a checked pattern. Her shoes are white, and a stripe of white fur runs down the back of her coat.
identity_text: An unnamed pale girl in a pastel pink bunny-themed outfit, with tall white rabbit ears above long white hair and a fluffy white scarf.

appearance_text: A young child with light brown hair that sticks up in two pointed tufts and big brown eyes. They wear a flowing robe of yellow and orange with wide sleeves, tied at the waist with a brown sash, and the skirt of the robe hangs to the knees. Dark brown boots cover the lower legs and the robe is plain orange down the back.
identity_text: A young air nomad from Avatar: The Last Airbender, a child in the traditional yellow and orange robes of the air-bending monks, belted with a brown sash over dark brown boots.

head: blue hood pulled up behind the hair

appearance_text: A very pale figure with fluffy light blue hair falling over dark blue eyes. A soft blue hoodie with a big front pocket covers the body, its hood bunched at the neck and hanging down the back. The trousers are dark navy and the shoes are pale blue with white soles.
identity_text: An unnamed very pale figure with fluffy light blue hair in a matching blue hoodie, dark navy trousers and pale blue shoes.

hair: heart shape at the back of the head

big pink gem on the chest

appearance_text: A character who is pink all over, with dark pink hair swept across the head and a heart shape at the back. Big white eyes sit above pink cheeks with black marks curving under them. The dark pink top has puffy shoulders and a large pink gem shape in the middle of the chest. White trousers run down to short dark pink boots.
identity_text: Spinel, the pink Gem villain of Steven Universe: The Movie, with heart-shaped hair, dark marks under the eyes and a gem in the chest.

appearance_text: An old man with a balding head, grey hair round the sides and a squared brown beard and moustache. His eyes are white with small dark pupils and his face looks lined. He wears a teal short sleeved shirt with bare arms, blue trousers and grey shoes.
identity_text: Steve, the default Minecraft character, drawn as an old man: balding with grey hair at the sides and a squared brown beard, still in the classic teal short-sleeved shirt and blue trousers.

footwear: long white socks with black checks

appearance_text: A girl with long cream-coloured hair that hangs down her back and a side fringe over big light blue eyes rimmed with black makeup. She wears a fuzzy peach jacket over a short dark brown top with a white frill, and matching dark brown shorts. Her legs are covered by long white socks patterned with black checks, ending in dark shoes.
identity_text: A fashion-styled girl with long cream hair, a fuzzy peach jacket and black-checked knee socks.

appearance_text: A tall walking cactus, green from head to foot with no face at all. Stripes of light and dark green run straight down its head, body, arms and legs. Tiny black prickles are dotted in rows all over it, front and back.
identity_text: A walking cactus with arms and legs, green from head to foot with light and dark vertical stripes, rows of black prickles and no face.

head: pink hair
top: dark grey robe with a cream front panel

appearance_text: A pale character with soft pink hair and big black eyes, with pink flushed cheeks. A long dark grey robe covers the body, with a cream panel running down the front and an orange belt tied at the waist. The back and sleeves are plain dark grey, and the boots match the robe.
identity_text: A young robed spellcaster with soft pink hair, wearing a long dark plum robe with a cream panel down the front and an orange sash knotted at the waist.

hair: long light brown hair with a fringe
top: orange and white striped long sleeves

appearance_text: A girl with long light brown hair falling down her back and a soft fringe over dark eyes. She wears a yellow top with long sleeves striped in orange and white, under light blue denim dungarees with straps over the shoulders and crossing the back. The wide legs of the dungarees end just above little white shoes.
identity_text: A girl in everyday summer clothes: a yellow top with orange and white striped sleeves worn under light blue denim dungarees and white shoes.

appearance_text: A girl with long brown hair, one pink eye and one purple eye. She wears a white hoodie with pink drawstrings and soft pink and blue markings on the sleeves, and the hood has frilly pink gills running down the back like an axolotl. Below it are short black shorts and white and light blue boots.
identity_text: A brown haired girl in a white hoodie themed after Minecraft's axolotl mob, with frilly pink gills down the hood, worn over black shorts and pale blue boots.

appearance_text: A character built entirely out of blocks, with a bright orange cube for a head that carries a big white question mark on every side and a black rivet in each corner. The chest is a green panel dotted with lighter green squares. The arms and legs are orange brickwork with black lines marking out each brick.
identity_text: A walking figure assembled out of platform-game blocks — a question-mark block for a head, brick-textured limbs and a green block panel on the chest. It is built from the blocks rather than being one named block.
