appearance_text: A person with shaggy black hair and green eyes, dressed for hot work at a forge. A long brown leather apron hangs from the neck down over the chest and legs, worn on top of a grey shirt with the sleeves rolled up, and a grey metal tool sits against the chest. Dark brown trousers tuck into scuffed brown boots.
identity_text: An unnamed smith with shaggy black hair, dressed for the forge in a long brown leather apron over a rolled-sleeve shirt.

appearance_text: A lumpy green creature with a wide flat head, two dark green square eyes and a tiny nose. Its body is black with a big white skull-and-ribs pattern spread across both the chest and the back, and patches of teal on the shoulders and arms. The legs are black splashed with green mossy patches and a few small bright magenta dots.
identity_text: A fusion creature assembled from several hostile Minecraft mobs - a creeper-green head, a skeleton's ribcage across the chest and back, teal shoulders and black limbs flecked with magenta. The title is a coined label for this one texture rather than a creature that exists elsewhere.

appearance_text: A girl with long light blonde hair falling past her shoulders, with tiny pale blue flowers tucked into it at the back and sides. She has big blue eyes. She wears a soft pale blue jacket open over a dark blue top, and plain white trousers with a thin black strap around one thigh.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with long fair hair pinned with little blue flowers, wearing an open pale blue jacket, a dark navy top and plain white trousers.

head: short bobbed hair

appearance_text: A pale girl with short black hair cut in a chin length bob. She wears a plain green tracksuit, jacket and trousers, with a white collar showing at the neck and a small white number patch on the chest. On her feet are simple white slip on shoes.
identity_text: Sae-Byeok, the contestant known as Player 067 in the Netflix series Squid Game, in the numbered green tracksuit the players wear.

appearance_text: A warrior in a broad gold helmet with a dark red crest and two black slits where the eyes look out. A heavy dark red cloak hangs from the shoulders over grey plate armour, with gold guards strapped to the arms. The legs are grey armour with gold knee plates, and the cloak covers most of the back.
identity_text: An armoured warrior in a broad gold helmet with a T-shaped visor and a dark red crest, wearing a heavy dark red cloak over grey plate armour. The title describes the look; no character, empire or army is named.

head: sandy blonde hair
top: cream tunic wrapped across the front

appearance_text: A young man with sandy blonde hair and dark eyes. He wears a plain cream tunic that wraps across the front with long sleeves, held with a dark brown belt. His trousers are the same cream colour and tuck into tall dark brown boots.
identity_text: Luke Skywalker in the plain cream desert tunic and belt he wears at the start of the original Star Wars trilogy, with sandy blonde hair and tall brown boots.

appearance_text: A young man in a red short-sleeve shirt with a dark strap slung across his chest and back. He wears a brown flat cap pulled low over his eyes and has a small white bandage on his chin. His trousers are dark grey with rolled grey cuffs above grey shoes, and his arms are bare.
identity_text: The Scout from Team Fortress 2, in RED team colours: a young man in a red shirt and flat cap with a bag strap slung across his chest.

appearance_text: A girl with a short orange brown bob and a straight fringe over dark eyes. She wears a dark navy high-collared uniform jacket fastened with gold buttons, white cuffs showing at the wrists, and a brown belt at the waist. A matching dark skirt and brown ankle boots finish the outfit.
identity_text: Nobara Kugisaki from Jujutsu Kaisen, wearing the dark navy high-collared school uniform with gold buttons, white cuffs, a brown belt and brown ankle boots, her orange-brown hair cut in a short bob.

appearance_text: A soft tan dog standing upright with a pale cream muzzle, chest and paws. A pink tongue pokes out beneath its grey nose and its eyes are small grey squares. Its ears are rounded and a pale cream tail curls into a loop on its back.
identity_text: A Shiba Inu puppy standing upright, tan with a cream muzzle, chest and paws.

appearance_text: A girl whose very long hair is split down the middle, mint green on one side and candy pink on the other, falling all the way past her waist at the back. Her eyes are soft purple. She wears a mint green top striped with pink and pale blue shorts, and her legs are covered by long socks in the same pink and mint stripes.
identity_text: A girl whose waist-length hair is split mint green down one side and candy pink down the other, wearing a pastel chequered top and long matching socks.

appearance_text: A gaunt, bald figure with pale grey skin stretched tight over a domed skull. Its eyes sit in deep black hollows with tiny white points inside, and two long pointed teeth show beneath a thin nose. It wears a heavy dark brown coat that reaches the knees, fastened with round buttons down the front, over matching dark trousers and black shoes.
identity_text: Count Orlok, the vampire antagonist of the 1922 silent film Nosferatu, gaunt and bald with pale grey skin, pointed front teeth and a long buttoned coat.

head: green helmet with a gold visor
top: green chest plate with a gem

appearance_text: A warrior head to toe in green plate armour edged with gold. The helmet is green with a wide gold face plate and a black T-shaped slit for the eyes and nose. Chunky gold pads sit on the shoulders and a bright green gem shines in the middle of the chest. The arms and legs are banded in green and gold, ending in gold boots.
identity_text: An unnamed knight in full green plate armour trimmed with gold, wearing a gold-faced helmet, chunky gold shoulder pads and a green gem on the chest.

hair: long dark brown hair down the back
head: light purple axolotl hat with a face and frilly gills on top

appearance_text: A girl with tan skin and long dark brown hair wearing a big light purple animal hat shaped like an axolotl, with a face on the front and frilly gills on top. She has a simple white short sleeved top under light purple dungarees with a soft check pattern, and plain white shoes.
identity_text: A tan-skinned girl with long dark brown hair in a big light purple axolotl hat and matching checked dungarees. She is dressed as the creature rather than being one.

appearance_text: A tall figure hidden inside a dark hooded robe, with the hood pulled up so the face is nothing but shadow with two glowing pink eyes staring out. The robe is dark grey and ragged at the sleeves, with a bright pink sash tied at the waist. Black gloves cover the hands and the boots have glowing pink tops.
identity_text: The listing names this as the Raven skin from Fortnite: a robed figure whose pulled-up hood hides everything except two glowing magenta eyes.

red hair

appearance_text: A character with bright red hair sticking out under a black flat-brimmed cap that has orange flames licking around its front. The black hoodie is patterned with orange and yellow flames climbing up both sleeves and across the shoulders. Black trousers carry matching bands of yellow and orange near the ankles, above clean white shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed boy with bright red hair under a black flame-printed snapback cap, wearing a matching black hoodie and black trousers banded with fire above clean white shoes.

head: blue sailor hat with a black band
white feathered head

appearance_text: A white feathered duck standing upright, with a large orange bill and round eyes. It wears a small blue sailor hat with a black band tipped over one side of its head. Its blue sailor top has gold trim, a white collar and a red bow tie at the throat, and a white feathered tail sticks out at the back. It wears no trousers, showing bare orange duck legs and webbed feet.
identity_text: Donald Duck, the Disney cartoon duck, in his blue sailor top and hat with a red bow tie, and no trousers over his orange legs.

face: dark orange markings around the eyes
head: pointed ears
flame-coloured face

appearance_text: A creature that looks like it is made of fire, glowing orange and gold from head to toe. Its head has two pointed ears and dark orange markings around the eyes over a pale muzzle. Its chest and arms burn dark red with bright gold flames licking up the middle, and the whole back glows a brilliant gold. Its legs are speckled gold and orange like scattered embers.
identity_text: A phoenix, the mythical sacred firebird, rendered as a creature made entirely of orange and gold flame.

accessories: black gaming headset with a microphone
head: black gaming headphones
top: black t-shirt with an orange round logo

appearance_text: A bearded man with short brown hair, blank glowing white eyes and a black gaming headset with the microphone swung in front of his mouth. He wears a black t-shirt with a round orange logo on the chest and black wristbands on both arms. Dark grey jeans and white sneakers with blue trim complete the look.
identity_text: A bearded gamer in a headset and black logo tee, given the blank glowing white eyes of the Herobrine legend rather than being that character himself.

head: white skull mask
top: black costume with white ribs and bones

appearance_text: A small character in a black skeleton costume with white bones painted down the chest, arms and legs and a ribcage across the front and back. The head is a white skull with two enormous eyes and a wide grinning black mouth with a bright orange tongue hanging out. The hands and shoulders have white cuffs, and the lower legs are dark grey.
identity_text: Skid, one of the trick-or-treating kids from Sr Pelo's animated series Spooky Month, in his black-and-white painted skeleton costume.

appearance_text: A girl with long light brown hair wearing a grey green animal hood with frilly gills sticking up on top and two dark eye spots on the front. She wears a sage green jacket that slips off her shoulders over a white top, and a white checkered skirt. Long white socks and white shoes finish the outfit, and her hair falls all the way down her back.
identity_text: A girl with long light brown hair wearing an axolotl-style animal hood with frilly gills, a sage green off-shoulder jacket and a white checkered skirt.

head: hood down at the back
top: light blue hoodie with white clouds all over it

appearance_text: A girl with long brown hair falling down her back and big blue eyes. She wears a light blue zip hoodie printed all over with fluffy little white clouds, front, sleeves and back, with a plain white top showing underneath. She has short dark blue shorts, blue and white striped socks pulled up her legs, and white shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with long brown hair in a sky-themed outfit, wearing a light blue hoodie printed all over with white clouds.

head: three ridges standing up on top of the head

appearance_text: A huge muscly creature with blue grey skin and enormous arms. Its face is cream coloured with bright red eyes and a wide grin, and three cream ridges stand up on top of its head. It wears only black trunks held up by a gold belt.
identity_text: Machamp, the fighting-type Pokémon named in the title, rendered as a hugely muscled blue-grey creature in black trunks with a gold belt.

appearance_text: A big serious man drawn only in black, white and grey, with short black hair and a thick black beard covering his chin. He wears a dark grey jacket with pale grey pads over both shoulders and a black strap running across his chest and back. His trousers are dark grey with grey belts buckled around the thighs, and he has heavy black boots.
identity_text: A big, serious man drawn only in black, white and grey, with a thick black beard, a dark jacket with pale shoulder pads, a chest strap, belted trousers and heavy boots. The listing describes him as a cross between the Giga Chad meme and the Heavy from Team Fortress 2.

face: half of the face washed out to white
head: brown hair on one side
white blank on the other side

appearance_text: One half of this man looks completely ordinary — short brown hair, a brown beard, one blue eye, a teal shirt, a tan arm and blue trousers. The other half has washed out to blank white, as if it is disappearing, with a blurry grey edge where the two meet. The white side has no face, no colour and no detail at all, and the same split carries on across the back.
identity_text: Minecraft's Steve caught mid-fade: one half keeps his brown hair, teal shirt and blue trousers while the other half has washed out to blank white with no face or detail.

hair: shaggy brown hair with a fringe
top: red and black checked shirt worn open

appearance_text: A teenage boy with shaggy brown hair falling over his eyes and a wide open smile. He wears a red and black checked shirt hanging open with the sleeves rolled up over a plain white t-shirt. His jeans are blue and his trainers are grey, and the checked pattern covers the back of the shirt too.
identity_text: Bajan Canadian, a Minecraft YouTuber and member of Team Crafted, in his red and black checked shirt over a white t-shirt.

accessories: wicker basket on the back with vegetables
head: wide tan straw hat
motifs: carrot and apple in the basket
top: brown coat with a padded vest and belt pouches

appearance_text: A stooped old man with long white hair and a big white beard, half hidden under a wide tan straw hat. He wears a brown coat with a darker vest, a belt with small pouches and pale cuffs at the wrists. His trousers are olive green tucked into dark brown boots, and a woven basket packed with a carrot and an apple is strapped across his back.
identity_text: An unnamed elderly farmer on the road, in a wide straw hat and brown coat with olive trousers, carrying a wicker basket of produce on his back.

face: blank dark screen instead of a face
head: boxy white television head
dark blank screen
little coloured buttons
top: red sweater with a small black bowl and spoon printed on it

appearance_text: A figure whose head is a chunky white television set, with a dark empty screen where a face should be and tiny coloured buttons along the bottom edge. It wears a bright red sweater with a small black bowl and spoon printed on the chest, and the sleeves reach white hands. Dark blue trousers and white shoes go underneath, and the back of the television is plain white.
identity_text: An unnamed character whose head is a white television set with a blank dark screen, wearing a red sweater with a noodle-bowl print, dark blue trousers and white shoes.

head: copper head
half orange and half pale green

appearance_text: A figure whose whole body looks like a slab of copper. One side is bright orange metal speckled with lighter and darker patches, while the other side has weathered to a soft pale green. The change runs right down the middle of the head, chest and legs, so it looks like a statue slowly turning green. There is no clear face, just the faint outline of one in the metal.
identity_text: Steve cast as a solid copper statue, one half still bright orange metal and the other weathered to pale green patina, with only the faintest outline of a face.

top: dark red scarf at the neck

appearance_text: A girl with long light brown hair and big navy eyes. A dark red scarf is wrapped round her neck over a white long sleeved shirt, with a navy pinafore dress buttoned over the top. Her short navy skirt sits above cream long socks and dark red shoes, and a small navy bow is tied at her back.
identity_text: A schoolgirl with long light brown hair in a navy pinafore and white shirt, with a maroon scarf at her neck. The title names the scarf, not a character.

head: grey hood up
top: white skull printed on the chest
skull on the back of the hood

appearance_text: A kid with brown hair peeking out from under a grey hood pulled up over his head. The grey hoodie has a pale skull printed on the chest and another skull shape on the back. He wears blue jeans that fade lighter down the legs and white shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed boy in a grey hoodie worn with the hood up, a pale skull printed on the chest, blue jeans and white shoes.

hair: orange hair with a straight fringe
head: orange hair
top: light blue trim at the shoulders

appearance_text: A slim figure with bright orange hair cut in a straight fringe and green eyes in a tan face. She wears a green short sleeved tunic with a pale blue edge at the shoulders, leaving her forearms bare, and a brown belt around her waist. Her trousers are grey brown and she wears sturdy brown boots.
identity_text: Minecraft's default player character Alex, drawn in the smooth flat style of the game's promotional artwork: orange hair, green tunic with a brown belt, grey-brown trousers and brown boots.

appearance_text: A boy with brown hair combed over his forehead, wearing a bright red hoodie with white drawstrings and a black pocket across the front. The hood hangs behind his neck and a black band runs across the back of the hoodie. He wears blue jeans and black shoes with white soles.
identity_text: An unnamed boy with brown hair combed over his forehead, wearing a red hoodie marked with a black band across the chest and back, blue jeans and black shoes with white soles.

appearance_text: A boy with fluffy red hair under a tall green top hat with a dark band. He wears a green suit jacket with gold buttons over a white shirt and a black tie. His trousers match the jacket and his shoes are black.
identity_text: A ginger-haired teenager wearing a green leprechaun suit with gold buttons and a matching green top hat. He is a boy in costume rather than a leprechaun himself.

head: dark hair with pointed tufts at the sides
subjects: rugged man in a leather jacket

appearance_text: A rugged man with dark hair that sticks up in two pointed tufts, heavy sideburns and stubble across his jaw. He wears a worn brown leather jacket open over a blue shirt, with blue jeans and dark shoes.
identity_text: Logan, the clawed mutant of the X-Men, shown in ordinary clothes rather than a costume: brown leather jacket, blue shirt and blue jeans, with his hair in the two familiar pointed tufts.

appearance_text: A girl with long black hair tied into two round buns, with a fluffy white headband over her head and a long braid hanging down her back. She wears a bright yellow long sleeve shirt under light blue denim overalls with short legs. Her legs are covered by tall black socks and she has chunky black and white sneakers.
identity_text: A girl whose yellow-and-blue outfit is themed after a Minion; the figure itself is an ordinary girl in overalls, not the character.

face: no face, just darkness in the helmet
head: silver helmet
gold crest and horns
dark slit where the face should be

appearance_text: A tall warrior sealed inside gleaming silver plate armour edged everywhere with gold. The helmet has two gold horns curving up from it and nothing but darkness where a face should be. The chest plate is polished silver with gold bands over the shoulders, and the same gold pattern runs down the arms and around the dark chainmail legs and armoured boots. The armour is just as detailed across the back.
identity_text: An unnamed armoured knight sealed in silver plate trimmed with gold, his crested helmet showing only blackness where a face would be.

face: dark navy visor across the eyes
only the nose and mouth showing
head: white hood
dark visor

appearance_text: A fighter dressed head to toe in a white padded suit with a tight hood pulled over the head and a dark navy visor across the eyes, leaving only the nose and mouth bare. The suit is broken up with pale purple and grey camo patches on the arms, chest and legs. Dark navy boots cover the feet and a dark pack sits against the back.
identity_text: An Overwatch Elite, the white-uniformed heavily armoured soldier from Half-Life 2.

head: pink flowers on the back of the head

appearance_text: A girl with long pale mint green hair and small pink flowers tucked into the back of it. Her big dark eyes and pink cheeks sit in a very pale face. She wears a soft pale green top with loose sleeves over a white and light blue skirt, and small tan shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in soft sea foam colours, with pale mint hair holding pink flowers, a pale green top and a white and blue skirt.

head: dark green leaf sticking up from the head
top: green scaly chest with a dark red patch

appearance_text: A slim green lizard creature with sharp yellow eyes and a wide dark red mouth. A pointed dark green leaf sticks up from the top of its head and more leaf shapes spread across its back. A dark red patch covers the middle of its chest, and its arms and legs end in green claws.
identity_text: Grovyle, the grass-type Pokemon: a slim green lizard with sharp yellow eyes, a dark red chest patch and pointed leaves on its head and back.

colors.name: red

colors.item: melon slice on the back of the head
colors.name: red

head: green striped melon head
red melon slice at the back
top: red watermelon slice printed on the chest

appearance_text: A walking watermelon with green striped rind for skin, wearing big black sunglasses and grinning with wide white teeth. It wears a dark blue t-shirt with a red watermelon slice printed on the chest, and another red melon slice shows on the back of its head. Its shorts are watermelon red and its striped green legs are bare.
identity_text: A walking watermelon with green striped rind for skin, wearing big black sunglasses and a dark blue t-shirt printed with a slice of melon.

appearance_text: A boy with short dark brown hair and very big pale blue eyes. He wears a light blue long sleeve jumper with a white collar and two white stripes near each cuff. Grey trousers and black shoes with white soles finish the outfit.
identity_text: A dark-haired boy in a sky blue jumper with a white collar and white-striped cuffs, worn with grey trousers. The title describes his eye colour, not a character.

appearance_text: A creature made from a bar of chocolate, its brown head and chest divided into neat chocolate squares. The face has two dark square eyes and a wide dark frowning mouth. From the waist down it is still inside a bright blue wrapper torn open in a jagged white line, with red letters printed on a white label down the front.
identity_text: A creeper made out of a bar of chocolate: its head and chest are brown chocolate squares carrying the usual square eyes and wide frowning mouth, and from the chest down it is still inside a torn blue wrapper with a red lettered white label.

subjects: man in a red lightning bolt t-shirt
top: red t-shirt with a yellow lightning bolt over a striped long sleeved shirt

appearance_text: A man with short brown hair and blue eyes wearing a bright red t-shirt with a yellow lightning bolt in a white circle on the chest. Underneath it a long sleeved shirt shows at the arms, striped red and white on one side and light blue and white on the other. His trousers are brown and his shoes dark brown, and the shirt is plain red across the back.
identity_text: Sheldon Cooper from The Big Bang Theory, in his red Flash t-shirt layered over a striped long-sleeved shirt.

hair: dark brown hair with a sandy hood over it
head: sandy torn hood

appearance_text: A tan-skinned man with dark brown hair, blue eyes and a brown moustache, his head half covered by a ragged sand-coloured hood. The same torn sandy cloth hangs off his shoulders as a shirt, leaving his arms bare. Below it he wears short dark green rags and tall black boots.
identity_text: Minecraft's Steve dressed in a dead husk's desert rags, keeping his brown hair, blue eyes and moustache under a tattered sand-coloured hood. The husk clothing is a costume, so the figure named here is Steve.

top: light blue t-shirt with a v neck

appearance_text: A boy with short brown hair, light blue eyes and pink cheeks. He wears a light blue t-shirt with a small v at the neck and short sleeves, leaving his arms bare. His shorts are grey and end above the knee, and he has white shoes with black cuffs.
identity_text: An ordinary boy in a light blue t-shirt, grey shorts and white shoes, with bare arms and legs. 'Blue Summer' describes the outfit, not a character.

appearance_text: A boy with short messy brown hair and bright blue eyes. He wears a dark blue hoodie with the hood hanging down his back and the sleeves pushed to his wrists. His legs are in plain black jeans and he has blue sneakers with white soles.
identity_text: An everyday boy with short brown hair and bright blue eyes in a teal-blue hoodie worn hood-up, black jeans and blue sneakers. The title only describes the garment, so no character is named.

hair: shaggy brown hair to the shoulders
head: shaggy brown hair

appearance_text: A man with shaggy brown hair falling to his shoulders and glowing yellow eyes. He wears heavy dark brown layered robes over a black tunic, with a wide black belt at the waist and thick folds hanging down his back. His trousers are black and his tall boots are black too.
identity_text: Anakin Skywalker from Star Wars, shown hooded in layered dark brown robes over a black tunic, with the yellow eyes of the dark side.

appearance_text: A boy with short brown hair, thick eyebrows and brown eyes. He wears a plain dark red hoodie with white drawstrings hanging at the neck. His trousers are black and his shoes are grey.
identity_text: An unnamed boy in a plain maroon hoodie with black trousers and grey shoes.

hair: dreadlocks, blond on one side and dark blue at the back
head: half blond half dark dreadlocks

appearance_text: A brown-skinned character with dreadlocks that are bleached blond on one side and dark blue at the back. They wear a plain white sleeveless vest that shows tattooed arms, and loose black shorts. White socks with black stripes rise above white trainers.
identity_text: The American rapper named in the listing, shown with his half-blond dreadlocks, tattooed arms, white vest and black shorts.

bottom: woody bark legs with red berries
head: bark head with two pointed horns
top: bark chest with glowing green cracks

appearance_text: A hulking creature made of brown bark with two pointed horns rising from its head. Bright green light glows out of its eyes, mouth and the cracks running across its chest, arms and legs. Patches of dark green moss and little red berries cling to its shoulders, back and legs.
identity_text: An unnamed monster made of bark, lit from inside by bright green light that shines out of its eyes, mouth and the cracks across its body, with moss and red berries growing on it.

appearance_text: A boy with short dark brown hair falling over his eyes. He wears an open dark green jacket over a plain grey shirt, with the jacket sleeves reaching his wrists. His trousers are black and his shoes are white.
identity_text: A boy with dark brown hair falling over his eyes, in an open dark olive jacket over a grey hooded top, with ripped black jeans and white shoes. 'Dark Green' names the colour of the jacket, not a character.

appearance_text: A big blue turtle creature standing on two legs, with a broad head, small pointed ears and narrow red eyes over a wide cream jaw. Its chest and belly are cream with ridges across them. A hard brown shell covers its whole back, and its arms and legs are the same blue as its head.
identity_text: Blastoise, the large blue turtle Pokémon, standing on two legs with a hard brown shell across its back and a ridged cream belly.

accessories: brown belt with a gold buckle
wooden crate held above the head
head: red pointed gnome hat
motifs: crate with a pickaxe on it
top: dark blue coat with wide sleeves

appearance_text: A stubby little bearded fellow in a floppy red pointed hat, with a huge white beard covering most of his face and a round nose poking out. He wears a dark blue coat with wide sleeves, a brown belt with a big gold buckle, brown trousers and chunky white boots. Balanced above his hat is a wooden crate with a grey pickaxe marked on every side.
identity_text: A stubby bearded gnome in a floppy red pointed hat and dark blue coat, with a wooden chest balanced on top of his head and chunky white boots.

appearance_text: A man with fluffy brown hair and a thick dark beard covering his chin and mouth. He wears a bright pink jacket, open over a red and white patterned shirt, and the jacket is plain pink all the way round the back. His jeans are pale blue and slightly baggy, tucked into chunky white shoes.
identity_text: Garrett "The Garbage Man" Garrison from the Minecraft movie, in his bright pink jacket and pale baggy jeans.

top: small red badge on the chest

appearance_text: A serious looking man with short black hair slicked back from his forehead and very thick black eyebrows over narrow eyes. He wears a black suit jacket over a pale blue shirt with a dark grey tie, and a tiny red badge is pinned on his chest. His trousers are dark grey and his shoes are black.
identity_text: Giovanni, a character from the Pokemon games, drawn as a stern man in a black suit with a small red badge on his chest.

head: long dark red brown hair
top: red and blue armoured chest piece
glowing red gem in the middle

appearance_text: A girl with long dark red-brown hair and brown eyes. She wears a fitted red and blue armoured chest piece with a glowing red gem set in the centre, leaving her shoulders and stomach bare, and matching guards strapped around her wrists. Blue shorts sit on her hips and tall brown boots with red trim cover her lower legs.
identity_text: An unnamed heroine in a red and blue armoured breastplate with a glowing red gem, blue shorts and tall brown boots.

accessories: white spots on the back of the hoodie
head: silver grey hair with a fringe
brown animal ears on the hood
top: fluffy brown hoodie with white fur trim
white collar and a small black tie

appearance_text: This girl has shoulder length silver grey hair with a straight fringe and pale skin. She wears a fluffy brown hoodie with soft white fur trim, and the hood is shaped like an animal head with two brown ears standing up. The back of the hoodie is furry brown dotted with pale spots. A white collar with a small black tie shows at the neck, and below she wears short dark brown shorts with bare legs.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with pale ice-blue hair wearing a fluffy fox-eared animal hoodie over short dark shorts. The title reads like an account name and nothing in the listing says who she is.

hair: long dark purple hair down the back

appearance_text: A pale woman with long dark purple hair and matching purple eyes. She wears a deep purple gown with heavy gold ornaments spread across the chest and gold bands on her bare arms, leaving her shoulders uncovered. The gown flows down into a long purple skirt, and running down her back are bright magenta bows with more gold trim.
identity_text: Morgana, the dark sorceress champion from League of Legends, in a flowing purple and gold gown with bare shoulders.

hair: long blue hair in two braids
braids reaching down to the ankles
motifs: blue tattoo patterns on the arms
top: dark brown laced corset top with bare shoulders and midriff

appearance_text: A very pale girl with bright pink eyes ringed in dark liner and long blue hair tied into two braids that run all the way down her back to her ankles. She wears a laced dark brown corset top that leaves her shoulders and midriff bare, with blue tattoo patterns inked across both arms. Short brown shorts and scuffed dark brown boots cover the rest.
identity_text: Jinx as she appears in the series Arcane, with ankle-length blue braids, blue arm tattoos, a laced brown corset top and scuffed boots.

head: brown leather flying cap
goggles with light blue lenses on the forehead

appearance_text: A pilot wearing a brown leather flying cap with round goggles pushed up on the forehead, their lenses pale blue. He has a brown leather jacket done up over a cream scarf at the neck, with a belt at the waist. His trousers are dark grey and he wears brown boots.
identity_text: An old-school pilot in a brown leather flying cap and bomber jacket, with goggles pushed up on his forehead and a cream scarf at his neck.

appearance_text: A fish standing on two legs, with a big orange head, wide white eyes on the sides and an open round mouth. A dark brown hat with a wide brim sits on top. Its body is orange too, dressed in a bright blue sleeveless vest and matching blue shorts held up by a black belt. Its arms and legs are bare orange.
identity_text: Fishstick, the Fortnite outfit named in the description: an orange fish standing on two legs with wide side-set eyes, here dressed in a blue vest and shorts under a wide-brimmed brown hat.

head: yellow cowl with pointed ears
top: circle emblem with a lightning bolt

appearance_text: A figure in a full yellow bodysuit with a tight hood that has two small pointed ears on top. Glowing red lenses sit where the eyes are, and the mouth and chin are left bare. On the chest is a round emblem holding a dark red lightning bolt. Black gloves cover the hands and black boots cover the legs from the knee down, and the back of the suit is plain yellow.
identity_text: Reverse Flash, the yellow-suited speedster supervillain of DC Comics. His hood has small pointed ears and red lenses over the eyes, and a dark round emblem with a red lightning bolt sits on the chest.

head: bald head
top: bare arms and chest on one side

appearance_text: A bald, tan skinned man with thick dark eyebrows and a calm narrow-eyed face. He wears a bright orange robe draped over one shoulder that leaves the other arm and part of his chest bare, tied at the waist with a black belt. The robe continues down as loose orange trousers, ending in simple black shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed Buddhist monk: bald, tan skinned and broad shouldered, in an orange robe worn over one shoulder with a black belt and plain black shoes.

appearance_text: A tall green creature covered head to toe in blotchy light and dark green patches like camouflage. Its square head has two glowing red eyes and a wide black mouth that turns down at the corners. The body is thin and boxy with short stubby arms and four squat legs, all in the same speckled green.
identity_text: A Creeper, the exploding green mob from Minecraft, given the glowing red eyes it has in the Revenge music video. Square head with a wide black frown, boxy body and four squat legs.

appearance_text: A stocky creature covered in shaggy brown fur, with a cream muzzle and chest. Its mouth is stretched wide open showing a row of huge white fangs and a big red tongue, and its white eyes glare under heavy brows. Small round ears with pink insides sit on its head, and its short arms and legs are the same brown fur.
identity_text: Taz, the Tasmanian Devil from Looney Tunes, shown mid-roar as a stocky brown-furred beast with his mouth stretched open over huge white fangs.

bottom: black trousers with light blue stripes
face: glowing light blue visor over the eyes
head: brown hair
light blue visor across the eyes
top: white jacket with light blue trim
creeper face printed on the back

appearance_text: A boy with short brown hair and a glowing light blue visor strapped across his eyes. He wears a white jacket edged in bright light blue over a black shirt, and on the back of the jacket is a big square print of a creeper face. His black trousers have light blue stripes running down them and he wears white and grey trainers.
identity_text: A boy kitted out as a futuristic gamer or runner: a glowing cyan visor over the eyes, a white cyan-trimmed jacket with a creeper face on the back, and striped black trousers with white trainers.

appearance_text: A girl with long dark grey hair hanging over her forehead and clear green eyes. She wears a worn grey sleeveless dress that is frayed and ragged along the hem and shoulders, leaving her arms bare. Her legs and feet are bare too, with no shoes at all.
identity_text: A stranded girl with long dark grey hair in a worn, frayed grey sleeveless dress, barefoot with bare arms and legs. The title describes her situation rather than naming a character.

hair: brown hair sticking out at the back
head: green cap with a white badge

appearance_text: A young boy in a green cap with a white badge, with brown hair sticking out at the back and plain black eyes. He wears a green long sleeve shirt under purple dungarees with straps over the shoulders, and brown shoes.
identity_text: A child-sized Luigi: green cap with a white badge, green long-sleeve shirt, purple dungarees and brown shoes, with brown hair sticking out at the back and no moustache.

appearance_text: A boy with messy dark brown hair and blue eyes wearing old-fashioned village clothes. Over a cream long-sleeved shirt he has a dark red vest fastened up the front with small buttons. His trousers are dark brown and tucked into brown boots with turned-down cuffs.
identity_text: A young medieval villager in a buttoned red vest and brown work trousers, going about ordinary village business. No particular character is named.

accessories: small red and white balls on the belt
head: white cap with a red brim

appearance_text: A young boy in a white cap with a red brim, black hair poking out underneath. He wears a blue sleeveless jacket with a green collar over a white shirt, green fingerless gloves on both hands and blue jeans with small red and white balls clipped at the waist. A blue backpack is carried on his back and his trainers are white and red.
identity_text: Ash Ketchum, the Pokemon trainer, in his red-and-white cap, blue sleeveless jacket over a white shirt, green fingerless gloves, blue jeans and a backpack.

top: blue short sleeved uniform shirt with red sleeves and a red panel down the side
small yellow and red badge on the chest

appearance_text: A boy with short pale cream hair and blue eyes. He wears a short sleeved uniform shirt that is blue down the middle with red sleeves and a red panel running down one side, with a small round badge on the chest. His trousers are black with white toes showing on his shoes, and the red and blue uniform wraps around his back too.
identity_text: A pale-haired boy in the blue, red and yellow staff uniform of the Indonesian convenience store chain Indomaret, with black trousers and white shoes. The store is what the listing names, not the figure.

accessories: long dark cape down the back
head: grey helmet shaped like a spiked crown
light blue gem on the brow
top: skull shape on the belly plate

appearance_text: A figure in heavy grey plate armour from head to toe, with a helmet shaped like a spiked crown and a glowing light blue gem set above two dark eye slits. Huge shoulder plates sit above a chest plate marked with a pale skull shape, and a white fur collar tops a long dark blue cape that falls down the whole back. The legs and boots are armoured to match.
identity_text: Arthas from World of Warcraft, in spiked crown-like plate armour with a skull on the front plate and a long dark cape.

bottom: black legs with green glowing lines
head: black head with a glowing green square face
top: black chest with glowing green lines
glowing green circle on the chest

appearance_text: A black figure lit up with glowing bright green lines all over it. Its square head carries a green glowing face with two blank eye squares and a wide frowning open mouth, and the same face glows again across its back. Green lines trace the shoulders, arms and legs like circuits, with a bright glowing ring in the middle of the chest.
identity_text: A Creeper drawn in a neon circuit style: a black figure lit with bright green lines, the glowing creeper face on its head and again across its back.

head: dark helmet with a glowing yellow lamp on the front
top: torn and bloodied white shirt under dark clothes

appearance_text: A grimy figure in dark blue and purple work clothes, with a battered helmet whose yellow lamp glows on the forehead. The face beneath is dark and smudged, hard to make out. A torn pale shirt shows on the chest, stained all over with dark red blotches, and the same stains streak the arms, back and trousers down to the heavy dark boots.
identity_text: A zombie miner from deep underground, in grimy dark work clothes and heavy boots, with a battered helmet whose yellow lamp still glows.

hair: hair down the back with a small clip
top: white shirt showing at the chest

appearance_text: A pale girl with long brown hair falling down her back, held with a small clip, and soft grey eyes with pink cheeks. She wears a dark brown hoodie with the strings hanging down and a white shirt showing at the chest. Her jeans are light blue and her shoes are dark green.
identity_text: A teenage girl in everyday clothes: a dark brown hoodie with the strings hanging loose over a white shirt, pale blue jeans and dark shoes, with long brown hair down her back.

head: straight brown hair with a fringe

appearance_text: A tan man with straight brown hair falling over big black sunglasses and a wide open laughing mouth. He wears a black tuxedo jacket over a white shirt with a line of buttons and a small black bow tie, with white cuffs at the wrists. His trousers are black and his shoes are white.
identity_text: SammyGreen, an Australian Minecraft YouTuber, drawn in a black tuxedo and bow tie with big dark sunglasses.

appearance_text: A pale girl with soft light purple hair cut in a fringe at the front and gathered into a long ponytail that runs all the way down her back, with big purple eyes. She wears a dark purple band-like crop top that leaves her middle bare, with a dark purple jacket over her shoulders and arms. Dark purple shorts sit on her hips above a belt, and sturdy brown boots come up over her ankles.
identity_text: A pale girl with light purple hair in a long ponytail, dressed in a dark purple crop top, jacket and shorts with a belt and sturdy brown boots. The listing calls her an elf; the title is a one-off invented name.

head: big orange dinosaur head with a snout

appearance_text: A chunky orange dinosaur standing on two legs, with a big head, a long snout full of small white teeth and round green eyes. Its whole body is shades of orange with a paler belly and faint stripes down the tummy. Three white claws stick out from each hand and foot.
identity_text: Agumon from Digimon, the short two-legged orange dinosaur with a toothy snout, green eyes and three white claws on each hand and foot.

top: white t-shirt with an avocado on it

appearance_text: A pale boy with messy dark green hair hanging over his eyes. He wears a loose white t-shirt with a big green avocado printed in the middle of the chest, its brown stone in the centre. His trousers are pale green with a checked pattern, and he wears simple brown shoes.
identity_text: An ordinary boy with messy dark green hair, wearing a white t-shirt with a big avocado printed on the chest and green chequered trousers. The title is a nickname for the look and the listing itself calls him just a regular guy, so there is no character to name.

bottom: black trousers with a red band at the ankle
head: short black hair
top: red jacket with white stripes on the sleeves and body

appearance_text: This man has short black hair and light skin, with a wide pair of grey sunglasses across his eyes. He wears a bright red jacket banded with white stripes on the sleeves and body, with a bit of white shirt showing at the collar. His trousers are black with a red band at the ankles, above red and black shoes.
identity_text: A skin of the YouTuber VanossGaming: a man in a red jacket banded with white stripes, wide grey sunglasses, black trousers and red and black shoes.

head: dark rocky head
orange lava over the top of the head
two little horns of flame

appearance_text: A monster whose body looks like blackened burnt rock split open by rivers of orange and yellow lava. Bright molten patches cover the top of its head, one arm and its shoulders, and hot pink streaks run down its chest and back. Its feet glow the brightest, as if it is standing in melted rock.
identity_text: A creature that looks like a lump of burnt black rock cracked open, with orange, yellow and hot pink lava running down its chest and glowing brightest at its feet.

colors.item: plume on the back of the helmet
colors.name: pink

face: no face, just a dark slit in the helmet
head: full helmet
copper faceplate
narrow eye slit
plume at the back

appearance_text: A warrior sealed inside dark blue armour edged all over with copper. The full helmet covers the whole head, with a copper band across the face and a narrow black slit to see through, and a pink plume rising from the back. Copper trim outlines the shoulder plates, the chest and the arms. The armoured legs are the same dark blue with copper edges down to heavy boots.
identity_text: An unnamed knight sealed inside dark blue plate armour edged with copper, with a full helm, a narrow eye slit and a pink plume at the back.

top: dark red cloth down the back

appearance_text: A young man with tall spiky blonde hair and bright blue eyes. He wears a dark navy top with a grey metal guard strapped over one shoulder, and a long dark red cloth hangs down the whole of his back. His trousers are grey-blue with belts around the waist, tucked into worn brown boots.
identity_text: Cloud Strife, the spiky blonde-haired swordsman who is the main character of Final Fantasy VII, in a navy top with a metal shoulder guard and a red cloth down his back.

appearance_text: A creature built out of pale tan and cream bones from head to toe. Its skull has dark sunken sockets with tiny light blue eyes and a wide open mouth full of teeth. Ribs show across the chest and down the back, and the fingers and toes end in sharp teal claws.
identity_text: A pale bone-coloured dinosaur that looks built from its own skeleton, with dark sunken sockets holding tiny blue eyes, a wide toothy mouth and teal claws.

top: baggy white jumper with a red strawberry

appearance_text: A girl with long brown hair and green eyes wearing a baggy white jumper with a big red strawberry printed on the front. The sleeves hang past her hands and her legs are bare below the jumper. Green checked socks come up her calves into little red strawberry boots, and her hair covers most of her back.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in a strawberry-themed outfit: an oversized white jumper printed with a big red strawberry, worn with green checked socks and berry-red boots.

bottom: black trousers with white stripes near the ankles
head: short dark brown hair
top: black jacket open over a white shirt

appearance_text: This man has short dark brown hair and tan skin, with a small beard and a pair of red framed sunglasses across his eyes. He wears a black jacket hanging open over a plain white shirt, and the jacket is solid black across the back. His trousers are black with white bands near the ankles, above black shoes.

keywords: DJ Got Us Fallin' in Love
identity.name: Usher

identity_text: The singer Usher, as drawn for CaptainSparklez's Minecraft music-video parody: a black jacket open over a white shirt, with red-framed sunglasses.

head: dark brown hair
top: orange brown coat with gold trim

appearance_text: A heavy-set man with a thick dark beard and a scowling face, dressed in a long orange brown coat edged with gold. A pale strap runs diagonally across his chest and the back of the coat is deep red with gold flashes at the shoulders. Below the coat are dark blue trousers and worn brown boots.
identity_text: Gangplank, the pirate captain champion from League of Legends, in a gold-trimmed orange coat with a strap across his chest.

hair: one long black braid down the back
motifs: dark blue stripes on the skin
top: bare blue chest with a brown strap across it

appearance_text: A tall figure with bright blue striped skin, glowing yellow cat-like eyes and a flat wide nose. Short black hair sits on the head and one long black braid runs all the way down the back. The chest is bare apart from a brown strap crossing it, with matching brown bands on the arms and a simple brown loincloth over bare blue legs.
identity_text: Jake Sully in his Na'vi form from Avatar: a tall blue striped alien with a long braid, a brown chest strap and a loincloth.

accessories: grey backpack with straps over the shoulders
head: messy black hair over the forehead

appearance_text: A boy with messy black hair falling over his forehead and light brown skin. He wears a plain grey hoodie with the hood down and matching grey jeans. A grey backpack sits on his back with the straps over both shoulders, and his trainers are white.
identity_text: A boy in a plain grey hoodie and grey jeans carrying a grey backpack; the title describes the low-key look rather than naming anyone.

colors.item: stripes on the arms and legs
colors.name: white

face: big black eyes with tiny white pupils
blue tear streaks running down the cheeks
head: smooth white mask face

appearance_text: A tall thin figure with a smooth white mask for a face, big black eyes with tiny white pupils and a wide black smile. Two blue tear streaks run down each cheek. Its body is black with a small blue bow tie and two blue buttons down the chest, and its arms and legs are wrapped in bold black and white stripes.
identity_text: Monster Vinnie, the masked puppet-like animatronic from the horror game series Five Nights at Candy's. It appears as a tall black-bodied figure in a white mask with blue tears, a small blue bow tie and striped limbs.

face: eyes hidden under a low grey helmet
red bandana pulled over the mouth
head: low grey helmet

appearance_text: A tough figure whose eyes are hidden beneath a low grey helmet and whose mouth is covered by a red bandana. His chest is bare and pale, crossed by a black strap, with a small row of red spots across the ribs. Black guards cover his forearms and shoulders, and he wears dark grey trousers tucked into black boots.
identity_text: Honeydew, the dwarf character from the Yogscast's Minecraft series on YouTube: a helmeted figure with a huge red beard, a bare chest crossed by a black strap, and black arm and shoulder guards.

motifs: criss cross pattern on the legs

appearance_text: A pale girl with very long dark green hair and light green eyes. She wears a baggy black hoodie with long sleeves over a short black skirt. Her legs are bare with a criss-cross pattern across the thighs, and she has short white socks with black shoes.
identity_text: A pale girl with very long dark green hair and light green eyes, in a baggy black hoodie and short black skirt with criss-cross patterned legs. The title describes her colouring, not a character.

appearance_text: A tall thin figure whose head is a smooth blank gold block with no eyes, nose or mouth at all. It wears a dark gold suit jacket over a yellow shirt with a black tie down the chest, and the same dark gold covers its legs. Its blocky hands are pale yellow and the plain suit continues all the way around the back.
identity_text: Slenderman, the tall faceless figure in a business suit, recoloured entirely in gold. His head is a smooth blank block with no eyes, nose or mouth.

head: white and yellow cat face
top: light blue and white striped football shirt

appearance_text: A cartoon cat with a white face, huge black eyes, a red nose and a yellow muzzle, its arms covered in brown fur. It wears a football shirt striped in light blue and white with a big number ten across the back. Dark blue shorts, white socks and dark boots complete the kit.
identity_text: Gaturro, the cartoon cat, dressed in a light blue and white striped football kit with the number ten on the back, dark shorts and white socks.

colors.item: meat patty in the burger head
colors.name: brown

head: hamburger for a head
bun, tomato, patty and lettuce layers

appearance_text: A man in a smart dark grey suit whose head is a giant hamburger instead of a face. The bun is tan on the top and bottom with a red tomato slice, a dark brown meat patty and frilly green lettuce stacked between them. Under the suit jacket he wears a white shirt with a dark purple tie, and his trousers and shoes are dark.
identity_text: A man in a dark pinstriped business suit whose head is a whole stacked hamburger, with no face at all. The title is a coined label for the joke rather than an existing character.

head: pink cat ears
pink hair
top: pink and dark red striped top
black cross shape on the chest

appearance_text: A pale girl with long pink hair and two pink cat ears on her head, her eyes closed in a happy little smile. Her top has pink and dark red stripes down the sleeves with a small black cross shape on the chest. She wears a pink and red checked skirt, her legs are bare, and her shoes are black.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with long pink hair and pink cat ears, in a striped pink and dark red top marked with a black tie shape, a checked skirt and black shoes.

bottom: long flowing skirt fading from teal to pale mint green
footwear: bare feet under the long skirt
hair: very long dark teal hair down the back

appearance_text: A pale girl with very long dark teal hair that runs all the way down her back, with a light purple fringe across her forehead. She wears a sleeveless dress whose top is dark teal and whose long flowing skirt fades down into pale mint green, leaving her arms bare. White bracelets circle both wrists and a black band sits around one leg.
identity_text: A girl dressed to look like the northern lights, in a sleeveless gown whose skirt fades from dark teal into pale mint, with very long teal hair. The title names the theme of the dress rather than the figure.

head: tall spiky yellow hair
motifs: orange fighting gi with a blue sash

appearance_text: A fighter with tall spiky golden yellow hair and bright green eyes. He wears an orange fighting outfit with a dark blue undershirt showing at the collar and a dark blue sash tied around his waist. Blue bands circle his wrists and dark blue boots cover his feet, with the orange top continuing across his back.
identity_text: Son Goku from Dragon Ball in his orange fighting gi, drawn in the golden-haired, green-eyed Super Saiyan form.

appearance_text: A man with short brown hair, a neat brown beard and purple eyes. He wears a plain teal short-sleeved t-shirt with bare tan arms, and dark blue trousers. Grey shoes cover his feet, and the back of the shirt is the same plain teal.
identity_text: A remake of Steve, the default Minecraft player character, with the familiar teal t-shirt, dark blue trousers and brown beard.

appearance_text: A smiling man with short brown hair and blue eyes. He wears a loose white sleeveless vest with a cord round his neck, leaving his arms and shoulders bare. His swim shorts are red and his legs and feet are bare.
identity_text: A young lifeguard in a white sleeveless vest and red swim shorts, barefoot with a whistle cord round his neck. The title is his job rather than a name.

appearance_text: A pale man with short dark brown hair, light blue eyes and a thick brown beard and moustache covering his chin. He wears a plain red collared shirt with the sleeves ending at the wrists. His trousers are blue jeans and his shoes are dark brown.
identity_text: A plain bearded man in a red collared shirt, blue jeans and brown shoes. The listing says this is the skin worn in the Minecraft music video 'In Search of Diamonds' but names no character.

colors.item: stripe down the back of the shirt
colors.name: white

top: blue plaid flannel shirt worn open

appearance_text: A boy with messy brown hair that hangs over his grey eyes. He wears a blue and black checked flannel shirt open over a plain dark blue t-shirt, with a wide white stripe running down the back of the shirt. Below he has black shorts and his lower legs and feet are bare.
identity_text: An unnamed teenage boy with messy brown hair hanging over his eyes, in a blue and black plaid flannel worn open over a dark navy top, with black trousers and bare feet.

hair: two hair loops at the front

appearance_text: A tan-skinned girl with very long dark brown hair, two thin loops of hair framing her face, and bright blue eyes. She wears a blue robe with white bands at the cuffs and hem, a pale blue choker at her throat and a white sash hanging down the front. The long blue skirt reaches her shins over darker blue leggings, and dark brown boots with white tops cover her feet. Her hair falls in a thick curtain all down her back.
identity_text: Katara, the waterbender from Avatar: The Last Airbender, in her blue robe with white trim, blue choker and hair loops.

appearance_text: A girl with very long hair that glows like fire, deep orange at the roots and bright yellow at the tips, hanging in a thick sheet down her back. Her cheeks have a warm orange blush under brown eyes. She wears a plain cream sweater and matching cream trousers, with grey bands around each ankle.
identity_text: An unnamed girl whose very long hair is coloured like fire, deep orange at the roots and bright yellow at the tips. She wears a plain cream sweater and trousers with pale blue bands at the ankles.

colors.item: dark red bow tie at the collar (front only)
colors.name: red

head: light brown shaggy hair
top: black and white striped long sleeve shirt

appearance_text: A boy with light brown shaggy hair that hangs over his eyes and a small red scarf tied at his neck. He wears a long sleeved shirt with wide black and white stripes under blue denim overalls with straps over both shoulders. His shoes are white with black soles, and the stripes and overall straps carry around to his back.
identity_text: An unnamed boy in blue denim overalls worn over a boldly striped black and white long-sleeved shirt, with a little red tie at his neck.

colors.item: block on top of the head
colors.name: blue

head: blue block on top of the head
huge white eyes
top: huge screaming mouth on the chest

appearance_text: A creature dressed in a smart black suit with white shirt cuffs and a small gold tie. Its head has two enormous white eyes with a bright blue block sitting on top, and a huge mouth ringed in red gapes open across its chest, full of white teeth. Its shoes are teal.
identity_text: A cartoon creature in a smart black suit and gold tie, with a bright blue block for a head and a huge red-rimmed mouth gaping open down its chest, in the pose of the 'firing my lazor' meme face the listing mentions.

appearance_text: A girl with long light brown hair and soft teal eyes. She wears a thick dark brown coat left open over a plain white top, with a light blue knitted scarf wrapped around her neck and hanging down her front and back. A short black skirt sits at her waist, and long brown socks come up her legs into dark brown boots.
identity_text: An unnamed girl dressed for cold weather in a thick brown coat, a knitted scarf, a short dark skirt and long socks with boots.

appearance_text: A woman with long brown hair under a wide dark blue tricorn hat with a dark red band. She wears a brown leather corset laced over a cream shirt, with her arms bare, and a belt around her waist. Dark brown trousers tuck into tall black boots, and her hair hangs down her back beneath the hat.
identity_text: An unnamed woman dressed as a pirate, in a dark blue tricorn hat over long brown hair, a laced leather corset over a cream shirt, and tall black boots.

bottom: short black skirt with white buttons
hair: hair in strands over the shoulders

appearance_text: A pale girl with long blonde hair falling in strands over her shoulders and big grey eyes. She wears a blue denim jacket over a light blue top, with dark bands round the sleeves. Her skirt is short and black with two little white buttons, and her legs disappear into tall dark brown boots.
identity_text: An unnamed blonde girl in a blue denim jacket over a light blue top, with a short black skirt and tall dark brown boots that come up over her legs.

head: fox pelt hood
pointed fox ears
top: orange fur mantle over the shoulders

appearance_text: A figure wearing an orange fox pelt pulled over the head like a hood, complete with two pointed fox ears, so only a tan face with dark eyes shows underneath. Shaggy orange fur spills over the shoulders and down the whole back like a cloak. Underneath is a teal tunic with a grey beaded necklace, and the legs are wrapped in patchy brown fur that ends in furry boots.
identity_text: Sister of the Fox, a character from Mojang's card game Scrolls, shown as a hunter wearing an orange fox pelt as both hood and cloak over a teal tunic.

face: two narrow glowing white eye slits
head: smooth gold helmet covering the whole head

appearance_text: A hero whose head is completely covered by a smooth gold helmet with two narrow glowing white slits for eyes and no mouth at all. Broad gold shoulder plates and a gold chest panel sit over a dark blue bodysuit, with gold gauntlets on the arms. The legs are dark blue with tall gold boots, and a long gold panel hangs down the back like a cape.
identity_text: Doctor Fate, the helmeted sorcerer-superhero of the Justice League, in gold armour and cape over a dark blue bodysuit.

bottom: blue robe down to the feet
head: gold crown with red gems
top: long white beard hanging over the chest

appearance_text: An old man with pale blue skin, small black eyes and an enormous white beard that hangs from his chin all the way down to his waist. A tall gold crown with three red gems sits on his head over white hair. He wears a plain blue robe that covers his arms and reaches down to his feet, blue all the way around the back.
identity_text: The Ice King from Adventure Time, an old blue-skinned wizard king in a long blue robe, with a huge white beard and a tall gold crown set with red gems.

bottom: gold belt with a big buckle
face: white eye holes with dark eyes
orange nose and mouth showing through the mask
head: blue and red wrestling mask
yellow patch on top

appearance_text: A big muscly figure with orange skin wearing a blue wrestling mask with red side panels, a yellow patch on top and white eye holes. His chest and arms are bare and bulging, with blue bands round the wrists. He wears blue trunks held by a wide gold champion belt, and tall blue boots.
identity_text: El Primo, the masked luchador brawler from the mobile game Brawl Stars. He is drawn as a heavy orange-skinned wrestler in a blue and red mask, bare bulging chest, and a gold champion belt.

appearance_text: A fierce blue beast covered in icy scales, with a huge dark red mouth wide open showing rows of blunt white fangs and narrow black eyes above it. A pale white patch runs down its chest and another pale streak marks its back. Its legs are the same scaly blue and end in white clawed feet.
identity_text: An invented beast rather than a known character: a scaly ice-blue creature with a gaping dark red mouth full of blunt white fangs, narrow black eyes and clawed white feet, which the listing places on the planet Nuron.

face: two tiny pink eyes glowing inside the cage
head: dark iron cage block for a head

appearance_text: A blocky figure whose head is a dark iron cage of thick bars, with two tiny pink eyes glowing somewhere inside it. The whole body, arms and legs are grey stone speckled with patches of green moss. There is no clothing at all, just rough stone from shoulders to feet.
identity_text: The Minecraft mob spawner block walking about: a barred iron cage for a head with a tiny mob spinning inside it, on a body of grey mossy cobblestone.

hair: long dark brown hair down the back
head: yellow flower crown around the head

appearance_text: A brown skinned girl with long dark brown hair falling down her back and a ring of bright yellow flowers circling her head. She smiles under dark eyes. Her top is a simple light blue tank top and she wears short dark blue denim shorts. Long white socks reach her knees above small black shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed brown skinned girl with a ring of bright yellow sunflowers around her head, wearing a light blue tank top, denim shorts and white knee socks.

head: yellow corn kernel head
top: body covered in yellow corn kernels

appearance_text: A walking corn cob with a head and body made of chunky yellow and orange kernels. Two tiny black eyes and a small black smiling mouth sit on the front of its head. Its arms are covered in kernels too, and its legs are green husk leaves with darker green stripes running down them.
identity_text: A cheerful walking corn cob, its head and body covered in yellow and orange kernels, with a tiny smiling face and green husk leaves for legs.

colors.item: eye piece over half the face
colors.name: purple

face: one glowing light blue robot lens in a purple plate
head: short brown hair
purple metal eye piece covering one side of the face
top: purple chest armour with a glowing light blue core

appearance_text: A person with short brown hair whose right side of the face is covered by a purple metal plate with a glowing light blue lens where the eye should be, while the other eye is still human blue. Purple chest armour with a bright light blue glowing core sits over dark green shoulder plates, and one arm is a metal limb. Dark grey trousers and grey boots cover the legs, and the glowing blue lines run down the back too.
identity_text: A part-machine man: one side of his face sits behind a purple metal plate with a glowing blue lens, and he wears purple and green armour with a glowing core on the chest.

colors.item: whipped cream swirl on the back
colors.name: cream

footwear: dark brown boots with fluffy cream tops
head: long brown hair
two furry brown ears

appearance_text: A girl with long wavy brown hair, rosy cheeks and two furry brown ears on top of her head. She wears a tan and brown wrapped top that leaves her shoulders bare, with a big swirl of cream curling up her back like the top of a hot drink. Her legs go into dark brown boots with soft fluffy cream cuffs.
identity_text: An unnamed girl themed after a hot autumn drink, in a tan and brown wrapped top with a cream swirl curling up her back, animal ears on her head and fluffy-topped brown boots.

top: small orange logo on the chest

appearance_text: A young man with short dark brown hair, pale skin and thick dark eyebrows. He wears a blue-grey t-shirt with a tiny orange mark on the chest and loose white shorts. His shoes are white, and his bare arms show below the short sleeves.
identity_text: A young man with short dark brown hair in a blue-grey t-shirt marked with a tiny orange logo, loose white shorts and white shoes. The title only calls him a simple guy.

accessories: red bow tie at the collar
head: white animal ears with red bows
top: black dress with a red bow

appearance_text: A girl with very long pale cream hair that hangs past her waist and covers her eyes with thick bangs. Small white animal ears with little red bows sit on top of her head, and her cheeks are pink. She wears a black dress with a red bow at the collar and a short black skirt. Long white socks come up over her knees and her white shoes have tiny red bows on them.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with very long pale cream hair and white cat ears, in a black dress with red bows and long white socks.

appearance_text: A dried-out zombie with sandy brown cracked skin, dark hollow eyes and no mouth at all. It is dressed very smartly in a tan suit jacket over a white shirt with a black tie, and white cuffs poke out at the wrists. The trousers are black and so are its shoes, and its bare sandy hands hang out of the sleeves.
identity_text: A Husk, the dried-out desert zombie mob from Minecraft, dressed smartly in a tan suit jacket, white shirt, black tie and black trousers.

bottom: grey trousers with a pale pattern
head: pink axolotl hood
frilly pink gills around the head
flat pink face with a wide mouth
top: small white points at the shoulders

appearance_text: A pink figure wearing a big axolotl head as a hood, with a flat pink face, two small dark eyes and a row of frilly darker pink gills sticking out all around it. The body and arms are the same soft pink, with two tiny white points at the shoulders. Grey shorts with a pale pattern cover the hips and the legs are grey down to pale pink feet.
identity_text: A boy in a pink axolotl costume, the axolotl head pulled over his own like a hood — a person in a costume rather than the animal.

appearance_text: A girl with long blonde hair tied back with a green band, the hair falling in a wide sheet down her back. Her jumper is striped in red and white with a chunky green scarf around the neck, and she wears green shorts. Her socks carry the same red and white stripes and her shoes are pale green.
identity_text: A blonde girl in a red and white striped jumper with a green scarf, green shorts and striped socks, the whole outfit built out of fruit colours. The title is a description of that look, not a name.

head: dark brown hood
top: black and white penguin picture on the back

appearance_text: A girl with very long dark brown hair falling down her back, wearing a dark brown hood pulled over her head and big light blue eyes underneath. Her light grey jumper is worn under a fluffy dark brown jacket, and a large black and white penguin is printed across the back of the jumper. She has short dark purple shorts and tall dark brown boots with white sock cuffs peeking out at the top.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in a winter outfit themed around penguins, with a big penguin printed on the back of her jumper under a fluffy hooded jacket. The title names the garment, not a character.

appearance_text: A stocky character with pinkish-brown skin, a big flat nose taking up the middle of the face, a thick dark unibrow and small green eyes. He is dressed in a smart black suit jacket over a white shirt collar with a bright red tie. Black suit trousers and black shoes complete the outfit, and his bare arms stick out of the short sleeves.
identity_text: A Minecraft villager — big flat nose, heavy unibrow, small green eyes — dressed up in a black suit jacket, white collar and bright red tie.

face: tiny blue eyes squeezed to the top of the head
head: short brown hair

appearance_text: A man whose face has been squashed and stretched into a huge toothy grin that fills most of his head, with two tiny blue eyes pushed right up to the top. Brown hair sits above and a brown beard rings the wide mouth. He wears a teal shirt with bare tan arms, blue trousers and grey shoes.
identity_text: Minecraft's Steve in his default teal shirt and blue trousers, redrawn as a cursed meme with his mouth stretched into an enormous toothy grin filling the head.

appearance_text: A dark skinned footballer with a shaved head and a small blonde mohawk strip on top. He wears a blue short sleeved football shirt with a small green, white and red flag badge on the chest and a big white number 9 across the back. His shorts are white, his socks are white and his boots are grey.
identity_text: Mario Balotelli, the Italian footballer, in a blue football shirt with a small Italian flag badge and a big white number 9 on the back, white shorts and grey boots.

top: big pink bow at the neck

appearance_text: A girl with long dark brown wavy hair spilling down her back, brown eyes and pink cheeks. She wears a soft light blue cardigan over a white shirt with a big pink bow tied at her neck. Her skirt is pink and pleated, and below it she has long white socks pulled up her legs and small black shoes.
identity_text: A schoolgirl with long dark wavy hair, a light blue cardigan, a big pink bow at her neck and a pink pleated skirt.

colors.item: stripes on the sleeves and legs
colors.name: light blue

top: pink jacket with light blue striped sleeves

appearance_text: A girl with long soft pink hair and pale blue eyes. She wears an open pink jacket whose sleeves are ringed with light blue stripes and spots, over a plain white top, and the pink and blue pattern carries across her back too. Below she has light blue shorts and legs covered in matching pink and blue candy stripes.
identity_text: A girl with long soft pink hair in a candy-coloured outfit — an open pink jacket with blue striped sleeves over a white top, light blue shorts and pink and blue striped legs.

appearance_text: A boy with messy ginger hair and blue eyes. He wears a grey school jumper over a white collared shirt with a red and yellow striped tie, and a thin red belt at the waist. His trousers are black and so are his shoes.
identity_text: Ron Weasley from Harry Potter, in the grey school jumper, white collared shirt and red and gold striped tie of his wizarding school uniform.

appearance_text: A girl with very long light brown hair and big blue eyes. She wears a white t-shirt under short black dungarees with a bright yellow lemon printed on the front. Her legs are bare with a thin black band around one thigh, and her shoes are white.
identity_text: A girl in short black dungarees worn over a white tee, with a big yellow lemon printed on the front and white shoes. A descriptive title, not a name.

face: one green eye and one blue eye
hair: wavy brown hair down the back

appearance_text: A pale girl with very long wavy brown hair reaching the middle of her back, tied with small black bows. One of her eyes is green and the other is blue. She wears an open black jacket over a light grey top and a grey skirt. Her legs are covered by black thigh high socks that leave a strip of bare skin, and she has white shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with very long wavy brown hair in an open black jacket, grey skirt and black thigh high socks.

appearance_text: A slim figure whose whole body looks carved from glassy black rock flecked with dark purple. Two small white eyes glow out of the otherwise featureless head, with no mouth or nose. Arms, chest and legs are all the same speckled black stone.
identity_text: A humanoid figure built entirely from obsidian, glassy black rock speckled with dark purple, with two small glowing points for eyes. Not a named character.

appearance_text: A girl with long silver hair that falls past her shoulders and pale yellow green eyes. She wears an olive green checked flannel jacket hanging open over a plain black shirt. Her jeans are dark navy and her shoes are light blue. Her hair covers most of her back.
identity_text: An unnamed teenage girl in an olive plaid flannel jacket over a black shirt, with long silver-white hair, dark jeans and light blue shoes.

head: black bat mask with pointed ears
white eye slits
top: yellow oval badge with a black bat

appearance_text: A hero in a black mask with pointed ears and glowing white eye slits, leaving only the chin bare. The suit is grey with a yellow oval on the chest holding a black bat shape, and a wide yellow belt at the waist. Black gloves, black shorts and boots complete it, and a long black cape hangs down the back.
identity_text: Batman, the DC comic book superhero, in the classic grey suit with a black bat cowl, yellow oval bat badge, yellow utility belt and a long black cape.

appearance_text: A figure shaped like the classic blocky hero, with a bowl haircut and a short beard, but made entirely of shiny purple crystal. The shirt, sleeves, trousers and shoes are all still there as shapes, only every one of them is the same speckled purple. Lighter purple highlights catch across the chest, arms and back.
identity_text: Minecraft's Steve rendered in solid amethyst — the classic blocky silhouette with its bowl haircut and beard, every part of the outfit the same speckled purple crystal.

accessories: jetpack with orange flames on the back
head: space helmet with a glowing orange visor
top: light blue space suit with a grey chest panel

appearance_text: An explorer sealed inside a pale blue space suit, with a helmet whose whole visor glows warm orange and yellow. A dark grey control panel sits in the middle of the chest and the suit is patterned with lighter and darker blue patches all over. Strapped to the back is a pack with white tubes and bright orange flames shooting out of the bottom.
identity_text: An unnamed astronaut sealed in a pale blue space suit whose visor glows orange, with a flaming jetpack strapped to the back.

bottom: white armoured legs with black bands
face: grey breathing vents on the mouth
head: white helmet with a black visor

appearance_text: A figure in full white plate armour from head to toe. The white helmet has a wide black band across the eyes and grey vents over the mouth. White chest and shoulder plates sit over a black bodysuit that shows at the sides and under the arms, with a black belt at the waist. The legs are armoured in white with black bands at the knees, down to white boots, and the back is covered by a plain white shell.
identity_text: A Stormtrooper, one of the white-armoured soldiers of the Galactic Empire in Star Wars, shown in full helmet and plate armour over a black undersuit.

face: open mouth with a red tongue
head: round green head

appearance_text: A bright green creature with a huge pair of white googly eyes with tiny black pupils taking up most of its face. Under them sits a thick black moustache and a wide open mouth with a red tongue showing. The whole body is green with a lighter green oval on the chest, and the arms and legs are green too.
identity_text: An unnamed silly green creature whose face is almost entirely taken up by huge white googly eyes above a wide, gaping red-tongued mouth.

appearance_text: A grim warrior with a bare cream skull for a head, glowing orange eyes burning in the sockets. Its body is covered in battered dark brown plate armour with heavy shoulder pieces and a belt at the waist. The legs are black and armoured, ending in scuffed dark boots.
identity_text: A skeletal warrior with a bare skull and glowing orange eyes, dressed in battered dark plate armour. The title describes the look rather than naming a character.

appearance_text: A girl whose long hair looks like orange and yellow flames, falling all the way down her back. She wears a long red dress with red and white striped sleeves and a dark red skirt. Her legs are covered by red and white striped socks, and she has big brown eyes in a pale face.
identity_text: A girl styled after fire, with long flame-shaped orange hair falling down her back and a long red dress. 'Nether Girl' describes the fiery look rather than naming a character.

accessories: leather satchel on a strap across the chest and back
head: wide brown cowboy hat with a dark band
top: light blue button shirt with rolled sleeves

appearance_text: A bearded man in a wide brown cowboy hat with a dark band, with brown hair showing beneath it. He wears a light blue button shirt with the sleeves rolled up, a leather satchel on a strap crossing his chest and hanging at his back, and a brown belt over dark brown trousers. Tall dark brown boots come up to his knees.
identity_text: Arthur Morgan, the outlaw hero of Red Dead Redemption 2, shown as a bearded cowboy in a wide brown hat, light blue work shirt, satchel strap across the chest and tall dark boots.

bottom: checkered cloak panels over the legs
head: shaggy dark red hair
top: black uniform jacket with a white collar
green and black checkered cloak over the shoulders and down the back

appearance_text: A boy with shaggy dark red hair and pink eyes, dressed in a black uniform with a white collar. Over his shoulders and all down his back hangs a cloak in a bold green and black checkerboard pattern, with the same checks over his legs.
