A belt holds the uniform at his waist and he wears white socks with dark sandals.
identity_text: Tanjiro Kamado from Demon Slayer, in his black slayer uniform under the green and black chequered haori.

appearance_text: A pale girl with very long light brown hair, small matching cat ears and a bright pink bow clipped to one side of her head. She wears a soft light blue t-shirt with a little pink cat printed on the front. Her legs are covered by plain white leggings.
identity_text: A pale girl with very long light brown hair, small matching cat ears and a bright pink bow, wearing a light blue t-shirt with a little pink cat printed on the front over pale legs.

appearance_text: A girl with long wavy brown hair and a small blue flower tucked above her ear. Her short sleeved top is light blue with a splash of darker blue across the back. She wears short black shorts, leaves her legs bare, and finishes with light blue shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in a light blue summer top and black shorts, with a blue flower tucked into her long brown hair.

hair: black hair at the back of the head
head: white mask
two grey horns

appearance_text: A figure dressed all in black wearing a smooth white mask with two short grey horns curling up from the top. The mask has narrow black slits for eyes and a huge black grin full of square teeth, with grey shading on the cheeks. Its body is covered by a black padded vest with pouches across the chest, over black sleeves. The trousers are dark grey with knee pads, above black shoes with white soles.
identity_text: A warrior dressed head to toe in black tactical clothing, his face hidden behind a smooth white horned mask with narrow eye slits and a huge square-toothed grin. Nothing in the listing ties him to any particular character.

accessories: bushy orange tail with a white tip
head: orange fox ears on top of the head

appearance_text: A person zipped into a fluffy orange fox suit, with pointed fox ears sitting on top of their head and brown hair falling around a pale face with green eyes. The fur covers the arms, body and legs in warm orange, and a big bushy tail with a white tip hangs down the back. On the feet are dark brown paw boots.
identity_text: A person zipped into a fluffy orange fox onesie with pointed ears, a white-tipped bushy tail and paw boots, their own face and brown hair still visible.

hair: small patch of orange brown hair on top of the head

appearance_text: An undead figure with blue-green skin, sunken black eyes and a flat unhappy mouth, with only a small patch of orange brown hair left on top of its head. It wears a torn dark purple shirt whose ragged hem and sleeves hang loose. Its trousers are the same teal colour as its skin and are frayed into jagged tatters at the bottom, leaving its feet bare.
identity_text: A cartoon styled version of the Minecraft zombie mob, blue-green skinned and barefoot in a torn purple shirt and ragged teal trousers.

appearance_text: A tall metal figure with a silver skull shaped head, hollow black eyes and a grim slot of a mouth. Its chest is built from silver plates with dark red wires running through them and a bright green light glowing in the middle. The arms, back and legs are the same bare silver metal with joints showing, and it ends in metal feet.
identity_text: A humanoid machine built as a bare metal endoskeleton, with a skull shaped head, hollow eye sockets and a green light glowing in the middle of its chest.

appearance_text: A chunky dinosaur standing on two legs, coloured bright pinkish purple all over. Its face has small dark eyes and a wide grin full of white teeth. A pale green patch runs down the front of its belly and its arms and legs are short and round.
identity_text: Barney, the big friendly dinosaur from the children's television show Barney & Friends, standing on two legs with short round arms, a pale green belly and a wide toothy grin.

colors.item: cap on top of the head
colors.name: grey

head: grey cap on top of the head
boxy metal head
top: yellow and brown metal chest plate

appearance_text: A boxy robot built out of yellow and rusty brown metal panels, with a grey cap fitted over the top of its head. In the middle of its dark face panel is one big glowing blue eye. Its chest is a bolted metal plate with a small red light, the same battered panels run across its back, and it stands on stubby black metal legs.
identity_text: Claptrap, the general-purpose robot from the Borderlands games — a battered yellow one-eyed machine with bolted, rusty panels.

head: orange cat head
two pointed ears
top: orange chest with a cream front

appearance_text: A bright orange cat standing on two legs, with pointed ears on top of its head and a long orange tail down its back. Its muzzle, chest and belly are pale cream and its green eyes are ringed with black markings. Each paw is white like a little sock. The orange fur is streaked with lighter and darker lines all over.
identity_text: The ginger cat avatar of the Minecraft YouTuber StampyLongNose, standing on two legs with a cream front, black eye markings and white paws.

head: red hood behind the head
top: darker red circle on the back

appearance_text: A boy with brown hair swept over his forehead and glowing red eyes. He wears a red hoodie shaded in lighter and darker patches, with white drawstrings at the collar and a dark ring pattern across the back. His trousers are black with red bands at the ankles above red and white shoes.
identity_text: A teenage boy in a red hoodie shaded in lighter and darker patches, worn with black trousers and red and white shoes. The title describes the shading, not a character.

head: red hat with white fur trim

appearance_text: A round jolly old man in a bright red suit trimmed with white fur. He wears a red hat with a white fur band and a soft bobble hanging down the back, and his face is almost hidden by a huge fluffy white beard and moustache with a pink nose above it. The red coat has white fur cuffs and a wide brown belt with a big gold buckle at the front. His red trousers have white fur cuffs above heavy dark brown boots.
identity_text: The traditional Christmas gift-bringer: a round, white-bearded old man in a white-fur-trimmed red suit and hat, with a broad belt, gold buckle and heavy dark boots.

head: long silver hair with a fringe
top: black jacket with white striped sleeves

appearance_text: A girl with long silver hair falling over her shoulders and down her back. She wears a black jacket with bright white stripes banding the sleeves and a dark collar at the neck. Her skirt is pale grey, and she has long white socks with black shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed gothic-styled girl whose long hair is black on one side and silver on the other, wearing a black jacket with white-banded sleeves over pale mint legwear and black shoes.

bottom: red and dark blue armoured legs

colors.item: armour on the arms and legs
colors.name: red

face: orange strip where the mouth would be
head: smooth light grey metal helmet
orange visor down the middle

appearance_text: A fighter fully sealed in metal, with a smooth light grey helmet split by a glowing orange strip down the middle, dark hollow eye holes and small orange marks on the cheeks. Dark navy plates armour the chest under light grey shoulder guards, and the arms are banded in red and blue-grey metal. The legs carry the same red and dark blue plating down to heavy dark boots, and the back is one solid dark shell.
identity_text: The Cyborg Ninja from Metal Gear Solid: a fighter sealed inside a grey metal exoskeleton with an orange visor strip down the face and red and blue plating on the limbs.

appearance_text: A monster with a bone-white head bearing two square black eyes and a wide frowning mouth with two square prongs hanging down. Below it the body is dressed in a smart black suit with a bright red tie down the front and pale grey hands showing at the cuffs. The trousers and shoes are black, and the suit is plain and dark all the way round the back.
identity_text: A creeper dressed in the black suit and red tie of the faceless internet horror figure, its bone-white creeper face above pale grey hands.

appearance_text: A boy with short messy black hair falling over his eyes and pale skin. He wears a black jacket zipped up over a black shirt, so his top half is black all the way round including the back. His trousers are dark blue jeans and his shoes are black with white soles.
identity_text: An unnamed boy dressed almost head to toe in black — black hair over the eyes, a black jacket, dark blue jeans and black trainers.

appearance_text: A white feathered duck standing upright with a big orange bill and small black eyes, wearing a tall black top hat. Its body is dressed in a black suit jacket over a white shirt with a red tie down the front. White tail feathers stick out at the back below the jacket. Its legs and webbed feet are bright orange and bare.
identity_text: Donald Duck, the Disney cartoon duck, dressed up formally in a black suit, red tie and tall top hat.

head: purple hood covering the head
top: white space suit with green panels

appearance_text: A square-jawed man in a bright white space suit with green panels across the chest, shoulders and legs. A purple hood covers the top and back of his head, framing thick brown eyebrows and wide blue eyes. A little panel of red and green buttons sits on his chest and purple stripes run around his arms and boots.
identity_text: Buzz Lightyear, the space ranger action figure from Toy Story, in his white suit with green chest panels, a purple hood and a little control panel on his chest.

face: empty black shadow inside the hood
head: big purple hood
cream trim

appearance_text: A tall robed figure in a big purple hood, with only empty blackness where a face should be. The hood is edged with cream trim and a purple gem sits at the throat of the purple robe. A pale cream sash runs across the body down to the waist. The long robe falls dark purple to black over black shoes, and the back of the robe is plain purple.
identity_text: A tall robed figure in a purple hood with no face at all inside it, a purple gem at the throat and a pale cream sash across the body, the robe falling almost black at the hem.

bottom: black trousers with a red stripe down one leg
head: swept brown hair
top: brown leather jacket over a dark blue shirt

appearance_text: A young man with swept brown hair and blue eyes, wearing a worn brown leather jacket open over a dark blue shirt. A brown belt sits at his waist above black trousers, one leg marked with a red stripe running down the side. Black boots finish the outfit and the jacket is plain brown across the back.
identity_text: Han Solo as a young man, in the worn brown leather jacket and red-striped dark trousers he wears in Solo: A Star Wars Story.

appearance_text: A black scaly creature standing upright, with a huge mouth thrown wide open showing bright pink inside ringed by big white teeth, and small glowing purple eyes above it. Short dark horns curl up from the head. Its chest has rows of grey belly plates, and the arms, legs and back are covered in rough black scales.
identity_text: The Ender Dragon, the boss mob of Minecraft's End dimension, drawn upright on a player model: black scales all over, short dark horns and its pink jaws thrown wide.

head: brown hair
top: white baseball shirt with blue sleeves

appearance_text: A boy with short brown hair and brown eyes. He wears a baseball style shirt with a white body and blue sleeves and collar. His trousers are grey with blue cuffs at the ankles.
identity_text: An everyday boy in a white and blue baseball tee with grey checked trousers and blue shoes. No character is named — a plain sporty kid.

head: long orange hair with buns on top

appearance_text: A pale girl with bright orange hair that falls long down her back with two small buns on top, and striking red eyes. She wears a red dress with a little white collar and puffy sleeves striped in red and white. Her stockings carry the same red and white stripes and she wears small red shoes.
identity_text: A girl dressed all in candy-cane red and white: a red dress with a little white collar, red and white striped puffy sleeves and matching striped stockings, bright orange hair with two small buns, and small red shoes.

appearance_text: A boy with short brown hair swept across his forehead and dark eyes. He wears a baggy grey blue hoodie with white drawstrings and the hood down on his shoulders, and a big white tick shape is printed across the back. His jeans are black and his sneakers are white.
identity_text: An unnamed boy in a faded blue-grey hoodie with a big white sportswear tick across the back, black jeans and white sneakers.

head: bare head
top: red zip-up jacket over a white shirt

appearance_text: A young woman with shoulder-length brown hair and blue eyes. She wears a bright red zip-up jacket left open over a plain white shirt, with the jacket's sleeves pushed down to her wrists. Her legs are in dark blue jeans and she has scuffed grey boots.
identity_text: One of the four survivors from Left 4 Dead: a young woman with shoulder-length brown hair, in her red zip-up jacket, white shirt and dark blue jeans.

appearance_text: A girl with messy cream-blonde hair and green eyes, with a dark band tied across her forehead. She wears a battered dark brown coat with leather straps crossing her chest and a dark red hood bunched behind her shoulders. Below it is a layered grey skirt over striped leggings, ending in black boots.
identity_text: A travelling girl in a battered strap-covered coat with a dark red hood, a layered skirt and black boots, dressed for life on the road.

bottom: dark brown trousers with grey knee pads

colors.item: black chest straps over the shoulders with a thin orange collar trim (no scarf)
colors.name: orange

head: blank bone-white mask
top: dark brown leather armour with shoulder pads

appearance_text: A figure whose face is a blank bone-white mask with two black slits for eyes and no mouth. The body is wrapped in dark brown leather armour with padded shoulders and an orange scarf and strap across the chest. Grey pads cover the knees above scuffed brown boots.
identity_text: A hunter whose whole face is a blank bone-white mask with two slits for eyes, dressed in scuffed dark leather armour with an orange sash at the waist and grey knee pads.

accessories: red ribbon tie at the collar
top: dark blue blazer over a white collared shirt

appearance_text: A tall girl with very long dark purple hair that falls all the way down her back and frames her face. She wears a dark blue school blazer over a white collared shirt with a small red ribbon tie, and a thin belt at her waist. Her skirt is dark and her legs are covered in black tights down to dark shoes.
identity_text: Shoko Komi from the manga series Komi Can't Communicate, in her dark blue school blazer over a white collared shirt with a red ribbon tie, dark skirt and black tights.

appearance_text: A boy with short brown hair and pale skin wearing a light green scarf bunched around his neck. His jacket is teal with brown straps over the shoulders and a brown belt at the waist. On his back he carries a round teal pack with pale claw-shaped straps. He wears dark purple trousers and brown boots.
identity_text: An unnamed boy kitted out for adventure in a strapped teal jacket, dark purple trousers and brown boots, with a light green balaclava pulled down around his neck.

face: wide orange visor instead of eyes
head: white helmet
orange visor band
black back panel

appearance_text: A figure sealed in smooth white armour from head to toe. Its helmet has a wide glowing orange band across the front where a face would be, with grey trim and a solid black panel at the back. White plates cover the chest, shoulders and legs, with a black backpack behind, a black belt at the waist, and black gloves and boots.
identity_text: A figure sealed head to toe in smooth white protective armour with a glowing orange visor band, described in the listing as a metal craftsman in his safety gear.

appearance_text: A short, wide warrior with a huge brown beard and moustache covering most of his face, leaving only white eyes and a pink nose. On his head is a cream helmet with two horns and a strip of metal down over the nose. He wears a dark red tunic under shaggy brown fur shoulder pads, with grey metal bracers on his forearms and a big buckled belt. His trousers are dark red and his boots are brown.
identity_text: A short, wide fantasy dwarf warrior in iron and leather: a horned helmet with a nose guard, fur shoulder pads over a dark red tunic, grey bracers and a big buckled belt.

accessories: light blue sash at the waist
hair: very long dark brown hair down the back
head: long dark brown hair

appearance_text: A slender figure with very long dark brown hair that falls all the way down the back. Loose white robes with wide sleeves cover the whole body, tied at the waist with a pale blue sash. There is a small lavender mark on the forehead, and the shoes are white like the robe.
identity_text: Xie Lian, in loose white robes with wide sleeves tied by a pale blue sash, with very long dark brown hair and a small lavender mark on the forehead.

colors.item: trim on the sleeves and hem
colors.name: teal

face: grey half and fiery orange half
one cyan eye and one glowing orange eye
hair: teal hair at the back of the head
head: pointed wolf ears
motifs: glowing teal markings on the back

appearance_text: A traveller with pointed animal ears whose face is split down the middle, grey and dull on one side and fiery orange on the other, with one cyan eye and one glowing orange eye. Teal hair falls at the back of the head. The body wears a black tunic edged with teal and studded with gold at the shoulders, with a gold necklace at the throat and glowing teal markings scattered down the back. Black trousers with teal patches lead into teal boots.
identity_text: An adventurer whose face is half hidden behind a pale wooden mask and half burning orange, wearing a black tunic with glowing teal markings shaped like a warden's chest cavity and a single glow berry on a gold necklace.

head: brown goggles pushed up on the forehead

appearance_text: A man with short orange hair and blue eyes, with a pair of brown goggles pushed up onto his forehead. He wears a long white lab coat over a white shirt with a red tie down the front, and dark grey gloves cover his hands. The coat is plain white across the back. Brown trousers run down to dark shoes.
identity_text: Duncan of the Yogscast, shown in his usual mad-scientist look: ginger hair, goggles pushed up on the forehead and a white lab coat with a red tie.

top: white straps crossed over the chest
white straps crossed on the back

appearance_text: A short worker with bright orange skin and a neat cap of green hair over black eyes. He wears a brown top with two white straps crossing over his chest and again over his back, held by a white belt. His trousers are white and he has white gloves on his hands. His shoes are dark brown.
identity_text: An Oompa Loompa, one of the small orange-skinned, green-haired workers from Roald Dahl's Charlie and the Chocolate Factory, dressed in a brown work smock with crossed white straps, white gloves and white trousers.

head: red and yellow jester hat with two floppy points
top: white puffy sleeved blouse with a ruffled collar
red and yellow checkered panel across the back

appearance_text: A pale girl with long dark purple hair under a floppy jester hat whose two points are one red and one yellow. Her blue eyes peek out from a purple fringe, and she wears a white blouse with big puffy sleeves and a ruffled collar, with a bright red and yellow checkered panel across the back. Short grey brown shorts sit above socks striped in red, yellow and white.
identity_text: A girl dressed up as a circus jester, in a two-pointed red and yellow cap, a white puff-sleeved blouse with a ruffled collar and striped socks. No particular character is named.

head: red and white cap at the back of the head
top: red dungaree straps over the shoulders

appearance_text: A boy with short brown hair and a red and white cap sitting on the back of his head. He wears red dungarees with two straps over the shoulders and small white buttons, over a pink short sleeved shirt that shows on the arms. The dungarees run all the way down the legs to plain grey shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed boy in red dungarees with white buttons worn over a pink short sleeved shirt, with a red and white cap on the back of his head and plain grey shoes.

appearance_text: A tall figure with a chalk white face, blank black eyes and a thin dark mouth, framed by long straight black hair that falls past the shoulders. It wears a long black coat with dark grey shoulder pads and two rows of small red buttons down the chest. Grey gloves cover the hands and grey boots poke out below black trousers.
identity_text: Reaper, the hooded black-coated mercenary from Overwatch, rendered here with a chalk white masked face, grey shoulder plates, grey gloves and grey boots.

bottom: long grey tail instead of legs
face: glowing red eyes on the sides of the head
head: long grey dragon snout
scaly head

appearance_text: A grey scaly creature with a long dragon snout, a wide open mouth full of sharp brown fangs and glowing red eyes set on the sides of its head. Its chest and shoulders are covered in grey scales, and a row of tan spikes runs all the way down its back. Instead of legs it has one long grey tail that tapers towards the ground.
identity_text: A grey scaly dragon-serpent with a long fanged snout, glowing red eyes set on the sides of its head, tan spikes down its back and one long tail in place of legs, presented by the listing as a chaos monster from Babylonian mythology.

accessories: small silver buckle on the belt
top: black jacket over a white shirt

appearance_text: A man with short ginger hair, blue eyes and a brown moustache. He wears a smart black jacket over a white shirt, with a red and green tartan kilt held by a small silver buckle at the waist. White knee socks come up his legs and his shoes are black. The kilt is checked all the way round the back.
identity_text: Scottish Steve, one of the default player skins from Minecraft: Xbox 360 Edition, shown as a ginger-haired man in Highland dress.

head: green seaweed sprouting from the head

appearance_text: A rotting undead figure with mottled blue-green skin, glowing pale cyan eyes and an open glowing mouth. Clumps of green seaweed sprout from the top of its head and hang over its shoulders. It wears a torn brown shirt with ragged sleeves and matching ripped brown trousers, both patched with slimy blue-green stains. Glowing cyan spots dot its arms, legs and back.
identity_text: The waterlogged undead mob added to Minecraft in the Aquatic update: a rotting blue-green zombie with glowing pale cyan eyes and mouth, seaweed growing out of its head and tattered brown clothes.

hair: hair down the back to the waist

appearance_text: A pale girl with very long cream blonde hair falling all the way down her back and big grey eyes with dark lashes. She wears a short dark grey jacket over a matching crop top, leaving a small strip of her middle showing. Her light blue jeans are ripped at the knees and she has plain white shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed teenage girl with very long cream blonde hair, wearing a short dark jacket over a matching crop top, ripped light blue jeans and plain white shoes.

bottom: orange furry legs with dark paws
head: pointed fox ears with dark tips
top: orange furry chest with a cream belly

appearance_text: A fox standing upright, covered in warm orange fur with a soft cream belly and muzzle. Small pointed ears with dark brown tips sit on top of its head, and it has a tiny dark nose and little dark eyes. Its paws and the tips of its legs are dark brown, and a bushy orange tail hangs down its back.
identity_text: A fox standing on two legs, drawn with soft shading through its orange fur.

face: a screen instead of a face
head: beige computer monitor
screen showing blue sky over green grass
top: dark grey hoodie with black drawstrings

appearance_text: A slim figure whose head is a boxy beige computer monitor, the screen showing a blue sky with clouds over green grass. It wears a baggy dark grey hoodie with black drawstrings and a slightly darker collar, hood resting on the back. Red and black checked trousers and chunky white shoes finish the look.
identity_text: An unnamed slim figure whose head is a beige computer monitor showing a sky-and-grass desktop wallpaper, dressed in a grey hoodie, red checked trousers and chunky white shoes.

appearance_text: A boy with light brown hair swept over blue eyes and his mouth open. He wears a black jacket open at the front over a shirt striped in blue and white, with a big white skull printed across the back of the jacket. His light blue jeans are torn at the knees and thighs, and his shoes are grey.
identity_text: A teenage boy in a black jacket worn open over a blue and white striped shirt, with a large white skull printed across the jacket's back. No character is named.

head: flower crown of pink orange yellow and green flowers
long light brown hair

appearance_text: A girl with long light brown hair and a ring of pink, orange, yellow and green flowers sitting on her head like a crown. Her eyes are closed in a happy curve. She wears a blue checked shirt hanging open over a plain white top, grey shorts, and simple white shoes on bare legs.
identity_text: A sleepy-looking girl wearing a crown of rainbow-coloured flowers, an open blue checked shirt and grey shorts.

head: orange beanie on the back of the head
knitted hat

appearance_text: A pale girl with long brown hair and green eyes, wearing a soft orange knitted beanie pushed back on her head. Her sweater is dark brown with bright orange stripes running around the sleeves. She wears short orange shorts with her legs bare below them, and orange shoes with white soles.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in an autumn outfit of orange beanie, dark brown striped sweater and orange shorts and shoes.

face: glowing gold eye slits behind a white faceplate
head: heavy grey helmet with a white faceplate
top: bulky grey and black armour with big shoulder plates

appearance_text: A heavily armoured soldier in a bulky grey and black suit with huge shoulder plates. The helmet has a broad white faceplate framed in orange brown metal, with two glowing gold slits for eyes. A blocky pack is fitted to the back between the shoulders, and the armoured legs end in chunky boots banded in white and black.
identity_text: James Raynor from StarCraft in his Terran marine power armour, with an orange rimmed white faceplate and glowing gold eye slits.

head: black hair
blue hood down the back
top: glowing swirl on the front and back

appearance_text: A boy with messy black hair hanging over his eyes, wearing a bright blue hoodie. A glowing pale blue swirl is printed big across the front and again across the back, like water spinning round. His trousers are dark blue and his shoes are light blue.
identity_text: An unnamed boy in a bright blue hoodie printed front and back with a glowing pale blue swirl, his black fringe hanging over his eyes.

hair: hair in strands over the shoulders
head: red mushroom cap with white spots

appearance_text: A girl with long pale blue hair and dark eyes, wearing a red mushroom cap dotted with white spots on her head. Her outfit is white and light: a strappy top that leaves her shoulders and tummy bare, and a very short white skirt. She wears brown boots on her feet.
identity_text: A pale blue haired woodland girl wearing a red spotted toadstool cap as a hat, with a white top and skirt and brown boots.

colors.item: leather straps over mottled plate; no cloak
colors.name: dark brown

head: messy grey hair
hood over the head
top: layered purple and grey armour over the chest and shoulders

appearance_text: A weary fighter clad head to toe in battered armour of dull purple and grey, scratched and patched all over. Dark brown leather straps and a heavy cloak hang across the chest and shoulders, and thick plates guard the arms. Grey hair falls around a tired face with dark eyes, and armoured boots cover the feet.
identity_text: A weary armoured fighter clad in scratched purple and grey plate. A generic fantasy knight, not a named character.

appearance_text: A girl with long pale lavender hair tied into two pigtails with fluffy white ties, and big purple eyes. She wears a floaty white summer dress with thin straps that leave her shoulders bare, and the skirt is short over bare legs. Her shoes are white, and her pigtails hang down her back.
identity_text: A girl dressed for summer in a floaty white strappy dress and white shoes, her pale lavender hair tied into two pigtails. The title names only the palette.

appearance_text: A skinny bald creature with blotchy grey brown skin and huge pale round eyes set in a wide flat face above a dark slot of a mouth. Its chest and arms are bare and bony with ribs showing through, and patches of darker brown mottle the skin all over including the back. It wears only a small black cloth around the hips and its feet are bare.
identity_text: Gollum from The Lord of the Rings: a skinny bald creature with blotchy grey-brown skin, huge pale eyes and nothing but a scrap of black cloth around his hips.

face: no face, just sky and sun
head: pale blue sky head with a glowing sun
top: sky and sea picture with a small island and palm tree

appearance_text: This character is a picture instead of a person. The head is a pale blue sky with a soft yellow sun shining in it. The chest shows a tiny sandy island with a green palm tree sitting in bright blue water, and the legs fade down into deep teal ocean. There is no face, no hair and no clothing.
identity_text: A tropical island scene worn as a skin: sunlit sky over the head, a little palm-tree island sitting in bright water on the chest, and deep teal ocean running down the legs. There is no figure, face or clothing.

colors.item: long pastel two-tone hair down the back (no cape)
colors.name: grey

footwear: dark grey thigh-high boots with straps
head: very long pastel hair

appearance_text: A pale girl with hair split light blue on one side and pink on the other, hanging all the way down to her ankles. She wears a dark grey jacket hanging open so her chest and middle are bare, with a thin black choker at her neck. Her shorts are the same dark grey and her boots come up over her knees with strap bands, and a pale grey cape hangs behind her.
identity_text: A pale girl whose ankle-length hair is light blue on one side and pink on the other, in an open dark grey jacket, matching shorts and thigh-high strapped boots. The title describes the look; no character is named.

head: brown bear hood with round ears and a bear face

appearance_text: A pale haired kid wearing a brown bear hood with round ears and a little bear face on top. The hoodie is baggy and dark grey with long sleeves that cover the hands. Grey striped leggings run down to dark grey shoes.
identity_text: A kid in a baggy brown-grey hoodie topped with a bear hood — round ears and a little bear face — over striped trousers and dark shoes.

appearance_text: A girl with very long brown hair that reaches past her waist and two small brown cat ears on top of her head. She has pale blue eyes and wears a plain white long sleeved top with grey dungaree straps over grey shorts. Long white socks come up over her knees.
identity_text: A girl with very long brown hair and small pointed animal ears, in a white long-sleeved top with grey dungaree straps, grey shorts and over-knee white socks. The title is a bare given name with no referent outside this skin.

accessories: small white wings on the back
head: small blue head

appearance_text: A small blue-grey creature with glowing white eyes and a wide toothy white grin. Its body is wrapped in a darker blue-grey tunic with the arms folded across the chest. A pair of pale white wings spreads across its back, and its short legs are the same blue.
identity_text: The Vex, the small flying hostile mob added to Minecraft in version 1.11: a blue-grey creature with white wings, glowing pale eyes and a wide toothy grin.

appearance_text: A cheerful young man with brown hair under a bright red cap, blue eyes and a wide white grin. He wears a red short sleeved work shirt with a small badge on the chest and a round orange and red pizza logo printed across the back. Dark blue jeans with a yellow belt buckle and brown shoes finish the uniform.
identity_text: A cheerful delivery man in a pizza shop's red uniform: red cap, red short-sleeved work shirt with a badge and a round pizza logo on the back, dark blue jeans with a yellow belt buckle.

face: wide open mouth with white teeth
head: spiky black hair sticking out in tufts

appearance_text: A pale man with black hair sticking out in sharp spikes all round his head and bright blue eyes. His mouth is stretched wide open in a huge grin showing a row of white teeth. He wears a smart black suit jacket over a white shirt with a red tie, black trousers and black shoes.
identity_text: Djh3max of the YouTube group Hat Films, drawn as a wide-grinning man with spiky black hair in a black pinstripe suit and red tie.

head: orange hair over a pale face
high grey armour collar

appearance_text: A fighter sealed in heavy dark grey plate armour with thick blocky shoulder pieces and a high collar around the neck. Orange hair sits above a pale face and a grey guard covers the mouth. Small orange lights dot the middle of the chest and the armour is scratched and worn all over. The legs and boots are the same dull grey metal, plated at the knees.
identity_text: An unnamed fighter sealed into a scratched suit of dark grey stealth battle armour with chunky shoulder plates and small glowing orange chest lights, orange hair showing above the mouth guard.

appearance_text: A girl with long bright orange hair that hangs down her back, held with a pale blue band. She has big purple eyes and pale skin, and wears a purple dress with lighter purple sleeves and a small green scarf knotted at her neck. Her legs are covered by pale pink tights and she has pink shoes.
identity_text: Daphne Blake from Scooby-Doo, the long orange-haired member of the mystery-solving gang, in her purple dress, green neck scarf and pink tights.

head: brown hair with a fringe
thick eyebrows
top: green monster face on the front and back

appearance_text: A boy with brown hair, thick eyebrows and green eyes. He wears a light blue hoodie with green edging and a big green monster face printed on the front and again on the back. Grey trousers and brown shoes complete the look.
identity_text: A brown-haired boy in a light blue hoodie trimmed in green, with a large green creeper face printed on the front and back. He wears the creeper print, so he is not a creeper.

appearance_text: A young man with bright orange spiky hair and big round eyes. He wears a red jacket left open over a plain white t-shirt, and the jacket is solid red across the whole back. Blue jeans that fade darker at the bottom lead down to black and white trainers.
identity_text: Fry from the cartoon Futurama, the spiky orange-haired delivery boy in his open red jacket, white t-shirt and blue jeans.

footwear: long white socks with lavender stripes

appearance_text: A girl with long brown hair tied into two pigtails that fall down her back. She wears a baggy lavender sweater that slips off both shoulders, with long sleeves past her wrists. Underneath are little white shorts, and long white socks striped with lavender come up over her knees.
identity_text: A girl with long brown hair in two pigtails, wearing a baggy off-the-shoulder lavender sweater over little white shorts, with long striped socks up over her knees.

head: big pointed ears sticking out sideways

appearance_text: A small light green creature with huge round black eyes, a tiny nose and a little mouth. Two very big pointed ears stick out from the sides of its wrinkled head. It is wrapped from the shoulders down in a plain tan robe with wide sleeves that hangs almost to its feet.
identity_text: Grogu, the small green alien child from The Mandalorian, with a wrinkled head, huge round black eyes, big pointed ears and a plain tan robe.

colors.item: stripes on the sleeves and socks
colors.name: white

head: grey cat ears on top of the head
top: dark grey hoodie with white striped sleeves

appearance_text: A girl with long grey blue hair falling past her waist, bright teal eyes and two furry grey cat ears standing up on her head. She wears a dark grey hoodie with white stripes banding the sleeves, ending above her middle. Below are short black shorts, black and white striped socks and black shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed cat-eared girl with grey blue hair, in a short dark teal hoodie with striped sleeves, black shorts, striped socks and black shoes.

head: bare head with a hood down at the back
top: green hoodie open over a white t-shirt

appearance_text: A pale boy with short brown hair and bright green eyes. He wears a green hooded jacket left open over a plain white t-shirt, with white drawstrings hanging down and two white stripes ringing each sleeve. The hood sits behind his neck, his trousers are tan, and his trainers are green with white soles.
identity_text: A boy with short brown hair in a green hooded jacket over a white t-shirt, with tan trousers and green and white trainers.

appearance_text: A man with short brown hair under a black flat cap. He wears a faded light blue work shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbows, and an olive backpack with straps crossing over his chest. His jeans are dark blue and his boots are dark and worn.
identity_text: A nameless male survivor from the survival horror game DayZ, in a black flat cap, faded blue work shirt, dark jeans and an olive backpack.

colors.item: black panel painted on the back of the grey military coat - no cloak layer
colors.name: black

appearance_text: A figure standing with a big carved orange pumpkin where its head should be, with angry slanted eyes and a small dark mouth cut into it. It wears an old-fashioned grey-blue coat with wide lapels and a row of gold buttons down the front. A dark ragged cloak hangs down its back. Grey trousers tuck into scuffed dark brown boots.
identity_text: The Headless Horseman, the folklore rider who carries a carved pumpkin where his head should be, here in an old-fashioned grey-blue coat with wide lapels and gold buttons, grey trousers and scuffed brown boots.

appearance_text: A dark red creature with a huge orange snout that covers most of its face, above tiny dark eyes. Its body is deep red with wrinkly darker streaks, and a wide teal patch spreads across the whole back. Stubby grey feet finish off the short legs.
identity_text: The large, gentle seed-digging mob added to Minecraft in the 1.20 update, shown as a deep red creature with an enormous orange snout, tiny dark eyes and a teal patch across its back on stubby grey feet.

appearance_text: A chubby penguin with a black back and wings and a big white tummy and face. It wears a red and white santa hat flopping over to one side and dark sunglasses across its eyes, with a small orange beak below. A red and green striped scarf is wrapped round its neck and hangs down the front, and it stands on flat orange feet.
identity_text: A chubby black and white penguin dressed for Christmas in a floppy red and white santa hat, a red and green striped scarf and dark sunglasses, standing on flat orange feet.

colors.item: monster face on the back of the hoodie
colors.name: dark grey

appearance_text: A boy with short black hair and bright blue eyes. He wears a blue hoodie with grey and light blue stripes around the sleeves and the hood lying flat on his back. His jeans are dark blue and his shoes are dark. Printed large across the back of the hoodie is a dark grey monster face.
identity_text: An ordinary black-haired boy in a bright blue hoodie with a creeper face printed across the back, worn with dark blue jeans. The mob motif is on the clothing, not what the figure is.

appearance_text: A figure covered head to toe in copper-orange plate armour. The helmet has no face, just a glowing green slit where the eyes would be, and a round rivet on the back. The chest plate carries a small green gem, matched by another one between the shoulders, and the arms are built from banded plates with black joints. The legs are armoured all the way down to heavy metal boots.
identity_text: An unnamed faceless figure sealed in copper steampunk plate armour, lit by a green visor slit and a green gem in the chest.

accessories: yellow bands around the arms and legs
bottom: black armoured trousers with yellow bands

colors.item: bands on the arms and legs
colors.name: yellow

face: orange mask covering the mouth and nose
head: black hood
top: orange and black armoured ninja top

appearance_text: A masked warrior in black and bright orange armour, with an orange cloth covering the lower half of his face and a black hood over black hair. His chest and shoulders are plated in glowing orange with a grey buckle at the waist. Yellow bands wrap his arms and his legs, and pointed orange plates spread across his back like wings.
identity_text: Scorpion from Mortal Kombat, the yellow-and-black ninja, masked below the eyes and plated in glowing orange armour with pointed plates spreading across his back.

hair: very long dark brown hair down the back

appearance_text: A girl with very long dark brown hair falling all the way down her back and bright purple eyes. She wears an orange jacket that slips off her shoulders over a white top, with black shorts held by straps. Her boots are cream at the top and dark brown below.
identity_text: A girl in autumn colours: an orange jacket worn off the shoulders over a white top, black strap shorts and tall cream-topped brown boots. 'Autumn Girl' describes the outfit rather than naming anyone.

appearance_text: A man in a full suit of dark grey plate armour, with a helmet that leaves his brown face, purple eyes and short brown beard showing. The chest piece has broad shoulder plates and matching armoured legs and boots. Small blue glowing bits sit at his neck and belt.
identity_text: Steve, the Minecraft player character, geared up in a full set of dark netherite armour with glowing blue trim; the base texture underneath is his usual cyan shirt and blue trousers.

face: one purple eye and one red eye
hair: long black hair with purple streaks
head: pink axolotl hood with frills and a snout

appearance_text: A girl wearing a soft pink axolotl onesie, with the animal's frilly head pulled up as a hood over her face. Her long black hair falls past her shoulders and has bright purple streaks near the front. One eye is purple and the other is red, and her cheeks are pink. The onesie has fluffy white feet and a paler pink belly.
identity_text: A girl wearing a faded pink axolotl onesie with the frilled hood up, her long black hair with purple streaks hanging out below it. She is a girl in a costume rather than an axolotl.

appearance_text: A blocky person made entirely of shiny gold, from the top of the head to the shoes. The hair is a slightly darker orange gold cut short and square, with a short beard along the jaw and two small square eyes above a little mouth. The same gold covers the short sleeved shirt, the bare arms, the trousers and the shoes, with brighter yellow patches where it catches the light.
identity_text: Steve, the default Minecraft player character, cast entirely in shiny gold from his square haircut down to his shoes.

top: white shirt with a red tie

appearance_text: A pale boy with spiky white hair and dark red eyes. He wears a dark navy jacket hanging open over a white shirt with a red tie down the front, and a swirling blue pattern spreads across the back of the jacket. His trousers are black and his shoes grey.
identity_text: An unnamed teenage boy with spiky silver-white hair, wearing a dark navy jacket open over a white shirt and red tie, with black trousers.

face: white clown mask with dark red bands over the eyes and mouth
head: white clown mask covering the whole face

appearance_text: A man whose whole face is hidden behind a white clown mask marked with dark red bands over the eyes and across the mouth. He wears a brown suit jacket over a grey vest and tie, with bright blue gloves on his hands. His brown trousers end at plain black shoes.
identity_text: Hoxton, one of the masked heisters from the game Payday 2, wearing a brown suit and blue gloves behind a white clown mask.

head: bald head
big red patches around the eyes

appearance_text: A huge bare monster with no skin at all, so its whole body is dark red muscle with deep lines running between the strands. Its bald pale head has small blank white eyes and red patches around them, and its mouth is a permanent wide grin with no lips, showing two long rows of big white teeth. The same raw red muscle covers its back, arms and legs and it wears nothing.
identity_text: The Colossal Titan from Attack on Titan, a skinless giant of exposed red muscle with a bald head and a permanent toothy grin.

bottom: glowing orange lava at the feet
head: white square head
top: white tentacles down the chest and back

appearance_text: A big white square head with closed grey eyes and a grey down-turned mouth, with long white tentacles dangling from underneath it. The body below is dark red cracked rock with black splits running through it. Down at the legs and feet the rock glows bright orange and yellow like hot lava.
identity_text: A Ghast, the big white tentacled mob of the Nether, with its body drawn as cracked red netherrack glowing with lava at the feet.

face: black square eyes and a wide frowning mouth on the mask
a human face with brown hair and blue eyes showing at the back of the head
hair: brown hair on the hidden face
head: green creeper mask

appearance_text: A figure covered head to toe in mottled light and dark green, with a wide-mouthed green mask whose two black square eyes and gaping black mouth stare forward. A cyan collar sits at the neck and a brown strap runs diagonally across the chest. Turned around, a human face with brown hair and blue eyes shows through the back of the green hood.
identity_text: A creeper kitted out as a hunter: mottled green all over with the creeper face, a diamond collar, a bow across its chest and a human head carried on its back.

head: shoulder length brown hair
top: open orange shirt with white flowers

appearance_text: A girl with shoulder length brown hair and green eyes. She wears an open orange shirt covered in little white flowers over a plain white vest top. Her skirt is olive green and she has matching olive socks pulled up under white trainers. The back of the shirt has the same orange and white flower pattern.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in an open flower-printed summer shirt over a white vest top, with an olive skirt, matching socks and white trainers. 'Cool Summer' is a mood, not a name.

face: blue and yellow dummy in the mouth
head: bald head

appearance_text: A chubby little baby with a bald pink head, big blue eyes and a blue and yellow dummy in its mouth. Its tummy and arms are bare and it wears nothing but a white nappy. It stands barefoot with soft rounded arms and legs.
identity_text: A big chubby baby with a bald pink head, wearing nothing but a white nappy and sucking a blue and yellow dummy, standing barefoot.

subjects: boy in a tie dye shirt
top: tie dye t-shirt with a rainbow swirl

appearance_text: A boy with short brown hair and big blue eyes. He wears a short sleeved t-shirt covered in a bright tie dye swirl of red, orange, yellow, green and blue, with the same swirl on the back. His trousers are plain tan and his shoes are red with white soles.
identity_text: An unnamed boy in a rainbow tie dye t-shirt, plain tan trousers and red trainers.

colors.item: hair at the back of the head
colors.name: brown

hair: brown hair only at the back of the head
head: bald on top
brown hair at the back

appearance_text: A pale bald man with only a patch of brown hair at the back of his head. His face is goofy, with two tiny black eyes set far apart and one long flat black line for a mouth. He wears a white shirt with black suspenders and a black tie, brown trousers held up by a brown belt, and brown shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed pale, nearly bald man drawn with a joke face - two tiny eyes set far apart and one long flat line for a mouth - dressed like an office worker.

head: short light brown hair
top: tiny black heart on the chest

appearance_text: A boy with light brown hair swept over his forehead and very big blue eyes. He wears a plain white hoodie with a tiny black heart printed on the chest. His jeans are black and his shoes are blue with white soles.
identity_text: An unnamed boy with light brown hair in a plain white hoodie marked with a small black heart, black jeans and blue trainers.

hair: long brown hair over the shoulders
top: grey and white striped long-sleeved shirt

appearance_text: A girl with long brown hair falling over her shoulders and a braid running down her back. She wears a grey and white striped long-sleeved shirt under blue denim dungarees, with the straps crossing her shoulders. The dungaree legs have small rips at the knees, and she has white shoes with black bands at the ankles.
identity_text: An unnamed everyday girl in blue denim dungarees over a grey and white striped shirt, with a braid down her back and white shoes.

hair: brown hair at the back and sides
head: balding head

appearance_text: A man who is bald on top with brown hair around the back and sides of his head, black eyes and a bit of stubble. He wears a dark brown sleeveless vest over a white shirt, with a brown strap running diagonally across his chest. His trousers are a dull dark red and his boots are dark brown. The back is plain dark brown with the pale sleeves showing at the arms.
identity_text: Old Peculier, the character from the Yogscast's Minecraft series on YouTube, shown as a stubbled, balding man in a dark brown vest over a white shirt with a strap across his chest, dull red trousers and dark brown boots.

head: long white bunny ears with pink insides

appearance_text: A soft white rabbit standing on two legs, its fur shaded with pale grey patches all over. Two tall ears stick up from its head with pink insides, and its face has big black eyes and a little pink nose with a tiny smile. The whole body, arms and legs are the same fluffy white, with a small pale tail shape on its back.
identity_text: A bunny: an all-white rabbit standing upright, with tall pink-lined ears, a pink nose and a small pale tail on its back.

bottom: black trousers with glowing cyan streaks
head: dark messy hair
top: glowing cyan streaks down the chest

appearance_text: A shadowy figure dressed almost entirely in black, with dark messy hair and blank glowing pale cyan eyes that have no pupils. Glowing cyan cracks and streaks run down the chest, arms and legs like light leaking out from inside, and the feet glow the same colour. The same glowing streaks show down the back.
identity_text: Herobrine, the blank-eyed Minecraft creepypasta figure, in a radioactive version whose black clothes leak glowing cyan light through cracks.

face: black patches around long white eye shapes
head: bright red full face mask

appearance_text: A figure whose head is a bright red mask with black patches around two long white eye shapes. The red suit has black panels over the shoulders and down the legs, and brown leather straps cross the chest and back with pouches hanging from a belt. Black gloves cover the hands and heavy black boots the feet.
identity_text: Deadpool, the masked Marvel mercenary, in his red suit with black panels and a brown strap-and-pouch harness.

head: white 3D glasses across the eyes
top: red heart and green monster face printed on the chest

appearance_text: A boy with short brown hair and a big pair of white glasses covering his eyes, one lens red and the other blue. His mouth is open in a grin showing white teeth. His white t-shirt has a red heart and a square green monster face printed on the chest. He wears plain brown trousers and white shoes with blue soles, and the shirt is blank white across the back.
identity_text: An unnamed boy dressed as a games fan, in big red-and-blue 3D glasses and an 'I love Minecraft' t-shirt showing a heart and a creeper face.

appearance_text: A cartoon boy in a green winter hat pulled right down over his ears so no hair shows. His face is pink with big round eyes and a tiny mouth. He wears a bright orange coat with green cuffs at the wrists and plain black trousers.
identity_text: Kyle Broflovski from South Park, the boy in the green winter hat and bright orange coat.

appearance_text: A figure covered head to toe in light brown metal armour, with a rounded helmet that has a nose guard and only a dark slit for the eyes. The chest, shoulders and arms are made of banded plates in tan and brown. Around the hips is a short dark blue kilt, and the legs and boots are ringed with more brown metal bands.
identity_text: An unnamed fighter encased head to toe in a set of banded tan metal armour with a nose-guarded helm and a short dark blue kilt; the listing identifies the armour set as one from The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim.

head: green frog cap
two white frog eyes with black pupils on top of the cap

appearance_text: A girl wearing a green frog cap with two white and black frog eyes sitting on top, her red brown hair showing underneath. She wears a green jacket over a dark blue shirt with a tiny pink flower pinned near the collar. Her shorts are pink with green stripes down the sides, and her boots are green with cream tops.
identity_text: Rana, a humanoid mob from an early build of Minecraft that was removed in 2010, in her green frog cap and green jacket over pink shorts.

head: small flower hairpin
top: white dress top with gold trim

appearance_text: A girl with short blonde hair and purple eyes, with a small light blue flower pinned in her hair. She wears a white dress with gold trim and puffy shoulders, gathered at the waist with a brown belt. Dark brown bands sit high on her legs above pale blue boots. The back of the dress keeps the same white and gold pattern.
identity_text: Lumine, the female traveller of Genshin Impact, in her white dress with gold trim and a brown belt, short blonde hair with a small flower hairpin, and pale blue boots.

appearance_text: A young man with short brown hair and blue eyes wearing a blue-grey suit jacket with gold buttons down the front. Underneath is a white shirt with a bright red tie, and white cuffs show at his wrists. His trousers are dark grey and his shoes are black.
identity_text: A smartly dressed young man in a dark blue-grey suit jacket over a white shirt and bright red tie, with dark trousers and black shoes.

face: dark mask over the nose and mouth
one eye hidden by a headband
head: metal headband tilted over one eye

appearance_text: A warrior with spiky silver hair whose lower face is hidden behind a dark navy cloth mask and whose left eye is covered by a metal-plated headband, leaving one red eye showing. He wears an olive green pocketed vest over a dark navy long-sleeved shirt, with a red swirl marked high on the back. Dark navy trousers with white wraps at the knees and ankles run down to dark shoes.
identity_text: Kakashi Hatake from Naruto, a silver-haired ninja in an olive green flak vest over dark navy, with a cloth mask over his lower face, a plated headband covering one eye and one red eye showing.

bottom: cyan and yellow streaks down the legs
face: face broken into scrambled coloured squares
head: black hood with two pointed ears
top: band of scrambled rainbow colours across the chest

appearance_text: A dark figure in a black hoodie with a hood that comes to two pointed ears. Where its face should be there is a jumble of scrambled coloured squares in red, green, blue, purple and pink, with no eyes or mouth showing. The same broken rainbow colours tear across the chest of the hoodie. Its trousers are white with cyan and yellow streaks running down them, and its black shoes are flecked with colour too.
identity_text: An unnamed figure in a black eared hoodie whose face and chest dissolve into scrambled rainbow pixels, imitating a chromatic-aberration glitch. The title names the effect, not a character.

top: dark red cape over the back

appearance_text: A muscled warrior with black hair and a thick black beard, mouth open in a shout. His chest and arms are bare and tan, with a dark red cape hanging down his back. He wears only a small black loincloth around his hips and heavy dark brown boots.
identity_text: Leonidas, the hero-king of Sparta as portrayed in 300, shown as a bare-chested black-bearded warrior with a dark red cape and a black loincloth.

head: black top hat with a grey band
bare white skull
top: white rib bones showing down the chest

appearance_text: A bony figure with a bare white skull peeking out from under a black top hat with a grey band. It wears a dark brown jacket that hangs open so the white ribs of its chest show through in a stripe. Its hands are pale bone, and it wears dark blue trousers with black shoes.
identity_text: A skeleton dressed like a gentleman, wearing a black top hat and a dark jacket that hangs open so its white ribs show, with dark blue trousers and black shoes.

accessories: small orange badge on the chest
hair: messy black hair with a fringe
head: bare head

appearance_text: A pale boy with messy black hair that hangs over his forehead and dark eyes. He wears a plain white long-sleeved shirt with a tiny orange badge pinned near the collar, tucked into black trousers. His shoes are black with white soles, and the back of the shirt is plain white.
identity_text: Yuta Okkotsu from the manga series Jujutsu Kaisen, drawn here as a pale boy with messy black hair in a plain white shirt, black trousers and black shoes.

appearance_text: A man with short brown hair and a huge toothy grin across his face. He wears a rust orange jacket left open over a white shirt, with the same orange colour across his back and sleeves. His jeans are dark blue and his shoes are brown.
identity_text: A man in a rust orange jacket left open over a white shirt, with dark blue jeans and brown shoes, wearing a huge toothy grin. The listing presents him as a creepy psychologist rather than as any named character.

colors.name: yellow
