colors.name: white

top: yellow laughing face on the chest

appearance_text: A boy with messy dark green hair falling over his light blue eyes. He wears a plain white short-sleeved t-shirt with a big yellow laughing face printed on the chest, and the shirt is plain white across the back. His black tracksuit trousers have a white stripe running down the outside of each leg, and he wears black shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed boy with messy green hair in a white t-shirt printed with a big yellow laughing emoji, worn with striped black joggers.

appearance_text: A pale figure with a short dark purple bob and brown eyes peeking out from under the fringe. A teal jacket hangs open over a cream top with a dark band across the chest. The trousers are plain black and the shoes are white.
identity_text: A pale teenager with a dark purple bob, wearing an open teal jacket over a cream top with black trousers and white shoes. The listing places the figure as a rival character from Pokemon Sword and Shield.

head: bald white head
top: black suit jacket with a row of gold buttons

appearance_text: A tall figure with a chalk white bald head, burning red square eyes and a wide dark open mouth. It wears a long black suit jacket buttoned up the middle with a line of gold buttons, and small white shirt cuffs poke out at the wrists. The black jacket runs plain down the back, and the black trousers end in grey shoes.
identity_text: Israphel, the pale red-eyed villain of the Yogscast's Minecraft series, in a long black suit jacket with gold buttons and white shirt cuffs.

face: orange cloth covering the mouth and nose
head: dark hood pulled over the head

appearance_text: A broad, muscular man with a dark hood pulled down over his head and an orange cloth tied across his mouth and nose, leaving only pale blue eyes showing. His chest and arms are bare and heavily built, with a white band wrapped around one forearm. He wears dark grey trousers and black boots, and his back and shoulders are bare too.
identity_text: A hulking bare-chested medieval executioner in a dark hood with an orange cloth tied over the lower face, ragged dark trousers and bare feet. The title names the trade rather than a character.

top: small silver badge on the chest

appearance_text: A man with short dark brown hair and a neat grey beard and moustache. He wears a fitted red uniform top with black shoulders and a black collar, with a small silver badge pinned to the left of the chest. His trousers and boots are plain black.
identity_text: A bearded man wearing the red uniform of a Star Trek starship crew, with a small silver badge on the chest and plain black trousers. The listing names the uniform but no individual officer.

hair: long blonde hair down the back
head: crown of pale pink flowers
top: red jacket with white striped sleeves

appearance_text: A girl with long blonde hair wearing a crown of pale pink flowers around her head. Her jacket is bright red with white stripes running down the sleeves, worn open over a mint green top. She has light blue jeans and chunky white trainers with black soles, and her big blue eyes have long dark lashes.
identity_text: An unnamed blonde girl in a red jacket with white-striped sleeves and a pale pink flower crown, worn with ripped light blue jeans and white trainers.

appearance_text: A pale-skinned guard with messy black hair and green eyes. The uniform is almost all black with pale grey padded shoulders and light grey sleeves, and a small brown badge is pinned to the chest. Straps cross the front of the jacket and the trousers and boots are black.
identity_text: A prison guard in an almost all-black uniform with a padded vest, straps across the front and a small badge on the chest.

appearance_text: A creature whose whole body looks like burning fire. Its head is a bright patch of orange and yellow flames with two little pointed ears, two black dot eyes with light blue tear marks below them, and a small black mouth. The chest and arms burn a deeper red and orange, and the legs fade to a dark smouldering red.
identity_text: An unnamed creature whose whole body is burning fire, with a bright orange and yellow flame head, two pointed ears, black dot eyes and light blue tear marks below them.

colors.item: round mouth print on the chest
colors.name: red

head: short brown hair with a fringe
top: red ring of teeth printed on the chest

appearance_text: A light skinned boy with short brown hair falling in a fringe over green eyes. He wears a baggy dark blue hoodie with a big round red mouth ringed with white teeth printed across the chest. His jeans are faded blue and his shoes are dark blue. The back and sleeves of the hoodie are plain washed dark blue.
identity_text: An unnamed boy in a baggy dark blue hoodie printed with a big round red mouth ringed with white teeth, worn with faded blue jeans.

accessories: hose running up the back of the helmet
bottom: light purple suit legs covered in flowers
head: round space helmet
big dark purple visor
top: small control panel on the chest

appearance_text: A space explorer in a pale purple suit with a round helmet and a big dark purple visor that hides the face. The suit has a small white control panel on the chest and is sprinkled all over the arms and legs with tiny light blue and pink flowers. On the back sits an air tank with a hose curling up to the helmet, and the boots match the rest of the pale purple suit.
identity_text: An unnamed space explorer in a pale lilac suit sprinkled all over with tiny flowering vines, the face hidden behind a dark purple visor and an air tank strapped to the back.

accessories: orange tail curling up the back
face: dark green eyes with white markings
head: orange fox head with pointed ears
cream muzzle with a brown nose

appearance_text: An orange fox standing on two legs, with pointed ears, a cream muzzle and bright dark green eyes. Around the throat is a red neckerchief, and over a green flight suit sits a light grey jacket with big collars. The trousers are green with an orange belt, and chunky white boots cover the feet. An orange bushy tail curls up across the back.
identity_text: Fox McCloud, the fox pilot who leads the Star Fox squadron, in his grey flight jacket, red neckerchief and green flight suit.

face: brown eyes in the mask holes
head: dark blue bat mask with pointed ears
pale eyebrow markings
top: yellow oval badge with a black bat

appearance_text: A hero in a dark blue mask with pointed ears, pale eyebrow shapes and holes for his eyes, with his chin left bare. His suit is grey with a yellow oval on the chest holding a black bat and a wide yellow belt below it. Dark blue gloves, shorts and boots go with the long blue cape hanging down his back.
identity_text: Batman as he looked in the 1966 television series, in a navy blue cowl and cape with painted eyebrows over a grey suit with the yellow oval bat badge.

appearance_text: A man-shaped character coloured entirely in shades of red from head to toe. He has short dark red hair, dark red eyes and a hint of a beard, and his shirt, trousers and shoes are all the same red with darker red shading. The back and sides are the same solid red with no pattern or writing.
identity_text: Steve, the default Minecraft character, recoloured so that his hair, face, shirt, trousers and shoes are all solid redstone red.

head: pointed animal ears
top: grey wrapped band across the chest

appearance_text: An orange furry animal girl with pointed ears, messy brown hair and big purple eyes above a cream muzzle. A grey band is wrapped across her chest, leaving her orange shoulders and arms bare apart from small bands, and a brown belt with a pouch sits at her waist. Her furry orange legs end in chunky grey boots.
identity_text: The orange badger girl from the Sonic Boom cartoon, drawn with her grey chest wrap, brown belt pouch, arm bands and heavy grey boots.

head: long hair
top: dark purple jacket covered in flowers

appearance_text: A pale girl with long blonde hair and green eyes, with a small pink clip in her hair. She wears a dark purple jacket covered all over in small pink and white roses, open over a plain cream dress. Brown boots come up over her lower legs.
identity_text: A blonde girl in a dark purple jacket printed all over with small pink and white roses, worn open over a cream dress. The title names the flower motif on the clothes, not a character.

appearance_text: A boy with messy black hair and big surprised eyes, with a bright red scarf wrapped around his neck. He wears a dark hoodie with toggles down the front and a brown bear face printed on the back. His jeans are dark blue and his trainers are red and white.
identity_text: An unnamed boy with messy black hair in a dark hooded jacket with a bright red scarf, dark blue jeans and red and white trainers.

head: light blue hood pulled up around a yellow duck head
top: light blue hoodie with a front pocket

appearance_text: A round yellow duck with a small orange bill and two black dot eyes, peeking out of a pulled-up hood. It wears a light blue hoodie with a front pocket and two white drawstrings, plain light blue across the back and sleeves. Its bare yellow legs stick out below the hoodie.
identity_text: A small round yellow duck with an orange bill and black dot eyes, dressed in a light blue hoodie. A plain cute-animal skin, not a character from any work.

hair: brown hair with blue and pink streaks
head: dark purple beanie

appearance_text: A light-skinned young man in a dark purple beanie, with brown hair streaked in pastel blue and pink poking out underneath. He wears a dark purple jacket over a white shirt, and the sleeves are patchworked in soft pink and blue with matching bands at the wrists. A big green and teal spiral is painted across the whole back of the jacket. Dark purple trousers and pastel blue and pink shoes finish the outfit.
identity_text: Karl Jacobs, the Twitch streamer and YouTuber, in his pastel outfit: a dark purple jacket with patchwork pink and blue sleeves and a large spiral across the back, dark purple trousers and pastel shoes.

hair: long orange hair tied back in a ponytail

appearance_text: A slim character with long orange hair tied back in a ponytail that hangs down the back, green eyes and pink cheeks. She wears a green short sleeved shirt with a brown belt at the waist. Her trousers are grey brown and her boots are dark grey.
identity_text: Alex, the slim default Minecraft player character, in her green shirt with a brown belt, grey-brown trousers and dark grey boots, orange hair tied back in a ponytail.

appearance_text: A grown man with short brown hair and blue-green eyes, his face marked with dark red cuts under one eye, across his cheek and on his chin. He wears a worn brown jacket hanging open over a dark red shirt. His jeans are bright blue and his shoes are white.
identity_text: Butch Coolidge, the boxer from Quentin Tarantino's film Pulp Fiction, shown beaten up in a worn brown jacket over a white shirt and dark red tie, with blue jeans and white shoes.

colors.item: monster face print on the jacket back
colors.name: blue

head: white streaks in the hair
top: blue monster face on the back

appearance_text: A girl with long dark red hair that falls down her back, with pale white streaks near the top. She has brown eyes and light skin. She wears an open black jacket over a red shirt with a white skull printed on the chest, and a big blue monster face is printed across the back of the jacket. Below she wears short red shorts, bare legs, white socks and blue shoes.
identity_text: A girl with long dark red hair in an open black jacket over a red top, with red shorts, white socks and blue shoes. A large blue mob face is printed across the back of the jacket.

hair: very long pink and purple hair
head: dark hood down the back
moon shape on the hood
top: dark blue hoodie with white stars scattered over it

appearance_text: A pale girl with very long hair streaked pink and lilac that falls past her knees, and big blue eyes under a soft fringe. She wears a dark navy hoodie sprinkled all over with tiny white stars, with a crescent moon shape on the hood at her back. Her jeans are light blue and her shoes are black with pale soles.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with very long pink and lilac hair in a dark navy hoodie covered in little white stars. The title describes the starry look rather than naming a character.

head: purple cap with a yellow emblem

appearance_text: A tall skinny man with a huge pink nose and a thin pointed black moustache, wearing a purple cap with a yellow emblem on the front. He has a purple long sleeved shirt with dark navy overalls over it, held up by straps with round yellow buttons. His hands are covered by white gloves and he wears brown shoes.
identity_text: Waluigi from the Mario series, a tall skinny figure in a purple cap and shirt with navy overalls, white gloves and a long pointed moustache.

appearance_text: A huge creature covered head to toe in shaggy brown fur, with a paler grey belly and chest. Its face has a heavy brow, two small white eyes and a wide mouth with two white tusks poking up. The arms and legs are thick and hairy with pale feet.
identity_text: Bigfoot, the hairy ape-like creature said to live in the wilderness, covered head to toe in shaggy red-brown fur with a pale belly and two white tusks.

face: light skin showing under the helmet
head: grey helmet with an open face

appearance_text: A knight wearing a rounded grey helmet that leaves the lower face open, showing a moustache and an open mouth. Grey chainmail covers his arms and legs in a fine checkered weave, and over it he wears a plain brown surcoat that reaches his thighs, tied with a brown belt at the waist. Dark brown boots cover his feet.
identity_text: A medieval knight in fine grey chainmail with a brown surcoat belted over it and a rounded open-faced helmet. A generic knight rather than a named one.

colors.item: long hair on the other side
colors.name: dark brown

hair: orange and dark brown split hair
head: cat ears
two-tone split hair

appearance_text: A girl with long hair split down the middle, orange on one side and dark brown on the other, with two furry cat ears in the same two colours on top of her head. She wears a light blue hoodie with puffy sleeves that stops above her waist. Her legs are bare at the top and covered by black thigh high socks below, and she wears chunky white boots.
identity_text: An unnamed cat girl whose long hair is split orange down one side and dark brown down the other, with matching cat ears, a cropped light blue hoodie and black thigh high socks.

head: black flying goggles on the forehead
brown hair
top: navy coat with rows of buttons

appearance_text: A man with brown hair and a thick brown beard, with a pair of black flying goggles pushed up onto his forehead. He wears a navy coat with two rows of pale buttons down the front, open over a light blue shirt. His trousers are light blue and his boots are black.
identity_text: A brown-bearded airship captain in a navy double-breasted coat over a light blue shirt, with flying goggles pushed up onto his forehead. 'Skylord' is a rank here rather than a name.

head: twiggy bark growths on top of the head

appearance_text: A tall walking tree shaped like a person, covered head to toe in rough brown and grey bark with patches of green moss growing over it. Small black eyes and a simple wooden mouth sit in a bark face, and little twig-like growths stick up from the top of the head. The arms and legs are knobbly branches of the same bark.
identity_text: Groot, the walking tree creature from Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy, covered head to toe in knobbly brown and grey bark with patches of green moss.

head: copper head
moulded hair shape
top: copper chest with moulded shirt lines

appearance_text: A whole person cast in shiny orange copper, from head to feet, with mottled darker and lighter patches across the metal. The head keeps a moulded blocky haircut, hollow eye shapes and a flat beard across the chin. Faint lines mark a shirt hem, sleeves and trouser legs, but there is no cloth or colour anywhere, just metal.
identity_text: Minecraft's Steve rendered as a solid copper statue, his hair, beard and clothing lines moulded into mottled orange metal with no cloth or colour anywhere.

footwear: long white socks with yellow stripes
head: yellow duck hat with an orange bill and dark eyes
top: white top with a little duck on it

appearance_text: A girl with long brown hair falling past her shoulders and down her back, wearing a soft yellow duck hat with an orange bill over her forehead and two dark eyes on top. She has on an open yellow jacket over a white top with a small white duck printed on the chest. A white skirt covers her hips, and her legs are in long white socks with yellow stripes above white shoes.
identity_text: A long-haired girl in a duck-themed outfit — yellow duck hat, yellow jacket, white top with a small duck on it and striped socks. Not a named character.

hair: long light blue hair down the back
head: small gold crown
long light blue hair

appearance_text: A girl with very long pale blue hair falling down her back and a tiny gold crown resting on top of her head. She wears a soft fluffy pink jumper with puffy sleeves and a frilled hem, over short pink shorts that leave her legs bare. Light blue leg warmers bunch above brown boots.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in a soft angel themed outfit, with very long pale blue hair under a thin gold halo, a fluffy pink jumper and short shorts over bare legs.

hair: long hair striped light blue, pink and blonde
head: long pastel hair with a fringe
top: dark grey jacket over a light blue top

appearance_text: This girl has very long hair striped in light blue, pink and pale blonde that hangs all the way down her back. Her skin is light and her eyes are blue. She wears a dark grey jacket open over a light blue top, with purple and pink checked leggings under short grey shorts, and chunky black boots with white cuffs.
identity_text: A girl with very long pastel hair striped blue, pink and blonde, wearing a dark jacket over a light blue top, checked leggings and chunky boots. The title is a mood, not a name.

appearance_text: A bald figure with a huge flat nose, a thick straight brow and green eyes, dressed for a fight. Over a long brown robe he wears a white chest plate, dark plated shoulders and a belt with an orange buckle, with red straps crossing his back. His lower legs are wrapped in white striped guards above white boots.
identity_text: A Minecraft villager kitted out for battle, its brown robe covered by a white chest plate, dark red-trimmed pauldrons and a buckled belt.

appearance_text: This is a plump bird with a bright red head and neck, a yellow beak and a red wattle hanging beneath it. Its body is covered in brown and grey feathers, with folded wings at the sides. The back shows a big fanned tail made of brown and white rings, and it stands on skinny orange feet.
identity_text: A large North American bird, plump and covered in brown and grey feathers, with a bright red head and neck, a yellow beak with a red wattle hanging under it, and a wide fanned tail banded in brown and white.

appearance_text: A grown-up man with short brown hair and thick eyebrows, smiling slightly. He wears a light blue button-up shirt with a collar and a small bow tie at his neck. His trousers are plain black and his shoes are dark.
identity_text: Bill Nye, the television science presenter, in his light blue button-up shirt with a red bow tie and black trousers.

appearance_text: A warrior in a smooth silver helmet with a black T-shaped visor. Silver plates cover the shoulders, arms and chest, with brown leather straps crossing over them and a pouch at the belt. A long brown cape hangs down the back, and the trousers are blue with brown patches above heavy brown boots.
identity_text: The Mandalorian, the armoured bounty hunter from the Disney series, in a silver helmet with a black T-visor and a long brown cape.

bottom: long pale blue skirt down to the floor
head: blue snowflake ornament in the hair
top: pale blue gown with short sleeves
blue gem necklace at the chest

appearance_text: A girl with very long brown hair falling all the way down her back and bright blue eyes. A blue snowflake ornament is pinned in her hair at the back. She wears a floor length pale blue gown with short sleeves and a blue gem hanging at her chest, and the skirt shimmers lighter towards the hem.
identity_text: A princess with very long brown hair in a floor-length pale blue gown, wearing a snowflake ornament in her hair and a blue gem at her neck. The title describes the look rather than naming anyone.

head: pale green frog hat with pink cheeks
top: light green dress with pink flowers

appearance_text: A girl with long brown hair and pink cheeks, wearing a pale green frog hat with round eyes and little pink cheeks of its own. Her dress is light green and covered in small pink flowers, with green straps over the shoulders. She wears pink and white striped stockings and pale green shoes, and her hair falls in a long sheet down her back.
identity_text: A girl in a summery frog outfit — a pale green frog hat above a flower-printed green dress, with striped stockings and pale green shoes.

appearance_text: A heavily armoured fighter covered head to toe in thick green plating. A rounded green helmet with a wide grey visor hides the whole face. Chunky orange padding sits on the shoulders and upper arms, and a large brown buckle is fixed in the middle of the belt. A green pack is strapped across the back between the shoulders, and the armoured legs end in dark grey boots.
identity_text: The Doom Slayer, the armoured marine from the Doom games, in green plate armour with orange shoulder padding and a full-face visored helmet.

hair: long brown hair down the back

appearance_text: A young fighter with shaggy brown hair and green eyes, with longer hair hanging down the back. He wears a cream shirt under a brown leather vest, with a red sash and belt around his waist. His trousers are dark blue and he wears sturdy brown boots.
identity_text: A young swordsman kitted out for a fight, in a cream shirt under a brown leather vest with a red sash at his waist.

footwear: long white socks with checkered tops
head: white cat ears
long white hair

appearance_text: A girl with long white hair and two fluffy white cat ears on top of her head, with soft grey-blue eyes and pink cheeks. She wears an oversized pale grey hoodie over a white top and short white shorts. Long white socks with little checkered cuffs come up over her knees, and her hair falls all the way down her back.
identity_text: A girl in an icy white and pale blue winter outfit, with fluffy cat ears and long white hair falling down her back. The title describes the wintry look rather than naming anyone.

head: red square head
top: dark red body with grey patches

appearance_text: A stocky dark red creature with a big square head, two tiny white eyes and a wide dark mouth. Its red body and arms are blotched with patches of cold grey, and the same grey covers its short stumpy legs. A small grey nub sits on top of its head, and the grey blotches carry on across its back.
identity_text: A Strider, the lava-walking Nether mob from Minecraft, drawn in a humanoid player shape with a dark red body blotched with cold grey.

appearance_text: A pale girl with long straight grey-black hair and a blunt fringe just above her eyes. She wears a soft brown cardigan open over a white shirt with a bright red tie knotted at the collar. Her skirt is blue and pleated, and long cream socks come up to her knees above small dark brown shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed schoolgirl with long dark grey hair, wearing a brown cardigan over a white shirt and red tie with a blue pleated skirt.

bottom: pale green and blue grey legs
head: blue grey helmet
two pointed ears
top: light blue armour plates on the chest and one arm

appearance_text: A machine built like a wolf standing on two legs, with a blue-grey helmet head, two pointed ears and a pale cream face plate with narrow dark eyes. Light blue armour plates cover one side of its chest and arm, while the other side and the back are pale green, with black seams running between the panels. Its legs are split the same way, half pale green and half blue-grey.
identity_text: A bipedal machine built with a wolf-like helmet head and pointed ears, its plating split between light blue and pale green with black seams between the panels.

head: black top hat with a red band

appearance_text: A cheery snowman made of smooth white snow, with two black coal eyes, a pointy orange carrot nose and a little coal mouth. A black top hat with a bright red band sits on his head, and a red and green striped scarf is wrapped around his neck and trails down his chest and back. His hands are covered in green mittens and small black coal buttons dot the front.
identity_text: A classic snowman built of white snow with coal eyes and a carrot nose, wearing a black top hat and a red and green striped scarf.

head: black captain's cap with a gold band
top: blue sweater under a dark grey jacket

appearance_text: A stocky man with a huge bushy dark beard covering most of his face, under thick eyebrows. He wears a black peaked cap with a gold band pulled low over his eyes. His clothes are a blue sweater under an open dark grey jacket, with matching dark grey trousers and boots.
identity_text: Captain Haddock, the gruff bearded sea captain from The Adventures of Tintin, in his gold-banded peaked cap, blue sweater and dark grey jacket.

colors.item: trim and markings on the armour
colors.name: orange

colors.item: solid red robe back under chest armour (no separate cape)
colors.name: dark red

head: gold band around the forehead
pointed monkey ears
top: tan and orange armour with a grey chest plate

appearance_text: A monkey faced warrior with pointed ears, red streaks painted across his tan cheeks and a gold band tied around his forehead. He wears layered tan and orange armour with a grey plate across the chest and thick armoured shoulders. A long dark red cape hangs down his back, and his armoured legs end in dark grey boots.
identity_text: The Monkey King of Chinese legend, a monkey-faced warrior in layered tan and orange armour with a gold band across his forehead and a dark red robe down his back.

accessories: blue badge on the back of the jacket
head: black police cap with a chequered band
silver badge on the cap
top: dark radio clipped to the front

appearance_text: A serious looking officer in a flat black cap with a black and white chequered band and a small silver badge on the front. He wears a bright yellow high visibility jacket with grey reflective stripes around the body and sleeves, a small dark radio clipped near the shoulder, and a blue badge printed across the back. His trousers and boots are plain black.
identity_text: A British PCSO, a police community support officer, in a yellow high-visibility jacket, chequered cap and black trousers.

appearance_text: A figure that is purple all over, as if carved out of a speckled crystal. Light purple and white sparkle spots are scattered across the head, chest, arms and legs, with darker purple patches between them. There is no face, no hair and no clothing, just the same crystal pattern front and back.
identity_text: A player-shaped figure covered head to toe in speckled purple amethyst crystal, listed as an amethyst-themed axolotl although nothing axolotl-shaped is visible.

accessories: white rabbit riding on the back
head: brown dog head
black wide brimmed hat

appearance_text: A brown dog standing on two legs with a big black nose, white teeth and a wide black hat pulled low. He wears a grey suit jacket over a white shirt with a blue and black striped tie, grey trousers and dark shoes. Clinging to his back is a small white rabbit with long pink lined ears and a wide grin.
identity_text: Sam & Max, the dog detective and his rabbit partner from the game of the same name: the dog in a suit, striped tie and wide brimmed hat, with the little white rabbit riding on his back.

bottom: black trousers with grey bands at the knees
top: black jacket over a black shirt

appearance_text: A figure with very long dark red hair that hangs over the face and all the way down the back. Two glowing red eyes look out from a black band across the face and a grey mask covers the mouth. The jacket is black over a black shirt, and the black trousers have grey bands at the knees above black boots.
identity_text: A dark-clad figure with very long crimson hair, glowing red eyes behind a black band and a grey mask over the mouth, dressed in a black jacket, black trousers and black boots.

head: two curved horns
glowing teal marks on the head

appearance_text: A tall dark blue creature with a blank black face and no eyes at all, with two curved horns on top of its head. Glowing teal patches dot its head, arms, legs and back like little lights in the dark. A set of pale ribs shows across its chest, and its long arms end in big pale claws with matching pale feet.
identity_text: The Warden, the blind, glowing monster of Minecraft's deep dark, with teal sculk lights over a dark blue body, curved horns and pale ribs.

hair: hair puffed out at the back
subjects: bearded man in a plaid shirt
top: red and black plaid shirt with rolled up sleeves

appearance_text: A tan skinned man with curly dark brown hair that puffs out at the back and a full dark brown beard and moustache. He wears a red and black plaid shirt with the checks running over the sleeves and the whole back, and the sleeves rolled up to show bare forearms. Light blue jeans tuck into short brown boots.
identity_text: A bearded lumberjack in a red and black plaid shirt, blue jeans and brown boots. The listing offers only the bare first name Joe, which names nothing outside this skin.

bottom: blue jeans with red and white stripes

colors.item: curved shape on the back of the shirt
colors.name: red

head: small blue bow at the back of the head
top: red curved mark on the back

appearance_text: A boy with messy brown hair and a small blue bow at the back of his head. He wears a white t-shirt with short sleeves, a little blue square on the chest and a big red curved shape across the back. His jeans are blue with bands of red and white stripes down them, and his shoes are blue with red soles.
identity_text: A brown-haired boy in a white t-shirt and blue jeans banded with red and white stripes, dressed in American flag colours down to his blue and red shoes. The title is slang for the patriotic outfit rather than a name.

face: black band over the eyes like an eye patch
head: pink pig head
small pink ears

appearance_text: A pink pig standing on two legs with a wide snout, small ears and a black band across its eyes like an eye patch, leaving one white eye showing. It wears a bright red coat with white cuffs, a white and pink checkered scarf at the neck and a black strap running across the chest and over the back. Dark red trousers and pink trotters finish the outfit, with a small gold buckle on one leg.
identity_text: A pink pig standing upright in a red pirate coat, checked neck scarf and black eye patch, with dark red trousers and pink trotters. The pirate part is costume; the figure itself is a pig.

head: pale galaxy head under spiky dark hair
top: pale blue galaxy body with a spiky dark navy hood

appearance_text: A figure washed in soft pale blue, pink and lilac clouds like a night sky, with a jagged dark navy hood or spiky hair hanging over the shoulders in points. A dark bar sits across the face where the eyes would be. The legs turn deep purple and black before ending in pale blue shoes, and the same cloudy colours cover the back.
identity_text: A figure washed in pastel galaxy blues, pinks and lilacs, with spiky dark navy hair and a dark band across the eyes. The listing calls it a creeper in a galaxy outfit, but nothing in the render supports that.

head: green hood pulled over the head
gas mask covering the whole face

appearance_text: A figure covered head to toe in a mottled green protective suit with a hood pulled tight over the head. The whole face is hidden behind a cream gas mask with two large dark round lenses and a brown breathing filter at the chin. A brown strap runs across the chest and over the back, and the hands and boots are black.
identity_text: A figure sealed head to toe in a mottled green radiation suit, with a gas mask and respirator hiding the whole face.

hair: short brown hair with a fringe
head: short brown hair
top: small green and brown block print on the chest

appearance_text: A plain-looking boy with short brown hair and dark eyes. He wears a light grey t-shirt with short sleeves and a tiny green and brown block printed on the chest. His legs are in blue jeans and he has dark grey shoes.
identity_text: A plain boy in a light grey t-shirt with a tiny grass block print, blue jeans and dark shoes, drawn deliberately at half the usual texture resolution so the pixels come out twice as big.

appearance_text: This man wears a soft brown hat pulled down over his head and a wide pair of black sunglasses across his eyes. He has light skin and a short brown beard. His top is a plain black t-shirt with bare arms, and below it he wears blue jeans and white trainers.
identity_text: An unnamed bearded man dressed for travelling in a soft brown bucket hat, black sunglasses, plain black t-shirt, blue jeans and white trainers. "Urban Nomad" describes a style, not a person.

top: grey top with dark brown stripes on the sleeves

appearance_text: A pale girl with long soft pink hair and a straight fringe over pink eyes and rosy cheeks. She wears a loose grey top with two dark brown stripes banding each sleeve, plain grey around the back. A short brown skirt sits at her waist, leaving her legs bare down to small white shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed pale girl with long soft pink hair, wearing a grey banded-sleeve top under a brown pinafore skirt. "Dusky Rose" names the colour scheme rather than a character.

head: half sandy tan head, half black and purple
top: dark purple infected shoulder and arm

appearance_text: A dried out undead figure whose skin is sandy tan and cracked, with one hollow dark eye and a second eye glowing bright purple. Half of its body, one shoulder and one leg, is swallowed by black and purple corruption that glows at the edges. Its trousers are tattered dark brown and the purple spread covers part of its back as well.
identity_text: A husk, the dried-out desert zombie of Minecraft, with one shoulder, arm and leg taken over by glowing purple End corruption and a single purple eye.

appearance_text: A man whose whole body has gone grey, from his skin to his clothes. He has short black hair and a dark beard, and his eyes glow faintly purple. His shirt is plain grey with grey arms, his trousers are darker grey and his shoes are black. The back is the same flat grey all over.
identity_text: Minecraft's Steve with all his colour drained away: flat grey skin and clothes, black hair and beard, and eyes that glow faintly purple.

colors.item: trim along the bottom of the jacket
colors.name: orange

top: black jacket with an orange trim at the hem

appearance_text: A pale man with short ginger red hair and a big bushy ginger beard and moustache, with grey blue eyes. He wears a black jacket with a thin orange band along the bottom hem, open over a light blue shirt, and the ginger hair spills down over the back of the collar. Dark blue jeans and clean white shoes finish the look.
identity_text: Jens 'Jeb' Bergensten, the lead Minecraft developer at Mojang, shown as a ginger bearded man in a black jacket with an orange trimmed hem.

appearance_text: A boy with messy black hair, blue eyes and tanned skin. He wears a plain white short-sleeved t-shirt that leaves his arms bare, and blue shorts that stop above the knee. Light blue socks pull up his shins into white trainers.
identity_text: A tanned boy with black hair in a plain white t-shirt, blue shorts and white trainers. The title names a season, not a person.

colors.item: icing cuffs at the wrists and ankles
colors.name: white

footwear: white icing bands at the ankles
head: round brown gingerbread head
top: red sweet buttons down the front

appearance_text: A cheerful character shaped like a baked gingerbread cookie, warm brown all over with round arms and legs. Two little white icing dots make its eyes and a curved row of white icing makes a big smile. Three red sweets are pressed down its chest like buttons with a small green leaf above them, and neat white icing squiggles run around its wrists and ankles.
identity_text: A gingerbread man: a walking baked cookie, warm brown all over, with white icing dots for eyes and a big curved icing smile. Red sweets run down its chest like buttons.

footwear: cream boots with white fur tops
head: big white fur hood on the back
top: white top with a row of buttons
dark red coat with white fur cuffs

appearance_text: A girl with long dark brown hair, one side falling in a braid over her shoulder. She wears a dark red winter coat with thick white fur around the hood and cuffs, over a white top fastened with a row of buttons. Her skirt is dark red and her cream boots have white fur around the tops. The large fluffy hood sits across her back.
identity_text: An unnamed girl dressed for a snowstorm: long dark brown hair with a braid, a cream fur-trimmed coat banded in dark red, a big hood down her back and pale fur-topped boots.

accessories: brown belt with a gold buckle
head: short black hair

appearance_text: A man with short black hair and a surprised open mouth. He wears a plain white t-shirt with short sleeves and blue jeans held up by a brown belt with a gold buckle. His trainers are red and white.
identity_text: An ordinary townsman with short black hair and a surprised open mouth, in a plain white t-shirt, blue jeans with a brown belt and red and white trainers.

hair: long black hair with two buns
head: long black hair
two small buns

appearance_text: A pale girl with very long black hair tied into two small buns at the back of her head, the rest hanging down past her shoulders. She wears a baggy grey-blue sweater with long droopy sleeves that hangs to the tops of her thighs. Tall black boots cover her legs up to just below the knee.
identity_text: A pale girl with very long dark hair tied into two buns, wearing a baggy blue-grey knit sweater and tall black boots. The title is a mood word, not a name.

head: long brown hair
white and orange flowers in the hair

appearance_text: A girl with long straight brown hair and small white and orange flowers tucked into it. She wears a light blue pinafore dress with puffy sleeves covered in orange flowers, and a bow is tied at the back of the dress. Her legs are bare down to little white ankle socks.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in a light blue pinafore dress worn over a striped sweater, with flowers in her long brown hair and bare legs down to white ankle socks.

top: light grey shape printed on the chest

appearance_text: A pale boy with fluffy white hair whose messy bangs hang over his blue eyes, and pink blush on his cheeks. He wears a baggy dark blue sweater with a light grey shape printed on the chest. His trousers are blue with a checked plaid pattern, and he has plain white shoes. The back of his sweater is plain dark blue.
identity_text: An unnamed pale boy with fluffy white hair covering his eyes, in a baggy dark blue sweater printed with a pale anchor, blue checked trousers and white shoes.

hair: short brown hair under the hood
head: white animal hood with pointy ears

appearance_text: A child wearing a fluffy white animal onesie from head to toe. The hood has two pointy white ears and a small face with brown eyes and a bit of brown hair peeking out. The front has a soft cream belly patch, the hands and feet are white paws, and a fluffy tail hangs at the back.
identity_text: An unnamed child dressed head to toe in a fluffy white arctic-fox onesie with an eared hood, paw hands and a tail; the figure is a person in a costume rather than an animal.

head: short orange brown hair
top: blue hoodie with the hood down at the back
dark creeper face printed on the back

appearance_text: A boy with short orange brown hair and brown eyes. He wears a blue hoodie with grey cuffs and the hood resting down behind his neck, and on the back of the hoodie is a dark creeper face with square eyes and a frowning mouth. His jeans are dark blue and his shoes are blue with white toes.
identity_text: An unnamed boy in a blue hoodie with a creeper face printed across the back, dark blue jeans and blue trainers. The creeper is a print on the garment, not the figure itself.

appearance_text: A boy with short brown hair cut in a fringe over a pale face. He wears a striped white and tan short-sleeved shirt under blue denim overall shorts with straps that cross over his back. Small colourful bands sit on his wrists, and his legs and feet are bare.
identity_text: An unnamed boy with a short brown fringe in a striped short-sleeved shirt under blue denim overall shorts, wearing small rainbow wristbands and going barefoot.

appearance_text: A tall, armless figure with a blank speckled body in shades of light blue and teal. Its face has two square black eye holes and a wide black mouth that turns down at the corners in a frown. The mottled blue pattern covers the head, body and all four stubby legs, front and back.
identity_text: A Creeper recoloured in diamond blue, keeping the two square black eye holes and the wide downturned mouth, with the mottled pattern carried over head, body and legs.

appearance_text: A fighter with bright red hair standing up in tall spikes. He wears a dark grey armoured jacket with chunky shoulder pads and blue and orange straps crossing his chest. His trousers are blue with an orange belt, and his boots are black.
identity_text: Lance, the dragon-type trainer who serves as Champion of the Indigo League in the Pokemon games, in spiked red hair and a caped dark battle outfit.

head: white peaked cap with a black and gold band
top: dark navy uniform jacket with gold trim and buttons

appearance_text: A man in a white peaked cap with a black band and a gold badge, with brown hair showing beneath it and blue eyes. His dark navy uniform jacket is buttoned with gold buttons and trimmed with gold braid at the cuffs and shoulders, with a gold cord looped across the chest. His trousers are dark navy and his shoes are black, and gold stripes ring the sleeves at the back too.
identity_text: An unnamed Royal Navy admiral in dress uniform: white peaked cap, dark navy jacket with gold braid and epaulettes over dark trousers.

appearance_text: A girl with very long brown hair and hazel eyes, peeking out of a light blue animal hood with round pink-lined ears. identity_text: A girl with very long brown hair zipped into a light blue hooded animal onesie with round ears, a pink stripe down the back and soft brown paw feet. The title is only a first name, so no character is asserted.

appearance_text: A tall figure wrapped in a black hood and a long dark robe, with two glowing white eyes shining out of the shadow where a face should be. Brown leather straps cross the chest and more brown bands wrap around the sleeves. Grey gloves cover the hands and the robe hangs almost to the ground over dark boots. The back is plain black with the same brown straps showing at the shoulders.
identity_text: A dark wizard: a tall hooded figure in a long black robe with brown leather straps across the chest, only two glowing white eyes showing under the hood. The title names the archetype, not a character.

appearance_text: A green monster with a mottled square head, two black square eyes and a wide black frowning mouth. It wears an open light blue and white checkered shirt over a plain white shirt, with a dark red checkered scarf bunched around its neck. It has dark grey trousers and chunky brown boots.
identity_text: A Creeper dressed in street clothes: an open blue-and-white checked shirt over a white tee, a dark red checked bandana at the neck, dark grey trousers and chunky brown boots.

identity_text: Jar Jar Binks, the gangly Gungan from Star Wars, with his long floppy ears, wide mouth and shabby brown vest.

appearance_text: A figure whose whole head is a giant bright red mouse head with two big round ears sticking up. The face has huge white oval eyes and a wide white toothy grin. Below it is a matching red suit with a white shirt and black tie, red trousers with white cuffs, and black shoes.
identity_text: Deadmau5, the Canadian electronic musician, wearing his giant red mouse head above a matching red suit and black tie.

identity_text: The Grinch, the shaggy green Christmas creature created by Dr. Seuss, wearing a red Santa coat with white fur trim, a grey belt and red boots.

identity_text: A pale blonde girl in a meme-cat themed outfit: grey pink-lined cat ears, a pink pastry-patterned top with grey sleeves, and knee socks fading from mint green to light blue.

identity_text: An unnamed girl with very long grey hair and small animal ears, wearing a dark red t-shirt with a white heart and ripped light blue jeans.

identity_text: Kenny McCormick from South Park, a small round-headed kid buried in a bright orange hooded parka zipped so tight that only his eyes and nose show.

identity_text: An unnamed boy in streetwear: a red-trimmed black hoodie worn open over a white t-shirt, with a face-like print on the back, grey camo trousers and black shoes.

identity_text: Peeta Mellark, the baker's son from District 12 in The Hunger Games, shown in a plain navy t-shirt and olive trousers.

identity_text: A girl with very long pastel rainbow hair, in a mint green top with striped sleeves and brown shorts. Nobody is named - the title only describes her hair.

appearance_text: A figure in a smart black suit whose head is nothing but burning yellow and orange flame, with two tiny black eyes in the middle of the fire. The jacket is buttoned over a white shirt with a bright red tie, and white cuffs show at the wrists. The trousers and shoes are black.
identity_text: A Blaze, the fiery Minecraft mob, dressed up in a smart black suit with a white shirt and bright red tie, its head nothing but burning yellow flame.

She wears a baggy mint green sweater with a white collar and a small red heart on the chest, and her pale legs end in dark pink boots.
identity_text: A girl with a maroon bob under a crown of small peach flowers, in a baggy mint green sweater with a white collar and a red heart on the chest, above pale legs and dark pink boots.

A grey harness sits over the shoulders and brown straps cross the chest and back. A brown belt with an orange buckle and small pouches wraps the waist, above matching red and black legs and boots.
identity_text: Deadpool, the masked Marvel mercenary, in his red and black bodysuit with a shoulder harness, crossed straps and a brown utility belt.

appearance_text: A boy with bright yellow skin and two tiny black dot eyes, topped with light brown bowl-cut hair. He wears a blue shirt with a red tie down the front, leaving his yellow arms bare. His trousers are plain green.
identity_text: A boy drawn as the default starter avatar from Roblox, with bright yellow skin, two dot eyes and bowl-cut hair, in a blue shirt with a red tie and green trousers. The title says the clothes are in that game's style, so it is not a character name.

appearance_text: A tall square-headed creature coloured all over in soft mint green with faint lighter speckles. Its face has two square grey eyes and a wide grey frowning mouth with two square feet hanging below it. The arms, body and legs are all the same pale mint green with no clothes at all.
identity_text: A creeper, the square-faced Minecraft mob with the frowning mouth, recoloured all over in faded mint green with grey facial squares.

appearance_text: A pale, pointy-eared character with short blonde hair and green eyes. The body is covered in grey plate armour with dark green trim and chunky shoulder plates. A long green cape hangs down the whole back and a green panel runs down the front. The legs and boots are armoured in the same grey.
identity_text: A blonde, pointed-eared warrior in grey plate armour trimmed with dark green, wearing a long green cape down the back.

appearance_text: A pale girl with shoulder length black hair streaked with red and a fringe over purple eyes. She wears a red jacket hanging open over a short black top that leaves her middle bare. Below that are dark blue shorts, long black socks pulled up over the knees, and white shoes.
identity_text: A pale goth-styled girl with black hair streaked red, wearing an open red jacket over a black crop top with torn dark blue jeans.

appearance_text: A pale figure with messy light brown hair falling over the forehead and narrow dark eyes. A black jacket hangs open over a plain white shirt with a small black tie at the collar. The legs are in dark grey trousers with light grey cuffs at the ankles above black shoes, and the jacket is dark all the way across the back.
identity_text: An unnamed pale figure with messy light brown hair, dressed in a black jacket over a white shirt and tie with dark trousers and black shoes.

appearance_text: A stern man in dark wraparound sunglasses with short swept-back brown hair. He wears a heavy black leather jacket zipped over a black shirt, with a belt at the waist. His trousers and boots are black too, so almost the whole outfit is black.
identity_text: The Terminator, the original Series 800 cyborg assassin, shown in its human disguise as a stern man in black wraparound sunglasses and a black leather jacket.

identity_text: A body-builder version of Steve, the Minecraft player character, with a broad chest and huge arms in his usual blue t-shirt and dark trousers.

The metal is scratched and stained with brown, and a leather strap runs across the chest to a belt at the waist. The same worn plating covers the arms, legs and the whole of the back, ending in heavy dark boots.
identity_text: An unnamed knight in worn full plate armour, his face hidden behind a closed helmet whose visor is just a dark T-shaped slit.

identity_text: A teenage boy in a loose white sports shirt carrying a small red chest logo and lettering down one sleeve, worn with heavily ripped light blue jeans and white trainers. The brand in the description is printed on his shirt, so it is not his name.

On its face, piped in white icing, are two square eyes and a wide frowning mouth. Three little sweets in green, yellow and red are stuck down its chest like buttons, and white icing bands are piped around its wrists and ankles.
identity_text: A creeper dressed up as a gingerbread man: a cookie-brown body from head to toe with the creeper's square eyes and wide frowning mouth piped on in white icing, plus candy buttons and icing cuffs.

identity_text: Minecraft's Steve gone dark and corrupted, dressed head to toe in black with two burning orange lights where his eyes should be.

appearance_text: A heavy fighter clad in armour of dark purple, almost black, with broad shoulder plates and grey purple guards on the arms and legs. The helmet has narrow glowing white eye slits and a pale mark on the forehead, and below it an open mouth shows a row of teeth. Grey boots cover the feet.
identity_text: An armoured fighter in obsidian-dark purple plate with a full helmet, presented by the listing as an original Minecraft superhero rather than an existing character.

A brown belt sits over red and white checked shorts, and her legs are covered in matching patterned stockings. Chunky dark brown boots come up over her ankles.

appearance_text: A tall creature covered from head to toe in shaggy brown fur in light and dark patches. Its flat furry face has two small black eyes and a dark nose, with longer hair falling around the shoulders. A silver studded strap is slung across one shoulder and down its chest, continuing across its back.
identity_text: Chewbacca the Wookiee from Star Wars, rendered as a tall figure covered head to toe in shaggy light and dark brown fur, with a silver studded bandolier slung across his chest and continuing over his back.

The rest of its body is smooth light grey with soft shading.
identity_text: Mewtwo, the legendary psychic Pokemon: a tall pale grey creature with a narrow horned head, a rounded purple belly plate and a thick purple tail down its back.

identity_text: A panda — a black and white panda head on a clothed, human-shaped body — dressed in a mottled bright pink sweatshirt, black trousers and white paw-like feet.

identity_text: A snowy owl: white plumage dappled with grey and black, big yellow-ringed eyes, a small hooked beak and yellow talons.

identity_text: A triceratops: a stocky olive green dinosaur with a bony frill, two long pale horns over a beaked snout, and yellow plates running down its belly.

identity_text: Lieutenant Simon 'Ghost' Riley, the masked special forces soldier from Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2. He is in a black skull balaclava and beanie with a grey tactical vest over khaki army clothes and brown boots.

identity_text: A very pale teenager whose long black hair covers the face completely, wearing a baggy red and black striped sweater full of holes and ripped black trousers.

identity_text: Bilbo Baggins from The Hobbit and The Lord of the Rings, a curly-haired hobbit in a dark red coat and green waistcoat, going barefoot.
