identity_text: A girl in a Pikachu-themed outfit: a baggy yellow jumper with a zigzag tail drawn on the back, worn with yellow and black striped leggings.

head: shiba dog head with pointed ears

appearance_text: A character with the head of a fluffy orange shiba dog, with cream cheeks, cream eyebrow patches, small black eyes and a black nose. Its body wears a smart dark purple suit with a brown tie down the front, and the orange paws poke out of the sleeves. The trousers match the jacket and the back is plain dark purple.
identity_text: The doge meme shiba inu dressed as a boss: a fluffy orange dog head with cream cheeks above a dark purple suit, with orange paws poking out of the sleeves.

face: bulging white eyes with black dots
head: big green frog head
bumps above the eyes

appearance_text: A green frog person with a big wide head, bulging white eyes with small black dots and long pink lips stretched across a froggy mouth. Two bumps sit above the eyes. He wears a plain blue-grey shirt with short sleeves that show his green arms, and dark red shorts above bare green legs.
identity_text: Pepe the Frog, the green cartoon frog from internet memes, given a Minecraft body in a plain blue-grey shirt and dark red shorts.

accessories: brown belt with a gold buckle
hair: bright pink hair with a fringe
head: blue headband

appearance_text: A girl with bright pink hair cut in a fringe, held back by a wide blue headband. Her eyes are big and purple. She wears a blue sleeveless top with dark grey straps crossing the chest and brown wraps around her wrists, cinched with a brown belt and a round gold buckle. Dark grey trousers tuck into black boots with grey knee guards.
identity_text: Firecracker, the pink-haired character from the mobile game Clash Royale, in her blue headband and sleeveless blue top with dark trousers tucked into black boots.

head: black hair
top: white military jacket with medals and a gold sash

appearance_text: A man with a big bushy black beard and wide black sunglasses. He wears a white military jacket with a gold sash running across the chest and a row of little coloured medals pinned near the shoulder, and the sash carries on across the back. His trousers match the white jacket and his boots are black.
identity_text: General Aladeen, the blustering ruler from the film The Dictator, in a white dress uniform with a gold sash, medals and dark sunglasses.

top: off-shoulder dark grey top with dark blue sleeves

appearance_text: A pale girl with long reddish brown hair falling all the way down her back and large purple eyes. She wears a dark grey top with dark blue sleeves that slip off her bare shoulders. Her black jeans are ripped with tears down the legs, and she wears black sneakers with white soles.
identity_text: A teenage girl with long reddish brown hair in an off-shoulder top with dark blue sleeves and ripped black jeans.

bottom: dark blue cloth hanging at the front
head: dark horned helmet
spikes over the brow

appearance_text: A towering figure in heavy dark grey armour, with a black horned helmet and two burning icy blue eyes where a face should be. Bone shaped plates curve over the shoulders and chest, and a small skull sits at the belt. A long dark blue cape falls all the way down the back, and dark cloth hangs between the armoured legs.
identity_text: The Lich King, master and lord of the Scourge in World of Warcraft, in heavy dark grey armour with a horned helm, glowing icy blue eyes and a long cape.

appearance_text: A rotting figure with blotchy green and grey skin and dark sunken holes where its eyes should be. It wears a torn light blue shirt that hangs in strips off the arms, with reddish stains across the chest and back. Its trousers are dirty dark brown and ripped at the knees.
identity_text: A Minecraft zombie drawn in a shaded, detailed style, with blotchy green-grey rotting skin and a shredded pale blue shirt over dirty brown trousers.

appearance_text: A tall figure covered head to toe in dark purple plated armour with rough shading. The hood or helmet is bright purple on top and hides the face in shadow, leaving only two glowing pink eyes. A small glowing light blue gem sits in the middle of the chest, and the arms and shoulders have chunky armour plates. The legs and boots turn dark grey, and the back is plated the same purple as the front.
identity_text: Signus, the Envoy of the Devourer boss from Terraria's Calamity Mod, a hooded figure plated in dark purple with a glowing gem at the chest.

appearance_text: A walking pile of bones with a bare skull, two dark empty eye sockets and a small dark mouth. It wears an open light blue holiday shirt scattered with pink flowers, with its bony ribs showing down the middle and thin bone arms poking out of the sleeves. Green shorts hang on its hip bones and its skinny bone legs are bare.
identity_text: A skeleton on holiday, wearing an open pale blue shirt scattered with pink flowers over its bare ribs, with green shorts on its hip bones.

appearance_text: A huge green figure with enormous muscles in the arms, chest and legs. The face is green with white angry eyes and an open shouting mouth, topped with dark brown bowl-cut hair. The only clothing is a pair of torn purple trousers, and the big feet are bare.
identity_text: The Hulk, the huge green Marvel character: all muscle, with a bowl cut of dark hair, an angry shouting face and torn purple trousers.

face: one blue eye and one green eye
hair: pink purple and blue at the front
yellow and red down the back

appearance_text: A girl whose long hair is every colour at once, pink and purple at the front, bright blue down one side and yellow and red flowing down her back. Her eyes do not match, one is blue and the other green. She wears a simple white t-shirt with short sleeves and plain black shorts, and her shoes and socks are a bright mix of pink, blue and red.
identity_text: An unnamed girl whose long hair is every colour of the rainbow at once, dressed simply in a white t-shirt, black shorts and mismatched bright shoes.

head: dark red hood down at the back
top: orange pumpkin face across the back

appearance_text: A boy with short brown hair falling over glowing red eyes. He wears a dark red hoodie with the empty hood resting on his shoulders and bright orange bands around each sleeve, plus a small orange flame shape at the collar. Across the whole back of the hoodie is a big orange pumpkin face with triangle eyes and a jagged grin. His jeans are grey with dark cuffs above black shoes.
identity_text: An ordinary boy dressed for Halloween in a dark red pumpkin hoodie, grey jeans and dark shoes. Not a specific character.

hair: long blonde hair past the shoulders
head: long blonde hair

appearance_text: A girl with long blonde hair and big blue eyes. She wears a short sleeveless dress in pink and white checks that leaves her arms and legs bare. Her shoes are pink and her hair falls down her back.
identity_text: Barbie in the pink-and-white gingham dress from the 2023 live-action film, with long blonde hair, bare arms and legs and pink shoes.

face: two round glowing red goggle lenses
dark open mouth below the goggles
hair: long dark hair down the back
head: dark hood with red goggles strapped over the eyes
top: dark brown jacket with grey shoulder pads

appearance_text: A grim figure whose face is hidden under a dark brown hood with two round glowing red goggle lenses strapped over the eyes, leaving only a dark open mouth showing below. Long dark hair falls down the back. Heavy grey shoulder pads sit over a dark brown jacket with a strap crossing the chest and a dark red wrap around the waist. The trousers are black and the boots are dark.
identity_text: Mordecai, the hunter class character from Borderlands, hooded with red-lensed goggles over his eyes. Grey shoulder pads sit over a dark brown wasteland jacket with a dark red wrap at the waist.

appearance_text: A brown-skinned man with a big rounded black afro, bushy sideburns and a thick black moustache. He is dressed in a sharp black suit jacket over a white shirt with a narrow black tie running down the middle, and white cuffs peek out at his wrists. His trousers and shoes are the same black as the jacket, and the back of the suit is plain black.
identity_text: Jules Winnfield from Pulp Fiction, a man in a black suit and narrow black tie with a big rounded afro.

appearance_text: A soft yellow duck, yellow all over from head to feet. Its round head has two tiny black dot eyes and a flat orange bill. Faint paler yellow shapes on the chest, back and sides suggest folded wings and feathers. Nothing is worn.
identity_text: A simple bright yellow duck with a flat orange bill and two tiny black eyes, plain yellow from head to feet.

hair: bright orange hair tied in a ponytail down the back

appearance_text: A slim character with bright orange hair swept back into a ponytail that hangs down her back, green eyes and a small pink mouth. She wears a plain green short sleeved shirt. Her trousers are dark brown and her boots are dark grey.
identity_text: A remake of Alex, the default Minecraft player character, in her plain green shirt with dark brown trousers and grey boots, bright orange hair tied back in a ponytail.

bottom: white onesie legs with brown cow spots
head: cow hood with ears
white and brown spotted hood

appearance_text: A girl with long light brown hair hanging over her face, bundled up in a cow onesie. The hood is white with brown patches and has two little cow ears with pink insides. The body and legs of the onesie are white covered in big brown cow spots, while the sleeves are solid brown, and she wears chunky dark brown boots.
identity_text: An unnamed girl bundled into a brown and white cow onesie whose hood carries little cow ears, with long light brown hair falling over her face.

appearance_text: A pale ghostly man in a suit covered in black and white stripes, with a white shirt and a dark tie. His face is chalk white with big dark circles around his tired eyes. Messy mossy green hair sticks up all over his head and out the back. He wears matching striped trousers and plain black shoes.
identity_text: Beetlejuice, the chalk-white ghost of the 1988 film, in his black and white striped suit with messy green hair.

appearance_text: A robot built out of grey metal plates, with a smooth helmet face, two glowing red eyes and a dark slit for a mouth. A small square red light glows in the middle of its chest, surrounded by riveted metal panels. Its arms, back and legs are all made of the same scuffed grey and dark grey metal.
identity_text: A full-body metal war robot in scuffed grey plating, with two glowing red eyes, a dark mouth slit and a red light in its chest. The listing calls it an Iron Man style robot, but nothing in the render pins it to a particular character.

head: long blonde hair with a fringe

appearance_text: A girl with long blonde hair falling in front of her shoulders and down her back, and pale blue eyes. She wears a black jumper with white bands around the sleeves. Her shorts are light blue denim and she has white socks with black shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with long pale blonde hair in a dark jumper with white sleeve bands, light denim shorts and black shoes over white socks.

appearance_text: A girl with long pale blue hair and a pair of tall white bunny ears with pink insides standing up on her head. Her eyes are closed in a happy smile and her cheeks are pink. She wears a soft white cardigan over a light blue shirt with a little pink bow at the collar, a grey pleated skirt, white knee socks and grey shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed pastel girl wearing white bunny ears, with long pale blue hair, a soft white cardigan, grey pleated skirt and white knee socks.

colors.item: stripes on the arms and legs
colors.name: white

head: white mask covering the whole face
top: black body with three white buttons

appearance_text: A tall thin figure with a white mask for a face, two big black hollow eyes, red circles on the cheeks and a wide red smiling mouth. Its body is black with three white buttons down the chest. White stripes ring the arms and run down the legs to black feet.
identity_text: The Puppet from Five Nights at Freddy's: a tall thin animatronic in a black body with white stripes and buttons, its face a smiling white mask with hollow black eyes.

head: long wavy purple hair
top: baggy mint green jumper with white cuffs

appearance_text: A girl with long wavy purple hair that falls past her shoulders in dark and light streaks, and matching purple eyes. She wears a baggy mint green jumper with white bands at the cuffs, and short white shorts underneath. On her feet are black boots with white laces over white socks.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with long wavy purple hair and purple eyes, wearing a baggy mint green jumper, short white shorts and black laced boots over white socks.

head: yellow swimming goggles pushed up on the head
top: white t-shirt with a yellow duck on the chest

appearance_text: A cheerful kid with short brown hair and yellow swimming goggles pushed up on the forehead. A white t-shirt with a little yellow duck on the chest is worn with puffy orange arm floats, and a pink ring sits around the waist. The shorts are blue with white patches, a pink star is printed on the back, and white socks and shoes finish it off.
identity_text: A cheerful kid kitted out for the pool: goggles pushed up on the forehead, inflatable orange arm floats, a bird-printed white t-shirt, blue swim shorts and white socks and shoes.

appearance_text: A grey elephant standing on two legs, with wide ears, small eyes and two pale cream tusks curving out of its face. A long brown trunk hangs down the front of its body and a dark red cloth is draped over its back. Gold bands run across its chest, arms and legs like a harness, and its grey skin is patched with lighter and darker grey.
identity_text: A war elephant, an elephant kitted out for battle with a gold harness and a dark red cloth over its back, standing on two legs.

appearance_text: A girl with very long pale blonde hair and big blue eyes. She wears a soft cream coloured fluffy jacket left open over a dark brown top, with light blue denim shorts. Her legs are bare above dark brown boots.
identity_text: An unnamed blonde girl in a fluffy cream jacket over a dark brown top, with light blue denim shorts and dark brown boots.

bottom: white fur trim above the boots
head: brown fur hat with ear flaps
top: white fur trim at the collar and cuffs

appearance_text: A bearded traveller with a shaggy brown fur hat pulled over his ears, rosy cheeks and a bushy grey and white beard. He wears a padded pale blue winter coat with white fluffy trim at the collar and cuffs, fastened with a round gold buckle at the waist. His trousers match the coat with more white fur above heavy brown boots, and a brown backpack with a buckle is strapped to his back.
identity_text: An unnamed arctic explorer with a bushy white beard, wearing a padded pale blue parka with fur trim, a brown fur hat and a backpack.

appearance_text: A pale girl with very long dark blue hair that hangs past her waist and bright teal eyes. She wears a teal top banded with white that leaves her shoulders bare, with matching teal bands around her upper arms, and a short teal skirt. Long white socks cover her legs almost to the knee.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in a teal and white ocean themed outfit with very long dark blue hair.

appearance_text: A soft white bear with round ears on top of its head, small black eyes and a dark grey nose over a pale muzzle. Its whole body is puffy white fur with light blue shadows, so it looks like it is built out of little clouds. The same fluffy pattern covers its back, and its arms and legs end in soft rounded paws.
identity_text: An unnamed white bear whose fur is drawn as puffy, pale-blue-shaded clouds, with round ears and soft rounded paws.

appearance_text: A tall green figure with patchy, slimy-looking green skin and two dark hollow eyes. It wears a ragged light blue shirt that is torn open across the chest and shoulders. Dark blue trousers cover the legs down to matching shoes, and the arms are bare green.
identity_text: A zombie crossed with a slime: a tall green undead figure with gooey mottled skin, hollow black eyes and a torn cyan shirt.

head: clear glass fishbowl over the head
brown hair

appearance_text: A man with a big clear glass bowl fitted right over his head, so his brown hair, wide white eyes and brown moustache show through it. He wears a dark blue sleeveless top that leaves his brown arms bare, with a belt at the waist. Bright red trousers run down to dark blue shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed man walking around with a clear block of glass stuck over his head, his brown hair and moustache showing through it, wearing a dark navy top, a yellow belt and red trousers.

colors.item: hood at the back of the head
colors.name: cream

face: three glowing orange slits across the mask
head: grey wooden mask
pale hood at the back
top: glowing orange embers across the chest

appearance_text: A figure hiding behind a flat grey wooden mask with three burning orange slits cut across it. Behind the mask, the back of the head is wrapped in a pale cream hood. It wears a heavy brown coat with knobbly grey pieces over the shoulders, and glowing orange embers spread across its chest and back. The trousers and boots are plain grey.
identity_text: A figure hiding behind a flat grey wooden mask cut with three burning orange slits, with pale bark-like tufts behind it and glowing embers across the chest of a heavy brown coat. The listing describes it as someone wearing the mask of the Creaking mob rather than the mob itself.

head: brown hair
top: white shirt with a red tie

appearance_text: A boy with brown swept hair and wide black sunglasses across his eyes. He wears a black jacket with two small gold buttons on the front over a white shirt with a red tie hanging down. His jeans are dark grey and his shoes are red with white soles; the jacket is plain black all across the back.
identity_text: Fushka, a Russian Minecraft YouTuber, shown as a brown-haired boy in wide black sunglasses, a black gold-buttoned blazer and dark jeans.

top: red jacket with white sleeve stripes

appearance_text: A boy with a shaggy fringe that is bright red on one half and black on the other, over pale skin and glowing red eyes. He wears a red jacket with two white stripes around each sleeve and a black shirt showing at the collar. His trousers are black and his shoes are red with black soles.
identity_text: A pale boy whose hair is red on one side and black on the other, wearing a matching red and black hoodie with black trousers and red shoes. The title only names the colours.

head: hood bunched at the back
top: baggy hoodie in purple, yellow and orange bands

appearance_text: A girl with bright red hair falling to her shoulders and big purple eyes. She wears a baggy hoodie split into wide bands of colour, purple across the shoulders and sleeves, yellow through the middle and orange below, with a dark red hem, and the same bands run across the back. Underneath she has short black shorts, white socks and pink shoes.
identity_text: A red-haired girl in a baggy hoodie split into wide purple, yellow and orange bands, with black shorts and pink shoes. The title describes the garment.

appearance_text: A young adventurer with short brown hair and bright green eyes. He wears a bright orange jacket with grey plates over the shoulders, a light blue collar and thick brown gloves. His trousers are dark red with a light blue belt, and his boots are brown. A bulky brown backpack is strapped to his back.
identity_text: The listing names this as Ratchet, the main playable character of the Ratchet and Clank series, drawn here as a young human adventurer in his orange jacket with a backpack.

accessories: big white 3d glasses with one blue lens and one red lens
face: big white glasses covering the eyes
top: dark red plaid shirt with short sleeves

appearance_text: A bearded man with short dark brown hair and a thick brown beard around his mouth. Across his eyes sits a pair of big white cardboard glasses, one lens blue and the other red. He wears a dark red checked shirt with short sleeves, dark green trousers and white shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed bearded man wearing a pair of white cardboard 3D cinema glasses, a red plaid shirt and dark green trousers.

accessories: feather necklace in orange, red and teal
hair: long dark brown hair down the back
head: white horned bone mask

appearance_text: A figure wearing a white bone mask with curved horns and glowing purple eyes, with long dark brown hair falling down the back. Their chest is bare apart from a necklace of orange, red and teal feathers, and pale bone bands circle the upper arms. A skirt of green grass strands hangs around the waist, and their bare legs are streaked with grey markings.
identity_text: A tribal shaman whose head is hidden inside a horned white bone mask, wearing a feather necklace and a skirt of grass.

face: dark eye on the other side

appearance_text: A girl with long brown hair falling down her back, whose face is split in two: one half is normal skin with a dark eye, the other half is a bare white skull with a hollow black eye socket. She wears a grey top that slips off the shoulders and leaves her middle bare. Her shorts are black with grey patches and she has grey boots.
identity_text: A long brown haired girl whose face is half ordinary skin and half bare white skull, in a grey off-shoulder top, dark patched shorts and grey boots.

appearance_text: A shaggy creature covered head to toe in blue fur, with tufts standing up on its head. Its face has heavy frowning eyebrows over wide white eyes and a broad flat grin across a lighter blue muzzle. Its arms, chest and legs are all the same shaggy blue fur, with no clothes at all.

keywords: That feeling when knee surgery is tomorrow
identity.name: Grinch

identity_text: The Grinch rendered in blue fur instead of the usual green, as he appears in the 'That feeling when knee surgery is tomorrow' meme.

appearance_text: A girl with long light brown hair falling down her back and soft furry ears poking out of the top of her head. Her face has big pink eyes and pink blush on both cheeks. She wears a baggy pale pink jumper and matching pale pink shorts, with bare legs and cream shoes.
identity_text: A girl in a cosy pale pink jumper and shorts with soft brown animal ears on her head. She is a look, not a character.

head: red knitted beanie
orange goggles
top: grey gear vest with straps and pouches

appearance_text: A tough figure in a red knitted beanie with big orange goggles pulled over the eyes and a red bandana covering the nose and mouth. A grey vest loaded with straps and pouches sits over black sleeves, with a red patch on one shoulder. The trousers are dark grey with side pockets, tucked into heavy grey boots.
identity_text: A masked demolition expert in a red beanie, orange safety goggles and a red bandana, wearing a grey tactical vest full of pouches over black sleeves. The title names the job, not a character.

accessories: black bands on the upper arms
head: tall black top hat

appearance_text: A showman in a tall black top hat, with dark sideburns and rosy cheeks. His long tailcoat is bright red with a soft check pattern, worn open over a gold waistcoat and a gold cravat at the throat, and black bands circle his upper arms. Grey striped trousers and black boots finish the outfit, and the red coat covers his whole back.
identity_text: P.T. Barnum, the American showman, in ringmaster dress: a tall black top hat, a red checked tailcoat over a gold waistcoat and cravat, grey striped trousers and black boots. The listing ties him to the 2017 film The Greatest Showman.

colors.item: marking on the back of the jacket
colors.name: black

appearance_text: A pale girl with long white hair and two fluffy white animal ears on top of her head, with big purple eyes. She wears a loose tan jacket hanging open over a short light top, showing her middle, with a black marking printed on the back of the jacket. Black shorts, bare legs and black and white shoes finish the look.
identity_text: An unnamed pale girl with long white hair and fluffy white animal ears, in an open tan jacket over a cropped pink top with black shorts.

appearance_text: A woman with long red hair falling over her shoulders and down her back, with green eyes and dark make-up around them. She wears a tight black zipped bodysuit with gold cuffs at the wrists and gold buckled belts slung round her hips. The suit runs unbroken down to black boots.
identity_text: Black Widow, the Marvel spy, in a tight black zipped catsuit with gold cuffs at the wrists and gold-buckled belts at her hips, with long red hair.

appearance_text: A girl with long brown hair and big green eyes, with a pair of dark sunglasses pushed up on her head. She wears a bright orange puffy jacket with white stripes on the sleeves, over black overalls that reach her ankles. Orange and white shoes finish it off, and her long hair falls down her back.
identity_text: An unnamed girl kitted out for autumn in a bright orange puffy jacket with white striped sleeves, black overalls and dark sunglasses pushed up on her head.

head: flat blocky head
dark grey hair
top: white shirt with green arms showing

appearance_text: A tall figure with blotchy green rotting skin and two black empty holes where its eyes should be. Short dark grey hair sits flat on its square head. It wears a plain white shirt that leaves its green arms bare below the elbows, black trousers and white shoes.
identity_text: A zombie from the game, with blotchy green rotting skin and empty black eye holes, wearing a flat dark grey hat, a white shirt and black trousers.

face: big black eyes with white shine
head: rounded brown animal head
small ears
top: fluffy cream collar around the neck

appearance_text: A small brown furry creature standing on two legs, with a rounded head, big black eyes with white shine and a tiny black nose and mouth. A fluffy cream collar puffs out around its neck and chest. The rest of its body, arms and legs are soft brown fur, and a bushy tail with a cream tip curls on its back.
identity_text: The brown, fox-like Pokemon species that stands on two legs, with a fluffy cream ruff puffing out around its neck and chest and a bushy cream-tipped tail on its back.

colors.item: bones on the chest and arm
colors.name: grey

face: brown beard on the other side
head: half skull
brown hair on the other half
top: grey bones showing through one side

appearance_text: A man split down the middle: one half of his head is normal with short brown hair, a brown beard and skin, while the other half is a bare white skull with a dark eye socket. He wears a cyan t-shirt, and on the skull side grey bones show through the shirt and down the arm. His trousers are blue-purple and his shoes are grey.
identity_text: A man split down the middle: one half ordinary with brown hair and a beard, the other half a bare white skull with bones showing through his shirt and arm.

top: teal hoodie with dark blue shoulders and sleeves

appearance_text: A smiling boy with short brown hair and brown eyes. He wears a teal hoodie with dark blue shoulders and sleeves, and a matching teal backpack sits squarely on his back. Dark blue jeans and red and white shoes finish the outfit.
identity_text: A smiling brown-haired boy in a teal hoodie with dark blue sleeves, carrying a green backpack, in dark jeans and red and white shoes.

head: short brown hair
top: red t-shirt with a white number one

appearance_text: A cheerful kid with short brown hair, big black eyes and a round orange nose. He wears a red t-shirt with a big white number one on the chest and a red backpack strapped over his shoulders and across his back. His shorts are dark grey and his white socks are pulled up above white shoes.
identity_text: The Villager, the townsfolk character of the Animal Crossing games, here a brown haired kid in a red number one t-shirt with a red backpack, grey shorts and white shoes.

appearance_text: A girl with short messy dark brown hair falling over her forehead and bright green eyes. She wears a soft cream jumper with long baggy sleeves, tucked over plain black trousers. Her boots are dark red and black.
identity_text: An unnamed teenager with short messy dark brown hair and green eyes, in a baggy cream jumper, ripped black jeans and dark red boots.

appearance_text: A small old woman with short white hair pulled back, big dark eyes, rosy pink cheeks and a little pink mouth. She wears a grey blue apron over a cream shirt with brown sleeves at the shoulders and a tiny green and white flower pinned at the neck. Her long brown skirt reaches down to dark brown shoes, and the apron straps cross over her back.
identity_text: Granny Bacon, the little white haired old woman from the Yogscast's Minecraft series, in a grey blue apron over a cream shirt with a long brown skirt.

accessories: brown wristbands with a blue gem
head: large bald head with a big nose

appearance_text: A brown-skinned figure with a very large flat nose, a thick dark unibrow and small green eyes on a bald head. Its chest and arms are bare and heavily muscled, banded with gold rings around the upper arms and brown wristbands set with a light blue gem. Around the waist is a gold belt holding a dark brown loincloth, and the legs are bare down to the feet.
identity_text: A Minecraft villager built like a bodybuilder, bare-chested with gold arm bands, a gold belt and a brown loincloth.

footwear: pink and purple striped leg warmers

appearance_text: A pale girl with very long dark purple hair reaching past her waist, with a bright pink streak running through it. She wears a purple top with darker panels and a short purple skirt, leaving her arms and thighs bare. Pink and purple striped leg warmers cover her lower legs above chunky grey boots.
identity_text: A girl with very long dark purple hair and a matching purple top and skirt. The title describes the colour scheme rather than naming anyone.

appearance_text: A pale girl with very long cream blonde hair that is tied into a braid running all the way down her back, with light blue bows in it. She has bright green eyes. She wears a soft light blue jacket with long sleeves over a darker band across the chest, and dark grey shorts. White socks come up her legs and end in chunky black boots.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with a long cream braid and light blue bows, wearing a light blue jacket, grey shorts and black boots.

footwear: green and white striped long socks
head: long mint green hair
black bow at the back of the head
top: white shirt under a pale green cardigan

appearance_text: A girl with very long pale mint green hair tied with a small black bow at the back. She wears a white shirt under a soft pale green cardigan and a dark grey pleated skirt. Long socks striped in green and white come up over her knees, above dark shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed schoolgirl with very long mint green hair, in a white shirt under a soft pale cardigan, a dark pleated skirt and striped over-knee socks.

colors.item: flowers on the top and sleeves
colors.name: white

hair: long wavy ginger hair down the back
hair tied with a bow at the top
top: pink summer top with puffy sleeves
small white flowers dotted over it

appearance_text: A girl with long wavy ginger hair that falls all the way down her back, tied with a little bow on top. She wears a pink summer top with puffy sleeves and a white frilly front, sprinkled with small white flowers on the chest and arms. Under it is a short brown skirt, and she has white socks pulled up to her knees with soft pink shoes. Her eyes are green.
identity_text: An unnamed ginger-haired girl in a pink summer top sprinkled with small white flowers, a short brown skirt and white knee socks.

head: bone white skull mask covering the whole head

appearance_text: A soldier wearing a bone white skull mask over his whole head, with black holes for eyes and painted teeth across the mouth. His body is covered in a brown army jacket with bright orange straps across the chest and orange bands around both arms. A big orange pack is strapped to his back, and he wears dark brown army trousers with knee pads and dark grey boots.
identity_text: Lieutenant Simon Riley from the Call of Duty games, wearing a full bone-white skull mask. His brown army gear is strapped with bright orange webbing, with a matching orange pack on his back and knee-padded trousers.

appearance_text: A green cube-headed creature with two black square eyes and a tiny square mouth, wearing battered grey plate armour over its chest and shoulders. An orange strap runs diagonally across the armour from shoulder to hip, and the same strap crosses the back. Its arms are gooey green above dark gloves, and it wears black armoured trousers with worn brown boots.
identity_text: A Minecraft slime kitted out for battle: the green cube head with its square slime face sits above worn grey plate armour, an orange shoulder strap and dark armoured trousers.

appearance_text: A boy with messy black hair hanging over his forehead and bright red eyes. He wears a chunky sweater striped in red and white, with a leaf-green scarf wrapped around his neck and hanging down the front. Blue jeans and red and white sneakers finish the outfit, and the stripes wrap all the way around his back.
identity_text: An unnamed boy in a chunky red and white striped sweater with a green scarf, blue jeans and red and white trainers.

appearance_text: A boy with short dark brown hair combed over his forehead. He wears a bright purple hoodie with white strings hanging down the front and the hood resting on his back. His jeans are black and his shoes are white.
identity_text: A boy with short dark brown hair in a bright purple hoodie with white drawstrings, black jeans and white shoes. The title names the colour of the hoodie, not a character.

appearance_text: A pale girl with long brown hair that has bright pink streaks and a pink fringe, and big light green eyes. She wears a mint green jacket over a cream shirt with a cream skirt covered in a small checkered pattern. Her socks are striped in pink and cream and she has dark brown shoes. Her long hair hangs down her back with the pink showing through.
identity_text: An unnamed girl styled after ice cream, with neapolitan pink, cream and brown hair, a mint green jacket and a cream checkered outfit over striped socks. The title describes the theme rather than naming a character.

head: dark grey hair with white streaks at the sides

appearance_text: A man with dark grey hair swept back, white streaks above each ear and a neat dark goatee around his mouth. He wears layered dark blue robes tied with a wide brown belt at the waist. A long red cloak hangs from his shoulders and covers the whole of his back and the outside of his arms, and his boots are dark blue.
identity_text: Doctor Strange, the Marvel sorcerer, in dark blue robes with a wide brown belt and the long red cloak hanging from his shoulders.

appearance_text: A boy with short brown hair and brown eyes in a bright yellow hoodie with the hood down behind him. The sleeves end in white cuffs, and light blue jeans run down to red and white trainers. The back of the hoodie is the same plain yellow.
identity_text: An unnamed teenage boy in a bright yellow hoodie with the hood down, light blue jeans and red and white trainers.

head: round white mask
blond hair at the back and sides

appearance_text: A figure whose face is hidden by a round white mask with two black dot eyes and a wide black smile, with short blond hair showing around the sides and back. The body wears a bright green hooded jacket with dark grey sleeves and a hood hanging down the back. Black trousers with green cuffs cover the legs, and the feet are in white trainers with green stripes.
identity_text: Dream, the Minecraft YouTuber, in his white smiley mask, here with blond hair and a bright green hooded jacket with dark grey sleeves.

hair: flat black hair cut straight across the forehead

appearance_text: A big green-skinned creature with a tall flat-topped head and black hair cut straight across a heavy brow. Its face is glum, with small dark eyes and a wide mouth. It wears a battered brown jacket hanging open over a bare chest, dark grey trousers and heavy dark boots.
identity_text: Frankenstein, the creature from Mary Shelley's novel, green-skinned with a flat-topped head and a ragged brown jacket.

head: light blond hair

appearance_text: A boy with messy light blond hair and bright blue eyes. He wears a black jacket open over a bright orange hoodie, with orange bands at the cuffs and a blue stripe around each upper arm. The back of the jacket is dark grey and black with an orange collar, and dark grey trousers run down to dark shoes with orange edges.
identity_text: Spark, the leader of Team Instinct in Pokemon Go, a blond boy in a black jacket over an orange hoodie.

appearance_text: A figure that looks carved out of a single green gemstone, shaded in light and dark green all over. The shape of short hair, a squared beard and moustache shows on the head, and the outline of a shirt, sleeves, trousers and shoes shows on the body, all in the same green.
identity_text: Minecraft's default character Steve, rendered as though carved out of solid emerald. Hair, beard, shirt, trousers and shoes are all present only as shading in the same green stone.

appearance_text: A friendly looking man with short brown hair, purple eyes and no beard. He wears a light blue short-sleeved t-shirt with bare tan arms and dark blue trousers. The trousers run all the way down to matching dark blue shoes, and the shirt is plain blue across the back.
identity_text: A redrawn version of Steve, the default Minecraft player character, in his usual light blue t-shirt and dark blue trousers.

identity_text: An unnamed girl in a white long sleeved shirt under a dark grey pinafore dress, with pink bands above tall black boots.

appearance_text: A stocky man with dark brown curly hair, very thick black eyebrows and a bushy grey and black beard around a wide mouth. He wears a plain light blue short sleeved t-shirt with bare tan arms, and the shirt is the same plain blue all the way round the back. Below that he has blue jeans and dark brown shoes.
identity_text: Steve as played by Jack Black in the Minecraft movie: a stocky bearded man in a plain light blue t-shirt, blue jeans and brown shoes.

identity_text: A teenage girl in a red and white striped top under a black jacket, with light blue denim shorts, brown shoes and a small red bow on top of her head.

identity_text: An ordinary teenage boy in casual streetwear: an open red checked flannel over a grey hoodie, ripped jeans and white shoes. No character is depicted.

He wears a buttoned dark grey waistcoat with a dark tie over a cream shirt, so only the sleeves show pale on his arms. His trousers are dark grey with faint stripes and his shoes are black, and the back of the waistcoat is dark all over.
identity_text: An unnamed 1950s gangster in a wide brimmed dark fedora, a buttoned waistcoat and tie over a cream shirt.

top: carved cream chest with a raised pattern

appearance_text: A stiff little carved figure the colour of pale cream and tan, outlined all over in darker brown. Its square head has two bright green gem eyes and a flat blank face, with a pale beard shape hanging below. Its chest carries a raised swirl carving and its arms and legs are thin carved posts.
identity_text: A Totem of Undying, the small carved statue from Minecraft that saves a player from death when held, with bright green gem eyes and thin carved arms and legs.

identity_text: An unnamed girl in a punk-flavoured outfit: a soft pink jacket over a short white top, a belted denim skirt, black and white striped leggings and dark boots, with a black choker at her neck.

head: pink hood resting at the back

appearance_text: A person with messy brown hair falling over blue eyes, wearing a soft pink hoodie with two white drawstrings hanging at the chest and the hood pushed back behind the neck. The hoodie is plain pink all the way round. Below it are black trousers slashed with white rips down the legs, tucked into dark grey boots.
identity_text: An unnamed teenager with messy brown hair in a faded pink hoodie, black ripped trousers and dark grey boots. The title names the garment, not a character.

appearance_text: A man with a thick brown beard and moustache and bright blue eyes, wearing a flat green hat with a yellow band. His shirt is grey and white checked with long sleeves, and brown overalls with shoulder straps go over the top. He wears dark brown boots with white socks folded over them.
identity_text: A man dressed in a classic German lederhosen outfit: brown dungarees with shoulder straps over a grey and white checked shirt, topped with a flat green hat.

top: grey armour with silver chest plates

appearance_text: A bearded warrior with short orange blond hair and a matching beard. He wears grey armour with shiny silver plates on the chest and dark straps, and a long red cape hangs all the way down his back. Below that he has black trousers with grey patches and dark grey boots.
identity_text: Thor from The Avengers, shown as an orange-blond bearded warrior in dark plated armour with a long red cape.

appearance_text: A tough-looking man with shoulder-length brown hair and a black mask covering his nose and mouth, leaving only his eyes showing. He wears a dark leather combat outfit criss-crossed with straps and buckles, and his whole left arm is polished silver metal with a red star painted on the shoulder. Dark trousers and heavy brown boots complete the outfit.
identity_text: The Winter Soldier, the masked Marvel assassin: shoulder-length brown hair, a black face mask, strapped black combat leathers and a silver metal arm marked with a red star.

identity_text: A boy in everyday clothes — a baggy white hoodie, blue jeans and dark blue shoes — with short messy black hair. A white monster face with red eyes is printed across the back of the hoodie.

identity_text: A girl with long brown hair falling over her eyes, white daisies tucked into it, wearing a dark red sweater with a small white bow at the collar and grey checked trousers. The title is a label, not a character name.

Under the hoodie she wears short black shorts and long black socks, with white trainers on her feet.
identity_text: A girl with long brown hair swept to one side, wearing a baggy white hoodie with a little rainbow-maned unicorn printed on the front and an animal face on the back of the hood, over black shorts and long black socks.

identity_text: Rainbow Dash, the light blue pegasus pony from My Little Pony, with her rainbow striped mane and tail.

appearance_text: A tall square headed creature coloured dark navy blue all over, with the classic two square eyes and a wide frowning mouth glowing pale lavender. A small pale crescent moon is marked on its chest, with another faint curve on its back. Its arms and legs are the same deep blue with no clothing.
identity_text: A Creeper recoloured for a moonlight theme: deep navy from head to feet, with a pale lavender face and a crescent moon marked on its chest.

appearance_text: A pale person with short brown hair and a lighter fringe, with light blue eyes. They wear a grey t-shirt under an open blue checked flannel shirt that hangs down over the hips. Below are short black shorts with a white and black band and tall brown boots.
identity_text: A casually dressed kid in an open blue checked flannel shirt over a grey t-shirt, with black shorts and tall tan boots. 'Rowan' reads as a bare given name, so no character is asserted.

appearance_text: This girl has very long dark purple hair that falls past her waist, with a bright pink streak running down the back and two small dark ears poking up on top. Her skin is pale and her eyes are big and purple. She wears an open dark purple jacket over a white and lavender crop top, a short grey skirt, black and white checked long socks and black shoes.
identity_text: A teenage wolf girl with small dark ears and very long purple hair streaked with pink, in an open purple jacket, grey skirt and checked long socks. 'Twilight Wolf' describes the look rather than naming a character.

appearance_text: A fierce girl with very long red hair that falls all the way down her back and dark eyes. She wears shining gold chest armour with matching gold plates over her shoulders and upper arms, leaving her middle bare. A short gold armoured skirt sits at her hips and gold guards wrap around her lower legs.
identity_text: An unnamed warrior girl in ornate golden armour, with very long red hair down her back and a short armoured skirt.

appearance_text: A pale boy with short dark brown hair falling over his forehead and bright green eyes. He wears a plain blue hoodie with long sleeves and no pattern on it. His trousers are black and he has pale light blue shoes.
identity_text: An ordinary boy in a plain oversized blue hoodie, black trousers and pale blue shoes. A generic example of its type.

appearance_text: A broad, muscular man in a bright red one-piece super suit. He has short blonde hair and wears a black mask across his eyes, showing blue eyes and a small smiling mouth. A yellow and black badge sits in the middle of his chest, a yellow belt goes around his waist, and he wears black gloves and tall black boots.
identity_text: Mr. Incredible from The Incredibles, a broad, muscular hero in a red super suit with a yellow chest badge, black eye mask, yellow belt and black boots.

appearance_text: A figure sealed head to toe in a bright yellow protective suit, streaked and smudged as if it has been through something. The head is covered by a black hood and a gas mask with two wide white lenses and a round breathing filter. Black gloves, a black belt and black boots with red trim finish the suit, and a big black number one is printed on the back.
identity_text: A figure sealed head to toe in a scorched yellow hazmat suit, with a black hooded gas mask, black gloves and heavy black boots.

She wears a crisp white uniform shirt with black tabs on the shoulders and a small badge on the chest, and a yellow tie hangs down the back. Her trousers are black and her boots are black too.

identity.franchise: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach

identity_text: Vanessa, the night security guard from Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach, in her white uniform shirt with shoulder tabs and badge, black cap, black trousers and boots.

appearance_text: A man with a very long black beard and teal eyes, wearing a round dark red hat pulled low on his head. He is dressed in a rich red robe with a wide purple collar and matching purple shoulder pieces, fastened at the chest with a small gold clasp. His sleeves are striped red and white, and patterned brown trousers run down into dark boots.
identity_text: A Byzantine merchant: a man with a very long black beard in a rich red robe with a wide purple collar, red and white striped sleeves and a round dark red cap.

They wear a cream shirt with a tall green pine tree printed right across the chest and another on the back, while the sleeves are patterned in blocks of green. Their trousers carry the same green patchwork pattern, and they wear plain white shoes.
identity_text: A green-haired person in a cream shirt printed with a pine tree front and back, with matching green chequered sleeves and trousers.

head: dark green peaked cap with a gold band and black brim

appearance_text: A man with short brown hair in a smart dark green uniform. He wears a matching peaked cap with a gold band and a black brim, and his jacket has gold buttons down the front, small coloured medal ribbons on the chest and a white shirt with a tie at the collar. Gold shoulder boards sit on both shoulders, and he has plain black trousers and black shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed army officer in a smart dark green dress uniform with gold buttons, gold shoulder boards, medal ribbons, a white shirt and tie, and a peaked cap.

appearance_text: A tall grey-brown creature with long thin arms and legs and no clothes at all. Its head has no eyes; instead the whole face splits open into red fleshy petals ringed with rows of pale pointed teeth, with a dark throat in the middle. The rough skin is mottled brown and grey all over the body.
identity_text: The Demogorgon, the predatory monster from the Upside Down in Stranger Things, with its head that opens into a ring of teeth and its long bare grey-brown limbs.

appearance_text: A young man with short dark brown hair and thick eyebrows. He wears a brown leather jacket with darker sleeves and a strap running diagonally across his chest and over his shoulder to his back, fastened with a small gold buckle. His trousers are dark grey and his boots are brown with lighter cuffs.
identity_text: A young dark-haired man kitted out as an explorer, in a brown leather jacket with a satchel strap slung across his chest, dark trousers and brown boots.

appearance_text: A grey rabbit standing on two legs with tall ears, huge purple eyes, a small pink nose and two white front teeth. She wears a smart blue police uniform shirt with a dark collar and a shiny gold badge on the chest, and a black vest panel is strapped across her back. Matching blue trousers run down to her feet, and her arms and legs keep the same blue uniform colour.
identity_text: Judy Hopps, the rabbit police officer from Zootopia, standing on two legs in her blue police uniform with a gold badge.

identity_text: An unnamed girl in a white checked hoodie, denim shorts and patterned thigh high socks.

appearance_text: A girl with long light brown hair that hangs past her shoulders, big dark eyes and pink blushing cheeks. She wears light blue denim overalls with straps over her shoulders and long pale blue sleeves underneath. Matching light blue jeans run down to plain white shoes.
identity_text: A girl dressed head to toe in pale blue - denim overalls over long light blue sleeves with matching jeans and plain white shoes.

appearance_text: A slender creature whose smooth green hair curves over its head like a helmet and hides part of its red eyes. Its body is a long white gown with a pink fin running down the middle of the chest, and its arms and shoulders are the same green as the hair. The legs are plain white and the back of the head is a solid green dome.
identity_text: Gardevoir, the Psychic and Fairy type Pokemon, a slender green and white creature in a gown-like body with helmet-shaped hair.

appearance_text: A tall figure covered head to toe in dark grey and black armour, with a closed helmet whose eye slits glow bright light blue. Layered plates cover the shoulders, chest and legs. A blue cape hangs down the whole length of the back.
identity_text: The armoured avatar of the Minecraft YouTuber PopularMMOs: full dark grey plate armour with a closed visor lit by blue eye slits and a long blue cape.

He wears a blue denim jacket over jeans, with a thick gold chain hanging at his neck and a red and green striped belt. A large gold patch covers the back of the jacket, and he has grey and white trainers.
identity_text: Lil Pump, the American rapper, with his multicoloured dreadlocks, thick gold chain and blue denim jacket over jeans.

identity_text: A blonde girl in a soft blue sweater with purple shorts and pink striped leggings. A pastel look rather than a named character.

identity_text: Taiga Aisaka from Toradora, an anime girl with extremely long light brown hair, a pink top and a short blue skirt.

identity_text: An unnamed crusader knight in Templar dress: a full helmet with only a viewing slit, a long dark red surcoat over armour, chainmail sleeves and heavy boots.

identity_text: A Creeper rendered entirely in snowy white with grey speckles, a winter version of the Minecraft mob.

identity_text: A girl with long wavy blonde hair wearing a soft white unicorn onesie. The hood is shaped like a unicorn's head with a pale horn and pink ears, and a bright rainbow mane runs down the back with a matching rainbow patch across her back.

identity_text: A lion dressed as a businessman, its maned tan head above a black suit and white tie, with a tail hanging down behind.

identity_text: An unnamed girl with very long pink hair and tall rabbit ears, in a white dress trimmed with pink, long white socks and pink shoes. The title describes the costume.

identity_text: An unnamed boy in a bright red Christmas jumper printed with a star-topped green tree, worn with black trousers and red shoes.

identity_text: A pale girl with light blue hair down past her waist, in a purple striped jacket, blue top and striped skirt. The listing calls her a cute girl from another galaxy without naming her.

appearance_text: A walking yellow pencil. The top of its head is a chunky pink rubber held on by a shiny silver band, and the yellow body is shaded orange down the sides like the flat faces of a pencil. A black number two is printed across its back. Its arms and legs are the same yellow, and each leg ends in a sharpened brown wooden tip.
identity_text: A walking yellow number 2 pencil with a pink eraser for a head, a silver band below it and sharpened wooden tips for feet.

A tiny black top hat perches on its head and a black bow tie sits under its chin. Its chest and belly are lighter tan, and dark seam lines run around its shoulders, arms and legs where the joints are.

identity_text: The Joker in the red suit and clown make-up of the 2019 film, with green hair, a white painted face and a wide red smile.

A glowing light blue skull sits in the middle of the chest and again on the back. The trousers are black with the same faint purple clouds, and the shoes are white with purple laces.
identity_text: A pale kid with fluffy light blue hair in a black hoodie swirled like the night sky, with a glowing blue skull printed front and back. The title describes the hoodie rather than naming anyone.

The body of the suit is green with a grey green belly panel, and a bumpy dark green ridge runs all the way down the back.

Red trousers and cream shoes finish the outfit.
identity_text: A child zipped into a red dragon onesie, with the dragon head pulled up as a hood over their own face and a curled tail on the back. The dragon is the costume, not the wearer.

appearance_text: A brown bear standing on two legs with small round ears, a cream muzzle, a black nose and an open mouth. identity_text: A brown bear standing upright in old-fashioned clothes, a dark red waistcoat with gold buttons over a white shirt.

appearance_text: A figure with a bright red face covered in bold black markings, glowing yellow eyes, and a ring of short pale horns around the top of the head. The body is wrapped in plain black robes with long sleeves and a hood hanging behind. The trousers and boots are black as well.

identity_text: An unnamed very pale figure with fluffy white hair and big dark eyes, bundled into a thick white fur coat over light blue jeans.

identity_text: Crash Bandicoot, the orange marsupial hero of the game series, grinning wide with big green eyes, a bare chest, blue jeans and red shoes.

It wears a red coat with a black band across the middle and white feathers showing at the chest and back, and its bare orange legs and webbed feet stick out below.
identity_text: Scrooge McDuck, the wealthy old duck from the DuckTales cartoon, in his red coat, blue spectacles and tall black top hat.

appearance_text: An old man with short white hair, bushy white eyebrows and a thick white beard and moustache around an open mouth. He wears a long grey suit jacket buttoned down the front over a white shirt collar and a bright red tie. His trousers are the same grey with pale skin showing at the wrists. The back of the coat is plain grey with soft shading.
identity_text: Hades, the underworld king of the Broadway musical Hadestown, shown as a white-bearded old man in a long grey suit with a red tie.

identity_text: An unnamed girl with bright blue hair in a blue and white sleeveless top carrying a round emblem, a short white skirt and tall blue and white boots.

appearance_text: A grim figure with grey drowned skin, a bald head and glowing teal eyes. An enormous grin of white teeth over red gums stretches right across the lower half of the face and round the sides. The body wears a torn grey green shirt with a pale fur collar, heavy dark studded gauntlets on both arms, and ragged brown trousers tucked into dark boots.
identity_text: Pyke, the drowned undead assassin from League of Legends, with his huge tooth-filled grin, glowing eyes and torn sailor's clothes.

Little white claws tip its hands and feet, and a long orange tail with a burning flame at the end is drawn on its back.
identity_text: Charmander, the small orange fire lizard species from Pokémon, with a cream belly and its burning tail drawn across its back.

identity_text: Mario in his fire power-up colours: a white cap and white long-sleeved shirt under red dungarees, with his big brown moustache and brown boots.

identity_text: A Minecraft pig dressed up as a gentleman: a bright pink pig head with little ears and a snout, wearing big black sunglasses above a black tuxedo with a white shirt, white tie and a red flower in the lapel.

identity_text: Fumblemore, the doddery old wizard from the Yogscast's Minecraft series on YouTube, in a star-covered blue robe with gold trim and a long white beard.

identity_text: An unnamed shadowy figure in a black suit and white tie, greyscale from head to toe, with shaggy grey hair covering where its face should be. The title describes the look rather than naming anyone.

identity_text: SeaNanners, the online handle of the YouTuber Adam Montoya, shown as a bearded man in a black shirt carrying the M of Machinima.

identity_text: Plastic Man, the red-suited DC Comics superhero, in his usual red bodysuit with a deep V front, black white-rimmed goggles across the eyes and a gold belt at the waist.

identity_text: A pale girl in a long midnight blue strapless gown with her black hair streaked bright light blue. 'Aura' is a mood word for the look, not a character name.

identity_text: Minecraft's Steve rendered as a solid iron figure, plain pale metal all over with only faint darker marks where the eyes and mouth would be.

identity_text: A riot officer in full tactical gear, faceless behind a visored helmet and a black gas mask, with a bulky armoured vest, knee-padded trousers and a utility belt. No particular character is named.

identity_text: Marty Mcfly, named in the title as the main character of Back To The Future, in his puffy orange-red body warmer under a light blue denim jacket, with blue jeans and white sneakers.
