appearance_text: A grinning figure with a chalk white painted face, dark sunken eyes and a wide smeared red smile stretching across his cheeks, topped with messy dark green hair. He wears a long purple suit jacket over a gold waistcoat and white shirt with a small blue bow at the collar, and white cuffs at the wrists. The purple carries all the way across the back and down the striped trousers to dark purple shoes.
identity_text: The Joker, Batman's archenemy, with a chalk white painted face, wide red grin, green hair and a purple pinstripe suit over a gold waistcoat.

face: grey mask with dark eye holes
head: red hood pulled over the head
top: dark grey jacket under a red cloak

appearance_text: This figure wears a deep red hood pulled right over the head, with a plain grey mask and two dark eye holes where the face should be. A red cloak hangs from the shoulders down the back over a dark grey jacket with padded shoulders. A small yellow pouch is tucked at the belt, and the brown trousers end in grey boots.
identity_text: A secretive medieval trader from far-off lands, hooded and cloaked in deep red with a blank grey mask hiding the face, over a dark grey padded jacket, brown trousers and grey boots.

head: gold crown with small gold studs
top: black shoulder cape with red bows

appearance_text: A girl with very long dark brown hair and a thick fringe covering her eyes, wearing a gold crown with small studs around it. Her cheeks are pink on pale skin. She wears a short red dress with a gold necklace and a black cape over her shoulders with red bows tied at each side, and the cape hangs down her back over the red dress. Her legs are bare above tall black boots banded with red and tipped in white.
identity_text: A girl in a red dress, gold crown and black gold-trimmed shoulder cape, dressed after Minecraft's migrator cape. The title names the theme rather than a character.

bottom: white armoured shorts with red trim

colors.item: trim on the hips and arms
colors.name: red

hair: dark brown hair with a fringe

appearance_text: A boy with dark brown hair and blue eyes wearing a suit of white armour. Big white shoulder pads sit above a light grey chest plate, and matching guards cover his forearms with red bands at the edges. White armoured shorts with red trim leave his legs bare and he stands barefoot.
identity_text: A dark haired boy just out of bed, in a loose white sleep shirt and white shorts printed with little red hearts, standing barefoot. The title names the moment rather than a character.

head: grey helmet with a dark visor band

appearance_text: A short, stocky man with a huge bushy red beard that covers most of his face, topped by a grey helmet with a dark band across the eyes. He wears a black sleeveless top with a large grey letter S on the chest, showing off thick bare arms. Dark grey trousers are held up by a belt studded with red, and his boots are the same dark grey.
identity_text: A superhero version of Honeydew, the short red-bearded character, wearing a grey helmet and a black sleeveless top marked with a grey S.

appearance_text: A brown skinned boy with thick curly black hair that puffs out around his head and pale eyes. He wears a plain black t-shirt with short sleeves and small gold bracelets on both wrists. His shorts are white and loose, leaving his legs bare down to white socks worn inside purple sandals.
identity_text: A brown skinned boy dressed for hot weather in a plain black t-shirt and loose white shorts, with a thin gold chain, gold bands on both wrists, and purple sandals worn over white socks. His black hair is thick and curly.

top: brown leather armour over a dark red tunic

appearance_text: A broad, stern man with dark red hair and a thick red beard covering most of his face, and pale green eyes. He wears brown leather armour with padded shoulders, a strap running across the chest and a pouch hanging at the belt. His trousers are dark grey and his boots are scuffed brown leather.
identity_text: A broad, stern dwarven mercenary with dark red hair and a thick red beard, wearing brown leather armour with padded shoulders over dark grey trousers and scuffed brown boots.

accessories: long blue scarf trailing down the back
bottom: dark grey trousers with white bands
head: flying goggles pushed up on the forehead

appearance_text: A young pilot with dark brown hair and a pair of grey flying goggles on a blue strap pushed up onto the forehead. A long blue scarf is wrapped at the neck and streams down the back over a pale green flight jacket with a dark shirt underneath. Dark grey trousers with white bands at the knee tuck into navy blue boots.
identity_text: A young airman with flying goggles pushed up on his forehead and a long blue scarf streaming down his back over a pale green flight jacket. No particular pilot is identified.

head: round curly hairstyle
top: light blue button-up shirt with rolled sleeves

appearance_text: A smiling man with a big round mass of curly brown hair and a full brown beard and moustache. He wears a light blue button-up shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, tucked into blue jeans with a brown belt. His shoes are brown and the back of his hair is just as curly.
identity_text: Bob Ross, the American painter and television presenter named in the listing, with his big curly hair, full beard and rolled-sleeve blue shirt.

head: green frog hat with round eyes

appearance_text: A pale kid with long white hair that hangs all the way down the back, wearing a green frog hat with dark round eyes on top. Under grey blue dungarees with white buttons is a plain white shirt with short sleeves. The shoes are white and the cheeks are pink.
identity_text: A kid with very long white hair wearing a green frog hat and grey-blue frog-print dungarees over a white shirt.

head: tan animal head
two small ears on top
top: dark red jacket over a dark blue shirt

appearance_text: A gentle animal character with a light tan head, two small ears standing up and a cream muzzle under plain black eyes. It wears a dark red jacket over a dark blue shirt, with a round brown pack on its back. Below is a green skirt, white leggings and dark brown hooves for feet.
identity_text: A small woodland-looking character in a rust red jacket and dark blue shirt, with a green skirt, white leggings and a round brown pack on the back. The listing calls her a girl with hair buns; the render reads equally as a fawn-like animal girl.

appearance_text: A pale woman with short red-orange hair swept back and bright green eyes. She wears a sleeveless dark green tunic over a yellow top, leaving her arms bare, with a green cloak falling down her back. Green leggings and dark green boots complete the woodland outfit.
identity_text: Windranger, the archer hero from Dota 2, in her sleeveless green ranger tunic with bare arms, green leggings and dark green boots.

appearance_text: A boy with messy black hair and round black glasses, with bright blue eyes behind them and a small red lightning bolt scar on his forehead. He wears a long black school robe that hangs open over a grey jumper and a white shirt collar, with a red and gold striped tie down the front. His trousers are grey and his shoes are black. The robe is plain black across the back.
identity_text: Harry Potter, the boy wizard from the books and films, in his wizarding school uniform. The black robe hangs open over a grey jumper and a red and gold striped tie, and he has the round glasses and the lightning scar.

head: pug dog head with folded ears
top: black tuxedo jacket over a white shirt

appearance_text: A character with the head of a cream-coloured pug, with a squashed wrinkly dark grey muzzle, folded ears and small dark eyes. It wears a smart black tuxedo jacket over a white shirt, with a small blue pin on the lapel. Its cream paws show at the cuffs and it wears black trousers and black shoes.
identity_text: A pug dog standing upright in a smart black tuxedo and white shirt, with a small blue badge pinned to the lapel.

bottom: blue jeans rolled up at the ankles
top: pink t-shirt with a yellow star

appearance_text: A cheerful boy with a big mop of curly dark brown hair and dark eyes. He wears a pink t-shirt with a bright yellow star in the middle of the chest, leaving his tan arms bare. His blue jeans are rolled up at the ankles above pink sandals, and the shirt is plain pink across the back.
identity_text: Steven Universe, the boy hero of the cartoon series of the same name. He is drawn in his signature pink star t-shirt with rolled-up jeans and sandals.

colors.item: bands on the arms and legs
colors.name: pink

hair: fluffy white hair with lavender streaks
head: pointed ears
fluffy white and lavender hair

appearance_text: A small pale girl with fluffy white hair streaked with lavender and two pointed brown ears sticking out from the sides of her head. Her eyes are big and orange and her cheeks are pink. She wears a little pink wrap top with a white sash hanging down the front and a short matching wrap below, leaving her shoulders, middle and legs bare. Pink bands are tied around her upper arms and her calves.
identity_text: A small pale girl dressed in a fairy outfit of pink wraps, bands and a white sash, with fluffy white and lavender hair and pointed brown ears. No wings are shown.

bottom: dark mottled legs with pink patches
head: pink head with a dark crust on top
green mould running down the face
top: dark grey green crust over the chest and shoulders
pink flesh showing through the gaps

appearance_text: A hunched creature with bare pink skin that is being swallowed by dark green mould. A hard grey green crust covers its head, shoulders and chest, cracking open in places to show the pink flesh underneath. The rot runs down its arms and legs and covers its whole back in patchy green and black.
identity_text: A rotting pink-fleshed creature described in the listing as a cross between two Minecraft undead mobs, its body armoured in dark crust and streaked with green mould.

hair: black bob with a straight fringe
head: short black bobbed hair
two little pigtails

appearance_text: A stiff faced little girl doll with a black bob, a straight fringe and two short pigtails tied at the sides. Her cheeks are round and pink and her mouth is a tiny open circle. She wears a bright orange pinafore dress over a yellow short sleeved shirt. Long white socks come up to her knees above small black shoes.
identity_text: The giant doll that runs the red light, green light game in Squid Game, in her orange pinafore dress, yellow shirt and white knee socks.

head: green hat with a wide brim
gold buckle on the hat band

appearance_text: A short bearded fellow dressed in green from hat to trousers. His wide brimmed green hat has a gold buckle on the band, and orange hair and a bushy grey beard stick out around his pink cheeked face. His green coat has gold buttons and a big gold buckle on the belt, and he wears dark brown boots.
identity_text: A short bearded fellow dressed head to toe in green, with a wide-brimmed hat and a belt both fastened by big gold buckles and orange hair sticking out around his face. The listing calls him a fairy from Irish folklore.

hair: dark brown hair with a blonde streak
head: hood with two round animal ears
top: dark brown hoodie with gold buttons

appearance_text: A girl in a big dark brown hoodie with two round animal ears standing up on the hood. Gold buttons run down the front and a blonde streak shows in her dark brown hair at the back. Her legs are bare above long brown socks and white shoes.
identity_text: A girl in a big dark brown hoodie with round animal ears on the hood and small gold accents, over bare legs with long brown socks. The listing frames the bee theme as something she likes rather than what she is.

bottom: green robe falling to the feet
head: spiked crown around the head
top: long green robe with deep folds

appearance_text: A tall figure that looks carved from pale green weathered copper from head to toe. A crown with pointed spikes circles the head above a calm blank face. A long robe with deep folds wraps around the body and falls all the way to the feet, with the folds carved down the back as well.
identity_text: The Statue of Liberty, rendered as a figure of weathered pale green copper with a spiked crown and a long folded robe.

head: white hood up
small round ears on the hood

appearance_text: A boy with soft brown hair falling over sleepy half-closed eyes, with a white hood pulled up over his head that has two little round ears on top. The white hoodie is puffy at the sleeves and has a small grey picture in the middle of the chest. He wears dark brown shorts and white shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed tired-looking boy bundled into a puffy white hoodie with round bear ears on the hood, worn with dark brown shorts and white shoes.

head: rounded purple head
motifs: glowing teal circle on the chest
ring of small teeth at the neck

appearance_text: A soft purple creature with one huge round eye set in a pale cream face. A ring of tiny pointed teeth sits under its chin, and a glowing teal circle shines in the middle of its chest with teal swirls spreading down the arms and legs. The back is smooth purple with a pale teal pattern running down the spine.
identity_text: A soft purple monster with one huge round eye in a pale cream face and a glowing teal circle on its chest. The title is a coined creature word with no referent outside this skin, so no name is asserted.

head: fluffy peach pink hair
top: red and black checked shirt worn open

appearance_text: A slim character with soft peach pink hair falling over grey eyes. They wear a red and black checked shirt hanging open over a plain dark grey shirt, with the checked sleeves reaching the wrists. Blue jeans and white shoes with red heels finish the outfit.
identity_text: A peach-pink-haired teenager in an open red-and-black checked flannel over a dark grey shirt, with blue jeans and white shoes.

face: teal face mask over the nose and mouth
head: teal surgical cap

appearance_text: A figure dressed head to toe in teal hospital scrubs, with a matching cap tied over the head and a mask pulled up over the nose and mouth so only tired eyes show. Dark red stains are splashed across the mask, chest and sleeves. White gloves cover both hands, and the trousers end in scuffed dark brown shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed hospital surgeon covered head to toe in teal scrubs, cap and mask, with dark red blood splashed across the mask, chest and sleeves.

appearance_text: A light skinned man with short brown hair, bushy eyebrows and a thick brown moustache. He wears a smart dark navy suit jacket over a white shirt with a blue tie. The matching navy trousers go down to dark shoes, and his hands show bare at the cuffs.
identity_text: Walt Disney, the American animator and film producer, in a dark navy suit with a white shirt and blue tie.

appearance_text: A boy with spiky brown hair sticking out at the sides and a small smirk. He wears a plain black t-shirt with short sleeves and a pale blue pendant hanging at the waist. His jeans are a purple blue with lighter patches, and his shoes are black.
identity_text: Gary Oak, the rival trainer from the Pokemon series, as a smirking teenager in a plain black t-shirt and purple blue jeans.

head: fin on top of the head
top: blue chest with a pale belly

appearance_text: A small round blue creature with a pale light blue belly that runs down its chest. It has big black eyes with white shines, a tiny mouth, bright orange fins sticking out of both cheeks, and a tall fin on top of its head. A pale fin also runs down the middle of its back, and its short arms and legs are the same blue as its body.
identity_text: Mudkip, the small blue water Pokemon, round-bodied with orange cheek fins, a tall head fin and big black eyes.

appearance_text: A pilot wearing a bright orange flight suit from neck to ankle, with a grey control box strapped across the chest and grey pads at the knees. The head is covered by a white helmet with a wide yellow band and small red squares on top, leaving only the mouth and chin showing. Grey boots finish the outfit and a plain white panel sits on the back of the helmet.
identity_text: The listing names this as a Rebel Pilot from Star Wars: a flier in a full orange flight suit with a chest control box and a white and yellow flight helmet that leaves only the mouth showing.

colors.item: crescent moons at the sides of the head
colors.name: white

head: navy patches with white moons at the sides

appearance_text: A girl with very long pale cream hair falling almost to her knees and big blue eyes. She wears a short navy blue jacket sprinkled with tiny white stars and matching navy shorts with more stars, leaving her arms and legs bare. On each side of her head sits a dark patch with a white crescent moon on it.
identity_text: A girl in a night-sky themed outfit: a navy jacket and matching shorts sprinkled with little white stars, with white crescent moons at the sides of her head and very long cream hair down her back.

face: brown beard patch under the mouth
head: short brown hair

appearance_text: A man with short brown hair cut in a straight fringe and purple eyes, with a patch of brown beard under his mouth. He wears a teal short sleeved t-shirt and blue jeans. His shoes are grey.
identity_text: Steve, the default Minecraft player character, in his teal short sleeved t-shirt, blue jeans and grey shoes.

head: gold helmet with a dark T shaped slit

appearance_text: A warrior sealed inside a full suit of armour, with a golden helmet whose only opening is a dark T shaped slit where the face should be. The chest and legs are dark green plates edged with swirling golden trim, and big gold plates cover both shoulders. A round white gem sits in the middle of the chest and the boots are gold as well, so the whole character shines.
identity_text: A warrior sealed inside a full suit of plate armour, dark green edged everywhere with swirling gold. Big gold shoulder plates, gold boots and a round white gem on the chest complete it, and the closed helmet shows only a T shaped slit.

appearance_text: A short round spaceman in a bright red suit, drawn with heavy black outlines. A wide light blue glass visor covers most of the front of the head, while the back of the head is plain red. The body is one rounded red piece with stubby arms and two short red legs.
identity_text: A small spacesuited figure from the game Among Us, its suit deep red and its helmet fronted by a wide pale blue visor.

appearance_text: A tall skeleton made of pale cream bones with nothing worn over them. The skull has two dark slanted sockets that make it look angry, and a dark line for a mouth. Ribs and a spine are drawn across the chest and again down the back, and the arms and legs are thin bones with dark shadows between them.
identity_text: Skeletron, the skeletal boss from the game Terraria, drawn here as a full-body cream-boned skeleton.

face: television screen instead of a face
head: boxy grey television for a head
screen with static stripes

appearance_text: Instead of a face this character has a boxy old grey television for a head, its screen filled with grey and white static stripes. The body wears a plain light grey hoodie with drawstrings at the neck and a big front pocket. Below that are dark grey joggers with black scuffs down the legs and clean white trainers.
identity_text: A figure with an old boxy television where its head should be, the screen filled with grey and white static. It wears a plain light grey hoodie, dark grey joggers and clean white trainers.

appearance_text: A boy with fluffy brown hair swept over his forehead and tan skin. He wears a plain dark red t-shirt with short sleeves and nothing printed on it, front or back. His shorts are black and reach the knee, and his shoes are white.
identity_text: A boy in a plain dark red t-shirt, black trousers and white trainers. The title describes clothing and names no one.

bottom: white trousers with a grey cross on the front
motifs: grey cross shape on the trousers
top: open red jacket over a bare chest

appearance_text: A performer with short blue hair and a face painted white, with black patches over the eyes, a big round red nose and a thick black moustache. He wears a bright red jacket hanging open over a bare chest, red across the sleeves and the whole back. White trousers marked with a grey cross on the front lead down to blue shoes.
identity_text: Jimmy T from Nintendo's WarioWare series, drawn here as a clown with blue hair, a white painted face and an open red jacket.

appearance_text: A boy whose whole head is a plain white block flecked with light grey, with no face at all. Around his neck is an orange collar. He wears a dark red t-shirt with white long sleeves, black trousers with dark red cuffs, and dark red shoes.
identity_text: A boy whose entire head is a blank white quartz block, dressed in Nether-coloured clothes: a dark red t-shirt with white sleeves, black trousers and dark red shoes. The proper noun names the block his head is made of, not a character.

head: flower crown of pink and purple flowers

appearance_text: A pale girl with long white hair and a thick crown of pink and purple flowers around her head. She wears very little: a small pink top and a short purple skirt with dangling strips. Her arms have pink cuffs at the wrists and she stands with bare feet.
identity_text: A pale, long white-haired girl standing barefoot in a small pink top and a short purple fringed skirt, wearing a thick crown of pink and purple flowers.

face: one green eye and one pink eye
head: pink flower tucked in the hair

appearance_text: A pale girl with long creamy blonde hair, one green eye and one pink eye. She wears a soft pink jacket over a white top, with a short mint green skirt. Pink shoes with green soles cover her feet, and a pink flower is tucked into the back of her hair.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in a pastel pink and mint green outfit themed after a watermelon, with long pale blonde hair.

head: brown hair
red headband with a white patch
top: white shirt with red shoulders and a red collar

appearance_text: A boy with brown hair held back by a red headband with a white patch on the front. His shirt is white down the body and sleeves with bright red blocks over the shoulders and collar, matching across the back. Black trousers run into red and white shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed sporty teenage boy in a white shirt with red shoulders, black trousers and red shoes, with a red headband pushed across his forehead.

appearance_text: A very pale girl with short white hair, small white animal ears on her head and a white bow tied at the back. Her eyes are soft purple and her cheeks are pink. She wears an all-white dress with puffy sleeves, long white socks that reach up her legs, and grey shoes.
identity_text: A very pale girl in an all-white pastel outfit with small animal ears and a bow. An aesthetic look, not a named character.

accessories: pale blue cape hanging down the back
bottom: long gown fading to deep blue at the hem
top: light blue gown with ice crystal shapes

appearance_text: A very pale girl with white blonde hair pulled into a thick braid over one shoulder and soft light blue eyes. Her long gown starts pale icy blue at the top, scattered with sparkling crystal shapes, and deepens to a strong blue at the hem. A sheer pale blue cape hangs from her shoulders all the way down her back.
identity_text: Elsa from Disney's Frozen, redrawn in a softer modern style. Her gown fades from icy pale blue scattered with crystal shapes down to a deep blue hem, with a sheer cape down her back.

head: mottled green and grey square head
top: mottled green chest with exposed white ribs

appearance_text: A tall green creature with a square head, two black square eyes and a wide black frowning mouth. One whole side of it has rotted away to grey, and a set of pale white ribs shows through the middle of its chest. The rest of the body is patchy light and dark green all the way down its four thin limbs, which end in black feet.
identity_text: A creeper gone undead: mottled light and dark green with one entire side rotted grey, and pale ribs showing through its chest.

colors.item: round coconut shape on the top
colors.name: white

top: white round coconut shape on the chest
light blue strap over one shoulder

appearance_text: A girl with long wavy brown hair and big pale blue eyes above pink cheeks. She wears a short cream top with a round white coconut shape on the chest and a light blue strap crossing one shoulder, leaving her tummy bare. Below that are very short dark brown shorts and dark brown socks pulled up over her lower legs, with her thighs bare in between.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in a tropical summer outfit themed on a coconut, with a cream crop top, one pale blue shoulder strap and long brown socks.

head: blue hood with a white fluffy trim

appearance_text: A young climber bundled in a bright blue winter parka with a round hood trimmed in white fluff around the face. Brown hair pokes out at the front and dark eyes look out from the hood. A white belt crosses the waist, the trousers are the same blue, and the boots are brown with white tops.
identity_text: Popo, the parka-bundled hero of the Ice Climber games, in his blue hooded coat with white fur trim, white belt and brown boots.

hair: very long dark brown hair down the back
head: two small cream horns
long dark brown hair

appearance_text: A girl with brown skin and very long dark brown hair that falls all the way down her back, with two small cream horns poking out of the top of her head. She wears a white cow print top and matching shorts, both splashed with black patches, leaving her middle and legs bare. A black band sits around one thigh and her shoes are white.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with brown skin and very long dark brown hair, wearing a cow print crop top and shorts with two small cream horns poking through her hair.

accessories: gold star badge on the sleeve
head: short brown hair

appearance_text: A grown man with short brown hair, blue eyes and a thick brown beard. He wears a buttoned tan shirt with chest pockets and a small gold star badge on the sleeve. Dark brown trousers held by a black belt run down to matching brown boots.
identity_text: Rick Grimes, the sheriff's deputy from The Walking Dead. He has short brown hair and a thick brown beard, and wears his tan uniform shirt with a gold star badge over dark brown trousers and boots.

hair: long brown hair down to the shoulders
motifs: diagonal sash across the chest and back
subjects: bearded man in a white robe
top: long white robe with a blue sash running diagonally across it

appearance_text: A tan skinned man with long brown hair parted in the middle and a full brown beard and moustache. He wears a simple long white robe with a bright blue sash running diagonally across the chest and continuing over the back. His arms are bare below the shoulders and brown sandals cover his feet.
identity_text: Jesus of Nazareth, shown as a tan-skinned man with long brown hair and a full beard, wearing a white robe with a blue sash and sandals.

head: dark blue full face mask
pointed ear shapes
top: dark blue suit with a red spider on the chest

appearance_text: A hero in a dark navy body suit with a full face mask. A large red spider shape spreads across the mask, with black eye slits, and pointed shapes stick up from the sides of the head. Red spider legs curl over the chest and red dashes run down the outside of both arms. The legs, boots and the whole back are plain dark blue.
identity_text: Spiderman 2099, the future Marvel spider hero, in a dark navy suit with a big red spider across the mask and chest.

head: full face mask split black and red
white eye shapes
top: pointed yellow and red badge on the chest

appearance_text: A masked hero whose whole costume is split down the middle into two different halves. The left of the mask is black with a pale eye shape, while the right is bright red with a white eye. A blue chest carries a pointed yellow and red badge, the sleeves are patterned in green and dark blue, and one leg is green while the other is purple, both ending in bright yellow boots.
identity_text: One figure stitched together from several different comic-book hero costumes, with a half-black half-red mask, a pointed badge on a blue chest and mismatched green and purple legs. It is a mashup rather than any single hero.

head: dark brown hair over the eyes
top: sunset picture printed on the chest

appearance_text: A boy with shaggy dark brown hair that falls right over his eyes and tanned skin. His cream t-shirt has a big square picture printed on the chest showing a blue sky above an orange sunset with a dark shape in front of it. He wears loose grey-blue shorts with yellow socks and white shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed boy with a shaggy fringe over his eyes, in a cream t-shirt printed with a sunset scene and loose grey-blue shorts.

head: tall blue rabbit ears
white face plate
top: light blue plastic chest with a white belly panel

appearance_text: A shiny light blue robot rabbit with tall ears and a white face plate. It has bright green eyes, round red circles on its cheeks, a small black nose and a white muzzle with square teeth, plus a red bow tie under its chin. Its chest has a big white oval belly panel, and its arms and legs are blue with visible joint seams all the way round.
identity_text: Toy Bonnie, the shiny light blue animatronic rabbit from Five Nights at Freddy's.

appearance_text: A grown man with wavy brown hair down to his shoulders, a brown moustache and a small beard on his chin, and pale blue eyes. He wears a loose white shirt with the sleeves reaching past the elbows. His jeans are light blue and his shoes are black with white soles.
identity_text: Post Malone, the American rapper, in the loose white shirt and light blue jeans from his Congratulations video.

appearance_text: A cheetah standing on two legs, its orange fur covered in black spots from head to toe. It has a yellow muzzle with a huge white grin and wears wide black sunglasses across its eyes. Its belly is white and its paws are white too, and more black spots run down its arms, back and legs.
identity_text: Chester Cheetah, the spotted orange cheetah mascot of the Cheetos snack brand, standing on two legs in his wide black sunglasses.

head: green squishy head
blue metal patch over one eye

appearance_text: A green squishy-headed creature with two dark green square eyes and a small dark green mouth, one eye covered by a bright blue metal plate. Its chest and shoulders are wrapped in blue-grey metal armour, while its arms stay green. Dark brown trousers and grey boots cover its legs, and the metal plating carries on across its back.
identity_text: A green slime mob rebuilt as a cyborg: a squishy green head with the usual dark green eyes and mouth, one eye hidden behind a blue metal plate. Its chest and shoulders are cased in blue-grey armour while its arms stay green.

hair: blonde hair in a side ponytail
subjects: girl in a red checked shirt
top: red checked shirt over a white top

appearance_text: A girl with long blonde hair gathered into a ponytail that falls over one shoulder, with bright blue eyes. She wears a red and dark checked shirt hanging open over a plain white top, with blue denim shorts. Her boots are grey brown and come up past her ankles, and her legs are bare between the shorts and the boots.
identity_text: A blonde girl with her hair gathered into a side ponytail, in an open red checked shirt over a white top, denim shorts and cuffed grey brown boots. The title only names the hairstyle.

appearance_text: A chunky panda standing upright, covered in black fur with a white head and a big white patch down its chest and belly. Its round ears are black, and it has thick black patches around its small brown eyes, a tiny black nose and a white muzzle. Its arms and legs are solid black, and the white belly patch shows on the back as a pale streak too.
identity_text: A panda standing upright on two legs, black-furred with a white face and belly, black patches round the eyes and a tiny black nose.

hair: brown moustache and beard around the mouth
head: brown hair

appearance_text: A cheerful grown man with short brown hair, thick eyebrows and a wide toothy smile framed by a brown moustache and beard. He is dressed up in a crisp white shirt with a light blue bow tie at his collar, plain white across the back. He wears dark blue trousers with light blue socks showing above brown shoes.
identity_text: A cheerful bearded man dressed up for a celebration in a crisp white shirt with a light blue bow tie, dark blue trousers and brown shoes.

bottom: red armoured legs with gold panels
head: gold helmet face plate
top: glowing white triangle in the middle

appearance_text: A hero encased head to toe in glossy red and gold armour. The helmet is gold with two narrow glowing white slits for eyes, and a bright white triangle of light shines in the middle of the chest. Gold panels cover the shoulders, hips and knees over the red plating, and the back is the same red and gold suit.
identity_text: Iron Man in his glossy red and gold powered armour, with a gold helmet, glowing eye slits and a lit chest reactor.

appearance_text: A hulking beast covered in shaggy dark blue-grey fur, with a wolf head, pointed ears and a black snout. Two glowing red eyes stare out and sharp white fangs show under the snout. Its arms and legs are thick with fur and end in white claws, and the fur runs shaggy all down its back.
identity_text: A werewolf, here the shaggy wolf-beast enemy from Terraria, covered in dark blue-grey fur with glowing red eyes, white fangs and white claws.

appearance_text: A boy with short brown hair and big light blue eyes. He wears an open black jacket over a white hoodie with the hood resting down at the back. His trousers are black and his shoes are white.
identity_text: An unnamed teenage boy in an open black jacket over a white hoodie, with black trousers and white shoes.

appearance_text: A girl with long brown hair pulled into a braid that runs all the way down her back, tied at the top with a big pink bow, and bright light blue eyes. She wears a short red jacket with rolled sleeves over a long pink dress that reaches her ankles. Her boots are dark brown and the red jacket sits over the pink dress at the back too.
identity_text: Aerith Gainsborough from Final Fantasy VII, in her ankle-length pink dress and short red jacket, her brown hair braided all the way down her back under a pink bow.

appearance_text: A flyer wearing a brown leather cap with big goggles over the eyes that have pale blue lenses. Long white tentacle-like strands hang down from under the face onto the chest and back. Over the body is a brown leather jacket with a row of orange buttons, dark blue trousers and dark brown boots with orange flames licking up them.
identity_text: A pilot in a brown leather flying jacket, cap and goggles, with white ghast tentacles hanging from under the face. The title describes what the skin is themed after rather than naming a character.

appearance_text: A pale figure whose messy black hair hangs right over the eyes, with the lower face hidden behind a pale blue wrap. The white jacket is torn and smeared with brown stains, worn open over a light blue shirt. The dark trousers are ripped at the knees with more brown marks, and the boots are grey.
identity_text: An unnamed survivor with very pale frostbitten skin, the lower face wrapped in a pale blue cloth and dark hair hanging over the eyes. The torn, stained white jacket and ripped trousers place him as a wanderer rather than any particular character.

Below it are white sleeves and a red shirt that has a small mustached face printed across the chest, with the back of that little head showing brown hair from behind. The legs are blue overalls with two yellow buttons, ending in short brown shoes.
identity_text: The Minecraft YouTuber SethBling, drawn in his red-shirt-and-blue-overalls plumber outfit with a Minecraft block where his head should be.

appearance_text: A man with short brown hair wearing a plain black suit. Under the jacket is a white shirt with a dark tie running down the middle. The trousers and shoes are black, and the back of the outfit is all black too.
identity_text: Mr. Orange from the film Reservoir Dogs, a brown-haired man in the crew's plain black suit, white shirt and black tie.

identity_text: An unnamed girl with short dark purple hair and green leaves tucked into it, wearing a long flowing pale purple dress and going barefoot.

appearance_text: A grim figure in a long black coat with gold buttons and a wide collar, topped by a black peaked cap. His face is pale and bony with a bristly grey moustache. From the waist down his legs blaze orange, streaked with dark jagged marks like a fire burning where his legs should be, ending in dark brown boots.
identity_text: A grim figure in a long black military-style coat and peaked cap, with one leg replaced by a glowing carved pumpkin lit from inside like a jack-o'-lantern.

appearance_text: A boy with black hair and a gold band tied across his forehead. He wears an open dark brown jacket over a plain white shirt, with curling gold flame shapes painted on one sleeve and again across the back. His trousers are black and his shoes are white with dark cuffs above them.
identity_text: A boy with black hair and a gold band tied across his forehead, wearing an open dark brown jacket painted with curling gold flames over a plain white shirt.

appearance_text: A pale girl with long pink hair streaked with deeper pink, falling in layers around her face, and olive green eyes. She wears a cream top with puffy sleeves under an olive green vest, gathered at the waist by a dark purple band. Her legs are covered in olive green and cream striped socks and she wears soft pink shoes. A pale green patch runs down the back of her outfit.
identity_text: A pale girl with very long pink hair and an olive-green and cream outfit gathered at the waist by a dark band. The title is a made-up personal name and nothing identifies her as an existing character.

appearance_text: A boy with short messy brown hair and blank glowing white eyes with no pupils. He wears a loose white long sleeve shirt with a thick red scarf bunched around his neck and hanging down his chest. His trousers are dark grey and he wears sturdy brown boots that come up over his ankles.
identity_text: An unnamed boy with blank glowing white eyes, a loose white shirt, a heavy red scarf and brown boots, listed as a haunted survivor with no soul.

appearance_text: A pale green creature with a rounded head and two curved yellow feelers sticking up like antennae. Small brown eyes sit above yellow markings on its cheeks. A ring of pink flower petals circles its neck like a collar, and its green body is plain all over with slightly darker green shading down its back. Its little toes are cream coloured.
identity_text: Meganium, the grass-type starter Pokemon from the Johto region: a pale green creature with a ring of pink petals around its neck and two curved yellow antennae on its head.

appearance_text: A bird standing on two legs with a fluffy white head, a big curved yellow beak and black eyes ringed in yellow. Its body and arms are covered in brown feathers, with a fringe of white feathers where the white head meets the brown shoulders. The legs end in bright orange feet with claws.
identity_text: An eagle standing upright: white-headed and brown-bodied with a hooked yellow beak and orange clawed feet, the bald eagle used as the national bird of America.

two short dark horns

appearance_text: A shaggy white animal covered in thick fur with creamy patches through it. Its head is white with two short dark grey horns on top, floppy ears at the sides and a dark grey muzzle shaped like a T over its nose and mouth. Long tufts of fur hang down its chest and legs, and its hands and feet end in grey hooves.
identity_text: Minecraft's goat mob: a shaggy white animal with short dark horns, a T-shaped muzzle and grey hooves.

appearance_text: A slim girl with long dark brown hair that hangs over her shoulders and down her back, with a fringe falling across a very pale face. Her body is covered by a tight black suit with purple panels running down the chest and belly, shaped like armour plates. Her arms and legs are dark grey metal with lighter joints, ending in dark boots.
identity_text: Alita from the film Alita: Battle Angel, shown as a pale, long-haired girl in a black bodysuit with purple armour panels.

appearance_text: A small person whose head is a big white mushroom cap with a bright red patch on top, and a plain face with tiny black eyes underneath. He wears a yellow sleeveless vest with blue straps running over the shoulders to a blue pack on his back. His arms are bare, his trousers are white and his shoes are dark brown.
identity_text: Toad, the mushroom-headed helper of the Mushroom Kingdom from the Super Mario Bros. games, with a white cap marked in red, braces over a pale top and a blue pack on his back.

top: yellow basketball jersey with the number 24

appearance_text: A dark-skinned man with very short hair, dressed for basketball. He wears a sleeveless yellow jersey with a big white number 24 on the front and on the back, edged with purple at the shoulders and sides, leaving his arms bare. Purple shorts with a yellow stripe come to his knees, and he wears tall white socks inside black shoes.
identity_text: Kobe Bryant, the late American professional basketball player, in the yellow and purple Los Angeles Lakers kit with his number 24.

appearance_text: A boy with messy brown hair and blue eyes wearing a bright tie-dye hoodie that fades through red, orange, yellow, green and blue with black drawstrings at the neck. The whole back of the hoodie is one huge rainbow swirl. He wears black trousers with a thin white stripe down each side and plain black shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed boy in a rainbow tie-dye hoodie whose back is one big colour swirl, worn with black striped track trousers and black shoes.

head: shaved head with a thin dark mohawk strip
top: dark red vest hanging open over a bare chest

appearance_text: This man has a shaved head with a narrow strip of black hair down the middle, tan skin, dark eyes and a small tuft of beard on his chin. A dark red vest hangs open over his bare chest with a pale strap running across it, leaving his arms bare. His trousers are green camouflage and his boots are grey.
identity_text: Vaas Montenegro, the pirate villain from Far Cry 3, with his thin mohawk, open dark red vest over a bare chest and green camouflage trousers.

head: pale pink cat ears
top: white jacket over a light blue top

appearance_text: A very soft, pale character with long pinkish-white hair that reaches down to her legs and two small matching cat ears on her head. Her clothes are all faded pastels: a white jacket over a light blue top, with pale blue shorts below. Her legs are wrapped in cream and blue striped socks above light blue shoes.
identity_text: A very pale girl with floor-length pinkish-white hair and small matching cat ears, in a white jacket over a light blue top, pale blue shorts and cream and blue striped socks.

appearance_text: A stiff robot made entirely of polished gold metal plates, from its smooth round head down to its feet. Two big round white eyes stare out of its face above a flat metal mouth. Bundles of bright blue wires show through a gap at its waist, and dark seams mark the joints all over its arms, legs and back.
identity_text: C-3PO, the golden humanoid protocol droid from Star Wars, with big round white eyes, a flat metal mouth grille and blue wires showing at his waist.

hair: short black hair with a fringe
top: white sleeveless top with grey shoulders

appearance_text: A boy with short black hair and bright blue eyes wearing a white sleeveless top with grey shoulders, leaving his arms bare. Two brown straps cross his chest and hold a bright orange backpack with dark markings on his back. He wears blue jeans with a brown belt and simple brown shoes.
identity_text: A teenage free-runner in a sleeveless top with an orange backpack strapped across his chest, meant for parkour servers. The title names the activity, not a character.

appearance_text: A tan-skinned girl with very long brown hair falling past her shoulders and two small ears poking up on top of her head. She wears a baggy brown sweater with a little white heart on the chest and short brown shorts. Her legs are bare down to tall white boots that come up over her ankles.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in a baggy brown sweater marked with a small white heart, worn with brown shorts and white boots.

appearance_text: A tall figure in dark purple and grey plated armour with bulky shoulder plates flaring out at each side. The closed helmet has a single glowing purple slit where the eyes would be. Small purple lights glow on the upper arms and the armour plates continue in overlapping layers down the legs to heavy boots.
identity_text: An unnamed armoured figure in dark purple sci-fi plate with a closed helmet showing one glowing purple eye slit.

The robe is white and heavily trimmed with gold, with a dark purple panel running down the chest and gold plates capping the shoulders. A long white cape hangs down the whole back, and the robe reaches black boots with white tops.
identity_text: Invoker, the spellcaster hero from Dota 2, wearing an ornate white robe heavy with gold trim and a full-length white cape.

appearance_text: A bald man with a dark brown beard, thick eyebrows and bright cyan eyes. He wears a black suit jacket over a white shirt with a blue tie down the front. His trousers and shoes are black, and the back of the jacket is plain black.
identity_text: A bald, bearded grown man in formal business dress — a plain black suit over a white shirt with a dark blue tie down the front.

appearance_text: A tall figure wrapped in a long black robe with a deep hood that hides the face, leaving only two glowing light blue eyes. Gold plates sit on the shoulders and gold trim runs down the front, with glowing pale blue panels on the arms and chest. A long grey sword is strapped diagonally across the back and the boots have gold cuffs.
identity_text: A fighting monk in a long black hooded robe edged with gold, glowing cyan armour panels and a sword slung across his back, with only two glowing eyes showing under the hood. No specific character is named.

appearance_text: A tall red fox robot with a long snout full of sharp white teeth and a black eyepatch over one eye, the other glowing yellow. Its red fur is torn open across the chest and back, showing dark holes and the metal frame underneath. It wears baggy brown pirate trousers, and its lower legs and one arm are bare grey metal with visible joints.
identity_text: Foxy, the battered red pirate-fox animatronic from Five Nights at Freddy's, with an eyepatch, a mouthful of sharp teeth and exposed metal limbs.

appearance_text: A boy with short dark brown hair and pale skin, with plain dark eyes. His shirt is striped in bands of blue and white all the way round, with short sleeves leaving his arms bare. He wears dark blue jeans and grey shoes.
identity_text: Slamacow, a YouTube creator of Minecraft animations, shown as a dark-haired boy in a blue and white striped polo shirt and dark jeans.

appearance_text: A tall, thin, pitch black figure with two glowing bright pink eyes and no mouth at all. A ragged dark purple cloak is draped over its shoulders with the hood pulled up over its head, hanging down its back. Its long arms and legs are the same deep black, with worn grey wrappings around the lower legs.
identity_text: An Enderman — the tall, thin black Minecraft mob with glowing eyes — here wrapped in a ragged hooded cloak. Its eyes glow bright pink rather than the usual purple.

The black t-shirt has a burst of rainbow-coloured sound wave bars across the chest, and the arms are bare and tan. Black trousers and blue trainers finish the look.
identity_text: A DJ wearing oversized blue headphones whose band covers the eyes, in a black tee printed with rainbow sound-wave bars.

The body wears a smart black suit jacket over a white shirt with a red tie, and matching black trousers. Its hands and shoes are the same bright yellow as its head.
identity_text: The yellow laughing meme face — huge white eyes and a wide open mouth with the tongue out — worn as the whole head of a man in a smart black suit and red tie.

appearance_text: A big shaggy brown gorilla standing upright, covered in brown fur over its arms, legs and back. Its face is tan with a wide grinning muzzle, black eyes and heavy brows, and its hands and feet are bare tan. A red tie hangs on its chest with two yellow letters on it. Nothing else is worn.
identity_text: Donkey Kong, the big brown gorilla from the Donkey Kong video games, wearing his red initialled necktie and nothing else.

Its chest and stomach are lined with bright orange plates that look like burning coals, and a row of orange spikes runs all the way down its back. Streaks of red and orange fire climb up its arms and legs. Its feet end in dark claws.
identity_text: A black-scaled fire dragon with curved orange horns, coal-bright belly plates and flames running up its limbs. It is a generic fire dragon, not a particular named one.

identity_text: Minecraft's default player character Steve - brown hair with a straight fringe, teal short-sleeved shirt, blue jeans and grey shoes - redrawn at reduced resolution so the whole skin looks soft and blocky.

She wears a baggy brown sweater with short sleeves and pink shorts underneath. On the back of the sweater is a big brown monster face with two black eyes and a wide red mouth full of square white teeth. Her legs are bare down to tall dark brown boots.
identity_text: A pink-haired girl in a baggy brown sweater and pink shorts, the back of the sweater printed with a big brown monster face full of square white teeth. The listing says the sweater is based on a Japanese TV mascot; the girl herself is not a named character.

identity_text: A pastel candy-coloured girl with knee-length bubblegum pink hair, dressed in a light blue striped top and matching shorts with blue striped ankle socks. The title describes the sweet look rather than naming a character.

identity_text: Netherite, the Minecraft block personified as a tall figure in a full suit of near-black armour with a dark red cape and a helmet that hides the face.

appearance_text: A pale boy with short silver white hair falling over bright blue eyes, with a dark band shading across his face. A grey hood sits back over his hair. He wears a baggy dark navy blue hoodie with long sleeves, light grey jeans ripped at the knees and plain white shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed pale boy with short silver-white hair and a dark band shading his eyes, wearing a baggy dark navy puffer hoodie, ripped light grey jeans and plain white shoes.

identity_text: A brown-haired girl in a pink off-shoulder top, blue skirt, white socks and blue boots. 'Bright Blue' describes the colour of the outfit rather than naming anyone.

appearance_text: A round, heavy creature covered in dark blue-green fur with a big cream coloured belly and a cream face. Its eyes are closed in two long dark lines above a wide happy grin, and small pointed ears sit on top of the head. The arms and back are all dark teal, and each foot ends in three white claws.
identity_text: A big, round, sleepy creature with dark blue-green fur, a cream belly and face, eyes closed in a wide happy grin and three white claws on each foot — one of the best known Pokémon species.

Strips of dark grey cloth are wound around the arms and a grey belt crosses the waist, and the robe falls straight down over black legs and boots.
identity_text: A faceless figure wrapped head to foot in a long black hooded robe, with only darkness where a face should be. Dark grey cloth strips are wound round the arms and a grey belt crosses the waist.

appearance_text: A hero whose head is covered by a red helmet with big orange goggles across the eyes. The suit is cream down the chest and stomach with red shoulder pads, and the arms and legs are ringed with red and cream stripes. A brown belt with a grey buckle and small side pouches sits at the waist, above tall brown boots.
identity_text: Rex Splode, a superhero from the Invincible comics, in his goggled red helmet and red-and-cream striped costume.

appearance_text: A tall red and white striped box with popped corn heaped over the top, standing up on its own like a person. The fluffy pale yellow popcorn makes the head, which wears black sunglasses and grins with a pink tongue sticking out. The striped box runs all the way down and around the back with no arms or legs showing.
identity_text: A walking box of popcorn: a tall red and white striped carton with fluffy popped corn heaped over the top to form the head, wearing black sunglasses and grinning with its tongue out.

Long mint green socks come up her legs into short black boots, and a light blue bow is tied in her hair at the back.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with very long dark brown hair in an open salmon cardigan, mint top and white shorts, a pale blue bow tied at the back of her head.

identity_text: A boy in a backwards baseball cap and a navy striped t-shirt printed with a friendly white cartoon ghost. He wears long tan checked trousers, white socks and dark shoes.

appearance_text: A brown reindeer standing on two legs, with a big bright red nose in the middle of a white muzzle and small black eyes. Short dark antlers and pointed ears sit on top of its head. Its chest and belly have a white patch, and its brown legs end in black and white hooves.
identity_text: Rudolph the red-nosed reindeer, a brown reindeer standing upright with a bright red nose, small dark antlers and a white patch down its chest.

They wear a deep red winter coat with white fur cuffs at the wrists and a dark green scarf wound around the neck. Dark green trousers and red boots with white trim finish the outfit, and the coat is the same deep red across the back.
identity_text: An unnamed child bundled up for the cold in a deep red fur-trimmed winter coat, a soft white hat and a dark green scarf. The title only names the outfit, so there is no character behind it.

identity_text: An unnamed boy in a blue and white striped hoodie with the collar pulled up over his mouth, dark blue jeans and blue shoes.

appearance_text: A stern man with black hair combed back off a high forehead and pale eyes. He wears a white doctor's coat with bright red sleeves and cuffs, a small red bow tie at the collar and a dark waistcoat beneath, and the coat hangs down his back like an apron. His dark grey trousers end in black shoes.
identity_text: The Medic from Team Fortress 2 in red team colours, a stern black-haired man in a white doctor's coat with red sleeves and a red bow tie.

She has a soft pink cardigan with puffy sleeves under blue dungarees, with a little red flower tucked at the chest. On her back she carries a woven brown basket with flowers poking out, and her shoes are yellow and white.
identity_text: A blonde girl in a pink cardigan and pale blue dungarees, wearing a leaf crown and carrying a flower basket on her back. The title names a style, not a character.

appearance_text: A girl wearing a big blue hood shaped like an animal head, with round orange patches on each side of it. Long cream hair falls out from under the hood and she has large light blue eyes. She wears a matching blue hoodie with a pale front, short orange trousers, orange and black striped socks and black shoes.
identity_text: A girl with long cream-blonde hair wearing a blue creature hoodie with round orange cheek patches, orange shorts and striped socks. The outfit is themed after a blue water Pokemon, but the figure is a girl in a costume rather than the creature itself.

bottom: red shorts with two white buttons
head: two big round black ears

appearance_text: A black cartoon mouse with two big round ears and a tan face. Its eyes are large and white and its nose is a small black button. The whole body is black and furry, with bright red shorts held up by two white buttons on the front. White gloves cover the hands and the feet are chunky yellow shoes.
identity_text: Mickey Mouse, the Disney cartoon mouse, black and round-eared with a tan face, red shorts held by two white buttons, white gloves and yellow shoes.

appearance_text: A round, soft pink creature with a big head and a chubby body of the same pink. Its face has two tall blue oval eyes, bright magenta blush patches on the cheeks, and a wide open dark red mouth as if it is about to swallow something. Short stubby pink arms stick out at the sides, and its legs are bright red boots. The back is plain pink all over.
identity_text: Kirby, the round pink creature from Nintendo's games, with stubby arms and bright red boots. The texture also hides a tiny full-body Kirby sprite in a spare corner.

face: wide dark red mouth with cream fangs
head: lumpy pale head

appearance_text: A lumpy creature covered in pale pink blotchy skin. Two glowing red eyes sit above a huge dark red mouth lined with cream fangs that stretches across the lower face. A dark red stain spreads over its chest, and its thick arms and legs are the same pale flesh colour.
identity_text: A lumpy pale pink monster with glowing red eyes and an enormous fanged mouth across its lower face. The title is a moniker for this design, not a character from a known work.

appearance_text: A character whose head is a big carved orange pumpkin with dark triangle eyes and a glowing yellow grin. He wears a crisp white suit jacket with a red tie, and orange stripes show at the cuffs. His trousers are white to match and he stands in shiny black shoes.
identity_text: A smartly dressed figure whose head is a carved orange pumpkin with dark eyes and a glowing yellow grin, wearing a white suit with a red tie and black shoes. The title describes the look rather than naming a character.
