appearance_text: A girl with very long light purple hair that reaches down her back and two small round ears poking out of the top. Her big dark eyes take up most of her pale face. She wears a purple hooded top speckled with tiny pale marks over a light grey skirt, with white socks and dark purple shoes.
identity_text: A girl with very long pale purple hair and small ears on her head, wearing a speckled purple hoodie over a pale dress with white socks and dark shoes. 'Night Girl' describes the starry look rather than naming a character.

appearance_text: A stocky warrior in a steel helmet with a straight nose guard and two dark red horns curving out of the sides. A long red beard hangs down over a black armoured chest with grey plates on the shoulders and a belt with an orange buckle. He wears brown trousers and grey boots, and the armour and horns look the same from behind.
identity_text: An unnamed Norse warrior in a horned steel helmet with a long red beard, black and grey chest armour, brown trousers and grey boots. "Viking" names the kind of warrior rather than a particular character.

appearance_text: A girl with long dark brown hair wearing a red hooded top. The hood, hanging behind her, is shaped like an animal head with pointed ears and a white face marking. Over the hoodie she wears a dark brown pinafore dress with straps over the shoulders. Long black socks come up her legs to meet the skirt, with small white shoes at her feet.
identity_text: A dark-haired girl in a red hoodie whose hood is shaped like an animal's head, worn under a dark brown pinafore dress with long black socks.

colors.item: face print on the back of the hoodie
colors.name: orange

hair: spiky dark purple hair with orange streaks
head: white hood on the back
top: orange face printed on the back

appearance_text: A light-skinned boy with spiky dark purple hair streaked with bright orange, and glowing orange eyes. He wears a plain white hoodie with the hood down on his back and a small orange face printed between the shoulders. Faded blue jeans and red shoes finish the outfit.
identity_text: An unnamed teenage boy in a plain white hoodie with a small orange mob face printed on the back, worn with faded blue jeans and red shoes.

appearance_text: This character has flat green skin and dark hollow eyes with no shine in them. A grey knitted beanie is pulled down over the head. It wears a dark purple sleeveless hoodie that leaves the green arms bare, with the hood bunched at the back of the neck, and matching dark purple trousers.
identity_text: A zombie — the flat green-skinned undead mob, with the hollow dark eyes of the game's zombie face — dressed in modern streetwear: a grey beanie and a dark purple sleeveless hoodie with matching trousers.

appearance_text: A soft white creature with long floppy pink ears and a pink patch across one side of its face, with big pale blue eyes and a tiny black nose. A little white bow sits at its neck. Long pink ribbon streamers with pale blue tips trail from its back, and its white legs end in pink paws.
identity_text: The white and pink fairy-type Pokemon with long pink ribbon streamers trailing from its neck and back, a small white bow at its throat and pink-tipped paws.

appearance_text: A man with short brown hair and a brown beard, wearing a bright blue suit jacket over a black shirt with white cuffs at the wrists. A red tie hangs down the front and a tiny red and white badge is pinned to one sleeve. He has dark grey trousers and black shoes.
identity_text: A bearded man in a bright blue suit jacket with white cuffs, a red tie over a black shirt, dark grey trousers and black shoes - a stock exchange trader dressed for the trading floor.

hair: long brown hair down the back
head: white animal ears with pink insides
long brown hair
top: pink jacket with white fluffy trim

appearance_text: A girl with very long brown hair and a pair of white animal ears with pink insides on top of her head. Her big blue eyes peek out from under a soft fringe. She wears a pink jacket edged with thick white fluffy trim over a white top, with a pink skirt below. White socks reach all the way up her legs to white boots.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in a pink fur trimmed jacket and skirt with white animal ears on her head and very long brown hair.

colors.item: christmas tree print on the back
colors.name: green

head: long brown hair
red bow on top of the head
top: christmas tree with coloured baubles on the back

appearance_text: A girl with long brown hair, green eyes and a red bow on her head. She wears a white jumper with red and white candy cane stripes down the sleeves, and a green christmas tree covered in coloured baubles is drawn across the back. Below she has a dark green skirt, red and white striped socks and dark brown boots.
identity_text: A girl dressed head to toe for Christmas, in a white jumper with candy cane striped sleeves and a baubled tree across the back, a dark green skirt and striped socks.

bottom: red and silver panels on the legs
head: blue robot helmet
two antennae on the sides of the head

appearance_text: A tall metal robot with a blue helmet head, two short antennae sticking up at the sides, and a silver face plate with glowing blue eyes and no mouth. Its chest and arms are covered in bright red armour plating with silver panels down the middle. The legs are blue metal broken up by red and silver plates, ending in heavy blue feet. The back is red and blue armour to match.
identity_text: Optimus Prime, the Autobot leader from Transformers, built as a red and blue armoured robot with a blue helmet and a silver face plate.

appearance_text: A young man with short spiky blond hair and bright blue eyes. He wears a dark grey sleeveless vest with a grey scarf bunched at his neck, leaving his bare arms showing, with red bands around his upper arms and dark pads on his elbows. His brown cargo trousers have dark patches at the knees and a small blue pocket on one leg, and he finishes with chunky black boots.
identity_text: Jonesy The First, an outfit from Fortnite: a spiky blond survivor in a sleeveless dark vest, neck scarf and brown cargo trousers.

appearance_text: A figure whose whole body is wrapped in streaks of orange and brown flame. Curls of orange fire rise from the top of the head above a brown band across the forehead, and the tan face below has blank white eyes. Brighter orange fire glows at the shoulders and hands, and the flame streaks run all the way down the legs to dark brown boots.
identity_text: The Human Torch, the flame-powered member of Marvel's Fantastic Four, shown flamed on with orange fire streaking across his whole body and rising from his head.

accessories: knobs on the back of the television head
face: screen showing soft rainbow colour bars
head: grey television head with an aerial
top: dark grey hoodie with a hood and pocket

appearance_text: This character has a chunky grey television where its head should be, with a screen full of soft pastel rainbow bars and small knobs and vents on the back. It wears a plain dark grey hoodie with the hood down at the back and a front pocket. The trousers are black and so are the shoes.
identity_text: A figure with a chunky grey television where his head should be, the screen filled with soft pastel colour bars. Everything else about him is plain: a dark grey hoodie, black trousers and black shoes.

bottom: dark purple legs with glowing spots

colors.item: glowing wave line on the back
colors.name: blue

head: dark red head
top: black body with a glowing zigzag wave

appearance_text: A shadowy creature almost entirely black and dark purple, with a dark red face and two blank white glowing eyes. Across its chest runs a bright zigzag wave line that glows green, blue and pink, like a sound wave, and the same glowing wave shows across its back. Small glowing pink and blue patches light up its arms and legs.
identity_text: A near-black shadowy creature with a dark red face and blank white eyes, marked front and back by a glowing rainbow zigzag like a sound wave.

head: long red hair
top: dark purple top with puffy sleeves

appearance_text: A girl with long red orange hair that hangs down her back with one strand pulled over her shoulder, and bright purple eyes. She wears a dark purple top with short puffy sleeves and a matching short dark purple skirt. Her legs are bare down to purple ankle bands and dark purple shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with long red-orange hair dressed head to toe in plum purple: puffy sleeved top, short skirt, ankle bands and shoes. The title names the colour scheme, not a character.

colors.item: stripes on the arms and legs
colors.name: rainbow

head: grey cat head
cat ears
top: pink pop tart body with sprinkles

appearance_text: A grey cat with a round face, white eyes, bright pink cheeks and a wide open black smile. Its body is a pink frosted toaster pastry covered in tiny sprinkles, front and back. Rainbow stripes in red, orange, yellow, green and blue stream down both arms and both legs.
identity_text: Nyan Cat, the internet meme whose grey cat head sits on a body made of a pink frosted pop tart covered in sprinkles, with rainbow stripes streaming down its arms and legs.

bottom: short white skirt with a brown belt
footwear: white boots with light blue tops
hair: strands falling in front of the shoulders
head: long pink hair with pale streaks
top: soft white dress with puffy shoulders

appearance_text: A gentle girl with very long pink hair, streaked with paler pink, and soft light purple eyes. She wears a floaty white dress with slightly puffed shoulders and a thin brown belt around her waist. Her legs are bare above tall white boots with light blue cuffs.
identity_text: A soft pastel girl with very long pink hair, small rounded ears on her head, a floaty white dress and tall pale boots. The title describes the colour scheme rather than naming her.

bottom: blue and white striped pyjama trousers
head: blue and white striped nightcap
top: blue and white striped pyjama shirt with buttons

appearance_text: A boy with brown hair peeking out from under a floppy blue and white striped nightcap. He wears matching striped pyjamas with a row of buttons down the front and long striped trousers. Dark brown slippers cover his feet.
identity_text: The pyjama-clad lobby NPC for BedWars, the Hypixel mini-game, in a blue and white striped nightsuit, matching nightcap and brown slippers.

bottom: white legs covered in black spots
face: one giant black hole instead of a face
head: white head with a huge black hole where the face should be
top: white chest and arms covered in black spots

appearance_text: A plain white figure with big black spots scattered all over its arms, chest and legs. Where its face should be there is one huge black hole taking up almost the whole head. Nothing else is worn — the body is smooth white with only the black holes breaking it up.
identity_text: The Spot, the portal-covered villain from the 2023 animated film Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse, shown as a white figure dotted with black holes with one enormous hole where his face should be.

face: no face, just a dark slit in the helmet
head: full metal helmet
dark visor slit

appearance_text: A figure covered head to toe in battered metal armour, rusty brown with patches of bare grey steel. The full helmet has no face, only a dark horizontal slit where the eyes would be. Broad grey shoulder pads sit over armoured arms, and thick plates cover the chest, legs and boots, scratched and worn all over.
identity_text: A faceless warrior sealed head to toe in a battered, rusted suit of plate armour. The title describes the armour rather than naming a character.

hair: bald with two hairs on top
head: bald yellow head

appearance_text: A bald man with bright yellow skin, two stray hairs on the top of his head and enormous round white eyes. A band of tan stubble surrounds his wide mouth and heavy jaw. He wears a plain white short-sleeved shirt over yellow arms, light blue jeans and dark grey shoes.
identity_text: Homer Simpson from The Simpsons, bright yellow and bald with huge round eyes, in his white shirt and blue jeans.

hair: long dark purple-brown hair down the back
head: crown of small purple flowers and leaves
top: dark purple sash across the chest

appearance_text: A pale girl with long dark purple-brown hair falling down her back and one strand over her shoulder, wearing a crown of little purple flowers and green leaves. Her dress is soft white and flowing, gathered over one shoulder with a dark purple sash crossing the chest and trailing down the side. The short skirt leaves her legs bare, with thin dark straps around her ankles.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in a flowing white one-shoulder dress with a dark purple sash, wearing a crown of small purple flowers over long dark purple-brown hair.

hair: hair falling over the shoulders and down the back
head: small flowers tucked in the hair

appearance_text: A girl with long curly reddish brown hair that spills over her shoulders and down her back, with a few tiny flowers tucked into it. She wears a red checked shirt open over a dark red top, with light blue jeans that are ripped at the knees. Her boots are dark purple.
identity_text: A girl with long curly auburn hair, flowers tucked into the back of it, wearing a red checked shirt, ripped light blue jeans and dark purple boots.

top: red and yellow shield on the chest

appearance_text: A strong man with neat black hair, a little curl on his forehead and bright blue eyes. He wears a tight blue suit with a big red and yellow shield shape on the chest, and a long red cape hangs all the way down his back to his knees. Over the blue suit he has red trunks with a yellow belt, and tall red boots on his feet.
identity_text: Superman in his classic DC Comics costume — blue bodysuit with the red and yellow S shield, red trunks over a yellow belt, red boots and a long red cape.

appearance_text: A bearded man in a sand coloured camouflage uniform with a short brown haircut. A grey chest vest with pouches sits over the jacket and straps cross his back like a pack. A small flag patch is stitched on his sleeve, and his camouflage trousers tuck into heavy grey boots.
identity_text: An unnamed bearded soldier in tan desert camouflage with a loaded chest rig, a flag patch on the sleeve and heavy grey boots.

colors.item: panel on the front of the shirt
colors.name: white

head: white round face
brown hair
top: light blue t-shirt with a white front

appearance_text: A boy with short brown hair whose whole face is plain white with two tiny black square eyes and a big wide black smile. He wears a light blue short-sleeved t-shirt with a white panel down the front, leaving his arms bare. Blue jeans cover his legs and he wears bright red shoes.
identity_text: Cryaotic, the YouTuber, shown with his trademark blank white smiley face over short brown hair, wearing a blue checked shirt over a white t-shirt with blue jeans and red shoes.

hair: dark red hair under the cap
head: red cap with a white band

appearance_text: A short chubby character with a round pink face, big black eyes and a little pink nose, wearing a red cap with a white band. He has a red long sleeved shirt under blue dungarees fastened with two yellow buttons. His boots are brown and his cheeks are rosy.
identity_text: A young, chubby version of Mario, Nintendo's plumber mascot, with a round pink face, red cap and red shirt under blue dungarees and brown boots.

bottom: light blue jeans with a speckled pattern

appearance_text: A teenage boy with messy brown hair falling over bright blue eyes. He wears a red hoodie with white drawstrings hanging at the neck and the sleeves pushed down to his wrists. His light blue jeans have a speckled pattern on the front and a small yellow belt buckle at the waist. On his feet are red sneakers with white soles.
identity_text: A teenage boy dressed as a skater, in a red hoodie over speckled light blue jeans and matching red sneakers.

head: dark green peaked cap with a red band and gold badge
top: dark green military coat with two rows of gold buttons

appearance_text: A stern man in a dark green military coat buttoned with two rows of gold buttons, with red boards on the shoulders. He wears a matching peaked cap with a red band and a small gold badge on the front. A thick black moustache sits under his nose and his eyes are blue. His trousers are black and tucked into tall black boots.
identity_text: Stalin, the Soviet leader who followed Lenin at the head of the Communist Party, in a dark green military greatcoat with gold buttons, red shoulder boards and a peaked cap.

top: white and red striped short top

appearance_text: A girl with long blonde hair hanging straight down her back and big pale blue eyes. She wears a short white top with bold red stripes and puffy striped sleeves, leaving her tummy bare. Below it are blue denim shorts, her legs are bare, and she has dark blue boots.
identity_text: An unnamed girl dressed as a sailor, with long blonde hair, a red and white striped crop top and denim shorts. The title describes the look rather than naming a character.

footwear: long white socks with red tops
hair: long brown hair down the back
head: red beret

appearance_text: A girl with long brown hair falling past her shoulders and a red beret perched on her head, with blushing cheeks under her fringe. She wears dark blue overalls with shoulder straps and short legs, over white puffy sleeves that leave her shoulders bare, and a red bow sits at her chest. Long white socks with red tops come up over her knees into small white shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in a cute school-style outfit: dark navy overalls over puffed white sleeves, a red beret on her long brown hair and a red bow at the neck.

head: green cactus head
prickly bumps
top: dark green cactus badge on the chest

appearance_text: A green cactus person with bumpy prickly skin all over. Big black sunglasses cover its eyes and it shows a wide white grin underneath. It wears an orange vest with a dark green cactus badge on the chest and red shorts, and its green legs are bare and covered in little spines.
identity_text: A grinning cactus person, green and prickly from head to foot, wearing big black sunglasses, an orange vest and dark red shorts.

footwear: chunky black boots with white soles

appearance_text: A pale girl with very long dark blue hair tied into small bunches on top and falling down her back. She wears a grey blue dress with yellow trim that leaves her shoulders bare, with separate grey sleeves around her arms. Chunky black boots with white soles cover her feet.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with very long dark blue hair tied in bunches, wearing a blue grey dress with yellow bands and black boots.

head: white bow on top of the head

appearance_text: A pale girl with very long light brown hair that reaches almost to her knees, tied with a small white bow on top. She wears a soft white dress with bare shoulders and separate white puffy sleeves on her arms. Tall white boots come up over her knees, so she is dressed in white from head to toe.
identity_text: A girl dressed head to toe in white with tall rabbit ears and very long light brown hair. The title describes the look rather than naming anyone.

head: brown walrus head
top: white lab coat over a shirt

appearance_text: This character has a big brown walrus head with tiny black eyes and two long pale tusks hanging down from its snout. It wears a long white lab coat over a shirt with a light green striped tie, and the coat covers the arms and back. Below the coat are grey trousers and dark shoes.
identity_text: Trottimus of Hat Films, drawn with a brown walrus head and long tusks above a white lab coat, a pale green striped tie, grey trousers and dark shoes.

appearance_text: A young figure wearing a gold crown set with orange gems over brown hair, with striking red eyes. A red jacket edged in gold hangs open over a white shirt, and blue shorts are belted at the waist. A long pale blue cape falls from the shoulders all the way down the back, and gold-trimmed brown boots come up the legs.
identity_text: An unnamed teenage king in a gold gem-set crown and a red gold-trimmed jacket, with a long pale blue cape down his back and gold-trimmed brown boots.

appearance_text: A pale boy with short brown hair and brown eyes. He wears a hoodie covered in bold orange and white stripes that run right around the body and sleeves, with a grey hood behind his neck and drawstrings at the front. His shorts are blue denim, and below them his socks are striped orange and white above bright orange shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed boy in a bold orange and white striped hoodie with a grey hood, blue denim shorts, striped socks and bright orange shoes.

head: messy brown hair
orange pumpkin hood with a green stem at the back
top: orange pumpkin hoodie with ribbed stripes

appearance_text: A boy with messy brown hair and big green eyes. He wears a bright orange hoodie ribbed like a pumpkin, with white drawstrings hanging at the front, and the back of the hood has a little green stem on top. He finishes the outfit with plain black trousers and white shoes.
identity_text: A boy dressed for Halloween in a bright orange hoodie ribbed like a pumpkin, with a small green stem on the back of the hood, plain black trousers and white shoes. He is a child in a costume hoodie rather than a pumpkin creature.

head: red hair with black on top

appearance_text: A boy with messy red hair that turns black on top, and small brown eyes. He wears an open purple shirt covered in pink flowers and green leaves, with a plain white t-shirt showing underneath. His shorts are beige and end above bare legs, and he wears black sandals with black bands around his ankles.
identity_text: A boy dressed for a beach holiday in an open purple flowered shirt over a white t-shirt, with beige shorts, bare legs and black sandals. His hair is dark red at the front and near black on top.

appearance_text: A boy with short brown hair wearing huge black sunglasses that cover most of his face, grinning underneath. He has a light blue t-shirt with darker blue bands around the short sleeves. His shorts are white with little red dots on them, and his legs and feet are bare.
identity_text: n00b, the joke figure of a brand-new Minecraft player: a boy in huge black sunglasses and a light blue tee, grinning under the shades.

appearance_text: A cheerful boy with short blond hair, green eyes and peach skin. He wears a plain orange t-shirt with short sleeves that leave his arms bare. His legs are in blue jeans and he has white trainers on his feet.
identity_text: An unnamed blond boy in a golden yellow t-shirt, blue jeans and white trainers - a plain everyday kid skin.

hair: long brown hair with reddish ends

appearance_text: A girl with long brown hair that turns reddish at the ends, and pale light blue eyes. She wears a jumper striped in black and white across the body and sleeves, with the stripes continuing round the back, over a dark top. Black shorts sit at her hips, and black and white striped socks run up her legs into short dark brown boots.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in a black and cream striped jumper worn over a dark top, with black shorts, striped socks and brown boots.

subjects: girl in a red plaid jacket and white skirt

appearance_text: A pale girl with long light brown hair, one thick braid falling down her back and another over her shoulder, and big mint green eyes. She wears an open red plaid jacket, checked all over the sleeves and back, with a plain black top underneath. A short white skirt with a little orange flower on it sits above bare legs and small white ankle socks.
identity_text: An unnamed teenage girl in an open red plaid jacket and a short white skirt, her light brown hair in braids. The title refers to her jade green eye colour rather than to any character.

bottom: gold leg armour with black bands
head: short brown hair
no helmet
top: gold chest armour with black trim

appearance_text: A man with short brown hair, thick eyebrows and peach skin, wearing no helmet. His body is covered in gold armour striped with black, with wide plates over the shoulders and matching guards down both arms. A bright red scarf loops across his chest and hangs down his back, and gold leg armour banded with black runs down to his boots.
identity_text: An unnamed warrior in gold armour striped with black, bare-headed with short brown hair and a red scarf across his chest.

face: dark eyes peeking out of the hood
head: hood with pink pig ears
brown fuzzy hood

appearance_text: Somebody bundled up in a fuzzy brown onesie with the hood pulled right up, two little pink pig ears sticking out of the top and only their eyes showing underneath. Gold clasps run down the front of the onesie and two more sit on the back. The suit covers the arms and legs completely, ending in chunky dark brown boots.
identity_text: A boy bundled into a fuzzy brown onesie themed after the Piglin mob, with pig ears on the hood and gold clasps at the waist. The costume is the theme, so the figure is a person in a costume.

hair: very long silver hair down the back
head: long silver fringe over the forehead
top: black dress with a high collar

appearance_text: A light skinned girl with very long silver hair that hangs past her waist and a thick fringe over blue eyes. She wears a simple black dress with a high collar, and over it a soft jacket splashed with pink, yellow, green and blue like a faded rainbow. The same rainbow colours patch her leggings. Her boots are plain black.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with very long silver hair, wearing a black high-collared dress under a jacket splashed with pastel rainbow colours, with matching rainbow legs and black boots.

appearance_text: A girl with a short dark grey bob and a thick fringe, wide black eyes and bright pink blush on her cheeks. She wears a white short-sleeved t-shirt under short brown dungarees with straps over the shoulders. Her legs are bare apart from black bands around them and white socks on her feet.
identity_text: A girl in short brown dungarees worn over a white t-shirt, with a short black bob and bright pink blushed cheeks. An everyday outfit rather than a particular character.

appearance_text: A man with short brown hair, a brown beard and purple eyes, whose face looks squashed and melted with the eyes sitting low. He wears a plain cyan short-sleeved shirt and blue trousers that fade and smear at the edges. His shoes are grey, and the back is the same smeared cyan and blue.
identity_text: A deliberately warped version of Steve, the default Minecraft player character: the familiar cyan shirt, blue-purple jeans and brown beard, with the texture smeared and the head features pushed out of place.

head: white headband across the hair
top: baggy red sweater with wide sleeves

appearance_text: A girl with very long black hair held back by a white headband, red eyes and pink blushed cheeks. She wears an oversized red sweater with wide baggy sleeves that slips off her shoulders, with a small pale marking on the back. Her legs are in plain black leggings above chunky white shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in an oversized red sweater with black leggings, her very long black hair pushed back by a white headband.

accessories: cable plugged into the back of the head
face: two small grey buttons under the screen
head: turquoise television head with a rounded white screen
subjects: character with a television for a head

appearance_text: A figure whose head is a turquoise box with a big rounded white screen filling the front and two small grey buttons underneath. A red and blue cable runs out of the back of the box and down the back. The body wears a baggy yellow hoodie with dark drawstrings and dark marks on the sleeves, white trousers and black shoes with white soles.
identity_text: An unnamed figure whose head is a turquoise television with a blank white screen and two little buttons, wearing a baggy yellow hoodie, white trousers and black shoes, with a cable plugged into the back of its head.

appearance_text: A traveller with messy brown hair and blue eyes, wearing a grey blue hood folded back over the shoulders. Underneath is a cream shirt with a row of buttons and a round gold medallion hanging at the chest, with pale striped sleeves at the arms. A long reddish brown cape hangs all the way down the back, over dark brown trousers and tall black boots.
identity_text: An unnamed fantasy traveller dressed for a long journey, in a grey blue hood pushed back off the head and a long reddish brown cape.

head: pale yellow duck hood with an orange bill and black eyes

appearance_text: A boy wearing a soft pale yellow duck onesie with the hood pulled up, so an orange bill sits above his forehead and two black dot eyes look out from the top of the hood. His dark brown fringe hangs over his eyes underneath. The onesie has two brown drawstrings at the chest and is plain pale yellow all around the back. Grey shorts show below it, with yellow cuffs above bare ankles and white shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed boy in a pale yellow duck kigurumi onesie worn with the hood up, so a duck bill sits above his fringe. The duck is the costume, not the figure.

face: big red brown beard hiding the mouth
head: dark grey iron helmet

appearance_text: A short stocky warrior almost hidden behind a huge red brown beard that covers his chin and chest, with a dark iron helmet pulled down over his brow. Grey armour plates sit on his shoulders over a dark blue tunic crossed with brown straps and a belt. A long grey cloak hangs down his back, and he wears dark blue trousers with heavy brown boots.
identity_text: Gimli, the dwarf warrior from The Lord of the Rings, in an iron helmet and grey shoulder armour over a dark blue tunic, with his enormous red brown beard spilling down his chest.

appearance_text: A chubby grey rabbit standing on two legs, with tall ears that have pink insides and a wide open smile showing a pink tongue. Its muzzle, chest and belly are white, and it has small black eyes and a round orange nose. White paws tip its arms and legs, a fluffy white tail sits on its back, and it holds orange carrots with green leafy tops.
identity_text: A cheerful cartoon rabbit standing on two legs, grey with a white belly, holding a carrot in each hand.

appearance_text: An old man with a long white beard, bushy grey eyebrows and bright blue eyes. He wears a floppy purple pointed hat and a mottled purple robe tied with a grey belt. The robe runs all the way down to purple boots, and the back is the same deep purple.
identity_text: An old wizard with a long white beard and bushy brows, in a floppy pointed hat and a mottled purple robe belted at the waist.

head: black rounded penguin head
top: pale blue belly patch with a yellow outline

appearance_text: A small round penguin, black all over with tiny white eyes and a wide flat red beak that takes up most of its face. A pale blue oval belly patch outlined in yellow sits on its chest, with short black flippers hanging at each side. Its legs and flat feet are bright orange.
identity_text: Pingu, the little black penguin from the children's claymation series, with his wide red beak, pale belly patch and bright orange feet.

appearance_text: A figure in a long plain white robe edged with red at the sleeves and hem, fastened at the chest with a round gold clasp. A wide gold crown sits over black hair, and pale markings cross the lower part of the tan face. On the back of the robe is a big red apple with a green stem and leaf. Brown shoes peek out below the hem.
identity_text: Father Braeburn, a robed priest from the Yogscast's Minecraft series on YouTube, in a white red-trimmed robe with a gold clasp and a red apple on the back.

head: blue hood covering the back of the head

appearance_text: A young man with messy brown hair and brown eyes. He wears a blue coat with pale cuffs and a hood that sits over the back of his head, open over a white shirt, with a brown bag strap running across his chest and down his back. His trousers are dark grey and his boots are black with white soles.
identity_text: A young man dressed for travelling in a blue hooded coat over a white shirt, with a brown satchel strap across his chest and black boots. A generic adventurer type, not a named character.

appearance_text: An older man with short grey hair, bushy grey eyebrows and light blue eyes. He wears a white shirt with the sleeves rolled up under a yellow checked vest that also shows across his back. His brown trousers are held up by a black belt, and he stands in white shoes with black soles.
identity_text: An elderly grey-haired man dressed for a round of golf, in a yellow checked sweater vest over a white shirt with brown trousers and white shoes.

footwear: tall white socks with black soles
head: dark red cat ears
top: dark red jacket over a black shirt

appearance_text: A pale girl with very long dark red hair falling past her waist and two matching pointed animal ears on her head. Her eyes are dark red. She wears a dark red jacket over a black shirt, with a short black skirt. Her thighs are bare and she wears tall white socks that reach her knees.
identity_text: An unnamed anime-styled girl with dark red hair past her waist, matching pointed animal ears, a dark red jacket over black, and tall white socks.

accessories: yellow blobs on the belly and hands
head: messy dark brown hair

appearance_text: A hunched, grubby figure with blotchy brown skin, messy dark hair and a wide open mouth showing pale teeth. One sunken eye glows dull yellow in its dirty face. It wears a ragged dark grey shirt smeared with sickly yellow blotches around the belly and hands, and plain black trousers.
identity_text: The Boomer, an infected creature from Left 4 Dead, a grubby brown-skinned figure in a ragged shirt smeared with sickly yellow blotches.

bottom: dark grey armoured legs with knee plates
face: wide glowing light blue eye slits
head: blue military helmet covering the whole head

appearance_text: A tall figure in heavy battle armour with a smooth blue helmet that hides the whole face except two wide glowing light blue eye slits. The chest, arms and legs are dark grey armour plates with thin red seams and blue pads on the shoulders. Black armoured boots and a belt finish the suit, and the back is plated to match.
identity_text: The Arkham Knight, the armoured main villain of the Batman: Arkham Knight game, in dark grey plate armour with blue shoulder pads and a blue helmet with glowing eye slits.

top: green leaf shape on the front

appearance_text: A girl with very long strawberry red hair that hangs all the way down her back, and bright green eyes. She wears a white top with pink trim and a green leaf shape across the front, with bare arms below the short sleeves. A pink skirt sits at her waist above green and white striped socks and little red shoes.
identity_text: Strawberry Shortcake, the berry-themed girl from the cartoon of the same name, with floor-length red hair, a white and pink top and striped socks.

colors.item: letter and wings on the mask
colors.name: white

face: open mouth and chin left bare
head: blue helmet mask with a white letter A
small white wings at the sides of the mask
top: blue suit top with a big white star on the chest

appearance_text: A hero in a bright blue suit with a big white star on the chest and a band of red and white stripes around the waist. A blue mask covers the whole head except the chin and mouth, marked with a white letter A on the forehead and little white wings at the sides. A brown belt sits at the hips, and the blue legs end in tall red boots.
identity_text: Captain America, the Marvel comic book superhero, in his blue star-spangled suit with a red and white striped waist, brown belt, red boots and the winged A-marked mask.

accessories: light blue shell on the back
face: big white eyes with black pupils
head: pink dinosaur head
big rounded snout

appearance_text: A round pink dinosaur with a big head, a wide rounded snout with two nostrils and huge white eyes with tall black pupils. A little red tongue pokes out of its mouth. Its chest and belly are white, the rest of the body is pink, and a light blue rounded shell with small bumps sits on its back. Short legs end in blue boots.
identity_text: Yoshi in his pink colour variant: a round dinosaur with a big rounded snout, huge eyes, a white belly, a light blue saddle-shell on the back and blue boots.

face: black mask over the nose and mouth
head: brown hair

appearance_text: A boy with messy brown hair and bright blue eyes, with a black cloth mask pulled up over his nose and mouth. He wears a white hoodie with red drawstrings and the hood bunched behind his neck, plain white across the back. Loose cream joggers cover his legs and he wears dark red and white trainers.
identity_text: A boy dressed for street running in a white hoodie and loose cream joggers, with a black cloth mask covering the lower half of his face. The title only describes the look, so no name is claimed.

head: white head with a creeper face

appearance_text: A tall thin monster made of pale snowy white, with two square grey-blue eyes and a wide frowning mouth. A bright red scarf is knotted around its neck, with the long end hanging down its chest and the band showing across the back. Small grey feet peek out at the bottom of the plain white legs.
identity_text: A Creeper made of snow, with the mob's square eyes and frowning mouth picked out in grey-blue and a bright red winter scarf around its neck.

colors.item: striped wraps on the arms and legs
colors.name: light grey

face: face in shadow under a hood
head: dark hood pulled over the head

appearance_text: A bearded man with a dark blue-grey hood pulled low so his face sits in shadow, only a brown beard showing. His grey coat is worn and layered, with pale grey wraps banding his arms. The same striped wraps run down his trousers, and heavy dark brown boots cover his feet.
identity_text: The Hunter, the hooded pouncing special infected from the game Left 4 Dead, in his worn blue-grey hoodie with taped and bandaged arms and legs.

head: brown hair
fluffy wolf ears
top: white t-shirt with a small dark paw print

appearance_text: A boy with messy brown hair, blue eyes and fluffy dark animal ears poking out of the top of his head. He wears a plain white t-shirt with a small dark paw mark on the chest, grey shorts and white shoes. His arms are bare and the back of the shirt is plain white.
identity_text: A boy with dark wolf ears poking out of his messy brown hair, in a white hooded top marked with a small paw print and plain grey trousers.

head: cream sun hat with a dark band

appearance_text: A grinning man in a wide cream sun hat with a dark band, wearing blue tinted sunglasses. His shirt is red with a darker pattern, and a small light blue camera hangs on a strap over his chest. He wears green shorts with bare tan legs, white socks and dark shoes.
identity_text: A grinning man kitted out for a holiday — sun hat, blue-tinted sunglasses, patterned shirt, green shorts and a camera round his neck. The title says what he is doing, not who he is.

head: white hood down at the back
top: red rectangle outline on the chest

appearance_text: A pale figure with silver hair hanging over the eyes, wearing a plain white hoodie with the hood down. A single hollow red rectangle is printed across the chest, and the back of the hoodie is left blank. Below are grey shorts torn at the hems and white shoes with red stripes at the heel.
identity_text: A teenage boy with silver hair in a plain white hoodie marked by a single hollow red rectangle on the chest. No character is named — the title describes the mark on his top.

footwear: light blue boots with white tops
hair: long straight blonde hair down the back
head: crown of pink flowers and green leaves
top: light blue jacket over a white top

appearance_text: A girl with long straight blonde hair and a crown of pink flowers with green leaves sitting on her head. She wears a light blue jacket over a white top, cinched with a small brown belt, and matching light blue shorts. Her legs are bare down to light blue boots with white cuffs, and her eyes are blue.
identity_text: A blonde girl in a pink flower crown wearing a matching light blue jacket, shorts and boots with a small brown belt. She is a generic flower-themed girl, not a named character.

appearance_text: A brown-skinned young man with long black dreadlocks tipped in gold that hang right down over his eyes. He wears a plain black short-sleeved t-shirt with white bands on both wrists and small white pieces at his ears. Dark grey shorts reach his knees, and below them his bare legs end in white socks and clean white trainers. The back is plain black hair and black shirt with nothing printed on it.
identity_text: Juice WRLD, the late American rapper, shown with gold-tipped dreadlocks over his eyes, a gold chain, a plain black t-shirt and white trainers.

head: short brown hair with a fringe
top: dark blue t-shirt with short sleeves

appearance_text: A boy with short brown hair and green eyes. He wears a plain dark blue t-shirt with short sleeves, leaving his arms bare. His trousers are black and his shoes are white.
identity_text: A brown-haired boy in a dark blue t-shirt, black trousers and white shoes, drawn in deliberately chunky double-size pixels.

hair: long purple hair down the back
head: long purple hair

appearance_text: A girl with very long purple hair that falls all the way down her back, with a lighter purple streak on top. She wears an open purple jacket over a purple striped crop top, leaving her middle bare, and light blue denim shorts. Her legs are bare down to tall purple boots with a checked pattern.
identity_text: An unnamed teenage girl with very long hair, an open purple jacket over a striped crop top, denim shorts and tall purple boots.

appearance_text: A friendly man in a dark blue peaked cap with a small yellow badge on the front. He wears a light blue short-sleeved work shirt with a white collar and a dark blue tie, and dark blue work trousers with light blue shoes. He holds a hammer with a brown handle in both hands, and short brown hair pokes out under the cap.
identity_text: Fix-It Felix from the Disney film Wreck-It Ralph, the cheerful repairman in his blue peaked cap and light blue work shirt, holding his hammer.

appearance_text: A girl coloured all in soft pink, with long pale pink hair that falls past her shoulders and two little pointed tufts on top of her head. Her eyes are small dark pink dots. She wears a plain pink bodysuit over her body and arms with small white cuffs at the wrists. Her lower legs are covered by tall white boots.
identity_text: A pastel girl coloured almost entirely in soft pink, with long pale pink hair and tall white boots.

appearance_text: A light-skinned kid with a mop of dark brown hair and a wide open mouth. They wear blue denim dungarees with straps over the shoulders fastened by little yellow buttons, over a white shirt with loose sleeves. The blue legs run down to plain white shoes, and the straps cross the back.
identity_text: A plain light-skinned kid with a mop of dark brown hair, wearing light blue denim dungarees over a white shirt and white shoes.

colors.item: cuffs at the top of the boots
colors.name: cream

footwear: tall brown boots with cream cuffs
hair: hair down the front and back

appearance_text: A girl with long blonde hair that hangs down over her shoulders and gentle brown eyes. She wears a chunky cream knitted jumper with a wide soft collar that covers her arms to the wrists. Below it is a short dark brown skirt, and tall brown boots with folded cream cuffs come up over her knees, leaving a little of her legs bare.
identity_text: A blonde girl in a chunky cream jumper, short brown skirt and tall brown boots. The title names a season, not a character.

face: grey helmet with a dark eye slit
head: grey steel helmet with a red cross
top: white tunic with a red cross

appearance_text: A knight whose whole head is inside a grey steel helmet with a dark slit for the eyes and a deep red cross painted down the front. Over dark chainmail sleeves he wears a white tunic marked with a big dark red cross on the chest, cinched with a brown belt at the waist. The white tunic hangs over dark chainmail legs and boots, and the back of the tunic is plain white.
identity_text: A knight: a crusader whose head is fully enclosed in a grey steel helm, wearing a white tunic with a dark red cross over dark chainmail.

appearance_text: A friendly brown bear standing on two legs, with small round ears and a wide dark red hat with a yellow band pulled down over its eyes. It wears a blue coat with bright orange buttons down the front and a dark scarf tucked at the neck, and the coat is plain blue across the back. Its furry brown legs stick out below the coat and end in dark red feet.
identity_text: Paddington Bear, the storybook bear, standing on two legs in his dark red wide-brimmed hat with a yellow band and a blue coat with orange buttons.

appearance_text: A brown bear standing upright with two round ears on top of its head. Its face has small black eyes, a black nose and a big cream muzzle. The fur is brown all over with a darker round belly, and its paws are the same brown.
identity_text: A plain brown bear standing upright on two legs, with round ears, a big cream muzzle and a darker round patch on its belly. The listing calls it 'Barry the Bear', which does not correspond to any known character.

appearance_text: A walking pile of bones, white and grey all over with no clothes at all. The head is a bare skull with two deep black eye sockets and a row of teeth. The ribcage and spine are drawn across the chest and the back, and the arms and legs are thin bones with dark gaps between them.
identity_text: A skeleton: an animated set of bare white and grey bones with a bare skull for a head, ribcage and spine drawn front and back.

head: small round ears with pink insides
big blocky snout

appearance_text: A chunky four-limbed animal covered in speckled dark purple-grey hide. Its head is mostly a wide flat snout in lighter purple with two small white tusks poking up and tiny white eyes above. Small round ears with pink insides sit on top, a paler grey patch covers the belly, and the stubby feet are white.
identity_text: A hippo, drawn as a stocky four-limbed animal with a broad muzzle, two little tusks and stubby white feet.

head: dark brown hair
motifs: red jacket over a grey hood

appearance_text: A boy with short dark brown hair, pale skin and dark eyes. He wears a bright red jacket with black patches, open at the front to show a grey hood and grey chest underneath, and the same red covers the back and sleeves. Grey jeans with darker patches run down to red and black shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed brown-haired boy in a deep red jacket with black panels, open over a grey hoodie, with grey jeans and red and black shoes.

appearance_text: A boy with short brown hair and blue eyes in a hooded jumper that is black across the shoulders and bright blue down the sides and back. A white tick is printed across the chest. He wears plain black trousers and blue shoes.
identity_text: A brown-haired boy in a hooded jumper that is black over the shoulders and bright blue down the sides, with a white swoosh on the chest, plain black trousers and blue shoes.

appearance_text: A pale-faced person wearing a brown reindeer hat with a bright red nose on the forehead and soft cream ears sticking out at the sides. Black hair with pink streaks falls out from under it and hides the eyes. A baggy white sweater is worn with a red and white striped scarf hanging down the front, and the trousers are red with a darker check pattern. The scarf trails down the back too.
identity_text: An unnamed festive child in a brown reindeer hat with a red nose and cream ears, wearing a baggy white sweater, a candy-cane striped scarf and red checked trousers.

bottom: orange suit legs with grey panels
head: short brown hair
black glasses

appearance_text: A man with short brown hair, a neat brown beard and thick black glasses across his eyes. He wears a bright orange full body suit with a dark grey armoured plate over the chest and big grey pads on both shoulders, and a matching grey pack on his back. Orange and grey panels run down the arms and legs into heavy orange boots.
identity_text: Gordon Freeman, the physicist hero of the Half-Life games, in his orange HEV hazard suit with grey armour plating over the chest and shoulders.

bottom: dark red apron hanging down the front
top: dark red leather apron over the chest

appearance_text: A stocky man with dark brown hair and a full dark brown beard, with bright blue eyes. He wears a cream shirt with the sleeves rolled up under a heavy dark red leather apron that covers his chest and hangs to his knees. Thick black gloves cover his hands and his boots are dark brown.
identity_text: An unnamed medieval blacksmith, a stocky bearded man in a heavy dark red leather apron over a cream rolled-sleeve shirt, with black gloves and dark brown boots.

head: round grey head with two small pointed ears
top: grey furry chest with a pale cream belly

appearance_text: A big round furry creature covered in grey fur with two small pointed ears on top of its head. Its face is mostly a wide white toothy grin with tiny black eyes above it. The chest and belly are pale cream marked with rows of dark grey arrow shapes, and a curled tail shape sits on the back.
identity_text: Totoro, the big round grey forest spirit from the film My Neighbor Totoro, with a wide toothy grin, tiny eyes and a chevron-marked belly.

head: white square head with the creeper face
top: cream sweater with a creeper face on the back

appearance_text: A figure with a plain white square head marked with the well-known frowning face: two black square eyes and a wide black mouth with two legs hanging down. It wears a baggy cream sweater with tan cuffs, and the same frowning face is printed across the back of the sweater. Light blue jeans and white shoes finish the outfit.
identity_text: A creeper in an all-white colour scheme, its square head carrying the familiar frowning face, dressed up in a cream sweater and blue jeans.

appearance_text: A figure hidden inside a heavy black hood edged with a ring of gold, with nothing but darkness where the face should be. The long black robe has a dark red collar at the shoulders and a gold band across the middle. A dark red sash hangs down the front of the robe, and the legs and boots are black.
identity_text: A Disciple of D'sparil, one of the faceless hooded dark-wizard enemies, in a black gold-trimmed robe with a red sash.

hair: short slicked back dark brown hair
subjects: man in a black suit and sunglasses

appearance_text: A man with short dark brown hair slicked back and a wide pair of black sunglasses hiding his eyes. He wears a plain black suit jacket over a white shirt with a narrow dark tie. His trousers and shoes are black and the suit is black all the way around the back.
identity_text: Agent Smith from The Matrix, in the agents' uniform of a plain black suit, white shirt, narrow dark tie and wide black sunglasses, with short slicked-back dark hair.

head: fluffy brown hair
top: white round face logo on the back

appearance_text: A pale boy with fluffy brown hair and brown eyes, wearing a roomy light blue hoodie with drawstrings at the neck. On the back of the hoodie is a large white rounded logo with two dark eyes. He wears dark grey trousers and clean white shoes.
identity_text: A teenage boy in a roomy light blue hoodie with the white Discord logo across the back, dark grey trousers and white trainers.

accessories: small dark red bows in the hair
hair: one long braid down the back
top: dark red jacket tied around the waist

appearance_text: A pale girl with long light brown hair, a fringe across her forehead and one thick braid running all the way down her back, tied with tiny dark red bows. Her eyes are red and her cheeks are pink with blush. She wears a grey top with a dark red jacket bunched around her waist above a short dark red skirt, and grey and white leg warmers over black and white shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in an anime-styled everyday outfit: grey top, dark red jacket tied at the waist, short dark red skirt and leg warmers, with one long braid down her back.

top: blue uniform shirt with black shoulders and collar

appearance_text: A man with short dark brown hair and a little stubble around his mouth. He wears a blue uniform shirt with black shoulders and a black collar, with a small grey badge pinned on the left of the chest. His trousers and boots are plain black, and the back of the shirt is the same blue.
identity_text: A starship crewman wearing the blue division uniform of Star Trek's Starfleet, with a badge on the chest and plain black trousers.

head: big black witch hat with a green band
top: dark green apron down the front

appearance_text: A stooped figure with grey-green skin, a huge brown nose and one heavy dark eyebrow over white eyes. A wide black pointed hat with a green band sits low on the head. The body is wrapped in a long purple robe with a dark green apron hanging down the front, tied with a brown belt, and grey shoes poke out at the bottom.
identity_text: The Minecraft Witch, the hostile potion-throwing mob: a stooped grey-green figure with a huge warty nose under a wide black pointed hat, dressed in a long purple robe.

subjects: old man in a black suit

appearance_text: An elderly man with thin grey hair, grey eyebrows and a neat grey moustache. He wears a formal black suit jacket over a white shirt with a small dark bow tie, and white cuffs show at his wrists. His trousers and shoes are black and the suit is plain black across the back.
identity_text: Alfred Pennyworth, the butler from the Batman comics, shown as an elderly man in a dark formal suit with a bow tie.

appearance_text: A young person with short brown hair and bright green eyes. They wear a plain white jacket with long white sleeves that is white all the way round the back. Their trousers are black and they wear white and grey trainers.
identity_text: A brown-haired boy in a plain white hooded jacket, black trousers and white trainers. 'Mr Nick' is a listing title, not a character who exists outside this file.

head: closed helmet with a gold cross over the face
dark eye slits
top: white tunic with a big red cross

appearance_text: A knight sealed in a dark grey helmet with a bright gold cross running down the front of the face and slits for the eyes. Over grey shoulder plates he wears a white tunic marked with a big red cross on the chest, and the same red cross shows on his back. Gold bands wrap his arms, waist and legs, and he stands in heavy dark armoured boots.
identity_text: An unnamed crusader knight in dark plate armour with gold banding, a gold cross across the helmet and a red cross on the white chest.

bottom: cream cloth wrapped around the waist
head: shaggy black hair hanging over the face
top: cream cloth wrap over one shoulder

appearance_text: A big broad shouldered figure with grey skin and long messy black hair that hangs down over his eyes. A cream coloured cloth is slung over one shoulder and across his chest, with more of the same cloth wrapped around his waist like a skirt. His arms and legs are bare and muscly, and one knee is bound with a strip of the same cloth.
identity_text: Giga Chad, the broad-shouldered meme strongman, restyled here as a caveman with grey skin, long black hair over his eyes and cream cloth wrapped over one shoulder and round his waist.

head: black hair
top: blue jacket with a bright yellow collar and yellow shoulder patches

appearance_text: A boy with black hair and blue eyes wearing a blue jacket with a bright yellow collar turned up around his neck and yellow patches on the shoulders. A grey shirt shows underneath and a brown strap crosses the back of the jacket. His jeans are light blue and his shoes are grey and white.
identity_text: An unnamed black-haired boy in a blue jacket with a bright gold collar and gold shoulder plates, worn over a grey shirt with light blue jeans.

appearance_text: A girl with very long dark purple hair, worn with two small buns at the top and a fringe over green eyes. She wears a black top that leaves her shoulders bare, with loose sleeves striped in black and white. A short black skirt sits at her waist, her legs are bare, and she wears black boots with white soles.
identity_text: A teenage girl with very long dark purple hair worn in two small buns, in a black off-shoulder top with striped sleeves and a short black skirt.

accessories: brown leather strap across the chest
head: grey helmet with a dark T-shaped visor

appearance_text: A tall warrior covered head to toe in grey steel plates. The helmet has a narrow dark T-shaped slit where the face would be, and wide plates cover both shoulders. Underneath the metal is a blue-grey padded tunic and matching leggings, with a brown leather strap running across the chest and around to the back. Heavy dark brown boots cover the feet.
identity_text: A warrior wearing the Faraam armour set from Dark Souls 2, grey steel plate over a teal padded tunic with heavy brown boots.

head: pale blue hair in a straight fringe
top: pale blue shirt shape with no other colour

appearance_text: A figure shaped exactly like an ordinary person but made entirely of pale icy blue, with no other colour anywhere. His hair, face, shirt, trousers and shoes are all the same soft blue, shaded lighter and darker so the edges catch the light. Faint darker blue marks show where his eyes and short beard are.
identity_text: Steve, the default Minecraft player, rendered entirely in pale diamond blue — the same hair, shirt, trouser and shoe shapes with all colour replaced by icy shading.

head: big green head
one eye in the middle of the face

appearance_text: A hulking green creature with one huge white eye and a black pupil in the middle of its face, and a row of blunt white teeth beneath it. Its whole body is green with broad heavy shoulders and a bare chest. Around its waist it wears torn brown trousers that hang in strips, and its hands and feet are a darker green. Its back is plain green with the same brown rags.
identity_text: An unnamed hulking green monster with one huge eye in the middle of its face, a row of blunt white teeth and ragged brown strips around its waist.

head: bright blue hair with a long fringe

appearance_text: A teenager with bright blue hair that hangs in a long fringe over their eyes. They wear a plain grey hoodie with two little white toggles at the chest, and dark grey jeans. Their shoes are white.
identity_text: A teenage boy in a plain grey hoodie and dark denim jeans whose one striking feature is a long bright blue fringe. He is not a named character - the title only describes his hair.

accessories: long purple cape down the back

colors.item: bright periwinkle panel painted on the back of the torso (no cape)
colors.name: purple

face: dark visor instead of a face
head: pink helmet with horns
dark visor slit

appearance_text: A tall armoured figure whose head is a pink helmet with small horns and a dark slit visor hiding the face. Pink and dark green plates cover the chest and shoulders, and the arms are banded in pink and dark stripes. A long purple cape hangs the whole way down the back, and the legs are armoured in teal and green.
identity_text: An unnamed sci-fi knight in bright pink and dark green plate armour with teal armoured legs, its face hidden behind a dark visor band.

hair: green mohawk running down the back of the head
head: shaved head with a green mohawk
top: black t-shirt with dark shoulder patches

appearance_text: A pale figure with a shaved head and a spiky green mohawk that runs right down the back of the skull, staring out with bright red eyes. He wears a plain black t-shirt with darker patches on the shoulders and chunky grey studded bands around both wrists. His dark blue jeans are ripped at the knees and he wears black shoes with white soles.
identity_text: An unnamed punk rocker with a shaved head, a green mohawk and glaring red eyes, in a plain black t-shirt, studded wristbands and dark blue jeans ripped at the knees.

appearance_text: A chubby green jelly bear with two little round ears on top of its head. Its face has tiny dark teal eyes, a pale muzzle and a small dark mouth. The whole body is a shiny green with lighter patches that look like light shining through jelly, and a big pale oval on the belly. Its short arms and legs are the same green.
identity_text: A gummy bear — a bear-shaped jelly sweet standing upright, moulded entirely in translucent green with round ears and a pale muzzle.

hair: fluffy light brown hair with a fringe
head: soft light brown hair
hood on the back
top: small brown heart on the chest

appearance_text: A pale character with fluffy light brown hair falling over grey eyes. They wear a soft pink hoodie with a tiny brown heart on the chest and the hood resting behind the neck. Their jeans are pale grey and their shoes are white. The back of the hoodie is plain pink.
identity_text: An unnamed pale teenager in a soft pink hoodie with a tiny brown heart on the chest, pale grey jeans and white shoes.

appearance_text: A pale skinned girl with fluffy icy pale blue hair and bright red eyes, with two small pointed brown animal ears poking out of the top of her head. She wears a loose white shirt with an open collar. Dark red shorts leave her legs bare above short brown boots.
identity_text: Lycos, the pale, red-eyed girl from the anime Children Of The Whales, in a loose cream shirt and dark red shorts.

accessories: green tank strapped to the back
hair: thick orange strands hanging over the shoulders
head: orange tentacle hair bundled at the back

appearance_text: A pale kid whose hair is a thick bundle of bright orange tentacles gathered at the back, with two heavy strands falling over the shoulders. The eyes are huge and black with orange markings around them. She wears a white short sleeved t-shirt with a black shape printed on the chest, black shorts and bare legs with small black bands around them. Her shoes are pink with teal soles, and a green tank with orange straps is fixed to her back.
identity_text: The Inkling Girl from Splatoon, a squid kid with bright orange tentacle hair, a white tee and black shorts, and an ink tank strapped to her back.

hair: long dark red brown hair with a fringe
head: black hair bow at the back
top: dark grey top with gold buckles

appearance_text: A girl with long dark reddish brown hair and a straight fringe, with a small black bow pinned at the back. Her top is dark grey with gold buckles across the chest and a studded belt at the waist. She wears dark checked leggings and black boots with gold studs.
identity_text: A teenage girl in a dark grey studded outfit with gold buckles, checked leggings and studded black boots. The listing describes her as wearing a Batman shirt, so she is a fan of the character rather than the DC heroine herself.

appearance_text: A pale girl with long teal hair that hangs past her waist and a teal fringe over her eyes, which are the same teal colour. She wears a baggy cream hoodie with black sleeves and white drawstrings, with the hood resting down her back. Her jeans are light blue and slightly faded, and her sneakers are black with white soles.
identity_text: An unnamed teenage girl with long teal hair, wearing a baggy cream hoodie with black sleeves, faded blue jeans and black-and-white sneakers.

head: yellow mask with two pointed horns

appearance_text: A muscular hero in a bright yellow mask with two pointed horns sticking out at the sides and narrow white eye slits. The suit is yellow across the chest with blue panels down the sides and sleeves, cinched with a wide red belt. Blue trousers run into yellow and blue boots, and the back of the suit matches the front.
identity_text: Wolverine in his classic yellow-and-blue costume, with the horned yellow cowl, blue side panels and a wide red belt.

colors.item: long red hair down the back (no cape)
colors.name: red

head: gold and green headpiece over red hair
top: dark armour with gold plates and jewels

appearance_text: A tall figure with greenish brown skin and long fiery red hair, wearing a gold and green band across the forehead. His dark armour is studded with gold plates and orange jewels down the chest and arms, and a long red cape covers the whole back down to the legs. The armoured legs end in heavy dark boots.
identity_text: Ganondorf, the dark lord from The Legend of Zelda, in his Ocarina of Time armour of dark plate studded with gold and jewels.

appearance_text: A boy with thick messy black hair falling over his forehead, orange eyes and dark stubble on his chin. He wears a plain red hoodie with the hood hanging down his back and black cuffs at the wrists. His jeans are black and his trainers are white.
identity_text: RageElixir, a Minecraft YouTuber, drawn as a boy with messy black hair in a plain red hoodie, black jeans and white trainers.

head: closed grey helmet
cross-shaped visor slit
small red gem on the forehead

appearance_text: A warrior in dark grey plate armour with a closed helmet whose visor is a narrow cross-shaped slit, with a small red gem set in the forehead. Bright red plates cover the shoulders and a long red tabard hangs down the front and back, with a pale cross marked on the back of it. The arms and legs are wrapped in grey armour with heavy boots.
identity_text: A medieval knight in mottled grey plate armour with red shoulder plates and a long red tabard bearing a white cross, his face hidden behind a cross-slit helmet set with a red gem.

appearance_text: A round green monster that is almost all head, with one enormous white eye in the middle of its face and a teal ring around the dark pupil. Under the eye is a wide open grin showing a row of white teeth. Two little bumps sit on top of the head. The whole body is the same green with short arms and stubby legs, and the back is plain green.
identity_text: Mike, the round green monster from Monsters, Inc., who is almost all head with a single enormous eye and a wide grin.
