colors.name: pink

appearance_text: A pale girl with long brown hair, blushing cheeks and small furry ears on top of her head. Pink flowers are dotted through her hair and all over the sleeves and back of her black jacket, which she wears open over a short black top. She has light blue jeans and white shoes with black soles.
identity_text: A soft-styled girl with pointed cat ears, pink flowers through her hair and across her black jacket, worn over a black crop top with pale blue jeans and white shoes.

appearance_text: A girl with long wavy reddish brown hair and big light blue eyes. She wears a red checked shirt hanging open over a plain black top, with the checked sleeves rolled down her arms. Her shorts are black and her legs bare above white socks and red checked boots.
identity_text: An unnamed teenage girl with long wavy reddish brown hair and big pale blue eyes, wearing a red checked shirt open over a black top, with black shorts and red checked boots.

accessories: dark red guitar shape on the back of the jacket

colors.item: guitar design on the jacket back
colors.name: dark red

head: brown hair with a blue fringe

appearance_text: A boy with brown hair swept over one eye and a bright blue streak across the front. He wears an open black leather jacket with the sleeves pushed up over a plain white shirt, and a dark red guitar shape is painted across the jacket's back. His black jeans are torn at the knees and shins, and he wears grey trainers.
identity_text: A teenage rock-star type in an open black leather jacket over a plain white shirt, with a blue streak in his hair and ripped black jeans. The title names the look rather than a person.

face: sky and clouds instead of a face
head: blue sky with white clouds
top: pink and orange sunset with a yellow sun

appearance_text: A figure that looks like a whole landscape instead of a person. The head is a pale blue sky dotted with white clouds and has no face at all. Across the chest a pink and orange sunset glows around a small yellow sun, with a band of dark blue water beneath it. The legs are covered in dark green trees standing on olive grass, and the same scene wraps around the back.
identity_text: Not a character but a scene: the game's sunset painted across a whole body, with a cloudy blue sky on the head, a sun setting over water on the chest and dark forest on the legs.

appearance_text: A figure whose head is completely wrapped in a dark green hood, with only two pale rectangular lenses showing where the eyes are. He wears a thick dark green hooded jacket that covers his arms and body. Below it are olive green trousers and heavy dark brown boots.
identity_text: Riddler, the supervillain of the 2022 film The Batman. His head is wrapped entirely in a dark green hood with two pale rectangular lenses over the eyes, and he wears a thick green hooded parka over olive trousers.

appearance_text: A short stocky fighter with a huge brown beard covering most of his face and white angry eyes peeking out under a dark brown helmet with side horns and a pale metal nose guard. He wears brown leather armour with shoulder pads over a blue tunic, and a gold rune mark is painted across his back. His trousers are grey with a checked pattern and he has brown boots.
identity_text: A stout dwarf fighter in a horned helmet and brown leather armour over a blue tunic, with grey checked trousers and a gold rune on his back. A dwarf as a kind of creature, not a specific named one.

head: big square yellow head
stud on top of the head

appearance_text: A plastic toy figure with a big square yellow head, two black dot eyes and a tiny smile. It wears a plain red shirt with yellow hands poking out of the sleeves. Its trousers and feet are bright blue, and a little stud sits on top of its head.
identity_text: A classic Lego minifigure: a big square yellow head with two dot eyes and a small smile, a plain red shirt, yellow hands and bright blue legs and feet.

accessories: black hood hanging behind the head
face: one gold eye and one light blue eye
hair: long cream hair with a tan streak on one side
top: dark grey strapped top with cream trim

appearance_text: A girl with long pale cream hair, streaked tan on one side, and mismatched eyes: one gold, one light blue, with small red marks beneath them. She wears a dark grey top with cream trim and straps across the chest, a short black skirt and grey leggings buckled with black bands. Chunky black boots cover her feet, and a big black hood hangs down behind her head.
identity_text: Trickster, a playable character from the pixel RPG Soul Knight: a cream-haired girl with mismatched eyes, a dark strapped outfit and a big hood hanging behind her.

appearance_text: An old man with a long dark brown beard and moustache hanging down over his chest, and dark eyes set in a lined face. He wears a speckled light blue hooded robe with wide sleeves, tied at the waist with a brown belt. The robe carries on down over pale blue trousers and ends above heavy dark grey boots.
identity_text: The Wizard troop from Clash of Clans, an old spellcaster with a long dark beard in a hooded pale blue robe and heavy boots.

head: small orange clips
top: yellow pineapple with green leaves on the chest

appearance_text: A girl with long grey-brown hair and a straight fringe, with two tiny orange clips at the top of her head. Her yellow top has wide sleeves and a bright yellow pineapple with green leaves printed on the chest. She wears simple cream shorts underneath and white shoes with orange trim over white socks.
identity_text: A girl in a summery yellow outfit with a pineapple printed on her shirt; the fruit is on the clothing, not what she is.

colors.item: land shapes on the planet head
colors.name: green

face: no face, just the planet surface
head: round planet earth for a head
blue oceans with green and brown land

appearance_text: A figure in a neat blue suit whose head is a round blue planet covered in green and brown patches of land, with no face at all. Under the jacket is a white shirt with a black tie. The trousers and shoes are black, and small tan hands stick out from the sleeves.
identity_text: A faceless figure in a smart blue suit whose head is the planet Earth, blue oceans marked with green and brown land. A visual-gag skin rather than a named character.

face: huge grin full of white teeth
head: dark purple head with swirls

appearance_text: A creature made of swirling purple and pink, with no eyes at all and an enormous grin full of blocky white teeth framed by bright pink lips. Curling pink swirls twist over the chest and arms, and the whole back is covered in a glowing cyan and blue spiral. The legs carry the same swirling purple and blue pattern down to the feet.
identity_text: An eyeless cosmic creature with an enormous toothy grin and bright pink lips, its whole body a swirl of purple, pink and glowing cyan.

face: big white eyes with black pupils
head: round blue bird head with a tuft on top
top: blue feathered body with folded wings

appearance_text: This is a small round bird covered in bright blue feathers, with a paler light blue chest and belly. It has big white eyes with black pupils and a little pale yellow beak, and a small tuft of feathers sticking up on top of its head. Its wings are folded at its sides and it stands on thin pale yellow legs.
identity_text: The little blue bird from the Twitter logo, drawn here as a round cartoon bird with bright blue feathers, a pale blue chest, big eyes, a small yellow beak and a tuft on its head.

appearance_text: A grown man with a big head of curly brown hair and a thick brown moustache. He is dressed in a bright pink suit with a matching jacket and trousers, and a white shirt collar shows at the neck. His shoes are dark brown.
identity_text: An unnamed grown man dressed in a head to toe bright pink suit with a white shirt collar, with big curly ginger-brown hair and facial hair. The title describes the outfit.

footwear: tall white boots with black tips
hair: long peach-orange hair down the back
head: small brown and grey animal ears

appearance_text: A girl with long peach-orange hair and a pair of small furry brown and grey animal ears on her head. She wears a soft cream dress with a frilly white front and long loose grey sleeves, and a fluffy brown tail sits at the back. Tall white boots with black tips come right up her legs, and her eyes are a warm orange.
identity_text: A fox-girl with peach-orange hair, small furry ears and a fluffy brown tail, dressed in a frilled cream dress with long grey sleeves and tall white boots.

head: gold crown
top: dark blue tunic with gold trim

appearance_text: A pale boy with brown hair to his chin and green eyes, wearing a gold crown. His dark blue tunic has gold trim, gold shoulder pieces and a gold belt, with lighter blue sleeves. He wears black trousers with gold stripes and black boots, and a long dark blue cape hangs down his back.
identity_text: A boy dressed as a young prince in a dark blue and gold tunic with blue sleeves, a gold crown and a long cape down his back. The title describes the role rather than naming anyone.

face: green helmet with a narrow black T-shaped visor
head: green helmet with a dark red band and a small orange side mark
top: green and grey battered armour with shoulder plates

appearance_text: A helmeted figure in scratched green and grey armour, with a narrow black T-shaped slit across the front of the helmet instead of a face. A dark red band runs over the helmet and a small orange mark sits on one side. Thick pads cover the shoulders and knees, an orange belt crosses the hips, and a bulky orange and white pack is strapped to the back.
identity_text: Boba Fett, the armoured bounty hunter from Star Wars, in his scratched green and grey armour with a T-visor helmet and a jetpack.

head: reddish brown hair
green and red knitted pattern at the back

appearance_text: A kid with short reddish brown hair and green eyes, with a green and red knitted pattern wrapping the back of the head. The chunky red jumper has a reindeer face knitted across the chest with a bright red nose, white and red striped sleeves and green cuffs at the wrists and hem. On the back of the jumper is a big green wreath with a red bow. Dark blue jeans lead down to red and white shoes.
identity_text: A kid in a chunky red knitted Christmas jumper with a reindeer face on the front and a wreath on the back, worn with dark blue jeans. Unnamed — the title describes the jumper.

accessories: gold hair bow at the back

appearance_text: A girl with long brown hair falling down her back, tied with a small gold bow near the top, and warm brown eyes. She wears a dark red sweater with long sleeves over a short white skirt. Her legs are bare down to red boots with black soles.
identity_text: A brown-haired girl in a dark red sweater over a short white skirt, with red boots and a small gold bow tied at the back of her hair.

appearance_text: A grown man with short brown hair, a thick brown beard and moustache, and purple eyes. He wears blue dungarees with a wide bib over a plain white t-shirt, leaving his bare arms showing. Blue jeans run down to dark brown shoes, and the dungarees straps cross over his back.
identity_text: A grown, bearded man dressed for farm work in blue bib dungarees over a white t-shirt with blue jeans and brown shoes.

face: black square eye and mouth holes on the back of the head
head: brown hair on the front
green mottled scalp at the back

appearance_text: From the front this looks like an ordinary man with short brown parted hair, a brown beard and purple eyes, wearing a cyan-blue t-shirt, blue jeans and grey shoes. Turn him around and the whole back is mottled green, speckled light and dark like camouflage. The back of his head carries a face made of black squares: two square eyes and a wide square mouth. His arms and legs are green and blotchy on the back and behind.
identity_text: A skin split front to back: from the front an ordinary miner in a cyan t-shirt and blue jeans, from behind the mottled green body and square black face of a creeper.

bottom: streaks of pale green like grass

appearance_text: A brown skinned woman with very long dark brown curly hair and softly glowing white eyes. She wears a flowing light green gown that looks made from leaves, gathered at the waist by a small gold ornament. The long skirt is streaked with pale green like blades of grass, and brown sandals show at her feet.
identity_text: An unnamed nature goddess with very long dark curly hair and pale glowing eyes, dressed in a flowing leaf-green gown gathered by a small gold ornament, with brown sandals.

appearance_text: A boy with short dark brown hair and big bright blue eyes. He wears a navy blue jacket hanging open over a plain white t-shirt, with the jacket the same navy colour all the way round his back. His trousers are tan, and on his feet are red trainers with white soles.
identity_text: A plain everyday boy in an open navy jacket, white t-shirt and tan trousers. The title is a bare given name attached to a generic boy skin, so no character is asserted.

appearance_text: A woman with a neat brown bob and a short fringe over small dark eyes. She wears a soft pink sweater with long sleeves and a plain white apron tied over the front of it. Her legs are in light blue jeans and she wears simple brown shoes.
identity_text: A woman dressed for the kitchen in a pink jumper with a plain white apron over it, light blue jeans and brown shoes.

accessories: grey hood hanging on the back

appearance_text: A young man with brown hair swept over his forehead and blue eyes. He wears a light blue denim shirt open over a white t-shirt, with a dark red bow tie at his collar and brown suspenders running down his chest. A soft grey hood hangs across his shoulders and back. His trousers are black and his shoes are grey.
identity_text: A young man in hipster dress: an open denim shirt over a white tee, a dark red bow tie, brown suspenders and black trousers.

colors.item: flames on the arms and legs
colors.name: orange

face: bull face with a wide muzzle
head: bull head with two curved cream horns

appearance_text: A hulking bull-headed creature made of smooth tan metal, with two curved cream horns, small white tusks and beady black eyes. Its wide chest is a rounded plate of the same tan, and darker brown shading runs over its shoulders and down its back. Bright orange and red flames lick up its arms and legs from the hands and feet.
identity_text: The Brazen Bull, a hulking bull-headed figure of smooth tan metal with flames licking up its arms and legs.

head: short brown hair with a fringe

appearance_text: A boy with short brown hair falling over his forehead, pale skin and big blue eyes. He wears a light blue short sleeved t-shirt with a dark navy collar around the neck, leaving his bare arms showing. Dark navy trousers and white trainers finish the outfit, and his back is plain blue with no print.
identity_text: An unnamed brown-haired boy in a light blue t-shirt with a dark navy collar, navy trousers and white trainers. 'Cool Blue' describes the outfit rather than naming anyone.

accessories: mushrooms growing on the shoulders and back
face: two glowing pale yellow eye slits
head: mossy skull
small red mushroom on top
top: mossy green growth over the ribs

appearance_text: A bony figure with pale grey bones showing through patches of green moss all over its body. Its skull has two glowing pale yellow eye slits and a small red mushroom sprouting from the top. Clumps of brown mushrooms and darker moss grow across its shoulders and down its back, and its thin legs are streaked with the same green.
identity_text: The Bogged, the mossy skeleton mob added to Minecraft in the 1.21 update, its pale bones overgrown with green moss and mushrooms and a small red mushroom on its skull.

bottom: white and light blue striped trousers

appearance_text: A very pale girl with long creamy white hair that falls down her back, soft grey eyes and big pink blushing cheeks. She wears a light blue jacket hanging open over a plain white top, and the same pale blue covers her arms and back. Her trousers are white with light blue stripes running across them, and she has small grey shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in a soft pastel outfit — a pale blue open jacket over a white top, striped white trousers and long cream-white hair.

footwear: long white socks with grey stripes
head: purple cat ears

appearance_text: A pale girl with long light purple hair and two matching pointed cat ears on top of her head. She wears a black jacket over a black top and short black shorts. Long white socks with grey stripes come up over her knees.
identity_text: A pale girl with long light purple hair and two matching pointed ears on her head, dressed all in black with a jacket, top and short shorts above long white socks.

face: dog face with black eyes and a grey nose
hair: brown hair at the back of the head
head: tan dog mask with pointed ears
brown hair showing at the back

appearance_text: A person whose head is hidden inside a big tan shiba dog mask with pointed ears, black eyes and a cream muzzle, with brown hair showing at the back. They wear a dark brown jacket with white stripes around the sleeves over a white hooded top. Below are light blue jeans and dark grey shoes.
identity_text: A boy wearing a big tan shiba dog mask, in a dark brown jacket with white striped sleeves over a white hooded top. The doge is the mask, not the wearer.

footwear: long brown socks with white stripes
hair: long brown hair hanging down the back
head: cream animal hat with black ears

appearance_text: A girl wearing a soft cream hat with two round black animal ears on top, with her long brown hair spilling out from under it and down her back. Her dark grey jacket has white stripes banded around both sleeves and a hood behind the neck. She wears light blue denim shorts with a black and white checkered strip at the waist, and long brown socks striped with white cover most of her legs.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in a cream animal-ear hat with her long brown hair spilling out beneath it, wearing a dark grey striped-sleeve jacket and light blue denim shorts.

appearance_text: An old man drawn entirely in black, white and grey, with messy grey hair and a huge bushy grey beard covering most of his face. He wears a black buttoned waistcoat over a white long-sleeved shirt. Black trousers and tall black boots finish the outfit, and his back is plain black with white sleeves at the sides.
identity_text: Thomas Wake, the elderly lighthouse keeper from the film The Lighthouse, drawn in black and white with a big beard and a buttoned waistcoat.

accessories: small red marks on the back of the jacket
face: face hidden behind a mirror visor
head: shiny silver helmet
mirrored visor
rainbow stripes on the helmet

appearance_text: A tall figure in a black suit whose whole head is a shiny silver helmet with a mirror across the face. Rainbow stripes of red, yellow and blue run down each side of the helmet, and there is a small tan panel on the back of the head. The hands are covered by bright gold gloves, and small red marks show on the back of the jacket. The trousers and shoes are black too.
identity_text: One of the two helmeted members of the electronic music duo Daft Punk, in a black suit with gold gloves and a mirrored silver helmet ringed with rainbow stripes.

head: green goblin head
pointy ears
top: dark red braces crossing the chest and back

appearance_text: A green skinned creature with a wide toothy grin, glowing yellow eyes and pointy ears sticking out at the sides of its head. Its chest and arms are bare green skin, crossed front and back by two dark red braces. Those braces hold up baggy dark red shorts, and its feet are in matching dark red boots.
identity_text: The Goblin, a small green raider unit from the mobile strategy game Clash of Clans, shown bare-chested with red braces, shorts and boots.

appearance_text: A pink-skinned character with a brown bobbed haircut and green eyes. She wears a sage green vest with a row of gold buttons over a light grey long sleeve shirt, with brown cuffs at the wrists. Below she has a brown skirt and black boots with little gold buckles.
identity_text: An unnamed girl dressed as a traveller or explorer, in a sage green buttoned waistcoat over a light grey long sleeve shirt, with a gold wristwatch on one arm.

appearance_text: A lion walking upright, with soft tan fur all over and a shaggy brown mane that surrounds its face and runs down its back. Its eyes are orange, its nose dark red and its muzzle and chest are cream coloured. Its paws are pale cream.
identity_text: A lion standing upright, covered in tan fur with a shaggy brown mane, a cream muzzle and chest and pale cream paws.

head: goggles on top of the head
dark red headband
brown hair

appearance_text: A rugged character with a pair of goggles strapped across the top of the head over a dark red band, with dark brown hair beneath. The scruffy brown leather top leaves the shoulders and arms bare and is crossed by an orange strap over the chest. Patched brown trousers and heavy brown boots complete the worn, dirt-streaked outfit.
identity_text: Renegade Raider, a scavenger outfit from the battle royale game Fortnite. She wears a scruffy brown leather top with an orange chest strap and keeps blue-lensed goggles pushed up over a dark red headband.

face: shiny gold visor instead of a face
head: round blue helmet with a gold visor

appearance_text: A bulky figure sealed inside blue plated armour from head to toe, with darker grey padding at the joints and down the middle of the chest. The rounded helmet has a wide shiny gold visor where a face would be. Thick armour plates sit on the shoulders, knees and boots, and the back of the suit is plated the same blue.
identity_text: A Spartan super-soldier from Halo, sealed in blue power armour with a gold visor and heavy plates on the shoulders and knees.

top: red and black checked flannel jacket

appearance_text: A boy with swept brown hair and bright blue eyes. He wears a thick red and black checked flannel jacket, open over a black shirt, and the checks carry across the sleeves and back. His jeans are black with red cuffs above red and white shoes with white socks.
identity_text: An unnamed boy in a thick red and black checked flannel jacket, black jeans and red and white trainers.

appearance_text: A man with shaggy brown hair, a thick brown moustache and beard, and tired blue eyes. He wears a light blue button up shirt with white buttons and sleeves rolled up to show brown work gloves on his hands. His trousers are plain black, ending in black shoes. His hair covers the back of his head and the shirt is plain light blue behind.
identity_text: An unnamed shaggy haired, moustached miner in a light blue work shirt with rolled sleeves and brown gloves.

head: red roses tucked in the hair
green leaves in the hair

appearance_text: A girl with very long black hair reaching her waist, scattered with bright red roses and small green leaves. She wears a pink jacket with white stripes around the sleeves over a white top. Her skirt is light blue and she wears tall black boots.
identity_text: A girl with waist-length black hair threaded with red roses and green leaves, wearing a pink striped jacket over a white top with a blue skirt. The title describes her flowers rather than naming her.

head: dark green pointed hood
gold horn shapes on the hood
top: dark green robe with gold trim
glowing blue gem on the chest

appearance_text: A tall hooded figure in a long dark green robe, with a shadowed face where only glowing yellow eyes and a glowing light blue lower face show. Gold curved shapes rise from the hood like small horns, and gold lines trim the robe down the front and around the back. A pale blue gem glows on the chest, and the robe ends above glowing light blue boots.
identity_text: An unnamed hooded spellcaster in a dark green robe with gold trim and a glowing gem, the face lost in shadow except for glowing yellow eyes. "Earth Mage" names the elemental theme, not a character.

head: messy black hair over the face

appearance_text: A slim character whose long messy black hair hangs over their face so only one eye shows, with a small red clip on one side. They wear a bright yellow hoodie with a simple face printed across the chest — two black eyes and a wide grey mouth — and small black spots dotted down one sleeve. Black trousers and chunky white shoes finish the look, and the back of the hoodie is plain yellow.
identity_text: Ethobot, a Minecraft YouTuber and animator, drawn as a slim figure with long messy black hair over one eye and a bright yellow hoodie with a face printed on the chest.

appearance_text: A girl with bright orange hair and pointy orange fox ears poking up from her head. She wears a salmon pink sleeveless top with orange shoulder covers, and short blue shorts. A bushy orange tail hangs down her back, and her bare legs end in simple brown sandals.
identity_text: An unnamed fox girl with pointed orange ears and a bushy tail, dressed in warm sunset colours with blue shorts and brown sandals.

face: pale face mostly hidden by hair
head: hair split black on one side and light purple on the other

appearance_text: A pale character with shaggy hair split down the middle, black on one side and light purple on the other, hanging over small dark eyes. They wear a loose white hoodie with dark purple bands at the cuffs. Below it are dark purple shorts and light purple socks pulled up to the knee, ending in white shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed pale teenager whose shaggy hair is black on one side and light purple on the other, in a loose white hoodie with purple cuffs, dark purple shorts and long socks.

bottom: orange onesie legs with brown spots

colors.item: cuffs at the wrists and ankles
colors.name: dark brown

footwear: dark brown feet of the onesie
head: dark brown fringe over the eyes
top: orange giraffe onesie with brown spots

appearance_text: A girl with dark brown hair and a pink streak in it, big blue eyes and pink cheeks, peeking out of a hooded animal suit. The whole suit is warm orange covered in dark brown giraffe patches, running over the arms, body and legs, with a dark stripe down the back. Dark brown cuffs finish the sleeves and the feet.
identity_text: A child zipped into a hooded giraffe onesie, warm orange and covered in dark brown patches from the hood down to the feet, with dark hair and a pink streak showing around the face.

accessories: flower crown of red, white and blue flowers
hair: long pale blonde hair down the back
head: flower crown
subjects: girl in an american flag outfit
top: red and white striped top with a blue star panel

appearance_text: A girl with long pale blonde hair that falls all the way down her back, blue eyes and pink cheeks. On her head sits a crown of red, white and blue flowers. Her short top is striped red and white with a blue panel of white stars, her sleeves match the stripes, and she wears denim blue shorts with her arms and legs bare.
identity_text: An unnamed girl dressed for a national holiday in a stars-and-stripes top, denim shorts and a red, white and blue flower crown, with long pale blonde hair and bare feet.

head: stone head
pointed ears
horns
top: glowing orange gem in the middle of the chest

appearance_text: A tall figure made of grey and brown stone with a horned head and glowing orange eyes. Its chest is covered in cracked stone plates with a bright orange gem glowing in the middle. Orange light shines out of the cracks around its hands and wrists, and its legs are heavy stone slabs.
identity_text: A heavy guardian built of cracked stone, lit from inside by orange glow at the eyes, the chest gem and the cracks around its hands. The title states its job rather than naming it.

bottom: light blue trousers with white clouds
face: huge round white eyes with black pupils
wide red-orange beak with a black line
head: big yellow bird head

appearance_text: A round yellow bird with a very big head, huge white eyes with black dots for pupils, and a wide red-orange beak. Its chest is soft yellow feathers and small yellow wings sit on its arms. Below the body it wears light blue trousers covered in little white clouds, like flying through the sky.
identity_text: Flappy Bird, the round yellow mascot bird of the mobile game, with enormous white eyes and a wide orange beak, here given cloud-patterned sky-blue trousers.

appearance_text: A grown man with short dark brown hair and a full dark beard. He wears a plain purple t-shirt with bare arms and tan shorts that stop above the knee. On his feet are red shoes with white socks. A large red backpack is strapped across his back.
identity_text: Ethan Klein, the YouTuber behind h3h3productions, drawn as a bearded man in a purple t-shirt and tan shorts with a big red backpack.

appearance_text: Someone with short greyish purple hair that hangs down over their eyes, with pink cheeks showing below. They wear a big puffy blue jacket with wide baggy sleeves that covers the chest, arms and back. Their trousers are light grey and their shoes are white with a blue stripe.
identity_text: An unnamed boy in an oversized bright blue hoodie with light grey trousers and white trainers, his grey-purple fringe covering his eyes.

head: pointy ear tufts
pale yellow hair
motifs: red flame marking on the back

appearance_text: A soft pale yellow character with matching pale yellow hair that curls at the shoulders and two pointed ear tufts standing up on her head. Her eyes are black with pink blush marks underneath and a tiny red mouth below. She wears only a small white top and white briefs, leaving her arms, middle and legs bare. A red flame-shaped mark runs down the middle of her back.
identity_text: An unnamed animal-girl whose skin and hair are the same pale yellow, with pointed ear tufts, pink blush marks and a red flame-shaped marking down her back, wearing only a small white top and briefs.

appearance_text: A pale girl with very long pink hair that falls all the way down her back, with two pink cat ears and tiny white blossoms tucked in near them. Her cheeks are pink with blush and her eyes are dark. She wears a soft pink top with sage green stripes around the sleeves and matching pink shorts, with green knee socks and small white shoes.
identity_text: A pastel cat girl themed on spring blossom, with pink hair down to her knees, pink cat ears and little white flowers tucked in beside them, a pink top with sage green striped sleeves and green knee socks.

footwear: dark red shoes with white soles
top: white bird shaped emblem on the chest
darker red pattern on the back

appearance_text: A boy with light brown hair and dark red eyes. He wears a dark red jumper with a small white bird shaped emblem in the middle of the chest and a darker red pattern spread across the back. His trousers are cream coloured and his shoes dark red with white soles.
identity_text: An unnamed boy with light brown hair and dark red eyes, wearing a dark red jumper carrying a small white bird-shaped emblem on the chest, with cream trousers and dark red shoes.

hair: very long hair down the back
head: long blue hair
blue fringe
top: pink and purple striped crop top

appearance_text: A girl with very long blue hair that hangs past her waist at the back. She wears an open purple jacket over a pink and purple striped crop top, with light blue denim shorts. Her legs are bare down to short black boots.
identity_text: A teenage girl with waist-length blue hair in an open purple jacket, a striped crop top, denim shorts and short black boots.

bottom: orange tunic with a jagged hem
hair: short black hair sticking out at the sides

appearance_text: A stocky caveman with short black hair sticking out at the sides, a big nose and heavy dark eyebrows. He wears a bright orange tunic covered in black spots, with a jagged hem and one shoulder left bare, and a small blue tie knotted at his neck. His arms and legs are bare and so are his feet.
identity_text: Fred Flintstone, the caveman lead of the animated sitcom The Flintstones, shown in his orange spotted tunic and little blue tie.

face: yellow beak instead of a nose and mouth
head: brown hair
yellow beak

appearance_text: A man with short brown hair, bright blue eyes and a curved yellow beak in place of a nose and mouth. He wears a white tunic with blue shoulders, a gold collar and a red band running down the chest, with gold bracers on his wrists. His trousers are white with gold bands, and his boots end in brown bird talons. A long red cape marked with a gold emblem hangs down his back.
identity_text: A bird-man superhero themed after a falcon: a yellow beak in place of nose and mouth, a white tunic with blue shoulders and gold trim, talon-tipped boots and a long red cape with a gold emblem.

top: light blue and white striped shirt
brown belt straps on the sleeves

appearance_text: An old man with short grey hair, a bushy grey beard and moustache, and dark green eyes set in a lined face. He wears a long dark red coat with brown straps on the sleeves, open over a light blue and white striped shirt. His trousers are dark brown and he wears black boots. The back of the coat is the same dark red and hangs down past his waist.
identity_text: An unnamed grey haired, grey bearded old explorer in a long dark red coat with gold trim over a striped shirt.

bottom: dark grey trousers with orange cuffs
face: orange bandana over the nose and mouth
head: dark blue hood
orange flame marks on the sides
top: dark blue jacket with orange trim
big orange emblem on the back

appearance_text: A boy hidden inside a dark blue hood with jagged orange flame marks on each side, and an orange bandana pulled up over his nose and mouth so only one eye shows. His dark jacket has orange trim at the wrists and a big orange badge across the back. Dark grey trousers with orange cuffs lead down to black shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed boy kitted out for parkour, his face hidden behind an orange bandana under a dark hooded head with flame markings, in a dark jacket with orange trim.

head: green slime covering the head like hair

appearance_text: A girl covered in soft green slime that sits on her head like hair and drips down over her shoulders. Her face is tan with bright green eyes, and her top and short skirt look like sheets of wobbling green goo, held with a pale belt at the waist. Her lower legs are wrapped in the same green slime, and a squashy slime blob shape shows on her back.
identity_text: An unnamed girl dressed up as a slime, in a green gooey hood, top, skirt and leg wraps over tan skin and blonde hair.

hair: blue puffy tufts at the sides
head: bald top of head
clown makeup

appearance_text: A clown with a chalk-white painted face, a big square red nose and a wide pink grin. The top of the head is bald with puffy blue tufts of hair sticking out over each ear. He wears a pink shirt with yellow sleeves and a blue bow tie, baggy green trousers and red shoes.
identity_text: Krusty the Clown from The Simpsons, in white clown make-up with a square red nose, a pink shirt with yellow sleeves, a blue bow tie and green trousers.

appearance_text: A girl with long wavy brown hair falling around her face. She wears a pale grey wrapped robe with long sleeves, cinched by a wide brown belt at the waist. Grey trousers show below the robe and her feet are in short black boots.
identity_text: Rey Skywalker, the heroine of the Star Wars sequel trilogy, in her pale wrapped desert robe cinched with a wide brown belt, with long wavy brown hair and short black boots.

appearance_text: A hulking two-legged reptile covered in rough brown and olive scales. Its long snout is lined with rows of sharp cream teeth and two small orange eyes sit high on its bumpy head. Darker stripes run down its back and ridged plates cover its belly, ending in thick legs with clawed feet.
identity_text: Neovenator, a large meat-eating theropod dinosaur of the Early Cretaceous, rendered as a scaly brown biped with a long toothy snout and clawed feet.

appearance_text: A woman with messy wavy brown hair falling around her face. She wears a rust red leather jacket hanging open over a plain black top, with her arms bare below the sleeves. Her trousers are grey with a faint check pattern and she has scuffed brown boots.
identity_text: Darlene Alderson, a character from the television series Mr. Robot, in a rust red leather jacket over a black top with grey checked trousers.

head: black hair
black eye mask
top: yellow letter badge on the chest

appearance_text: A young hero with short black hair and a black mask across his eyes, showing only white eye slits. He wears a red tunic with a yellow badge on the chest, green sleeves and green gloves, and a bright yellow cape hangs down his back. A yellow belt sits at his waist above short green shorts, bare legs and green boots.
identity_text: Robin, Batman's young sidekick, in the classic costume: black domino mask, red tunic with a yellow chest emblem, green sleeves and gloves, a yellow belt and cape, and green shorts and boots.

accessories: striped raccoon tail on the back
head: raccoon head hood with ears
dark brown animal face on top of the hood

appearance_text: A boy wearing a full grey animal onesie. The hood is a dark brown raccoon head with round ears and a little animal face on top, and his own face looks out below it with big blue eyes and a brown fringe. The suit is plain grey with paw ends on the hands and feet, and a black and grey striped tail hangs down the back.
identity_text: A boy wearing a full grey raccoon onesie, with the animal-head hood up over his own face and a striped tail down the back.

colors.item: carved pumpkin worn over the head
colors.name: brown

face: one brown eye showing beside the pumpkin
hair: greyish brown hair poking out at the side
head: brown carved pumpkin pulled over the head
green stem on top
subjects: girl with a pumpkin on her head

appearance_text: A girl with a big brown carved pumpkin pulled down over her head, a small green stem sticking up from the top and a wisp of greyish brown hair escaping at one side. She wears a soft grey jumper crossed with green stripes down the arms and body. Below it are short black shorts and long white socks that come up past her knees.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with a carved pumpkin pulled down over her head like a mask, wearing a green-striped grey jumper, black shorts and long white socks.

head: patterned block head with two small spikes
top: purple body covered in circuit patterns

appearance_text: A faceless figure covered from head to toe in swirling maze-like lines. The pattern is mostly purple and black with streaks of pink and pale glowing blue, and two little spikes stick up from the head. The same circuit-like lines wrap all the way round the arms, legs and back with no clothing shapes at all.
identity_text: A faceless figure with no clothing shapes at all, wrapped head to toe in swirling purple, black and pink maze-like lines. The listing calls it a pattern skin rather than naming any character.

bottom: dark green armoured legs with green glowing lines
face: bright green glow around the eyes
head: green creeper face

appearance_text: A green monster with a wide square face, dark square eyes and a big dark open mouth. Its body is covered in dark green plated armour with spiky shoulder plates and bright glowing green streaks running down the chest, arms and legs. The back is almost black with the same glowing green edges.
identity_text: A boss version of the Creeper, cased in dark green plate armour with spiked shoulders and bright green light glowing along every seam of its body.

head: gold crown
brown headband with a red jewel

appearance_text: A green mottled monster with two black square eyes and a wide black frowning mouth. On its head sits a gold spiked crown over a brown band with a red jewel in the middle. Gold armour covers its shoulders and chest in curved plates, while its arms and legs stay green and blotchy. Its boots are green with gold trim.
identity_text: A Creeper crowned as a king, wearing a gold spiked crown with a red jewel and curved gold plate armour across its shoulders and chest, with gold-trimmed boots.

appearance_text: A tanned character with spiky bright light blue hair, with a small orange starfish stuck in the back of it and a pale round shell at the side. An orange sleeveless top leaves the arms bare and shows a strong chest. Light blue jeans held by a grey belt run down into scuffed brown boots.
identity_text: An unnamed tanned beach boy with spiky pale blue hair and a starfish in it, in an orange sleeveless top, blue shorts and brown boots.

hair: short brown hair with a straight fringe
head: short brown hair

appearance_text: A man with short brown hair cut in a straight fringe, a neat brown beard and moustache, and purple eyes in a tan face. He wears a plain cyan short sleeved shirt that leaves his forearms bare. His trousers are blue and he wears simple grey shoes.
identity_text: Steve, the default player character of Minecraft, drawn in the brighter cyan-shirted look used in the game's promotional artwork.

face: glowing white eye slits behind a helmet
head: black helmet covering the whole head
top: dark armoured jacket over a grey chest plate

appearance_text: A tall figure covered head to toe in dark armour. The black helmet hides the whole face except two glowing white slits where the eyes should be. Dark grey plating sits over the shoulders and arms above a lighter grey chest piece, and a brown leather belt holds up worn brown trousers. Heavy black boots cover the feet.
identity_text: An unnamed knight covered head to toe in near-black armour, with two glowing white slits where the eyes would be.

appearance_text: A green square-headed monster with black square eyes and a jagged black mouth, wrapped in a white pointed hood. It wears long white robes with a bright red sash running down the chest and a brown belt at the waist. A grey strap crosses its back. Black boots cover its feet.
identity_text: A creeper, the green Minecraft mob, dressed in the white hooded robes and red sash of an Assassin's Creed assassin. The robes are the costume; the figure wearing them is a creeper.

hair: long blonde hair down the back
head: blonde fringe

appearance_text: A girl with long blonde hair that hangs down her back and a fringe over her forehead. She has green eyes and tanned skin, and her shoulders and arms are bare. Her top is covered in a brown leopard print, and she wears long white trousers with a tiny red buckle at the waist and white shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed blonde girl in a fashion outfit: a dark brown designer-print top, wide white trousers and a striped designer belt. The title describes the style rather than naming anyone.

head: green hood pulled up
orange fringe poking out
top: green hoodie with the hood up

appearance_text: A girl in an all-green speckled hoodie with the hood pulled right up, only her orange fringe and face showing. She has brown eyes, pink blushing cheeks and a small smile. The hoodie is short, leaving her middle bare above matching green shorts, and she wears tall dark green boots. The green speckled pattern covers her arms and back too.
identity_text: Cupa, the creeper-themed fan character, here with her green speckled hoodie pulled right up so only her orange fringe and blushing face show.

colors.item: fire glowing in the chest furnace
colors.name: orange

head: rounded copper head
riveted plates
top: copper chest with a little furnace door
orange flames showing through the bars

appearance_text: A robot built from riveted copper plates gone brown and rusty at the edges. Its head is a rounded box with two dark square holes for eyes and a row of square teeth below. A little grated furnace door sits in the middle of its chest with orange flames glowing behind the bars. Bolted plates cover its shoulders, arms and legs, and its back is plain riveted metal.
identity_text: An unnamed brass-and-copper automaton with a fire burning behind a grate in its chest. 'Steambot' names the kind of machine, not a character.

appearance_text: A stocky metal robot built out of grey and white plates with brown rusty streaks all over. Its boxy head has two little horn bumps on top, huge round white eyes that bulge out at the sides, and a wide dark slot for a mouth. The chest and arms are riveted armour panels, and the thick legs are the same worn metal all the way down, with plating across the back too.
identity_text: Josef, the little robot from the point-and-click adventure game Machinarium, built out of rusty grey and white riveted plates with huge round eyes.

appearance_text: A man with short dark hair, brown skin and a full black beard and moustache. He wears a bright orange puffy jacket with thick padded rings, open over a plain cream shirt, and the orange padding wraps right around his back. A thin necklace hangs at his chest. His legs are in light blue jeans and his feet in brown shoes.
identity_text: The Canadian rapper Drake, wearing the bright orange puffer jacket from his Hotline Bling video over a cream shirt and light blue jeans.

top: black dungaree straps over the shoulders

appearance_text: A tan skinned boy with messy dark brown hair and light blue eyes. He wears a white t-shirt with short puffy sleeves under black dungarees whose straps cross over his shoulders and buckle at the front. The dungaree legs run all the way down to tan coloured shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed tan skinned boy in black dungarees with crossed shoulder straps over a white puff sleeved t-shirt, with tan shoes and messy dark brown hair.

face: big round white eyes with small black dots
head: blue knitted hat with a red band

appearance_text: A small boy in a knitted blue hat with a red band pulled down over his head. His face is mostly two big round white eyes with tiny black dots and a little open mouth. He wears a brown jacket fastened with three round buttons and red cuffs at the wrists. His jeans and shoes are blue.
identity_text: Stan Marsh, the boy in the blue bobble hat and brown jacket from the cartoon South Park.

bottom: blue jeans with dark rot patches

colors.item: rotted half of the face and body
colors.name: black

face: white teeth showing through a rotted cheek
head: short brown hair
top: teal shirt with black rot spreading across it

appearance_text: A man with short brown hair, a teal shirt and blue jeans, but half of him has rotted away into black. One eye glows red and white teeth show through the torn cheek. Dark rot spreads over one arm, across the chest and over the back, with dull red stains around the edges.
identity_text: Minecraft's Steve in his teal shirt and blue jeans, with half of him rotted away to black: one glowing red eye and white teeth showing through the ruined side of his face.

bottom: bare legs under the long jumper
hair: light brown hair with a fringe
head: floppy brown bunny ears
top: little white bunny face on the chest

appearance_text: A girl with light brown hair and a pair of floppy brown rabbit ears on her head. She wears a baggy brown jumper that slips off her shoulders and has a little white bunny face printed on the chest, with a fluffy white tail at the back. Her legs are bare below the long jumper and she wears short brown boots, and one ear has a small blue earring.
identity_text: An unnamed girl dressed as a rabbit, with floppy brown ears, a baggy brown bunny jumper and a fluffy white tail over short brown boots.

hair: long brown hair down the back
head: blue hood with big white squid eyes on the sides

appearance_text: A girl with long brown hair and bright teal eyes wearing a blue hoodie pulled up, with two big white squid eyes staring out from the sides of the hood. Under the open hoodie she wears a black and white striped shirt. Her trousers are dark blue fading paler at the bottom and her shoes are light blue. Her hair hangs in a long brown sweep down her back.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in a squid-themed costume hoodie, the blue hood carrying two big white eyes at the sides, worn open over a black and white striped shirt.

head: brown hair
top: blue hoodie fading into glowing purple

appearance_text: A boy with short brown hair and purple eyes wearing a hoodie that fades from bright blue at the shoulders into a glowing purple cloud across the belly. White drawstrings hang from the hood at his chest. On the back of the hoodie is a dark creeper-style face with square eyes and a frowning mouth, and black trousers lead down to purple and blue shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed boy with short brown hair in a blue-to-purple galaxy hoodie that carries a creeper face on the back, wearing headphones.

accessories: brown backpack with straps over both shoulders
hair: dark brown hair with a fringe

appearance_text: A boy with dark brown hair and purple eyes. He wears a grey jacket hanging open over a purple and white checked shirt, with dark grey trousers and brown boots. A brown backpack is strapped over both shoulders and sits on his back.
identity_text: An unnamed boy kitted out for school or a hike, in an open grey jacket over a checked shirt with dark grey trousers, brown boots and a brown backpack on his back.

appearance_text: A girl with short black hair falling over her eyes and pale green eyes underneath. She wears a bright red jacket decorated with swirling gold flame patterns down the sleeves and front, and a big round gold badge on the back. Dark brown trousers and dark red shoes finish the outfit.
identity_text: A black-haired girl dressed for Lunar New Year in a red jacket patterned with gold swirls and a gold medallion on the back. The title describes the occasion rather than naming anyone.

face: no face at all, just bricks
head: a block of red bricks

appearance_text: A figure built entirely out of red bricks laid in rows with light grey mortar between them, from the top of the head right down to the feet. There is no face, no hair and no clothing, just brickwork on every side including the back. The bricks vary a little in shade, some bright orange-red and some darker.
identity_text: A person-shaped figure built entirely out of red brick blocks with pale grey mortar, with no face, hair or clothing on any side.

bottom: orange striped legs with grey plating
face: dark blue mask across the eyes
head: two dark curved horns
orange animal head
top: grey armour over an orange body

appearance_text: A horned orange beast with two dark curved horns rising from its head and glowing light blue eyes set in a dark blue mask across its face. Chunky grey stone-like armour covers its shoulders, chest and back, with orange fur and brown stripes showing through the gaps. Its arms and legs are banded in the same orange and grey.
identity_text: An original armoured beast creature with an orange striped hide showing through blue-grey stone plating, two dark curved horns and glowing cyan eyes behind a dark blue face band.

bottom: black robot legs with glowing blue stripes
head: black helmet
no face
glowing blue edges around the head
top: glowing blue lines down the chest and arms

appearance_text: A tall machine covered in flat black panels with bright light blue lines glowing along every edge. Its head is a smooth black helmet with no face at all, only a glowing rim. The blue lines run down the chest, along both arms and around the legs, and the feet glow brightest of all.
identity_text: A faceless black machine outlined in glowing cyan along every panel edge, from the helmet rim down the chest and arms to boots that glow brightest of all. No character is named.

colors.item: one side of the long hair
colors.name: blue

colors.item: other side of the long hair
colors.name: pink

hair: long hair, blue on one side and pink on the other
head: long two coloured hair
small pink bow

appearance_text: A girl with very long hair that is bright blue down one side and candy pink down the other, falling far past her waist with a little pink bow near the top. Her eyes are large and purple. She wears a soft fluffy white coat with pale sleeves, light blue trousers and pink boots, and the two hair colours split her back straight down the middle.
identity_text: A girl whose very long hair is split blue down one side and pink down the other, wearing a fluffy white coat, light blue trousers and pink boots. The title describes the style, not a character.

head: long pink hair with yellow streaks
top: black top with a white skull print

appearance_text: A girl with very long pink hair streaked with yellow, tied so it hangs in a thick tail down her back, and sharp yellow eyes with dark markings around them. She wears a black sleeveless top with a big white skull printed on the front and checkered bands at the wrists, leaving her arms bare. Her trousers are black and her shoes are white with checkered trim.
identity_text: Plumeria, the Team Skull admin from the Pokémon Sun and Moon games, in her black skull-print tank top with very long pink and yellow hair.

appearance_text: A tall figure dressed head to toe in black. A smooth dark mask shaped like a blank face covers the whole head, with no eyes or mouth showing, and a black hood sits over it. The long black coat, trousers and boots are all the same near-black shade with faint grey shading, and the back is just as plain and dark.
identity_text: The Front Man, the masked figure who runs the games in Squid Game, dressed head to toe in black with a featureless face mask under a hood.

head: red backwards cap
top: white t-shirt with a round red sign

appearance_text: A boy with spiky light blue hair sticking out from under a red cap worn backwards. He wears a white t-shirt with a round red crossed-out sign on the chest. His jeans are blue and his shoes are red with white soles.
identity_text: The Boyfriend, the main character of the Newgrounds rhythm game Friday Night Funkin, with his backwards red cap, spiky blue hair and crossed-out-sign shirt.

face: big white eyes with black outlines
head: white otter head
small dark blue ears
top: cream shell stuck to the belly

appearance_text: A small white furred otter creature with two little dark blue ears on top of its head, big round white eyes and a large brown nose. Its chest is pale blue with a round cream coloured shell stuck to the middle of its belly, and its arms are white. The lower half of its body is dark blue, and a dark blue tail hangs behind it.
identity_text: Oshawott, the water type sea otter Pokémon, white furred with small dark blue ears, a large brown nose and a cream shell on its belly.

top: white skull print on the chest

appearance_text: A girl with long blue-grey hair and a straight fringe over pale skin. She wears a baggy black sweater with grey patches on the shoulders and a white skull printed in the middle of the chest, long enough to hang past her hips. Her legs are bare down to chunky boots striped in grey and white.
identity_text: A blue-grey haired girl in an oversized black sweater that hangs past her hips, with a small white skull on the chest. The listing names no character.

hair: grey hair round the sides and back

appearance_text: An older man with a balding head, grey hair round the sides and a grey beard, wearing round black glasses. He is dressed in a plain black turtleneck jumper with the sleeves reaching the wrists, and blue jeans. White trainers finish the outfit, and the black jumper is plain all the way round the back.
identity_text: Steve Jobs, the co-founder of Apple, in his trademark black turtleneck, blue jeans and round glasses.

footwear: dark red boots with tan tops
head: tan hood with round bear ears
dark red hair spilling out
top: dark red patch down the back

appearance_text: A girl with long dark red hair wearing a fluffy tan hoodie with round bear ears on the hood. The hoodie is baggy with wide sleeves and has a dark red patch running down the back. Below it she wears tan shorts, and dark red boots with tan cuffs come up her legs.
identity_text: A girl with long dark red hair in a fluffy tan bear-eared hoodie, tan shorts and dark red boots. No named character is involved; the bear is the costume.

appearance_text: A machine built like a person, plated in deep red over a grey metal body. A single glowing yellow light burns behind the visor of its helmet, and a bright yellow triangle glows in the middle of its chest and again on its back. Yellow trim runs along the shoulders and the legs end in heavy red metal boots.
identity_text: A humanoid machine plated in deep red over grey metal, with a single glowing yellow visor and a yellow core burning in its body.

appearance_text: A hulking creature covered in red scales with a pair of dark horns curving up from its head. Its yellow eyes have narrow black slits and its snout is ridged and scaly. Orange plated scales run down the chest and belly, and a line of dark spines steps down the middle of its back.
identity_text: A hulking red scaled creature with curving horns, narrow yellow eyes and an orange plated belly, described in the listing as coming from the depths of the ocean. It is a kind of monster rather than a named character.

face: mouth and chin only, eyes hidden by the helmet
head: dark helmet covering the eyes

appearance_text: A man in a red army jacket with a row of small grenades strapped across the chest. A dark helmet is pulled so low that only his mouth and chin show, and a strap runs across his back. He wears black trousers and black boots.
identity_text: The Soldier from Team Fortress 2, in RED team colours: a man in a red army jacket with a helmet over his eyes and grenades across his chest.

bottom: bare legs under the long pyjama top

colors.item: teddy bear print on the chest
colors.name: brown

footwear: tall light purple socks with orange markings
head: long light brown hair
top: brown teddy bear printed on the chest

appearance_text: A girl with long light brown hair falling over her shoulders and down her back, and big blue eyes. She wears a baggy light purple pyjama jumper with white cuffs and a little brown teddy bear printed on the chest. The top is long enough that her legs are bare above her tall light purple socks, which have small orange markings and soft fluffy white tops.
identity_text: An unnamed girl in a baggy lavender pyjama jumper printed with a little brown teddy bear, worn long over bare legs and tall fluffy-topped socks.

face: tiny dark mouth low on one side
head: plain orange head
top: plain orange body with faint stripes

appearance_text: A simple figure coloured pumpkin orange from head to toe, with faint darker stripes running down its body like the ridges of a pumpkin. Its face is almost blank apart from two small dark square eyes and a tiny mouth set low and off to one side. It has no hair, clothes or shoes, and the back is plain orange too.
identity_text: A slime rendered as a plain pumpkin-orange humanoid with two small dark square eyes and a tiny off-centre mouth, wearing no clothes at all.

colors.item: hood at the back of the head
colors.name: brown

face: dark eyes under a white fringe
hair: short white hair with a fringe over the eyes
head: brown hood down at the back of the head

appearance_text: A pale figure with short white hair falling in a fringe over dark eyes, with a brown hood pushed down at the back of the head. A soft light blue scarf is wrapped around the neck and hangs over the chest. The jacket is dark brown and heavy, worn over brown trousers, and the boots are scuffed dark brown that come up over the ankles.
identity_text: An unnamed white haired traveller dressed for the road in a heavy dark brown jacket, a soft light blue scarf and worn boots.

head: red and white cap
top: red jacket with a raised collar
round blue and white ball emblem on the back

appearance_text: A boy in a red cap with a white front panel, with black hair tucked underneath and calm brown eyes. He wears a red jacket with a high collar over black long sleeves, and a big round blue and white ball emblem is printed across the back. His dark blue jeans end in chunky red and black shoes.
identity_text: A boy dressed as a Pokemon trainer from Kanto in the official Sygna Suit outfit from Pokemon Masters, with a big ball emblem on the back of the jacket.

accessories: glowing orange lantern at the waist
bottom: black robe fading into purple flames

colors.item: flames at the bottom of the robe
colors.name: purple

head: orange carved pumpkin head

appearance_text: A tall figure whose head is a carved orange pumpkin with glowing yellow eyes and a jagged glowing mouth. It wears a long black robe with a glowing purple gem set on the chest and a small orange lantern burning at the waist. The bottom of the robe and the arms fade away into bright purple flames instead of feet.
identity_text: A tall robed figure with a carved, glowing pumpkin for a head, a purple gem on its chest and a small lantern at its waist, trailing purple flame where its feet should be.

appearance_text: A creature made all of green jelly, shaped like a very strong person. Its head is a plain green cube with two darker green eyes and a tiny mouth. Big bulging muscles show on its chest, arms and back in slightly lighter green, and its legs are thick and green to match.
identity_text: A Minecraft slime shaped like a very strong person, its green jelly body moulded into bulging muscles on the chest, arms and back. The listing calls it a slime that has been hitting the gym.

hair: very long hair down the back
head: long rainbow coloured hair
fringe over the eyes

appearance_text: A girl covered in bright colours from head to toe. Her very long hair mixes light blue, purple, green and yellow and hangs all the way down her back. She wears a bright orange top under an open red jacket, yellow shorts, and tall purple boots on striped yellow legs.
identity_text: A girl wearing every bright colour at once, with rainbow hair down to her waist. "Queen of Colour" is a nickname for the look, not a character.

appearance_text: A boy with fluffy brown hair and dark eyes wearing a pale blue-grey hoodie left open over a plain white shirt. The hood sits bunched behind his neck and the back of the hoodie is the same soft grey. Dark grey shorts and grey and white shoes finish the outfit.
identity_text: An unnamed boy in a plain pale blue-grey hoodie worn open over a white shirt, with dark grey trousers and grey and white shoes. The title is a joke about how ordinary the outfit is.

hair: short blonde hair with a fringe
subjects: boy in a black t-shirt with a blue dinosaur print
top: black t-shirt with a blue cartoon crocodile on the front

appearance_text: A boy with short blonde hair and big blue eyes. His black t-shirt has a little blue cartoon crocodile with a yellow spiky back printed on the chest, and the back of the shirt is plain black. He wears blue jeans and grey shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed blonde boy in a black long-sleeved top printed with a little blue cartoon crocodile, blue jeans and pale shoes. The creature is a print on his shirt, not the figure itself.

hair: long pale blue hair down the back
top: dark navy sweater sprinkled with white star dots

appearance_text: A pale girl with very long soft ice blue hair that spills down her back and big dark eyes. Her sweater is dark navy, sprinkled all over with little white star dots, and it stops above her waist. Below it she wears a short white skirt, and her legs disappear into chunky black boots dotted with the same white specks.
identity_text: A pale girl with very long ice blue hair, wearing a star-speckled navy sweater above a short white skirt and chunky dark boots.

accessories: gold sword design down the back
head: white spiky hair

appearance_text: A pale boy with bright white spiky hair hanging over blue eyes. He wears a dark navy jacket with a row of buttons down the front, black padded shoulders and long pale sleeves. A tall gold sword shape runs the length of his back. His trousers are black with small gold markings on the thigh, and his shoes are white.
identity_text: Parzival, the game avatar of the main character in Ready Player One, with spiky white hair, a dark navy jacket over pale patterned sleeves and a gold sword emblem down his back.

appearance_text: A bald figure with a huge flat nose, a thick straight brow and small teal eyes. He wears a long plain brown robe that reaches past his knees with the sleeves folded across his front. Grey trousers and grey shoes show below the robe, and the back of the robe is the same brown.
identity_text: A Minecraft villager, the passive village NPC, bald with an oversized flat nose, a heavy unibrow and a long plain brown robe with the arms folded in front.

face: small red tentacles under the mouth
head: red lobster head

appearance_text: A red lobster-like creature standing upright, with a boxy red head, pale bulging eyes and small red tentacles dangling below its mouth. It wears a long white doctor coat with a light blue collar, plain white right around the back. Below the coat are pale green scrub trousers with red cuffs, and its hands and feet are bare red claws.
identity_text: Dr. Zoidberg, the crustacean alien doctor from the animated series Futurama, in his white medical coat over pale green scrubs, with bare red claws.

bottom: dark navy trousers with white drawstrings
head: icy blue head with frosty streaks
top: icy blue chest and arms with white streaks

appearance_text: A figure whose head, chest and arms look carved out of pale blue ice, with lighter white streaks running through them like cracks in a frozen block. Two small dark eyes sit in the middle of the face and there is no mouth. From the waist down it wears plain dark navy trousers with white drawstrings and white shoes.
identity_text: A figure whose head, chest and arms look carved out of cracked pale blue ice, with two small dark eyes and no mouth, wearing ordinary navy joggers and white shoes below the waist. No character is named.

head: long red brown hair
flower crown of pink and white flowers

appearance_text: A girl with long red-brown hair reaching her waist and calm green eyes, wearing a crown of pink and white flowers around the back of her head. Her sweater is soft green with long sleeves. Short pink shorts leave her legs bare, and she wears white socks pulled up under pink shoes.
identity_text: A girl with long auburn hair wearing a crown of pink and white flowers, a soft green sweater, pink shorts and white socks under pink shoes.

bottom: green trousers with dark camouflage patches
head: green cap with a dark red crown
goggles pushed up on the cap

appearance_text: A small adventurer in a green cap with a dark red crown and a pair of light blue goggles strapped across the front. He wears a red sleeveless vest that leaves his tan arms bare, with a belt and pouch at his waist and a bulky pack strapped to his back. His green trousers are patched with darker camouflage and tuck into brown boots.
identity_text: Teemo, the swift scout from League of Legends, in his green goggled cap, red vest and camouflage-patched green trousers.

appearance_text: A girl with long brown hair, one thick braid falling over her shoulder and a small dark red tie at the top of her head. Her eyes are bright teal and her cheeks are pink. She wears a soft light grey blue hoodie with a green scarf around her neck, salmon pink trousers and brown shoes.
identity_text: A girl in a light grey-blue hoodie with a green scarf, salmon pink trousers and a long brown braid; the listing calls her a girl gamer. The title describes her rather than naming anyone.

head: spiky black hair
top: light blue jacket with a hood
grey creeper face printed across the back

appearance_text: A boy with spiky black hair wearing a light blue hooded jacket with white bands around the sleeves. Across the whole back of the jacket is a big grey creeper face with dark square eyes and a frowning mouth. His trousers are black and his shoes are light blue with white soles.
identity_text: An unnamed boy with spiky black hair in a light blue hooded jacket that carries a big grey creeper face across the back, with black trousers and light blue shoes.

appearance_text: A walking banana with a long yellow body and a big yellow banana shape down its back. Its face has two huge round eyes and a wide open red mouth. The arms and legs are dark green and the feet are black and white checks, with pale purple patches around the sides.
identity_text: A banana walking about on legs, with huge round googly eyes and a wide open red mouth, dark green limbs and chequered shoes.

bottom: black dungarees with crossed straps at the back
hair: long blonde hair with a straight fringe
head: long blonde hair
top: black and white striped long sleeve top

appearance_text: A girl with long blonde hair and big blue eyes. She wears a long sleeved top striped in black and white under black dungarees whose straps cross over her back. Her shoes are white with white socks showing above them.
identity_text: A blonde child dressed in bee colours, wearing a black and cream striped long-sleeved top under black dungarees with crossed straps.

hair: wild fluffy white hair sticking out at the sides
subjects: old man with wild white hair

appearance_text: An old man with a wrinkled face, wild fluffy white hair sticking out around his head and a big bushy white moustache under his nose. He wears a plain pale green knitted jumper with long sleeves. His trousers are dark green and his shoes are brown.
identity_text: Albert Einstein, the German physicist, as an old man with wild white hair and a bushy white moustache, in a pale green knitted jumper, dark green trousers and brown shoes.

head: pointed cat ears with pink insides

appearance_text: A fluffy kitten standing on two legs, covered in dark grey and black fur with a bright white chest and belly running down the front. Its round face has two big blue eyes, a little pink nose and a pale muzzle, with pointed ears that are pink inside. The grey fur carries over the back and down the arms and legs, mottled with lighter and darker patches.
identity_text: A kitten: a fluffy grey-black and white cat standing upright, with pointed ears pink on the inside. Not a particular named cat.

appearance_text: A girl with long light brown hair that falls past her shoulders and big grey eyes. She wears a soft pink sweater with white stripes near the cuffs of the long sleeves. Her legs are in light blue jeans and she has plain white shoes.
identity_text: An unnamed everyday girl with light brown hair, in a soft pink sweater with white cuff stripes, light blue jeans and plain white shoes.

appearance_text: A pale person with a big pile of fluffy dark purple hair covering most of their head. They wear a white shirt with puffy sleeves under a black waistcoat, with a dark red tie down the front. Black trousers and black shoes finish the outfit.
identity_text: A bar or restaurant worker in the standard waistcoat-shirt-and-tie uniform, with a big pile of very dark purple hair. The listing names an occupation, not a character.

head: grey headband
black hood
top: white swirl badge on the chest

appearance_text: A fighter with spiky silver hair under a wide grey headband and glowing red eyes. He wears an all black hooded top with a grey band across the chest and a white swirl badge on the front, with a pale star shape on the back of the hood. His trousers are black and his shoes are white.
identity_text: A fighter dressed head to toe in black with a wide grey headband, spiky silver hair and a white swirl badge on the chest, one eye glowing red. No character is named in the listing.

hair: long black hair to the shoulders
subjects: man with a long black beard

appearance_text: A pale man with long black hair hanging to his shoulders and a big bushy black beard and moustache covering most of his face. He is dressed in a long dark robe that reaches almost to the ground, dark all over with faint grey shading. His hands and dark boots peek out from under it.
identity_text: Grigori Rasputin, the Russian peasant mystic of the last imperial court, shown as a pale man with long black hair, a heavy black beard and a floor-length dark robe.

head: small pale ears poking through the hair

appearance_text: A pale girl with very long white hair, tinted pale blue at the tips, that falls right down her back with a soft fringe over big teal eyes. She wears a dark teal jacket, open over a dark grey top, and the jacket covers her shoulders and back. A grey skirt sits at her waist above teal leggings. Her feet are in chunky dark brown boots.
identity_text: An unnamed pale girl with floor-length white-blue hair, in a teal ombre jacket, grey skirt and chunky brown boots. "Dusk" is a mood title, not a character.

appearance_text: This character wears a brown leather flying cap with ear flaps and a pair of green-lensed goggles pushed up on the forehead. A dark blue waistcoat with gold buttons goes over a white shirt with rolled sleeves, and a pale green scarf sits at the neck. Brown leather gloves cover the forearms, and brown trousers tuck into tall black boots. A bulky black backpack is strapped across the back.
identity_text: An unnamed sky explorer in a leather flying cap and goggles, dressed in a waistcoat and shirt with a pack on his back.

accessories: light blue bands on the arms
hair: long purple hair down the back
head: long purple hair
small pale clips on top of the head

appearance_text: A slim character with long purple hair falling down the back, a purple fringe and pale blue eyes. The close fitting top is a pale pink, almost the same shade as the skin, and light blue bands are worn around the arms. Short dark grey shorts sit at the hips, leaving the legs bare down to bare feet.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with long purple hair in a pale pink top and short grey shorts, standing barefoot. Here 'Plum' describes her hair colour rather than naming a character or a fruit.

head: red and green hair clip
top: red top with black seed spots

appearance_text: A pale girl with very long straight black hair and a small red and green clip on top. She wears a red short-sleeved top covered in little black seed spots and a green skirt, so she looks like a slice of melon. Pink and white striped socks and red shoes finish it off, and her long hair hangs down her back.
identity_text: An unnamed girl with very long dark hair dressed to look like a slice of watermelon, in a seed-spotted red top over a green skirt.

appearance_text: A girl with pale sickly green skin and hollow black holes where her eyes should be. Long dark green hair hangs down over her shoulders and covers most of her back. She wears a torn teal top and short blue shorts, and her bare green arms and legs are blotched with darker patches. Dark grey shoes cover her feet.
identity_text: A zombie girl done in the Minecraft mob's colours, with pale green blotched skin, hollow black eyes and long dark green hair over a torn teal top.

face: one green eye and one blue eye

appearance_text: A pale character with brown hair swept over the forehead and hanging long down the back, with one green eye and one blue eye and a small smile. They wear a dark brown leather jacket with white cuffs, open over a light blue shirt. Their jeans are faded blue denim tucked into dark grey boots.
identity_text: An unnamed character with brown hair and two different coloured eyes, one green and one blue, wearing a dark brown leather jacket over a light blue shirt with faded jeans and dark grey boots.

appearance_text: A creature whose head looks like cracked grey stone with tan patches flaking off, lit by two glowing pale yellow eyes and a dark slit of a mouth. It wears a sharp black suit jacket over a white shirt with a black tie, white cuffs showing at the wrists. The trousers and shoes are black too, so only the strange stony head and hands stand out.
identity_text: A dried-out desert undead figure with cracked grey and tan skin and glowing pale eyes, dressed in a smart black suit and tie.

appearance_text: A grown man with short grey hair on the sides and a big bushy brown beard covering most of his face, with wide black eyes. He wears a plain white t-shirt with short sleeves and no print on the back. His jeans are blue with a brown belt, and his shoes are white.
identity_text: Crazy Dave, the pot-wearing neighbour from the game Plants vs. Zombies, in a plain white t-shirt, blue jeans and a brown belt.

appearance_text: A pale skinned young man with bright blue hair and pale teal eyes. He wears a blue tunic with a pale teal collar and a small red jewel pinned at the chest, with dark grey guards strapped to his arms. A pale teal cape hangs down his back, and a brown belt sits at his waist above blue trousers and brown boots.
identity_text: Marth, the blue-haired swordsman prince of the Fire Emblem role-playing games, in blue armour with a pale teal cape and a red jewel at his collar.

bottom: dark blue-green trousers with colourful speckles
head: bare head
top: rainbow striped jacket over a white shirt

appearance_text: A pale teenager with messy orange hair and brown eyes. They wear an open jacket striped in rainbow bands of red, orange, yellow, green and blue, with a plain white shirt showing underneath and the same rainbow bands wrapping right around the back. The trousers are dark blue-green flecked with bright colours, and the shoes are red with green flashes.
identity_text: A teenager with messy orange hair in a jacket striped in rainbow bands over a white shirt, with dark speckled trousers and red shoes.

face: light blue eyes behind the lenses
head: grey goggles pushed up on the head
top: white necklace with a red charm hanging at the back

appearance_text: A tanned man with short blond hair, grey goggles pushed up on his head and dark sunglasses over his eyes. He wears a green sleeveless top with a white cord necklace whose red charm hangs down his back. His long shorts are blue and he has brown sandals on bare feet.
identity_text: Martyn, a Minecraft YouTuber from the Yogscast, drawn as a tanned blond man in a green sleeveless top, long blue shorts and sandals.

accessories: face mask over the nose and mouth
orange scarf tucked into the coat
face: grey mask covering the nose and mouth
head: black flat cap pulled down
subjects: masked man in a long brown coat

appearance_text: A man in a black flat cap pulled low, with a grey mask covering his nose and mouth so only his eyes show. He wears a long brown trench coat over a grey top, with an orange scarf tucked in at the collar. His jeans are blue and his boots are black, and the coat hangs long and brown down his back.
identity_text: Aiden Pearce, the hacker vigilante from Watch Dogs, in his black flat cap, face mask and long brown trench coat over blue jeans and black boots.

appearance_text: A pale character with short white hair and glowing orange eyes, wearing a crown of red flowers with green leaves. A soft white hood covers the head and an orange fox fur cape is draped over the shoulders and down the arms. Underneath is a grey tunic with a black belt across the chest, cream trousers with fur trim, and dark brown boots.
identity_text: An unnamed pale-haired figure wrapped in an orange fox fur coat and a white hood, wearing a crown of red flowers.

colors.item: stripe on the back of the coat
colors.name: orange

appearance_text: A shambling undead figure with grey-green skin, two big bulging white eyes of different sizes and a wide open mouth full of blunt square teeth. He wears a scruffy brown coat over a white shirt with a long red tie, and there is an orange stripe running down the back of the coat. His blue jeans end in dark brown shoes.
identity_text: The brown coat zombie from Plants vs. Zombies: a grey-green undead figure with big bulging eyes and blunt teeth, shambling along in a scruffy brown coat and red tie.

appearance_text: A pale man with short dark brown hair and blue eyes, with a small black earpiece clipped to one ear. He wears a sharp dark grey suit jacket over a white shirt with a bright red tie down the chest, and a red mark is painted across the back of the jacket. Matching dark grey trousers and plain black shoes complete the outfit.
identity_text: James Bond, the secret agent, in a dark grey suit with a red tie and an earpiece at one ear.
